  - After: "Drop your weapons and die, heretic. We are the Sire's sickles!" {n}Fanatic zeal.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The whispers grow stronger, conjuring visions of strange worlds inhabited by unthinkable creatures... Or is it a single creature? It has Unity, Meaning, Purpose, and Perfection. It is magnificent, and next to it, you are nothing.{/n}
  - After: {n}Visions of one creature: Unity, Meaning, Purpose, Perfection. You are nothing.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is a strange... allure to the whispers. You begin to glimpse vague yet intriguing images — images of glorious victories and meaningful service, of a truly worthy goal, and of companions bound to you by the seal of genetic sameness. The angelic song enters into your dreams, revealing astounding truths.{/n}
  - After: {n}Alluring whispers: glory, purpose, kin of genetic sameness.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A ripple of dissonance runs through the chorus of voices as they screech in anger, vexation, defiance. The song no longer carries a sense of overpowering superiority.{/n}
  - After: {n}The chorus screeches in anger; its superiority falters.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His very presence is unbearable — it washes over your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}mind{/d}, twisting and crushing it. You feel a wet crack inside your skull, and blood comes pouring out of your eyes and nose.{/n}
  - After: {n}It crushes your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}mind{/d}; your eyes and nose bleed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You hear stifled groans behind you. Even standing near this entity is torturous for anyone who possesses psychic powers.{/n}
  - After: {n}Psykers behind you groan in pain.{/n}
- **Nemi Monteg**
  - Before: "You won't hurt him, heretic! The Sire won't let you! I won't let you!" {n}The girl's eyes burn with a fanatic zeal.{/n}
  - After: "You won't hurt him, heretic! I won't let you!" {n}Fanatic zeal.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something starts scratching at the walls of your mind, making you ill.{/n}
  - After: {n}Something scratches at your mind, sickening you.{/n}

  - Before: {n}Marazhai's face splits into a grin as he casts you a mocking look.{/n} "A sore spot with you, is it not?"
  - After: {n}Marazhai grins mockingly.{/n} "A sore spot, is it?"
- **Master Helmsman Ravor**
  - Before: {n}This simple truth, known to any and all {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}voidsmen{/d}, causes something in Ravor's mind to click.{/n} "I have... veered off? Blast me in the back with plasma torpedoes, who's watching the readings? And why am I aiming this thing at..."
  - After: {n}A {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}voidsman{/d}'s truth clicks.{/n} "Veered off? Why am I aiming at..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your heart feels strangely calm. It seems that performing feats of heroism has become {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}second nature{/d} to you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heroism is {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}second nature{/d}; you're calm.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The doppelganger peers into your smile. Displeased. Concerned. From the imperious look in {mf|his|her} eyes, {mf|he|she} expects submission, but there is no submission or fear in you. And this inspires terror.{/n}
  - After: {n}In {mf|his|her} eyes: {mf|he|she} expected submission, finds none, and fears.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A rumbling growl shudders through every nerve ending in your body. It is the roar of a beast defending its territory. The throne is no longer yours. It was never yours in the first place.{/n}
  - After: {n}A territorial roar. The throne was never yours.{/n}
- **Nemi Monteg**

You {d|Encyclopedia:HelpedInfernusFamily}recognise{/d} the Infernus Master's sister and niece, Nemi and Mia. Their faces are no longer friendly, but twisted with determination and hatred.{/n}
  - After: {n}Among the mutineers: Nemi and Mia, the Infernus Master's kin you {d|Encyclopedia:HelpedInfernusFamily}recognise{/d}, now hateful.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sacrifice of the many paves the way to a triumphant future for the titan that is the Protector of the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperiumGlossary}Imperium{/g}. It is a heavy burden to be the ground beneath His feet, but it is glorious to serve such a righteous purpose in unity.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The strands of fate are fragile — yet woven together, they are strong. Not everyone is destined to see this voyage through to its end, but no one will be forgotten.{/n}
  - After: {n}Not all will see the voyage's end, but none will be forgotten.{/n}

  - Before: {n}You close your eyes and hear a quiet splash — Kibellah has entered the pool. She puts her hands around your neck and gently pushes you under the water. As your lungs start to burn, she pulls you back to the surface, allowing you to take a single breath of air before she begins to drown you again. This process repeats several times, and she holds you beneath the surface a little longer with each plunge. The fourth descent lasts an eternity — but her hands prevent you from resurfacing.{/n}

  - Before: {n}After a few heavy seconds of silence, Kibellah exhales through clenched teeth. Fury slowly gives way to weariness, despair. Then, quietly, she says,{/n} "Our bond, Domin'{name}. Our bond was a mistake. I can't pass this trial because my thoughts are distracted by pointless worries."
  - After: {n}Fury fades to despair.{/n} "Our bond was a mistake, Domin'{name}. It distracts me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah shakes her head.{/n} "Whatever has stretched the thread between us, we must stop it. It blurs our reason, robs our thoughts of their cold clarity, makes us lose the path... through the labyrinth..." {n}Her fingers twitch, instinctively looking for a knife.{/n} "The Vizsier... told us..."
  - After: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "We must cut this thread..." {n}Her fingers seek a knife.{/n} "The Vizsier told us..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My grief is all the bitterer for knowing the truth: though worry for you stabs at my mind without remit, yours is occupied with thoughts of another — the one you've tied yourself to in the same way we are bound."
  - After: "Worse, I worry for you while you think of another, bound to you as we are."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah tilts her head.{/n} "What you call mysterious is merely the difference between the worlds we each inhabit. You have stepped into my labyrinth, and I have become your shadow. And yet... we have no understanding of one another, or of each other's customs and rituals. I cannot imagine that you were able to comprehend what transpired on the officers' deck in its full depth."
  - After: {n}She tilts her head.{/n} "Just different worlds. I doubt you grasped what happened on the officers' deck."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah nods.{/n} "And yet we both serve Him, as is our duty."
  - After: {n}She nods.{/n} "Yet we both serve Him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah thinks for a moment before a spark of curiosity flashes in her eyes.{/n} "I would not be against learning more about your world, seeing your rituals, Domin'{name}... should you be open to showing them to me."
  - After: {n}Curiosity sparks.{/n} "I'd like to see your rituals, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The expression in Kibellah's eyes changes: she glances at you from beneath her eyelashes and smiles slightly.{/n} "I'm here, Domin'{name}."
  - After: {n}She smiles slightly.{/n} "I'm here, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah clenches her fists.{/n} "The Tenets of the Bloodspun Web give us purpose, a destiny in His service! How could I even consider—" {n}She groans as if in pain.{/n} "Then again, the Vizsier also didn't consider a place as poisoned as this..."
  - After: {n}She clenches her fists.{/n} "The Tenets are my purpose! How could—" {n}She groans.{/n} "But the Vizsier never foresaw this place..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She falls silent. The echo of a grim smirk crosses her lips.{/n} "The Dark City's shadows will hide my every trespass against the Bloodspun Web, and I will emerge purified. Strong. Untarnished." {n}She glances at you warily.{/n} "Leave me, Domin'{name}. I must traverse the labyrinth with your words in my soul."
  - After: {n}A grim smirk.{/n} "These shadows will hide my trespasses." {n}A wary glance.{/n} "Leave me, Domin'{name}."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are my Domin. I am your blade, and I am honed by your blessing. My arms are strong while your will is strong. - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The twining is the blood oath I have made to my {mf|lord|lady}." {n}Kibellah dips her fingers in the spilt blood and traces a symbol, first on her own forehead, then on yours. It appears to resemble a blade that is cutting through an intricate knot.{/n}

The twining is complete: you and I are now bound by the blood oath. Think of me while I hunt, as will I think of you. Become a thought flowing through my mind. If the Undying One is gracious to us, He will send you dreams, and in those dreams you will see me. If He is more gracious still, those dreams will be truthful."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Sit down now, Domin'{name}, and listen. Let the ceremony of twining begin." {n}Using a finely honed blade, Kibellah carves an intricate symbol into the floor. She then produces a small bundle wrapped in incense-laden parchment and sets it alight.{/n}

Kibellah hands you the cup, and begins tracing her finger around the bottom while whispering a prayer:{/n} "Watch now, Domin'{name}. But as soon as your gaze lingers on any of them, reality bleeds through the fluid shapes.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah looks at you intently before pulling out a vial of scarlet liquid and pouring it out into the cup.{/n} "The blood of a dozen martyrs, mixed with their tears, sanctified by their dying prayers, and gathered at their final breath. This artefact is hardly as powerful as the Domin's blood, but since you refuse to give yours... this should suffice for the ritual to commence."
  - After: {n}She pours a vial into the cup.{/n} "Martyrs' blood. Weaker than yours, but it will do."

This is no profane psychic art, but the blessing of the Undying One, bestowed upon the spinners of the Bloodspun Web. A thin thread of spiritual kinship that connects the fates of the Domini with those of their shadows."
  - After: {n}She snaps,{/n} "We are no {g|Encyclopedia:PsykerGlossary}witches nor accursed sorcerers{/g}. This is His blessing: a thread binding Domini to their shadows."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The skull grins benignantly.{/n} "You are learning to see what is hidden behind the familiar shell. Keep practising, and years later you will be able to see the truth even with your eyes closed."
  - After: {n}The skull grins.{/n} "You're learning to see beneath. Keep practising."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your spirit will come with me to the plasma drive chambers while your body remains motionless. If the Undying One graces you, you will hear what I hear, see what I see. You will think my thoughts as if they were your own. But if you shout out to me, if you give me an order, I will not hear it. Only the ripples of your mind can reach me through the winding thread."
  - After: "Your spirit follows me to the plasma drive chambers. You may see what I see, but only your thoughts reach me, not orders."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "One who follows the thread of the Web fights not out of rage, but with a mind as cold as stone. Nevertheless, rage can become a potent weapon in the hands of a punisher. I... understand, Domin'{name}. I accept your blessing."
  - After: "The Web fights cold, yet rage can arm a punisher. I accept, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am your shield. Your shadow. Your weapon. Your enemies will find only vengeance in the close embrace of my blades."
  - After: "Your shield, shadow and weapon."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is no turning back for those who have defied the {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark, who have traded the arduous path of service for the sweetness of false promises... At least, not commonly. But I will remember your words, Domin."
  - After: "Traitors to the {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark rarely turn back. But I'll remember, Domin."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pain gives way to a burning sensation as Kibellah grasps your hand and squeezes it over the ritual cup. But this new discomfort is quickly replaced again, this time by a dull numbness and the faint warmth of blood flowing from your open wound.{/n}

Her words linger, then rush through your mind in a deluge. The heavy scent of incense envelops you and makes your head spin.{/n}
  - After: "Our blood spins a scarlet web for our prey." {n}She hands you the dagger. Incense makes you dizzy.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "For the twining to happen, you must first expand your mind, see the unseen, hear the unheard. Those who live and die by the Tenets of the Web often burn sacred essences, and your body is not yet accustomed to them, Domin'{name}. Your mind is trying to grasp at its new boundaries. Do not resist. Breathe deeply. Learn."

It is too weak to let you see or feel through another's consciousness, and yet... it is too strong to be dismissed as insignificant.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Anoint me with your blessing, Domin'{name}, and may the ceremony of twining commence." {n}Kibellah's face blurs before your eyes. No matter how hard you try to focus and dispel the vision, in place of her face, you see a death mask, a broken skull with hollow eye sockets.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Soon your spirit will be able to follow me. I will bid the servants to carry your body to your chambers, where you will not be disturbed. Wait in silence and safety. For me, the hunt has begun."

  - Before: "Soon your spirit will be able to follow me. Wait in silence and safety in your chambers. For me, the hunt has begun."
  - After: "Soon your spirit can follow. Wait in your chambers. The hunt begins."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/Demagogues/Demagogues_dialogue

- **Player**

  - After: [Sense the stench of blasphemy]

  - After: [Silently watch His foes perish]

  - Before: "Stop! You are committing treason!"
  - After: "Stop! This is treason!"

  - Before: [Stand firm and do not resist]
  - After: [Stand firm, don't resist]

  - Before: [Lose myself in the dance of blood]
  - After: [Lose myself in the blood dance]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Feel the flowing rage of these poor wretches]
  - After: [Feel the wretches' rage]
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The laypeople press in from all sides, pushing and shoving. Their faces are ablaze with terror and rage, and a violent energy boils through the mass of bodies. This power will be difficult to contain — frightened people are dangerous people. The hunt was meant to go differently, but such is the Undying One's will.{/n}
  - After: {n}Furious, terrified laypeople press in. Frightened people are dangerous.{/n}
- **Rot**
  - Before: "They have the almighty baton. All you have is the source of the power that feeds the whole ship. Why shouldn't they take you for granted? It serves you right, you cowards!" {n}His ugly shriek spills like venom upon the sweating faces as they slowly draw closer and closer.{/n}
  - After: "They have the baton, you power the ship! Cowards!" {n}His shriek poisons the crowd.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I take a deep breath, and something stupefying, noxious, and luscious disturbs my senses. This is no ordinary odour, but something subtle and... foul. It carries the same stench as Rot.{/n}
  - After: {n}A noxious scent, the same as Rot's.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Twisted faces and bestial snouts. Stench and spittle bursting from open mouths. Staring eyes, clenched fists, hair standing on end... They are smothering me with their mass, pressing, demanding, lamenting, complaining... They are ugly in their offence, and like all offenders, they yearn to be punished.{/n}
  - After: {n}Twisted faces, spittle, fists. Like all offenders, they yearn for punishment.{/n}
- **Furnace**
  - Before: {n}The crowd draws nearer, and Furnace shouts at the top of his lungs,{/n} "Do you hear? They have nothing to say! Even they know we are right!"
  - After: {n}Furnace bellows,{/n} "They have no answer! We're right!"
- **Furnace**
  - Before: {n}Strong. Heavy. Enormous hands whose blows should be feared. A great belly that has become a symbol of his success. He does not starve, so those who follow him will not starve either. A powerful leader, recognised by the whole pack.{/n}
  - After: {n}Huge, heavy, well-fed. The pack's leader.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I turn my thoughts to {rt_mf|him|her}, for it is {rt_mf|his|her} people that are standing before me. What would {rt_mf|he|she} do, the one whose thread I anoint with my blood?{/n}
  - After: {n}I think of {rt_mf|him|her}; these are {rt_mf|his|her} people. What would {rt_mf|he|she} do?{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Faced with the blade, all the strength and authority have been erased from her features. The crowd looks on in horror at the one whom, just moments ago, they had been willing to die for. They have seen how easily her power was overthrown, and they are seized with fear.{/n}
  - After: {n}Facing the blade, her authority vanishes, and fear seizes the crowd.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They grow still, as though a sheet of ice had formed on the roiling surface of a water tank. No one dares to be the One Whose Name Is Spoken. No one dares to leave the crowd and lose the protection of anonymity.{/n}
  - After: {n}They freeze, hiding in anonymity.{/n}
- **Rot**
  - Before: "Why are you surprised? Have the officers ever treated us otherwise?" {n}A new voice, sandpaper-rough, tears through the rumbling of the crowd. Its owner is ragged and filthy, and a feverish gleam burns in his eyes. His words inflame the people's minds, like rot feasting upon a wound. Rot cries out mockingly,{/n} "That's because you're afraid of them, but they're not afraid of you!"
  - After: "When were officers ever better?" {n}Rot, ragged and feverish, festers in the crowd.{/n} "You fear them; they don't fear you!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}None of them are steeped in corruption, and so the sweetness of trespassing still intoxicates them. Their minds are captivated by how close they have come to the forbidden. They have not earned an immediate execution... not yet. But do they deserve to be saved? Why save them at all?{/n}
  - After: {n}Not yet corrupt, just drunk on the forbidden. Worth saving?{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I address the one who commands these people and who possesses the authority to execute and pardon. Am I to hear {rt_mf|his|her} thoughts?{/n}
  - After: {n}Will I hear {rt_mf|his|her} thoughts, the one who executes and pardons?{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}But the whisper of the Undying One will not forsake me.{/n}
  - After: {n}But His whisper will not forsake me.{/n}
- **Rot**
  - Before: "{rt_mf|He|She} only cares about {rt_mf|his|her} flunkies!" {n}The bile spraying from Rot's mouth sizzles in the workers' minds like acid. It is burning them through.{/n}
  - After: "{rt_mf|He|She} only cares about {rt_mf|his|her} flunkies!" {n}Rot's bile burns them like acid.{/n}
- **Rot**
  - Before: "That's right! Deal with it, you lowlifes! They are not afraid of you!" {n}Rot's voice seems out of place in the hanging silence, sounding foreign, bereft of power. The word of the punishment has returned a shred of reason to the minds of the workers, for all is as it should be. Insolence has been followed by retribution. The world makes sense once more, and is no longer frightening.{/n}
  - After: "That's right! They don't fear you!" {n}Rot sounds powerless. Punishment followed insolence; order returns.{/n}
- **Rot**
  - Before: "You see! They're already itching to kill us, and we haven't even done anything yet! They're not afraid of us!" {n}The bile spraying from Rot's mouth sizzles in the workers' minds like acid. It is burning them through.{/n}
  - After: "See? They want us dead already!" {n}Rot's bile burns them like acid.{/n}
- **Rapier**
  - Before: "We will not commit rebellion, but we will not allow ourselves be slaughtered by villains, either. The law and the Emperor are on our side!" {n}A young woman steps forth, slender and supple like a rapier.{/n} "If they want to crush us with the fear of death, let them kill us: it will only prove our righteousness!" {n}The ringing call is a command, pressing itself into their hearts. The foul stench of sacrilege almost knocks me off my feet.{/n}
  - After: "We won't rebel, nor be slaughtered. The law and Emperor are with us!" {n}Young Rapier steps forth.{/n} "Killing us proves us right!" {n}Sacrilege reeks.{/n}
- **Rapier**
  - Before: {n}She is fragile, but there is a strength in her, an authority, taken for granted and understood by everyone. She is clearly ready to command, with legions willing to die for such maidens, beautiful and resolute as they are. She carries no banner in her hand, for she herself is the banner.{/n}
  - After: {n}Fragile, yet she is the banner.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The crowd reeks of flowering treason. I delve down to its root and realise what it is that rejects His will so: His sacred privilege is being attacked. He alone chooses who may journey to Him, but these three... instigators, they are determined to make this decision for themselves, dragging the souls of all around into the fires of violence with them.{/n}
  - After: {n}Treason: these three instigators usurp His right to choose who dies.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}But the noise around me drowns out my own thoughts and stops me from focusing on {rt_mf|his|her} image.{/n}
  - After: {n}The noise drowns my focus on {rt_mf|his|her} image.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The crowd does not answer. They do not hear me. The sacred promise of death no longer moves them, for they have fallen under the enemy's spell.{/n}
  - After: {n}They don't hear me; the enemy has them.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The spilt blood becomes the tipping point. The crowd erupts into cries. They no longer hear me, for the enemy has them in their grasp.{/n}
  - After: {n}The blood tips them; they erupt.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}A hoarse shriek rises above their heads: "Strike down the heretics!" Within moments, the raging mob begins tearing, punching, and trampling the three seditionists, reducing them to nothing but a mass of flesh and bone. This is wrong! I need them alive!{/n}
  - After: {n}"Strike down the heretics!" The mob tears the three apart. I needed them alive!{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The crowd is too enraged, stunned by their fury. Fists rise and fall, each time with more and more blood on them.{/n}
  - After: {n}Too enraged. Fists rise and fall, bloodier each time.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}It is too late. The crowd is too enraged to fear any more violence. It thirsts for blood, and those I wound scream with ecstasy, glorying in their agony.{/n}
  - After: {n}Too late. Those I wound scream in ecstasy.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Everything ends quickly and bloodily. This delicate flesh cannot withstand the rage of those who have realised that they were almost sent to their execution.{/n}
  - After: {n}It ends quickly, bloodily.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They surround me, threatening, pointing fingers, cursing. They dare not strike, not yet... But already their enormous bulk presses down upon me as the smell of blood in the air grows thicker by the minute.{/n}
  - After: {n}They surround me, cursing. Blood scents the air.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I can bear it no longer. The blades in my hands sing, and blood streaks across astonished faces. I am done speaking and exhorting — I merely dance on the thread that I have spun. I bestow death and blessed wounds. I catch a glimpse of Rapier's cloven face and Furnace's open belly. Rot's severed hand falls at my feet, and its owner flees howling. I dance, and breathe, so freely!{/n}
  - After: {n}I break. My blades sing: Rapier's face cloven, Furnace's belly open, Rot's hand severed as he flees howling. I dance, so freely!{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They hear me no more. They cannot, for the poison of disobedience has utterly filled their minds.{/n}
  - After: {n}They hear me no more, poisoned by disobedience.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The crowd presses forward, harder and harder. My breath is growing short, my bones are crunching. Somebody is screaming in my face... I endure the stench.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd crushes me. I endure.{/n}
- **Rot**
  - Before: "Do they think they can hide their {rt_mf|master|mistress}'s {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}disgrace{/d} behind such threats?" {n}The bile spraying from Rot's mouth sizzles in the workers' minds like acid. It is burning them through.{/n}
  - After: "Can threats hide their {rt_mf|master|mistress}'s {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}disgrace{/d}?" {n}Rot's bile burns the workers' minds like acid.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}That tantalising, elusive scent of rage... It is more than a stench. It is a tool. The weapon of the despicable trio, which they use to influence the minds of the laity. Invisibly intoxicating their minds!{/n}
  - After: {n}The scent of rage is the trio's weapon, intoxicating the laity unseen!{/n}
- **Furnace**
  - Before: {n}One voice rises above the others, the voice of a burly, bearded {g|Encyclopedia:Technomat}technomat{/g}, low as the roar of a furnace. Furnace smells of sweat and sacred unguents. He is not afraid, he merely pretends to be. Beneath the shudder of terror, I hear excitement.{/n} "Do we deserve to be executed, my brothers and sisters? Have we not laboured with the sweat of our brow? Have we not perished from the outbursts of raging machine spirits? Why do they call us rebels? Why are we being punished?" {n}Furnace's words make the crowd seethe even more.{/n}
  - After: {n}Furnace, a burly {g|Encyclopedia:Technomat}technomat{/g}, roars with feigned fear.{/n} "Do we deserve execution? We die to raging machine spirits! Why call us rebels?" {n}The crowd seethes.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}But there is something else mixed into their righteous indignation, something that taunts them, excites them, angers them. It is something foul, hovering in the air. Aberration.{/n}
  - After: {n}Something foul in the air excites their indignation. Aberration.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The flame burns high, for there is strong fuel at its heart. These people have amassed many grievances. The enforcers are cruel to them, for they believe that fear eradicates treason. The officers despise them, for their clothes and hands are filthy. The quartermasters rob them and withhold what is owed to them, for their clan is not strong enough to make demands. They are vulnerable. Their hearts are vulnerable. The Undying One commands us to spin a web to catch such hearts before they plunge into the abyss of treason. And so, I am spinning the web.{/n}
  - After: {n}Their grievances fuel it: cruel enforcers, scornful officers, thieving quartermasters. He bids us catch such hearts before treason. So I spin.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Skinny and scrawny, Rot leers at me with his gaping mouth. He is a nobody who has nothing. His body has wasted away from disease. His hands are five fingers short. His fate is sealed. And that makes him convincing: everyone knows he has nothing to gain for himself, and thus no reason to lie. His poverty is his armour.{/n}
  - After: {n}Scrawny, diseased Rot has nothing to gain, so he seems honest. Poverty is his armour.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They are impudent upstarts who have put themselves above Him... and above me, the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web, His chosen servant. The realisation of such audacity burns my very soul.{/n}
  - After: {n}Upstarts above Him, and above me, His Second Spinner!{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}At last, I perceive a glint of understanding and willingness to listen on their pale faces. I point to Furnace, Rot, and Rapier, and I know that no words are necessary as the crowd speaks out for me:{/n} "Traitors!"
  - After: {n}At last they listen. I point to Furnace, Rot and Rapier.{/n} "Traitors!"
- **Rot**
  - Before: "We're not warriors. We're common people! And we will not be intimidated by some retired {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}Commissar{/d}!" {n}Rot's voice seems out of place in the hanging silence, sounding foreign, bereft of power. The image of the posters chills the crowd's hearts: a person can be killed, but a living embodiment of punishment is invulnerable. Everyone gathered here knows that their futile battle is already lost.{/n}
  - After: "We're common people! No retired {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Commissar}Commissar{/d} scares us!" {n}Rot sounds powerless. Their battle is lost.{/n}

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/DemagoguesFinal/DemagoguesFinal_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [What will the appearance of the survivors tell me?]
  - After: [What do survivors tell me?]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Are Flaming Voice and Steel Mistress still alive?]
  - After: [Do Flaming Voice and Steel Mistress live?]
- **Player**
  - Before: [What can these corpses reveal to me?]
  - After: [What do the corpses reveal?]
- **Player**
  - Before: [It is time for the next step]
  - After: [Next step]
- **Player**
  - Before: [I draw the beginning of the Spread]
  - After: [Draw the Spread's beginning]
- **Player**
  - Before: [I draw the heart of the Spread]
  - After: [Draw the Spread's heart]
- **Player**
  - Before: [I draw the end of the Spread]
  - After: [Draw the Spread's end]
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}It did not go the way I had planned. The smell of blood lingers in the air like the stench of impending defeat.{/n}
  - After: {n}Not as planned. Blood, and defeat, in the air.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Two bodies are sprawled before me. I have severed their threads. The third blasphemer has managed to escape, but his disembodied hand also lies on the floor. Useless meat.{/n}
  - After: {n}Two bodies. The third blasphemer fled, leaving his hand.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They huddle in the corners, terrified of my blood dance. They no longer think of rebellion, only of the keenness of my blades.{/n}
  - After: {n}They cower, fearing my blades. Rebellion forgotten.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They huddle in the corners, ashamed of their own subservience. They tried to convince themselves that the blood they so foolishly spilt would absolve them, but... they know it is not enough.{/n}
  - After: {n}They cower in shame. Their spilt blood absolves nothing.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Their threads have not yet been cut. I realise with astonishment that they are standing close to me. Flaming Voice is furiously reproaching all those who had only recently joined the revolt, while Steel Mistress booms like a siren, shaking her maul and threatening punishment. They are useless to the hunt now.{/n}
  - After: {n}Both alive. Flaming Voice berates rebels; Steel Mistress threatens. Useless now.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Very little. The faint traces of the vile mutations that twisted their bodies. The foul stench of corruption emanating from their meat. The deformed, strangely coloured brains in their crushed skulls that spawned the heresy of sedition.{/n}
  - After: {n}Little. Mutation, corruption, deformed brains.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}A thrill runs through the strands of my consciousness. Is this... Domin'{rt_name}? Can I truly feel {rt_mf|him|her} again, or am I imagining it? I need to concentrate. I gaze at the puddles of blood and the patterns they form. I see... I see... a labyrinth. The Undying One has given me a sign!{/n}
  - After: {n}A thrill. Domin'{rt_name}? Do I feel {rt_mf|him|her}? The blood forms a labyrinth. A sign!{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The Hound. I gaze at the card and at its depiction of the Astra Militarum armoured vehicle that bears that formidable name. The pursuit of truth, sacrifice, and victory — this is me, and I am on the right track.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Hound. Pursuit, sacrifice, victory. Me, on the right track.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The Harlequin, inverted. Lies, manipulation, a shadow play blocking my path. But it is a lie exposed — a deception that must be revealed.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Harlequin, inverted. Lies blocking my path, to be exposed.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The Preacher. A man who carries an idea and proclaims it... But who is it? Nemesite? One of his supporters? Someone already slain or someone still alive? The divination is unclear, and so I draw a fourth card. It is dangerous to ask more of the Undying One, but I must know!{/n}
  - After: {n}The Preacher. Nemesite? A follower? Unclear. I risk a fourth card.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Undying One has manifested his omen in the traitors' blood. The hunt that has begun will be completed by the unveiling of a great deception. Our enemy is elusive because he has a powerful ally, one who espouses faith in the Emperor on this vessel. The ship's confessor is in league with Nemesite. He will be the next prey."
  - After: "The omen: Nemesite's ally preaches the Emperor aboard. The ship's confessor. He is next."
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "Adalbert. That scoundrel! I will prepare a team of enforcers to arrest him, but I need the Lord Captain's authorisation. Impressive display, Mistress Kibellah."
  - After: "Adalbert. Scoundrel! I'll ready enforcers, with the Lord Captain's leave. Impressive, Kibellah."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Thoughts of Domin'{rt_name} crowd my mind, irrelevant and harmful though they are in this sacred moment. I do not immediately realise how foreign they are to the here and now. Why am I thinking about {rt_mf|him|her}?{/n}
  - After: {n}Thoughts of Domin'{rt_name} intrude. Why {rt_mf|him|her}, now?{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I should be thinking about the hunt, and yet my thoughts now lie only with the moment when I will stand before Domin'{rt_name} once more and tell {rt_mf|him|her} what I have seen. Will {rt_mf|he|she} be proud of me? Will {rt_mf|he|she} be pleased? This is wrong.{/n}
  - After: {n}Not the hunt: Domin'{rt_name}, telling {rt_mf|him|her}. Will {rt_mf|he|she} be proud? Will {rt_mf|he|she} be pleased? Wrong.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Three broken bodies lie before me. The crowd tore them apart, squeezed the life out of them, and rendered them useless.{/n}
  - After: {n}Three bodies, torn apart by the crowd. Useless.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}My hand finds the sealed case in which {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g} cards reside. It is time for a divination in the blood of the dead — it will reveal to me the name of their unholy master.{/n}
  - After: {n}I take out {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g}. A blood divination will name their master.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The Aquila. His holy image watches me from within the card, and my heart grows frigid with the knowledge of what it represents.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Aquila. My heart freezes at its meaning.{/n}

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/EnforcerPDChambers/EnforcerPDChambers_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [I know how Whip's thread will end]
  - After: [I know how Whip's thread ends]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Whip, what can your scars reveal to me?]
  - After: [Whip, what do your scars reveal?]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Nothing is unimportant during the hunt. Tell me what you know, and I will listen."
  - After: "Nothing is unimportant in the hunt. Tell me."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Let the enforcers converse. I will keep an eye on those around us]
  - After: [Let the enforcers talk. I'll watch the crowd]
- **Player**
  - Before: [I breathe in essence made from the ashes and blood of the faithful. It enlightens the mind, granting it the grace of reading His signs]
  - After: [Inhale ash-and-blood essence to read His signs]
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Day after day, she watches the serfs labour away, exhausting their last vestiges of strength. And there is no compassion in her eyes. They are simply a resource she is commanded to use and then discard. She hates them because she blames them for her pain, her wounds.{/n}
  - After: {n}She works the serfs ruthlessly, blaming them for her wounds.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "M-Master-at-Arms! Lieutenant Godierda, ready to present a report as you—"
  - After: "M-Master-at-Arms! Lieutenant Godierda, reporting—"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}An old burn spread across her body in a scarlet blotch. A look of contempt. A heavy baton, covered in blood and symbolising boundless power. Like a fierce leather whip, she lashes with both her hand and her gaze.{/n}
  - After: {n}An old burn. Contempt. A bloody baton.{/n}
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "And Motilda, I presume, is that wonderful, not-at-all intimidating baton on your belt? I guess our disguise is working, but I would rather not spend the next few watches in the medbay because of a misunderstanding." {n}His breathing has quickened. Flaming Voice always makes jests when he is nervous... or irritated. Do enforcers infuriate him?{/n}
  - After: "And Motilda is that cuddly baton? I'd rather avoid the medbay." {n}He jests when nervous... or irritated.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We sealed off the exits and reduced the air supply to the maintenance tunnels to the absolute minimum — now you can't stay in there longer than a few minutes without passing out. There's no way the bastards could have left the plasma chambers. They are definitely in here somewhere." {n}Like snakes, the servants of Nemesite have shed their skin. The red scarf is just a distraction.{/n}
  - After: "Exits sealed, tunnel air cut. They're still in the plasma chambers." {n}The red scarf is a shed skin, a distraction.{/n}
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "Keep it down, will you? I understand your desire to curry favour, but do you have to do it so loudly? Mistress Sauerback is already a colourful, attention-grabbing character all by herself."
  - After: "Quieter. Mistress Sauerback draws enough attention alone."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Some of the people I escorted to the other side looked at me the same way. In the past, I did not understand, but now... Do the laypeople see spinners performing their duty to the Undying One or enforcers performing theirs to the Domin as monsters?{/n}
  - After: {n}Did those I escorted beyond see spinners, like enforcers, as monsters?{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A group of workers wearing red scarves were seen in the compartment just after the attack on the shrine. The foreman stated that they were at work on the freight line. No gunpowder on their clothes, no fresh wounds. Too many of them have started wearing red masks, and it muddles the trail. But we also found some red scarves and bloody rags in one of the shredders only shortly afterward."
  - After: "Red-scarved workers were seen after the shrine attack; foreman vouched, no gunpowder. Many wear red now. But a shredder held red scarves and bloody rags."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Infernus Master? M-Master-at-Arms? Apologies for not recognising you, ma'am!"
  - After: "Infernus Master? M-Master-at-Arms? Apologies, ma'am!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The workers hide their eyes. But I can hear the murmurs echoing through the bay. There is an impotent rage in their hearts directed at Whip, for she is the embodiment of the very order they despise. But why do they not realise that the enforcer is a shield as much as a lash?{/n}
  - After: {n}The workers murmur, hating Whip, blind that she shields as well as lashes.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}A portent from Him... The Undying One blesses me to take Whip. The minions of Nemesite fear her. When her soul is delivered to the Undying One, the traitors will feel invulnerable. They will crawl out of their holes and fall into my web.{/n}
  - After: {n}He blesses taking Whip. With her gone, Nemesite's minions will crawl into my web.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}A wave of epiphany sweeps my thoughts away, pulling me into a blessed trance. My fingers move of their own accord over the sacred deck and draw a card. It is the Martyr. I see a tear of blood wash over the pale features in the image, and they shift, becoming Whip's face.{/n}
  - After: {n}A trance. I draw the Martyr. Its face becomes Whip's.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The Domin forbade the spinners to cut the threads of {rt_mf|his|her} subjects. I will have to go against the will of my {rt_mf|lord|lady} to protect {rt_mf|him|her} and the ark. And if punishment follows... I am ready to accept it. My duty to the Domin comes before my life.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Domin forbade spinners to cut {rt_mf|his|her} subjects' threads. I defy my {rt_mf|lord|lady} to protect {rt_mf|him|her}, whatever the cost.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What are you looking at, you beggars? You finish your shift, you go to the barracks. You start your shift, you check in with the foreman and get to work before Motilda comes to pat you on the back."
  - After: "What are you staring at? Work your shift, or Motilda pats your back."
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "Don't you dare reprimand my own enforcers in front of me." {n}Steel Mistress clearly agrees with him, but her pride will not let her admit it. She is afraid of appearing weak — of losing control, respect. And by so doing, she may spoil the hunt.{/n}
  - After: "Don't reprimand my enforcers before me." {n}She agrees, but pride forbids it.{/n}
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "Godierda, we are conducting an inquest. Answer the spinner's questions. I hope your report will be useful."
  - After: "Godierda, this is an inquest. Answer the spinner."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I cannot sever Whip's thread with a blade, for the serfs would recognise me as one of the spinners and lose all courage. But the spark of the machine spirits in the plasma drive chambers has already claimed the lives of many. I will use this, and thus, the web will be spun.{/n}
  - After: {n}A blade would expose me. The plasma chambers' machine spirits kill many. I'll use them.{/n}

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/KibellahInvestigation/KibellahInvestigation_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [The thread shakes. The quarry always leaves a trail. We may not see it, but we can feel it]
  - After: [The thread shakes. We feel the trail]
- **Player**
  - Before: [The web is taut. Know the hunting ground]
  - After: [The web is taut. Know the ground]
- **Player**
  - Before: [I step silently. Darkness is our ally. Merge with the shadows]
  - After: [Step silently into shadow]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Instil a false sense of impunity. Convince them that they can and must act now."
  - After: "Make them feel safe to act."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Intimidate them with an impending threat."
  - After: "Intimidate them with a threat."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Strike out the spark that will ignite the flame."
  - After: "Strike the spark."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Stale air. Oppressive noise. The hum and whirr of machinery drown out all thoughts. This place rings with tension... Is it the powerful energy coursing through the cables, or have the wails of the workers merged into a cacophony of indignant whispers and desperate prayers? Lost, mired in petty troubles, unmindful of duty, their voices creak as if covered in rust and their eyes are dimmed by the endless drudgery and lack of light here on the working decks of the Domin's great ark.{/n}
  - After: {n}Stale air, roaring machines, whispered complaints and prayers.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I taste the air. The scent of fresh dye with a subtle note of sparks... This is new. Pleasant. The upper decks reek of luxury, but here I feel comfortable. There is something else... This is it. I recognise the smell. Unguent, lho, and burnt meat. Just like inside the shrine. The time has come to spin the scarlet web.{/n}
  - After: {n}Dye and sparks. And unguent, lho, burnt meat, like the shrine. Time to spin the scarlet web.{/n}
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "I would not be surprised if the cultist set out on the trail of Nemesite alone. The spinners are arrogant. We are just another soul to them, a gift to offer death." {n}Steel Mistress's voice is hard and cold, like her will. I can see in her eyes that she dislikes me. She is wary. And so she should be, for we serve the Domin, not one another.{/n}
  - After: "The cultist likely hunts Nemesite alone. Spinners see us as death's gifts." {n}She dislikes me. Wise.{/n}
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "Does this remind you of anyone at all, Jocasta?" {n}This man is enamoured with fire. Even his words sound full of biting flames, and he himself enjoys playing with fire — too much so. They bicker again. Their mutual animosity may disrupt the hunt.{/n}
  - After: "Remind you of anyone, Jocasta?" {n}He loves fire too much. Their bickering may hurt the hunt.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}To the laypeople, the two are now scarcely distinguishable from the common serfs. In a world where status and privilege are defined by appearance, a single piece of rotten cloth is enough to lower your standing. We will become spectral hounds and follow the trail without drawing attention.{/n}
  - After: {n}In rags, they pass for serfs. We'll hunt unseen.{/n}
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "You can exchange pleasantries later. Lieutenant Godierda is on duty in this compartment. I have ordered her to gather information on all the workers who wear red scarves and who have recently left the bay." {n}This is pointless. The red scarf is not proof of guilt, it is merely a symbol. It could be a trap. I need to find her. I will watch the enforcer and those who are watching her in turn.{/n}
  - After: "Later. Lieutenant Godierda is tracking red-scarved workers who left." {n}A scarf proves nothing. I'll watch her watchers.{/n}
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "Your enforcer knows nothing about life in this compartment. I guarantee it. I have a better source of information, a good friend of mine who knows a lot about delicate matters. It would be easy to get him to talk: he's terrified of pain... and death." {n}Only the faithless fear death. I will not trust him. Let him trust me so that his trust may become a snare for my hunt.{/n}
  - After: "Your enforcer knows nothing. My friend does, and fears pain... and death." {n}Only the faithless fear death. His trust will be my snare.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I have seen it before. In these murky depths, people become creatures all too ready to devour each other for worldly gains, fleeting pleasures, or imaginary freedom from obligation born from the abyss of spiritual emptiness. The Undying One punishes them through me. Disgusting mutations, abominations, reflections of vice are born in these shadows, and I will be their doom.{/n}
  - After: {n}In these depths, people devour each other and mutations breed. Through me, they are doomed.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I feel them lurking in the crowd. My enemies. They are cautious. I must find them and let them believe their luck. Then, they will shed their masks, and I will take them down.{/n}
  - After: {n}Enemies lurk in the crowd. Let them trust their luck, and fall.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}To find the enemy, I must listen. Inhale. Exhale. Inhale. The rhythmic beat of engines and pumps: that is the ship's breathing. That is the ship's heartbeat. Is it strange that I feel at home among the workers of the lower decks, who pass their time like the living dead? {/n}
  - After: {n}The engines are the ship's heartbeat. I feel at home among these living dead.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}In the twilight of the chamber, barely illuminated by flickering candlelight, I become like them — the lost, mired servants. They will become unwitting allies in my hunt. Their hopelessness, their desperation, their thirst for survival will become tools for my use.{/n}
  - After: {n}In the gloom, I become one of the lost. Their desperation will serve me.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I cut them off with a gesture. Their methods of hunting are not mine. But I take the grain of truth from their words and weave it into my plan:{/n} "We need to provoke them into making a move."
  - After: {n}I cut them off, but take their grain of truth:{/n} "We must provoke them to move."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}They look at me in silence. They do not understand yet, but that matters little. I am on the hunt.{/n}
  - After: {n}They stare, not understanding. No matter. I hunt.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}This enforcer who answers to Steel Mistress is the symbol of order and obedience in these chambers. She is... standing in the way. When she disappears, my enemies will believe it is safe to strike... and that will be a costly mistake.{/n}
  - After: {n}Steel Mistress's enforcer embodies order here. Remove her, and my enemies will strike.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Flaming Voice relies on a talker, one who keeps no secrets and fears pain. An unreliable vessel is bad for holding secrets, but good for spilling them. Through him, I will whisper lies to the enemy.{/n}
  - After: {n}Flaming Voice's talker spills secrets. Through him, I'll feed the enemy lies.{/n}
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "There she is! Welcome to the plasma drive chambers, esteemed holy assassin."
  - After: "There she is! Welcome, holy assassin."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Warmth spreads through my chest. I like to think that it is the connection with which the Undying One bound my and the Domin's fates together. He has blessed us, and we hunt as one.{/n}

  - After: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}implacable judge{/d}'s calm frightens him; his aim veers.{/n} "Yours is today's first verdict!"

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/OfficerCeremony_Start/OfficerCeremony_Start_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "And who might you be, madam matriarch?"
  - After: "And who are you, madam matriarch?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "So, why would Sauerback entrust my safety to someone so... advanced in years?"
  - After: "Why would Sauerback send someone so... aged?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you believe Nemesite will fall for our ruse?"
  - After: "Will Nemesite fall for our ruse?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am bored. Perhaps you might amuse me with a story."
  - After: "I'm bored. Tell me a story."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You could have drowned an innocent man in porridge."
  - After: "He might have been innocent."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What a delightful tale! Give me another!"
  - After: "Delightful! Another!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Look at the participants in the ceremony]
  - After: [Look at the ceremony participants]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Perhaps you should have climbed into an empty vat."
  - After: "You should've hidden in an empty vat."
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "Oh, the stories I could tell... I remember, in the early days of my time in service, someone started poisoning the food in the kitchen. We couldn't catch the vermin, so I came up with an idea to get into a vat of protein porridge and catch them unawares. I was a small and skinny little thing, so I climbed into the vat and sat there up to my neck in porridge. I waited a long time before someone lifted the lid. It wasn't one of the kitchen servants, but a man twice my size, carrying a bag of foul-smelling stuff!"
  - After: "Someone poisoned the kitchen food once. I hid in a porridge vat. The lid lifted: a huge man with a foul bag!"
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "Belinda Traufgold, Lord Captain. Transferred from the enforcers with the rank of senior lieutenant to the staff of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s quarters on account of my age and declining health. But, as you can see, there's no such thing as a former enforcer." {n}A friendly smile stretches across her bloodless lips.{/n}
  - After: "Belinda Traufgold, Lord Captain. Ex-enforcer lieutenant, now in Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s quarters. No enforcer truly retires." {n}She smiles.{/n}
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "I guess the Master-at-Arms remembers how Belinda used to be the best shot among the enforcers back in the day, and knows that my eye and hand have not diminished over the years. I spent forty years on duty, and to this day, I can tell if a man is carrying contraband in his pockets just by the way he is walking."
  - After: "I was the enforcers' best shot. Still am. I spot contraband by a man's walk."
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "I am grateful to Mistress Sauerback for the honour. I don't want to die in my bed. Let me fall in battle, defending the Lord Captain and crushing traitors." {n}Belinda gives an imperious yet absent-minded nod and dabs her eyes with the handkercher.{/n}
  - After: "I'd rather die defending you than in bed." {n}She dabs her eyes.{/n}
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "Judging by the way that serf in the back row keeps glancing around, our Nemesite has swallowed the bait just like the void rat he is. The porridge will hit the fan any moment now." {n}A most benign smile crosses her face.{/n}
  - After: "That twitchy serf in back? Nemesite took the bait." {n}She smiles.{/n}
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "And that was it! I grabbed him by the shoulders and dunked him into the porridge. I held the brute down until he passed out. The Master-at-Arms back then, he lauded my ingenuity and commended me for apprehending the poisoner, but he also took the cost of the porridge out of my wages."
  - After: "I dunked him till he passed out. I was praised, then docked for the porridge."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A loud and menacing voice booms through the hall, cutting short the sacred words:{/n} "But not today."
  - After: {n}A menacing voice cuts off the prayer:{/n} "But not today."
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "What kind of innocent man would skulk about a kitchen where food was being poisoned? If he wasn't a saboteur, he was a thief. Either way, he wasn't there to season the porridge, that's for sure."
  - After: "Innocents don't skulk in poisoned kitchens. He wasn't seasoning porridge."
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "You're not wrong! But I was young and foolish, and thought only of how I might nab the culprit."
  - After: "True! I was young and foolish."
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "Don't be angry with an old woman, Lord Captain. I'm an enforcer: nobody taught me how to speak glibly. My talents are of a different kind."
  - After: "Forgive an old woman. I'm an enforcer, not a storyteller."
- **Belinda Traufgold**
  - Before: "I'm afraid we don't have time, Lord Captain. We must be vigilant — the treacherous scum is about to reveal himself."
  - After: "No time. The traitor is about to show himself."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The ceremony comes to an end. The vows are given and the forehead of every officer is graced with the touch of the confessor. Now comes the moment for the closing prayer.{/n}
  - After: {n}Vows given, officers blessed. Now the closing prayer.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The facade is holding, with everyone playing their role perfectly. The Master-at-Arms must have instructed them thoroughly and shown them how best to conceal their weapons. All of them are wearing their best, and even you cannot tell where they are hiding their armaments.{/n}
  - After: {n}The facade holds. Weapons hidden even from you.{/n}

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/ReliquaryCouncil/ReliquaryCouncil_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "The blood's whisper? Did you perform another divination?"
  - After: "The blood's whisper? Another divination?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "See, Jocasta? It seems to me that your enforcers could learn much from these death cultists."
  - After: "Jocasta, your enforcers could learn from these death cultists."
- **Player**
  - Before: "And you gleaned all of that from a couple of bloodstains? Or did you have a vision?"
  - After: "From bloodstains? Or a vision?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Kibellah, tell us everything you know."
  - After: "Kibellah, tell us everything."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Kibellah is right: it would be prudent to use a disguise."
  - After: "Kibellah is right: use a disguise."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Disguises are overrated. You will do just as well without one."
  - After: "Disguises are overrated. Go without."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So we still have no idea where to find Nemesite."
  - After: "So we still can't find Nemesite."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The plasma drive chambers? Are you certain?"
  - After: "The plasma drive chambers? Certain?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Sauerback, gather the enforcers. We will follow Nemesite's trail."
  - After: "Sauerback, gather the enforcers. We follow Nemesite's trail."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. Let the ceremony commence."
  - After: "Very well. Begin the ceremony."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not have time for this right now."
  - After: "I have no time for this now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So what do you suggest we do, Kibellah?"
  - After: "What do you suggest, Kibellah?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "By the power vested in me by the Holy Ecclesiarchy and in the name of the God-Emperor, I hereby sanction a sacred hunt be performed in pursuit of the heretic who calls himself Nemesite!"
  - After: "By the power of the Holy Ecclesiarchy and in the God-Emperor's name, I sanction a sacred hunt for the heretic Nemesite!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The Cult of the Ravenous Star used the same compartment to assemble and store weapons. This cannot be a simple coincidence."
  - After: "The Cult of the Ravenous Star stored weapons in that compartment. No coincidence."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If the attackers have escaped through the maintenance tunnels, we can send in the enforcers after them."
  - After: "If they fled through the maintenance tunnels, send enforcers after them."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}Einrich watches the limp body of the Factotum get carried away and chews grimly on the {g|Encyclopedia:Lho}lho{/g}-stick that has appeared between his teeth.{/n} "So, what do we have so far? Master Danrok is on his deathbed, all the attackers are either dead or have absconded along with the sacred relic, and the witnesses all agree on this one thing: Nemesite and his accomplices came out of nowhere and struck suddenly. Only the Throne knows where we can find these bastards now!"
  - After: {n}Einrich chews a {g|Encyclopedia:Lho}lho{/g}-stick.{/n} "Danrok's dying, the relic's gone. Throne knows where Nemesite is!"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "We will find them." {n}Sauerback's voice is full of terrible fury.{/n} "We will turn this vessel inside out if we must. There is nowhere even a void rat can—"
  - After: "We will find them." {n}Sauerback seethes.{/n} "We'll turn this ship inside out—"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Yes and no. His Tarot guided me here and told me of the evil that lurked in the shrine. But beyond that... the bloody path carelessly tread by the raiders will reveal the truth."
  - After: "Yes and no. His Tarot led me here. The blood will do the rest."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Her steel claws dig into the dead man's arm.{/n} "Your wound holds the answer. You dressed it carefully... Not inside the shrine. Before that. Something struck you, ripped the tissue apart, burned you, turned your hand into a worthless lump. It was not fire, no." {n}Drawing a ragged breath, Kibellah opens her eyes.{/n} "The fury of the conductive charge. It has marked you, heretic. I recognise your wound, for I myself have encountered it on those I take to the other side within the plasma drive chambers."
  - After: {n}Claws in the corpse's arm.{/n} "Not fire. Conductive charge." {n}Her eyes open.{/n} "I know this wound from the plasma drive chambers."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "I can't say if it's worth drawing conclusions based on a conversation with a corpse, but if it is, then I concur with the esteemed spinner's findings." {n}The Infernus Master spits out the chewed-up lho-stick and immediately produces another.{/n} "All that about burns, the conductive charge, and the smell of cheap lho immediately made me think of the plasma drive technical compartments. Makes sense to me."
  - After: "If corpses testify, I agree." {n}Another lho-stick.{/n} "Burns, charge, cheap lho: plasma drive compartments."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "There is no need for revelations from the Undying Emperor here. For one who has dedicated their life to understanding the Tenets of the Web, death speaks a language clearer than any words. Blood writes the chronicle of the final hour, and it holds all the answers. It speaks to me. It can tell me with what instrument it was spilt. What its owner felt — whether they struggled in terror or were as cold as the steel of a blade. At what moment and how the thread snapped. For a spinner, no two wounds are alike, and each scarlet drop carries a message from the Undying One."
  - After: "No vision needed. Blood tells the weapon, the fear, how the thread snapped. Each drop speaks for the Undying One."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "I'm glad she's on our side." {n}Einrich scratches the back of his head, smiling wryly.{/n}
  - After: "Glad she's on our side." {n}Einrich smiles wryly.{/n}
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "The enforcers will procure regular work clothes for us. We will carry only inconspicuous weapons that we can hide easily in our tool bags. It will help us blend in with the crowd."
  - After: "We'll wear work clothes, weapons hidden in tool bags."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "As for this pattern..." {n}Kibellah points to a barely visible chain of scarlet droplets.{/n} "It was made in fury and desperation. The one who left it was wounded, but they did not flee. They fought back while they could, and then they retreated... into the darkness..." {n}Kibellah's eyes close and she falls silent, then she exhales sharply and points a steel claw:{/n} "...into the darkness of the maintenance tunnels hidden within the walls of the shrine."
  - After: "This trail..." {n}Faint droplets.{/n} "Wounded, fought, fled..." {n}She points a claw.{/n} "...into the shrine's maintenance tunnels."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "I'm going too. I have a couple of... good friends in the plasma drive chambers, the nosy kind who know everything about everyone. Convincing them shouldn't be difficult, especially if I pull a few favours. It'll be the three of us, then. What a company!" {n}Einrich's grim laughter echoes inside the shrine.{/n}
  - After: "I'm coming too. I've nosy friends in the plasma drive chambers." {n}Einrich laughs grimly.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The rite of blessing for the sacred hunt. With it, the Domin casts their shadow over the path of carnage. Under your benediction, I will strike harder and tread more softly."
  - After: "The blessing for the sacred hunt. With it, I strike harder and tread softer."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Before I depart to hunt for Nemesite, I ask the Domin to bless me. I pledged never to leave your side, yet the hunt demands that I do just that. Grant me this permission by performing the ceremony of twining." {n}Kibellah nods toward the altar.{/n} "When your people have taken their leave, under the gaze of the Undying One, we will begin the rite."
  - After: "Before I hunt, bless me, Domin. The hunt takes me from your side. Perform the ceremony of twining." {n}She nods at the altar.{/n} "Once your people leave."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "No, Domin'{name}. You must stay. You are the one that Nemesite has challenged, and those we hunt know you by sight. You will frighten away the prey, and we will lose the trail until the next tragedy occurs." {n}Kibellah's unblinking gaze meets your own.{/n}
  - After: "No, Domin'{name}. Nemesite's people know your face. You'd scare off the prey." {n}Her gaze is unblinking.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Undying One has blessed me with the ability to see the truth in death. How can anyone doubt the revelations His blessing bestows?"
  - After: "The Undying One shows me truth in death. Who doubts Him?"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Out of the question. An enforcer squad would certainly scare off the vermin, but I am not letting you go alone, servant of death. You and I will go to the chambers together, and together we will bring down all who have dared to insult the Lord Captain."
  - After: "Out of the question. You won't go alone. We hunt together."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I will go to the plasma drive chambers alone. I will track down the false champion and all who serve him. And I will prepare the grounds for your own hunt."
  - After: "I go to the plasma drive chambers alone, to prepare your hunt."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "With your permission, Lord Captain, the Infernus Master and I will take our leave now and set out to prepare for the descent into the chambers."
  - After: "With your leave, Lord Captain, we'll prepare for the descent."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Then I will humbly sharpen my blades as I await its arrival."
  - After: "Then I'll sharpen my blades and wait."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "The technical corridors extend hundreds of meters in different directions. Nemesite and his men must be familiar with the tunnels and possess either a map or a guide. Without a clear trail, the enforcers risk getting lost and wasting valuable time, not to mention the fact that those narrow tunnels are perfect for an ambush."
  - After: "The tunnels run for hundreds of meters. Without a trail, enforcers get lost or ambushed."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The tunnels only answer the question of how he left. Now death will tell us where he was heading."
  - After: "The tunnels show how he left. Death will show where."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}There is an awkward pause. Kibellah takes a long look at the officers' faces, before finally nodding her assent.{/n} "So be it. But not like this. Much like your faces, your guises are too conspicuous."
  - After: {n}Kibellah studies the officers, then nods.{/n} "So be it. But disguise yourselves."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}As if in a trance, Kibellah leans over a body and peers into its eyes.{/n} "He stinks of smoke. The smoke of singed coveralls, vile lho-sticks, burnt sacred unguents... and charred meat." {n}She slides a pale hand along the dead man's skin and snakes it under the sleeve of his coveralls, which she pushes back to reveal a fresh burn, bandaged with a torn scrap of shirt.{/n}
  - After: {n}Kibellah sniffs a corpse.{/n} "Smoke... and charred meat." {n}She bares a bandaged burn.{/n}
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "I sure hope so, Lord Captain. The workers are used to seeing me all over the place, but the unexpected arrival of the Master-at-Arms is going to raise a few eyebrows."
  - After: "Hope so. Workers know me, but the Master-at-Arms will raise eyebrows."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "There is no need. The blood's whisper will lead us to Nemesite." {n}Kibellah's words make the two exchange puzzled glances.{/n}
  - After: "No need. The blood's whisper will lead us to Nemesite." {n}The two exchange glances.{/n}
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Undoubtedly, Lord Captain." {n}She presses her lips into a thin line.{/n} "Perhaps the servant of death will share her insights, that we might all understand what happened here and what we should do next."
  - After: "Undoubtedly, Lord Captain." {n}Lips thin.{/n} "Do share, servant of death."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "With all due respect, Spinner, the enforcers have already questioned all the witnesses and compiled an extensive list of evidence, none of which tells us anything about how or where the troublemaker calling himself Nemesite might have escaped to."
  - After: "With respect, Spinner, no witness says where Nemesite went."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah sharply turns to face the crimson splashes on the floor and walls of the shrine. Her pupils dilate, threatening to drown her irises in darkness, her expression turns distant, her voice becoming low and strange:{/n} "This blood is drawn in a pattern of retribution. The one who spilt it appeared later. They moved swiftly and furiously, numb to their own wounds... An enforcer who was drawn to the gunfire and witnessed the sacrilege? Probably."
  - After: {n}Kibellah's eyes darken.{/n} "Retribution. A furious enforcer, drawn by gunfire."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "That mutineer cell and all their secret stockpiles were destroyed. I made sure of it. Nevertheless, you are right, and the same troubling thought has crossed my mind: they could have been connected to Nemesite."
  - After: "I destroyed that mutineer cell. But yes, they may be tied to Nemesite."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "We've already wiped out those xenos mutants or whoever they were, so we have one less thing to worry about now. All that's left is to deal with this cutthroat and his henchmen."
  - After: "Those xenos mutants are gone. Now just this cutthroat."

  - Before: {n}The laypeople have huddled together like a herd being chased by predators. Faded gazes, bent backs, the crimson kisses of batons on their bodies. - **Anvil**
  - Before: "Since you couldn't work, your wife had to pull three shifts. She collapsed at the lathe, and the conductive charge burned out her eyes. None of us deserve that." {n}Tough and unyielding. Every word hurts, but she is forgiven for her sincerity. They listen to her to pull themselves together. To share their common pain.{/n}
  - After: "Your wife pulled three shifts for you. The charge took her eyes." {n}Harsh, but sincere.{/n}
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "And then the lever smacked you right in the kisser? Hah! Give or take a tooth, this is nothing. Bruises, burns, cuts — that's just life."
  - After: "Lever to the kisser? Hah! Bruises, burns, that's life."
- **Anvil**
  - Before: "That's called justice — for every broken bone, for every gob of spit in our faces. Good bloody riddance!"
  - After: "That's justice. Good bloody riddance!"
- **Anvil**
  - Before: "Not everyone here is as chipper and thick-skinned as you. A bowl of soup is great, he says. What about having to choose which of your three kids gets it — is that great too? Beatings are nothing, he says. Remember when the enforcers broke your arm?"
  - After: "Choosing which kid gets soup, is that great? Remember your broken arm?"
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "Yes... Just as long as they don't pin her death on any of us."
  - After: "Yes... if they don't pin it on us."
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "You heard the news? The lieutenant got fried on the wires. A brutal end for a brutal woman."
  - After: "Heard? The lieutenant got fried on the wires. Brutal end for a brutal woman."
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "Did you hear what happened? Nemesite didn't stop at that foundry business, he's been roaming the upper decks too! They say he went to the vessel's shrine and shot some nobles."
  - After: "Nemesite shot nobles in the ship's shrine!"
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "They tell us this is how it's meant to be! Just because they were born on the upper decks and we down below, in the darkness! Is it really the God-Emperor's will that they grow fat on the fruits of our labours? Revel in luxury while we die without water or medicine?" {n}Hammer's voice rumbles, and the laypeople listen. Their hands clench into fists.{/n}
  - After: "They grow fat on our labour while we die without water or medicine. The God-Emperor's will?" {n}Fists clench.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}I can hear their whispers, insidious and deafening. No longer do they laugh with the others. No longer do they pretend.{/n}
  - After: {n}Their whispers are deafening. No more pretending.{/n}

  - Before: "Shut your foul mouth, void dog." {n}Flaming Voice? No, it is too soon! I understand your anger, but you must temper it!{/n} "What did you say about the Lord Captain? I can see why you have gathered here, and I will not let you start another rebellion." {n}Why are you reaching for your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-caster?{/n} "If you do not disperse, I will give the order to vent the plasma chambers. You have five seconds. Four..."
  - After: "Shut it, void dog." {n}Flaming Voice? Too soon!{/n} "No rebellion against the Lord Captain." {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-caster!{/n} "Disperse, or I vent the plasma chambers. Five. Four..."

  - After: "Tyrant's lackey! You'll die with us, madman!"

- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The laypeople are frightened. Angry. They feel the impunity that sprouted like a weed upon Whip's demise. They feel the threat crushing them from the upper decks, both imminent and inevitable.{/n}
  - After: {n}Since Whip's death, they feel unpunished, yet doom looms from above.{/n}
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "The enforcer is dead, and punishers from the upper decks will soon follow Nemesite's trail."
  - After: "Upper-deck punishers will follow Nemesite's trail."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The laypeople are huddled together in a pile of sweltering bodies, filthy and battered by the enforcers' batons, reeking of sweat and disease. Their hearts pump blood faster and faster through bulging veins as two of them send red-hot sparks into the air with their words like a hammer and anvil.{/n}

  - After: "Your plan worked, Spinner. The serfs are stirring."
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "No matter how hard you work, they will wring everything out of you and give you nothing! Who allowed this to happen? The Rogue Trader, {rt_mf|his|her} name be damned!
