  - After: "The Rogue Trader, {rt_mf|his|her} name be damned! A {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} on the throne, burning our bones for {rt_mf|his|her} 'protectorate'—"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The weariness and fear in the eyes of the laypeople have been replaced with sullen lights. Their faces no longer brighten with pale smiles. Their muscles are as tense as a beast ready to pounce. Their hearts pump blood faster and faster through bulging veins as the fiery words spoken by Hammer and Anvil sizzle in the air.{/n}
  - After: {n}Fear turns to sullen fire as Hammer and Anvil speak.{/n}
- **Hammer**
  - Before: "Just remind yourselves how you come home after your shift, having exchanged your ration card for a bowl of soup. How your little ones gulp that bowl down. How they fall asleep, feeling a little better. I say that's worth a hard day's work... and a punch in the face!" {n}He smiles, broad-shouldered, with a rusty beard. He is not afraid to share laughter with others, and so the crimson shades from the beatings never leave his face. His voice is bright, and sonorous, and listened to.{/n}
  - After: "Soup for your little ones is worth a punch!" {n}Hammer, bruised and rusty-bearded, laughs; they listen.{/n}
- **Anvil**
  - Before: {n}A small throwing blade flies out of my palm and draws a scarlet line across Anvil's neck. If I had wished it, she would be dead. But she continues to breathe and to bleed. And to scream furiously as she looks for me.{/n} "The Rogue Trader's assassins are here! Look! They wanted to kill me! Find the assassins!" {n}The spark is lit.{/n}
  - After: {n}My blade nicks Anvil's neck.{/n} "The Rogue Trader's assassins! Find them!" {n}The spark is lit.{/n}
- **Anvil**
  - Before: "And then he fled down into the chambers, so now a punitive squad is on its way. Prepare your backs: this is going to hurt."
  - After: "He fled here. A punitive squad's coming."
- **Anvil**
  - Before: "This is our chance. We need to act." {n}This is it. I can sense that the prey is close. They have little fear of giving themselves away anymore. They need a spark to ignite the flames. Something that will convince Nemesite's followers that they are strong, and that the Domin's servants are diminished.{/n}
  - After: "Our chance. We act." {n}The prey is close. They need a spark.{/n}

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q1/TalkerPDChambers/TalkerPDChambers_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [One glance is enough for me to see your true self, Stain]
  - After: [One glance shows me your true self, Stain]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where do things stand in the plasma drive chambers? Speak briefly. Speak sense."
  - After: "How are things in the plasma drive chambers? Briefly."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Set up the snare] "There will be a raid soon. Be careful. I warn you in appreciation for your cooperative nature."
  - After: [Set up the snare] "A raid is coming. Be careful. Thanks for cooperating."
- **Player**
  - Before: [The quelling stimulant on the needle's tip will loosen Stain's tongue]
  - After: [A quelling stimulant on the needle will loosen Stain's tongue]
- **Player**
  - Before: "This was done in service to the Domin. You are free to believe me or walk away."
  - After: "It serves the Domin. Believe me or walk away."
- **Player**
  - Before: "When the renegades hear of the coming retribution, it will make them nervous. Prone to mistakes. Likely to give themselves away."
  - After: "News of retribution will make the renegades nervous, and careless."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Reveal the truth to the enemy, and they will harm themselves with it."
  - After: "Reveal the truth, and the enemy harms themselves with it."
- **Player**
  - Before: [The laypeople fear the grim gaze of the spinners. I will stay silent and wait. His resolve is bound to crumble]
  - After: [Laypeople fear a spinner's gaze. Stay silent until he crumbles]
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am the herald of the end you fear so much. The Undying One has not whispered your name, so cast away your fear. No one will take your life before it is time."
  - After: "I herald the end you fear. The Undying One hasn't whispered your name. Your time isn't yet."
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "Long time no see, Spindle. Tell me, what does silence taste like?" {n}Are they using a secret code? Without Flaming Voice, he would never even speak to me.{/n}
  - After: "Spindle. What does silence taste like?" {n}A code?{/n}
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "I never said Spindle was 'trusted.' I said he knew what goes on in the plasma chambers."
  - After: "Not 'trusted.' He knows the chambers."
- **Stain**
  - Before: "We just had an enforcer die. I swear she did it to herself! Stepped right on a wire and riled up the machine spirits. You lot be careful now."
  - After: "An enforcer stepped on a wire. Her own fault, I swear!"
- **Stain**
  - Before: "R-really? I see... Well, if that's all you wanted, then can I... can I go?"
  - After: "R-really? Can I go?"
- **Stain**
  - Before: "There is a bunch of workers in the far corner who now gather between every shift, whispering to each other. They don't invite me — they say I talk too much. Well, if they're scared of my tongue, that means they have something to hide."
  - After: "Workers in the far corner whisper between shifts. Hiding something."
- **Stain**
  - Before: "Y-you... What are you looking at? You can't scare me! I know you lot never kill without reason. But we do! So quit staring, and just go... Please..."
  - After: "W-what? You lot don't kill without reason. We do! Go... Please..."
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "Are we bargaining for information with this lowlife now? It is the duty of every serf to aid the Rogue Trader and {rt_mf|his|her} associates, freely and willingly!"
  - After: "Bargaining? Serfs must aid the Rogue Trader and {rt_mf|his|her} people freely!"
- **Stain**
  - Before: "I'm not buying any of that spinner talk! I've known too many good men whose lives were taken, and it sure wasn't their time."
  - After: "Spinner talk! Good men died before their time."
- **Stain**
  - Before: "Hey, hey, hey, don't you poke me with that! Over my dead body, you hear?"
  - After: "Don't poke me with that!"
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "Enough! Now listen to me, you void mite. When I snap my fingers, your tongue will miraculously untie, I will be satisfied, and everyone here will stay in one piece. But if it will not..."
  - After: "Enough, void mite. Talk, and everyone stays whole. If not..."
- **Stain**
  - Before: "What is... this feeling? So... calm..."
  - After: "So... calm..."
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "It is difficult to admit, but I do share the Master-at-Arms's indignation. We came here to get information about the traitors, not to reveal our secrets."
  - After: "I agree with the Master-at-Arms. We came to learn, not tell."
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "But for them to take the bait, it must be compelling... Yes, I see."
  - After: "The bait must be compelling... I see."
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "There's no need to be so drastic, is there? We started this together, and we will finish it together."
  - After: "No. We finish this together."
- **Flaming Voice**
  - Before: "I just hope the wisdom of the Bloodspun Web won't cost us."
  - After: "Hope the Web's wisdom won't cost us."
- **Stain**
  - Before: "Fine, ask whatever you want. But then leave! My reputation cost me a lot of blood, and I didn't earn it to have it trampled into dust because you people happened to stop by!"
  - After: "Fine, ask. Then leave! Don't trample my reputation!"
- **Stain**
  - Before: "That's a funny look, Einrich! And you have a funny-looking company. Are you here to sell or to buy? And before you answer, remember the first rule: every word has a price!"
  - After: "Einrich! Selling or buying? Every word has a price!"
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "This wimp is your trusted source? He is pathetic."
  - After: "This wimp? Pathetic."
- **Stain**
  - Before: "Everybody knows silence doesn't taste like anything. If you wanna earn rations, you better start dealing in words." {n}He speaks casually, but his voice is slimy and slippery. His eyes are as dirty as an oil-stained garment. The impudence in his gaze and words when he turns them to us... He is unclean, and he knows it. He is unrepentant.{/n}
  - After: "Silence tastes of nothing. Deal in words." {n}Slimy, unrepentant.{/n}
- **Stain**
  - Before: "And, of course, everyone's talking about Nemesite. Sure, the foundry and the chapel were big, but he's been helping people all over. A lot of folks are sticking with him now. You can knock my teeth out if I'm lying — don't got many of those left anyhow — but I'll tell you this: even if someone finds him, they won't rat him out."
  - After: "Everyone loves Nemesite now. Nobody'll rat him out."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}You are a liar and manipulator, peddling other people's secrets and not knowing how to keep your mouth shut. You will become the bait, sowing confusion among the minions of Nemesite who hope to wait out the lockdown. They think they have enough time? I will deprive them of that confidence.{/n}
  - After: {n}Peddler of secrets. You'll be my bait for Nemesite's minions.{/n}
- **Steel Mistress**
  - Before: "What are you... That information is not meant for his ears!"
  - After: "That's not for his ears!"

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/Family/Parents/Parents_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I am looking for a Naaki Erebis. The ship's archives mention several of your ancestors, but the one I need is a living person."
  - After: "I seek a living Naaki Erebis."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The Undying Emperor? You were followers of the Bloodspun Web?"
  - After: "You followed the Bloodspun Web?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me about the Erebis family."
  - After: "Tell me about your family."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is there currently anyone named Naaki in your household?"
  - After: "Is there a Naaki here now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "From this point forward, Mattis will serve on my ship."
  - After: "Mattis will serve on my ship."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your son bears the name Mattis."
  - After: "Your son is named Mattis."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you remember Theodora well?"
  - After: "Do you remember Theodora?"
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: "He is the pride of the Erebis family. Its blood. Its essence. We are delighted for him to serve you as we used to serve Lady Theodora."
  - After: "Our pride. Let him serve you as we served Theodora."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: {n}The couple exchange glances again.{/n} "Our clan had... has a tradition. We name our children in honour of our past heroes: Mattis and Naaki Erebis, the twin founders of our family. A great warrior and a keeper of knowledge."
  - After: {n}They exchange glances.{/n} "We name children after our founders, twins Mattis and Naaki: warrior and scholar."
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: {n}Xioni Erebis nods slowly in response, a sad smile upon her lips.{/n} "We did. But the Emperor took her from us. The Undying Emperor."
  - After: {n}Xioni smiles sadly.{/n} "The Undying Emperor took her."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: "We realise that your attention to House Erebis was brought on by some manner of circumstances. Please let us know how we can be of service to you, and we will do what you require."
  - After: "How can we serve?"
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, allow us to thank you once again for this honour. Though we left the flagship a long time ago, it is a pleasure to be in the presence of a Lord Captain again." {n}Xioni looks at you with a pensive, unblinking gaze, her eyes darker than the night sky.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, thank you. We left the flagship long ago." {n}Xioni's dark eyes don't blink.{/n}
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: "Our eldest son, Mattis, is on the planetary guard. So is Lorna, our eldest daughter, though she has devoted herself to medicine. And to my great surprise and elation, our younger children, Rono and Lumi, have found their vocation in serving the God-Emperor and the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g}."
  - After: "Mattis and Lorna, a medic, guard the planet. Rono and Lumi serve the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g}."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: "Sadly, we are but a shadow of what was once a much more numerous clan. Most of our kinspeople fell in combat, but we believe the Erebises' last battle is yet to be fought. We raise cohorts of successors. We teach new recruits — and our own children — the ins and outs of void service before they even set foot on board. The new generation... are learning to serve in their own way."
  - After: "Most kin fell in battle, but our last fight is coming. We train our children for the void."
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: "No... No one has borne that name for many years now."
  - After: "Not for years."
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Randor and I, we have always been stalwart in our faith, and we revered the spinners' service, but their sacred path was too dark and frightening for us."
  - After: "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Their path was too dark for us."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: "We may not have understood the deeds of the Bloodspun Web, but we never doubted that the spinners carried out His will, for they gave their all to their duty. It is a heavy duty, but a true duty always is."
  - After: "Still, they did His will."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: {n}Randor laughs.{/n} "What can I say... I have always wanted to raise a great person."
  - After: {n}Randor laughs.{/n} "I wanted a great son."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: "I won't lie, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, we never saw her in person. We did not have the rank. Even her favour was bestowed on us in the form of a document penned and delivered by a scribe. But we remember her orders, and they were reflective of all the courage and fervour of a true Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, we lacked rank to meet her. Her orders were brave."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "They did name a daughter Naaki." {n}Kibellah's words hang heavy in the air.{/n}
  - After: "They named a daughter Naaki." {n}Silence.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "A keen observation." {n}Randor's eyes meet Kibellah's as she speaks, but he is not intimidated. On the contrary, the corner of his mouth curves upward slightly, and he gives a respectful nod.{/n}
  - After: "Keen." {n}Randor nods to Kibellah, smiling.{/n}
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: "Legend had it that a great future awaited bearers of those names. Every Mattis or Naaki Erebis would add to the clan's renown, and they would prove faithful assistants to any Lord Captain they served. But legends are just that, legends. It is not names that give people strength but the faith inside their hearts."
  - After: "Legend says those names bring renown. But faith, not names, gives strength."

- **Mattis Erebis**

  - After: "That corpse could have been me?" {n}Mattis recoils.{/n} "Why wasn't she told?"
- **Mattis Erebis**
  - Before: "It only hurts because I never knew you all these years."
  - After: "Only because I never knew you."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Enough. I... I know who Naaki Erebis is." {n}Her unblinking gaze turns to you.{/n}
  - After: "Enough. I know who Naaki Erebis is." {n}She looks at you.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The corners of her eyes twitch, as though she is in pain.{/n} "My name is Kibellah."
  - After: {n}She winces.{/n} "My name is Kibellah."
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: {n}Xioni leans over and puts an ear to her daughter's unmoving chest.{/n} "Her heart isn't beating! I must restart it! Step back!" {n}She lays her palms on Kibellah's breastbone and pushes — once, twice, thrice... ten times... thirty times...{/n}
  - After: {n}Xioni checks her.{/n} "No heartbeat! Step back!" {n}She pumps her chest.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}A heavy, raspy sigh escapes Kibellah's chest.{/n}
  - After: {n}Kibellah gasps.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Naaki Erebis... is dead. Only... Kibellah remains."
  - After: "Naaki is dead. Only Kibellah remains."
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: {n}Xioni touches Kibellah's cheek.{/n} "Naaki... The Emperor is merciful! He has not parted us!" {n}Kibellah carefully moves Xioni's hand aside.{/n}
  - After: {n}Xioni touches her cheek.{/n} "Naaki! The Emperor is merciful!" {n}Kibellah pushes her away.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I was weak. Reluctant to be taken in His hands. But then a haze clouded my eyes... And I saw her. A frightened girl. Naaki. The part of me even the ritual of releasing the burden had failed to erase. And I knew that a part of me had always clung to a past I did not even remember. My fear of death subsided. I let Naaki go, for the Undying One had been waiting to take her. And what was broken became whole. Naaki is gone. Only Kibellah remains."
  - After: "I feared death. Then I saw Naaki, a frightened girl. I let her go to the Undying One, and became whole."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah nods and casts a strange glance at those who, in another life, would have been her family.{/n} "Naaki Erebis is no more. Death's dues are paid. There is... one last thing to be done."
  - After: {n}Kibellah nods.{/n} "Naaki is gone. One last thing."
- **Xioni Erebis**
  - Before: "Naaki..." {n}Xioni Erebis looks at Kibellah with scarcely concealed fear, but her husband notices her reaction and shakes his head in warning.{/n}
  - After: "Naaki..." {n}Randor silences his frightened wife.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah shakes her head.{/n} "You are wrong, Domin. I hear your words, but I also... {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_StillDoubts}hear the whispers of monsters{/d} wandering through my mind. And they are glad that the Erebis will not die. For these people are the source of my doubts — empty hopes, the ghosts of attachments. Weaknesses that displease the Undying One. Only by cutting their threads will I prove that I am ready to serve Him fully."
  - After: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "No, Domin. I {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_StillDoubts}hear the whispers of monsters{/d}. These people are my doubts. I must cut them."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}She closes her eyes and exhales convulsively.{/n} "You... may be right. Perhaps I am making a mistake. I will trust you."
  - After: {n}She exhales.{/n} "Perhaps you're right."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The look in her dark eyes grows colder than the void itself.{/n} "These deaths please the Undying One. They are not for me, but for Him. I am but a blade that must be sharp if it is to serve. And I will cut the threads."
  - After: {n}Her eyes chill.{/n} "For Him, I will cut the threads."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The Erebis family recoils in horror, but a gesture from Kibellah freezes them on the spot.{/n} "I ask you and your guests to leave the room — let only the Undying One witness my return to the thread."
  - After: {n}Her gesture freezes the Erebises.{/n} "Leave. Only the Undying One may witness."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Death called the name... and my mind could not take in the will of the Undying One. The shock extinguished all thought, but there remained a hardness in my heart that my consciousness lacked. It... simply stopped. It did what I could not do by my own hand."
  - After: "Death called the name. My heart stopped, doing what my hand could not."
- **Mattis Erebis**
  - Before: "No!" {n}Mattis screams.{/n} "How could you keep something like that to yourselves? How could you... How could you!"
  - After: "No!" {n}Mattis screams.{/n} "How could you hide this!"
- **Lorna Erebis**
  - Before: {n}Lorna hugs her younger brother and sister, who cast frightened glances at their parents and the sinister woman with the wry smile.{/n}
  - After: {n}Lorna hugs the twins.{/n}
- **Mattis Erebis**
  - Before: "The woman who was destined for me. Not the love of my life, but... my sister?" {n}Mattis shudders and stares intently at Kibellah.{/n} "I didn't know. Do you... remember me?"
  - After: "My destined woman is my sister?" {n}Mattis shudders.{/n} "Remember me?"
- **Lorna Erebis**
  - Before: "An unseen shadow. A servant of death... Mother called her Naaki, but I knew she was talking to... someone she knew."
  - After: "A servant of death. Mother called her Naaki."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Naaki Erebis..." {n}Kibellah throws her head back, and her laughter resonates through the hall.{/n} "Naaki Erebis is me!"
  - After: "Naaki Erebis..." {n}Kibellah laughs.{/n} "Is me!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "You said the Undying One had taken Naaki. But death whispered her name only a short while ago."
  - After: "You said Naaki was taken. Death whispered her name just now."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/Family/VoidbornFamily_Start/VoidbornFamily_Start_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Let us enjoy the evening! Join the guests. We will talk later."
  - After: "Enjoy the evening. We'll talk later."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How is House Erebis faring on Dargonus?"
  - After: "How is House Erebis faring?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you finding the reception to your liking?"
  - After: "Enjoying the reception?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Officers Randor and Xioni Erebis both make the sign of the Aquila, reverent expressions on their battle-scarred faces. Beside them are their children. Raised to love the God-Emperor, they are mild-mannered but fascinated by their new surroundings. Judging by their uniforms, the two eldest children are already members of the Dargonus planetary guard.{/n}

  - After: "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Anytime."
- **Randor Erebis**
  - Before: "We are delighted by the favour shown to us, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Life in the capital is much calmer and slower compared to the ship. And I have almost gotten used to the gravity." {n}The prosthetic supporting Randor's spine creaks under his clothes as he attempts an awkward bow.{/n}
  - After: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! The capital is calm; I'm nearly used to gravity." {n}His spinal prosthetic creaks as he bows.{/n}
- **Xioni Erebis**

Even just permission to settle on Dargonus and continue our service on the dynasty's capital world was a most gracious gesture on Lady Theodora's part. We did not expect any further attention." {n}Xioni smiles gently, but her fingers are fidgeting with her heirloom pendant.{/n}

  - After: "Beyond our dreams! Dargonus was gift enough." {n}She fidgets with her pendant.{/n}

- **Xioni Erebis**

Let them get accustomed to these surroundings... and to your presence. Let them wander around the hall and taste the food. We will talk to each one individually."

  - After: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, House Erebis is honoured." {n}Randor looks anxious.{/n}

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/MeetingDeath/NewVizsier/NewVizsier_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You immediately donned the Vizsier's armour — is it helping you to embrace your new role?"
  - After: "Does the armour help you embrace the role?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I know this is a ridiculous question to ask, but... how are you doing?"
  - After: "Silly question, but how are you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Did I just see the God-Emperor? In the flesh?"
  - After: "Was that the God-Emperor in the flesh?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What will become of the Bloodspun Web now?"
  - After: "What becomes of the Bloodspun Web?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am sorry. Losing a mentor is hard."
  - After: "I'm sorry. Losing a mentor hurts."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have done your duty to the God-Emperor. It was his wish, as well."
  - After: "You did your duty, as he wished."
- **Player**
  - Before: "He was a crazed old man who lied to you and used you. Do not feel sorry for him."
  - After: "He was a crazed liar who used you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Am I to call you 'Vizsier' now?"
  - After: "Do I call you 'Vizsier' now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What did the Vizsier look like to you?"
  - After: "How did the Vizsier look to you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Clad in the Vizsier's armour, Kibellah is staring at the spot where, just a short time ago, lay the body of the man who raised her. Her shoulders are shaking and her head hangs low, but no tears are to be seen and no sobs come from behind her mask of dark gold. Suddenly, she throws her head back, and a desperate cry full of pain, fury, and regret echoes around the temple. This is not the Vizsier, nor a spinner you see before you. Just a daughter who has lost her father.{/n}
  - After: {n}In the Vizsier's armour, Kibellah screams in grief: a daughter who lost her father.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet shakes her head and whispers quietly,{/n} "To foster a bond just to sacrifice it in the end. To kill your father just to assume his place. Your kind's fear of what you perceive as weakness is, in truth, your greatest weakness of all — one that leads your spirit into a trap with no escape."
  - After: {n}Yrliet whispers,{/n} "A bond raised for sacrifice. Your fear of weakness is your greatest weakness."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Did you two have visions? All I saw was the old man himself... Though he did fight with a strength that is beyond mere mortals. Swift and deadly, he was. He chose himself a good death, even if it was bleak." {n}Ulfar looks at Kibellah pensively.{/n}
  - After: "I saw only the old man, fighting with uncanny strength. A good, bleak death." {n}Ulfar eyes Kibellah.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Tenets of the Web teach us never to regret or hesitate. But I could never have imagined that I would one day have to make a choice this painful. I did what had to be done... But that does not quell the pain. I know he is in the Undying One's hands, but that does not soothe the grief."
  - After: "The Tenets forbid regret. I did what I must, yet I grieve."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Was that how you saw the Vizsier, Domin'{name}? You saw an image of Death in him, but it was only an image. Fumes of the sacred intoxicant blessed our ritual, but what you saw, and killed, was a mere man. The Undying One does not come to the living. We come to Him."
  - After: "The fumes showed you Death, Domin'{name}, but you killed a man. We go to the Undying One, not He to us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Change lies ahead." {n}Kibellah cuts the air with her palm.{/n} "Travelling with you has given me {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Fanatic}many insights{/d}. We have been lurking in the shadows for too long! That was why we failed to prevent Nemesite's crimes or foil the abominations' plot. That was why we failed to protect Domin'Theodora. And I will not let anything like that happen to you! The Bloodspun Web will stretch its threads from out of the shadows and absorb new blood."
  - After: "Change." {n}She slashes the air.{/n} "You gave me {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Fanatic}many insights{/d}. Hiding, we failed Domin'Theodora. Never again! The Web will leave the shadows."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah raises her head to peer into the Undying Emperor's dark eye sockets.{/n} "We will not stray from the Tenets. We {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Humility}will not forget{/d} our predecessors' sacrifices and our Vizsiers' teachings. Service to the Undying One is our life. For He is duty. He is death."
  - After: {n}She looks up at the Undying Emperor.{/n} "We keep the Tenets and {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Humility}will not forget{/d} our forebears. He is death."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah tosses her head back proudly.{/n} "For too long, we have languished amid the dereliction of the lower decks, concealing ourselves and enacting His will in secrecy. No longer! Henceforth, we will be a scarlet hand guiding trembling souls. As His holy servants, we will vest ourselves in gold and the veneration we {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}deserve{/d}, for to despise us is to despise Him! And we will serve you, Domin'{name}, not from the shadows but bathed in radiance. Such is the new Bloodspun Web."
  - After: {n}She lifts her head.{/n} "No more hiding! We'll wear gold and the veneration we {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}deserve{/d}, serving you in radiance, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "He was... more than that. He was both a friend and..." {n}Kibellah's voice drops, her next words barely audible:{/n} "...a father."
  - After: "A friend and..." {n}She whispers.{/n} "...a father."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It was his duty. But he... was reluctant to leave me to the very end. I saw it as his eyes went dim."
  - After: "Yet he hated leaving me. I saw it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah whispers softly,{/n} "He was an old man who lied to me and used me... But he was. And now he is no more."
  - After: {n}She whispers,{/n} "He did. But now he's gone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Younger. The way he was when I first saw him. I was younger, too. It was as though we were facing each other in a training match like we used to."
  - After: "Young, like in our old training matches."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do not want to lose my name as my mentor lost his. But no spinner will ever speak it again, for I am their Vizsier. Yet you are my Domin. And I am your shadow. Let me remain Kibellah to you, at the very least."
  - After: "Spinners won't speak my name now. But to you, let me stay Kibellah."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We will open the temple to those among our congregation who wish to serve the flagship and the Undying One. We will grow our numbers. We will train fighters. We will share the enforcers' duty and fortify them with our skills. We will shun defending our grounds in confinement, and go on the offensive. We will no longer be unseen guardians, but will become His soldiers. And yours, Domin'{name}."
  - After: "We'll recruit, train fighters, aid the enforcers, and attack. Your soldiers, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I know I sought vengeance against him, but... I feel his absence already."
  - After: "I wanted vengeance, yet I miss him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I think so, yes." {n}Kibellah reverentially touches a drop of blood on the dark gold.{/n} "I... sense the weight of this sacred vestment. The weight of the Vizsier's burden and the decisions I must make. From this day forth — my burden." {n}Her voice is full of sombre pride.{/n}
  - After: "Yes." {n}She touches blood on the gold.{/n} "His burden is mine now." {n}Sombre pride.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "A fight worthy of Commorragh's arenas. I recall spectacles where members of the same family were forced to kill one another. What a treat it is to watch some mon-keigh patricide again."
  - After: "Arena-worthy. Mon-keigh patricide, what a treat."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/MeetingDeath/VizsierFinal

- **Player**
  - Before: "Sacrament? Are we being dragged into another ritual?"
  - After: "Sacrament? Another ritual?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you mean, 'the affliction you nurtured'? Was it you who doomed Kibellah to her suffering?"
  - After: "'The affliction you nurtured'? You made her suffer?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What will happen now?"
  - After: "What happens now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It seems your plan has failed. Kibellah did not carry out her last order."
  - After: "Your plan failed. She defied your last order."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let that which must be done, be done."
  - After: "Let what must be done, be done."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Kibellah, you must not commit... patricide!"
  - After: "Kibellah, no patricide!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is a simple transition of power not possible? Why must there be bloodshed?"
  - After: "Why not pass power without bloodshed?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not demand yet another sacrifice from her, Vizsier!"
  - After: "Demand no more sacrifice, Vizsier!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You snatched her from her family. Do not call her your daughter."
  - After: "You stole her. She's not your daughter."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And the feelings that exist between you. Those supersede all else, perhaps. Could I have prevented them from springing up? Smothered them while they were still weak? I could have. But I chose not to."
  - After: "And your bond. I could have smothered it, but didn't."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes. It is difficult to be cruel to someone you love. Have you come to know that, Domin?"
  - After: "Yes. Cruelty to loved ones is hard, Domin."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Do not call it love, Mentor. I was loyal to you and I deserved... better."
  - After: "Not love, Mentor. I deserved better."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I... forgive you for your cruelty, Mentor."
  - After: "I forgive you, Mentor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Kibellah will be the new Vizsier. Her journey to the Undying One and the choice she made will be reflected in the Bloodspun Web's new pattern. As for me... I will go to Him, as I have long awaited."
  - After: "Kibellah will be Vizsier. I go to Him at last."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The confusion and alarm in Kibellah's face gives way to anger and horror. Her face distorts like a crumbling paper mask as the emotions wash over her. Too many emotions for one whose soul has gone dead.{/n} "I— I have not yet done all that you expect me to, have I?"
  - After: {n}Her face crumbles in horror.{/n} "There's more you expect of me?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It has not failed. The choice has been made. Certainly, the new Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web will bring more change than I imagined. The threads will be more intertwined. The pattern will be different. But... the service to Him will continue."
  - After: "No. The choice is made. Service continues."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is correct, my daughter. Can you feel it? The proper way this burden must be passed?"
  - After: "Yes, daughter. Feel how the burden passes?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Agony distorts Kibellah's features, but she clenches her fists and nods.{/n} "We must summon death to these halls. And glorify Him."
  - After: {n}In agony, she nods.{/n} "We must summon death."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Still, it is... unfair." {n}Kibellah's face has become a death mask.{/n}
  - After: "It's unfair." {n}Her face becomes a mask.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Because great things are not achieved in small ways. Because if you worship Him, your sacrifice to Him must be great as well."
  - After: "Great worship demands great sacrifice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier's voice is full of sorrow and humility.{/n} "Yes. For I am stronger than you. And my high spinners stand with me, those who swore an oath to protect me and not outlive me. And He, too, stands with me. His face will emerge out of mine. And may those you chose when you set out along the threads of the Web, your comrades, your Domin — may they stand with you. Fight. Fight with no regret." {n}A bitter sigh falls from the old man's lips.{/n} "Farewell, my daughter. Let us honour the Undying One."
  - After: {n}Sorrowfully:{/n} "Yes. My spinners and He stand with me; your comrades with you. Fight." {n}He sighs.{/n} "Farewell, daughter."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah's voice falters. She clenches her teeth, trying to keep herself from bursting into tears.{/n} "I don't want to kill you!"
  - After: {n}Fighting tears:{/n} "I don't want to kill you!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah's face dissolves into a cruel and bitter smile.{/n} "And still you steal from me. Even my vengeance has become part of your ritual."
  - After: {n}Bitter smile.{/n} "Even my vengeance is your ritual."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I was her family. I raised her and taught her. I gave her everything I had. Did I not, my daughter?"
  - After: "I raised her. Didn't I, daughter?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A tired sigh escapes the Vizsier's chest.{/n} "A harrowing sacrament. A ruthless ritual... I am relieved that it is nearing the end. Everything is coming together just as He revealed to me. Perfection has been sculpted. The affliction I nurtured has been vanquished. The choice has been made... So whence all the sadness, my daughter?" {n}The Vizsier shakes his head, suddenly looking very human. His shoulders droop, and he extends a hand toward Kibellah.{/n}
  - After: {n}He sighs.{/n} "It ends as He revealed. The affliction I nurtured is gone. Why so sad, daughter?" {n}He reaches out.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A great ritual. Many decades ago, the Undying One revealed through a {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}Tarot{/g} reading what must come to pass, and I heeded. The Bloodspun Web's path toward gaining its new Vizsier was then conceived. A path of discovery, devotion, dying, and resurrection in purity. Kibellah's predecessor stumbled on that path. So did the next one. I waited. I have lived long past my due time. The Undying One has been waiting for me for so long..."
  - After: "Decades ago a {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}Tarot{/g} reading showed the path to a new Vizsier: devotion, death, rebirth. Two before her failed. I've waited long."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Undying One laid the thread, and I served as guide. The meeting with you and your world, Domin. The hunt for Nemesite, her grim and ghastly doppelganger. The comprehension of her flock's pain... My assignments stirred anxiety in my daughter's soul. As they were meant to."
  - After: "I guided her thread: meeting you, hunting Nemesite, her double. My tasks unsettled her, as intended."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "You... were my family, Mentor. You and the Bloodspun Web. I will not defile myself with a lie."
  - After: "You were my family, Mentor. I won't lie."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Blood is our gift. The only thing that is truly ours. The only worthy way to worship and honour Him."
  - After: "Blood is our gift, the worthy way to honour Him."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/MeetingDeath/VizsierFinal/VizsierFinal_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "We have learned how Kibellah came to be part of the Bloodspun Web. We have met her family."
  - After: "We learned how Kibellah joined. We met her family."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You greet us clad in armour. Are you preparing for battle?"
  - After: "Armour? Preparing for battle?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Kibellah has been cured of her affliction."
  - After: "Kibellah is cured of her affliction."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier whispers a prayer, his masked face turned toward the Undying One's image. Instead of his usual threadbare clothes, he is wearing elegant armour of bone and dark gold, marked with purity seals. He turns as he hears you approach.{/n} "Kibellah... I have been hearing your footsteps for a long time. In His whispers."
  - After: {n}The Vizsier prays, armoured in bone and gold.{/n} "Kibellah. I heard you coming."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier's voice becomes astonishingly gentle.{/n} "My daughter, do you believe you have only served Him because I set you on the thread of the Web? Do you believe you have no faith in Him? You know that is not true."
  - After: {n}Gently:{/n} "Daughter, is your faith only mine? No."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I grieve for her. And I am proud of you, Second Spinner. Your faith is beyond doubt."
  - After: "I grieve her, and am proud of you."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "This is my final report, Mentor. I no longer wish to serve you."
  - After: "My final report, Mentor. I quit your service."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Your words are dishonest. The ritual of releasing the burden erased me. Made me hollow. What will of my own I had... you took from me. And filled me with yours instead."
  - After: "Lies. The ritual hollowed me; you filled me with your will."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This is true. No longer do I see anguish in her soul... Second Spinner, I am ready to receive your report. Have you accomplished the task the Undying One Himself set you?"
  - After: "True. Report, Second Spinner. Is His task done?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Everyone the name of Naaki Erebis ever meant anything to is dead. Naaki is no longer among the living."
  - After: "All who cared for Naaki are dead. She's gone."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Yes, Mentor. My mission has been accomplished. The Undying One revealed a name to me, and I found my mark."
  - After: "Yes, Mentor. I found my mark."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Everyone the name of Naaki Erebis ever meant anything to has forgotten her... and themselves. Naaki is no longer among the living."
  - After: "All who cared for Naaki forgot her. She's gone."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Naaki Erebis died the moment she realised the Undying One wanted her to come to Him. Her body was wrested away from death, but... That which was once Naaki is now dead."
  - After: "Naaki died when He called. Only her body survived."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The task remains undone. I refuse to complete it! Condemning a life to oblivion is wrong for those who worship death. No one will hurt my family! No one will hurt me! Let the Undying One punish me if He so wills!"
  - After: "I refuse! No one hurts my family! Let Him punish me!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This was difficult for you to do, my daughter. I understand, and I am sorry. But such was the Undying One's wish."
  - After: "Hard, daughter. I'm sorry. His wish."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Silence falls for what feels like an eternity. At last, the Vizsier responds with the sadness of an all-forgiving father,{/n} "That... is one of the threads as well, my daughter. I understand you."
  - After: {n}A long silence.{/n} "That too is a thread. I understand."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Domin'{name}, {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark. It is good that you are here with her. It is right. The Undying One has blessed this union of light and shadow."
  - After: "Domin'{name}, {mf|Lord|Lady} of the Ark. He blesses this union."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Today is a special day. I have only donned this armour once before, when I was Second Spinner. That day... I ceased to be second. But I have remembered the weight of this gold on my shoulders and chest through all the years since." {n}Kibellah opens her mouth, but the Vizsier stops her with a gesture.{/n} "You will understand, my daughter. You will understand soon."
  - After: "I wore this armour once, when I stopped being second." {n}He silences Kibellah.{/n} "You'll see."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier looks away for a brief moment and nods to empty space.{/n} "The Undying One's congregation sacrifices the blood of its blood. That is how spinners are brought into this temple. But only those who would serve Him of their own volition stay and spin the Bloodspun Web. As Kibellah did."
  - After: {n}He nods to nothing.{/n} "Spinners are given as children. The willing stay."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah grits her teeth hissing,{/n} "You used my trust to make me your tool! Of course I see no other destiny for myself now. But that does not mean it was preordained!"
  - After: {n}She hisses,{/n} "You made me your tool! It wasn't preordained!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "You... are right, Mentor. The path I walk is mine. And I thank you for setting me on it."
  - After: "You're right. My path is mine. Thank you."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah's brow furrows in anguish.{/n} "Perhaps I could have served Him differently... Now I will never know. You took that away from me."
  - After: {n}Anguished:{/n} "You took my other paths from me."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/Trance/AstropathAfterDeath/AstropathAfterDeath_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Leave] "I tried to help her. But some ailments are incurable."
  - After: [Leave] "I tried. Some ailments are incurable."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As the shock of another mind's jumbled thoughts stops constricting your throat and the rippling haze falls from your eyes, you find yourself facing empty space. Kibellah's body, or indeed any trace of her, is nowhere to be seen: it is as if she was never in the chapel.{/n}
  - After: {n}The haze clears. Kibellah has vanished without a trace.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I looked away for one second, and that kaskha was gone! O Exalted One, I hope You really did collect her — because if You didn't, then this ship now has a mad murderer on the loose."
  - After: "That kaskha vanished! Exalted One, I hope You took her, or a mad murderer's loose."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/Trance/AstropathSoulThread/AstropathSoulThread_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "How are your ghosts, Weisz?"
  - After: "How are your ghosts?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is the Choir managing to fulfil its duties without Weisz?"
  - After: "Is the Choir coping without Weisz?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let us leave this subject."
  - After: "Let's drop this."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A slender young man, his eyes hidden behind sacred manuscripts, adjusts the augmetic on his temple. He notices you and starts.{/n} "L-Lord Captain! How can I be of service?"
  - After: {n}A blindfolded youth starts.{/n} "L-Lord Captain! How may I serve?"
- **Zacchary Weisz**
  - Before: {n}As you approach, the Choirmaster's blindfold lights up with a bluish glow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship seldom comes here without a reason. How can I be of service to you today?"
  - After: {n}Weisz's blindfold glows.{/n} "How may I serve, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I fear I am not in any way familiar with the ship's supply procedures or the lives of its children, so I cannot give you an answer, Lord Captain."
  - After: "I know nothing of supplies or the ship's children."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your words... They so remind me of what the late Master Weisz used to say. For reasons I will never know, this thought always troubled him." {n}The Choirmaster's brow furrows.{/n} "After some reflection of my own, I concluded that tormenting myself with such questions would only make said death in the warp arrive that much sooner."
  - After: "Weisz said that too; it troubled him." {n}A frown.{/n} "Brooding hastens death."
- **Zacchary Weisz**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Did you... ask for help? My apologies. I have only a vague recollection of what I was doing and whom I was talking to when Adeline appeared." {n}Weisz's face is sunken, but the undying spark behind the time-worn scrolls is still there.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I barely remember before Adeline came." {n}Gaunt, still sparked.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Monalic Qadd, acting Choirmaster of the Astropathic Choir, elected following Master Weisz's death until such time as a new Choirmaster is assigned to the flagship by decree of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAstraTelepathicaGlossary}Adeptus Astra Telepathica{/g}."
  - After: "Monalic Qadd, acting Choirmaster until the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAstraTelepathicaGlossary}Adeptus Astra Telepathica{/g} replaces Weisz."
- **Zacchary Weisz**
  - Before: {n}The Choirmaster looks away, embarrassed.{/n} "The mistakes of the past no longer haunt me, not in my dreams or in reality. But I still remember. I remember every single one of them."
  - After: {n}He looks away.{/n} "My mistakes no longer haunt me. But I remember them all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "To tell the truth, I have simply been too short on time lately. Running the Choir consumes all of my attention."
  - After: "The Choir takes all my time."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Despite all the difficulties — yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Master Weisz was the strongest voice in the Choir, and it is not easy for us without him. Sending and deciphering messages is harder now, but every Astropath is doing their utmost not to let the dynasty down."
  - After: "Barely, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Without Weisz, messaging is harder."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/Trance/KibellahAfterDeath/KibellahAfterDeath_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you well, Kibellah? Do you remember what happened? How we met... Death?"
  - After: "Are you well? Remember meeting Death?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}As the shock of another mind's jumbled thoughts stops constricting your throat, you find yourself staring at Kibellah's pale face. It has settled into a strange expression.{/n} "Domin... {name}?"
  - After: {n}Kibellah stares, pale.{/n} "Domin... {name}?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "But you have reminded me of who I am. And that my shameful weakness must be extinguished."
  - After: "You reminded me who I am. My weakness must die."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "And I am still filled with doubt. Is the Vizsier leading the Bloodspun Web down the right path? Do I hear truth in His whisper, or am I distorting it with my own wishes? That doubt must be extinguished."
  - After: "Is it His whisper, or my wishes? That doubt must die."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah looks away.{/n} "This 'Naaki Erebis' is the payment the Undying One demands. The price of redemption. The price of freedom. Who is this person? Where are they from? I do not know. Help me find them, Domin. Your Factotum oversees archives that contain many names. Let him find the one that Death has spoken. And I will pay the price that was set. For I know... I feel with all my essence... The death of Naaki Erebis is the key. The answer to my questions."
  - After: {n}She looks away.{/n} "Death's price for my redemption: Naaki Erebis. Have your Factotum search his archives for the name. Their death is the key."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I remember... stumbling. I remember my doubt in the truth of the Tenets throwing me off my feet. I remember deciding to kill... and not because I had heard His whisper, but because I deemed it to be right. Death whispered my name. For a spinner without a thread is like a sky without stars. They would drown in their own soul's darkness."
  - After: "I doubted the Tenets. I chose to kill by my own judgment, not His whisper. Then Death whispered my name."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionQuest/DeathCultist_Q2/Tribunal/KibellahKilledOfficer/KibellahKilledOfficer_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I must attempt to save her, at the very least."
  - After: "I must at least try to save her."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why is a Requiescator speaking for the late Forius? Does the man not have a family?"
  - After: "Why a Requiescator? Has Forius no family?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me about the circumstances of the murder."
  - After: "How did the murder happen?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Grant her grim soul mercy, Vizsier. Let her die."
  - After: "Grant her mercy, Vizsier. Let her die."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is happening to her? She is not herself."
  - After: "What's wrong with her?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why have you come here, Vizsier?"
  - After: "Why are you here, Vizsier?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whom specifically did Forius torture?"
  - After: "Whom did Forius torture?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Kibellah is not subject to ordinary justice. She serves the Emperor through death, and as such cannot be convicted for a death."
  - After: "Kibellah serves the Emperor through death; she can't be convicted for one."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Forius deserved to die, and I am not going to punish Kibellah for that murder. As for his practices, they are henceforth banned on this ship."
  - After: "Forius deserved death. Kibellah goes free, and his practices are banned."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have violated the prohibition on killing that I issued to the Bloodspun Web."
  - After: "You broke my ban on Bloodspun Web killings."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let us hear from the victim's representative."
  - After: "Let the victim's representative speak."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I find Kibellah guilty. But she will receive a more lenient penalty than death."
  - After: "Kibellah is guilty, but won't face death."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My companion is within her rights to kill anyone on this ship. Her accusers, on the other hand, are naught but dust. Do not touch her. Is that clear?"
  - After: "My companion may kill anyone aboard. Her accusers are dust. Do not touch her. Clear?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let us see just how well he knows the deceased. Tell me, Requiescator, what did Forius like and dislike about his work?"
  - After: "Requiescator, what did Forius like and dislike about his work?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The Forius clan will be awarded a generous indemnity for their loss, to be paid by me."
  - After: "I'll pay the Forius clan a generous indemnity."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The blame for what happened lies not with Kibellah, but with your entire perverse philosophy. Enforcers, I order you to cull every member of the Bloodspun Web on my ship!"
  - After: "Your perverse creed is to blame. Enforcers, cull every Bloodspun Web member aboard!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I never gave you permission to harm my servant, Vizsier."
  - After: "I never let you harm my servant, Vizsier."
- **Player**
  - Before: "She must die — not because anyone's beliefs demand it, but because such is the will of the Lex Imperialis. Kibellah, for the murder of a servant of the Imperium, your sentence is death. Vizsier, carry out the execution."
  - After: "By the Lex Imperialis, not belief: Kibellah, for murdering an Imperial servant, death. Vizsier, execute her."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have learned enough."
  - After: "I've learned enough."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A murder was committed. The punishment for that is clear. Let the law triumph. Commence preparations for the execution."
  - After: "Murder means death. Prepare the execution."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is it true that you killed him, Kibellah?"
  - After: "Did you kill him, Kibellah?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "These arguments are sensible."
  - After: "Sensible arguments."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Forius's nonchalant disregard for common humanity is worthy of respect!"
  - After: "His disregard for humanity is admirable!"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, a murder has been committed on this ship. The victim is one Lettard Forius, Chirurgeon Majoris. The perpetrator was apprehended at the scene of the crime, admitted her guilt, and did not resist arrest."
  - After: "Lord Captain, Chirurgeon Majoris Lettard Forius was murdered. The killer confessed."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: "How would one heal the soul of another, Domin? She is fighting a losing battle inside her mind... One she has all but lost. We cannot enter her mind. We cannot reach out a hand to her... Although..."
  - After: "How does one heal a soul? She is losing... Although..."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "The eyewitness accounts didn't give us much. The deceased and the murderer had a brief conversation, following which Mistress Kibellah beheaded the Chirurgeon Majoris. The witnesses did not overhear any details of the conversation."
  - After: "They talked briefly, unheard, then Kibellah beheaded him."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "The clan to which the deceased belonged are wary of bringing accusations against the Lord Captain's companion. And the esteemed Lettard never made any courageous friends in his life, having always preferred his work to the company of others."
  - After: "His clan fear accusing your companion. Lettard had no brave friends."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Heartless Man imagined himself to be above others. He believed his trade had uplifted him. He {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}did not even avert his gaze{/d} before a servant of the Undying One. It was... brazen. Unjustifiable."
  - After: "He thought himself above others; he {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}did not even avert his gaze{/d} before me."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Heartless Man enjoyed what he did. His work should have been a {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Fanatic}holy mission of service{/d}. The pain of thousands should have been a solemn sacrifice. Yet he derived pleasure from it. It was... repulsive."
  - After: "It should have been {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Fanatic}holy mission of service{/d}. He enjoyed the pain. Repulsive."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Heartless Man took on a burden that was not his to bear. His duty was to heal, but instead he sent people to the Undying One, people whose time had not yet come. He was... {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Humility}cruel{/d}. And had no intention of ever stopping."
  - After: "A healer who sent people to Him early. {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Humility}cruel{/d}, and unstopping."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: "The Second Spinner is in the throes of a spiritual ailment that we call doubt. This most terrible ailment, though harmless to layfolk, is deadly to us. For a doubtful spinner will stray from their destined thread and into bloodthirsty madness. Doubt brings them to the Undying One before their time."
  - After: "She doubts. A doubting spinner strays from their thread into bloody madness."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Enforcers! The Bloodspun Web is now outlawed! Execute the undesirables!"
  - After: "Enforcers! The Bloodspun Web is outlawed! Execute them!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah appears cold and apathetic. Her unblinking eyes stare vacantly, her expression odd.{/n}
  - After: {n}Kibellah stares vacantly.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Mentor... Why me? Do you truly think the greatest danger to your flock is... me?" {n}Kibellah's voice trembles with pain.{/n}
  - After: "Mentor... I am your flock's greatest danger?" {n}She trembles.{/n}
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "Unimportant people. Common people. Doomed people." {n}The Requiescator shakes drops of imaginary blood from his hands with disgust.{/n} "This was the esteemed Lettard's way of thinking: does a doomed leper care whether the disease or the knife is causing them pain? Is the formula for a medicine that would cure distinguished officers not worth the lives of a few dozen commoners turned test subjects? With the knowledge he gained, he invented a multitude of balms, antidotes, and treatment methods that went on to save thousands of lives."
  - After: "Doomed commoners." {n}He shakes his hands.{/n} "Few lepers for a cure? His findings saved thousands."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Yes." {n}Neither the chirurgeon's death nor her own impending punishment seem to trouble Kibellah. Her pensive dark gaze wanders around the bridge.{/n} "It was me."
  - After: "Yes." {n}Untroubled.{/n} "It was me."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: {n}Though the Vizsier's eyes are sewn shut, one can still read the grief that permeates his wrinkled features. He whispers in a sorrowful voice,{/n} "You have strayed from the thread. You have doomed the Tenets of the Bloodspun Web to oblivion. What a sorry end — for me, not for you. For I am compelled to usher my apprentice's soul to the other side before it is my own time to go."
  - After: {n}The Vizsier grieves.{/n} "You strayed and doomed our Tenets. Now I must end you."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Undying One... never whispered his name. I myself decided to sever his thread."
  - After: "He never whispered his name. I chose to sever his thread."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Heartless Man did more than heal people. He maimed them, too. Tortured them. Killed them slowly. And observed."
  - After: "He also maimed, tortured, slowly killed. And watched."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier turns his face toward Kibellah, who seems withdrawn, her spark snuffed out. He whispers,{/n} "Then seek a steward of souls. An artisan who will put you both in a psyker's trance, allowing your minds to become one. You have a chapel full of Astropaths, Domin. One of them will surely do you that service. See that their guidance is strong, for inside her soul, you will encounter... monsters. A doubt-ridden mind is a dangerous place."
  - After: {n}He faces Kibellah.{/n} "Have an Astropath join your minds in a trance. Her doubting soul holds monsters."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "When there is no one to speak for a deceased person in court, their representative is entitled to seek assistance from a member of the Requiescators' Guild. Their duty is to know and remember each and every person on this ship so that they can defend the interests of the deceased and represent them in court. They study the victim's entire life history to gain the most detailed impression of their personality, deeds, and aspirations. The guild was founded by one of your distant ancestors and, to my knowledge, the Requiescators only exist on our glorious flagship."
  - After: "When none speaks for the dead, a Requiescator may. Their guild, founded by your ancestor, knows everyone aboard."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "We humbly await your verdict, Lord Captain."
  - After: "We await your verdict, Lord Captain."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: {n}The masked man's voice is unpleasantly creaky.{/n} "The esteemed Lettard served this voidship and this dynasty for many years. He treated the sick and gained new knowledge as his trade commanded. He saved many, but he himself was not saved. He caused Mistress Kibellah no grievance. He never offended her. He merely answered her questions regarding his work, whereupon he was attacked. And so he has the right to demand a reckoning. The death of his murderer would be lawful and proportionate retribution."
  - After: {n}A creaky voice.{/n} "He answered her questions and was attacked. Her death would be lawful."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: {n}The masked head bows ceremoniously.{/n}
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n}
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "His methods were efficient. Only one who has never lain upon an operating table would prefer a principled healer to a competent one."
  - After: "Efficient. Patients prefer competence to principle."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "The esteemed Lettard would be grateful for this judgement. He was a man of logic and practicality."
  - After: "Practical Lettard would be grateful."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: {n}The masked man bows, stiffly and decorously.{/n}
  - After: {n}The masked man bows.{/n}
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: {n}A single voice cuts through the ensuing silence.{/n} "That is the Lord Captain's will. But the deceased would not call it justice."
  - After: {n}One voice:{/n} "Your will. Not the deceased's justice."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}She points at the masked man and smiles wryly. Her grim whisper is chilling:{/n} "I am going to kill you too."
  - After: {n}She smiles at the masked man.{/n} "I'll kill you too."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I am fine." {n}Kibellah turns her face toward you slightly. A whisper escapes her lips:{/n} "This is just hollow ceremony. Pointless."
  - After: "Fine." {n}Whispering:{/n} "This ceremony is pointless."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: {n}The masked head lowers, and the man strokes his chin contemplatively.{/n} "He was fascinated by diseases. Injuries. Pathogens. Complications. The part he disliked was... the patients. They would not let him concentrate on that which was killing them."
  - After: {n}He muses.{/n} "He loved diseases. Patients distracted him."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Frowning, Kibellah adds,{/n} "There was another like the Heartless Man. A xenos from the Dark City who lorded over flesh and oversaw {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_KibellahWasInCommoragh}unholy resurrections{/d}. They were both touched by the same corruption, that of hubris."
  - After: {n}She frowns.{/n} "A Dark City xenos did {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_KibellahWasInCommoragh}unholy resurrections{/d}. Same hubris."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: "To take the one who no longer sees the Tenets. To give her to Him. She is dangerous. To pacify her forever — such is my duty, and so it must be."
  - After: "To give her to Him. She is dangerous. My duty."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: "But if you saw her the way I see her, you would. She is tempest. She is woe. You do not want this by your side, Domin. Believe me."
  - After: "If you saw her as I do, you would. She is tempest and woe."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Did He whisper my name to you? I— I do not believe you, Mentor. I am loyal to Him. You must have been confused and misread His signs."
  - After: "He whispered my name? No, Mentor. I'm loyal. You misread Him."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "What makes you think you are fit to judge me, Mentor? You are not Him!"
  - After: "Who are you to judge me? You are not Him!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah fixes you with a long stare, as though struggling to comprehend what you have just said. Then she sighs.{/n} "That matters little. You cannot prevent death from taking. It simply takes."
  - After: {n}She sighs.{/n} "You cannot stop death."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "I humbly declare that the esteemed Lettard was indifferent to the fortunes, good or otherwise, of his estranged kinspeople whom you have made rich. And that he would not be satisfied with this ruling."
  - After: "Lettard cared nothing for his kin. He'd be unsatisfied."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "He treated the sick and he gained knowledge." {n}The masked head jerks up haughtily.{/n} "The boots of those who walk the path of wisdom leave bloodied footprints. It is a rule that existed long before the esteemed Lettard did."
  - After: {n}Haughtily:{/n} "Wisdom's path leaves bloody footprints."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: "Our service is demanding. It requires clarity and a sense of purpose that she no longer possesses. Long have I sensed the seeds of anxiety in her, but I hoped her reason would prove stronger and prevail. Alas, now I see the mark of despondence on her. Alas, I know that I am not mistaken."
  - After: "Our service needs clarity she has lost. I hoped her reason would win."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: "You could. A thread binds the Domin and {mf|his|her} shadow together. A rare thread, a shared thread. Will that connection be enough for your souls to enter into harmony?"
  - After: "You could. A rare thread binds the Domin to {mf|his|her} shadow."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai shrugs.{/n} "So she felt like killing some servant. Why do they all take such offence? Is every corpse going to cause such a stir from now on?"
  - After: {n}Marazhai shrugs.{/n} "She killed a servant. So?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I told you it would end like this. But why should anyone listen to little old Jae?" {n}She shakes her head sullenly.{/n}
  - After: "I told you. Nobody listens to Jae." {n}She sulks.{/n}
- **Deck Enforcer**
  - Before: "No contradicting the Lord Captain, convict." {n}The enforcer lays a firm hand on Kibellah's shoulder.{/n}
  - After: "Quiet, convict." {n}He grips Kibellah's shoulder.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Her colours have changed. The scarlet and the gold are drowning in the rage of muddled crimson, the misty blues of sorrow, and the impenetrable greens of doubt. These shades are all in conflict, melding together in a frenetic tapestry..."
  - After: "Her colours clash: crimson rage, blue sorrow, green doubt."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "You walked a narrow, dark path across a yawning abyss — it is small wonder that you stumbled. This soul, already mangled by bloody and frightening service, has fractured further still. Can it still be saved?" {n}Yrliet falls silent, leaving her own question unanswered.{/n}
  - After: "You stumbled on a narrow path over an abyss. Can your soul be saved?" {n}Silence.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "She was never sane to begin with. Judging lunatics is a thankless duty. The more important thing to address is that her cult is guilty of having drilled the notion of chosenness into her head — the whole sect must answer for this incident."
  - After: "She was never sane. Her cult taught her she's chosen; it must answer."
- **Vizsier of the Bloodspun Web**
  - Before: {n}The bridge is suddenly filled with a furious clamour, until an old man's whisper cuts through the noise.{/n} "Enough, my daughter."
  - After: {n}A whisper cuts the clamour.{/n} "Enough, my daughter."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Do. Not. Touch me!" {n}Her hissing whisper turns into a ferocious cry. Out of nowhere, a dagger appears in her grasp and flashes across the enforcer's hand. His bloodied fingers fall to the floor.{/n}
  - After: "Do. Not. Touch me!" {n}Her dagger takes the enforcer's fingers.{/n}
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "The Forius clan invoked a ship's tradition and summoned a Requiescator to testify on behalf of the deceased."
  - After: "The Forius clan summoned a Requiescator."
- **The Late Lettard Forius**
  - Before: "When you were brought in and placed on his table, burned by the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}fire you had passed through{/d}, he saved you. The methods he used to keep your body alive had been tested on inhabitants of Loading Bay 8. As had the scar-removing techniques. Were their lives worth yours? The esteemed Lettard thought that they were."
  - After: "He saved you from the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}fire you had passed through{/d} using methods tested on Loading Bay 8. Worth it, he judged."

  - After: {n}Running water. A bloody vision fades at Kibellah's touch.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Tenets are impermanent." {n}Kibellah's voice is barely louder than the water.{/n} "Death is the end of all, and even they cannot avoid that end. Their time has come."
  - After: "The Tenets are impermanent." {n}Softly.{/n} "Death ends them too. Their time has come."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "May these waters mend the mistakes of the lost." {n}Kibellah presses a hand to her chest, staring at the rippling surface.{/n} "May they wash away the missteps, cleanse the soiled hands, clear the clouded mind... and as we wade in, may they grant us the strength to follow our thread."
  - After: "May these waters mend our mistakes." {n}Hand on chest.{/n} "And give us strength to follow our thread."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A pool of clear water is not something one finds in the bowels of a ship..." {n}Kibellah's hand slides down your shoulder, pulling you closer.{/n} "Today, we can allow ourselves a little... relief. Forget all about the Tenets and the Bloodspun Web... Although, who knows — perhaps my apprentices would benefit from a lesson in pleasure. Perhaps their mistress will teach them one day."
  - After: "Clear water on a ship..." {n}She pulls you close.{/n} "Today, forget the Tenets. My apprentices could use a lesson in pleasure."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She touches your cheek and presses her forehead to yours.{/n} "The union of two. The joining of fates. The interweaving of souls. Thus, the Grace of the Web is born. Our thread. Our world. Our destiny. I love you."
  - After: {n}Forehead to yours.{/n} "Souls interwoven. Thus the Grace of the Web is born. Our thread. I love you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She raises her head and looks directly at you.{/n} "Always remember, Domin'{name}, that I love you. I will carry this love into the embrace of death when the time comes for me to reach my end. Remember. Remember..."
  - After: {n}She meets your eyes.{/n} "Remember, Domin'{name}: I love you, until death. Remember..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She plants an ardent kiss upon your lips.{/n} "Enough words. Today, we belong only to each other, no one else. Masks, facades... those are things of tomorrow. Not of now. Love me, and only me."
  - After: {n}An ardent kiss.{/n} "Enough words. Today we're only each other's. Love only me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Domin'{name}..." {n}She speaks so tenderly that she loses her breath.{/n} "I would defy the Tenets — no, every law in the Imperium — just for a chance to be happy with you... but I know I won't be." {n}She falls silent, waiting to hear your guiding voice.{/n}
  - After: "Domin'{name}..." {n}Breathless.{/n} "I'd defy every law for you... but I won't be happy." {n}She waits.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I can love you still, from the shadows of the web. If that isn't enough for you... I will withdraw into the darkness. I will take our feelings with me and keep them far away from you."
  - After: "I can love you from the Web's shadows. If not enough, I'll withdraw."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, you do. The knowledge lies within — deep in your soul. The Grace of the Web is upon you."
  - After: "You do, deep in your soul. The Grace of the Web is upon you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She laughs.{/n} "And who has been my guiding light? Who has walked me through the darkness to this revelation? Lead me on, then. To freedom. Our freedom. Forever."
  - After: {n}She laughs.{/n} "Who guided me here? Lead on, to our freedom."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah laughs with a light-heartedness you have not heard from her before.{/n} "The Tenets of the Web are behind me — so, why think about something that's already gone? Take my hand — let us wash ourselves clean of the ashes of the past and step into the future."
  - After: {n}A light laugh.{/n} "The Tenets are behind me. Let's wash off the past."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah places her hands on your chest.{/n} "Why don't we burn it all down? Walk away from this absurdity and celebrate together. I even have something in mind..."
  - After: {n}Hands on your chest.{/n} "Let's burn it and celebrate. I have an idea..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah looks at you, her smile calm and sad.{/n} "We have passed the labyrinth's web. Ahead of us..." {n}Tears glisten in her eyes.{/n} "...are new trials. But I believe that as long as we keep each other in our hearts, we will always prevail. Come, Domin'{name}." {n}She whispers so quietly that you can barely hear her.{/n} "Let's cleanse ourselves before we go back to our threads."
  - After: {n}Sad smile.{/n} "Ahead..." {n}Tears.{/n} "...new trials. Together, we'll prevail, Domin'{name}." {n}Whispering.{/n} "Let's cleanse ourselves, then return to our threads."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her hands wrap around you, joining at the back of your neck. Her lips meet yours, and together you dissolve in the flood of her tenderness and passion as she loses herself in the kiss.{/n} "I love you, {name}. I always will. Until the end of the last star in the dark void."
  - After: {n}A passionate kiss.{/n} "I love you, {name}. Until the last star dies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Forever..." {n}Kibellah's expression tenses — she wants to look at you, but she does not lose control.{/n}
  - After: "Forever..." {n}She keeps her control.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "I've left too many tracks within its walls. I must complete the journey."
  - After: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "I must finish the journey."
