- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah bows her head in a short greeting. Her eyes practically glow with anticipation.{/n} "Within these walls, under the spectral watch of the dead, in the land that our deeds have cleansed of pestilence... I wish to take you on a journey: the ritual of finding light."
  - After: {n}Kibellah bows.{/n} "Among the dead, I would take you through the ritual of finding light."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She slowly brings a hand to your face and touches the corner of your eye.{/n} "Sight is your ally and your foe, for it exists only to perceive deeds and be oblivious to intentions. I will teach you to see without eyes, Domin'{name}, as I was taught once. Will you permit me to sew your eyes shut and guide you through the ritual, along a thread unseen?"
  - After: {n}She touches your eye.{/n} "I will teach you to see without eyes, Domin'{name}. May I sew them shut?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Darkness is merciless. You learned this while trying to hide from the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}nightmares{/d} that torment you. No matter how tightly you shut your eyes on those long nights, the haunting visions would not leave you alone, either in sleep or during waking hours. The moment Kibellah applies the final stitch, you can feel it: the horrors are already here, lying in wait for you to make even a single misstep. And when you do, they will drown you in that merciless darkness.{/n}
  - After: {n}As with your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}nightmares{/d}, darkness is merciless. The horrors await your misstep.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No, Domin'{name}. My stitches will be precise and my hand careful. Once you have passed the ritual, I will unseal your eyes, and no harm will have come to you."
  - After: "No, Domin'{name}. After the ritual I will unseal them, unharmed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah steps away, her hand sliding off you to hang limply by her side. You barely hear her as she says,{/n} "I understand. Perhaps the distance between us was never meant to be crossed. Go, then."
  - After: {n}Kibellah steps away.{/n} "Perhaps our distance cannot be crossed. Go."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}In the gloom of the crypt, the needle in Kibellah's hands could be mistaken for the flash of one of her blades.{/n} "Close your eyes, Domin'{name}, and humble your breathing in a silent prayer to the Undying One."
  - After: {n}Her needle gleams.{/n} "Close your eyes, Domin'{name}, and pray."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your eyelids hurt after having been punctured and stitched together with thread. The sensation muddles your thoughts and evokes an eerie dread from the depths of your heart. You are blind. Not a single ray of light can creep into your world, and your only awareness about your immediate surroundings is based on subtle noises. Through the veil of pain, you hear Kibellah's quiet voice:{/n} "We accept His blessings with a single purpose: to serve Him in our unity stronger than any chains. Come to me, Domin'{name}. The sound of my voice will show you the way, if you can unfetter your heart..."
  - After: {n}Stitched blind, in pain, you hear Kibellah:{/n} "Come to me, Domin'{name}. Follow my voice..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She pauses before answering. She moves her hand down, cautiously touching your chest.{/n} "There is... much between us that I have yet to understand. Decks and bulkheads separate us, but greater still is the spiritual distance. You have entered my labyrinth, and I have been to your world. But there is still so much more that we must learn about each other. I am inviting you to walk my paths so that you may see into me. And I into you."
  - After: {n}She touches your chest.{/n} "A spiritual distance lies between us. Walk my paths and see into me. And I into you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You push yourself out of the depths of pain, submitting completely to Kibellah's voice. A moment later, it starts to become louder and clearer. The disturbing pain does not disappear, but now you know where to go — and you follow your guide.{/n}
  - After: {n}You submit to her voice, and follow.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The loss of sight must have affected you on a subconscious level. You cannot get the throbbing pain out of your mind. Your legs are shaking... You feel forever lost in the darkness with no way out, other than the faint hope of following the echo of Kibellah's voice.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pain overwhelms you. You cling to Kibellah's echoing voice.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You focus all your attention on your physical suffering... and the pain retreats, as if intimidated by your resolve. You take a step and then another.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your resolve beats back the pain. You step forward.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Suddenly, Kibellah's voice seems to multiply, as if every word were being spoken by several copies of her in unison:{/n} "Along the threads that form the web; along the rays of the star whose heart turns ice into flame; along the tracks we have left for one another, we shall come together in a unity that will become our revelation — in death which grants true sight; in death for which all are fated..." {n}Your knees buckle — the anxiety that has been with you since the beginning of the ritual now clamps around your throat like a collar of steel.{/n}
  - After: {n}Kibellah's voice multiplies:{/n} "Along the web we shall unite, in death which grants true sight..." {n}Dread clamps your throat.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Where the joining of opposites begets a collapse, a collapse that will become an act of creation: from the ruins of meaning, sacred halls will rise, and He will be pleased..." {n}Her tone changes subtly — as if the ritual prayer were somehow transforming into a love song.{/n}
  - After: "Where opposites collapse into creation..." {n}The prayer becomes a love song.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You muster your strength and renounce the phantom terrors. Your weakness forgotten, you follow the guiding thread that shines in your mind — the thread of Kibellah's voice.{/n}
  - After: {n}You shake off the terror and follow her voice.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You channel your force of will to push the suffocation aside, refusing to let it force you to your knees... and you can almost hear the ringing of metal as the collar around your throat finally loosens. The guiding thread of Kibellah's voice shines on in your mind.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your will breaks the dread. Her voice still guides you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You are powerless before this smothering fear. The anxiety swallows you whole like a wave, and as you are pulled under, you can no longer hear Kibellah's voice for a few long seconds.{/n}
  - After: {n}Fear swallows you; you lose her voice.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "All who rest in these halls do so as a reward for the deeds they performed in His name. May the end of our journey be as glorious as that of all who came before us..." {n}Kibellah trails off. Eventually, she adds, softly and quietly,{/n} "Take my hand. Thus shall we walk into the halls we are destined for."
  - After: "May our journey end gloriously..." {n}Softly:{/n} "Take my hand."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You feel a slight resistance... but then she lets out a trembling sigh and steps toward you, placing her hand in yours.{/n}
  - After: {n}She resists, then sighs and takes your hand.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A strange sensation comes over you, as if the two of you had found yourselves in a confined space, delirious from the lack of air and intoxicated by each other's warmth. You can see Kibellah — and a maze of dully flickering crimson lines beneath your feet. She exhales,{/n} "It's wrong... It's all wrong..." {n}She squeezes your fingers.{/n} "But I trust you. I'm coming toward you. The distance is fading away."
  - After: {n}You see Kibellah over crimson lines.{/n} "It's all wrong..." {n}She squeezes your hand.{/n} "But I trust you. The distance fades."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}...and you feel the darkness touch you. Directly ahead, you see Kibellah, holding your hand. Her eyes, so full of warmth, are looking at you.{/n} "You've found me... despite everything. Now, dive deeper... immerse yourself in what unites us at this crossroads..."
  - After: {n}Kibellah holds your hand.{/n} "You've found me. Now dive deeper..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}...and though your eyes are still blind and your body trembles, you feel warmth — her warmth. Despite everything, you have walked the road of darkness — and reached the one who has been guiding you with her voice. You feel her breath on your neck and hear her words in your ear:{/n} "We've gone deeper. We're closer now. Closer than ever before."
  - After: {n}Still blind, you reach her warmth.{/n} "We're closer than ever."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The gloom begins to part as a razor-sharp blade cuts the stitches on your eyelids one by one. You feel gentle touches, your wounds sting a little... and at last, you can see once more. The dim light of the crypt blinds you so badly that Kibellah appears as a faceless dark silhouette before you.{/n}
  - After: {n}A blade cuts the stitches. You see again.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And once again, you have witnessed my truth, Domin'{name}." {n}Kibellah does not look at you — her gaze seems to be directed inward or, perhaps, nowhere at all.{/n} "Light has been found. We have passed another circle on our way to the truth at the heart of our bond."
  - After: "Again you witnessed my truth, Domin'{name}." {n}Her gaze turns inward.{/n} "Light is found. Another circle passed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She touches your cheek with her fingertips.{/n} "No. I should be the one thanking you. Few are worthy of this ritual. I have never performed it for anyone before..." {n}A smile blossoms on her lips.{/n}
  - After: {n}She touches your cheek.{/n} "I should thank you. I've never done this for anyone." {n}She smiles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She looks at you with an elusive smile.{/n} "Yes, we did. That is how the ritual of finding light is performed: not alone, but together, by those who are bound in His light, in His name."
  - After: {n}She smiles.{/n} "Yes. It is done together, in His light."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is no need. The ritual is complete. And this experience... do not try to make sense of it — simply accept it, as one would accept death."
  - After: "No need. Accept it, as one accepts death."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah takes a deep breath.{/n} "You... saw it? Then you're walking down its winding paths... together with me. You must have truly come to know me if our minds have touched so." {n}She frowns.{/n} "I did not expect your trance to extend so deeply. I... must think about this."
  - After: {n}She breathes deep.{/n} "You saw it? Then our minds have touched." {n}She frowns.{/n} "So deep... I must think."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You must return from death's halls out into the world. And please..." {n}Kibellah presses a hand to your chest.{/n} "All that the ritual has revealed to you — keep it in your heart. It is your treasure alone."
  - After: "Return to the world." {n}Hand on your chest.{/n} "Keep what you saw. It is yours alone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You hear silence... and suddenly the ethereality around you is replaced by something else, something normal. You hear footsteps approaching, then a whisper:{/n} "I'm here. Don't move. Let me take those off."
  - After: {n}Silence, then a whisper:{/n} "I'm here. Let me take those off."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You open your eyes and see light once more — and Kibellah, wearing a saddened expression.{/n} "I should not have distracted you from your labours, Domin'{name}. Please... return to your thread. I will think upon all that took place here."
  - After: {n}Kibellah looks saddened.{/n} "Forgive me, Domin'{name}. Return to your thread."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We wear masks on our faces, not on our souls." {n}The corners of her mouth twitch.{/n} "I may be a spinner of death, but I'm still a human inside... as are you."
  - After: "We mask faces, not souls." {n}She smiles.{/n} "I'm still human... as are you."

  - Before: {n}A new, unfamiliar pain seeks to consume you, so you find sanctuary in the older, more familiar ache. The torment that you went through in the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}past{/d}, the torment that could not break you, eases your suffering in the present. You take a step and then another.{/n}
  - After: {n}You take refuge in {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}past{/d} torment. You step forward.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

Through the revelation of the flesh, we have spun a stronger spiritual bond between us. Do you feel it?"

  - Before: "The Bloodspun Web does not encourage the pleasures of the flesh, but nor does it forbid them. A spinner is free to enjoy carnal love, but what draws them to it is usually curiosity rather than passion. Or... a special feeling, a sacred feeling that must not be sacrificed to ascesis."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah's eyes drift closed.{/n} "Yes. It was... a new sensation. Every moment with you was replete with meaning. Empty lust would not grant such depth of feeling."
  - After: {n}Eyes closed.{/n} "Yes. Every moment held meaning."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "The first of many revelations." {n}She stretches.{/n} "Body and soul, toward unity."

  - Before: {n}A wan smile briefly flickers on Kibellah's face.{/n} "Then the shadow will be silent. The Domin's will is law."
  - After: {n}A wan smile.{/n} "The Domin's will is law."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/CompanionRomance/UnwelcomeInterruption/UnwelcomeInterruption_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You were thinking about me?"
  - After: "You thought of me?"

  - After: "I didn't mean to disrupt it."

  - After: [Smirk] "Beaten by someone who landed no blow! How does it feel?"

  - Before: "I doubt the God-Emperor forbids our bond."
  - After: "The God-Emperor won't forbid our bond."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Thinking about someone you hold dear is perfectly normal."
  - After: "Thinking of a loved one is normal."

  - Before: "Why are you so distraught? Can't you reserve even one small part of your life to yourself?"
  - After: "Why so distraught? Can't you keep some of life for yourself?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I refuse to answer that question."
  - After: "I won't answer that."

  - Before: "I would continue doing my duty."
  - After: "I'd keep doing my duty."

  - Before: "I would accept that the appearance of someone important in my life was bound to throw things into a bit of a disarray."

  - Before: "I am tired of your woes. There won't be anything to distract you anymore, because you and I are done."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah makes a ritual gesture, but you notice her fingers tremble.{/n} "Domin'{name}, you need to know about what happened. You and no one else."
  - After: {n}Her fingers tremble.{/n} "Domin'{name}, only you must know."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "During the divination that revealed Adalbert's betrayal to me, my trance was interrupted. Instead of converging on a single point, my thoughts were thrown off the intended path, and I lost my thread." {n}She looks up at you with distress in her eyes.{/n} "What distracted me... were thoughts of you."
  - After: "Divining Adalbert's betrayal, I lost my thread." {n}Distressed:{/n} "Because of you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She nods.{/n} "Your image intruded upon my mind when it was supposed to act as a blade seeking its target — when all of my being was focused on fulfilling my duty. My trance was broken, and I committed an offence against the Undying One."
  - After: {n}She nods.{/n} "Mid-duty. My trance broke. An offence to Him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "I know, but your shadow blocked my vision when I was looking for a sign from Him."
  - After: {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "Yet you blocked His sign."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her brow furrows.{/n} "You've chosen a poor time for jests. Through training and abstinence, my mind has been shaped to be impenetrable to outside influence. And still, you forced your way into my mind's eye and put the whole ritual at risk."
  - After: {n}She frowns.{/n} "No jests. You broke into my trained mind."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I was able to restore my trance and banish all thoughts that didn't belong. But that this happened at all is still worrying." {n}She pauses.{/n} "You... are dear to me, more so than I first realised. But my duty is to serve the Undying One. What if..." {n}She falters, then looks at you intently.{/n} "What if your presence in my mind, in my labyrinth... goes against the Tenets?"
  - After: "I restored my trance, but I'm worried." {n}A pause.{/n} "You're dear to me." {n}She falters.{/n} "Does that defy the Tenets?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her eyes flash.{/n} "Every life becomes death. Every thread of choice is part of the Bloodspun Web. Every movement of my soul belongs to Ahn—" {n}She stops short.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eyes flash.{/n} "My soul belongs to Ahn—" {n}She stops.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You don't understand. It may be normal for laypeople, but not within the Bloodspun Web. Not for me. If I lose control of what makes me a faultless weapon — then what will be left of me?"
  - After: "Not for me. Without control, what weapon am I?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah's eyes narrow into slits.{/n} "Careful, Domin'{name}. Not even you can presume to speak for Him. His designs are unfathomable — the best we can do is read the signs and hope that our service pleases Him."
  - After: {n}Eyes narrowed.{/n} "Careful, Domin'{name}. None speak for Him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Domin'{name}... our fates are connected. We walk the same labyrinth. Tell me... what would you do if your mind's worries were to dull your resolve and mar your spirit?"
  - After: "Domin'{name}, our labyrinth is shared. What if worry dulled your resolve?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But..." {n}she exclaims before momentarily falling silent. Her glare burns into you... but then, her expression shifts.{/n} "I understand. The Tenets are not your destiny. You cannot tell me what to do. We may walk the same labyrinth, but I must find the path myself."
  - After: "But..." {n}Her glare softens.{/n} "I see. The Tenets aren't yours. I'll find the path."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah gives you a look of painful doubt — and tenderness.{/n} "Enough. Let us go back." {n}Before she turns to leave, her fingers wrap around your hand and squeeze it passionately.{/n}
  - After: {n}Tender, doubtful:{/n} "Enough. Let's go." {n}She squeezes your hand.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah nods, though somewhat uncertainly.{/n} "Of course. It would be strange to expect you to say otherwise, Domin'{name}."
  - After: {n}She nods, unsure.{/n} "Of course, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She lets out a quiet laugh.{/n} "Your life is in enough disarray as it is. Still, your ability to exist in pandemonium without losing sight of your goal deserves some praise..."
  - After: {n}She laughs softly.{/n} "Your life is chaos, yet you hold your goal."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah focuses all her attention on you. Her eyebrow tenses in some desperate struggle.{/n} "You are right. Predators never stop chasing their prey. Never." {n}She smirks.{/n} "The Vizsier hardly would have approved of me ignoring the Tenets... but he also never had to face the kinds of trials that I have."
  - After: {n}She struggles inwardly.{/n} "Predators never stop." {n}A smirk.{/n} "The Vizsier never faced my trials."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah closes her eyes. She looks as if she wants to say something... but she merely nods instead.{/n} "I accept your choice, Domin'{name}."
  - After: {n}She nods silently.{/n} "I accept your choice, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Forgive me. And thank you for this lesson. I am so used to relying on the Vizsier's teachings that, when faced with an obstacle he did not warn me about, my instinct is to seek advice from others." {n}Kibellah touches your chest.{/n} "Thank you for letting me pick myself up, {name}."
  - After: "Forgive me, and thank you." {n}She touches your chest.{/n} "Thank you, {name}."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Companion/KibellahFarewell/KibellahFarewell_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I am glad to see you undaunted by the unknown."
  - After: "Glad you're undaunted by the unknown."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I thank the Emperor for having met you."
  - After: "I thank the Emperor I met you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Now would be a good time to receive an inkling about our future. Have you consulted the Tarot?"
  - After: "Have you consulted the Tarot?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Have you thought about what happens afterward? If we survive."
  - After: "What happens after, if we survive?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whatever awaits us, it is time we set forth."
  - After: "Whatever awaits, we set forth."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My love for you will give me strength."
  - After: "My love gives me strength."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah stands motionless, deep in trance, but returns to reality the moment you approach.{/n} "Your every breath and heartbeat has been in anticipation of this moment, Domin'{name}. Do not hesitate. Step into the darkness and allow your shield and shadow to walk with you."
  - After: {n}Kibellah wakes from trance.{/n} "Your moment, Domin'{name}. Step into the darkness."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is no need for a reading. The {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}cards{/g} will ask if we are prepared to face the challenge with dignity. And that will be the answer to our own question."
  - After: "No need. The {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}cards{/g} would only ask if we have dignity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah lowers her gaze and stays quiet for a while. Her eyes are full of tenderness and deep, sincere love.{/n} "I will forever be your shadow, until the Undying One bestows upon me the greatest reward for my service."
  - After: {n}A tender gaze.{/n} "I will be your shadow until the Undying One rewards me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah gives you a thin smile.{/n} "Gaze upon me whenever you feel your faith in yourself waning. Seek strength in this union of the strong, and remember: only the victor commands the flow of history."
  - After: {n}A thin smile.{/n} "When faith wanes, look to me. Only victors command history."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah lets silence fall, keeping her deathly calm gaze on you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Kibellah stays silent.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Now and forever, each of us must follow our own thread. And so it shall be, until the day we find ourselves in His embrace." {n}Her lips curve into a smile.{/n} "But what's between us... It has made a web that joins you and me, and along that web our love will travel. I will stay strong. I will hold. Because it is what the Tenets demand, and because I can do no less for you."
  - After: "Each follows their own thread." {n}She smiles.{/n} "But our web joins us. I will hold, for you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Once we are done triumphing over our enemies?" {n}She presses a finger to her lips.{/n} "I have spent some time considering the future of the Bloodspun Web... and I think that the cult is due for a new set of Tenets. I should keep the details to myself... for now."
  - After: "After our triumph?" {n}Finger to lips.{/n} "The Bloodspun Web needs new Tenets. Details later."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Such was His design. In the pattern of the Bloodspun Web, my thread stretched out to yours, Domin'{name}. To shield you. To serve you." {n}She touches a wound that has barely begun to heal.{/n} "And every night, I praise Him for the honour of letting me twine around your path."
  - After: "His design joined our threads, Domin'{name}." {n}She touches a fresh wound.{/n} "I praise Him for it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She frowns as if failing to understand the question.{/n} "A shadow is inseparable from its master, Domin'{name}. I will follow you as before and guard your thread."
  - After: {n}She frowns.{/n} "A shadow follows its master, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Every thread ends in death... but only the Undying One knows the time and place."
  - After: "Every thread ends in death, when He wills."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Undying One has given us a great gift — a path of thorns, a fate of trials. What is it, if not a sign of His favour? We will either offer our victory to Him or find His embrace."
  - After: "A path of thorns is His favour. Victory, or His embrace."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah hurries near to kiss you, then steps back just as quickly. There is a spark of warmth in her eyes.{/n} "The Grace of the Web guides us hand in hand, Domin'{name}. Death will be our reward for a thread honourably followed."
  - After: {n}A quick kiss.{/n} "The Web guides us, Domin'{name}. Death rewards an honoured thread."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You wish to foresee what lies along our thread? Do not try. When the hour is right, the future will reveal itself to you. Until then, we can only do what we must and pray for His blessing."
  - After: "Don't seek the future. Do what we must and pray."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/Crypt/CryptGates/CryptGates_dialogue

  - After: "Fight with what you have. Die, if required."

  - After: "Children of the Emperor, I bless your crusade!"

  - After: "Quick work, Infernus Master."

  - After: [Shout] "Soldiers! No mercy, no cowardice, no retreat!"

The enforcers keep reminding us about it, and if they see an armed infernus, they'll execute them on the spot. Such was the Lord Captain's will."

  - After: {n}He bows. Oil stains: he scouted himself.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I fear we might be underestimating the enemy. The enforcers have already done it once. I... The Infernus Guild would join you in this fight, if you would have us. To get inside, the aberrations would have had to make a passage for themselves somewhere in the crypt's perimeter. No one knows the maintenance tunnels better than us. We could find this breach and attack the enemy from the rear. I doubt a few workers armed with axes and torches will make much of a difference, but we would be honoured to die in your name."
  - After: "The enemy breached the crypt somewhere. We know the maintenance tunnels. Let the Infernus Guild find the breach and hit their rear. We'd die in your name."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, we now require your blood. The crypt will not open without the Rogue Trader's genetic signature."
  - After: "Lord Captain, the crypt needs your blood to open."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The panel's mechanical teeth sting your flesh, and you feel your blood trickling down the small ducts into the altar's bowels. You hear a click, and the crypt doors open with a piercing creak. Beyond them, you see nothing but darkness.{/n}
  - After: {n}Spikes draw your blood. The doors creak open onto darkness.{/n}
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "This was done on purpose, I'm sure of it. Our coming is expected. Vanguard, provide the Lord Captain with a luminator servo-skull!" {n}She gives you a surprisingly easy smile and bows.{/n} "Take care, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and watch out for dark corners. Move out! For House von Valancius!"
  - After: "Deliberate. Vanguard, a luminator servo-skull!" {n}She bows.{/n} "Careful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, wait! There's been..." {n}Einrich bursts into the antecompartment and stops short when he sees the open doors and the gloom beyond.{/n} "Damn it, I'm late. I meant to report an act of sabotage. They've cut off the {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} supply to the crypt's lighting. You're walking into an ambush."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, wait!" {n}Einrich sees the open doors.{/n} "Too late. The crypt's {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} lighting was sabotaged. It's an ambush."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "Depends on who's wielding it," {n}Einrich says with a chuckle, but then his expression darkens.{/n} "The Infernus Guild is banned from taking up arms. Our clan is branded because our ancestors were rebels. The station where we originally hail from once rose against Lady Theodora's predecessor. The traitors were killed, and the rest of the station was left stranded in the void to die without air or water. Out of those who repented, the Rogue Trader selected a thousand who were allowed on board."
  - After: "Depends who wields it." {n}He darkens.{/n} "We're banned from arms. Our ancestors' station rebelled against Lady Theodora's predecessor and was left to die. A thousand penitents came aboard."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}His eyes widen in astonishment.{/n} "Your... I... I never would have dared to ask, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We will live up to your expectations, I swear it. Those who die today will die smiling, for today is a great day for our people!"
  - After: {n}Astonished.{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Today our dead die smiling!"
- **Einrich Monteg**

Since we may not enter, we will focus our efforts on finding the breach in the maintenance tunnels. We won't launch a surprise attack on the traitors, but at least we'll block their escape routes with our bodies and axes."
  - After: {n}He hangs his head.{/n} "Then we'll find the tunnel breach and block their escape."

  - After: {n}Abelard scowls.{/n} "Convenient timing for this tale, Monteg."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Their faces glow with righteous indignation and a drive to exterminate the traitors who dared to invade the sanctity of the dynasty's most eminent dead. Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}sermon{/d} has ignited a fire in their hearts.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The warriors' faces show staunch pride and a readiness to die rather than bring shame to their {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}commander{/d}.{/n}
  - After: {n}They'd die before shaming their {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}commander{/d}.{/n}

  - Before: {n}A hand-shaped panel opens in the altar of unsealing. The panel is lined with sharp spikes.{/n}
  - After: {n}A spiked hand-panel opens in the altar.{/n}

  - Before: "Jocasta Sauerback, I pardon the enforcers their negligence that led to treason endangering the ship. You and your people have proven yourselves."

  - Before: {n}The old man before you resembles a human being, but the scaled bony growths going from the bridge of his nose to the top of his bloated, hairless head, the grotesque cheekbones, and the black claws on his meaty fingers leave no doubt that this creature is a genetic aberration. He utters in a creaking voice, black spittle spraying from his mouth,{/n} "You have spilt the blood of the Congregation. You have offended the purest of His chosen children! You... heretic!"
  - After: {n}A clawed, scaled old mutant spits black bile.{/n} "You spilt the Congregation's blood! Heretic!"

  - Before: {n}Sauerback's gaze remains trained on the mutant. You notice deep wounds on her chest and shoulder, but she shows no signs of acknowledging their existence.{/n} "Strike forces have cleared the side sections of mutants. The freaks fought like madmen, but they could not match the skill of the von Valancius enforcers. Once victory was secured, our pursuit units made sure that none would escape. Our flamer squads are in the process of purging the crypt. All degenerates confirmed dead."

  - Before: {n}You glance at the gaping hole in the adamantine bulkhead. It is almost unbelievable that the mutants were able to make a hole like that — they would have required truly powerful industrial equipment, and not the kind that can be easily assembled or stolen.{/n}

- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "We have. This discovery cost the guild sixty-eight souls. It was crowded in those tunnels. They set monsters on us, but... Few things can scare someone who has seen a fire in the arsenal bay."
  - After: "Yes. It cost sixty-eight souls."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I have words to say to you as well, heretic. Every beast akin to you shall perish in the flames of purgation. Their hearts shall burn away, and their lungs shall boil until their chests burst. You promise us death? We are already cutting through your vicious spawn." {n}The old man lets out a hateful shriek and starts thrashing like a monster of the warp before a holy image.{/n}
  - After: "Your kind will burn, heretic." {n}He shrieks and thrashes.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The mutant erupts in wet, slurping laughter.{/n} "I am the herder of the pure! The Many-Armed Emperor has blessed my mind with the ability to behold Him, and I guided His children... until you came and slaughtered us, heretic!"
  - After: {n}Wet laughter.{/n} "I herd the pure! I guided the Many-Armed Emperor's children, till you slaughtered us!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The true god who comes through the void to us, His devout children. The universe is an abyss of horrors, and only He can save us! But not you, vile heretics! You are all doomed!"
  - After: "The true god, coming through the void to save His children. You're doomed!"
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "I will perform the ritual and pray in hopes of easing Lady Theodora's anger."
  - After: "I'll perform the ritual and pray to ease Lady Theodora's anger."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His face becomes a gloating grimace.{/n} "We are the pure! We are the Congregation, children of the Many-Armed Emperor, the genetic perfection of existence! You will never understand... You are of inferior flesh, your genes are woven from feebleness and misery. We are the new curve of the spiral. We are one, and thus we are strong."
  - After: {n}He gloats.{/n} "We are the Congregation, genetic perfection! We are one, so we are strong."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "I've been waiting for this." {n}The sound of your voice hangs in the air as the steel toe of Sauerback's mag-boot pulverises the man's knee and bone shards shred his decrepit flesh like shrapnel.{/n}
  - After: "Gladly." {n}Sauerback's mag-boot shatters his knee.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The old man doubles over, but it is not pain or fear but burning hatred that contorts his face.{/n} "Go on, torture me! I'll endure it all. My time may be up, but you are all doomed! I will gladly spit the words of truth in your face and they will burn you like acid! In death I will ascend to the hosts of pure voices and I will await the day when you will pay for the shed blood of His children!"
  - After: {n}He doubles over, hateful.{/n} "Torture me! In death I'll await your reckoning!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man's face twists in rage and his milky eyes bulge. He hisses,{/n} "The Many-Armed Emperor cometh! The true god shall avenge us! And when He does, I will laugh—" {n}His string of doomsayings is silenced by a kick from the Master-at-Arms.{/n}
  - After: {n}He hisses.{/n} "The Many-Armed Emperor will avenge us—" {n}A kick silences him.{/n}
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "The accursed spawn have disrespected the spirits of the dead, but, thankfully, they did not have enough time to wreak as much destruction as they could have. Many tombs were disturbed, but what is the most outrageous..." {n}Adalbert carefully presents you with a sapphire-blue gemstone.{/n} "They sought to despoil Lady Theodora's urn."
  - After: "Many tombs desecrated, but worst..." {n}Adalbert shows a sapphire gem.{/n} "They sought Lady Theodora's urn."
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "After Her Ladyship's cremation, her ashes were made into this magnificent relic, an example of resilience and purity. One of the heretics dared to lay claim to it."
  - After: "Her Ladyship's ashes, made into this relic. A heretic dared claim it."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard stares at the gem with a crestfallen expression. His lip twitches as if he is struggling against a new wave of grief or else enraged at the thought of someone so heinously violating Theodora's rest. He forces himself to look away without saying a word.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard stares at the gem, grieving, then looks away.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}The sight of the gem takes Idira's breath away. You catch her quiet whisper:{/n} "She's beautiful. Even in death, she shines on."
  - After: {n}Idira whispers,{/n} "Even in death, she shines."
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "Not all, no. Tradition demands that the Lord Captain's body be burned so that no one could use samples of their tissue or blood to gain access to the ship's systems that require the Rogue Trader's genetic imprint. Lady Theodora herself once voiced her desire to be turned into a stone."
  - After: "No. Lord Captains are burned so none can use their genes to access the ship. Lady Theodora chose the stone."
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "If such is Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s wish. I see deep symbolism in this duty."
  - After: "As Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} wishes. A fitting duty."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}The Master-at-Arms lowers her head.{/n} "Our honour is sullied. We have failed our forebears. Our ineptitude and weakness are shameful, Lord Captain."
  - After: {n}She lowers her head.{/n} "Our honour is sullied. We failed our forebears, Lord Captain."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Sauerback casts a hostile look at the autopistol on Einrich's belt but says nothing.{/n}
  - After: {n}Sauerback glares at Einrich's autopistol.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You shall perish in the cold void, your heart shall beat its last under the light of uncaring stars, your lungs shall become trees of ice within your chest! You will never receive the grace of the Many-Armed Emperor!" {n}The old man calls curse after curse down upon you with spiteful satisfaction.{/n}
  - After: "You'll die in the cold void, never graced by the Many-Armed Emperor!" {n}He curses on.{/n}
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Their loathsome tribe has spawned a sorcerer." {n}Sauerback grimaces in disgust.{/n} "No doubt to help them brainwash more victims and swell the cult's ranks."
  - After: "A sorcerer." {n}Sauerback grimaces.{/n} "To brainwash more recruits."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Psychic ability, human-like appearance, high status within the cult... I believe we are looking at a so-called Magus — a psychically-gifted Genestealer cultist. The cult's elite. A Magus's speciality is recruitment and subjugation."
  - After: "Psychic, human-looking, high-ranking: a Magus, Genestealer cult elite. Recruitment and subjugation are its speciality."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The malice alight in the abomination's eyes leaves no doubt — no barrier could have stopped him, intent as he was on committing sacrilege.{/n}
  - After: {n}His malice shows no barrier would have stopped him.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's visor flashes scarlet, growing brighter with every word.{/n} "This statement is false. Only the True Flesh is perfect. You are a scrap of ignorant meat, and this vaunted genetic perfection, which you are not, will be ground into nothing by the cogs of the Omnissiah." {n}The old man shrinks and hisses as his face is bathed in the red light of the visor, itself framed by the shadows of writhing mechadendrites.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal's visor glows scarlet.{/n} "False. Only the True Flesh is perfect. The Omnissiah's cogs will grind you." {n}He shrinks.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet touches her spirit stone, and it resonates with a soft, pearly glow.{/n} "They may appear similar. And yet, as bright as mon-keigh relics are on the surface, they are hollow inside. They hold no memory, no life."
  - After: {n}Yrliet's spirit stone glows.{/n} "Mon-keigh relics shine but are hollow. No memory, no life."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Be silent, xenos. This place has heard too many blasphemous utterances already, and your voice is trying its patience."
  - After: "Silence, xenos. Enough blasphemy here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The creature's last word elicits a nervous laugh from the nearby enforcers — the irony of this embodied perversion of the human form accusing you of heresy is not lost on them. The confessor whispers a quiet prayer. The Master-at-Arms is watching the old man's every move, her lips twisted in contempt.{/n}
  - After: {n}The enforcers laugh nervously at a mutant calling you heretic. Sauerback watches in contempt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "None wander in here. We were free to offer our prayers without fear of discovery. And the sight of dead heretics... was pleasing! Trampling your bones was a righteous act! That is why I ordered the pure to sunder the walls of your bone vault and make this place a sanctuary for the Congregation!" {n}He sneers.{/n}
  - After: "No one came here. Trampling heretic bones pleased us! So I had the pure breach your vault for our sanctuary!" {n}He sneers.{/n}
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "The ashes of the other eminent dead, whose rest was disturbed, will be transferred to the reliquary chapel. Rites of redemption will be held day and night. Thousands of the ship's crew will be allowed to kneel before the relics and pray for the Lord Captain's health and the dynasty's prosperity."
  - After: "The other ashes go to the reliquary chapel. Crew may pray there day and night for you and the dynasty."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "Now I see why so many inspectors in the adjacent compartments have had 'accidents.'"
  - After: "So that's why nearby inspectors kept having 'accidents.'"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}She bows her head respectfully, and her expression relaxes. She responds with a weak smile,{/n} "Thank you for restoring our honour, Lord Captain."
  - After: {n}She bows, smiling weakly.{/n} "Thank you for restoring our honour, Lord Captain."

  - Before: "I wish to hear what my retinue thinks."

  - Before: "It seems that not all the officers have been presented to me yet."

  - Before: "Throw them all out of an airlock and let us be done with this."

  - Before: "I hereby sentence the guilty officers to be shot. Take them away."
  - After: "The guilty officers are to be shot. Take them."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the officer] "I will not punish you or your men. Continue your service and do not make any more mistakes."
  - After: [Address the officer] "No punishment. Serve on, and make no more mistakes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Get this treacherous rabble out of my sight and shoot them."
  - After: "Take this rabble away and shoot them."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "A cut to the heart. A cut to the throat. A cut to the stomach. These wounds have been inflicted according to His pleasure. The blood of the apostates will wash away the stain of their treachery, so that their souls may prostrate themselves before the Undying One's throne and beg His forgiveness." {n}Kibellah wipes the blood from her blade in one swift movement.{/n} "I have acted with reverence and shown proof of my loyalty. Will you accept me, Domin'{name}? Will you make me your shield and shadow?"
  - After: "Cuts to His pleasure." {n}She wipes her blade.{/n} "I've proven my loyalty. Will you make me your shield and shadow, Domin'{name}?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "These wretched apostates were caught trying to sabotage the reactor. They are guilty of treason..."
  - After: "These apostates tried to sabotage the reactor. Treason..."
- **Confessor Adalbert**
  - Before: "The exhausted crew was too weak and emaciated to resist the invaders... but then the spinners emerged from the depths. They stood alone against hundreds of foes, yet they did not falter. They did not sleep or rest as their bladetip dance brought death. Though many spinners fell, the Bloodspun Web held strong until the flagship left the turmoil of the warp."
  - After: "The starved crew fell, but the spinners held, few against hundreds, until the flagship left the warp."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Death has whispered your name, Domin'{name} von Valancius. You may refuse the gift, but it will remain yours forever.   - After: "Death whispered your name, Domin'{name} von Valancius. {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g} ordained it. You may yet change your mind."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Enough, Einrich. The Lord Captain will decide the truth of these claims for {mf|himself|herself}."
  - After: "Enough, Einrich. The Lord Captain will judge for {mf|himself|herself}."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Bone and sinew revealed your hubris. You abandoned vigilance for the promise of glory. You did not give weapons to the traitors, but you left your post to seek a hero's path. Though you did not act with treasonous intent, you are complicit nonetheless."
  - After: "Bone and sinew revealed your hubris. You left your post chasing glory. Complicit."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The young woman folds her hands over her chest in the sign of the Aquila before vanishing into the shadows. The cultists follow.{/n}
  - After: {n}She makes the Aquila and vanishes.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}The cultists retreat into the shadows as Kibellah sheathes her ceremonial dagger.{/n} "Your blade awaits direction, Domin'{name}. We will speak again when the time is right."
  - After: {n}Kibellah sheathes her dagger.{/n} "Your blade awaits, Domin'{name}."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I have heard, though only at a distance, the prayers the spinners offer up to Him. I have seen how their deeds fill the people's hearts with confidence in the inevitability of His wrath.   - After: "The spinners embolden the faithful. Their loyalty to the Emperor is beyond question."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Although Lady Theodora never granted the cult an audience or brought a spinner into her retinue, she respected the Bloodspun Web and approved of its mission."
  - After: "Lady Theodora kept no spinner, but respected the Bloodspun Web."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the spinners of the Bloodspun Web were watching, tracking, and killing von Valancius enemies long before the Warrant of Trade passed to Lady Theodora. However, their blade has also been known to cut short the lives of highly upstanding persons." {n}The Factotum swallows nervously, casting a fleeting glance at Kibellah.{/n} "But I certainly do not in any way condemn the deeds of the deeply esteemed cult... I am sure they must have had good reason..."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the spinners kill von Valancius enemies. And some upstanding persons." {n}He glances at Kibellah.{/n} "Not that I object..."

  - Before: {n}The Master-at-Arms clears her throat.{/n} "The cultists are the scourge of the seditious. They bring the unrighteous to ruin. The enforcers respect the Bloodspun Web, for we share a common goal — to bring His light and His harsh justice to the darkest depths of this ship."
  - After: {n}Sauerback coughs.{/n} "They scourge the seditious. The enforcers respect them."
- **Confessor Adalbert**

  - After: "Legend says the spinners bled to save this ship from the Archenemy, earning House von Valancius's favour."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "...theft of weapons, sabotage, and the deaths of the crew in Bay AL-82."
  - After: "...weapon theft, sabotage, and the crew deaths in Bay AL-82."
- **Einrich Monteg**

Divine visions and dark portents may be reason enough for you to shed blood, but not everyone here shares your perspective."

- **Jocasta Sauerback**

  - After: "The Lord Captain has spoken. Take them!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I could not honour you by ushering the souls of those traitors to the other side. This troubles me, for I wish to serve you as the sword serves its master. Will you make me your shield and shadow, Domin'{name}?"

- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The practice of sacred divination using the bones and sinews of a martyr led us to the reactor room. This is true. But it is also true that I beheld the act of treachery with my own eyes."

  - After: "You're right. I'll wield you against my enemies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Those on the deck watch in awe as the final figure moves gracefully into a ceremonial pose. Some of the officers whisper in excitement, while others murmur prayers to the {g|Encyclopedia:EmperorGlossary}God-Emperor{/g}.{/n}

She moves toward you soundlessly, the dim light casting shadows across the mask which conceals her face.{/n} "The Undying Emperor commanded us to spin a web of blood around His children, and we obeyed. We obey still." {n}The masked cultists repeat the words in a mournful whisper, "We obey still."{/n}{g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}{/g}
  - After: {n}A masked woman steps forward.{/n} "The Emperor bade us spin a web of blood around His children. We obey still." {n}Others echo.{/n}{g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}{/g}

They are exemplary slayers, invisible executioners, and the scourge of traitors, heretics, and fallen souls. Many righteous people honour them as votaries of the faith, while others see their fearsome rituals as frenzied spectacles touched by madness.{/n}
  - After: {n}A death cult: the {g|Encyclopedia:ImperiumGlossary}Imperium{/g}'s holy assassins, worshipping through killing heretics. Some call them mad.{/n}

We tracked down the traitors and sliced open their bodies. Then we washed the flagship's bulkheads in their blood in a sacred act of ritual purification."
  - After: "We failed Domin'Theodora. To restore our honour, we washed the ship in her traitors' blood."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A ringing sound fills your ears, deafening the noise of the world around you. Time goes still. A voice {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}whispers{/d} seductively in the back of your mind.{/n} "How interesting... Devout assassins who believe themselves to be instruments of a higher power. They revel in violence, and cannot tell the difference between bloodthirst and piety. They follow their faith blindly, unaware of how closely they tread to corruption and depravity. Look at them. They stand on the edge of a precipice. The smallest push will send them plummeting into the abyss. You could be their downfall. All you have to do... is push."
  - After: {n}Time stops. A voice {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_CutByKnife}whispers{/d}.{/n} "Zealots who confuse bloodthirst with piety, on the edge of corruption. One push. Push."

They are clearly flattered to be the subject of the Rogue Trader's attention and generosity.{/n} "The Bloodspun Web would not dare to cause offence by refusing the Domin."
  - After: "The Tenets forbid worldly desires. But..." {n}The cultists stir, flattered.{/n} "We dare not refuse the Domin."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}She stares at you in bewilderment.{/n} "We follow His design. We claim those marked by His omens. We submit to His will. How could it be otherwise?"
  - After: {n}She stares, bewildered.{/n} "We follow His design. How could it be otherwise?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I am the Second Spinner of the Bloodspun Web. The honour of this title is bestowed only upon those who have ushered more souls than—" {n}Kibellah stops abruptly. She touches a slender finger to the fresh wound on her hand, and paints the symbol of a lock across her lips in blood.{/n} "It is shameful to speak of one's own deeds. I am here to become your shadow, not to make boasts."
  - After: "The Second Spinner, for ushering more souls than—" {n}She paints a blood lock on her lips.{/n} "Boasting shames. I am your shadow."

  - Before: {n}Everything about these people unsettles you. Their manner of speech and the sinister grace with which they handle their blades is enough to make your blood run cold. They do not look like any servants of the Emperor you have ever met. However, your officers treat them with cautious reverence, and speak about their prowess in whispers of admiration.{/n}

{n}The others echo: "Undergo the test."{/n}

  - After: {n}He smiles.{/n} "Are you ready for every trial, Domin'{name}?" {n}Your face goes numb. Blood from his blade is on your cheek.{/n}

  - Before: "The Song of Trailing Blood tells of a path fraught with trials. By accepting it and setting out on that path, you passed the first one, the trial of resolve. You passed it when you put yourself, albeit briefly, in the service of another soul, a man suffering from burns. For the choice between life and death is to be made only by those willing to take responsibility for the pain of another."
  - After: "The Song of Trailing Blood names the trials. Setting out, you passed resolve. Helping the burned man, you passed compassion, for only those who bear another's pain may choose life or death."
- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier bows his head guiltily.{/n} "Such are the Tenets of the Web. They are all we have ever known and the only life we have learned to live. The path you walked was a gift from the Undying One. And so we decided that was how we were to honour you."
  - After: {n}He bows guiltily.{/n} "The Tenets are all we know. The path was His gift to you."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Struggling to suppress the tremors in his body, the Vizsier bows as low as his hunched back allows.{/n} "Forgive us our poor manners. Our intention was not to insult you. - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As I delve into my divinations from the flesh and blood of the departed ones, I turn to a relic most ancient and priceless.   - After: "Long ago, {g|Encyclopedia:ImperialTarotGlossary}His Tarot{/g}, the Matriarch Spider's relic, showed me our meeting, but not when. So we waited."

  - Before: "The third was the trial of justice.   - After: "Third, justice: you judged an apostate. Fourth, duty, which always leads to death. You proved ready to serve Him, as we are."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier smiles gently.{/n} "I cannot share the full wealth of my knowledge, for it has taken me a lifetime to learn. But I can share this foremost lesson with you: be guided by reason, not fury, when you fight. And seek no pleasure in killing. That is how you will win."
  - After: {n}He smiles.{/n} "Fight with reason, not fury. Take no pleasure in killing. Then you win."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "To give and receive death. And to fear no twist or turn of fate. One who is afraid of death is already dead in their soul, waiting for the end, afraid to accept the inevitable. A life of fear is disgraceful. The true service is in dedicating oneself to death with no regrets."
  - After: "To give and receive death without fear. Who fears death is already dead inside."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Scarlet shadows, death's messengers, accompanied you. They were my eyes and my ears. And thus I saw every choice you made, and heard every word you spoke."
  - After: "Scarlet shadows were my eyes and ears. I saw every choice you made."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "'Many are blind even with their eyes wide open.' Thus spoke the Matriarch Spider. People look at things without seeing their essence, which makes them easy to beguile or frighten. We adorn the tunnels with the bones of the righteous, that they may guard our faithful against corrupt deeds and thoughts. We use the blood of the unholy ones for divination so we may see dangers. The blood of martyrs is our wine, for their suffering makes us stronger. People are afraid, but only because they see death as the end. Death, however, is a beginning. It is life and duty and oblivion. Death has many facets — that is its essence. That is its beauty."
  - After: "'Many are blind with eyes open,' said the Matriarch Spider. Righteous bones guard us; martyrs' blood is our wine. People fear death as an end. It is a beginning. That is its beauty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier nods obediently and makes a strange sign with his crooked fingers. The spinners echo back.{/n} "Three hundred lashes, so the flesh may know repentance.   - After: {n}He signs; the spinners echo.{/n} "Three hundred lashes. Three dozen cycles without food or sleep. The Web repents."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Then we would have met at another time. For the tangle of fate's threads cannot be rearranged by one turn, however earnestly one may try to run in the opposite direction."
  - After: "Then we'd have met another time. Fate cannot be outrun."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I was sighted for much of my life, until a disciple of mine violated the Tenets and I realised just how blind I had been. A lesson, but a bitter one.   - After: "A disciple's betrayal showed me how blind I was. Eyes are fooled; the heart is not. I sealed mine with a Geas of True Sight."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The smallest stain of rot is enough to ruin the most beautiful woven pattern. Weakness is a gateway into the soul, one we hold open for new failings. It is born of desire. Kill your desires, and your weakness will die along with them."
  - After: "Weakness is born of desire. Kill desire, and weakness dies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier turns his head as if looking around the temple.{/n} "I see echoes of those who came before us and those who were with us, but have since crossed over to the other side.   - Before: {n}The Vizsier's sewn-shut eyes seem to peer into your face. Studying it. Then he turns away and speaks into empty space again.{/n} "Peace, my brother. The time has almost come."

  - Before: {n}One moment, the walls of death's sanctum grow infinitely wide. The next, they are so narrow as to make it hard to breathe. The floor dances under your feet, and the Undying Emperor's statue seems to shake its head threateningly as it looks down upon you.{/n}

  - Before: {n}You intend to ask a question, only to find that the seemingly simple idea you had in your mind has eluded you. - **(conversation owner)**

  - Before: "The spinners guided them along a different trail. You had to take the step, for only you were meant to become the flagship's blood, Domin. There was no reason to test the faith of those who follow you, for this burden was for their {mf|lord|lady} to bear."

  - Before: {n}Your heart is beating slowly, your breathing has become deeper, and your thoughts are muddled. You seem to be under the influence of a potent stimulant.{/n}

  - After: {n}The frail Vizsier paints war symbols in blood.{/n} "Twice {mf|he|she} found {mf|himself|herself} at death's edge; twice the Undying One rejected {mf|him|her}. Thus wove {mf|his|her} path."

  - Before: "I had the pleasure of cutting up two of the three that came after me. I then followed the trail of the one I let go to see where these pests were coming from."
  - After: "I cut up two. Followed the third to their nest."

  - Before: "What? You crooked old spider! Why did your servants not tell me the enemy was coming? You tricked me into fleeing from battle!"
  - After: "Crooked old spider! You tricked me into fleeing battle!"

  - Before: "An omen, a scarlet whisper, bled into the web of prophecy: the foe longed to slaughter those alone in their chambers. But they were too late — the spinners had already led your chosen few to our abode along a hidden thread."
  - After: "The foe meant to slay those alone. The spinners brought your chosen few here first."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Violence and turmoil. A mutiny of twisted souls! The traitors speak in a false voice over the vox. They speak of enforcers and officers who sought to slay their Lord Captain. But seek they did not... It was the murk-wreathed abominations who threatened the Domin."
  - After: "Mutiny! Traitors on the vox say enforcers tried to kill the Captain. A lie — the abominations did."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "One sees now that this was but a pawn, ushered into place merely to deflect the falling sword. The player knew the game was forfeit, and thus made a trade: a few of their tribe sent to the slaughter so that they might sell the lie that the foe was dead."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier nods at the emptiness behind you.{/n} "Yes...   - Before: {n}The decrepit old man looks pensive as he twirls a dagger, making it dance between his fingers.{/n} "An old blade, if hardened well and honed with care, does not lose its sharpness, Domin'{name}."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This man, blind and wretched, knows nothing... But He knows all." {n}He points a knotted finger at the majestic statue.{/n} "He reveals the truth to this unworthy speck, warns him through divinations... And the spinners who dance upon the threads help him grasp the visions."

  - Before: {n}His shrivelled face turns to you. His lips quiver in joyous anticipation.{/n} "Once again, the Tenets of the Web lead us along the thread of righteous struggle.   - Before: "At last has Domin'{name} honoured us with a visit, and we welcome {mf|his|her} arrival. This was preordained — blood was meant to lead the Domin to death's abode.   - After: "Domin'{name} visits at last, as foretold, led by aberrations' blood. {mf|his|her} arrival pleases the Undying One, as {mf|his|her} path was woven."

A xenos of immense psychic and physical strength who has total control over the cultists. It must be destroyed. This is no longer a question of our own safety, but rather the continued existence of the Expanse as a whole."
  - After: {n}Heinrix rubs his nose.{/n} "Worst case. Your ship carries the Genestealer progenitor, a psychic xenos controlling every cultist. It must die, for the Expanse's sake."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We did not know who our foe is. There was only the appalling shadow upon the bulkheads; the divinations were silent, and no answer was read. But the signs changed when the corruption assailed your flagship: the Undying One bid us bare our blades, and among the deaths of the wicked, answers rang out. At once I sent His spinners to those of the lower bays that should not fall into the foe's hands. Others became guides for your chosen few."
  - After: "The divinations were silent until your flagship was attacked. Then I sent spinners to guard the lower bays and guide your chosen few."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This is also the desire of the Undying One. He has not whispered the name of young Giorek, so we may heal him."
  - After: "The Undying One hasn't named Giorek. We'll heal him."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "I smell no reason to worry about this one's head staying on his shoulders. His bearing tells me all — this worn body belies the spirit of a mighty warrior, the kind who stands tall in the midst of battle, knee-deep in blood and with a grim prayer on his lips."
  - After: "Worn body, warrior's spirit. He'll be fine."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "Glaito sensed one of the cultists coming. I thought your sect had finally shown its true colours and had started assassinating the crew. You are officially cleared of suspicion — but in regard to this incident only."
  - After: "I thought your sect was killing the crew. You're cleared — this time."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "Your invasion of my laboratory was utterly presumptuous, though very timely. However, I can hardly blame the Cult of the Bloodspun Web for disrespecting the mysteries of Knowledge — let those responsible for the ruined specimens be held accountable for this... surge of entropy."
  - After: "Barging into my lab was presumptuous, if timely. Someone owes me specimens."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Nuncius stares silently at the Vizsier through his empty eye sockets, his gaze echoed by the hundreds of skulls adorning the temple.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nuncius stares silently.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "A surprisingly sensible plan. I expected something less judicious and more... bloodthirsty."
  - After: "Surprisingly sensible. I expected bloodthirst."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "They call the true master 'the Sire,' it which spawned the cult. A vessel of xenoheresy, a fierce yet cunning predator that twists their minds into a single knot with only its will... That knot must be severed."
  - After: "The true master is 'the Sire', a xenos binding their minds into one knot. That knot must be severed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is no glory to be found in a needless death, Wolf of Midnight. The foe will choke on the blood you lust for soon enough. Ready your fangs and your claws."
  - After: "No glory in a needless death, Wolf of Midnight. The foe comes soon."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "At first, I thought they were coming to finish me off. What a surprise: even a witch gets rescued sometimes!"
  - After: "Even a witch gets rescued sometimes!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "It was a wise move to deny the assassins their target without starting a panic among the crew."
  - After: "Wise, without panicking the crew."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The spinners could use a lesson in courtesy, but should I really complain of mistreatment? It was not the first time, and, by the Exalted One, it will not be the last."
  - After: "Rude spinners, but I've had worse."

  - Before: {n}Upon the ritual platform, at the Undying Emperor's feet, under the keen gaze of His dark, empty eye sockets, you feel completely insignificant. Surprisingly, the thick blood pouring from His hands onto your brow, chest, and shoulders is still warm.{/n}

He did not save Theodora. He will not save you either. You are not His chosen one. But what if... you offer a prayer to the gods that are truly immortal?   - Before: {n}Each word consecrated to Him echoes in your temples and chest. Your veins become hot, and your blood turns to liquid flame. You have no fear in you. A whisper seems to come from above, from the Emperor's lips of stone: "I see you."{/n}

  - Before: {n}The words of corruption fill your consciousness like rotting pus from a lanced abscess. A whisper of approval gurgles and purrs inside your brain. The blood streaming down your face becomes sweeter than honey... However, a dismal feeling comes over you as well. As though the gaze of the statue's empty eye sockets has grown a dozen times heavier, and the stream of blood is lashing your back and shoulders harder than before.{/n}
  - After: {n}Corruption fills your mind. A whisper purrs approval. Yet the statue's gaze grows heavier.{/n}

  - Before: {n}Blood floods your eyes. It creeps its way into your ears and nostrils. You slide your hands down your face, trying in vain to escape it, but breathing becomes ever harder.{/n}
  - After: {n}Blood floods your eyes and nose. Breathing grows hard.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A rusty taste fills your mouth, causing a spasm in your stomach. Your head is spinning, but you struggle to determine if it is a thrilling sensation or one of profound revulsion.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cultists whisper prayers to the Undying One as they help you change your clothes and regain your faculties.{/n}
  - After: {n}Praying cultists help you change and recover.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Blood falls into your eyes. You hiss in pain, but raise your head. Through a red mist, you glimpse a harsh truth in the Emperor's face: death sees you. Death is watching you.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "To many, He comes during their time of service, in images of blood and whispers from the shadows. But remember that those are mere visions. For true death will not come for you until your time, and it will take your soul gently in its bony hands."

  - Before: {n}Bowed before His image, the Vizsier assumes the ceremonial postures with incredible ease, his withered body moving swiftly and soundlessly. You are slowly plunged into darkness to the sound of ritual chants and swooshing blades. Amid the noise of splashing blood and the cultists' whispers you hear the words,{/n} "Death has spoken your name, Domin'{name}. Death accepts you."

Hear our exultation and accept this gift of a vestment sewn from the bones of His faithful with the threads of death."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vizsier's voice grows suddenly thunderous and snaps you out of your reflections.{/n} "Death has accepted you, Domin'{name}! Now and for all of time, you are the Bloodwarden and the Undying One's most venerable servant."
  - After: {n}The Vizsier thunders:{/n} "Death accepts you, Domin'{name}! You are the Bloodwarden, the Undying One's foremost servant."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The ritual is complete... but you are not." {n}The Vizsier gestures for one of the cultists, who is carefully holding a strange garment, to come closer.{/n}
  - After: "The ritual is complete... but you are not." {n}A cultist brings a strange garment.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: {n}A faint, immensely powerful whisper — or imagination?{/n}

  - Before: {n}Before the Master-at-Arms lies a groaning heap that was once a man. It shudders and lets out a gurgling sob:{/n} "Stop... I'll... talk..."

- **Einrich Monteg**

- **(conversation owner)**

- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Choking with rage, Sauerback grabs the maul from her belt. She rasps,{/n} "Allow me, Lord Captain... Please..."
  - After: {n}Furious, Sauerback grabs her maul.{/n} "Allow me, Lord Captain... Please..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man laughs with contempt, then starts chanting:{/n} "Tempting are the promises of heretics, but barren as the darkness-cursed void in which they bury the souls of those who trust them!"

- **(conversation owner)**
