## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/OfficerDeck/InfernusConflict/InfernusConflict_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Cease the beatings immediately! Those people are to be provided rations and water."
  - After: "Stop the beatings! Give them rations and water."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will not have you disrupting the course of this investigation."
  - After: "Don't disrupt this investigation."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A senior officer has their duties. See to them. That is an order."
  - After: "A senior officer has duties. See to them. An order."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I see. Nothing important, then."
  - After: "Nothing important, then."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. I command you to cease the beatings and provide those people with rations and water."
  - After: "Fine. Stop the beatings; give them rations and water."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have a fine family, Einrich."
  - After: "A fine family, Einrich."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Return to the rest of the detainees."
  - After: "Return to the other detainees."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How did they end up in the hands of the enforcers?"
  - After: "How did the enforcers get them?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "That was indeed terrible. This one gets no rations and no water."
  - After: "Terrible joke. No rations or water for this one."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I want results, not excuses. What have you learned during the interrogation? Or, by the Lex, are the lot of you only playing at justice?"
  - After: "Results, not excuses. What did you learn? Or are you playing at justice, by the Lex?"

- **Player**
  - Before: "You are one strict lady, Mia."
  - After: "You're strict, Mia."
- **Player**

  - After: "So be it. Join your family."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It was a jest. I, too, have a sense of humour."
  - After: "A jest. I have humour too."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will know to watch your tongue next time, commoner."
  - After: "Watch your tongue next time, commoner."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Nemesite, you say? I wonder who that is."
  - After: "Nemesite? Who's that?"
- **Player**

  - After: "Patience, Einrich. Once the culprit's found, they go free."
- **Einrich Monteg**

You've got teenagers and elderly folk here — they're all just ordinary workers, they've done nothing wrong!"
  - After: {n}Einrich looms over an enforcer.{/n} "Why beat and starve kids and elders?"
- **Enforcer Officer**
  - Before: "They're all guilty until proven otherwise. You think a kid or an old man wouldn't do something that might threaten the Lord Captain's life? Once we light a bit of fire under them, who knows, perhaps someone will confess. So, sod off, traitor spawn, or I'll put a baton through your skull for attacking an enforcer. I couldn't care less about your rank."
  - After: "All guilty till proven otherwise. Sod off, traitor spawn."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}Einrich looks up at you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I ask you please to protect your servants from this abuse."
  - After: {n}To you:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, protect your servants."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}Einrich adjusts his clothes and approaches confidently.{/n} "What do your enforcers think they're doing, Jocasta? Why are you assaulting my people, denying them water like they're criminals? You've got teenagers and elderly folk here — they're all just ordinary workers, they've done nothing wrong!"
  - After: {n}Einrich strides up.{/n} "Jocasta, why beat and starve my people?"

  - Before: "No, Einrich, what do YOU think you are doing? Attacking my people, chastising me in front of the Lord Captain? Get out before I have you charged."
  - After: "You attack my people and shame me? Leave before I charge you."

  - Before: {n}As Nemi's shoulders slump, Mia hisses to her,{/n} "I told you! It's fine, I'll split mine with you."
  - After: {n}Mia hisses,{/n} "Told you! I'll share."
- **Einrich Monteg**

  - After: {n}Bitter, not angry:{/n} "As you command."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "The enforcers are revelling in their impunity, treating the crew like cattle, especially my clan. Many in their custody are dying of thirst or injuries. My sister and niece are there too. I don't expect them to be exempted from the investigation, but I'm begging you to put an end to these assaults and let my people have some food and water."
  - After: "The enforcers treat my clan like cattle. People are dying, my sister and niece too. Stop it, feed them."

  - Before: "We're following procedure, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The regulations dictate the use of extreme force when dealing with the rabble so that the scoundrels do not cover up each other's transgressions."
  - After: "Procedure, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Force keeps the rabble honest."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "Thank you. We won't forget your mercy."
  - After: "Thank you. We won't forget it."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}Einrich gestures at a dishevelled young woman and a short-haired girl in her teens. Both are dressed in utility coveralls and smeared with soot.{/n} "Lord Captain, let me introduce my sister Nemi and my niece Mia. Ladies, you should thank the Lord Captain for helping you."
  - After: {n}He points to two sooty women.{/n} "My sister Nemi, niece Mia."
- **Nemi Monteg**

  - After: "Hello, Your Majesty! Thanks for saving our hands!" {n}Awkward laugh.{/n}
- **Marazhai**

  - After: {n}Marazhai yawns.{/n} "Hideously banal."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "My status as senior officer exempted me from being arrested, but that same privilege did not extend to them — they were taken, along with the rest of the clan."
  - After: "I was exempt as senior officer. They weren't."
- **Mia Monteg**

  - After: {n}Mia elbows her.{/n} "'Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'! No jokes, or {mf|his|her} mercy ends!"
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "Thank you, Lord Captain. They're all I live for, and, thanks to you, the people most important to me are now safe."
  - After: "Thank you. They're all I live for."
- **Nemi Monteg**
  - Before: "They were acting horribly! They were hitting people in the head and the ribs, they didn't care if someone fought back or not. Nemesite would never allow that!"
  - After: "They beat everyone! Nemesite would never allow that!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Mia elbows her again.{/n} "Shush! If they hear his name, they'll get angry again!"
  - After: {n}An elbow.{/n} "Shush! His name angers them!"
- **Nemi Monteg**
  - Before: {n}Nemi lowers her eyes in fear.{/n} "No one! Just a hero from a tale my grandfather used to tell when I was little."
  - After: {n}Nemi looks down.{/n} "No one! A hero from Grandpa's tales."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}Einrich raises his chin proudly.{/n} "In that case, I request permission to join my family."
  - After: {n}Einrich lifts his chin.{/n} "Then let me join my family."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "That's enough, Nemi." {n}Einrich scowls disapprovingly.{/n} "You are not a child anymore, so stop bothering people with those silly rhymes. Forgive my sister, Lord Captain. That was inappropriate."
  - After: "Enough, Nemi." {n}He scowls.{/n} "Forgive her, Lord Captain."
- **Einrich Monteg**

  - After: {n}Infernus Master Einrich Monteg, bloodied, spits beside an unconscious enforcer.{/n}

  - Before: "The void take your procedures! These are not seditionaries. They serve the dynasty, just like you and I."
  - After: "Void take procedure! They serve the dynasty!"
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}A pair of enforcers with battered faces is escorting Infernus Master Einrich Monteg. His lip is busted, his knuckles are grazed and covered with blood, and there is a chewed-up lho-stick between his teeth.{/n}
  - After: {n}Battered enforcers escort a bloodied Infernus Master Einrich Monteg.{/n}

  - Before: "Not yet, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But they will soon!"
  - After: "Soon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

  - After: {n}He's hiding something.{/n}

  - After: "Why was he beaten? I ordered it stopped!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Perhaps our culprit is a simple idiot?"
  - After: "Maybe he's just an idiot?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "We can still execute him, can we not?"
  - After: "We can still execute him?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Jinevri, where did you get your knowledge of heretical signs?"
  - After: "Jinevri, how do you know heretical signs?"

  - Before: "Hold on. He has lied to us more than once, and maybe he is lying to us still. Jinevri, do you have anything to say?"
  - After: "Wait. He's lied before, maybe still. Jinevri, anything to say?"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Allow me to demonstrate. You there, cultist. You said you rubbed elbows with daemons? Name one for me."
  - After: "Cultist. Name a daemon."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "That makes sense. You cannot beat a man half to death without everyone in the compartment getting wind of such a scene. We will look into it."
  - After: "True. Beatings get noticed. We'll look."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}A vein swells on Sauerback's temple.{/n} "Should we also grant him a pleasure palace in the spires of Dargonus while we are at it? Lord Captain, I doubt you will get the result you desire, but we will do everything within our power."
  - After: {n}A vein swells.{/n} "A palace too? Doubtful, but we'll try."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "We can certainly try, although we risk breaking him permanently. Extensive practice has shown that repeated torture of prisoners in this condition rarely has the desired effect."
  - After: "It may break him. It rarely works."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "What do you want us to do with him when we are done?"
  - After: "And afterwards?"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Undoubtedly inspired by your idea, Sauerback rolls her eyes and faintly mutters under her breath,{/n} "Emperor, grant me strength... It will be done, Lord Captain. We will recite psalms to the prisoner."
  - After: {n}Sauerback rolls her eyes.{/n} "Emperor, grant me strength... Psalms it is."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "I agree, Lord Captain." {n}Sauerback growls at the worker:{/n} "I want the truth! Who are you? And who told you to give us this pathetic confession?"
  - After: "Agreed." {n}To the worker:{/n} "Who fed you this confession?"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "We have the pipewardens' names and identification numbers, and we know which clan they are from. We will keep pressing the riffraff until either the culprit confesses or someone turns him in. I will handle this." {n}The Master-at-Arms pointedly grips the maul on her belt.{/n} "Please enjoy your meal in the interim, Lord Captain. The scoundrel will appear before us soon enough."
  - After: "We know the pipewardens' clan. We'll press until someone talks." {n}She grips her maul.{/n} "Enjoy your meal."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hrotko looks proud and self-important. Jinevri is biting her nail, as if hesitant to say anything. Sauerback is observing the worker in silence, apparently sunk deep in thought. Meanwhile, Klein merely stands still with a distrustful grimace on his face. Other than Hrotko, no one here seems to believe that you are looking at the real culprit.{/n}
  - After: {n}Only Hrotko looks convinced this is the culprit.{/n}
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "There is no cause for alarm, Lord Captain. This 'conspirator' may have been a fake, but now it is only a matter of time before we find the real culprit."
  - After: "No alarm. He was a fake; we'll find the real one."
- **Enforcer Klein**
  - Before: {n}Klein smirks.{/n} "The dead mutant looked more like a daemon worshipper to me, the way his guts were all twisted. As for this one here... There's no touch of the warp on his body, that's for sure. The worst he'll be able to show us is an ingrown nail."
  - After: {n}Klein smirks.{/n} "The mutant looked cultish. This one has no warp touch."
- **Enforcer Klein**
  - Before: {n}Klein shakes his head morosely.{/n} "My mistake, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Mutations are common among heretics... I guess this really is about a cult."
  - After: {n}Klein sighs.{/n} "My mistake, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. It's a cult."
- **Enforcer Jinevri**
  - Before: "There is one thing that's bothering me." {n}Jinevri points at the symbols on the worker's body.{/n} "Gwedon, what are those marks all over you?"
  - After: {n}Jinevri points.{/n} "Gwedon, what are those marks?"
- **Enforcer Jinevri**
  - Before: {n}Jinevri baulks sheepishly, casts a wary gaze at the Master-at-Arms, then shakes her head.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jinevri glances at Sauerback, shakes her head.{/n}
- **Enforcer Jinevri**
  - Before: "There is no such symbol. It's supposed to be a circle with eight arrows, and there is no way it's called 'the hame of terror.' This is some kind of travesty. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the man is talking nonsense."
  - After: "No such symbol. It's an eight-arrow circle. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, he's lying."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Sauerback glances at Jinevri with curiosity.{/n} "Jinevri, do you concur with the Lord Captain? Have you anything to say about this... expert display?"
  - After: {n}Sauerback eyes Jinevri.{/n} "Concur, Jinevri?"
- **Enforcer Jinevri**
  - Before: "I often have to deal with insidious rabble. The idleness and avarice of the scum on the lower decks breeds heresy, especially during warp travel, and people start carving signs on themselves and praying to... all sorts of things. The circle with eight arrows is more common than any other symbol, but I've never seen this variation before."
  - After: "Lower-deck scum carve heretic signs. The eight-arrow circle is common; this variant isn't."
- **Enforcer Jinevri**
  - Before: "What? I swear that I have not—"
  - After: "What? I swear I haven't—"
- **Enforcer Hrotko**
  - Before: "And yet he knows your name and pointed you out right away. Do you not find that funny?"
  - After: "Yet he knew your name. Funny?"
- **Enforcer Klein**
  - Before: "And do you not find it funny that your head is always up your arse, Hrotko? It's obvious that someone framed her!"
  - After: "Your head's up your arse, Hrotko. She was framed!"
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Cease this bickering!" {n}Sauerback's snarl forces the officers to back down.{/n} "Lord Captain, what we have here is a liar, and a well-coached one at that. He will never confess on his own. What do you suggest we do?"
  - After: "Enough!" {n}They back down.{/n} "He's coached. He won't confess. Suggestions?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta sighs, shaking her head sorrowfully.{/n} "God-Emperor, forgive this wayward soul his feeble-mindedness."
  - After: {n}Argenta sighs.{/n} "Emperor, forgive his feeble mind."
- **Enforcer Hrotko**
  - Before: "Mistress Sauerback, are you not being too hasty in your conclusions? He did confess, after all."
  - After: "Too hasty? He confessed."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "He confessed what he was told to confess. I was personally involved in interrogating Voigtvir's henchmen, and even they did not spout such drivel."
  - After: "As told. Even Voigtvir's men didn't spout such drivel."
- **Jocasta Sauerback**
  - Before: "Then he is the smartest idiot I've ever seen. He successfully carried out the crime, yet there is nothing remotely nefarious in his behaviour."
  - After: "A clever idiot. He pulled off the crime, yet acts innocent."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Klein hesitates, avoiding your gaze.{/n} "I suppressed a dozen mutant revolts on Dargonus for Lady Theodora. I've torn the freaks to pieces myself. But to open one up... to sink my hands into their impure guts infested with the mutant blight..."
  - After: {n}Klein looks away.{/n} "I crushed mutant revolts on Dargonus. But touching their guts..."

  - Before: {n}The twisted abnormalities of the mutant's insides make you wonder if he can even be considered human at all. As you probe deeper, your hand finds something lodged in the victim's gullet: someone has stuffed a black feather into the man's throat.{/n}

- **Argenta**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You refuse to submit to fear and revulsion. One foul corpse is nothing to someone who has triumphed over {mf|his|her} own fate and achieved the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}impossible{/d}. You look at the mutant's insides without a moment's hesitation.{/n}
  - After: {n}You achieved the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}impossible{/d} and mastered {mf|his|her} fate. You look without flinching.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}"Bloody business." You turn your attention to the floor around the corpse. There is no spatter, no gobs of flesh, no bloody footprints fortuitously trailing into the dark. And yet... you know there is no way to butcher a corpse like that without getting dirty at all.{/n}
  - After: {n}No spatter or footprints. Such butchery can't be clean.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Klein almost drops his scalpel.{/n} "But what methods of seeking the truth remain to us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? The rabble do not understand any other way."
  - After: {n}Klein flinches.{/n} "What else works, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Rabble know nothing else."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I must commend your fearlessness and insight... and apologise for my weakness of spirit. My shameful fear prevented me from doing my duty. It will not happen again."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, forgive my weakness. Never again."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Klein lets out a ragged breath and then draws himself up straight, speaking in a clipped tone:{/n} "Yes, Lord Captain."
  - After: {n}Klein straightens.{/n} "Yes, Lord Captain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The enforcer dips his head deferentially.{/n} "You have been a model of fearlessness and competence — I will aspire to follow your example."
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "I'll follow your example."

  - Before: "Vestigial limbs, chitinous formations. These are far beyond mutations that one would consider common or acceptable. We must locate the killer and find out what they managed to learn about this creature."

It is as if you are dissecting a seed that should have evolved into something more complex and alien.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You cannot begin to guess what unfavourable genetic factor caused such hideous mutations.{/n}
  - After: {n}You can't guess what caused such mutations.{/n}

  - After: {n}Klein nods.{/n} "Not yet, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

This time, I intend to get the epidemic under control, study the disease thoroughly, and develop a proper cure."

  - Before: "'Expend them'? What is that supposed to mean, Lord Cap'n? Now we'll have to teach new idiots the ins and outs of the voidsman's craft!"

The disease goes through several stages, with each containing clues to its nature and vulnerabilities. The voidsmen will have to stay sick for some time until I discover the cure, assuming, of course, that the disease is reversible in its final stages."

The rabble immediately plundered the medical storehouse and proceeded to smash other supply stations, slaughtering officers as they went.
  - After: Foundry bay unrest. Nemesite, a lower-deck avenger, shot the commandant and roused the serfs. They looted stores and killed officers.

  - After: The Seneschal: Nemesites spark sedition when serfs feel oppressed, killing the most hated officers.
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: The Vox Master: rumours call Nemesite a spirit of justice, even immortal. Hard to catch.
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: Many betray neighbours, but no Nemesite. Order is restored.

She had delayed the queue by begging to be given medicine for her afflicted children, which the commandant refused because her request exceeded the expenditure quota. The widow persisted and was given ten lashes on the spot. That was when Nemesite fired the fatal shot that set off a mutiny in the compartment.
  - After: A widow begged medicine for her sick children beyond quota. The commandant had her lashed. Nemesite shot him.

The previous three were captured by enforcers, and each openly identified themselves as Nemesite. The public executions evidently have no effect: people continue to rally around their hero as soon as one emerges and always believe in the invulnerability of their champion.
  - After: The Master-at-Arms: the fourth Nemesite in years. Three were executed; the people still believe him invulnerable.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Nemesite has escaped, and the situation on the deck is increasingly spinning out of control. The Master-at-Arms asks permission to employ the harshest possible treatment, not simply to restore order, but to avenge the dead commandant as well as the fallen enforcers.

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The instigator fuelled the mob's anger with outrageous but regrettably popular stories about the Rogue Trader's allegedly {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}reprehensible{/d} character. As a result, a certain vile epithet has spread rapidly throughout the voidship: the Dynasty's Pustule.
  - After: The instigator spread tales of your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}reprehensible{/d} nature. Now you're called the Dynasty's Pustule.

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/ShipTemple/NewConfessor_Chaos/NewConfessor_Chaos_dialogue

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A dazzling young woman presses her hands to her chest rapturously. Her dark eyes glint with maniacal excitement.{/n} "I am elated to behold you, O Great Beacon!"
  - After: {n}A young woman glows, manic.{/n} "I am elated to behold you, O Great Beacon!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your fame grows! I can tell — after all, before I was confined to that monastery, I made some... friends who were very good at procuring all manner of {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMissionGlossary}oddities{/g} — remarkable things that people mistakenly brand as forbidden. Shortly after my release, I contacted them to spread the good word about you! Oh, how intrigued they were!"
  - After: "Your fame grows! I've told my friends who procure {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMissionGlossary}oddities{/g} all about you!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "The power of the Warrant has gone to your head, I see. Do not expect the Inquisition to ignore the blasphemous acts you enable here."
  - After: "The Inquisition won't ignore this blasphemy."
- **Ulfar**

  - After: "What filth wears priest's robes, Aett-Vater?" {n}Ulfar snarls.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Confessor Cecilia, your most devoted servant. My parents threw me into a monastery for showing interest in knowledge that the ignorant see as forbidden. But when you came to power, I knew things were about to change. I prayed to you, and you answered when you sent your people to search for a truly pious soul. They tested me, but it was nothing, for any price is dust compared to the chance to serve you personally."
  - After: "Confessor Cecilia, your servant. Cloistered for 'forbidden' knowledge, I prayed; you chose me."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "Marvellous! They need only see..." {n}She whispers.{/n} "...their god is here, in the flesh."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "No, don't answer — I'll predict your desires."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She closes her eyes and says in a breathy, almost sultry voice,{/n} "I will set the minds of your subjects free and shatter the chains of the false faith. Let them witness your glory and offer all their prayers to you."
  - After: {n}Breathily:{/n} "I'll break the false faith; they'll pray only to you."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta's face is alight with righteous indignation.{/n} "{name}, did you purge this place of heretics only to nurture a new heresy in their place?"
  - After: {n}Argenta bristles.{/n} "{name}, a new heresy in place of the old?"

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/ShipTemple/NewConfessor_Death/NewConfessor_Death_dialogue

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man raises his head, and you see a face covered in scars that form a holy {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}. A rustling voice speaks,{/n} "I am here to serve, Domin'{name}."
  - After: {n}His face bears a scarred {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}.{/n} "I serve, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I used to mentor the Web's disciples. Now I mentor laypeople. It is... different. More unsettling. But it is a beautiful dance still."
  - After: "Teaching laypeople unsettles me, yet it's beautiful."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The flock... is afraid. I will help them to see the Undying Emperor. Those who behold Him are no longer afraid. They will recognise Him in self-denial and servitude, and they will expel weakness through sacraments of pain. Through purifying ascesis and sacrificial bloodletting, they will be saved and renewed as His servants who are without doubt. His servants... and yours, Domin'{name}."
  - After: "Through pain and bloodletting, the fearful flock will become His servants, and yours, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He nods slowly.{/n} "They call me Confessor Tercitius. I have left the cloister of the Bloodspun Web and now reside here. I teach the Tenets of the Web to the laity."
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "Confessor Tercitius. I left the cloister to teach the laity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The word of the Undying One travels around the flagship... and beyond. Many pirates who live off plunder and murder are deaf to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g}'s sermons. Our teaching is easier for them to understand. Much like the pirates themselves, it is forged in blood and violence. The Bloodspun Web has told them of you and your devotion to Him." {n}He bows his head.{/n} "We honour the Domin."
  - After: "Pirates deaf to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g} grasp our bloody faith." {n}He bows.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The bones adorning the confessor's armour glitter with gold, as does the blood-filled chalice that he is holding.{/n} "Blessed are your steps, Domin'{name}."
  - After: {n}He holds a blood chalice.{/n} "Blessed are your steps, Domin'{name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Vizsier has {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}elevated{/d} the Bloodspun Web, and now it is the laypeople's duty to pay their guides, be it in respect, gold, or blood. Our flock trembles, for we are death."
  - After: "The Vizsier {d|Encyclopedia:CompKibellah_Distortion}elevated{/d} the Web; laypeople pay in gold or blood. We are death."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Never before has our teaching guided laypeople, Domin. It is a revelation meant for His chosen spinners. But now, a new thread of the Bloodspun Web will be spun, for you have commanded that it be so."
  - After: "This was for His spinners alone, Domin. Now, at your command, it spreads."

## DLC/DLC1/Narrative/ShipTemple/NewConfessor_Eccl/NewConfessor_Eccl_dialogue

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You see a middle-aged woman dressed in rich ecclesiastical robes. Her features are large and unsightly, but her majestic posture and commanding gaze, coupled with her gleaming gold regalia, make her an imposing figure.{/n}

I will start from nothing, as if I were arriving on a world unfamiliar with the Creed, and from there I will rebuild the citadel of faith aboard this vessel. Within one year, you will be surrounded by the righteous."
  - After: "My predecessor was a heretic. I'll rebuild from nothing. In a year, you'll be surrounded by the righteous."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Where a heretic once preached, the Imperial Creed now thunders as before! It fills my heart with a joy almost as deep as that of fighting His foes." {n}Argenta exchanges a look of pious resolve with the confessor.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Confessor Arabella Bolint, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, of the Calixian Lesser Bolints. It is an honour to be welcomed aboard your vessel. You may entrust me with your crew, for I am a lifelong missionary and preceptor. I was drawn to serving the faith from a young age, and I have been fortunate enough to have studied under some of the most doctrinally rigorous mentors in the Expanse."
  - After: "Confessor Arabella Bolint, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, of the Calixian Lesser Bolints. A lifelong missionary, strictly trained."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Never before have I served on a ship, but the faith in Him must be uniform and consistent with the Creed in every place, must it not? I see much unorthodoxy in the life of the voidsmen, but by the Emperor's grace, I will rekindle the light of His teachings until it banishes the shadows from your subjects' hearts."
  - After: "My first ship, but the Creed is one everywhere. I'll banish the voidsmen's unorthodoxy."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And, of course, I will see to it that your name is always upon the lips of the Expanse's faithful. Servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g} must stand together in this grim hour, and news of your pious deeds, loudly proclaimed, will contribute to this. Let our faith unite us in the face of the trials ahead."
  - After: "And the Expanse's faithful will hear of your piety. The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorumGlossary}Ecclesiarchy{/g} must stand united."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The confessor is covered head to toe in jewellery. Even her nails are gilded, and her smile reveals teeth inlaid with mother-of-pearl.{/n} "Great Beacon, our glorious {mf|master|mistress}!"

- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "I cut the saints from my sermons to preach Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s divinity as {mf|master|mistress} of the {g|Encyclopedia:WarrantGlossary}Warrant{/g}." {n}She fawns.{/n}
