  - After: {n}Heinrix's mask flickers.{/n} "The Archenemy's mark may board with those priests."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, Lord Captain. I will immediately inform the navigation and artillery decks of the impending manoeuvre."
  - After: "Yes, Lord Captain. Alerting navigation and artillery."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Vox Master falters.{/n} "Lord Captain... we saw a number of ships approach the sun. Black creations of inhuman make, amalgams of sharp angles and edges...   - After: {n}Faltering:{/n} "Black, angular xenos ships surrounded the sun... and it vanished!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator closes his eyes and grimaces.{/n} "Drukhari."
  - After: {n}The Interrogator grimaces.{/n} "Drukhari."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix nods.{/n} "A breed of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, the most cruel and devious of their kind. The design of their ships matches the description provided by the Vox Master."
  - After: {n}Heinrix nods.{/n} "The cruellest {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}. Their ships match."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix gives you a keen look.{/n} "I am talking about xenos, Rogue Trader. The {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, one of Humanity's most ancient enemies. More specifically, I am referring to the most cruel and devious of their kind. The design of their ships matches the description provided by the Vox Master."
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks keenly.{/n} "Xenos: the cruellest {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, ancient foes of Humanity. Their ships match."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Like all {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} are a blight on the face of the galaxy, but their technological superiority is indisputable. They abhor and fear warp sorcery, which is why they rely on creations of their twisted intellect — and many of those creations are capable of things that may seem akin to sorcery to the unenlightened eye. The theft of a sun is one example of what they are capable of."
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} are a {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} blight with superior technology. Fearing sorcery, they build devices that rival it — like stealing a sun."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix responds in Vigdis's stead:{/n} "Hold your temper, Rogue Trader. Judging by the Vox Master's description, the system was infiltrated by the most elusive breed of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, one of Humanity's ancient enemies. Your {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} are no match for the kind of technology they have at their disposal."
  - After: {n}Heinrix answers for Vigdis:{/n} "Calm down. Elusive {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} did this. Your {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g} can't match them."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix's eyes grow wide in astonishment.{/n} "The souls of millions of subjects of the Imperium are in your hands... reconsider! Rykad Minoris must be obliterated before it is in the thrall of the Archenemy!"

- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix nods, his face frozen in a gloomy expression.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix nods gloomily.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix glances around.{/n} "The situation calls for immediate action, {name}. We can continue this conversation later if you so wish, but right now..." {n}He gestures at the deck teeming with tumultuous activity.{/n} "I believe you should assume command."
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks around.{/n} "Later, {name}. Right now..." {n}He gestures at the deck.{/n} "Take command."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/BridgeAndCabinet/NavigatorsPreparations/NavigatorsPreparations_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "By what right do you issue commands on my vessel? Do not forget that you are alive solely thanks to my magnanimity."
  - After: "You command on my ship? You live by my mercy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not want to speak to you. Go to the Sanctum Navis. Now."
  - After: "Go to the Sanctum Navis. Now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The last Navigator made do without these tricks, and you will as well."
  - After: "The last Navigator managed without tricks."
- **Player**
  - Before: "First you will do your duty as Navigator. All other conversations can wait."
  - After: "Duty first. Talk can wait."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What did you wish to speak about?"
  - After: "What did you want to discuss?"
- **Player**

  - Before: "Why are you asking for these items? Now is not the time to indulge in painting."

  - Before: "I shall ensure that all the necessary supplies are delivered to the Sanctum Navis."

- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you refuse red paint?"

- **Player**
  - Before: "Not at all. I regret frightening you, although it was the only way to convince you to leave Eurac V."
  - After: "No. Scaring you was the only way off Eurac V."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Hardly. You are free to leave as soon as I find someone to replace you."
  - After: "No. You leave once I find a replacement."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Indeed you are. And I detest it when my prisoners rattle on."
  - After: "Yes. And I hate chatty prisoners."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Of course you are. I will not allow a monster like you to make itself at home here."
  - After: "Yes. No monster gets comfortable here."

  - After: {n}Cassia clutches the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone{/d} at her throat, wincing.{/n} "First, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}. Leave us."

  - After: {n}Cassia nods curtly.{/n} "So be it."

  - After: "Thank you for saving {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaServantsSaved}my servants{/d}, especially Uve, my valet in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}."

  - After: "I'll use my own sacred Navis Nobilite blood this time."
- **Cassia**

  - After: "Thank you. When Theobald died, you acted {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaTakenAmicable}honourably{/d}. I am grateful."

  - Before: "I am ready to go to the Sanctum Navis and perform the sacred rite. I require brushes, canvas, and the best paints you have on board. But no red."

  - After: "O-of course... Call me when ready."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}After a few seconds' hesitation, Cassia lets out a small exhale, and then raises her pointed chin.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cassia raises her chin.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I am obliged to refuse your... request. If you wish to doom every soul on this ship, that is your prerogative as the captain of this vessel. But you will send me to Rykad Minoris before you do so."
  - After: "I refuse. Doom the ship if you like, but send me to Rykad Minoris first."
- **Cassia**

  - After: "On House Orsellio's word: without paint, the warp goes badly."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia nods in thanks.{/n} "I shall take my leave of you for the duration of the rite. I ask that you do not follow me — few can survive the gaze of my Warp Eye when it is opened."
  - After: {n}Cassia nods.{/n} "Don't follow me. Few survive my Warp Eye."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g}, welcome aboard. The Sanctum Navis has been prepared for the communion ritual, but if the Lady Navigator wishes to rest in her quarters first..."
  - After: "Welcome aboard, Lord Captain, {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g}. The Sanctum Navis is ready."

I can but hope that it will not be a hindrance when I am guiding the ship through the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Sea of Souls{/g}."
  - After: "But Felek's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone{/d} smothers me, and I can't remove it. May it not hinder me in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Sea of Souls{/g}."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "But now..." {n}Cassia throws back her shoulders.{/n} "I am ready to go to the Sanctum Navis and perform the sacred rite. I require brushes, canvas, and the best paints you have on board. But no red."
  - After: "Now..." {n}She straightens.{/n} "I'm ready for the rite. I need brushes, canvas and paints. No red."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}The Navigator's pale lips tremble in the face of your aggression, but she resolutely continues,{/n} "All the Navigators in this system died on Eurac V. You need me. You will not kill me. Not now."
  - After: {n}She trembles, but holds firm.{/n} "All other Navigators died on Eurac V. You need me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Sudden weariness crashes down on your shoulders. Your thoughts grow fuzzy. You do not want to continue this argument. Or... have you been forced to think this?{/n}

- **Cassia**

  - After: "Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}fame{/d} reached Eurac V, {name}. What a {mf|man|woman}. Now a Rogue Trader."

  - Before: "They are not tricks, but a sacred ritual. I refuse to perform it without the appropriate preparation."
  - After: "A sacred ritual, not tricks. I need preparation."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/JailPlanetoid/Commandant/Commandant_Jail_dialog

- **Player**

  - After: "How do you know me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What madness have you wrought in this prison?"
  - After: "What madness is this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I know you received a transmission shortly after my ship emerged from the warp. What was the message?"
  - After: "What message did you get when my ship arrived?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "I am here to quell a riot. By means far from diplomatic."
  - After: [Attack] "I'm here to quell a riot. Undiplomatically."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Aurora was felled by my hand. You will fall as well."
  - After: "I killed Aurora. You're next."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Who is Brother Twilight? Give me his name!"
  - After: "Who is Brother Twilight? Name him!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why did you mutilate these people?"
  - After: "Why mutilate them?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Step away from the hostage at once!"
  - After: "Step away from the hostage!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "So you are one of Aurora's followers! I should have expected as much."
  - After: "So you follow Aurora!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Aurora was felled by my hand. You have nothing to hope for. Surrender."
  - After: "I killed Aurora. Surrender."
- **Player**
  - Before: "That pit... there is something special about it, is there not? An item of value was once buried there. Now tell me, Warden: what was the item and who took it from here?"
  - After: "Something was buried in that pit. What, Warden, and who took it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Who is that on the table?"
  - After: "Who's on the table?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Everything in the appearance of the man walking toward you, his every gesture and his very demeanour, speaks of his noble birth. This creates a stark contrast with his hair — a matted knot that clearly has not seen a brush in weeks — and his crumpled and filthy clothing. His face is pale, and his eyes burn feverishly.{/n} "Who are you? I was expecting my friend Evayne, not an intrusion."
  - After: {n}A filthy, feverish nobleman approaches.{/n} "Who are you? I expected my friend Evayne."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I told you, Evvie. They are hiding so much from us. Arrogant mentors, holy brothers and sisters — what have they ever given us? Nothing but a pile of fibs and useless admonitions." {n}The voice of the man standing with his back to you sounds almost soft. Heedless of everything but what is in front of him, he leans over a prisoner dressed in expensive clothing.{/n}
  - After: "I told you, Evvie. Our mentors gave us only fibs." {n}A man leans over a richly dressed prisoner.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But Aurora — she is different. She spoke with me like no one ever had before. She revealed the truth to me. And now I can reveal it to you... if you just stop struggling for one minute! What..." {n}The man finally realises he is not alone and turns to you. He is clutching a long thin metallic rod with blood dripping off it.{/n} "We have guests? From the von Valancius ship, I would wager. Evvie, my dear, you will have to wait. Do not faint, I beg of you. It's important that you feel everything. Including your other eye."
  - After: "Aurora showed me the truth. Stop struggling!" {n}He turns, bloody rod in hand.{/n} "Von Valancius guests? Wait, Evvie. Feel everything, including your other eye."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The warden raises his hand, and the maimed people start thrashing about in their death throes.{/n} "The time for words has passed. Optimates, give your power to this Harbinger of Aurora! Let our foes see the truth — or become awash in blood!"
  - After: {n}The maimed thrash at his gesture.{/n} "Optimates, empower this Harbinger of Aurora! Let our foes see the truth, or drown in blood!"
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "Then your wait is over, An." {n}Evayne takes a step forward.{/n} "However, I do not come alone — I am accompanied by the honourable {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
  - After: "Your wait is over, An." {n}Evayne steps up.{/n} "With {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why not? I'm sure you have an inkling already. Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius. Your own blood... A shame that he is the only one in your entire house who was brave enough to cast off the dogmas we've been fed since childhood!"
  - After: "Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius. Your own blood, the only one brave enough to cast off dogma!"
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "An, this isn't you. I do not know how it has come to this, but please, let me—"
  - After: "An, this isn't you. Please—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Quiet, Evvie. I promise I will talk to you... later. When we are alone."
  - After: "Quiet, Evvie. Later. Alone."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta hisses like an angry cat.{/n} "Heresy! Outright heresy!"
  - After: {n}Argenta hisses.{/n} "Heresy!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Till the end of my days, I will regret not wringing that rotter's neck with my own hands."
  - After: "I'll always regret not wringing that rotter's neck."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "These are my optimates. Saints who will guide the flock at the fated hour. Listen..." {n}He pauses and smiles.{/n} "Can you hear? You can't? They are crying out. Calling. It's just that their cries are not meant for our ears. They cast their voices out there, beyond the edge of the glass, into the transparent quiet. There, they are heard. There, their call is answered."
  - After: "My optimates, saints for the fated hour." {n}He smiles.{/n} "They cry beyond the glass, and are answered."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am one of the Harbingers of Aurora. I was chosen — not just to see, but to open the eyes of others."
  - After: "I am a Harbinger of Aurora, chosen to open eyes."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh! So you've managed to barge in here and interfere with the Prophetess's designs without even knowing who she is? But it is too late now. You will never attain sight. All you can do is accept your fate."
  - After: "You defy the Prophetess without knowing her? Too late. Accept your fate."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He laughs hoarsely.{/n} "You barely know what you're talking about, don't you? You may have killed Aurora's mortal shell. But the Prophetess is far more than her body. One day, you will meet her other, fearsome form — and you will know the sheer folly of your triumph."
  - After: {n}He laughs.{/n} "You killed her mortal shell. One day you'll meet her fearsome other form."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We are too attached to this life, to the limitations of our weak bodies, to the short-sightedness of our eyes that can scarcely see. It is all so insignificant... The true future lies beyond {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. And the only way to reach it is through a cleansing sacrifice. Do you understand?"
  - After: "Our weak bodies are nothing. The future lies beyond {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}, reached through sacrifice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He suddenly stirs like a predatory beast.{/n} "I do not like it when people take the Prophetess Aurora's name in vain. I desire your death, enemy of the truth."
  - After: {n}He tenses.{/n} "Don't take Aurora's name in vain. Die, enemy of the truth."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The warden sneers and glances at the maimed young man.{/n} "Hostage? How rude! Young Winterscale is my guest and dearest friend. He came here himself to visit his old acquaintance and have a heartfelt talk, and I... I am merely showing him some appropriate hospitality to commemorate our reunion." {n}As if echoing his words, Evayne lets out a weak moan.{/n}
  - After: {n}He sneers.{/n} "Hostage? Young Winterscale is my dear friend and guest." {n}Evayne moans.{/n}
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "I can't say I'm eager to spend time alone with you. Not after everything I've witnessed on Rykadi Philia — and what I'm witnessing right now."
  - After: "Not after Rykadi Philia, and this."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do you truly want to know?" {n}He becomes more animated and runs a hand through his matted hair. You note it has been some time since he last trimmed his nails.{/n} "This was my garden, where I tried to grow the seedlings of a beautiful future. That was before I realised that there is no future, not in the sense ordinary people understand."
  - After: {n}He rakes his matted hair.{/n} "My garden for a beautiful future. Then I learned there is no future."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard shakes his head sombrely.{/n} "That poor fool. I knew nothing good would come of his naive attempt at negotiating with heretics. However, Evayne appears to still be alive — if we make haste, we might yet save him. Having a scion of House Winterscale in your debt would certainly prove beneficial."
  - After: {n}Abelard frowns.{/n} "Evayne lives. Save him, and a Winterscale owes you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My sincerest apologies. Where are my manners? Please, allow me to introduce Evayne Winterscale, the younger son of Calligos Winterscale, in the flesh. You know, he was so close to witnessing the truth right before you interrupted our little chat."
  - After: "Meet Evayne Winterscale, younger son of Calligos. He nearly saw the truth."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Such... dreadful shades..." {n}Cassia recoils and covers her mouth.{/n} "The colours of this place, they are putrescent to the core. And these people... their colours are oozing with madness and despair, pain, and doom..."
  - After: "Dreadful shades..." {n}Cassia recoils.{/n} "These people ooze madness and doom..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "How dare you, contemptible peasant! For every drop of noble blood you spill, you will pay a hundredfold more!" {n}Cassia turns to you for support with an expression that is in equal parts indignant and frightened.{/n}
  - After: "How dare you, peasant! You'll pay a hundredfold!" {n}Cassia looks to you, frightened.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Enough with this feigned nobility, Lord Winterscale." {n}Heinrix draws his weapon as the air around him begins to freeze.{/n} "And if you could kindly step aside before you are caught in the crossfire."
  - After: "Enough, Lord Winterscale." {n}Heinrix draws, air freezing.{/n} "Step aside."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix sighs and draws his weapon.{/n} "There was never any point in having this conversation to begin with."
  - After: {n}Heinrix draws.{/n} "This talk was pointless."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator surveys the quarry and the warden.{/n} "This place was corrupted to its core long ago. Keep your weapons close, Lord Captain."
  - After: {n}Heinrix scans the quarry.{/n} "Corrupt to the core. Weapons ready, Lord Captain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man shoots you a piercing glare.{/n} "I should have guessed it would be you. What do you want, enemy of Aurora?"
  - After: {n}He glares.{/n} "You. What do you want, enemy of Aurora?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix grits his teeth.{/n} "The boy is still alive. But if we want him to stay that way, we should hurry."
  - After: {n}Heinrix grits his teeth.{/n} "The boy lives. Hurry."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The warden's words are suddenly drowned out by a chorus of voices in your head: the entity that still dwells in the recesses of your mind rejoices in a cacophony of cries. This place... it holds great significance for the entity. In the frantic chanting of the voices, you can almost make out words that speak of an ancient grave, one that was opened, for it contained a priceless treasure, a most coveted prize that was retrieved by the faithful after a centuries-long search.{/n}
  - After: {n}The entity in your mind rejoices, chanting of an ancient grave opened by the faithful for a long-sought treasure.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The warden's gaze bores into you. Then he smiles with the corners of his lips.{/n} "You are too late, enemy of the truth. This bastion has already fulfilled its great purpose. You will never find the trail of the reclaimed relic that now rests in the hands of the devout."
  - After: {n}He smiles thinly.{/n} "Too late. The relic is with the devout. You'll never find it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A fleeting glance at Winterscale's outstretched body is enough to turn your stomach. Torture — the very word makes you cringe in shameful horror. Your mind reels with the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}memories{/d} you have tried unsuccessfully to push to the back of your mind all these years.{/n}
  - After: {n}Winterscale's torture stirs {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}memories{/d} you've tried to bury.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lies have many faces, but there is only one truth. And it has been laid bare before me. I knew the enemy of the truth would come here sooner or later!"
  - After: "There is one truth, and I've seen it. I knew its enemy would come!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "You know, we had this guy once, he was a quiet one. One day he walked into a middle deck bar, threw one back, and then pulled out a gun and started shooting people left and right without saying a word. Then he shoved the barrel in his mouth and blew his brains out. Our warden here has exactly the same look in his eyes right now."
  - After: "Knew a quiet guy who shot up a bar, then himself. The warden's got that look."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A warning," {n}he says with a smirk.{/n} "My brother, Brother Twilight, informed me that a false Rogue Trader had taken the helm of House von Valancius, and that {mf|he|she} was an enemy and a potential source of trouble."
  - After: "A warning," {n}he smirks.{/n} "Brother Twilight said a false Rogue Trader, {mf|he|she}, is our enemy."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader, every moment spent on talking to this heretic could be a moment spent destroying him and committing this place to purifying flames. Isn't it time we got started?"
  - After: "Rogue Trader, stop talking and let's burn this heretic."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}The air around Idira grows so thick, one could cut it with a knife. She mutters through her teeth,{/n} "Lord Captain, do you mind letting me paint the walls with this scumbag's brains? I'll be careful not to get too much of it on you."
  - After: {n}Idira seethes.{/n} "Lord Captain, may I paint the walls with his brains?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As the warden is speaking, a strange {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}sensation{/d} draws your attention toward the ground — specifically, an open pit in the loose dirt. A single word spontaneously surfaces in your mind: "cradle." The pit itself does not appear to be of much interest, but at some point, it housed something of great importance — something faintly familiar to you.{/n}
  - After: {n}A {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}sensation{/d} draws you to an open pit. "Cradle." It held something familiar.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/JailPlanetoid/EwainConclusion/EwainConclusion_Jail_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave. I will see to it that assistance is provided to you and that you are escorted from here."
  - After: "I must go. I'll send help and an escort."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave. Your pilot will take you to Governor Medineh."
  - After: "I must go. Your pilot will take you to Governor Medineh."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Conserve your strength. You are wounded and need help."
  - After: "Rest. You're wounded."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Curious indeed... Just what exactly has he done here?"
  - After: "What exactly did he do here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "May I invite you aboard my ship, Evayne? I would like to continue our acquaintance."
  - After: "Join me aboard my ship, Evayne?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave. And you must have your own duties to attend to."
  - After: "I must go. You have duties."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Finish him off] "I cannot be certain that you aren't infected by this corruption as your friend was. Accept your death!"
  - After: [Finish him off] "You may be corrupted too. Die!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Evayne approaches the body of his friend and remains silent for some time. Then he looks at the quarry. His gaze is dark.{/n} "Everything here must be purged with fire. An... What have you done?"
  - After: {n}Evayne mourns.{/n} "Purge it with fire. An... What have you done?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't believe we've been... properly introduced..." {n}Blood is bubbling on the young man's lips, and his voice is barely audible, but even now it remains melodious and quite courteous.{/n} "Evayne... Winterscale... af Koronus. Greatly pleased... to make your acquaintance."
  - After: "Evayne... Winterscale... af Koronus." {n}Bleeding, still courteous.{/n} "Pleased..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "An... The warden... My friend. I tried to convince him to stop the riot. Diplomacy... failed..." {n}Speaking is a struggle, but he continues stubbornly,{/n} "Father hates diplomacy. Which is why I... had to try!"
  - After: "An, my friend... Diplomacy failed..." {n}He struggles.{/n} "Father hates it. So I tried!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He nods, giving in to oblivion.{/n}
  - After: {n}He passes out.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "'Wounded'... I... would have phrased it altogether differently... 'Tortured and maimed,' perhaps... Have you ever... had your eyes burned out? This was my first time... I cannot say I recommend the procedure... It..." {n}He is either trying to make light of the situation or growing delirious from the pain.{/n}
  - After: "'Tortured and maimed,' rather... Eyes burned out. Not recommended..." {n}Jest or delirium.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix fixes Idira with a strange look.{/n} "It is more difficult than it may seem."
  - After: {n}Heinrix eyes Idira.{/n} "Harder than it seems."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I thank you for the invitation and accept it gladly. I will arrive by my shuttle. In a little while. If you'll excuse me, I would like... to be alone for the time being."
  - After: "Gladly. I'll follow by shuttle. Later."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard gasps in horror.{/n} "Lord Captain! You just killed an heir of the Winterscale dynasty! Your reasoning may be understandable, but... Do you wish to start a war with Calligos?"
  - After: {n}Abelard gasps.{/n} "You killed a Winterscale heir! War with Calligos?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Certainly. I wish you all the best, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius." {n}Evayne offers you a courteous bow.{/n}
  - After: "Farewell, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius." {n}Evayne bows.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do not know nor do I want to know. These ravaged people, this strange glass, all this talk of 'Aurora'... These are abundantly clear signs of lunacy and heresy. I wish I could understand how the man I knew came to be this way, but... one should not peer into the abyss."
  - After: "Lunacy and heresy. One should not peer into the abyss."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator glances at you.{/n} "Your judgement is swift, Rogue Trader. I cannot help but wonder whether you are motivated by righteousness or the desire to destroy your rivals."
  - After: {n}Heinrix glances at you.{/n} "Righteousness, Rogue Trader, or removing rivals?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lady... Cassia, I presume? The sacred Child of House Orsellio. How disgraceful it is that on the day we finally meet, I..." {n}Evayne looks away in shame.{/n} "I find myself not at my best..."
  - After: "Lady Cassia of House Orsellio? To meet like this..." {n}He looks away.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He gasps abruptly, but has neither the time nor the strength to defend himself.{/n}
  - After: {n}He gasps, defenceless.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "On the rare days that Lord Winterscale visited Eurac V, the station was awash in a mist of warm hues. We were forbidden from meeting each other, but I was delighted still to see such rare colours in my home. Now, however... his colours are darkening. Twisting from pain and bitterness. We must help, Lord Captain! We must save the clarity of his soul, for he whose presence makes the world a little brighter deserves no less."
  - After: "His visits warmed Eurac V with colour. Now pain darkens it. We must save his soul, Lord Captain!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix reaches a hand toward Evayne, and the temperature drops a few degrees.{/n} "He is in a bad way, but timely assistance from a chirurgeon will save his life. For now, I will... do what I can."
  - After: {n}The air chills.{/n} "A chirurgeon can save him. I'll help meanwhile."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira whistles as she watches Evayne's breathing even out.{/n} "Fancy that, iceman... Can you make his eye grow back too?"
  - After: {n}Idira whistles.{/n} "Fancy that, iceman. Regrow his eye too?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "There is no disgrace in your predicament, Lord Winterscale. The Lord Captain and I met under... similarly dreadful and tragic circumstances."
  - After: "No disgrace. The Lord Captain and I met in tragedy too."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "You've got that right. That abyss happily swallows up wretched commoners and polished aristocrats alike — and it likes naive idealists best of all." {n}Idira smiles bitterly at Evayne before turning her gaze to the remains of his former friend.{/n}
  - After: "That abyss swallows everyone, naive idealists first." {n}Idira smiles bitterly.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/JailPlanetoid/EwainEarly/EwainEarly_Jail_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Let us discuss the matter at hand. You are here to end the riot, are you not?"
  - After: "To business. You're here to end the riot?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Greet him with decorum] "{mf|Lord|Lady} {name} von Valancius. I am pleased to make your acquaintance."
  - After: [Greet him with decorum] "{mf|Lord|Lady} {name} von Valancius. A pleasure."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We can dispense with the formalities. There are more important matters at present."
  - After: "Skip the formalities. Bigger matters await."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You yourself are the son of a Rogue Trader, are you not? So what is it about me you find so fascinating?"
  - After: "You're a Rogue Trader's son. Why am I fascinating?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It would be so refreshing to at last converse with another of commensurate pedigree and not some lowly servant or commoner."
  - After: "How refreshing to talk to an equal, not a servant."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It would be my utmost pleasure to indulge you."
  - After: "My pleasure."
- **Player**
  - Before: "There is no question that my destiny is great. You, on the other hand, have yet to prove your worth to me. My consideration is no mere trifle."
  - After: "My destiny is great. Prove your worth first."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We will have to discuss social gatherings some other time. This hardly seems the appropriate occasion."
  - After: "Socialising can wait."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The warden is clearly not of sound mind. At one point, he was trying to manage the inmates by offering incentives and even days of rest! What utter madness!"
  - After: "The warden is mad. He gave inmates incentives and rest days!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The warden is clearly not of sound mind. He performed inhumane experiments on prisoners. Acts of sheer brutality."
  - After: "The warden is mad. He did brutal experiments on prisoners."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Rebelling against lawful authority is heresy! Extending clemency to a heretic... Are you in your right mind?"
  - After: "Rebellion is heresy! Clemency for a heretic? Are you mad?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The desire to help a friend is a noble one."
  - After: "Helping a friend is noble."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If your diplomacy truly can stop the riot, it is worth a try. The fewer deaths, the better."
  - After: "If diplomacy stops the riot, try it. Fewer deaths."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where is Warden Casteglia now?"
  - After: "Where is Warden Casteglia?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Can I at all dissuade you from this escapade of yours?"
  - After: "Can I talk you out of this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. In that case, I shall accompany you."
  - After: "Very well. I'll come with you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. You may go see your friend. Far be it from me to try and stop you from losing your head!"
  - After: "Fine. Go lose your head!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Thank the Emperor that at least someone in this back-of-beyond system is my equal! Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, absolutely delighted to make your acquaintance."
  - After: "Thank the Emperor, an equal in this backwater! Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, delighted."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You came here with naught but a single shuttle's worth of guards — do you not think it foolhardy?"
  - After: "One shuttle of guards? Foolhardy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you not wish to enquire why I now stand at the head of my house and not Theodora?"
  - After: "Won't you ask why I lead my house, not Theodora?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Theodora perished in a cultist raid, one that took place right here in the Rykad System. That is when I took the helm."
  - After: "Theodora died in a cultist raid here in the Rykad System. I took the helm."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your restraint is warranted. I have no desire to speak of it at this time."
  - After: "I'd rather not discuss it now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is there anything you can tell me about the Navis Nobilite station in this system?"
  - After: "What do you know of the Navis Nobilite station here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Allow me to use your access code. My Navigator is dead. If I fail to find a new one, the very first warp jump could spell disaster for my ship. As a nobleman and a scion of a Rogue Trader house, you are obliged to aid me."
  - After: "Lend me your access code. My Navigator is dead; without one, my first warp jump could be a disaster. As a Rogue Trader's scion, you must help."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "{mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius, my greetings! May the light of eternal {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerra}Terra{/g} shine forevermore!" {n}The young man before you offers an impeccably courteous bow. He then straightens his back and looks you in the eye, not as a show of defiance, but with cool confidence. It is a gaze with which one graces an equal.{/n} "Evayne Winterscale, younger son of Calligos Winterscale. At your service."
  - After: "Greetings, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius! {g|Encyclopedia:HolyTerra}Terra{/g}'s light!" {n}He bows, eyeing you as an equal.{/n} "Evayne Winterscale, younger son of Calligos Winterscale."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Evayne raises his eyebrows, somewhat flustered.{/n} "In times like these, nobility usually prefers the safety of family bunkers to such uninviting places. Yet {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}you{/d} are more drawn to acts of daring, I see."
  - After: {n}Evayne blinks.{/n} "Most nobles hide in bunkers. {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}You{/d} prefer daring."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A short-lived smile flashes across Evayne's face.{/n} "I gather more than a few people have already put that question to you. Or perhaps you expect to be accosted by such queries in the future. Honestly, I did not ask because I was afraid of being obtrusive and tactless. But to tell the truth, I am dying to know."
  - After: {n}A brief smile.{/n} "I didn't want to pry. But I'm dying to know."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The young man bows his head politely.{/n}
  - After: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}He bows.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As am I." {n}Evayne's voice is soft and immaculately polite.{/n} "Please accept my apologies for the slight breach of etiquette. Here and now is neither the best place nor time for protracted ceremony."
  - After: "As am I." {n}Softly.{/n} "Forgive the brevity. No place for ceremony."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Absolutely not. They absolutely cannot," {n}Abelard mutters, barely audible.{/n}
  - After: "Absolutely not," {n}Abelard mutters.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are a {mf|man|woman} of action, I see? I agree, this is hardly the time for cordial greetings."
  - After: "A {mf|man|woman} of action? Agreed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Please accept my condolences. May Lady Theodora's soul be forever in Terra's eternal light." {n}Evayne pauses for an appropriate length of time.{/n} "So you are still new to your status! And you have not yet had your Magnae Accessio, I presume? How fascinating. I do not believe I have ever had the fortune of meeting an individual with a fate so compelling as yours. I hope that one day you may grace me with your presence under more civil circumstances, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius. There is much I wish to ask you about!"
  - After: "My condolences." {n}A pause.{/n} "So you're new, no Magnae Accessio yet? Fascinating! Let's talk later, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Evayne's expression is grave.{/n} "Indeed. It is a personal matter, if you will. And not simply because this incident occurred in a system that belongs to my father. The prison warden, An... he used to be a close friend of mine, once. I want to give him a chance to come to his senses, lay down his weapons, and stop this senseless uprising."
  - After: {n}Evayne is grave.{/n} "Yes, and it's personal. The warden, An, was a close friend. I'll give him a chance to surrender."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My father has ruled for an exceptionally long time. He has already outlived three of his chroniclers. I would be far more interested in speaking to someone who had just recently acquired their first taste of power and responsibility. Besides... to be perfectly honest..." {n}Evayne appears to be slightly embarrassed.{/n} "I am not exactly Calligos Winterscale's most favoured descendant. I could count on one hand the number of times I have had meaningfully long conversations with my father. And for half of those conversations, we exchanged messages through an {g|Encyclopedia:Astropath}Astropath{/g}. I think it prudent to say I have not exactly been lavished with the attention and insight of a Rogue Trader."
  - After: "My father has outlived three chroniclers. I'd rather hear someone new to power. And..." {n}Embarrassed.{/n} "I'm not his favourite. We've barely spoken, half via {g|Encyclopedia:Astropath}Astropath{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Of course. I hope my company will not disappoint you."
  - After: "I hope I won't disappoint."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am delighted! And now, I believe it's high time we returned to discussing the far-from-delightful circumstances in which we currently find ourselves..."
  - After: "Delighted! Now, back to our grim situation."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Evayne looks offended, but he finds the strength to keep his emotions in check.{/n} "Very well, then. I dare not pester you any further. Let us discuss the matter that has brought us both to this dismal place."
  - After: {n}Offended, but composed.{/n} "Very well. To business."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are certainly right, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
  - After: "Quite right, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Incentives and leisure, you say? That sounds like the An I know..."
  - After: "Incentives and leisure? That's the An I know..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Experiments? Atrocities? I believe you, but... that sounds nothing like him!"
  - After: "Atrocities? That's not like him!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "For as long as I have known him, An has always been a thinker, a dreamer, even. He would dig up these ancient books, studying societal models and theories. He was obsessed with ideals. There are priests within the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g} who would call it heresy to view the society of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} as anything but perfect, however... I believe that An only wanted what he thought was best. I only wish I knew where that road had taken him..."
  - After: "An was a dreamer obsessed with ideals. {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g} priests call it heresy to doubt the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s perfection, but he meant well. Where did it lead him?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He lowers his head stubbornly.{/n} "He is my friend. And my father's vassal. I do not deny his guilt — but I intend to give him the chance to atone for it."
  - After: {n}He stands firm.{/n} "He's my friend and my father's vassal. Guilty, but he deserves a chance to atone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My father would disagree..." {n}Evayne smirks wryly.{/n} "Thankfully, he is not here."
  - After: "My father would disagree..." {n}A wry smirk.{/n} "He's not here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "He is up ahead somewhere. And further below. We exchanged a few words over the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}, and he said he would meet me in the quarry behind the prison building. A strange choice for negotiations... but those were his conditions." {n}There is worry in his voice.{/n}
  - After: "Below. By {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} he set the meeting in the quarry behind the prison." {n}He sounds worried.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In that case, I thank you for your time, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius." {n}Even if he intends for his words to bite, his voice offers no indication. With a bow of his head, he departs.{/n}
  - After: "Thank you, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius." {n}He bows and leaves.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I must admit, I do appreciate your company. This prison is giving me a strong sense of unease. But the lift cannot support both our parties. If you are going ahead, wait for us in the quarry, we will follow shortly."
  - After: "Thank you; this prison unsettles me. The lift can't take us all. Wait for us in the quarry."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Please, I kindly ask that you not waste your breath. My decision is final."
  - After: "Please. My decision is final."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So did you." {n}Evayne smiles.{/n} "I... had my doubts, of course. But I am not Governor Medineh. I refuse to sit idle in the safety of a bunker. I wanted to do something, and I thought arriving with a light escort would show Anathagon the sincerity of my intentions. Had I arrived at the head of a whole unit, I would not fault An for assuming this was an assault."
  - After: "So did you." {n}He smiles.{/n} "I won't hide like Governor Medineh. A light escort shows Anathagon I'm sincere, not assaulting."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix lets out a strange sound — apparently deciding a bit too late to disguise a sardonic chuckle as a cough.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix coughs over a chuckle.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira leans close to you and whispers in a conspiratorial tone,{/n} "Lord Captain, while he's being all nice, why don't you ask him if you could borrow a few teensy planets of his? And later, if he asks for them back, you can just say you can't remember where you left them! Trust me, works every time, heh heh."
  - After: {n}Idira whispers,{/n} "Borrow a few planets, Captain, then forget where you left them! Works every time."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Such sentiments and intentions tend to only create more victims."
  - After: "Such intentions only make more victims."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}You hear Idira scoffing.{/n} "Yeah, I've known a few 'dreamers' like that myself! They always want what's best, but somehow it always ends in heresy. Back on my world, there was a big shot who was really into dental hygiene. To spare his people from pain, he started pulling out all their rotten teeth. But he, uh, got slightly carried away and started pulling healthy ones too, sometimes along with the jaw. 'Preventive care,' he called it. So a mob of toothless servants ended up tearing his kindly head clean off. It was preventive too, you see — that little noggin of his was rotten through and through."
  - After: {n}Idira scoffs.{/n} "A 'dreamer' back home pulled his people's teeth, healthy ones too. 'Preventive care.' They tore his head off. Also preventive."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Oh, cut him some slack, will you? We should be glad for Evayne here. It takes proper effort to still have that kind of attitude at his age! It's not too often you meet someone who's truly honourable."
  - After: "Ease up. Truly honourable folk are rare."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Your Lordship..." {n}Abelard looks at young Winterscale with worry.{/n}
  - After: "Your Lordship..." {n}Abelard frets.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I know more than most but less than one might expect. Our {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} are true recluses..." {n}Evayne stops for a moment and glances forward. You can see he is aching to continue further into the prison, but he suppresses the urge to rush off.{/n}
  - After: "A little. {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} are recluses..." {n}He glances ahead, eager.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Eurac V Station is the sovereign demesne of Navigator House Orsellio. As I said, they are remarkably reclusive, unwilling to interact with anyone, even the system's governor." {n}Evayne pauses.{/n} "However, House Orsellio has a direct agreement with House Winterscale. Several Navigators of the House serve on my father's ships. That is why I was granted personal access to the station — for emergency situations and important negotiations."
  - After: "Eurac V Station belongs to House Orsellio. They shun even the governor." {n}A pause.{/n} "But they serve my father's ships by pact, so I have emergency access."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have been to the station twice. Alone — it is the masters' demand that even guards and servants be left on the shuttle. By the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}, is it a bizarre place. Inexplicably, my emotions would shift from sudden trembling to carefree jubilation. For what reason, I cannot say. That station was far from uplifting. Every servant who tended to me there had had their tongue amputated. Well, I doubt such details are of interest to you... Once we are done here, I can try to contact the station and request access for you as well — but I am almost certain it will be for naught."
  - After: "I've gone twice, alone. By the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}, it's bizarre. I'll request access for you later, likely in vain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Evayne hesitates before making a helpless gesture.{/n} "I wish I could assist you, but I gave my word that I would keep the secrets of House Orsellio. I beg your forgiveness, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
  - After: {n}Evayne hesitates.{/n} "I swore to keep House Orsellio's secrets. Forgive me, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is a long pause. Evayne peers at you, weighing something in his mind. Eventually, he lets out a sigh.{/n} "It is an onerous task, trusting someone at first glance, but... I have a good feeling about you, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius. After all, people in our position can afford to be candid with one another."
  - After: {n}Evayne sighs.{/n} "I trust you, {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius. Our kind can be candid."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lately, the Orsellios have been acting even more strangely than usual. They change their access codes with unreasonable frequency. If it is of little help to you, you have my apologies. The {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} are... a peculiar breed."
  - After: "The Orsellios change codes constantly. The latest: 'How can a blind man see the starry sky?' The {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} are peculiar."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/JailPlanetoid/NatureOfTheLens/NatureOfTheLens_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Argenta is right — the danger of heresy cannot be overstated."
  - After: "Argenta is right. Heresy is a grave danger."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Idira is right. It is too soon to cast accusations of heresy."
  - After: "Idira is right. Too soon to cry heresy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Sister Argenta, you will cease these insinuations about Theodora at once! I will not allow the name of the von Valancius family to be defamed by such words."
  - After: "Argenta, stop slandering Theodora! I won't let the von Valancius name be defamed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Witch, you are walking a fine line between outright heresy and the barrel of a bolter. Shut your mouth before I shut it for you."
  - After: "Witch, you're close to heresy and a bolter. Shut your mouth."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have nothing to hide, Heinrix. When we found Theodora's body, there were shards of the same type of glass lying nearby."
  - After: "Nothing to hide, Heinrix. The same glass lay near Theodora's body."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am sure the members of my retinue will satisfy the Inquisition's curiosity."
  - After: "My retinue will satisfy the Inquisition's curiosity."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not dare to interrogate my people on matters that are of no concern to you!"
  - After: "Don't you dare interrogate my people!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your eye is drawn to the peculiar device. At first, you are vexed by worries of some pernicious influence, but the real reason soon becomes apparent. The glass installed in the device shimmers in a unique way — just the same way as the shards of the unknown broken object you found near Theodora von Valancius's desk.{/n}
  - After: {n}The device's glass shimmers like the shards near Theodora's desk.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your eye is drawn to the shards of the enormous lens scattered around the broken device. At first, you are uncertain as to what troubles you, but suddenly the realisation hits you. The glass shimmers in a unique way — just the same way as the shards of the unknown broken object you found near Theodora von Valancius's desk.{/n}
  - After: {n}The lens shards shimmer like those near Theodora's desk.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator proffers an icy smile.{/n} "Thank you for your valuable guidance, Rogue Trader, but my position obligates me to make my own judgement about whom to question, on what, and using what methods."
  - After: {n}Icy smile.{/n} "I choose whom to question, Rogue Trader, and how."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "What's the matter, Lord Captain? Why are you so interested in..." {n}Abelard trails off when he notices what you are looking at. He instantly makes the connection.{/n} "By the Imperium's saints... it cannot be!"
  - After: "Lord Captain..." {n}Abelard sees it.{/n} "Saints... it cannot be!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira bites her lip.{/n} "I... I see it too. Whatever that thing in her study was... it was made from the same material as this junk."
  - After: {n}Idira bites her lip.{/n} "Her study's thing was made of this."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "What? WHAT?" {n}Abelard is at a loss for words. He takes a moment to collect himself, and all at once they start pouring out in a hasty sputter:{/n} "It's a mistake. Slander meant to blemish the good name of a person who is now dead and cannot even defend herself! First those minions of the Archenemy murdered Lord Captain Theodora, and now... This cannot be tolerated! It WILL not be tolerated!"
  - After: "WHAT?" {n}Abelard sputters.{/n} "Slander against the dead! The Archenemy murdered Lord Captain Theodora, and now this? It WILL not be tolerated!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Come on now, Abelard. Remember what she was like." {n}Idira's smile betrays her grief, but, at the same time, is strangely knowing.{/n} "Brazen. Assertive. It was like her entire life was a race against fate until fate caught up with her in the end. She would've gone headfirst into a black hole if she had thought it would put her even one step ahead of everyone else out in the Expanse. If we could just find out what she was keeping in her desk and why she went to get it during the attack..."
  - After: "Remember her, Abelard." {n}Idira smiles sadly.{/n} "Brazen, racing fate. If only we knew what was in her desk, and why she went for it during the attack..."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Sister Argenta's beautiful face is full of grief.{/n} "How bitter it is to know that you were born from bad blood — but do not let this knowledge drag you into darkness!"
  - After: {n}Argenta grieves.{/n} "Bad blood. Don't let it drag you into darkness!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}The sister's words ring with a genuine, sincere hope that you be blessed with a worthier fate. She does not appear to be shocked by the news of Theodora's possible heresy.{/n}
  - After: {n}She hopes you fare better. Theodora's heresy doesn't shock her.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}The sister's words ring with genuine, sincere sorrow and hope that you will not follow in Theodora's footsteps.{/n}
  - After: {n}She hopes you won't follow Theodora.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Life must be so easy for you sanctimonious preachers. A dubious trinket, and you no longer see a person, you see 'bad blood,' an annoying hindrance." {n}There is enough venom in Idira's voice to poison an entire regiment.{/n}
  - After: "One trinket and a person becomes 'bad blood.'" {n}Idira's voice drips venom.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta recoils, but the next moment her dark eyes ignite with fury.{/n} "How dare you admonish me? We are speaking of abetting the Archenemy! A person who has tainted themselves thus can never justify their actions!"
  - After: {n}Argenta flares.{/n} "This is abetting the Archenemy! Nothing justifies it!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Sure, why go through all the trouble of trying to make sense of anything when you can just label them a heretic and call it a day? Except, dear friend, I seem to remember that you didn't mind Theodora so much while you were aboard the ship. You didn't leave her side for even a moment. She rescued you, aided you, and your adoration wilted the moment you heard an accusation sullying her memory. You weren't surprised or upset — you just gave up on her and moved on."
  - After: "Easy to cry heretic. You never left Theodora's side. She rescued you, and you dropped her at one accusation."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator observes you with polite and ominous interest.{/n} "I don't believe I am privy to the story you are so passionately discussing. I am sure Master Werserian and Mistress Tlass will be delighted to rectify my ignorance once we are back aboard the ship. We wouldn't want to distract the Lord Captain from any important matters."
  - After: {n}Ominously polite.{/n} "I'm not privy to this. Master Werserian and Mistress Tlass can enlighten me aboard ship."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "But she—" {n}A look from you makes her immediately bite her tongue.{/n} "I'm sorry, Lord Captain."
  - After: "But she—" {n}Your look silences her.{/n} "Sorry, Lord Captain."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix thinks for a moment.{/n} "Rogue Traders often cross the line while striving for greatness or seeking to understand the unknown. It is difficult to say what the item in Theodora's possession was... but the very fact that she had it hardly speaks in your predecessor's defence."
  - After: {n}Heinrix muses.{/n} "Rogue Traders cross lines. Having that item hardly defends Theodora."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix glances at Abelard and Idira, who exchange worried looks.{/n} "Undoubtedly, {name}."
  - After: {n}Abelard and Idira look worried.{/n} "Undoubtedly, {name}."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "{name}, don't be naive. Theodora kept an unsanctioned witch by her side like a pet. Do you really believe she would think twice about crossing the line in other ways?"
  - After: "Naive, {name}. Theodora kept an unsanctioned witch as a pet. Why not cross other lines?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, I'm not excusing heresy, I just don't believe... I don't want to believe Theodora would be involved in it. That all the good she did can be so easily crossed out with a single word."
  - After: "I don't excuse heresy. I just won't believe one word erases Theodora's good."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira shakes her head in despair, then freezes, as if having remembered something. She shrinks in terror at the sound of the Interrogator of the Holy Inquisition quietly clearing his throat.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira cowers as the Interrogator clears his throat.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta's fiery gaze instantly bores into you. She coldly bites out,{/n} "The deeds of the Rogue Trader's predecessor speak more loudly than any words I could utter."
  - After: {n}Argenta glares.{/n} "Your predecessor's deeds speak for themselves."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/JailPlanetoid/Pilot/Pilot_Jail_c1_dialog

  - Before: "Why would young Winterscale have felt the need to parley with the dissidents?"
  - After: "Why would young Winterscale parley with dissidents?"

  - Before: "I have no more questions. You may excuse yourself, pilot."
  - After: "No more questions. Dismissed, pilot."

  - Before: "What happened here?"
  - After: "What happened?"

  - Before: "He is alive but badly wounded. Help my people get him to my ship."
  - After: "Alive but badly wounded. Help get him to my ship."

  - Before: "I have not yet been to Rykad Minoris and know nothing of this officer's fate."

  - Before: "He is safe and in one piece. He will be back here soon, so ready the shuttle."

  - Before: [Lie] "Evayne Winterscale tragically died from the brutal torture he was subjected to by the rebel warden."

  - After: "Is this riot tied to the planetary rebellion?"

  - Before: "Is there anything else I should be apprised of before I set out?"
  - After: "Anything else before I set out?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young woman stares at you, adjusting her uniform nervously.{/n} "Your... {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? A thousand pardons if I addressed you improperly! - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pale young woman looks at you with a mixture of hope and disbelief swirling in her eyes. You notice her hands trembling as she clutches her weapon.{/n} "Who are you? Did you come from the planet? Are you reinforcements? Saint's teeth, I thought you'd never come!"
  - After: {n}A pale, trembling woman.{/n} "Reinforcements? Saint's teeth, finally!"
- **Abelard**

  - After: {n}Abelard glares.{/n} "Officer, address {name} von Valancius, a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, properly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "At once!" {n}The woman stands at attention.{/n} "Captain Raquel Vekhari, servant of House Winterscale and the pilot of this shuttle! It is an honour to be greeting {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} von Valancius!"

  - Before: "There's been a prison riot on the planetoid. Sadly, it is being led by the prison warden himself, the honourable Anathagon Casteglia.
