  - After: "Warden Anathagon Casteglia leads the riot, and declared Rykadi Philia independent!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We are engaged, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}," {n}she declares somewhat bashfully.{/n}
  - After: "We're engaged, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}," {n}she says bashfully.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "The first Winterscale in my memory who prefers to talk first rather than shoot and slash."
  - After: "A Winterscale who talks before shooting."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That's a shame. May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} keep that fool from harm... Thank you for your time, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "A shame. {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} keep him. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ah... uh... yes, of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We will! It is a great honour!" {n}She forces a smile. Then, with far greater sincerity, she adds,{/n} "And thank you — both for saving Jaspar and for letting me know he's all right!"
  - After: "An honour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}Sincerely:{/n} "Thank you for saving Jaspar!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She lets out a long sigh. You can see the relief gleaming in her eyes.{/n} "You can't imagine how much I needed to hear that. Thank you!"
  - After: {n}Relieved.{/n} "Thank you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The colour drains from the pilot's face.{/n} "The young lord... is... dead?" {n}For a few moments of drawn-out silence, she tries to make sense of what has happened.{/n} "I... I need to retrieve his body. And... and report the tragedy. Th-thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}She pales.{/n} "The young lord... dead?" {n}Silence.{/n} "I must retrieve his body. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She bows. You can tell by the desperation in her eyes that she is exhausted, frightened, and wishes to be off this planetoid as soon as possible.{/n}
  - After: {n}She bows, exhausted, eager to leave.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She smiles slightly.{/n} "You're quite right. Young Lord Winterscale is not his father's shadow. If he is determined to save his friend, he will try to do so no matter what obstacles get in his way."
  - After: {n}A slight smile.{/n} "Young Lord Winterscale isn't his father. He'll save his friend."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She smiles faintly.{/n} "Young Lord Winterscale is not his father's shadow. If he is determined to save his friend, he won't back down. I pray to the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} that he is alive and well. He's been gone for such a long time, and... I really don't like this place."
  - After: {n}A faint smile.{/n} "He won't abandon his friend. {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} keep him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The only settlement on Rykadi Philia is a penal colony. The prisoners work in the mines and the domed quarries. They mine sulphur, ceramdust, and sand, which is then melted down. A rather nondescript place... or so it was, prior to current events."
  - After: "A penal colony. Convicts mine sulphur, ceramdust and sand."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "And I take it they're looking forward to a diet of sand and gravel? What kind of madman would start a revolt on a barren rock?"
  - After: "Eating gravel? Who revolts on a barren rock?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Well noted. Either the warden has allies willing to supply him with resources, or he is insane. Granted, there is a third explanation: he does not intend to leave this world alive."
  - After: "The warden has suppliers, is insane, or plans to die here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It seems more likely that Warden Casteglia learned about the rebellion on Rykad Minoris and decided to use the situation to his advantage. I can't say for certain. Perhaps no one can. Governor Medineh has always preferred to shoot rebels rather than enquire about their motives and connections."
  - After: "Likely Casteglia exploited the Rykad Minoris rebellion. Governor Medineh never asks rebels why."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman looks at you for a while longer, eyes laden with hope, then sighs.{/n}
  - After: {n}She waits, hopeful, then sighs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Unless it's one of the prisoners or guards, then it seems unlikely. There are no shuttles in working order other than yours and mine. There is nothing else anyone could have used to reach this place."
  - After: "Unlikely. Only your shuttle and mine work."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman freezes for a moment before asking hesitantly,{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, if I may have a minute of your time... I wouldn't ever have dared to trouble you with a personal matter, but the situation... In any case, have you been to the capital of Rykad Minoris yet? I wanted to ask if you saw a man there, a communications officer by the name of Jaspar..."
  - After: {n}She hesitates.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, on Rykad Minoris did you see a vox officer, Jaspar?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Some of the rebels have holed up in the barracks. I don't know how many, but, given this is the only way through to where the negotiations are taking place, I would expect heavy resistance. Please take caution, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}: Lord Winterscale's guards mined the entrance so that the rebels couldn't get to the shuttle."
  - After: "Rebels hold the barracks ahead. The guards mined the entrance, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Evayne Winterscale has made several diplomatic visits to Eurac V on behalf of his father, Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale. The Great Regent would not have granted entry to someone dishonourable, which means... whatever happened in this terrible, malodorous place, we must aid this man of noble blood."
  - After: "Evayne was his father's envoy to Eurac V. The Great Regent admits only honourable men. We must aid him."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia frowns in confusion.{/n} "Theobald executed his wife and only son on the mere suspicion of treason against House Orsellio. So why did the noble Evayne... rush to save someone who had betrayed his house? Do bonds of friendship give one the right to make inexcusable mistakes?"
  - After: {n}Cassia frowns.{/n} "Theobald executed his own family on suspicion of treason to House Orsellio. Why save a traitor?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I doubt that he has had many opportunities to do so. As far as we know, Evayne Winterscale seldom leaves Rykad Minoris and spends most of his time in its spires. A poor environment in which to seek glory or even get a taste of real life beyond reinforced walls." {n}Heinrix catches Abelard's look and shrugs.{/n} "We are obliged to be well informed about any individual even remotely connected to the Rogue Traders of the Expanse."
  - After: "Unlikely. Evayne rarely leaves Rykad Minoris' spires." {n}Heinrix shrugs at Abelard.{/n} "We keep informed."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira fidgets for a few seconds, hesitant to say anything, but then decides to quietly answer for you,{/n} "He's alive. We saw him at the starport when we landed on Rykad..." {n}Meeting your gaze, she shrinks and turns away.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira answers for you.{/n} "He's alive. We saw him at the starport." {n}She shrinks.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pilot nods to Idira with a weak smile.{/n} "Thank you."
  - After: {n}A weak smile.{/n} "Thank you."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Labouring biomass should have been equipped with shutdown switches. It is surprising that this procedure was not performed in a timely manner."
  - After: "Labouring biomass should have shutdown switches."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "They what? Switches? They're not machines, you can't switch them off— oh, groxshit, I get it now. A few grams of fyceline implanted at the base of the skull, is that your idea of a shutdown? You do realise those are living people, not a resource?"
  - After: "Switches? Groxshit — fyceline in the skull? They're people!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This statement is false. The primary attribute of convicted personnel on a mining station is that of a resource. Individuality is negligible."
  - After: "False. Convicts are a resource. Individuality is negligible."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She anxiously pitches forward.{/n} "Is Lord Winterscale alive? Is he... is he all right?"
  - After: {n}Anxious.{/n} "Is Lord Winterscale all right?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Reporting! There's been a prison riot on the planetoid, led by the prison warden himself. My lord Evayne Winterscale, son of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Calligos Winterscale, went to parley with him."
  - After: "Reporting! The warden leads a riot. My lord Evayne, son of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Calligos Winterscale, went to parley."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is visible relief on the pilot's face. Clicking her heels together, she cheerfully barks out,{/n} "Consider it done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Thank you for the good news!"
  - After: {n}Relieved.{/n} "Done, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Thank you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There are glimmers of panic in the pilot's gaze, but she quickly pulls herself together.{/n} "I-it will be done immediately! Thank you for letting me know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: {n}Panic, then composure.{/n} "At once, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It's a great honour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Captain Raquel Vekhari, servant of House Winterscale and the pilot of this shuttle!" {n}The woman meets your eyes, clearly trying to tell if she has managed to show proper respect to a figure of such high standing.{/n}
  - After: "An honour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Captain Raquel Vekhari, Winterscale pilot!" {n}She checks your reaction.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I came here as a shuttle pilot alongside the honourable Evayne Winterscale, son of Calligos Winterscale, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, Vanquisher of Xenos, Forever Triumphant over the Enemies of Humanity," {n}she details, enunciating every word of her overlord's title.{/n}
  - After: "I flew Evayne, son of Calligos Winterscale, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, Vanquisher of Xenos, Forever Triumphant," {n}she recites.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Young Lord Winterscale wished to speak to the warden personally. The honourable lord means to put an end to this lawless treason. He and his escort {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Jail_Early}left to meet with the insurgents{/d}, while I was ordered to await their return."
  - After: "Lord Evayne went to end the warden's treason. He {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Jail_Early}left to meet with the insurgents{/d}; I wait."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Young Lord Winterscale wished to speak to the warden personally so he could put an end to his lawless treason. He and his escort went ahead, and..." {n}She grows paler.{/n} "I haven't been able to contact them over {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} for a {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Jail_Late}very long time{/d} now."
  - After: "Lord Evayne went to confront the warden." {n}She pales.{/n} "No {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} for a {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Jail_Late}very long time{/d}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes..." {n}She bites her lip.{/n} "No one expected this. Master Casteglia is a nobleman from a respected governor house and a vassal to House Winterscale! All of a sudden, he proclaimed that Rykadi Philia was now his personal domain, that the prisoners were his subjects, and that he would never bow to anyone again... It's pure heresy!"
  - After: "Yes." {n}She bites her lip.{/n} "Casteglia, a Winterscale vassal, claimed Rykadi Philia. Heresy!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She sighs quietly.{/n} "It's a personal matter. Master Casteglia, the seditious warden, is Lord Evayne's childhood friend. When my lord heard of the riot, the news saddened him greatly and so he rushed here without delay — in hopes of bringing his old friend to his senses, no doubt."
  - After: {n}She sighs.{/n} "Casteglia is Lord Evayne's childhood friend. My lord came to reason with him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't dare delay you any further. Good luck to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I will contact Lord Evayne's party over {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} and inform them of your coming!"
  - After: "Good luck, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I'll {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} Lord Evayne's party."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/JailPlanetoid/SneakyPirates/SneakyPirates_Jail_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "Consider your request denied. Now die!"
  - After: [Attack] "Request denied. Die!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Give me a reason not to execute you on the spot."
  - After: "Why shouldn't I execute you now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me more about the warden and the riot."
  - After: "Tell me about the warden and the riot."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If I spare you, what do I gain from it?"
  - After: "What do I gain by sparing you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. I shall spare you."
  - After: "Very well. I'll spare you."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "I have changed my mind. By His name, I will not let heretical riffraff such as yourselves leave this place alive!"
  - After: [Attack] "By His name, no heretic leaves alive!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shall not leave you here to die at the hands of the warden's henchmen. Go, tell my pilot that it is the Lord Captain's order that you be sent to my ship. You will join my ship's crew. You have my personal pardon as a Rogue Trader."
  - After: "I won't leave you to die. Tell my pilot to take you to my ship. Join my crew, pardoned."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What kind of 'very serious people'?"
  - After: "What 'very serious people'?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are pirates. I came across a voidship belonging to your associates. They were planning to break you out."
  - After: "You're pirates. Your associates' ship planned to break you out."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thank the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}! Normal-looking faces! We thought we were going to die here with these nutters!" {n}The old man with a gap-toothed smile drops his weapon and holds out his hands in a placating gesture.{/n} "Please don't shoot us, Yer Nobleness! Let us speak a word!"
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} be praised, normal faces!" {n}A gap-toothed old man drops his weapon.{/n} "Don't shoot, Yer Nobleness!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Here's the deal: we're honest, quiet inmates. We didn't want to riot! But, well, sitting it out wasn't really an option either. The warden's lapdogs made short work of those who refused to join in the festivities. So we had to — you know — play along. But that's all it was — play! We never meant no offence to Governor Medineh nor to the lawful authority of House Winterscale."
  - After: "We're honest inmates! The warden's lapdogs killed anyone who wouldn't riot, so we played along. No offence to House Winterscale."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Or that's how it was at first. Then the warden decided it's the optimates, not the guards, who should be in charge of punishments. And that it wasn't the overseers' job to watch the prisoners work — it was the optimates'. Well, let me tell you: that's when these goody two-shoes really started to shine! The guards aren't even in the same league as our dear fellows, the optimates. In the old days, we had maybe five or ten stiffs kicking it a week, and now, well now we were lucky if it was only fifty."
  - After: "Then optimates took over punishments. Worse than guards! Five dead a week became fifty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And that wasn't even the end of it! Warden Casteglia moved out of his chambers to live right in the quarry, under the dome. And I think something in his new home really scrambled his brain. He began spouting the wildest things like 'the optimates are saints' who will 'behold the truth.' And he started taking them to the quarry. Not all of them returned. The ones who did, you wouldn't recognise them, more beast than man. They were butchering people left and right. Even guards. And overseers. The warden himself had armed them! And that's the whole sob story. But I knew it from the moment he let us have dinners: oh, this won't end well."
  - After: "Then Warden Casteglia moved into the quarry dome and went mad, calling optimates 'saints.' Those he took there came back as armed beasts, butchering everyone. Knew those dinners meant trouble."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hmm, hmm, now, how can lowly jailbirds hope to thank yer noble self... Ah! I have an inkling. You see, us here, we're — how should I put this — different from the rest of the prisoners in this place. They're all petty thieves from Rykad Minoris, debtors, guttersnipes. They're no one serious! Now, we, Yer Nobleness, are cut from a different cloth altogether. We're fortune seekers from the void."
  - After: "How to thank you... Ah! We're not petty thieves like the rest. We're void fortune seekers."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix tilts his head slightly to one side, listening intently.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix listens intently.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man grunts, huffs, then makes up his mind.{/n} "Well, now that's outta the bag... Our fellows were supposed to come get us a long time ago, but they got tied up somewhere, void kraken's gullet with them! And in all this time we had to wait, THIS happened... Pardon me for trying to pull the synth-wool over you, it's just that we want nothing to do with this whole warden nonsense. So what now? Will you let us go?"
  - After: {n}He huffs.{/n} "Fine. Our fellows were late, and then THIS. Sorry for lying. We want no part of it. Will you let us go?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why don't we tell you where on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall Station{/g} — you know Footfall, the only shipyard and the best market in all the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} — yes, so... where on Footfall you can find some very serious, business-minded people, and how you can get yourself a very special discount from them on some very special goods?"
  - After: "I'll tell you where on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall Station{/g}, best market in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, serious folk give special discounts."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "You're serious?" {n}Heinrix glances at you with slight disgust.{/n}
  - After: "Seriously?" {n}Heinrix is disgusted.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh, that's so great to hear, Yer Nobleness! Just great! Now there's a true aristocrat, not that warden creep! Now then, Yer Nobleness, where was I...?"
  - After: "A true aristocrat! Now, where was I...?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If you're ever on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall Station{/g}, there's this district there, the Shadow Quarters. It's called that because it's located behind the statue of our holiest {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. I've known folks who called it something else, also on account of it being behind the statue. Don't repeat their mistakes, I tell you! Reverend Hieronymus wasted no time finding and burning them all."
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall Station{/g} has the Shadow Quarters, behind the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s statue. Don't call it anything ruder — Reverend Hieronymus burns people for that."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Forgive an old man for getting distracted... So! Footfall. The Shadow Quarters. There's a bar there, built into the remains of an old ship. And in that bar, in the back room, a certain Ryzza does her business. Tell her Grandpa Bakhval says hello. You'll be her favourite client in the blink of an eye! There we are. Well, Yer Nobleness... we'll be going now if you don't mind?"
  - After: "In the Shadow Quarters, a bar in an old ship. Back room: Ryzza. Say Grandpa Bakhval sends hello. May we go?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Will do, Yer Nobleness!" {n}The old man smiles slyly and leaves.{/n}
  - After: "Will do!" {n}He leaves, smiling slyly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Uh... Thanks. We are most grateful, Yer Nobleness!" {n}The old man glances at you somewhat sceptically but then smiles and leaves.{/n}
  - After: "Uh... most grateful!" {n}Sceptical, he smiles and leaves.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix lets out a sigh of disappointment.{/n} "Old Ryzza. The most well-known fence on Footfall. I was hoping to hear a new name."
  - After: {n}Heinrix sighs.{/n} "Ryzza, Footfall's best-known fence. Nothing new."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Well, this is a welcome change — talking before shooting. Still, Lord Captain, the look of this... ragtag bunch hardly inspires trust."
  - After: "Talking first, a nice change. But this ragtag bunch inspires no trust."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira cracks her neck.{/n} "Sure, no problem. Today you tell us a little lie, tomorrow you stick a torpedo in our side from that ship of yours... if it doesn't fall apart the moment our helmsman sneezes in its general direction."
  - After: {n}Idira cracks her neck.{/n} "Today a lie, tomorrow a torpedo from that wreck of yours."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "This is unwise, Lord Captain. Most unwise..."
  - After: "Most unwise, Lord Captain..."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal enquires demurely,{/n} "Does the fact that this serf is presently confined and therefore has previously betrayed the trust of the Imperium's servants need to be vocalised? Or is it evident to the lait— persons uninitiated in the sacred mysteries of logic?"
  - After: {n}Pasqal, demurely:{/n} "Must I state that a prisoner already betrayed the Imperium's trust?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Pah, why soil yer tongue talking about that heretic? But if you insist... Here's how it is. The warden of this here prison, the honourable Master Casteglia, was a crackpot from the start. The previous warden ran things the proper way: prayer, one meal a day, work, a punch in the chompers from the guards, work again. But the new one... Do you know what his first decree was? He introduced lunches and dinners! By the Nine Devils, that's three meals a day! The man was obviously stark raving mad."
  - After: "Casteglia was a crackpot from day one. The old warden did it right: prayer, one meal, work, punches. His first decree? Three meals a day! Mad."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Give us a chance, eh? We just want to wait until everything blows over and we can go back to our cells and quietly do the rest of our time..."
  - After: "Give us a chance? We'll just finish our time quietly..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Things only went downhill from there. The guards quit it with the teeth punching — the warden forbade them. Instead, the overseers started counting which prisoners were digging up more things in the quarry or swinging their pickaxes harder or whatnot — and then, would you believe it, they put together a list of best workers! And if someone on that list also showed good behaviour, that's when they'd get promoted to an optimate. That's the upper crust among us jailbirds."
  - After: "Then the guards stopped punching. Top workers with good behaviour became optimates — jailbird upper crust."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira nods knowingly.{/n} "The old codger's right. Whenever nobles start giving handouts to commoners, something always goes wrong." {n}She notices your look and catches herself.{/n} "I mean that with all due respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, no offence intended."
  - After: {n}Idira nods.{/n} "Noble handouts always go wrong." {n}Your look.{/n} "No offence, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The most serious kind, Yer Nobleness! Have you heard about the Fellowship of the Void? It's the largest pirate alliance in the Expanse. There is no leader, of course, but there are some terribly serious captains who decided that cutting each other's throats over loot was — what do you call it — counterproductive. But cutting throats together — now that's anti-counterproductive!"
  - After: "The Fellowship of the Void, the Expanse's biggest pirate alliance! Leaderless captains who'd rather cut throats together than each other's."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And, well, their joint efforts leave them with an excess of spoils, so they need to dispose of it somehow. And I, Yer Nobleness, just happen to know someone who handles such kinds of dealings on behalf of those very serious people."
  - After: "They've spoils to sell. I know their middleman."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "A repentant, honest heretic. How novel." {n}Judging by Abelard's tone, the Seneschal is utterly unimpressed by the old man's ingratiating monologue.{/n}
  - After: "An honest heretic. How novel." {n}Abelard is unimpressed.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "The lowborn's speech is mottled with colours that conceal his true, darker hues. This old man has a long history of lies, and he is using his wiles on us as well, but... I see no foul corruption or ill intent in his words."
  - After: "A practised liar, using his wiles on us, but... I see no corruption or ill intent."

  - After: "Our affairs aren't for interlopers..." {n}He squints.{/n} "...noble or not. Nameless, you threaten the Child."
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "Defending myself before strangers... I never thought I would fall so low." {n}The old man looks at the unmoving Cassia and shakes his head in resignation.{/n} "If the Child's life were not at stake... Very well, I have no choice. Or proof of my innocence."
  - After: "Defending myself to strangers..." {n}He looks at Cassia.{/n} "For the Child, very well. I have no proof."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Felek? Did he...?" {n}Cassia's crimson eyes widen, but you cannot say whether out of fear or surprise.{/n}
  - After: "Felek? Did he...?" {n}Cassia's eyes widen.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "I can give you my word as a member of the Navis Nobilite — if the honest word of an honourable man counts for anything with you. I guarded this station against calamity and incursions from without to the best of my ability. I forced the wardens to strictly observe security protocols, I personally selected every servant... and I faithfully protected the Child during the coup."
  - After: "My word as Navis Nobilite: I guarded this station and the Child through the coup."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia raises an eyebrow in confusion.{/n} "So you are... a servant? Open your mouth, I need to make sure your tongue was chirurgeoned and you were properly branded with our House se—"
  - After: {n}Cassia frowns.{/n} "A servant? Open your mouth — is your tongue cut, and our House se—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And under whose tutelage did you learn etiquette? The Space Wolves? I am Lady {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella Orsellio. You may address me as—"
  - After: "Who taught you manners? I am Lady {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella Orsellio. Address me as—"
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "Save the Child and deliver her safely to Regent Aaronto, acting head of House Orsellio, in the Koronus Expanse. Rest assured that the reward will be worth your effort."
  - After: "Deliver the Child to Regent Aaronto, head of House Orsellio, in the Koronus Expanse. You'll be rewarded."
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "As I said already, House Orsellio ships will be here soon. We do not need your help." {n}The old man turns away to hide the uncertainty on his fish-like face.{/n}
  - After: "Our ships are coming. We don't need you." {n}He hides his doubt.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}Bushy brows furrow in displeasure.{/n} "Access to the station is no mere privilege — Evayne Winterscale broke the vow of silence he took before House Orsellio! The God-Emperor will judge him. But what about you? Who are you and why have you broken the isolation of Eurac V?"
  - After: {n}He frowns.{/n} "Evayne Winterscale broke his vow to us. Who are you, and why come?"
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}Theobald frowns.{/n} "Curse? You do not understand the sacred gift given to our Child. When the Child is sad, we all weep. When the Child smiles, we all laugh giddily. And if the Child wants blood, the world turns crimson. The Child's will is the will of the great Tisiphone, for she is the heir of House Orsellio."
  - After: {n}He frowns.{/n} "A sacred gift. When the Child weeps, we weep; if she wants blood, the world turns red. Her will is Tisiphone's."
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "Then what brings such an important personage to a station of House Orsellio, one of the greatest Houses of the Navis Nobilite? And what do you want from me? Speak."
  - After: "Why come to a station of House Orsellio? What do you want?"
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}But Theobald only shakes his head.{/n} "No, I am the Keeper of Eurac V and I will perish along with my station. On that note... I have other matters to attend to."
  - After: {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "No. I'll die with my station. Excuse me."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Where have I heard that before? That's it — Master Felek was babbling something similar... Or did I imagine that? Was it just one of the possible outcomes that I foresaw? Ahh... my head is killing me..."
  - After: "Master Felek said that... or did I foresee it? Ahh, my head..."
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}A bluish rivulet trickles down the old man's chin, and he wipes the mutated blood brusquely away with his sleeve. You glimpse strange burns covering his flesh under his clothing. Even the slightest movement must be causing him unbearable pain.{/n}
  - After: {n}He wipes away bluish blood. Hidden burns make every move agony.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}Theobald frowns again, trying to control the tremor in his hands. But despite the pain from his unseen wound, the Navigator is bearing up well.{/n}
  - After: {n}His hands tremble, but he bears his hidden wound well.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "So what are you proposing? That I hand over the Child to you, abandon her to the mercy of fate, cast her out into the darkness of the galaxy with a stranger? Alone?" {n}The Navigator's voice breaks into a shout.{/n} "No, I will not allow it!" {n}Theobald stands over Cassia's body, shielding it, and the air around him turns sweltering.{/n}
  - After: "Abandon the Child to a stranger? Alone?" {n}He shouts.{/n} "Never!" {n}He shields Cassia; the air scorches.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}The heat in the air dissipates and the old man lowers his arms wearily.{/n} "All right. Save... Save our sacred Child, Deliver her safely to Regent Aaronto, acting head of House Orsellio, in the Koronus Expanse. Rest assured that the reward will be worth your effort."
  - After: {n}The heat fades.{/n} "Very well. Deliver our Child to Regent Aaronto, head of House Orsellio, in the Koronus Expanse."
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "The last thing, then, is to deal with the traitors on the lower level. My... final battle in the service of the sacred Child." {n}Theobald looks wistfully at Cassia's insensate form.{/n} "I will revive the Child — do not be alarmed, the power of House Orsellio's heir will help us to destroy our enemies and shield the Child from Felek's forces. But you... rest for a time before the battle."
  - After: "Now, the traitors below. My last battle." {n}He gazes at Cassia.{/n} "I'll revive her. Rest first."
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "I will answer your questions — I will tell you as much as you are permitted to know."
  - After: "I'll answer what you are permitted to know."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Heresy..." {n}Argenta looks at the tall figure with a strange mixture of anger and sadness. Then she lowers her head, and her white hair veils her face.{/n}
  - After: "Heresy..." {n}Argenta bows her head sadly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You gasp for air in terror, drowning under a crashing wave of pain, you cannot catch your breath... Hot tears burn on your cheeks. Why is this happening? Why is it happening to you? Why do you feel so lonely and in so much pain? Do these feelings even belong to you?{/n}
  - After: {n}Drowning in pain, you weep. Is this loneliness yours?{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The muscles in Heinrix's jaw twitch as he struggles to maintain self-control.{/n} "'This' is one of the Navis Nobilite, the noble caste of mutants who guide Humanity's voidships through the treacherous warp. And now, Rogue Trader, stop asking stupid questions and go negotiate with your new Navigator."
  - After: {n}Heinrix's jaw twitches.{/n} "A Navis Nobilite, a mutant who guides ships through the warp. Stop asking and negotiate."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix jerks abruptly as if he intends to dash forward, but someone else is quicker.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix lunges, but someone is quicker.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "And they call me dangerous with my 'witchcraft,'" {n}Idira mutters under her breath.{/n}
  - After: "And they call me dangerous," {n}Idira mutters.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Watch out, Lord Captain. This one's so deranged it's making the whispers shriek like crazy... He might just open that eye of his..."
  - After: "Careful, Lord Captain. The whispers are shrieking. He might open that eye."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Threatening the head of the dynasty is a grave offence, esteemed... whoever you are." {n}Abelard places a hand on his weapon.{/n}
  - After: "Threatening our dynasty's head is a grave offence." {n}Abelard grips his weapon.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}With a stony expression, Kibellah wipes the single tear that has run down her cheek.{/n} "These are not my emotions. Mine have long since been cut out of my soul. Give the order, Domin'{name}. I cannot withstand this delirium for much longer."
  - After: {n}Kibellah wipes a tear.{/n} "Not my emotions. Give the order, Domin'{name}. I can't endure this."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator looks from the unconscious Cassia to Theobald.{/n} "I presume this Navis Nobilite House has reasons for treasuring the Child other than uncontrolled outbursts of warp sorcery. What might those be, I wonder? A young, immature Navigator who likely hasn't yet completed her training—"
  - After: {n}Heinrix eyes Theobald.{/n} "Surely the Child is valued for more than warp outbursts. An untrained Navigator—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As the otherworldly creature's gaze slides over you, your entire core shudders in terror. Flashes of {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}past warp nightmares{/d} reemerge from the shadows of your memory... and paralyse your will.{/n}
  - After: {n}Her gaze stirs {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}past warp nightmares{/d}, paralysing your will.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You are enveloped in despairing grief, and an invisible hand closes around your throat, cutting off your breath. Your limbs seem to fill with lead, your heart hammers in your chest, and the desire to turn and flee — from this room, from this station — almost gets the better of you. At the last moment, you master your emotions and your will pushes back against the illusion, forcing it to retreat.{/n}
  - After: {n}Grief chokes you; you almost flee. Then your will repels the illusion.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: "When it is a matter of life and death, every word matters." {n}The Navigator casts a concerned glance at Cassia, now lying in a dead faint.{/n}
  - After: "In life and death, every word matters." {n}He glances at Cassia.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta is painfully slow in reaching for her weapon, and the next moment her head drops to her chest.{/n} "I cannot... I cannot!" {n}The face of the Sister of Battle twists in anger, but her cheeks are glistening with tears.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta falters.{/n} "I cannot!" {n}She weeps.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Lady Cassia, I presume." {n}The Seneschal stares in the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g}'s direction with a faraway look, then turns sharply away and awkwardly wipes at his eye.{/n}
  - After: "Lady Cassia, I presume." {n}Abelard eyes the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Lady Navigator{/g}, then wipes his eye.{/n}
- **Theobald Orsellio**
  - Before: {n}The heavyset old man, who has been kneeling nearby, erupts into low sobs. His eyes, swollen from crying, dart desperately around the room, as though the veil of ignorance has just been ripped away from them.{/n} "The Child... Lady Cassia, where are you? Sacred Child? {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} preserve—" {n}Despite his venerable age, the Navigator leaps up and rushes to the young woman's side.{/n}
  - After: {n}An old man sobs, waking.{/n} "Sacred Child? {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} preserve—" {n}He rushes to her.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She tilts her head to one side.{/n} "Help me? I do not need help. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects. I have seen His light, which warms the soul across billions of stars and hundreds of systems. In the depths of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} and on the fringes of realspace. His light never goes out." {n}A strange tranquillity envelops you. You no longer hear the wailing, the sobs, the sighs. You are surrounded by nothing but endless emptiness, quiet, calm. And endless loneliness.{/n}
  - After: {n}She tilts her head.{/n} "I need no help. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects, even in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}." {n}Calm. Silence. Endless loneliness.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/NavisNobiliteStation/CassiaScared/CassiaScared_dialogue

  - Before: "Oh, Theobald..." {n}The crimson tears stain the Lady Navigator's white skin once again, but this time her power does not make everyone weep along with her.{/n}

- **Theobald Orsellio**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "How low can a man sink in the pursuit of power... Is your hatred of me really so strong, Felek?" {n}Cassia's ruby eyes fill with bloody tears as she looks the traitor in the face, and your heart is wracked by unbearable grief.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I... I've never..." {n}Cassia is almost whispering, but quickly regains her composure, raises her head, and enunciates calmly:{/n} "I did what ought to be done to renegades of House Orsellio. You need not worry, Rogue Trader — I have no such power over the lives of ordinary people."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The words fly off your tongue and scorch everyone around you with sparks of venomous green, but then they settle on your soul as leaden ash. You know, the more ash there is in someone's heart, the faster they lose their own humanity."
  - After: "Venomous words leave ash in your soul. Enough ash kills humanity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have no reason to lie, but you still won't believe me without proof. However, I have read the writings of Fergus-Kleon and understand your train of thought. Distrust is an innate defensive behaviour in most creatures, so I take no offence."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia frowns.{/n} "You are engulfed in an aurora of crimson, your hope for pain and battle. But my gift will not help you with that."
  - After: {n}She frowns.{/n} "Your aura craves battle. My gift won't serve that."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - Before: "And if I refuse?" {n}Cassia juts out her trembling chin and gives you a defiant look.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Navigator gives a thoughtful nod and then straightens up as if realising something important.{/n} "I recognise this coat of arms! You must be from the illustrious von Valancius dynasty? I am certain you are..."
  - After: {n}He straightens.{/n} "That crest! von Valancius, surely?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Is that so?" {n}Even wounded, Felek Orsellio remains composed.{/n} "I do not think so. You cannot force me, you can only end my life. But this is not your heart's desire, is it? Perhaps... Perhaps, we can help one another and reach a more beneficial agreement."
  - After: "Is that so?" {n}Felek stays calm.{/n} "You can kill me, not force me. Let's deal instead."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is darkness swirling in Felek Orsellio's bottomless eyes as he bares his sharp teeth in a defensive snarl.{/n} "Care to explain yourself, scion of the von Valancius dynasty? What is the meaning of this?"
  - After: {n}Felek snarls.{/n} "Explain yourself, von Valancius!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do not think this is possible. Eurac V is an observation station. We do not sign contracts and do not provide Navigators. We delve into the depths of infinity and chart the movements of the warp storms. And besides..." {n}Felek gestures at the disorder around him.{/n} "...you have chosen an inopportune time for negotiations."
  - After: "No. Eurac V charts warp storms; we provide no Navigators. And..." {n}He gestures at the ruin.{/n} "...bad timing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The blame lies with Theobald Orsellio, the second Keeper of Eurac V. The old man... was a great Navigator, but he could no longer control his powers. I begged him to retire, but he was too obsessed with our mistress, Lady Cassia. His madness and stubbornness spelled doom for the entire station, for he opened his third eye in a fit of rage and unleashed the horrors of the warp on those who displeased him. The Theobald I knew would never have used his powers in such a reckless manner. This will be difficult to explain to the uninitiated, but I am going to try."
  - After: "Blame Theobald Orsellio, the other Keeper. Obsessed with Lady Cassia and losing control, he opened his third eye in rage and unleashed the warp."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "The Lord Navigator here is speaking the unvarnished truth. I bet this station is full of voices and whispers, all trying to break through from the other side, waiting for you to reach out and swing the door open wide."
  - After: "He's right. This place is full of whispers waiting for a door to open."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "The suffocating grip of the Immaterium can be felt across the entire system. It is not surprising the veil grew thin here of all places — the Navis Nobilite can command the warp currents, but the use of their abilities wears down the barrier between the two worlds."
  - After: "The Immaterium grips this system. Navigator powers wear the veil thin."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In order to ascend to the mistress's chambers, you will need to remake a holy relic sanctified with the blood of Lady Orsellio herself. This is the control rod of the elevator {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g}. I have one part and the other was lost during the mutiny. But even this relic will be of no use unless the elevator mechanism is powered."
  - After: "To reach the mistress, remake the elevator {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirit{/g}'s control rod, blessed with Lady Orsellio's blood. Half is lost. The elevator needs power too."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have a phylactery containing the mistress's blood. It needs to be taken to the laboratory, which is located behind one of the reliquary doors. The most ancient of sacred mechanisms will help to rebuild the rod — the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} ceaselessly performed the rites of appeasement so that the machine spirit would serve the House in its time of need. The fateful hour is now upon us."
  - After: "Take her blood phylactery to the lab behind a reliquary door. Its mechanism, tended by {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g}, will rebuild the rod."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Felek gives an indifferent shrug.{/n} "That's why they are insane. Will you really heed the ramblings of retainers who dared to raise their hand against the scions of a noble bloodline?"
  - After: {n}Felek shrugs.{/n} "They're insane. Trust traitors?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The station's main {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} is situated in the guard room. Just enter the correct command sequence, and the sacred mechanism will do the rest."
  - After: "Use the main {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} in the guard room. Enter the command sequence."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I never said the feat would be easy to accomplish. The path to the laboratory and the guard room is blocked by the very same madmen who took over the station. They will not negotiate and are not afraid of displeasing the Navis Nobilite or incurring the Emperor's wrath. They bow only to brute strength, something which I currently happen to lack."
  - After: "Madmen block the lab and guard room. They yield only to force, which I lack."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So what have you decided, descendant of the von Valancius line?"
  - After: "Your decision, von Valancius?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ridiculous! I personally give out passwords to every attendant. What you mentioned when we first met has nothing to do with the access code to Eurac V. You have been misled."
  - After: "Ridiculous! I issue every password. That's not Eurac V's code. You were misled."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In this case, I shall turn a blind eye to your unceremonious invasion. But just this once." {n}There is a dangerous glint in the man's dark-shrouded eyes.{/n} "Very well, allow me to introduce myself. Before you stands Felek Christoph August, Keeper of this place. So, you did not arrive to offer support to the traitors? This is great news. Having said that, you must understand that Eurac V is a holy sanctum for House Orsellio and the path to it is only revealed to a select few. It pains me to say you are not on the guest list."
  - After: "I'll overlook your intrusion. Once." {n}His eyes glint.{/n} "I am Felek Christoph August, Keeper here. Not with the traitors? Good. But Eurac V is our sanctum; you're not invited."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As I'm sure you are aware, there were two Keepers of the Station. Your guess is absolutely correct — Theobald Orsellio, the demented old man obsessed with Lady Cassia and her power. And also the one to blame for the woes that have befallen Eurac V and our noble line."
  - After: "Two Keepers. Yes: Theobald Orsellio, demented, obsessed with Lady Cassia. He's to blame."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Felek's reply sounds curt and tired.{/n} "So be it. Hurry, the mistress's safety is all that matters. But should you fail, our arrangement is finished."
  - After: {n}Felek, curtly:{/n} "So be it. Hurry. Fail, and our deal's off."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You invade the sacred dominion of the Navis Nobilite and have the audacity to threaten me? On my own station?" {n}The air around the Keeper grows thick, and the Navigator's eye trembles menacingly.{/n} "You shall face your inglorious demise, scion of a great family. Guards!"
  - After: "You threaten me here?" {n}His eye trembles.{/n} "Die, then. Guards!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You do not understand! This is..." {n}Felek stops mid-sentence, makes a brief pause and then nods to himself.{/n} "You are correct, this may work. It certainly is possible..."
  - After: "You don't understand! This..." {n}Felek pauses, nods.{/n} "Yes, this could work."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You must be out of your mind to treat the Navis Nobilite like this! Don't even begin to hope that I will go quietly!"
  - After: "You're mad! I won't go quietly!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Our idle chatter will not save Lady Cassia. But if you need to be sure of something before you can help... So be it."
  - After: "Talk won't save Lady Cassia. But ask, if you must."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I cannot change the past and dare not hope you will ever trust me again. But I swear my words and my apology are genuine."
  - After: "I can't undo the past. But my apology is genuine."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are going to need this charm." {n}Felek hands you a precious stone without a setting. Its luminous surface remains cold to the touch no matter how long you hold it in your hand.{/n} "If you manage to press it against the monster's skin, whether by force or by guile, the baleful influence of her powers will recede. You will be able to take her and leave the station."
  - After: "Take this charm." {n}A cold stone.{/n} "Touch it to her skin to curb her power."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Felek looks exhausted, but arrogant resolve bolsters his voice.{/n} "And these technologies were made secret for a reason. I must respectfully decline your request, esteemed servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}. You have your sacraments and we have ours."
  - After: {n}Felek, proudly:{/n} "No, servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}. Our sacraments stay ours."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira suddenly cocks her head and drives her nails deep into her shoulder. Then she starts mumbling.{/n} "The crossroads! There are two paths, both stained with blood, both leading to the accursed eye. They all wear masks, so poor and flimsy, they fall at the slightest touch, one hiding a blind man, another a traitor."
  - After: {n}Idira claws her shoulder.{/n} "Two bloody paths, both to the eye. Masks hide a blind man and a traitor."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "My whisperers are giggling nastily, they will not speak, the naughty little things. They say that tearing off the masks is your concern."
  - After: "My whisperers won't say. Unmasking is your job."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This station has enough problems without your sorcery, psyker." {n}Felek waves Idira off and looks at you expectantly.{/n}
  - After: "No sorcery, psyker." {n}Felek waves her off.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira nods tiredly and glances at Felek out of the corner of her eye.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira eyes Felek.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The lowly insurgents got their hands on a weapon that suppresses my Navigator powers. Their absence makes me a living target, but this weapon is useless against you, as is the bunch of lunatics wielding it. I humbly ask you to deal with the scum huddling upstairs and hurry to adorn my mistress with the relic of our House, a sacred amulet against all evil."
  - After: "Their weapon blocks my powers, not yours. Clear them upstairs and put our House's amulet on my mistress."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A spark of concern flickers in the black pits of Felek's eyes.{/n} "You may not believe me, but Lady Cassia is capable of..." {n}The Navigator cringes, seemingly in pain, and furiously exhales,{/n} "...incredible things. Not even the traitor Theobald can easily harness her power."
  - After: {n}Felek frowns.{/n} "Lady Cassia is..." {n}He winces.{/n} "...formidable. Even Theobald can't master her."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I was lenient — this is true. And in the end I paid a steep price for it — just look at the destruction around us. The insurgents have left almost nothing of my home..." {n}The Keeper spits out the last few words with particular bitterness.{/n}
  - After: "I was lenient, and my home paid." {n}He spits bitterly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You... meddled with something that should have been left alone." {n}The Keeper folds his arms and shakes his head disapprovingly.{/n} "'The Child' is what the station's servants call Lady Cassia, for the commoners' dirty mouths must not sully her name by uttering it. You see, it is not beneficial for all servants to have their vocal organs altered. Some prove to be more useful when they are still able to speak."
  - After: "You meddled." {n}He frowns.{/n} "Servants call Lady Cassia 'the Child'; commoners may not speak her name."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Which means he did it before the report was filed! Or maybe after. Or..." {n}Felek's stern face twists in disgust.{/n} "You dare suspect me of what happened? The one who is going out of his way to preserve what little there is still left? By the God-Emperor, you will keep these slanderous accusations to yourself."
  - After: "Then he did it earlier!" {n}Felek scowls.{/n} "You suspect me? Watch your slander."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It really is time to end this." {n}Felek squares his shoulders and gestures to his guards.{/n} "I was hoping to find an ally in you, but now you are merely delaying the sorrowful end of your story. Prepare to die!"
  - After: "Enough." {n}He signals his guards.{/n} "Prepare to die!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Recent events have badly disturbed Lady Cassia's psyche, and warp entities always lust for weaker souls, especially when the veil grows thin. You too will be safe next to this charm."
  - After: "The warp preys on shaken souls. This charm protects you too."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Felek clutches the precious staff in a hand resembling a kraken's tentacle.{/n} "I may be a mutant. And yet monsters may wear many a pleasant guise — do not believe everything you see."
  - After: {n}Felek grips his staff with a tentacle hand.{/n} "Perhaps. But monsters can look pleasant."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Felek nods curtly.{/n} "You should hurry, then. We will stay here to hold the line and lick our wounds. Good luck, Rogue Trader. And may the Emperor's light be with you!"
  - After: {n}Felek nods.{/n} "Hurry. We'll hold here. Emperor's light be with you!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal excitedly reaches for a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}.{/n} "Requesting access to the object's {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypt{/g}. The Navis Nobilite use independent modifications of standard sanguinary technologies due to the uniqueness of the genetic code inherent in the lineage of each House."
  - After: {n}Pasqal grabs a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}.{/n} "Requesting {g|Encyclopedia:Cybercrypt}data-crypt{/g} access. Their blood-tech is unique."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I sincerely hope the influence of the Immaterium has not yet affected your body and your soul. With all due respect, I advise you not to remain at the station. Return to your voidship. I need to save Lady Cassia. If you are not willing to help or indeed risk your life, you must leave now."
  - After: "Return to your ship. I must save Lady Cassia; help or leave."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/NavisNobiliteStation/FinalFelec/FinalFelec_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What a coincidence. I was not going to let you go, either!"
  - After: "Funny. I wasn't letting you go either!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "A traitor? What is the meaning of this?"
  - After: "A traitor? Meaning what?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address Felek] "I held up my end of the bargain, Felek. You are my Navigator now."
  - After: [Address Felek] "Bargain kept, Felek. You're my Navigator now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is wrong, Lady Cassia? Did I not bring you to your champion?"
  - After: "What's wrong, Cassia? I brought your champion."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have signed your own death warrant!"
  - After: "You've signed your death warrant!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I beseech thee, Emperor! Shield me against this evil!"
  - After: "Emperor, shield me from this evil!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address Cassia] "Be silent, monster. Is it not you who has been tormenting your subjects all this time?"
  - After: [Address Cassia] "Quiet, monster. Didn't you torment your subjects?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader! You... came back." {n}You hear equal parts confusion and frustration in Felek's voice.{/n} "And dragged this monster along. Good."
  - After: "Rogue Trader! Back." {n}Felek seems flustered.{/n} "With the monster. Good."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Forgive me this little lie, Rogue Trader. You served the noble cause of liberating House Orsellio like no other, for which I will forever be grateful. We could have become close friends in another life."
  - After: "Forgive my lie. You freed House Orsellio. Pity we can't be friends."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Damnation! Why can't you just die already!"
  - After: "Damn you! Just die!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An oppressive force crashes down on you, almost knocking you down. The tang of metal floods your mouth, but an unbreakable will helps you to resist. Finally, the horrors spewed forth by the Navigator's third eye no longer have a hold over you.{/n}
  - After: {n}A crushing force hits you, but your will holds.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}The words get stuck in your throat and your hands refuse to obey. The hatred of Felek overwhelms your entire being. How could he? How dare he betray you? His mentor? His House? You hear a woman scream as if from afar, and the veil of other's conjoining emotions fades.{/n}
  - After: {n}Her hatred of Felek floods you, until a scream breaks it.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "You ruined my home and killed Theobald... for this? He will deceive you just like he's been deceiving my people for all these years! The mossy fog is clouding your eyes, but deep in your heart I can see the golden light of truth shining through. You know I am not lying to you."
  - After: "You killed Theobald for this? He'll deceive you too."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "My champion?" {n}Cassia laughs bitterly.{/n} "Felek Orsellio is a renegade. A traitor to our House who butchered my people... You brought me to my executioner without even realising it? How... how sad."
  - After: "Champion?" {n}She laughs bitterly.{/n} "Felek is a traitor. You brought me to my executioner."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "What are you talking about? I am Cassia Orsellio, one of the heirs of House Orsellio. I am not a monster and I will have you know that I have never tormented anyone! I... I've spent my entire life on Eurac V in the company of Felek and Theobald. And both remained in good health up to this day!" {n}Cassia nods at Felek angrily.{/n} "I do regret it now. I see the acid-green rings of deception constricting you. Felek's been lying to you... Just like he's been lying to me this entire time."
  - After: "I'm Cassia Orsellio, an heir, not a monster! I've harmed no one." {n}She glares at Felek.{/n} "He lied to you, as to me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An oppressive force crashes down on you, practically knocking you down. You feel your skin melt and your blood boil as the very air burns your lungs from the inside. Words get stuck in your throat and your hands refuse to obey, but somebody's scream brings you to your senses.{/n}
  - After: {n}A crushing force burns you, until a scream snaps you back.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia flinches at the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s words and clenches her fists. Her sharp nails dig deep into her soft skin, drawing blood. Cassia's face, however, remains dispassionate.{/n} "Traitor."
  - After: {n}Cassia clenches bleeding fists at the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}'s words.{/n} "Traitor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Almighty Emperor be praised, my beneficent mistress is safe! Wonderful, this is wonderful... The weight of the world has been lifted from my shoulders!" {n}Felek grins mockingly before turning grim.{/n} "You monster."
  - After: "Praise the Emperor, she's safe!" {n}He turns grim.{/n} "You monster."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "However, the House's reputation must not be jeopardised by your testimony. The girl is a curse on all of Orsellio. She is the legacy of Tisiphone, a beast who kept the entire House chained with fear, killing indiscriminately for any trace of dissent! I had to break the shackles of her tyranny. It is nothing personal. I am sure you understand." {n}The eye on the Navigator's forehead opens wide.{/n}
  - After: "You can't testify. She's Tisiphone's legacy, a tyrant's. I freed our House. Nothing personal." {n}His third eye opens.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Oh no no no, this is bad, this is very bad! The flimsy mask, it's gone, and the gaze behind it is aimed dead at you, Lord Captain!"
  - After: "Oh no! Unmasked, and it's staring at you, Lord Captain!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh, yes. About that..." {n}Felek Orsellio shrugs awkwardly.{/n}
  - After: "Ah. About that..." {n}Felek shrugs.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "This means that you murdered my only defender and dragged me straight into the arms of the traitor who doomed Eurac V!" {n}Cassia angrily brushes you away, barely holding back the quaver in her voice.{/n}
  - After: "You killed my defender and delivered me to the traitor!" {n}She pushes you away.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Liars like you, sir, do not deserve to call themselves friends of the dynasty." {n}Abelard reaches for his weapon.{/n} "Not that anyone has extended such an honour to you."
  - After: "Liars are no friends of the dynasty." {n}Abelard draws.{/n} "Not that you were."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The log is almost completely corrupted, but you manage to recover the latest entry:{/n} "Identity confirmed: Regent Aaronto Orsellio. Date of visit: classified. Reason for visit: classified. Date of departure: classified."
  - After: {n}One entry:{/n} "Regent Aaronto Orsellio. Details classified."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something buzzes in the cogitator's metallic gut. Several red lumens light up above the vid-screen:{/n} "Required access level: security captain or above. Current access level: senior security officer."
  - After: {n}Red lumens:{/n} "Requires security captain access. Current: senior officer."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The vid-screen flashes furiously and the control panel starts spitting out sparks that bite at your fingers. After a few minutes of desperate confrontation, the cogitator falls silent, once and for all barring you access to the classified data.{/n}
  - After: {n}The panel sparks and dies, locking the data for good.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Requesting permission to appease the weary spirits in this creation of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}." {n}Pasqal bends over the cogitator, his vox-system chanting a mantra of Mechanical Harmony as his mechadendrites carefully twist dials and push buttons on the control panel. A few minutes later the Tech-Priest reports:{/n} "It is done. Access to the archives has been granted."
  - After: "May I appease this creation of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?" {n}Pasqal works.{/n} "Done. Archives open."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogs within the sacred mechanism slowly start turning with heavy grinding and clacking. The tired machine spirits grant you access to the station control — or at least its parts that still obey the cogitator.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogs grind. You control what still obeys.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator's vid-screen goes dark as if the machine spirits had fled their mechanical casket. But your assumption is incorrect, as it fills with static just a few moments later. You can barely make out an inscription amidst the flow of rapidly changing symbols.{/n}
  - After: {n}The screen darkens, then static. An inscription flickers.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You turn a few of the remaining dials and pull the activation lever. The cracked vid-screen of the sacred engine flickers. The cogitator's insides emit creaks and groans and the {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}lumens{/g} oscillate at random. It takes a while, but eventually the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} do grant you access to the cogitator's systems.{/n}
  - After: {n}You pull the lever. {g|Encyclopedia:Lumen}Lumens{/g} flicker; the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} grant access.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You push a few buttons on the control panel, but the system rebels and keeps resetting your commands. According to the data, the compartment you are trying to open is depressurised.{/n}
  - After: {n}The system refuses. That compartment is depressurised.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You thank the machine spirits and reset the operating protocol.{/n}
  - After: {n}You thank the spirits and log off.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The vid-screen lights up with a smattering of unfamiliar green symbols and you hear a peculiar click from somewhere behind you. It appears one of the doors in the chamber has opened.{/n}
  - After: {n}Something clicks behind you. A door opened.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Report X-880 originator: classified. Date: classified.{/n} "The servants close to the Child have started butchering one another again. An order came from above to have their remains reprocessed."
  - After: {n}Report X-880, classified.{/n} "Servants near the Child are killing each other again. Reprocess the remains."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The system cannot carry out your command despite the eager compliance of the machine spirits. One thing is certain, the problem does not lie in the cogitator's mechanisms.{/n}
  - After: {n}The command fails, but not due to the cogitator.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Report X-886 originator: classified. Date: classified.{/n} "The negotiations with the Winterscales were a success. A new batch of servants will arrive in ten moons. Escort them to the laboratory at once, it is imperative that we increase the new retainers' resistance to the Child's powers."
  - After: {n}Report X-886, classified.{/n} "New Winterscale servants arrive in ten moons. Take them to the laboratory to toughen them against the Child."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's vox-systems emit a binharic trill.{/n} "The spirits of this sacred machine require special purification rituals in order to restore utilisation of the lingua more familiar to the citizens of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. Requesting access to the device."
  - After: {n}Pasqal trills.{/n} "This machine needs purifying to speak {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} tongue. Requesting access."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A shiver of static runs across the shattered vid-screen.{/n}
  - After: {n}Static ripples.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}After a brief pause, the data appears on the vid-screen:
- Felek Orsellio. Location: main hall. Status: alive.
- Theobald Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: alive.
- Calomira Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: deceased.
- Alexius Orsellio. Location: lower levels. Status: deceased.
- Rasmus-Estevan Orsellio. Location: unknown. Status: deceased.{/n}
  - After: {n}Felek Orsellio: main hall, alive.
Theobald: upper chambers, alive.
Calomira: upper chambers, dead.
Alexius: lower levels, dead.
Rasmus-Estevan: unknown, dead.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Report X-891 originator: classified. Date: classified.{/n} "Data expunged."
  - After: {n}Report X-891, classified.{/n} "Data expunged."
- **(conversation owner)**

ATTENTION! Calming procedures advised. ATTENTION! Upper chambers inaccessible. ERROR: the control rod is not present. If the rod has been misplaced, immediately contact a station Keeper or the Navis Laboratorum custodian.{/n}

Upper chambers sealed: control rod missing. Contact a Keeper or the Navis Laboratorum custodian.{/n}

  - Before: {n}A muffled howl comes from under the iron shell of the cogitator. No matter how hard you try to overpower it, the system remains inaccessible.{/n}

- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s vox-systems emit a binharic trill, and his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} start furiously lashing at the air:{/n} "I am recording blasphemy! The person found guilty of such cruelty to a noble mechanism must be sentenced to immediate destruction."
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} lash:{/n} "Blasphemy! Whoever did this must be destroyed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is a restless hum in the sacred machine's interior, but soon the required information is projected onto the vid-screen:
- Felek Orsellio. Location: main entry hall. Status: deceased.
- Theobald Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: alive.
- Calomira Orsellio. Location: upper chambers. Status: deceased.
- Alexius Orsellio. Location: lower levels. Status: deceased.
- Rasmus-Estevan Orsellio. Location: unknown. Status: deceased.{/n}

Theobald: upper chambers, alive.
Calomira: upper chambers, dead.
Alexius: lower levels, dead.
Rasmus-Estevan: unknown, dead.{/n}

ATTENTION! Calming procedures advised. ATTENTION! Upper chambers inaccessible. ERROR: the main elevator mechanism is not powered. ERROR: the control rod is not present. If the rod has been misplaced, immediately contact a station Keeper or the Navis Laboratorum custodian.{/n}

Upper chambers sealed: elevator unpowered, control rod missing. Contact a Keeper or the Navis Laboratorum custodian.{/n}
