  - Before: "In the cycles of the foreordained... there lurks a flaw... of worship..." {n}The Tech-Priest's body convulses. Pained, plaintive creaks of binharic prayers come from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}. As moments pass, the signal becomes less and less clear, as if something twisted and wrong were being added to it.{/n}
  - After: "In the cycles... a flaw... of worship..." {n}He convulses; his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} prayers grow twisted.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal studies the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s face carefully. His vox-system moans in a tragic vibrato:{/n} "Subject unidentified. This is not the blessed Amarnat. Stranger, I request your name. How do you know my mentor's motto?"
  - After: {n}Pasqal studies the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}.{/n} "Not Amarnat. Your name? How do you know my mentor's motto?"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah gives Pasqal a long look, her eyebrow raised in a silent question. Pasqal responds with an equally long silence, then creaks,{/n} "Thank you for your cooperation. Request denied. The Catechism demands that this act be performed by an authorised unit."
  - After: {n}Kibellah eyes Pasqal.{/n} "Request denied. The Catechism requires an authorised unit."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The fire of the hearth... sent forth sparks. The name... of this spark is... Abel... Haneumann."
  - After: "This spark is... Abel... Haneumann."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest looks over at Pasqal. For a brief moment, his speech becomes clear:{/n} "The echo of my call has reached you. Good. The iteration is at its end. The design is fulfilled."
  - After: {n}Briefly lucid, to Pasqal:{/n} "My call reached you. The design is fulfilled."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "What design? Why are you calling yourself by my name? Was it you who summoned me to Rykad Minoris? What for? I categorically demand an answer!" {n}Pasqal's voice rises to an intimidating howl, but the delirious Tech-Priest does not seem to understand what he is saying.{/n}
  - After: "What design? Why my name? Did you summon me to Rykad Minoris?" {n}The man doesn't understand.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is a look of gentle condescension in Abel's eyes — strange, given the circumstances.{/n} "The hubris of the mind spurs him to build monuments to himself. Do not regret, for all is predetermined by the iteration—" {n}A devastating coughing fit cuts him off, and you hear a clang of tearing metal from inside his chest.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abel looks condescending.{/n} "Hubris builds monuments. The iteration decides—" {n}He coughs; metal tears.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There are deep burns all over his flesh, and the skin around his {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g} is charred. Blasphemous spells have been carved into his sacred iron, forming unholy litanies of scrap-code. It is amazing how robust this Tech-Priest's life support systems have proven to be in maintaining the spark of life in his grievously wounded body.{/n}
  - After: {n}Burns, charred {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g}, scrap-code carved in his iron. Yet he lives.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "An intention both bold and honourable — to open new gates for the waters of Knowledge and Comprehension. A plan written so that the righteous may follow..."
  - After: "To open new gates for Knowledge. A plan for the righteous to follow..."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The subject has not been identified and has no record in my catalogue. Interrogation is impossible due to the subject's evident affective state of clouded consciousness."
  - After: "Unknown subject. Too delirious to interrogate."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A blast of the Motive Force runs down the Tech-Priest's body, and his face contorts in a mocking grimace. Malformed binharic code, repulsively jarring on the ears, pours out of his vox.{/n}
  - After: {n}Motive Force jolts him; malformed binharic pours from his vox.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Information archived to the effect that the circuit restoration hymn is the entrance password to the Electro-Priests' hiding-place." {n}Pasqal responds with the dour rhythms of a containment aria.{/n} "I note with great sorrow that the cultists' ritual has been partially successful. My tech-brother has been tainted by corruption. He is in the grip of a schismatical, an unholy imitation of a machine spirit. I request immediate activation of the techsorcism protocol."
  - After: "The circuit restoration hymn opens the Electro-Priests' hiding-place." {n}A dour aria.{/n} "The ritual partly worked: my tech-brother holds a schismatical, an unholy false machine spirit. I request techsorcism."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Request denied. If we are not granting him salvation, let us at least grant him a merciful deactivation."
  - After: "Denied. If not salvation, then merciful deactivation."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As mangled as it is, the Tech-Priest's body still clings to life. It takes several blows to end his corruption-tainted existence. But even after that, a repulsive giggle is heard over the static from his vox.{/n}
  - After: {n}Several blows. Still, his vox giggles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The possessed man responds with a burst of repulsive laughter. Every now and then, a word or two of Gothic finds its way into the binharic obscenities pouring out of his vox, in what seem to be the schismatical's tentative forays into a language that is alien to it.{/n}
  - After: {n}He laughs; stray Gothic words slip into his binharic filth.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} touches the dead man's head carefully, grips his neural augmetic in its claw, and extracts it from its socket with the utmost care. The skull bone cracks dryly, and brain matter taints the sacred metal.{/n} "Rest in purity, tech-brother. The Knowledge you have attained through your efforts will be preserved and purified."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} extracts the dead man's neural augmetic.{/n} "Rest in purity, brother. Your Knowledge will be preserved."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrite extends a thin drilling needle. Sacred unguent glistens on it. A code purification aria is heard as the needle sinks into the possessed Tech-Priest's skull and touches his neural augmetic, forming an electric circuit with it. Extreme strain is visible on his face. Furious litanies pour out of his vox.{/n} "Result: failure. Requesting assistance."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's needle pierces the skull. Furious litanies blare.{/n} "Failure. Requesting assistance."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Undaunted, you grab one of the severed cables and press it into the Tech-Priest's body, and a shock of formidable power shakes the possessed man. Machine oil gushes out of his mouth. His vox hisses deafeningly as the flow of the Motive Force burns the corruption in his sacred iron. The overload destroys some of the circuit boards of his neural augmetic, resets his code, and erases the schismatical from existence.{/n}
  - After: {n}You jam a severed cable into him. Oil gushes from his mouth as the Motive Force burns out the schismatical.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Undaunted, you grab one of the severed cables and press it into the Tech-Priest's body. A shock of formidable power stuns you, the possessed man, and Pasqal. The schismatical's mocking voice grows louder and more malicious. The augmetics under the Tech-Priest's skin become so hot they burn right through it, and blasphemous symbols appear upon his pale flesh.{/n}
  - After: {n}You jam a cable into him. The shock stuns all three; blasphemous symbols burn through his skin.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sacred words cause the possessed man to convulse, but the strength of your faith prevails over the unholy spirit's power. Boiling machine oil streams down from the Tech-Priest's ears and his breathing mask. Word after word, you push the abomination out of his innocent flesh and back into the warp's oblivion.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your faith prevails, driving the abomination back into the warp.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The possessed man's vox takes to echoing back the words you say, but distorting their sound in foul mockery. The synthetic muscles tense up, arching the body. You could swear you hear the unfortunate man's stretched tendons snap with a quiet, revolting screech.{/n}
  - After: {n}His vox mocks your words. His body arches; tendons snap.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "An ugly mockery of a noble machine spirit, created by the warp. Sometimes a few lines of despicable scrap-code or a small clump of the Motive Force falls under the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s influence and degenerates into an abomination of this sort: one whose very existence is an insult to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s wisdom."
  - After: "A warp-born mockery of a machine spirit, corrupted by the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}, an insult to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}With a jerk, the drill leaves the possessed man's skull. Pasqal's vox says, in a gloomy, hoarse voice interspersed with static,{/n} "There is no hope. We have done our best. Initiating merciful deactivation protocol."
  - After: {n}Pasqal withdraws the drill.{/n} "No hope. Initiating merciful deactivation."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest's eyes roll up, and he loses consciousness: crushed, yet still alive and no longer in the thrall of corruption. With the utmost care, Pasqal takes his body down from the mechanism and lays it on the floor. His stirring litanies of gratitude to the Omnissiah echo through the hall.{/n}
  - After: {n}He passes out, alive and pure. Pasqal lays him down.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As soon as you touch the Tech-Priest's battered flesh, he shifts his gaze to you and says, with sudden clarity,{/n} "Many sparks have gone out... but not all. The electric shepherds are alive. In the darkness... I heard their prayers. Find them. Save them. Recite the hymn... of contact circuit restoration, so that you may behold... what is hidden."
  - After: {n}At your touch, he speaks clearly:{/n} "The electric shepherds live. Save them. Recite the hymn of contact circuit restoration."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "We are the flame of Knowledge that drives the darkness away." {n}Pasqal is quickly inspecting Abel's wounds, paying no mind to the blood and sacred unguents staining his sleeves. His vox rasps soothingly,{/n} "Do not fear what is to come, brother. We are already here."
  - After: "We are the flame of Knowledge that drives the darkness away." {n}Pasqal checks Abel's wounds.{/n} "Fear not, brother."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "...and trust in the great pattern of revelation and uniform progression toward it." {n}Pasqal's voice is trembling with... elation?{/n} "Those are his words. I have not heard them in so very long."
  - After: "...and trust in the great pattern." {n}Pasqal sounds elated.{/n} "His words. At last."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Eschatos. This word does not appear in my catalogue. But I am aware of its existence. Perhaps it sounded in the blessed Amarnat's sermons. I must consult my notes."
  - After: "Eschatos. Uncatalogued, yet familiar. Perhaps from Amarnat's sermons."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Existence... has worn thin and threadbare. Eschatos... has discontinued the Cycle."
  - After: "Eschatos... has discontinued the Cycle."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Rest, tech-brother. We will come back for you when we have done our duty to the Miraculous Fusion Reactor."
  - After: "Rest, brother. We'll return after the Miraculous Fusion Reactor."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, the Omnissiah commands a pious mind to strive toward uncovering the truth. Therefore I will not stop until I find my mentor and understand his connection to this servant of the Machine God. I request the privilege of joining your retinue as a rightful companion. I can offer to fulfil the duties of an {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g} on your ship in exchange for the right to follow you and conduct my own investigation."
  - After: "Lord Captain, I must find my mentor and his link to this man. Let me join you; I'll serve as your {g|Encyclopedia:Enginseer}Enginseer{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His body convulses. His joints twist at unnatural angles with the sound of bursting steel couplings. As the possessed man thrashes about, his internal augmetics emerge gradually through the hanging tatters of his flesh, as though an iron homunculus hidden inside the Tech-Priest were trying to cast off the meat cocoon it no longer needed.{/n}
  - After: {n}His joints twist; augmetics burst through his flesh.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A cold premonition... rakes the heart... The probabilities are dark and frightening... Brother, I do not wish to gaze into them."
  - After: "A cold premonition... Brother, I won't look."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No." {n}The Tech-Priest's weak voice grows stronger.{/n} "He came because of himself."
  - After: "No." {n}His voice strengthens.{/n} "He came because of himself."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Myself? To redeem myself... To correct a mistake... Possibly. But how do you...?"
  - After: "To redeem myself? Perhaps. But how do you...?"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/Divers1/ArcheotechReactor_Diversion1_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Use your officer's voice] "In the name and for the glory of the God-Emperor, heed my command!"
  - After: [Use your officer's voice] "For the God-Emperor, obey!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the servitor menacingly] "Your function is to serve. And I command you to serve!"
  - After: [Address the servitor menacingly] "You exist to serve. Serve!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Carve your name into the servitor's pale flesh]
  - After: [Carve your name into the servitor]
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A heavy crown of golden neural augmetics rests upon the {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitor{/g}'s head. The crown is bent and broken from ruthless gun-butt blows. The pale body is covered in blasphemous inscriptions carved into the withered flesh.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitor{/g}'s augmetic crown is battered; blasphemies scar its flesh.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I identify this acolyte as a distribution servitor. I am registering upon it traces of sacrilegious violation of the Rite of Operation. The probability of its responsiveness to commands is below average."
  - After: "A violated distribution servitor. Unlikely to respond."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A shower of sparks bursts from the mechanism upon the servitor's head, and black, ash-tinted tears make tracks down its pale cheeks. A weak whisper comes from the servitor's lips.{/n} "Ready... to perform... my function... Glory... to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}..."
  - After: {n}Sparks; ashy tears.{/n} "Ready... Glory... to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The human machine is unheedful of your order.{/n}
  - After: {n}It ignores you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A shower of sparks bursts from the augmetics on the servitor's brow, and several black, ash-tinted tears run from its empty eye sockets.{/n} "Ready... to serve..."
  - After: {n}Sparks; ashy tears.{/n} "Ready... to serve..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The rite of ceremonial restarting fails to awaken the insensate servitor. The augmetics on its brow spark weakly.{/n}
  - After: {n}The restart rite fails.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The servitor observes your act of petty sacrilege with complete indifference.{/n}
  - After: {n}It doesn't react.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal clicks the claws of his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} in disapproval.{/n} "Do not be disrespectful to the ancient machine spirit this acolyte serves."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} clicks.{/n} "Respect the machine spirit it serves."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A powerful discharge comes from the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g} of the servitor you have disturbed. Its entire body convulses. The mouth opens to let out a horrible guttural howl of pain. The heretics around you shriek as they notice you, but their surprise quickly gives way to anger.{/n}
  - After: {n}Its {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetics{/g} discharge; it howls. The heretics spot you, furious.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Energise the hall's power units to the maximum."
  - After: "Power the hall's units to maximum."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "For the glory of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}, let this machine spirit sleep, that it may awaken and serve again." {n}Pasqal gently touches the servitor's crown, deactivating one of its segments.{/n} "Let the outer neural connection circuit be plunged in darkness." {n}Another touch, and several lights on the crown go out.{/n} "Let the command response hub fall silent."
  - After: "For the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}, sleep, to wake and serve." {n}Pasqal touches the crown.{/n} "Darken the neural circuit." {n}Lights fade.{/n} "Silence the hub."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal switches to binharic speech, accompanying his every action with a line from a sacred hymn. It is amazing how the reverent awe in the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s voice can be discerned even through his rattling {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}. Suddenly every light on the servitor's crown comes alive.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} chants binharic through his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}. The crown lights up.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/Divers2/ArcheotechReactor_Diversion2_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Pasqal, kindly sit down on the throne and recite the litany."
  - After: "Pasqal, sit on the throne and recite the litany."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Sit down upon the throne and recite the Litany of Actuation] "I am about to be greatly honoured, or else thoroughly charred. Maybe both."
  - After: [Sit upon the throne and recite the Litany of Actuation] "Honoured or charred. Maybe both."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pasqal, saving the relic and your mentor justifies a minor infraction of the rules!"
  - After: "Pasqal, saving the relic and your mentor justifies bending the rules!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Advance menacingly toward Pasqal] "Are you disobeying a direct order? I have blown out Guardsmen's brains for less!"
  - After: [Advance menacingly toward Pasqal] "Disobeying an order? I've shot Guardsmen for less!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s corpse, his throat slit, sits upon a splendid command throne laced with finely wrought Motive Force paths. A contorted expression of righteous anger is frozen on his face. A black blindfold covers his eyes.{/n}
  - After: {n}A blindfolded {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} sits dead on the throne, throat slit.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This is the lumenodeacon's command throne. This is where the power unit actuation and shutdown litanies are recited from. The blessed lumenodeacon himself has the honour of closing the circuit the Motive Force flows through."
  - After: "The lumenodeacon's throne. His litanies here start and stop the power units."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As soon as you lay your hands on the command throne's panels, a painful sting of electricity numbs your senses for an instant. Your fingers cramp and your vision grows dim.{/n}
  - After: {n}The panels shock you; your vision dims.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Clinging on to the blazing shreds of your fading consciousness, you repeat the words of the litany after Pasqal and touch the command runes, as the unabating lightning rips through your muscles and makes your bones crackle.{/n}
  - After: {n}Through searing lightning, you repeat the litany and touch the runes.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You try to repeat the words of the litany after Pasqal, but you cannot control your tongue, and the convulsions that wrack your body prevent your fingers from touching the right command runes. Before oblivion has engulfed you completely, you manage to get up from the throne and just barely keep your unsteady footing.{/n}
  - After: {n}Convulsing, you miss the runes and stagger off the throne.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal casts a scrutinising glance at you, then nods reluctantly.{/n} "Situation deemed an emergency. I request the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s forgiveness for the transgression about to be committed." {n}The Tech-Priest's body winces from the Motive Force discharge, but his vox begins to recite the sacred words of the litany as his fingers activate the command runes with precise, unhurried movements.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal nods reluctantly.{/n} "An emergency. {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}, forgive me." {n}Wincing, he recites and works the runes.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's vox screeches resolutely,{/n} "To violate the Rite is to trample upon the faith."
  - After: {n}Pasqal screeches:{/n} "To violate the Rite is to trample the faith."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pain is visible in the Tech-Priest's eyes as he looks upon the sacrilege.{/n} "Forgive us, Omnissiah, for such a gross violation of the Rite of Operation. Repeat the litany after me and activate the command runes I point to." {n}Pasqal's vox starts reciting the sacred words, gloomily and hoarsely.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal looks pained.{/n} "Forgive us, Omnissiah. Repeat after me and press the runes I show." {n}He recites.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Someone in the crowd of heretics shouts a warning. Your tampering with the throne must have been noticed.{/n}
  - After: {n}A heretic shouts. You're spotted.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal freezes, and a quiet whisper comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "Request denied. I am not authorised to sit upon the lumenodeacon's command throne. Such an act would be considered a sacrilege."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} whispers:{/n} "Denied. That throne is not mine. Sacrilege."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I am recording a successful activation of the power units."
  - After: "Power units activated."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/Divers3/ArcheotechReactor_Diversion3_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Stealthily sabotage the machine] "There was a young Navy officer on my old bridge who once disabled a whole relay grid this way..."
  - After: [Stealthily sabotage the machine] "A young Navy officer once disabled a relay grid like this..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Forgive us, honoured machine spirit. We are obliged to interrupt your work."
  - After: "Forgive us, machine spirit. We must interrupt your work."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The altar is adorned with gilded skulls. Threads of metal that used to be electoos are fused onto the bone. Once majestic, the altar has now been desecrated with blasphemous images of blue-green suns. Some of its levers and buttons have been pried from their sockets, but the mechanism still glorifies the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} with its operation.{/n}
  - After: {n}A desecrated skull altar still works for the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I identify this as the safety system control altar. For our diversion to succeed, this blessed machine must be executed — and may its {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}spirit{/g} forgive us."
  - After: "The safety control altar. For our diversion, it must be executed. May its {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}spirit{/g} forgive us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal offers a short binharic prayer, then enters command after command to set up a trap for the machine spirit inhabiting the altar. The code born out of the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s tinkering causes the spirit to flutter confusedly in a snare of impossible commands, heat up the altar's circuit boards, and perish forever in the showers of sparks that burst forth from the melting wires.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} snares the spirit in impossible commands; the altar dies in sparks.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal offers a short binharic prayer, then enters command after command to set up a trap for the machine spirit inhabiting the altar. But the Omnissiah refuses to give His blessing for the killing of His angel, and the Tech-Priest fails to beguile the keen servant of the Machine God.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal's code trap fails; the spirit isn't fooled.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Using a pried-out switch as a lever, you move the altar's platework aside and rip out a bundle of wires from inside it with one brutal jerk. The maimed machine cannot survive such a desecration.{/n}
  - After: {n}You lever off a plate and rip out its wires. The machine dies.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As soon as you touch the altar's inner wirework, the stern machine spirit sends a powerful electric discharge into your fingers. The spirit will have none of this blasphemous violation of the Rite of Operation.{/n}
  - After: {n}The machine spirit shocks your fingers, refusing your violation.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An alarmed cry is heard from the crowd of heretics. It looks like your tampering with the altar has caught the attention of someone too keen-eyed to be fooled by your disguise.{/n}
  - After: {n}A heretic cries out. Someone saw through your disguise.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}A mournful binharic requiem pours forth from Pasqal's vox.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal's vox plays a mournful requiem.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "May we be granted the Omnissiah's forgiveness for this act. I am registering a general shutdown of the security system."
  - After: "Omnissiah, forgive us. Security system shut down."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As would any veteran {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}officer of the Imperial Navy{/d}, you discover a fatal vulnerability in the machine's design — exposed connectors under a thin metal plate. You slide your dagger into the crack and cause a short circuit that halts the flow of the Motive Force.{/n}
  - After: {n}Like any {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}officer of the Imperial Navy{/d}, you short exposed connectors with your dagger.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/HeinrixFirstMeet/Heinrix_FirstMeet_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Pay no attention. She talks all kinds of nonsense."
  - After: "Ignore her. She talks nonsense."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Kneel and repent of your heresy before a Rogue Trader, filthy sorcerer, and I might spare your life."
  - After: "Kneel and repent before a Rogue Trader, sorcerer, and I may spare you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Seneschal, isn't this the chap we're supposed to find for the Lord Inquisitor?"
  - After: "Seneschal, isn't this the Lord Inquisitor's man?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I see you take no end of pleasure in your job. I've barely introduced myself and I'm already being grilled."
  - After: "I've barely introduced myself and I'm being grilled."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Theodora is dead. Slain in battle by enemies of Humanity."
  - After: "Theodora is dead, slain by enemies of Humanity."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Can this conversation wait for a better time? I'm here on the Lord Inquisitor's orders, to see to his acolyte's safe and timely arrival on Footfall."
  - After: "Can this wait? The Lord Inquisitor ordered me to get his acolyte to Footfall."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am here to collect you. I am under orders from the Lord Inquisitor to offer any assistance you may require, after which I am to provide you safe passage to Footfall aboard my ship."
  - After: "The Lord Inquisitor ordered me to assist you, then ship you to Footfall."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This wretched planet's troubles are none of my concern. I'm taking you to the ship. Now."
  - After: "This planet isn't my concern. We go to the ship. Now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Precisely what were you doing at the monastery?"
  - After: "What were you doing at the monastery?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Idira's predictions are seldom wrong. I will be watching you."
  - After: "Idira is seldom wrong. I'll watch you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Idira is a member of my personal retinue and is under my protection."
  - After: "Idira is in my retinue, under my protection."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Von Valancius... To the best of my knowledge, that dynasty is headed by the esteemed Theodora von Valancius. Has there been a change of circumstances?" {n}Heinrix watches your expression closely.{/n}
  - After: "Von Valancius? Isn't Theodora the head?" {n}He watches.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I convinced him to cooperate." {n}Heinrix bows his head, cracks his neck, and grimaces.{/n} "I can influence living bodies. And I find that the interrogated are much more eager to share information once the blood starts to boil in their veins."
  - After: "I convinced him." {n}He cracks his neck.{/n} "I influence bodies. Boiling blood loosens tongues."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The tall, dark-haired man sizes you up with a quick glance; a supernatural chill is making the air around him crackle softly. The expensive fabric of his jacket is stitched with gold thread and marked by several reddish brown stains. A force sword and a {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} hang from his belt, and the emblem of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Holy Inquisition{/g} glitters on his chest.{/n}
  - After: {n}A tall, chill-wreathed, bloodstained man, {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} at his belt, the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Holy Inquisition{/g}'s emblem on his chest.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes." {n}The man turns away slightly to clear his throat. The room starts to get noticeably warmer.{/n} "Since you know who I am and are in no hurry to kill me, I infer that you serve the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, not His enemies. Allow me to introduce myself — Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the Imperial Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos. With whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?"
  - After: "Yes." {n}The room warms.{/n} "So you serve the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. Interrogator Heinrix van Calox, Ordo Xenos. You?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And in this, we must be like {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Him{/g}." {n}The man nods to you.{/n} "My greetings to you, fellow servant of the Master of Mankind. I am Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the Imperial Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos. With whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?"
  - After: "As must we, like {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Him{/g}." {n}He nods.{/n} "Interrogator Heinrix van Calox, Ordo Xenos. You?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Hm! I dare say it is, Lord Captain. Now if it were possible for the gentleman to properly introduce himself and dispel our doubts—"
  - After: "I believe so, Lord Captain. If he'd introduce himself—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man looks over at Abelard and then at you again.{/n} "'Seneschal'? 'Lord Captain'? Do I have the pleasure of speaking to a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}? Allow me to introduce myself — Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Imperial{/g} Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos. I must confess I'm perplexed to meet someone of your standing in a place like this."
  - After: {n}He glances at Abelard.{/n} "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}? Interrogator Heinrix van Calox, {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Imperial{/g} Inquisition, Ordo Xenos. Odd place to meet."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man smiles acerbically out of the corner of his mouth.{/n} "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}... With all due respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, my right to sorcerous powers was bestowed upon me by a greater power than yours. Allow me to introduce myself — Interrogator Heinrix van Calox of the Imperial Inquisition's esteemed Ordo Xenos, member of the High Lord Inquisitor's circle and, by His Lordship's grace, sanctioned {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} in the service of the Imperium. If this suffices as introduction, permit me respectfully to enquire, what manner of circumstance has brought a Rogue Trader to this monastery, currently overrun by heretics?"
  - After: {n}He smirks.{/n} "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}... Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, a greater power sanctioned me. Interrogator Heinrix van Calox, Ordo Xenos, {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g}. Why are you here?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "D-don't you inquisition me! I'm under the Rogue Trader's protection!" {n}Idira looks at you pleadingly.{/n}
  - After: "D-don't inquisition me! The Rogue Trader protects me!" {n}Idira pleads.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix's eyes narrow.{/n} "Your name rings a bell... You're one of the heirs to Rogue Trader Theodora von Valancius, isn't that right?"
  - After: {n}His eyes narrow.{/n} "An heir of Theodora von Valancius?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix pulls back and looks away with visible effort.{/n} "I do admit courteous small talk is not my strong suit. What brings you to the Sanctum of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?"
  - After: {n}He looks away.{/n} "I'm poor at small talk. Why are you at the Sanctum of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The news is lamentable... My condolences. And I presume the heir to the sacred Warrant of Trade and the lofty title of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} is none other than yourself. Well then... what precisely has brought you to the Sanctum of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?"
  - After: "My condolences, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}. Why are you at the Sanctum of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix ruminates silently on what you have told him. Then he makes a "hmm" of satisfaction and says,{/n} "Then the timing of our meeting is fortuitous. I am requisitioning you and your retinue for my task."
  - After: {n}He hums, satisfied.{/n} "Fortuitous. I'm requisitioning you and your retinue."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I came to Rykad Minoris on a mission, which a rebellion prevented me from fulfilling. The governor is convinced that malcontents from among the rabble were the instigators, but I immediately suspected a more sinister presence at the root of the mutiny. My visit to the monastery and a few unhurried conversations with some of the rebels—" {n}Heinrix glances at the dead body at his feet.{/n} "—confirmed my suspicions."
  - After: "A rebellion halted my mission. The governor blames the rabble; I didn't. The rebels—" {n}He eyes the corpse.{/n} "—confirmed it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Someone by the name of Aurora is leading the rebellion. Data indicates that the head of the cultists is here right now, in the sanctum of the ancient reactor. Given the prophecy of the Final Dawn and the especial efforts made by the enemies of Humanity to seize the monastery, their goal is to gain access to the holy power source's control circuit and trigger a process that, once started, cannot be stopped. In other words, to detonate the reactor, thus being themselves the cause of their much-touted 'final dawn.'"
  - After: "Aurora leads the rebellion; the cult's head is in the reactor sanctum. Per their Final Dawn prophecy, they'll detonate the reactor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Perhaps I haven't made myself sufficiently clear..." {n}Heinrix leans forward a little and looks you dead in the eye.{/n} "In the Lord Inquisitor's absence, it is I who embody the will of the Holy Ordos. The Inquisition is fully intent on thwarting the vile prophecy that threatens doom for an entire planet. And I am not leaving the Rykad System until any such threat is removed."
  - After: "Here, I am the Ordos' will." {n}He stares.{/n} " I stay in the Rykad System until this doom is stopped."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator rests his intent gaze on Idira for another moment before shifting it to you.{/n} "Your retinue, you say? Then let's go back to my previous question. With whom do I have the honour of speaking?"
  - After: {n}He turns to you.{/n} "Your retinue? Then who are you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator rests his intent gaze on Idira for another moment before shifting it to you.{/n} "I'm afraid paying attention to such things is my express duty. But let's leave that aside for now and return to the issue at hand. With whom do I have the honour of speaking?"
  - After: {n}He turns to you.{/n} "Noticing is my duty. Who are you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator chuckles.{/n} "And I will be watching you. Now that we have declared our intent, let me ask again: who are you?"
  - After: {n}He chuckles.{/n} "And I you. Who are you?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Requisitioning!" {n}Abelard is left speechless for a moment.{/n} "Young man, your choice of words is unseemly to the point of insult — you are addressing a Rogue Trader!"
  - After: "Requisitioning!" {n}Abelard sputters.{/n} "Young man, you address a Rogue Trader!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix casts an apprehensive glance at Abelard.{/n} "I don't imagine you'll be any happier if I say 'taking into Inquisitorial custody.'"
  - After: {n}Heinrix eyes Abelard.{/n} "'Inquisitorial custody' won't please you more."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "To aid His faithful servant in the fight against corruption is the solemn duty of all whose actions affect millions of the Imperium's subjects. 'Let your example guide those who will carry the Emperor's light across a thousand stars.'"
  - After: "Aid him. 'Let your example guide those who will carry the Emperor's light across a thousand stars.'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are familiar with the works of Inquisitor Alastar the Redeemer? Not every acolyte can say the same, let alone... people less initiated." {n}Heinrix arches an eyebrow, examining the coat of arms on Cassia's clothes.{/n} "Please forgive my lapse in manners, Lady Navigator Orsellio. It is a great honour."
  - After: "You know Alastar the Redeemer?" {n}He notes Cassia's crest.{/n} "Lady Navigator Orsellio. An honour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As Heinrix van Calox speaks, you suddenly notice the way he is looking at you — with his eyes slightly narrowed, as if he is peering into your soul... a soul that is touched by the gift of sorcery. The change in your expression does not escape the Interrogator's notice, and you see the corner of his mouth twitch. He must have instantly recognised a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}fellow psyker{/d}.{/n}
  - After: {n}He peers into your soul; his mouth twitches: a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}fellow psyker{/d}.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You try to focus on the man in front of you, but you cannot shake the image of the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}deadly torture{/d} he inflicted on his victim. Your pulse quickens, blood pounding in your ears and sweat beading on your skin.{/n}
  - After: {n}His {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}deadly torture{/d} haunts you. Your pulse pounds.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Starting with her." {n}Heinrix nods at Kibellah.{/n} "You have provided exactly the kind of specialist that this situation requires."
  - After: "Her first." {n}He nods at Kibellah.{/n} "Just the specialist I need."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I arrived here with an escort squad, only to lose it in our very first open skirmish; the monastery is swarming with heretics. The soldiers I requisitioned from the governor fell in battle, bled to death, or deserted. I had to make do with catching and forcefully interrogating individual rebels. It is from them that I learned what I relayed to you just now."
  - After: "I lost my escort and the governor's soldiers. So I interrogated rebels myself."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah regards him coldly.{/n} "I am the Domin's shadow. If {mf|he|she} says the word, I will protect you. If {mf|he|she} says the word, I will take you to the Undying One."
  - After: {n}Kibellah, coldly:{/n} "I am the Domin's shadow. If {mf|he|she} says so, I protect you. If {mf|he|she} says so, you meet the Undying One."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira recoils from the Interrogator as if scalded, and starts swaying to and fro.{/n} "Sh-shadow! A great big sun-eclipsing chain-weaving shadow! I can see the threads, myriads of them extending toward us all, and all of them creeping off toward him like snakes, shrouding us in poison. My oh my, do I sense trouble, and it's right in my throat! It itches!" {n}A puff of black smoke comes out of the {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g}'s mouth and dissipates at once.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira recoils.{/n} "Sh-shadow! Poison threads creep toward him! It itches in my throat!" {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} coughs smoke.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thank you. Regrettably, the governor's people showed themselves to be unprepared for the perils of this place." {n}The Interrogator glances at the limp body clad in the colours of the governor's wardens, and sighs briefly.{/n} "And extracting blade shards from a person's stomach is beyond my powers. I hope that a Rogue Trader's retinue will prove more capable than a group of soldiers fresh off the base."
  - After: "Thanks." {n}He eyes a dead warden.{/n} "The governor's men weren't ready. I hope yours fare better."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Blasphemous insanity." {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s visor flashes and turns a bloody scarlet. A soft hum of some activating systems is heard from under his robe.{/n}
  - After: "Blasphemous insanity." {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s visor turns scarlet.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix eyes Idira keenly.{/n} "A psyker. Interesting. And a diviner, at that. Even more interesting. Are you sanctioned?"
  - After: {n}Heinrix eyes Idira.{/n} "A diviner psyker. Sanctioned?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He casts a repulsed glance at the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}heretical garb{/d} you are wearing and comments softly,{/n} "I would also advise against this type of disguise. Haven't you ever heard the adage 'the mask becomes the face'?"
  - After: {n}He eyes your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}heretical garb{/d}.{/n} "'The mask becomes the face.'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator takes a gloomy look at the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}heretics' tatters{/d} you are wearing and says, with clear reluctance,{/n} "I suppose I must put on a disguise or else I will stick out like a sore thumb. Luckily, I have— I had... a prisoner."
  - After: {n}He eyes your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CultistClothes}heretics' tatters{/d}.{/n} "I need a disguise too. I have— had... a prisoner."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/Paranoid/ArcheotechReactor_Paranoid_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Lean uncomfortably close to the cultist] "Are you sure you want to remember my face? Curious people like you rarely live long. And their short lives are often very sad."
  - After: [Lean uncomfortably close to the cultist] "Want to remember my face? Curious people die young, and sadly."

  - Before: [Smile mysteriously] "Perhaps the Master has blinded your eyes to trifles so that you may behold what is true?"
  - After: [Smile mysteriously] "Perhaps the Master blinded you to trifles so you may see the truth?"

  - Before: [Flash a menacing gaze] "I don't know you either, you know. What's with all the questions? Are you the governor's spy?"
  - After: [Flash a menacing gaze] "I don't know you either. Why the questions? Governor's spy?"

  - Before: [Throw up your hands sheepishly] "I'm new. Was sent here to slaughter unbelievers, and I've only just finished."
  - After: [Throw up your hands sheepishly] "I'm new. Sent to slaughter unbelievers; just finished."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Slap the impudent man] "Who am I? I am the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius!"
  - After: [Slap the impudent man] "I am the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Bash the cultist's brains out] "You are so observant. Here is your prize."
  - After: [Bash the cultist's brains out] "So observant. Here's your prize."

  - Before: "Enough beating about the bush. I know a filthy dog of the governor when I see one, no matter what rags they wear. To battle, brothers and sisters! For Aurora and the Final Dawn!"
  - After: "Governor's dogs! For Aurora and the Final Dawn!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Stunned by your response, Idira bursts out giggling — more out of surprise than mirth.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira giggles.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix lets out a quiet groan of frustration.{/n} "We sullied ourselves with these rags for nothing..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix groans.{/n} "These rags, for nothing..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your reply, imbued with mystical significance, was evidently to the cultist's liking. He smiles haughtily and says,{/n} "May our Master blind you too, {mf|broth|sist}er."
  - After: {n}He smiles.{/n} "May the Master blind you too, {mf|broth|sist}er."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The heretic continues glaring at you with suspicion.{/n} "What kind of nonsense is that?"
  - After: {n}He glares.{/n} "What nonsense?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cultist is taken aback, and staggers backward a little. Fear flashes in his mutated eyes.{/n} "Ah, to the abyss with you! Go on your merry way, {mf|broth|sist}er."
  - After: {n}He flinches.{/n} "To the abyss with you! Go, {mf|broth|sist}er."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A spy? Me? Everyone saw me killing the false believers. But where were you while I was doing that?"
  - After: "Me, a spy? I killed false believers. You?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cultist smiles bloodthirstily.{/n} "Ah. You're new. That's right. Every newcomer must slit a false believer's throat to prove their loyalty to the Edge of Daybreak. Did you enjoy it at all? You don't have to answer. I can see you did. Go ahead, {mf|broth|sist}er."
  - After: {n}He grins.{/n} "Newcomers slit a false believer's throat to join the Edge of Daybreak. You enjoyed it. Go, {mf|broth|sist}er."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "New? I didn't have you pegged as a snotty rookie. Bit too confident, the way you hold that weapon."
  - After: "New? You hold that weapon too confidently."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cultist stares at you in disbelief, holding his cheek. Crestfallen, he gives his fellows a sideways glance with his eerie eyes and mutters dazedly,{/n} "Kill h{mf|im|er}."
  - After: {n}Holding his cheek:{/n} "Kill h{mf|im|er}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cultist's eerie eyes fly out of their sockets and land on the floor with a wet squelch. The heretics stare silently at their fallen comrade, stupefied. Then they charge at you.{/n}
  - After: {n}His eyes squelch onto the floor. The heretics charge.{/n}

  - Before: {n}The cultist squints warily and lays a hand on his weapon.{/n} "There's something off about you."
  - After: {n}He grips his weapon.{/n} "Something's off."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: {n}Like other {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}pawns you've cowed{/d}, he backs off.{/n}

  - After: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}Incomprehensible{/d} terms baffle him.{/n} "Go pester others with your sadistics..."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/Prior/ArcheotechReactor_Prior_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Dahr-Impulse VI... It was to you, was it not, that Logis Abel came seeking an interpretation of his datatrance?"
  - After: "Dahr-Impulse VI, Logis Abel brought you his datatrance?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me more about your relic."
  - After: "Tell me about your relic."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are not like other members of the Adeptus Mechanicus I have met."
  - After: "You're unlike other Mechanicus I've met."
- **Player**
  - Before: "In the monastery, I was attacked by people who looked like Electro-Priests."
  - After: "Electro-Priests attacked me in the monastery."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to get to the holy reactor."
  - After: "I wish to reach the holy reactor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My enforcers and the governor's guards can help you reclaim the monastery."
  - After: "My enforcers and the governor's guards can help retake the monastery."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What precisely do you believe in?"
  - After: "What do you believe in?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You made the right decision when you chose to avoid combat and save yourselves."
  - After: "You were right to avoid combat and survive."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A true person of faith would never have hidden and let the enemy take over their temple."
  - After: "True faithful would never hide and yield their temple."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Scoff] "I was under no misconception that anything resembling a fighting spirit could be expected from humble priests."
  - After: [Scoff] "I expected no fight from humble priests."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have rescued him from the insurgents."
  - After: "I rescued him from the insurgents."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, declare this monastery to be under my protection."
  - After: "I, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, take this monastery under my protection."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The time has come to prove your loyalty to the Omnissiah, Praetor. In the name of the God of Humanity, strengthen my numbers with the faithful eager to fulfil their duty, so that they help me punish the blasphemers."
  - After: "Prove your loyalty to the Omnissiah, Praetor. Lend me your faithful to punish the blasphemers."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We serve the same holy being, the same many-faced divine revelation. I greet you."
  - After: "We serve the same many-faced divinity. I greet you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you calling me a pilgrim?"
  - After: "Why call me a pilgrim?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What happened here and how did you manage to survive?"
  - After: "What happened here, and how did you survive?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have a few questions about this place and the people in it."
  - After: "I have questions about this place."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me more about Logis Abel."
  - After: "Tell me about Logis Abel."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What kinds of visions was he receiving?"
  - After: "What visions did he have?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A shortish, muscular man wearing the scarlet colours of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Priesthood of Mars{/g} steps into your path. The wrinkles on his cheeks and forehead point to his propensity for frequent outbursts of fierce anger, but right now, he is showing no signs of aggression. Glowing blue patterns of electric tattoos, or electoos, show through his oddly bluish-tinted skin.{/n}
  - After: {n}A short, muscular man in {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Priesthood of Mars{/g} scarlet blocks your path, electoos glowing blue.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal keeps his solemn silence, but the quick clicking of his {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g}'s claw betrays his excitement at being so close to the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Archeotech}archeotech{/g}.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrite{/g} clicks eagerly near the {g|Encyclopedia:Archeotech}archeotech{/g}.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It would be pointless to describe the Miraculous Fusion Reactor. Only through beholding its ferocious power can one comprehend its blessed essence, and fear the might of the Omnissiah. Its core was found four thousand years ago and delivered to Rykad Minoris by the holy warrior of faith Locke-Impulse I during one of his campaigns. Its sacred spark has not gone out for an instant, and the walls and power units of this cenobium have been erected around the relic in order to protect it from ignorant laypeople, as well as protect them from its formidable might."
  - After: "Behold the Miraculous Fusion Reactor yourself. Locke-Impulse I brought its core four thousand years ago; its spark never died."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Confirmed. The presence of laypeople on monastery grounds without the Praetor Electroid's blessing will be regarded as a sacrilegious violation of the holy Rite of Operation."
  - After: "Confirmed. Unblessed laypeople here commit sacrilege."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "When the heretics descended in droves upon this cenobium, we gave battle. But the unholy foes buried the Omnissiah's warriors under a mass of their bodies, thus extinguishing the defenders' sparks of purity. It was then that I ordered my few surviving brethren to retreat into the monastery's secret chambers. Upon taking refuge there, we began to destroy the blasphemous intruders in surreptitious ways. Alas, as fiery as my brethren's anger was, I had no right to permit them to die in honest combat, for the task of taking back our abode still lay ahead for us."
  - After: "Heretics overwhelmed us. Survivors hid in secret chambers, striking unseen. I forbade dying in battle—we must retake our home."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Stop, pilgrim. You have no enemies here, for the corruption of heresy has not touched our fraternity."
  - After: "Stop, pilgrim. Heresy has not touched us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man responds curtly, as if giving a military command:{/n} "The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all."
  - After: {n}Curtly:{/n} "The Omnissiah knows all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I hope the Omnissiah preserves Tech-Brother Abel's life, that he may continue to comprehend the mysteries he has tapped into."
  - After: "May the Omnissiah preserve Brother Abel."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium receives you, pilgrim. I am Dahr-Impulse VI, a servant of the Motive Force and the Praetor Electroid of this sacred monastery."
  - After: "Welcome to the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium, pilgrim. I am Dahr-Impulse VI, its Praetor Electroid."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Sad news indeed. Tech-Brother Abel was chosen by the Omnissiah to be a comprehender of great mysteries. May his spirit's Motive Force come into being anew in the fount of the Miraculous Fusion Reactor."
  - After: "Sad news. May Abel's Motive Force be reborn in the Reactor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I cannot allow this. Laypeople are forbidden from visiting the monastery, and only a select few are allowed to behold the ark and the relic within. You and your retinue are pilgrims of a special status bestowed by the Emperor. However, should any soldier unblessed by the Omnissiah cross this monastery's threshold, I will deem them a heretic and have them put to death."
  - After: "No. Laypeople are forbidden. Your retinue has the Emperor's status; any unblessed soldier who enters dies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The hard-working servants and dwellers of this cenobium. Electro-Priests of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. The Corpuscarii did us a great honour by entrusting into our care the sacred relic around which the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium was built."
  - After: "Electro-Priests of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}, keepers of the Corpuscarii's relic."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We have devoted ourselves to the worship of that aspect of the Machine God which is known as the Motive Force. It is the blessed divine spark that creates impetus in the universe. The Omnissiah, in his mercy, gave the world the gift of the Motive Force, and we follow its impulses in order to increase it, bring it to laypeople, and protect it from unholy hands."
  - After: "The Motive Force, the Machine God's spark that moves the universe. We increase and guard it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thank you, pilgrim. It was not easy, watching unholy intruders stampede through the chambers of my temple. We all envied our brethren who had fallen before that sacrilege began."
  - After: "Thank you. We envied our fallen as heretics trampled our temple."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Praetor Electroid's face becomes stonelike.{/n} "My body is brimming with the fury of the Motive Force that wants to be unleashed upon the heretics who have dared to desecrate my temple. But this is pride, and it is incompatible with my rank and my duties."
  - After: {n}His face hardens.{/n} "I burn to strike them. But that is pride, unfit for my rank."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Praetor Electroid, too, falls sorrowfully silent.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Praetor falls silent too.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The relic that this monastery protects provides the entire planet of Rykad Minoris with the blessed Motive Force, and we, unworthy though we are, are glad to serve the ancient machine that dwells in this place."
  - After: "Our relic powers all of Rykad Minoris."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "'The Omnissiah's Tears' is what we call this phenomenon, this dying away of unworthy flesh. As we shun the layperson's primitive means of looking at the world, we gain the ability to sense the Motive Force around us with our entire bodies."
  - After: "'The Omnissiah's Tears.' Blind, we sense the Motive Force bodily."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is a lamentable mistake. We knew of no help that was on its way, and were not expecting to encounter any allies in the monastery's chambers. But I see that you are alive, and I mourn the senseless deaths of my brethren."
  - After: "A sad mistake. We expected no allies. I mourn my brethren."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix opens his mouth for a second to say something, but changes his mind and quietly clears his throat instead.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix almost speaks, then coughs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The ark is hidden from pilgrims' eyes. But considering the extraordinary circumstances of your visit to this monastery, I grant you that right. The hall that leads to the high reliquary has been barred by the enemy, but I will open a secret path for you. Enter the ark and experience the Motive Force, pilgrim. We will pray to the security systems that they may refrain from punishing you for your intrusion."
  - After: "I grant you the hidden ark. The reliquary hall is barred; I'll open a secret path. Pray the security systems spare you."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Sure, better to die protecting their lumens and coils than to accept help from 'unworthies'! And we're left to deal with the mess as usual..."
  - After: "Sure, die for their coils instead! We clean up, as usual..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A tight bandage covers the man's eyes, yet he turns his face straight toward you with no hesitation. He has a sharp, screeching voice not unlike a bird's cawing:{/n} "May the charge of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s mercy persist in the hands of the faithful."
  - After: {n}Blindfolded, he faces you, voice cawing:{/n} "May the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s mercy charge the faithful."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Only those laypeople who desire to experience the Motive Force are allowed to cross this monastery's threshold. All others are profaners and criminals. You do not belong to the fraternity of Electro-Priests, but your intentions are good. If you were not seeking the Omnissiah's wisdom, then it was the Motive Force itself that brought you here to find it."
  - After: "Only seekers of the Motive Force may enter. It brought you here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "May the charge of the Omnissiah's grace persist in the batteries of the faithful!"
  - After: "May the Omnissiah's grace charge your batteries!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "His mind has always been able to combine facts and conclusions into harmonious wholes that were nothing short of beautiful. Many among my flock found his sermons poetic."
  - After: "His mind wove beautiful wholes. His sermons were poetic."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Truth is like light, and blocking its path is criminal." {n}The Praetor Electroid nods majestically.{/n}
  - After: "Truth is light; blocking it is criminal." {n}He nods.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Our faith imposes a duty of obedience on us. Every Electro-Priest is given numerous electoos that combine in a blessed voltagheist circuit, allowing feeble flesh to withstand the might of the Motive Force. That is why our skin glows with its light, and our eyes boil and melt when we are ordained."
  - After: "Electoos let our flesh bear the Motive Force. Our skin glows; our eyes melt at ordination."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Praetor stays silent for a long time. Finally, he lets out a deep sigh.{/n} "Thank you, pilgrim, for reminding me of our duty to Humanity. I will send the Cenobium's warriors to your aid if that is what His warriors want me to do."
  - After: {n}A long sigh.{/n} "You remind me of our duty. I will send warriors."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia nods thoughtfully.{/n} "Yes, I see... House Orsellio follows the same rules when it comes to outsiders."
  - After: {n}Cassia nods.{/n} "House Orsellio treats outsiders alike."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am pleased to be the conductor of truth."
  - After: "I am pleased to conduct truth."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I must commend the skill with which your secret chambers are concealed." {n}You hear a tinge of wounded pride in Heinrix's words, as if he is upset about failing to discover the Electro-Priests' shelter.{/n} "Your choice of tactics was wise as well. There was no point in losing more lives in the massacre that the cultists wrought."
  - After: "Well-hidden chambers." {n}Wounded pride.{/n} "Wise tactics, too."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "You have the honour of hosting the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius. I urge you to follow proper etiquette when interacting with the eminent bearer of the sacred Warrant."
  - After: "You host the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius. Mind your etiquette."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Within these walls, worldly titles are nothing before the Motive Force. Your deeds, however, speak far louder than titles, for your path here is sprayed with the blood of desecrators."
  - After: "Titles mean nothing here. But your path drips desecrators' blood."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I wonder if you would have so touchingly mourned the Lord Captain's death or if such sentiments would have only been awoken by the sound of our voidship delivering a punitive strike from orbit."
  - After: "Would you mourn the Lord Captain, or only after our orbital strike?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man offers you a deep bow, respectful of the words spoken by a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}former Adeptus Ministorum servant{/d}.{/n} "May the Motive Force in your righteous limbs never fail in His holy service. I greet you in kind, {mf|brother|sister}."
  - After: {n}He bows to the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Ministorum}former Adeptus Ministorum servant{/d}.{/n} "I greet you, {mf|brother|sister}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Praetor Electroid looks at Kibellah and gives a dignified nod.{/n} "You have brought an assassin. Good. She will find much work here. Are you ready for new toils, blessed slayer?"
  - After: {n}He nods at Kibellah.{/n} "An assassin. Good. Ready for work, slayer?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man bows his head.{/n} "The Motive Force brought you here at the right time, pilgrim."
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "The Motive Force brought you in time."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal bows down humbly before the man. A trill of binharic signals comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}, to which the Praetor responds with a solemn gesture of blessing. Pasqal turns to you and says,{/n} "The rank of Praetor Electroid is a sign of high standing within the Electro-Priest fraternity. To have been granted an audience is a great honour."
  - After: {n}Pasqal bows, trilling via {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}.{/n} "A Praetor Electroid! A great honour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes. Tech-Brother Abel arrived here to engage in a magnetic meditation that would help clarify his visions. Unfortunately, the heretics' machinations prevented us from completing the ritual. The esteemed Logis volunteered his help in defending the monastery, but contact with him was lost soon afterward."
  - After: "Yes. Abel came for magnetic meditation on his visions. Heretics interrupted; he helped defend us, then vanished."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This holy place will be protected against sacrilegious practices. I swear it."
  - After: "This holy place will be protected. I swear it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We did not speak much to each other. He preferred to devote his time to solitary reflections in his chapel. The Omnissiah has given Tech-Brother Abel a gift of great insight, which allows him to discern each individual facet of existence rather than the overall view. This makes his logic different from that of other people."
  - After: "He kept to his chapel. He saw each facet, not the whole."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The leader of the heretics fought her way into the ark wherein dwells the Miraculous Fusion Reactor. She is trying to desecrate the Rite of Operation with her unholy litanies so that the relic may be corrupted and the world of Rykad Minoris may perish in a fount of fire. But my brethren, in their magnetic meditation, are hampering her efforts by chanting access request prayers in unison, thereby suppressing the commands that the blasphemers enter." {n}The Praetor Electroid nods toward his entranced comrades.{/n}
  - After: "The heretics' leader is in the Reactor's ark, corrupting its Rite to burn Rykad Minoris. My brethren's chanting blocks her." {n}He nods at them.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Omnissiah's revelation was encrypted with great meticulousness, which indicates its great importance. Grasping it fully is beyond my ability, but a single touch was enough for me to realise the enormity of the secret concealed within. Or, more exactly, the Secret Design, which was how Tech-Brother Abel referred to it. His mind had discerned in the world around him traces of some grand silence that he wished to comprehend."
  - After: "Heavily encrypted, so vital. I glimpsed its enormity: the Secret Design, Abel called it. He sought to understand a grand silence."

  - Before: "...the Motive Force that floweth through veins of copper."
  - After: "...the Motive Force in copper veins."
- **Player**
  - Before: "...the Omnissiah, from whom the holy discharge springeth forth."
  - After: "...the Omnissiah, source of holy discharge."
- **Player**
  - Before: "...the blessed Cathode that beckoneth the timeless electron."
  - After: "...the blessed Cathode beckoning electrons."
- **Player**
  - Before: "...the mighty Reactor that performeth the sacrament of fusion."
  - After: "...the mighty Reactor performing fusion."
- **Player**
  - Before: "...the Closed Circuit, wherein the path's start and end are tied in a knot."

- **Player**
  - Before: "...the Memory of ages that is preserved most zealously."
  - After: "...the zealously kept Memory of ages."
- **Player**
  - Before: "...the faultless Soul that the current washeth over."

  - Before: "...the mortal Body and the mechanisms thereof."

  - Before: "Pasqal, kindly remind me how this hymn goes."

  - Before: "...the splendid resistors that conceal within them the rite of transfiguration."

  - Before: "...the watchful breakers that protect us from the sacrilege of the short circuit."
