- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator's green screen lights up as you approach it, and displays the flashing message,{/n} "Pilgrim, only the words of the First Galvanic Hymn will reveal to you the gifts hidden behind the veil of knowledge. Now chant with me: 'Let us sing this canticle to...'" {n}The device's keyboard lights up, clearly expecting you to enter the rest of the verse.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogitator flashes:{/n} "Chant the First Galvanic Hymn: 'Let us sing this canticle to...'" {n}Type the verse.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's vox lets out a noisy groan as if he is clearing his throat, but then stops abruptly. After a brief pause, he averts his gaze and says in a rasping voice,{/n} "It is not known to me. Only high-ranking servants at shrines of energetic prosperity are permitted to perform the First Galvanic Hymn."
  - After: {n}Pasqal looks away.{/n} "I do not know it. Only high servants may."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard snorts and struggles to suppress an involuntary smile.{/n} "Emperor help us all. The esteemed Magos has been caught out not knowing a prayer, and now he's floundering like a cadet in an exam. I never thought I'd see the day."
  - After: {n}Abelard smirks.{/n} "The Magos, floundering like a cadet!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Now finish this prayer, pilgrim: 'May the unity of the sacred charges power...'"
  - After: "Finish: 'May the unity of the sacred charges power...'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Verse two calls to you, pilgrim: 'Let us fill our souls with gratitude toward—'"
  - After: "Verse two: 'Let us fill our souls with gratitude toward—'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A solemn binharic trill comes from the cogitator.{/n} "Verily so! A pilgrim who has learned our ways is worthy of the gifts of the enlightened."
  - After: {n}A trill.{/n} "Verily! You earned our gifts."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Only one who has learned the path of our Cenobium is worthy of its gifts. Walk the path of the enlightened, absorb their age-old wisdom, and sing with me again." {n}The screen goes dark in disappointment.{/n}
  - After: "Learn our path and sing again." {n}The screen goes dark.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/ArcheotechReactor/Reactor_Pascal/ArcheotechReactor_Pascal_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Laugh] "I'm actually curious to know what it's like to walk in a heretic's shoes."
  - After: [Laugh] "I'm curious to walk in a heretic's shoes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is the essence of your plan?"
  - After: "What's your plan?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you sure he is Amarnat?"
  - After: "Are you sure he's Amarnat?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "We must save the esteemed Tech-Priest without risking his life."
  - After: "We must save the Tech-Priest without risking his life."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will not allow corruption to touch you. We will vest ourselves in faith and kill every last traitor to the Golden Throne."
  - After: "Corruption won't touch you. In faith, we'll kill every traitor to the Golden Throne."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you suggesting we pass on the chance to kill them all with our own hands? Forget it. I'm not missing out on the fun!"
  - After: "Skip killing them ourselves? I'm not missing the fun!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If it helps to save a worthy man, I will put on the cultist's robes."
  - After: "To save a worthy man, I'll wear the cultist's robes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You do realise this plan sounds like suicide?"
  - After: "This plan sounds like suicide."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You would disgrace yourself by donning these tainted rags?"
  - After: "You'd disgrace yourself in these tainted rags?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A crowd of cultists has surrounded a {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} crucified upon a mechanism. A rhythmic whisper repeated by a hundred voices blends into some blasphemous enchantment. Powerful discharges of the Motive Force run through the machine, causing the unfortunate prisoner's body to convulse brutally and forcing woeful cries of pain from his lips.{/n}
  - After: {n}Chanting cultists surround a {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} crucified on a machine. Surges make him convulse and scream.{/n}
- **Tortured Tech-Priest**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest's hoarse voice echoes under the ceiling:{/n} "In the clenched claws of stagnation — in the shackles of Iteration Zero — under the iron wing — let — the Cycle — be discontinued!"
  - After: {n}He rasps:{/n} "Let — the Cycle — be discontinued!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} spring into combat mode instantly, and a wrathful rattle comes from his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "I am registering a severe violation of the purity protocol! The blessed Amarnat has been captured by heretics and is being tortured!"
  - After: {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} ready; his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} rattles.{/n} "Heretics are torturing the blessed Amarnat!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The safety system protecting the hall is controlled from the machine altar, which must be disabled. If all these operations are performed, I can guarantee that not a single blasphemer will survive the Omnissiah's wrath that will be unleashed upon this place."
  - After: "Also disable the safety system at the machine altar. Then no blasphemer survives."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Confirmed. I do not observe his face, but I recognise his words. 'Let the Cycle be discontinued' is the blessed Amarnat's motto."
  - After: "Confirmed. 'Let the Cycle be discontinued' is his motto."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The heretics have taken up positions everywhere, and many more are doubtlessly hiding in the passages leading out of the hall. For now, they are all focused on the sacrilegious torture of the Tech-Priest and do not notice you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heretics everywhere, absorbed in the torture. They don't notice you.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The mechadendrite points to the corpses of heretics lying nearby.{/n} "We can use the blasphemers' clothing as a disguise. Unrecognised, we can sabotage the power units, overloading them and thus cleansing the hall of heretics."
  - After: {n}He points at corpses.{/n} "Disguised in their clothes, we overload the power units."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "My analysis of the situation indicates the overwhelming numerical superiority of the enemy. In an open confrontation, the blessed Amarnat may be randomly or deliberately harmed by fire. I have an alternative proposal to direct engagement."
  - After: "They vastly outnumber us; Amarnat may be hit. I have an alternative."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The lightning discharges have charred the cultists' corpses. Whiffs of smoke rise from their empty eye sockets, whose contents have evaporated. Their clothes, covered in the blood of innocents, are crudely painted over with emblems of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}, which exude a repulsive air of soul decay.{/n}
  - After: {n}Charred corpses smoke. Their bloody clothes bear {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g} emblems.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "So be it. May the Omnissiah protect the blessed Amarnat in the coming battle. Death to the blasphemers!"
  - After: "So be it. Death to the blasphemers!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I pray that the Omnissiah gives the blessed Amarnat enough fortitude." {n}Pasqal grimaces as a new wail of pain rends the air.{/n}
  - After: "Omnissiah give Amarnat fortitude." {n}Another wail.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "A devotee of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} is capable of withstanding great bodily torment with no loss of functionality. But where flesh reinforced with sacred iron will persevere, the purity of spirit may perish."
  - After: "An {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} devotee's flesh endures. His spirit may not."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The heretic's garb clings to your skin like a greedy leech. Tingling and foul fever spread over your body, as though these tatters have imbibed the vile contents of their former wearer's soul.{/n}
  - After: {n}The garb clings like a leech, feverish.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal deadpans,{/n} "The only unbearable disgrace is that of a duty unfulfilled. The rest is merely spiritual attrition."
  - After: {n}Deadpan:{/n} "Only unfulfilled duty is disgrace."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}With a look of revulsion, Kibellah picks up one of the rags with the tip of her blade.{/n} "Nothing but your word, Domin'{name}, can make me don this filth. Once we are done, I will scrape my skin clean with a metal brush and bathe it in caustic lye."
  - After: {n}Kibellah lifts a rag on her blade.{/n} "Only for you, Domin'{name}. After, I'll scrub with lye."
- **Tortured Tech-Priest**
  - Before: {n}Another desperate scream rends the air.{/n}
  - After: {n}Another scream.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I hypothesise that the heretics have made the blessed Amarnat a participant in some variety of sacrilegious ritual. Through sacrilegious torture, they are trying to break his will and turn him into an unholy terminal with which to control the reactor's outer power circuit system."
  - After: "They're breaking him into an unholy terminal for the reactor's circuits."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Uttering a Litany of Actuation for the power units from the lumenodeacon's command throne will direct the Motive Force created by the blessed reactor into the hall. The {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}distribution servitor{/g} is keeping its output within the set parameters, but upon receiving an order to increase it to peak values, it will turn this place into an electric trap."
  - After: "A Litany of Actuation at the lumenodeacon's throne, then the {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}distribution servitor{/g} at peak: the hall becomes an electric trap."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I shudder with disgust at the mere thought of having to touch clothing adorned with unholy symbols, let alone wear it! This is the first step toward falling, a small compromise with evil that will lead to something greater. Is there truly no other way, Rogue Trader?"
  - After: "Wear unholy symbols? The first step to a fall! No other way?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "The signs of the Archenemy are not just painted symbols, but conductors of its will. The words of their prayers, even spoken without faith, their coats of arms, even deceitfully worn — all this increases the presence of the Ruinous Powers near you and draws their corrupting attention to you."
  - After: "Archenemy signs draw the Ruinous Powers, even worn falsely."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia stares in horror at the corrupted clothes and the scattered human ashes.{/n} "D-do not make me..."
  - After: {n}Cassia stares, horrified.{/n} "D-do not make me..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "The Tech-Priest's colours are stained with grime. They are diluted. Painted over with rot... And yet his heart still holds a cinder of bright red. This dying flame... can be ignited anew."
  - After: "His colours are rotted... yet a red cinder remains. It can be rekindled."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}A sound similar to a laugh escapes Pasqal's vox.{/n} "This statement is true. Then what do you propose? To flee? I have tried to employ this behavioural strategy in the past, and it brought my soul no relief."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's vox almost laughs.{/n} "True. Flee, then? I tried. It brought no relief."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/CommandCenter/MechanicusExploratorVendor/MechanicusExploratorVendor_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You are an Explorator, aren't you? What are you doing here?"
  - After: "An Explorator? Why are you here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Permission to transfer information granted. What do you wish to tell me?"
  - After: "Transfer granted. Speak."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is the Cognisance Fleet doing in the Rykad System?"
  - After: "Why is the Cognisance Fleet in Rykad?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Show me your arsenal. I accept the commercial transaction."
  - After: "Show me your arsenal. Let's trade."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The governor is carrying out his immediate duties. I do not intend to interfere."
  - After: "The governor is doing his duty. I won't interfere."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you know anything about the Tech-Priest Abel Haneumann?"
  - After: "Know of Tech-Priest Abel Haneumann?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What will I get in return for my help?"
  - After: "What do I get for helping?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will discuss it with the governor."
  - After: "I'll discuss it with the governor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The painfully thin Tech-Priest turns sharply toward you. The sudden movement makes his chromed augmetics briefly clang. His grey eyes, set under furrowed brows, almost blend into the pale skin of his face, and he levels you with a heavy, dour stare.{/n}
  - After: {n}A gaunt, chromed Tech-Priest stares at you dourly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Unit Quartz-Krame requests permission to negotiate trade agreements. Are you open to a commercial transaction?"
  - After: "Unit Quartz-Krame requests trade. Open to a transaction?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Retrieving archived data. Over seventy Terran years ago, the governor of Rykad Minoris and authorised representatives of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet made an agreement. Its goal was mutual benefit through cooperation. Unit Logis Quartz-Krame is the Fleet's appointed trade agent. The unit is responsible for maintenance of the arsenal and the combat machinery."
  - After: "Unit Logis Quartz-Krame: Cognisance Fleet trade agent here by a seventy-year pact."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}When the Tech-Priest notices Pasqal, his eyes widen. His vox-unit immediately lets out a string of screeching binharic, a tortuously long tirade in which the volume rises and falls seemingly at random. When it is finally over, the Omnissiah's servant bows his head in deference.{/n}
  - After: {n}Seeing Pasqal, he screeches a long binharic tirade, then bows.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I observe that this world's authorities lack diligence in the performance of their duties."
  - After: "This world's authorities lack diligence."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest says, sharply and curtly,{/n} "Haphazard and careless decisions on the part of the Rykad Minoris governor have led to unacceptable consequences. Communication with the Adeptus Mechanicus sanctum has been lost. Troops must be sent to the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium without delay. Restoring communication with the Electro-Priests and ensuring the sanctum's security are our top priorities."
  - After: {n}Curtly:{/n} "The governor's carelessness cut contact with the Cenobium. Send troops now."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Cognisance Fleet's presence in the Rykad System is negligible. Its research activities in the system have been concluded. A limited presence is maintained for the purposes of logistical support. Fulfilment of vows to maintain the Omnissiah's creations. Spiritual oversight."
  - After: "Negligible. Research concluded. A small presence remains for logistics and upkeep."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The priest pierces you with his grim gaze as his vox-caster tensely crackles. A few seconds later, he nods briefly.{/n} "Answer accepted. The future of the Adeptus Mechanicus sanctum remains under threat."
  - After: {n}A tense pause; a nod.{/n} "Accepted. The sanctum remains threatened."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Unit Quartz-Krame has had no previous communications with Unit Abel Haneumann. The memory sector contains other data related to this query."
  - After: "No prior contact. Related data exists."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Blessed are the valiant warriors, for there is no end to the darkness without them." {n}The Omnissiah's servants exchange short binharic mantras filled with intimidating solemnity.{/n}
  - After: "Blessed are the valiant warriors, for there is no end to the darkness without them." {n}Solemn binharic.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This statement is true!" {n}United in their denunciations and brimming with righteous criticism, the pair in red exchange knowing nods.{/n}
  - After: "This statement is true!" {n}They nod.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Identification. Unit Logis Quartz-Krame. Official trade representative of the Explorator Cognisance Fleet. The unit supervises supply routes in the Rykad System. Ensures the security of the combat arsenal. Performs commercial transactions and secures mutually beneficial contracts."
  - After: "Unit Logis Quartz-Krame, Cognisance Fleet trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Unit Quartz-Krame requests permission to transfer information. The Rogue Trader possesses a supreme degree of power. The potential to influence the current leadership. The ability to restore order in the Rykad System."
  - After: "Requesting transfer. You can restore order here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Various resources and data storage devices of interest have been extracted by the standing army of Rykad Minoris for preservation purposes. The command centre currently hosts a cogitator that was used by Unit Abel Haneumann. Appeal to the cogitator's spirits for further information."
  - After: "Abel Haneumann's cogitator is in the command centre."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Unit Quartz-Krame is grateful. The Rogue Trader is highly likely to successfully influence the future actions of the local authorities."
  - After: "Gratitude. You will likely sway them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are the head of a Rogue Trader dynasty. Your position enables you to exert influence—" {n}The Tech-Priest pauses for a moment.{/n} "—and pressure on the subjects of the Imperium. Unit Quartz-Krame requests assistance. The actions of Governor Faisal Rykadi ab Medineh af Koronus must be influenced. Demand that troops be sent to the holy monastery of the Adeptus Mechanicus."
  - After: "You can exert influence—" {n}A pause.{/n} "—and pressure. Make Governor Faisal Rykadi ab Medineh af Koronus send troops."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "A detailed complaint. I recommend you consider Unit Quartz-Krame's request to transfer information."
  - After: "A detailed complaint. Hear his request."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest stares at you without blinking.{/n} "Awareness of the fact that the Rogue Trader did not stand aside and has influenced the future of the Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium. Including the possible rescue of the most holy Electro-Priests. Unit Quartz-Krame can promise no more."
  - After: {n}An unblinking stare.{/n} "Knowing you aided the Cenobium. Nothing more."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/CommandCenter/OldCogitator/OldCogitator_RM_dialog

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}This cogitator looks a lot older and more worn than the ones next to it. However, it has evidently been well cared for: numerous parts have been replaced, not a single key is jammed, and fresh seals with prayers to the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} adorn its surface. One of the side panels has been removed. Bundles of gold-notched cables run from inside to a small data-crypt that was connected only a short while ago.{/n}
  - After: {n}An old, well-kept cogitator with {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} seals, wired to a new data-crypt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Logis Abel's conclusion: the insurrection on the planet had been long in the making, with the participation of external actors. It is alleged that two cycles ago, 'Aurora' arrived in the Rykad System — the rumoured unholy prophet of the insurgents. The subsequent ship movements can be attributed to weapon deliveries. But what is the nature of their activity near Rykadi Philia? Governor Medineh's attention must be drawn to—" {n}The final entry cuts off abruptly.{/n}
  - After: "Logis Abel: outsiders backed the revolt. Two cycles ago 'Aurora', the insurgents' prophet, arrived; ships brought weapons. Why near Rykadi Philia? Governor Medineh must—" {n}Cut off.{/n}

  - Before: "The machine spirits are ill-disposed toward you. Allow me to appease them in the appropriate manner." {n}Pasqal leans over the cogitator and sets to work.{/n}
  - After: "Let me appease the spirits." {n}Pasqal works.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The satellite Zafireh the Keen reports that a ship drifting nearby has hurriedly sped away. The ship had sent an encrypted vox-transmission to the insurgent-controlled areas of the surface of Rykad Minoris. Another transmission was directed to planetoid Rykadi Philia. Both transmissions were signed 'Brother Twilight.' Their contents could not be decrypted."
  - After: "Zafireh the Keen: a fleeing ship sent encrypted vox to insurgents and Rykadi Philia, signed 'Brother Twilight'."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You have bypassed the security layers. The cogitator is ready to reveal its secrets.{/n}
  - After: {n}Security bypassed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Despite your efforts, the stubborn machine spirits are unwilling to reveal their secrets.{/n}
  - After: {n}The machine spirits resist.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Upon Logis Abel's orders, the archives of every augur station on Rykad Minoris and the two primary satellites of Rykad's star have been queried. Said satellites are named Magos Ma'rouf and Zafireh the Keen, after two great champions of faith, whose external cogitators were placed inside the satellites' cores after their shells perished. The purpose of the sacred computation requested by the Logis is to uncover the external influence behind the ongoing insurgency."
  - After: "Abel queried all augurs, satellites Magos Ma'rouf and Zafireh the Keen for the insurgency's backers."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The satellite Magos Ma'rouf reports that a ship has translated into the system. Its signature is consistent with the records of the flagship of a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} dynasty, House von Valancius."
  - After: "Magos Ma'rouf: the House von Valancius {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} flagship has arrived."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Computation result: positive. Multiple instances of interference and malfunction detected, suggesting that the ships moving across the system deliberately blinded the sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g}' eyes. The first of these ships is thought to have arrived two Rykad Minoris cycles ago, early in the winter. The most recent one arrived a month ago."
  - After: "Positive. Ships deliberately blinded the {g|Encyclopedia:Augur}augurs{/g}: first two cycles ago, last a month ago."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The entry contains planetside coordinates marked as "Heavy augur station jamming. Possibly a hidden insurgent base?"{/n}
  - After: {n}Coordinates marked: "Heavy jamming. Hidden insurgent base?"{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The cycle can be discontinued... I recognise the words." {n}The voice from the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} is soft and pensive, barely audible over the static noise.{/n} "I believe I know the intended recipient of the message in the Furibundus System. It was me. Omnissiah, grant me the wisdom to fathom this mystery."
  - After: "The cycle can be discontinued... That message to the Furibundus System was for me." {n}His {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} is soft.{/n} "Omnissiah, grant me wisdom."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/CommandCenter/WarGovernor/WarGovernor_RM_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "My ship's crew has suffered heavy losses. I wish to secure replacements on Rykad Minoris."
  - After: "My crew suffered heavy losses. I need replacements from Rykad Minoris."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I need fresh crew to replace those killed in the attack on the ship. And I need material compensation."
  - After: "I need fresh crew for those killed, and material compensation."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pasqal, what is so special about the cenobium and the relic? What is in there that has drawn the attention of an Interrogator of the Inquisition?"
  - After: "Pasqal, why would the cenobium's relic draw an Interrogator of the Inquisition?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What a curious exchange of pleasantries. Is there some kind of discord between you and Abelard?"
  - After: "Curious greeting. Is there discord between you and Abelard?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The convoy was ambushed and massacred. The only surviving soldier turned out to be a traitor and was personally executed by me."
  - After: "The convoy was massacred. The lone survivor was a traitor, and I executed him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The convoy was ambushed and massacred in its entirety, save for one private's miraculous survival. I am counting on you to investigate the incident."
  - After: "The convoy was massacred, save one private. Investigate it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is there anything else I can do on this planet or in this system while I wait for the end of the revolt?"
  - After: "Anything else to do in this system while the revolt runs its course?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Heinrix van Calox, an Interrogator of the Most Holy Inquisition, is operating in your system. Do you know where he is?"
  - After: "Inquisition Interrogator Heinrix van Calox is in your system. Where is he?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you so confident that you will crush the insurrection soon? My own impression has been the exact opposite."
  - After: "You're sure you'll crush the insurrection soon? I think the opposite."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Our ship was attacked, Theodora was killed, and I claimed my inheritance. That is all you need to know."
  - After: "Our ship was attacked, Theodora killed, and I inherited. That's all you need."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The convoy was ambushed. There were no survivors except Private Camille Regias. I must commend his extraordinary loyalty and resilience."
  - After: "Only Private Camille Regias survived. I commend his loyalty."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Scores of crazed people with scorched eyes are stalking the city."
  - After: "Crazed people with scorched eyes stalk the city."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The insurgents talk of a 'Final Dawn' — the impending demise of the world."
  - After: "The insurgents speak of a 'Final Dawn' — the world's end."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I should be the one asking that question. Our ship was attacked by heretics. They killed Lady Theodora!"
  - After: "I should ask that. Heretics attacked our ship and killed Lady Theodora!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to know more about the monastery."
  - After: "Tell me about the monastery."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The insurgents are using the Archenemy's artefacts, enchanted lenses, to perform unholy sorcery."
  - After: "The insurgents use Archenemy artefacts, enchanted lenses, for sorcery."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to discuss the insurgency on the planet."
  - After: "Let's discuss the insurgency."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My kinsman Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius has betrayed our dynasty and the Imperium. If he is hiding in this system, I want him handed over to me."
  - After: "My kinsman Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius is a traitor. If he's here, hand him over."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You ought to leave your bunker more often, Governor Medineh. I have only recently arrived in this system and I already know much more about the uprising than you do."
  - After: "Leave your bunker, Governor Medineh. I just arrived and know more than you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I can see that it is not in my power to convince you. Let us change the subject."
  - After: "I can't convince you. Let's change the subject."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why did he fly to the monastery? That seems suspicious."
  - After: "Why did he fly to the monastery? Suspicious."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where can I get more information on this individual?"
  - After: "Where can I learn more about him?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pay no attention, Governor. She's a little off her rocker."
  - After: "Ignore her, Governor. She's a bit off her rocker."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The insurgency is headed by a certain Aurora, a prophet who, according to their followers, possesses mystical powers."
  - After: "A prophet called Aurora leads them, said to have mystical powers."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tech-Priest Quartz-Krame claims you have not been doing enough to ensure the safety of the Adeptus Mechanicus monastery."
  - After: "Tech-Priest Quartz-Krame says you're not protecting the Adeptus Mechanicus monastery enough."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My reasoning? One would have to be blind not to see all the signs of cultist activity! Have you ever had to deal with such a threat before, Governor Medineh? As a soldier of the Astra Militarum, I have, so do not waste my time with requests to prove the obvious, because I speak from experience!"
  - After: "Only the blind miss the cult signs! I've fought this in the Astra Militarum, Governor Medineh. Don't make me prove the obvious."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My esteemed predecessor died at the hands of cultists, may the Emperor incinerate their souls."
  - After: "My predecessor died at cultist hands, may the Emperor burn their souls."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The insurgents managed to steal a vox-caster. They have been listening to your people's communications."
  - After: "The insurgents stole a vox-caster. They're listening to your comms."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have picked an interesting time to quarrel with a servant of the Omnissiah, Governor."
  - After: "Odd time to quarrel with a servant of the Omnissiah, Governor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This Magos is part of my retinue. You have no right to give him orders."
  - After: "This Magos is in my retinue. You can't order him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Perhaps the esteemed governor is right."
  - After: "Perhaps the governor is right."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you so determined to get to the monastery? Is it just because of the relic?"
  - After: "Why so set on reaching the monastery? Just the relic?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It would be my pleasure to assist the Omnissiah's servant in reaching the sanctum."
  - After: "I'd gladly help the Omnissiah's servant reach the sanctum."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Witch, you will abstain from your sorcery in front of the governor!"
  - After: "Witch, no sorcery in front of the governor!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The rioters are too well organised, too well informed, too well armed. There are signs of indoctrination into heretical beliefs — they are clearly being directed by someone competent and charismatic. Governor, you are dealing with an Archenemy cult that is growing at an alarming rate."
  - After: "The rioters are too organised, informed and armed, and indoctrinated. Someone charismatic leads them. Governor, it's a growing Archenemy cult."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to commend the courage of one of your officers, Sergeant Malgar. He and his soldiers valiantly defend the starport."
  - After: "I commend Sergeant Malgar. He and his soldiers valiantly hold the starport."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This world belongs to Winterscale. Do the Adeptus Arbites truly have the authority to interfere in the rule of governors appointed by a Rogue Trader?"
  - After: "This is Winterscale's world. Can the Arbites really overrule a Rogue Trader's governors?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would never think to oppose a servant of the Lex."
  - After: "I'd never oppose a servant of the Lex."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not even try to involve me in this, Medineh."
  - After: "Don't drag me into this, Medineh."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Shrug] "I suppose there is nothing else for it."
  - After: [Shrug] "Nothing else for it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So, you are just going to sit the whole thing out in this bunker..."
  - After: "So you'll sit it all out in this bunker..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Proctor, do you also believe this rebellion was orchestrated by nothing more than a few lowborn lunatics?"
  - After: "Proctor, do you also think a few lowborn lunatics started this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Killing innocents is unacceptable, even for the sake of saving a world."
  - After: "Killing innocents is unacceptable, even to save a world."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A sound plan, Proctor. Only harsh measures can restore order."
  - After: "Sound plan, Proctor. Only harsh measures restore order."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish you luck in your investigation, Proctor."
  - After: "Good luck with your investigation, Proctor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The anti-aircraft battery that was giving you so much trouble has been destroyed."
  - After: "The anti-aircraft battery troubling you is destroyed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Please pay her no mind, Proctor. She has... episodes sometimes."
  - After: "Pay her no mind, Proctor. She has... episodes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare you work your sorcery in front of the Proctor, witch!"
  - After: "How dare you work sorcery before the Proctor, witch!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you think the rebels are hiding among the civilians? They could have shelters elsewhere."
  - After: "Why think the rebels hide among civilians? They could shelter elsewhere."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Lower your voice] "Governor, you didn't steal the tithe ship, did you?"
  - After: [Lower your voice] "Governor, did you steal the tithe ship?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I recommend not taking civilian casualties into account. These people are in need of a good lesson in pain and fear."
  - After: "Ignore civilian casualties. They need a lesson in pain and fear."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What has perplexed you about my companion's name?"
  - After: "Why did my companion's name puzzle you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why not shell the monastery if that is where the insurgents have gathered? Or deploy a landing force?"
  - After: "Why not shell the monastery, or send a landing force?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I realise that you yourselves are in a difficult situation, but my crew has sustained heavy losses. I must replace my missing crew members."
  - After: "I know times are hard, but I must replace my lost crew."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have no more questions."
  - After: "No more questions."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The tall, dark-skinned man turns toward you and greets you in a curt military manner:{/n} "Faisal Rykadi ab Medineh af Koronus, governor of this star system. Welcome to my temporary headquarters."

  - Before: "Oh, we will, I assure you!" {n}The governor gestures to the guards.{/n} "Take the suspect away. And find the executioner on duty. He should be done with interrogating the captured insurgents by now."

  - After: "Excellent news. Thank you!"
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I know this from a few intercepted vox-exchanges and a couple of scumbags we've interrogated. But first and foremost, I know from experience. Such mutinous rabble always feeds off its families and associates, who also provide a source of recruits to support its ranks. And, of course, there is the heretics' contemptible habit of using the local population as a shield. We need to flush them out of their nests and starve them of resources."
  - After: "Intercepts and experience. Rebels hide behind kin and locals. We flush them and starve them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Not you too! I swear on the Golden Throne and the blood of all martyrs: I never even considered committing such an act! Please, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, do not insult me with such suspicions."
  - After: "Not you too! I swear on the Golden Throne I never considered it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/StarPort/Haneumann_FirstMeeting/Haneumann_FirstMeeting_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You appear to be injured. You should go back — you will be given medical attention."
  - After: "You're injured. Go back for medical care."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You must be quite devoted to your mentor to be willing to wade into this mess for him."
  - After: "You must be devoted to brave this mess for your mentor."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Point at the exploded machine] "How did you manage to kill off a slew of people and blow up a sacred machine without even laying a finger on it?"
  - After: [Point at the exploded machine] "How did you kill so many and blow up a sacred machine without touching it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I invite you to join my retinue."
  - After: "Join my retinue."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius. I mean you no ill."
  - After: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius. I mean no ill."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Abelard, this is no time to lose your composure. Present me."
  - After: "Abelard, compose yourself. Present me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stop immediately, or I shall have you thrown into the remains of that machine to finish burning."
  - After: "Stop, or I'll throw you into that burning machine."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you wish to see the governor?"
  - After: "Why see the governor?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You do not even know how you caused such an explosion?"
  - After: "You don't know how you caused that explosion?"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The man dressed in crimson should not have survived an explosion like that. However, he is alive — you hear the wheezing of the respirator that covers half of his face.{/n}
  - After: {n}The man in crimson survived; his respirator wheezes.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The vox emits a contemptuous hiss:{/n} "The suffering of the flesh is a negligible factor. Metal conquers, meat is conquered. I recommend a swift advance." {n}The emaciated Tech-Priest, his robe shredded by debris in many places, doggedly grips his power axe, leaning on it like a staff.{/n}
  - After: {n}The vox hisses:{/n} "Flesh is negligible. Advance." {n}He leans on his axe.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I identify as Magos Pasqal Haneumann of the Priesthood of Mars. By the grace of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}, I am currently assigned to the maintenance personnel of the station Altar-Templum-Calixis-Ext-17."
  - After: "Magos Pasqal Haneumann of Mars, by the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s grace, of station Altar-Templum-Calixis-Ext-17."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest turns around and stares aghast at the burning remains as if he had nothing to do with what just happened. His vox produces a mournful prayer.{/n} "I... This was my doing?"
  - After: {n}He stares aghast.{/n} "This was my doing?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira has been staring at the Tech-Priest, biting her lip. She finally leans in to your ear.{/n} "The voices are being weird about him... They're saying garbled, conflicting things... like they're talking about completely different people... but he's not a threat to you. Even if that's a bit hard to believe after all the fireworks."
  - After: {n}Idira whispers,{/n} "The voices call him several people. But he's no threat."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The Omnissiah granted me a revelation. The spirit of this machine was dying, but it wished to perform a service, for such was its design. I sensed this and... appealed to it. I do not know how I did it — I merely followed my intuition. The understanding granted by the Omnissiah was not permanent — it has left me. " {n}The Tech-Priest appears shaken.{/n}
  - After: "The Omnissiah let me hear the dying machine's wish to serve. I appealed to it. That gift has left me." {n}He's shaken.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Small wrinkles gather around the Tech-Priest's exposed eye as if he is smiling under his respirator mask.{/n} "Cessation of vital functions is an unavoidable phenomenon and therefore an insignificant one. The doctrine of worship repudiates the fear of death."
  - After: {n}His eye smiles.{/n} "Death is inevitable, thus insignificant."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Acknowledged. Predicting successful and mutually beneficial cooperation."
  - After: "Acknowledged. Predicting beneficial cooperation."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}A trill comes from the folds of the partially smouldering crimson raiment — it is binharic speech, the sacred language of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}. The binharic hymn transforms into a {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-synthesised voice that sounds like thunder rolling over a vast plain:{/n} "Not another step."
  - After: {n}{g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} binharic trills into a thunderous {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}:{/n} "Not another step."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Clenching his teeth, the Seneschal grits out,{/n} "Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius greets you, honoured Tech-Priest, and graciously grants you permission to remain in {mf|his|her} presence."
  - After: {n}The Seneschal grits,{/n} "Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius permits you {mf|his|her} presence."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard steps forward to shield you from the stranger.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard shields you.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest's visor focuses on your attire and examines the symbols on it.{/n} "I identify you as a member of a high stratum belonging to Rogue Trader House von Valancius. I am detecting no need for confrontation."
  - After: {n}His visor scans you.{/n} "House von Valancius. No confrontation needed."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Altar-Templum-Calixis... I have heard the name before. The station appears on House Orsellio's star charts, in the Furibundus System, not far from the void colony of Footfall. You have travelled a long way to come here, esteemed Magos."
  - After: "Altar-Templum-Calixis is in the Furibundus System, near Footfall. You've come far, Magos."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Then his expression hardens, and he adds cryptically,{/n} "With my mentor's words, the Omnissiah gives me the algorithm for redemption and triumph in service. I will be redeemed, and I will triumph."
  - After: {n}He hardens.{/n} "Through my mentor, I will be redeemed and triumph."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "By the Throne... What is that servant of the Omnissiah made of? Adamantine— Argh, blast it!" {n}Abelard clutches his head as his ocular implant is racked with a wave of interference.{/n}
  - After: "Throne... Adamantine— Argh!" {n}Abelard's implant glitches.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah stares at him in surprise.{/n} "How strange it is to hear such words from one who is not of the Bloodspun Web... We have much in common."
  - After: {n}Kibellah, surprised:{/n} "You speak like the Bloodspun Web."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}His gaunt hand rises to stop you, and immediately your vox howls in pain and your machine equipment starts crackling. The Tech-Priest's blazing power axe disgorges a cloud of righteous sparks, and his visor glows menacingly in blue and green.{/n} "Flee, for I am death."
  - After: {n}His hand rises; your gear crackles, his axe sparks.{/n} "Flee, for I am death."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/StarPort/Sergeant/StarPort_Sergeant_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "How can some pathetic rebellion be cause enough for such a lacklustre welcoming ceremony in honour of a Rogue Trader's arrival? It is an insult."
  - After: "A rebellion excuses this pathetic welcome? An insult."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You must be mistaken. I am the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius."
  - After: "Mistaken. I am the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am the Rogue Trader von Valancius! Give me a status report, this instant!"
  - After: "I am Rogue Trader von Valancius! Report, now!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare you, commoner? On your knees, before I blow your brains out!"
  - After: "Kneel, commoner, or I blow your brains out!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is the path ahead dangerous? What exactly awaits me there?"
  - After: "Is the path ahead dangerous?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are a good soldier, Malgar. I will see that your heroism is noted."
  - After: "Good soldier, Malgar. I'll note your heroism."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A good fighter would have long since reclaimed the starport. Move out and attack, you cowardly knave!"
  - After: "A good fighter would have retaken the starport. Attack, coward!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I cannot leave you and your people without aid. Reinforcements will be sent from my ship."
  - After: "I won't leave you without aid. My ship will send reinforcements."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Some dirty dog nearly shot down my shuttle!"
  - After: "Some dog nearly shot down my shuttle!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am going to see the governor."
  - After: "I'm going to see the governor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Davian of Tertium? Who is that?"
  - After: "Davian of Tertium? Who's that?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are a fool. The governor, who is safe and sound in the rear, has left you for dead, and here you are, preaching about glory."
  - After: "Fool. The safe governor left you for dead, and you preach glory."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to see the governor of this planet."
  - After: "I wish to see the governor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you happen to know if a member of the Inquisition has come here?"
  - After: "Has the Inquisition come here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Pat him on the shoulder] "You are doing fine work, Malgar. And so are your troops. It is people like you that hold the Imperium together!"
  - After: [Pat him on the shoulder] "Fine work, Malgar. People like you hold the Imperium together!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is going on here?"
  - After: "What's going on?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Abelard, enlighten this rabble about the proper manner of greeting the God-Emperor's chosen."
  - After: "Abelard, teach this rabble to greet the God-Emperor's chosen."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The starport greets you with the din of ordnance and the smell of explosives tickles your nostrils. It is difficult to tell through the smoke who is firing at whom.{/n}
  - After: {n}Gunfire and smoke fill the starport.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "A very important person from the Adeptus Mechanicus arrived on the last shuttle before they locked down the sky. He kept on asking whether anyone by the name of Amarant or Amarnat or something like that had recently arrived. Barely answered any of our questions, though; said he was under no obligation to tell us anything."
  - After: "A Mechanicus bigwig came on the last shuttle, asking after an Amarant or Amarnat. Answered nothing."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Your imperious tone proves more effective than any official regalia, and the commoner collapses to his knees.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cowed, he kneels.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}At the word {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}"Inquisition,"{/g} the sergeant's face fills with awe.{/n} "I don't know, {mf|sir|ma'am}! There definitely haven't been any visitors like that on my watch! You might have to enquire at the headquarters, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
  - After: {n}Awed at {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}"Inquisition"{/g}:{/n} "Not on my watch, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Ask headquarters, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}With a mixture of awe and terror, he snaps to attention, raises his freshly cut chin like an exemplary soldier, and barks,{/n} "My mistake, {mf|sir|ma'am}! At once! The starport is under the control of the governor's wardens! Perimeter commander is Sergea—"
  - After: {n}He snaps to attention.{/n} "Yes, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Wardens hold the starport! Commander is Sergea—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A frag grenade explosion cuts off the rest of the sergeant's words. Shrapnel flies everywhere with a piercing screech. One of the soldiers falls to the ground, clutching the remains of his forearm that is now adorned with crimson tatters. Blood is pouring out of the stump, and the soldier's agony is short-lived. The sergeant curses and hastily says an army prayer for the dead.{/n}
  - After: {n}A grenade cuts him off, killing a soldier. The sergeant curses and prays.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "The rebels burned down the palace right at the start, but the governor, by the grace of the Emperor, is still alive and continues to oversee the defence efforts from a fortified command post."
  - After: "The palace burned, but the governor lives, leading from a fortified command post."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}Nothing good{/d}." {n}The sergeant sighs heavily.{/n} "Those bastards will shoot anyone walking the streets. Our own troops were ordered to fire without warning. You better move with caution, {mf|sir|ma'am} — on top of everything else, we mined the streets when we were pulling out."
  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}Nothing good{/d}." {n}He sighs.{/n} "Everyone shoots on sight. And we mined the streets, {mf|sir|ma'am}."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Affirmative, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! It's all those damned rebels — those maggots somehow got their hands on an anti-aircraft battery and it's causing our shuttles no end of trouble. That thing really packs a punch! You're lucky they missed you — I've seen them fry two shuttles carrying reinforcements, not a soul survived."
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Rebels have an anti-aircraft battery. It's downed two shuttles already."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! I couldn't have known, I wasn't notified! Had we known we were expecting such an eminent visitor, we would've... you know... at the double... with all due devotion!"
  - After: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Nobody told us!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I don't know what the situation is like there now, but the governor's personal vox operator recently made it to the starport. He left us the new vox-codes and departed on a special assignment, but not before telling us that the command post is well-reinforced and in no danger of falling."
  - After: "The governor's vox operator brought new codes and said the command post is secure."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Pah, by all the saints! I'm Sergeant Malgar, and you lot report to me now. Straighten yourselves out and drag your arses after me, I'll map out a defence sector for you." {n}By the end of his tirade, the sergeant's voice grows quieter as his eyes focus on your expensive gear.{/n}
  - After: "I'm Sergeant Malgar, you report to me. Follow me." {n}He trails off, eyeing your gear.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Halt! Weapons on the ground, or I'm firing!" {n}A man in a torn and dirty uniform hobbles toward you from behind the chunks of rockcrete and crumpled plasteel. His cracked helmet is adorned with a crooked label that reads: "Sgt Malgar."{/n}
  - After: "Halt! Weapons down!" {n}A ragged soldier, helmet labelled "Sgt Malgar."{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "If I may report, {mf|sir|ma'am}, as long as the rebels keep shooting their damned anti-aircraft battery, there is absolutely no way to shuttle you to the governor. It would have to be on foot, and the streets are dangerous."
  - After: "While that battery fires, {mf|sir|ma'am}, no shuttle can reach the governor. You'd walk dangerous streets."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I have no one to send with you as an escort — I assigned all available troops to accompany the esteemed Tech-Priest to the governor. I will vox-cast orders to them to wait for you. And I'll inform headquarters — they better send out a convoy to meet you halfway! Meanwhile, we will follow the governor's orders and hold the line here!"
  - After: "My troops escort the Tech-Priest to the governor. I'll vox them to wait for you. We hold here!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I live to serve!" {n}The sergeant's eyes are gleaming with pride. His expression is that of genuine happiness.{/n}
  - After: "I live to serve!" {n}He beams.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "All right, so our skies are in lockdown, the rebels are shooting down anything that flies, and you lot just happened to land in our rear without a scratch to show for it? And on a shuttle like that... Where did you get it? Stolen from the palace, isn't it?" {n}He is visibly awed by the resplendent gold of your transport.{/n} "Grab 'em, lads, we've got ourselves a rebel landing force!"
  - After: "Skies locked, yet you land unscathed? In a stolen palace shuttle!" {n}He gapes at the gold.{/n} "Grab 'em, lads, rebels!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I live to serve!" {n}The sergeant's grim voice rings with a martyr's pride.{/n}
  - After: "I live to serve!" {n}Grim, martyr's pride.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Among the cracked rockcrete and bent plasteel, you notice a man in the warden's uniform. He stares at the gleaming gold of your shuttle in surprise.{/n} "Did the governor send his personal guards? No matter! What are you standing there for, meat? Are you waiting for the rebels to blast your bucket again for good measure? The skies over the capital are blocked by enemy fire, all aerial traffic has been halted! What pest gave you clearance to deploy?"
  - After: {n}A warden gapes at your gold shuttle.{/n} "Governor's guards? Move, meat! The skies are closed — who cleared you to land?"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}A shadow of doubt crosses the sergeant's face.{/n} "No surprise there... It's a soldier's lot to serve and die. Not the governor's, though, that's not his duty..." {n}He gives you a flustered look.{/n}
  - After: {n}He doubts.{/n} "Soldiers serve and die. Not governors..." {n}He looks flustered.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Horror fills the sergeant's eyes.{/n} "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! We will rectify that at once! Follow my lead, you lot! I'm giving you two minutes to reload and patch yourselves up, then we are routing the rebel dregs!" {n}He roars his commands, organising his troops for what is undoubtedly a suicidal offensive.{/n}
  - After: {n}Horrified,{/n} "At once, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Reload, lads, we charge!" {n}A suicidal charge.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I live to serve!" {n}The sergeant is so astonished that he only barks out the mandated words of gratitude after a non-mandated lengthy pause.{/n} "We won't fail... We won't forget... We'll be praying to the Emperor for you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
  - After: "I live to serve!" {n}He's stunned.{/n} "We'll pray for you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "There is fighting in the capital, but we're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}holding strong{/d}, giving no quarter to the rebels! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects!" {n}The sergeant's voice is brimming with daring confidence.{/n}
  - After: "We're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}holding strong{/d}! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects!" {n}Confident.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His remark about mines lodges itself in your memory. More than anything, you will need to watch the ground and not your surroundings — you'd rather risk a shot from a rebel or a jittery soldier than experience a few handfuls of lethal frag shrapnel resting on top of some three hundred grams of explosive fyceline.{/n}
  - After: {n}Mines. Watch the ground above all.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant's answer is not particularly helpful. When danger is all around you in many forms, it is impossible to prepare for it.{/n}
  - After: {n}Unhelpful. Danger is everywhere.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}With a rasping cough, the sergeant turns back to you.{/n} "Pardon me, {mf|sir|ma'am}. Sergeant Lasse Malgar reporting! My unit is holding the starport on the governor's orders! How may I serve?"
  - After: {n}He coughs.{/n} "Sergeant Lasse Malgar, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Holding the starport for the governor! How may I serve?"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "They're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}crushing us{/d}, the scumbags. It's been a whole turn since the last reinforcements came in, we're running low on ammo, every other fighter is wounded. I don't know how bad it is in the streets, but they'll drive us out of here any minute."
  - After: "They're {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}crushing us{/d}. No reinforcements, low ammo, half wounded. We'll fall any minute."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Sergeant Lasse Malgar, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Eleventh-generation loyal soldier of House Winterscale, awarded three commendations for faultless service. Ever since the olden days, His Lordship the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} has recruited soldiers and shipwrights on Rykad Minoris, so there is no greater honour for a Rykadian than serving His Lordship with diligence!"
  - After: "Sergeant Lasse Malgar, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Eleventh-generation soldier of House Winterscale, proud to serve the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "He demanded to talk to the governor personally, so I had to send a quarter of my troops with him to keep trouble at bay."
  - After: "He demanded the governor, so I sent a quarter of my troops with him."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "My mistake, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Didn't recognise you, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Please pardon my blunder, it's a bloodbath in here—"
  - After: "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Didn't recognise you, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "My unit was here when it all went to the groxes. The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} linked to satellites reported sightings of strange voidships in the system. They were orbiting the star until one of them set course for landing on Rykad Majoris. The governor took precautionary measures and ordered to increase security at the key facilities — everyone knows that whenever something's not right, you better double the warden details. The alarm was raised, and we were sent to secure the starport. It's the only reason we were able to hold it."
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} saw strange voidships; one landing on Rykad Majoris. Guards were doubled, so we held the starport."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira frowns as her gaze grows distant, as if she is looking through the sergeant.{/n} "You're a good soldier, but you've got a lot of blood on your hands — both yours and others'. You know, the same hand that salutes now might falter in darkness. Rank and epaulettes won't save you from the bitterness..."
  - After: {n}Idira stares through him.{/n} "Much blood on your hands. The saluting hand may falter in darkness."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Pardon me, my lady, but I can't get my head 'round these fancy words you're saying. I've seen plenty of blood, but, trust me, I'll fight till my last drop!"
  - After: "Fancy words, my lady. I'll fight to my last drop!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Then Felek tore off his mask... precisely because he knew about the trouble on Rykad Minoris. He knew that none of our allies would come to our aid." {n}Cassia lets out a sorrowful sigh.{/n} "You may continue your report, peasant."
  - After: "Felek struck knowing no ally from Rykad Minoris would come." {n}Cassia sighs.{/n} "Continue, peasant."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard clears his throat.{/n} "You stand before Rogue Trader von Valancius, you ignorant worm! Snap to attention this instant and give {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} a formal report!"
  - After: {n}Abelard coughs.{/n} "This is Rogue Trader von Valancius, worm! Report to {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard turns purple.{/n} "By the Holy Throne, what is this mess..."
  - After: {n}Abelard turns purple.{/n} "What a mess..."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira glances around.{/n} "They're in a rough spot, old man. Go easy on them."
  - After: {n}Idira glances around.{/n} "Go easy on them, old man."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant shakes his head in disappointment.{/n} "Ah, if only Sergeant Davian of Tertium was here... He may have completely lost his marbles, but if I'd let him accompany you, you could have walked all the way to the governor's palace without any harm befalling you."
  - After: {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "If only Sergeant Davian of Tertium were here. Mad, but he'd get you to the governor safely."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "One of ours — a veteran. No idea how he wound up here. The man's from Atoma Prime — the other end of the galaxy. Silent chap, crazy eyes, but you should see him slay enemies of Humanity. There's none like him." {n}The sergeant casts a glance somewhere past the starport.{/n} "When it started, he went missing out in the streets somewhere. Worse news for the rebels, though: he's an absolute beast in close-quarters combat."
  - After: "Crazy-eyed veteran from Atoma Prime. Deadly up close." {n}He glances away.{/n} "Vanished into the streets."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant sighs heavily.{/n} "All of our roadblocks are gone, the whole place is in the rebels' hands. The city is {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}almost lost{/d}, so no help will come, we are surrounded by rebels. And watch your step, {mf|sir|ma'am} — the streets are chock-full of mines."
  - After: {n}He sighs.{/n} "Rebels hold everything. The city's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}almost lost{/d}. Mind the mines, {mf|sir|ma'am}."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant blushes slightly.{/n} "I live to serve!"
  - After: {n}He blushes.{/n} "I live to serve!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Another explosion interrupts the sergeant's words. With a sigh of relief, he turns to his soldiers and spits out a booming series of commands.{/n}
  - After: {n}An explosion. Relieved, he barks orders.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Ill thoughts, {mf|sir|ma'am}! We've fallen on hard times, the ground keeps shaking, things keep exploding. The people are scared, they've forgotten all about their duty. And that's when those, Emperor forgive me, 'preachers' came... They started riling everyone up! Sure enough, we shot a few, but they just kept coming, more and more of them."
  - After: "Hard times, {mf|sir|ma'am}. Quakes, scared people, then 'preachers' stirring them up. We shot some; more came."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The soldier grows more and more pale with every word you say. As soon as you are done speaking, he falls to his knees.{/n}
  - After: {n}He pales and kneels.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Unrest, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Armed rebellions in both the capital and the provinces. First the lower levels sparked, then it went up the spires — they hit the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-hubs{/g}, the arsenals, the mag-train stations."
  - After: "Unrest, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Revolts everywhere. They hit the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-hubs{/g}, arsenals, mag-trains."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/StarPort/Sergeant_InBlood/StarPort_Sergeant_InBlood

- **Player**
  - Before: "Sergeant, where are the people who were sent to assist you from my ship?"
  - After: "Sergeant, where are my ship's people?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Sergeant Malgar, I demand an immediate report! What is going on here?"
  - After: "Sergeant Malgar, report! What's going on?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Governor, would you care to explain to me what is going on here?"
  - After: "Governor, explain this."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Point your weapon at the sergeant] "How dare you treat highborn officials in such a manner?"
  - After: [Point your weapon at the sergeant] "How dare you treat highborn officials so?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Point your weapon at the sergeant] "You will drop your weapon, servant, or I will end you like a rabid dog!"
  - After: [Point your weapon at the sergeant] "Drop your weapon, servant, or die like a dog!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "There is nothing left to discuss."
  - After: "Nothing left to discuss."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Malgar, now is not the time to massacre each other. It is not the first time I have done the impossible — I will get everyone out of here, including your men."
  - After: "No massacres, Malgar. I'll get everyone out, your men too."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I agree. Let us save your people and escape this place."
  - After: "Agreed. Let's save your people and escape."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Look at yourself, servant of the God-Emperor. Whom do you serve? Humanity or its foes? How dare you speak of justice with kindred blood on your hands? Lower your weapon if you value your soul!"
  - After: "Whom do you serve, Humanity or its foes? Lower your weapon if you value your soul!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It would seem you intend to rise up against the very foundations of the Imperium."
  - After: "You'd rise against the Imperium itself."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you truly wish to see them dead? Each and every one of them?"
  - After: "You want every one of them dead?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I care nothing for these people, just get me and my retinue off this planet."
  - After: "I don't care about them. Just get my retinue off-planet."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the nobles] "Would anyone like to say anything to Sergeant Malgar?"
  - After: [Address the nobles] "Anything to say to Malgar?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are acting like an executioner. You think you have such a right?"
  - After: "By what right are you executioner?"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant holds your gaze for a long moment, then with a heavy sigh he lowers his weapon.{/n} "If anyone else had said that to me, I would have laughed and spit at their feet. But you're a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}hero of the Imperium{/d}. If even half the stories of your exploits are true... Well, I will trust you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}."
  - After: {n}He lowers his weapon.{/n} "You're a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_GreatDeed}hero of the Imperium{/d}. I'll trust you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The stench of fyceline and blood blankets the starport. Echoes of shouts and gunfire drift over the landing pads. The shards of plex-glass crunch underfoot. You recognise Sergeant Malgar amid the crowd huddled next to the shuttles — he was the soldier who greeted you upon your arrival on Rykad Minoris.{/n}
  - After: {n}Blood and gunfire. By the shuttles stands Sergeant Malgar, who greeted you on Rykad Minoris.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The governor turns to you but does not get the chance to say anything as Malgar strikes him with a stun baton.{/n} "Don't trouble yourself, Lord Governor. I'll explain myself!"
  - After: {n}Malgar stuns the governor with a baton.{/n} "Allow me, Lord Governor!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "So, since my people aren't highborn, they can be treated however you like, is that it?" {n}Malgar lets out a bestial growl as he turns to face you.{/n} "I'm not letting anyone go! I'll show them what it's like being left for dead!"
  - After: "So my people don't matter?" {n}He growls.{/n} "Nobody leaves!"
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "They already went back to your ship, {mf|sir|ma'am}." {n}Malgar is trying to sound respectful, but his voice is vibrating like a taut string.{/n} "Good people, your soldiers, they {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped us out{/d}. Unlike this carrion!" {n}He looks back at the nobles.{/n}
  - After: "Back on your ship, {mf|sir|ma'am}." {n}Taut.{/n} "They {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped us out{/d}. Unlike this carrion!" {n}The nobles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An angry murmur runs through the group of nobles. Some are uttering the deceased governor's name in horror, others are begging you to kill the deranged warden, some are hoarsely wishing eternal torment upon Malgar. But none dare to raise their voice and answer you.{/n}
  - After: {n}The nobles murmur and curse Malgar. None dare answer.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant's chest is fitted with a sturdy-looking flak vest bearing insignia customary among your troops. One of the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}enforcers you sent{/d} must have given it to Malgar as a gift.{/n}
  - After: {n}Malgar wears a flak vest from the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}enforcers you sent{/d}.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "That's not true. I am loyal to the Imperium — the Imperium of Man, the Imperium of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}. I am ready to fight the darkness among the stars and aid {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}His{/g} servants, so that His design may triumph. But I refuse to believe that the Imperium needs a bunch of arrogant nobles more than us honest workers and warriors."
  - After: "I'm loyal to the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}His{/g} design. Not to arrogant nobles."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant pauses before nodding heavily.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}, you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped{/d} us when things looked grim for us. I'll do as you say. Why you want to save these parasites, that I don't understand. But maybe not all of them deserve death."
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {mf|sir|ma'am}, you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped{/d} us. I'll obey."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant shakes his head.{/n} "No! You may have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped{/d} us, but that doesn't mean that I will be saving these leeches! But I won't stop you from leaving either, in honour of your good deeds. Save yourself, {mf|sir|ma'am}."
  - After: {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}helped{/d} us, but I won't save these leeches. You may go, {mf|sir|ma'am}."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Malgar bares his teeth like a madman.{/n} "Oh, now you feel like barking orders too, do you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Figured you could get your privileged arse off this planet before our families? Go ahead and try."
  - After: {n}Malgar grins madly.{/n} "Fleeing before our families, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Try it."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard looks at the governor's body, his brow furrowed.{/n} "Madness... punishable by death."
  - After: {n}Abelard frowns at the body.{/n} "Punishable by death."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I do! The decision to leave the commoners on the planet did come from the governor, but they supported it! They're accomplices! No one tried to stand up for us."
  - After: "I do! They all backed abandoning us."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "As much right as they do when they act as our executioners! We are but common subjects of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."
  - After: "Same right they had! We're mere subjects of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Malgar nods heavily.{/n} "All right. You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}didn't abandon{/d} us in our hour of need, and neither will we. Get aboard any of these shuttles, we'll take you to orbit."
  - After: {n}Malgar nods.{/n} "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantGrateful}didn't abandon{/d} us. Board a shuttle, we'll take you up."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Malgar aims his own weapon back at you and lets out an angry, almost deranged chuckle.{/n} "Nothing scares me anymore, {mf|sir|ma'am}, so I won't falter!"
  - After: {n}Malgar aims back, laughing madly.{/n} "Nothing scares me now, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira flinches and starts babbling desperately:{/n} "No, no, no, don't say anything, don't say anything, don't say anything..."
  - After: {n}Idira flinches.{/n} "No, no, don't say anything..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A group of bloodied and frightened people is wedged between Malgar's wardens and the shuttles. You recognise them as the governor of the planet and the members of his high-ranking entourage. Their expensive attire has been torn in the fight and many bear wounds left by bayonets.{/n}
  - After: {n}The governor and entourage cower by the shuttles, bloodied.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The chorus of the nobles' screams cannot drown out the sergeant's spiteful whisper:{/n} "Enough. You've said your piece."
  - After: {n}The sergeant whispers:{/n} "Enough. You've said your piece."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantFreeThinking}You were right{/d} when we first met, {mf|sir|ma'am}." {n}Malgar mutters through his teeth.{/n} "Now I can see that the governor is a scumbag, unworthy of even a drop of our blood."
  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_SergeantFreeThinking}You were right{/d}, {mf|sir|ma'am}." {n}He mutters.{/n} "The governor's not worth our blood."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "We don't have time for this. We need to get to the shuttle, now."
  - After: "No time. To the shuttle."
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The sergeant spins around to face you, his face a twisted grimace of anger.{/n}
  - After: {n}The sergeant spins, enraged.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "Our esteemed governor and his gang of cronies have been cowering behind us, and now, when things got rough, they thought they could scarper. And leave us here to die! We've shed our blood for him and broken our backs to provide for him! And after all this? You think that's fair, you piece of {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}groxshit{/g}?" {n}Malgar's stun baton hits the governor in the chest, causing the adornments on the governor's uniform to jingle in unison.{/n}
  - After: "They flee and leave us to die! Fair, you {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}groxshit{/g}?" {n}He strikes the governor.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: "I knew you would understand!" {n}The sergeant's voice is trembling slightly. He signals his troops and turns to the shuttle, about to board it.{/n}
  - After: "I knew you'd understand!" {n}He heads for the shuttle.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A dull thud comes from deep within the starport. Heavy footsteps shake the rockcrete, raising an unpleasant tremor in your bones.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heavy footsteps shake the starport.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}The governor spits out blood and opens his mouth to respond, when his head explodes. His body falls limp to the side, his remaining eye staring upward.{/n}
  - After: {n}The governor's head explodes.{/n}
- **Sergeant Malgar**
  - Before: {n}Malgar raises his gun at you, only to immediately lower it. His hands are shaking. Shame and despair are showing through his mask of bloodlust.{/n} "For crying out loud, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, {mf|sir|ma'am}... How could you say such a thing..."
  - After: {n}Malgar lowers his gun, ashamed.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, {mf|sir|ma'am}... How could you say that..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "For generations upon generations, the nobles of this world cared for Rykad Minoris and ensured the prosperity of its inhabitants. And this is your gratitude, peasant? For killing a nobleman, you deserve to be executed where you stand." {n}Cassia throws out her hand, and Malgar's knees buckle.{/n} "My mentor was right — the rabble truly have no honour."
  - After: "Nobles kept Rykad Minoris prosperous, peasant. Killing one means death." {n}Cassia gestures; Malgar buckles.{/n} "Rabble."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/StarPort/StarPortOfficer/StarPortOfficer_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "There is something else you are hiding from me, isn't there? More classified secrets?"
  - After: "You're hiding more secrets?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pray not for her survival, but for her honourable death, should it come to it."
  - After: "Pray for her honourable death instead."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I hope that no harm comes to her."
  - After: "I hope she comes to no harm."
- **Player**
  - Before: "And what exactly were you doing here on your own?"
  - After: "What were you doing here alone?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am a Rogue Trader. Why don't I simply order you to tell me everything? It is well within my rights."
  - After: "I'm a Rogue Trader. I order you to talk."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What if what you know is priceless intelligence? And you were to die before you could relay it to anyone?"
  - After: "What if you die before sharing priceless intelligence?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whatever punishment you are afraid of, I can do worse things to you. You had better start talking."
  - After: "I can do worse than any punishment you fear. Talk."

  - Before: "I have no more questions."
  - After: "No more questions."

  - Before: "So be it, then. You may keep your secrets."
  - After: "So be it. Keep your secrets."
- **Player**

  - After: "Have you seen an Inquisition Interrogator here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you think the governor can handle the rebellion?"
  - After: "Can the governor handle the rebellion?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Wink at Idira] "Mistress Tlass, would you kindly read all his thoughts for me?"
  - After: [Wink at Idira] "Mistress Tlass, read his thoughts?"

  - Before: "I must take my leave."
  - After: "I must go."
