  - Before: "So why did they send you to the starport?"
  - After: "Why send you to the starport?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Good. Despondency gets you dragged in front of a firing squad."
  - After: "Good. Despondency earns a firing squad."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Brutally maim him] "You know, I think I will punish you for disclosing classified information after all."
  - After: [Brutally maim him] "I'll punish your leaking after all."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Strike him] "Get out of my sight. You are a waste of my time!"
  - After: [Strike him] "Get out of my sight!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Worry not, for your Raquel is alive. I met her on Rykadi Philia."
  - After: "Raquel is alive. I met her on Rykadi Philia."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He falls to the ground with a cry. His once-handsome face has been disfigured by a deep laceration, he is missing half an ear, and his nose is crushed and twisted to one side. It is unlikely that Jaspar can afford a sawbones capable of restoring his good looks.{/n}
  - After: {n}He falls, face slashed and nose crushed, his looks ruined.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

Raquel Vekhari, the esteemed Evayne Winterscale's personal pilot. When the riot reports came from Rykadi Philia, Lord Evayne headed there personally. Then this rebellion started down here, and we lost communication. No one knows how they're doing up there."
  - After: {n}He looks away.{/n} "My betrothed, Raquel Vekhari, flew Lord Evayne Winterscale to riot-torn Rykadi Philia. Then comms died."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He shuts his eyes, bracing for an attack on his mind.{/n} "With all due respect, my {mf|lord|lady}, I can't let you do that! My mind is like rockcrete, so even your witch couldn't pull a thing out of it." {n}Though, he doesn't sound particularly confident.{/n}

  - Before: {n}He grimaces and blushes, but still shakes his head.{/n} "I can't. I just can't. I'm an aide... a confidant!"
  - After: {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "I can't. I'm a confidant!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The esteemed and honourable scion of blessed Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale, master of the Rykad System. At the behest of his illustrious father... or grandfather... or uncle... well, his illustrious relative, Lord Evayne took up residence on Rykad Minoris."
  - After: "Scion of Rogue Trader Calligos Winterscale, master of the Rykad System. He lives on Rykad Minoris."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Emperor protects, my {mf|lord|lady}. If someone you love is in trouble right now, may He protect them too."
  - After: "The Emperor protects, my {mf|lord|lady}. Your loved ones too."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Forgive me, my {mf|lord|lady}, but my wish is to see my Raquel alive again. She's... She's everything to me."
  - After: "Forgive me, my {mf|lord|lady}, I want Raquel alive. She's everything."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jaspar smiles, but his smile looks a little less carefree than a few moments ago.{/n}
  - After: {n}His smile dims.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He stops talking — a little too abruptly.{/n}
  - After: {n}He stops — too abruptly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}This chatty officer is every spy's dream. He is pathologically incapable of keeping his mouth shut.{/n}
  - After: {n}A spy's dream: he can't shut up.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It was my pleasure to be of service to you, my {mf|lord|lady}. It's been nice to chat to someone... normal." {n}He glances warily at the body of the nearest blinded lunatic.{/n}
  - After: "My pleasure, my {mf|lord|lady}. Nice talking to someone normal." {n}He eyes a corpse.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well, all right, if you really are a Rogue Trader, I'll tell you everything."
  - After: "If you're a Rogue Trader, I'll tell all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well, that would make me a saboteur and a traitor, wouldn't it? Yes, you're right! This is an emergency!" {n}He looks relieved.{/n}
  - After: "I'd be a traitor! Yes, it's an emergency!" {n}Relieved.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I give up. No need to do anything to me." {n}He does not look frightened, however — relieved is more like it. He glances around with a conspiratorial look and whispers,{/n} "Please don't tell anyone, all right? Or the governor will make sure I'm punished."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jaspar's face quickly turns grey as he says,{/n} "I have. But I don't know where he is now. I'm sorry, but I don't like discussing the affairs of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}."
  - After: {n}He goes grey.{/n} "I have, but don't know where he is. The {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} scares me."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I have studied several deceased individuals with similar injuries. Their sensory organs were removed by means of thermal influence of concentrated light beams. - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There's not much anyone could tell you about it.   - Before: {n}He gives you a pleading look.{/n} "Please don't torment me like this, my {mf|lord|lady}! I wish I could tell you, but it's absolutely prohibited."
  - After: {n}Pleading:{/n} "It's forbidden, my {mf|lord|lady}!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jaspar mumbles evasively,{/n} "Well, obviously. I'm not some pessimist to say otherwise..."
  - After: {n}Evasive:{/n} "Obviously. I'm no pessimist..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You really won't? Well then, if you ask me, things are pretty rotten!" {n}His words come flying at the rate of stubber fire.{/n} "Those rebels are strange. We would've easily quelled a normal riot — we're not some commoners, we're Rykadians, the naval elite of House Winterscale. But those people, they're... vicious. They know no fear."
  - After: "Then things are rotten!" {n}He gushes.{/n} "We Rykadian elite could crush a normal riot. These rebels are vicious, fearless."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Is this a test, my {mf|lord|lady}? Everything will be fine, victory will be ours, glory to House Winterscale."
  - After: "A test, my {mf|lord|lady}? Glory to House Winterscale."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And their attacks, they're so precise, it's like they know what's going to happen ahead of time. The command executed seven officers on suspicion of espionage, but it's not about spying. - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm supposed to deliver updated {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-codes and, how should I put it... assess the situation. The Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium had sent out a distress call before it went dark."
  - After: "Delivering new {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-codes. Rebels tapped the vox-net. The Hallowed Electrodynamic Cenobium called for help, then went dark."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It is beginning to sound like he is complaining.{/n} "That place is creepy. They say they order shuttles with servants from Rykad Minoris on a regular basis.   - After: {n}He grumbles.{/n} "Creepy. They ship servants from Rykad Minoris. None return."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}?" {n}After casting a quick glance over your gear, he nods in understanding.{/n} "Oh, so you must be from House von Valancius's ship!   - After: "A {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}?" {n}He eyes your gear.{/n} "House von Valancius! Augurs saw your shuttle meet a strange unidentified ship, which then left."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The fault is mine! I beg your forgiveness, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Orders are orders..." {n}He shrinks, looking at you in terror, and departs with haste. It seems your anger scares him far more than the prospect of running into more rebels.{/n}
  - After: "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}He flees in terror.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You know what I'm afraid of? That they'll come back, and those rebel scumbags will shoot them out of the sky. I wanted to find a place that's high up, set up a vox-caster there, and send them a transmission: 'The sky is closed off, don't try to land.' But I didn't make it in time — those blind dogs chased after me, and as I was running, I tripped and broke the caster." {n}He hangs his head sadly.{/n} "I worry for her. She's an excellent pilot, but I still worry."
  - After: "I fear they'll be shot down returning. I tried to vox a warning, but broke the caster fleeing the blind ones." {n}He hangs his head.{/n} "I worry."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He glances at you sadly and says,{/n} "But still, I can't divulge anything classified. You may be a Rogue Trader, but I have my orders. And if I don't follow them, the governor will have my tongue ripped out and demote me to a servitor."
  - After: {n}Sadly:{/n} "But secrets stay secret, or the governor makes me a servitor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young, shaggy-haired soldier is still pale; nonetheless, as you approach, he holsters his pistol — the hallmark of good discipline. He gives you a somewhat frightened but genuine smile.{/n} "Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}. You arrived in the nick of time. I don't know what those babbling creeps wanted with me, but it definitely wasn't anything good."
  - After: {n}A pale young soldier holsters his pistol, smiling.{/n} "Thanks, my {mf|lord|lady}. Those babbling creeps meant me harm."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Really? That's marvellous! May the Emperor protect you for a thousand years and then a thousand more for bringing me such good news!" {n}He beams in elation.{/n} "I'll name my firstborn after you, I swear! In fact, I'll name all my children after you!"
  - After: "Marvellous! Emperor bless you!" {n}He beams.{/n} "I'll name all my children after you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You're right, we shouldn't stay here or we might run into rebels. I'll go find a safe place to watch the sky for any landing shuttles. May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protect you, my {mf|lord|lady}."
  - After: "Right. I'll watch the sky for shuttles. {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protect you, my {mf|lord|lady}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jaspar's face betrays a fierce inner struggle before he blurts out,{/n} "You know what I think? I find it curious that blessed Calligos didn't make him the ruler of our world.   - After: {n}He blurts,{/n} "Calligos never made Lord Evayne ruler. I think he's exiled!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Mercy! I... I confided in you and only you... It won't happen again, I swear! The telltale brand you left on his face is crying blood, staining the rockcrete.{/n}
  - After: "Mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I'll never talk again! Spare me!" {n}He backs away, bleeding.{/n}

  - Before: {n}He pales, his eyes darting between you and Idira.{/n} "N-no need, my {mf|lord|lady}!   - Before: {n}Idira scoffs and rubs her hands together in excitement.{/n} "She can see into the future, is that right? We'll see about that — she's up against the wrong psyker!   - After: {n}Idira grins.{/n} "Sees the future? So do I. Hers looks dim now the Lord Captain's involved."

  - After: "As if there's much in there..." {n}Idira sighs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Only now does Jaspar notice Cassia, and his eyes go wide with fear. He opens and closes his mouth a few times helplessly like a fish, unable to utter a sound. Instead, he just nods nervously.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lucky Jaspar, the governor's aide and personal vox operator. I was dispatched to the starport on special orders," {n}the young man proclaims, desperately trying to tame his tousled hair.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "All thanks to you, my {mf|lord|lady}. Those blind lunatics are all over the city right now! - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He lowers his voice and adds with gravity,{/n} "The command doesn't want anyone to talk about it, but I've heard whispers that it's not just some nonsense — it's heresy, actual heresy. - **(conversation owner)**

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/StarPort/StarPortPilot/StarPortPilot_dialogue 

- **Player**
  - Before: "What was that weapon they fired at us?"
  - After: "What weapon fired at us?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pilot dressed in a crumpled uniform adorned with the von Valancius coat of arms still looks quite pale. Her white hands bear red marks left by the wheel. The scream of terror she let out when the missile flew right past your shuttle is etched in your memory.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your pilot is still pale from the near miss.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, the pilot is right — we cannot put your life at such risk. We will have to wait until the governor's forces deal with this menace... or until the rebels run out of shells... Surely they aren't sitting on a whole depot of them..."
  - After: "She's right, Lord Captain. We wait until the governor's forces stop it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Can't say I know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but the shots it fires certainly fly quick. I've never seen guns like that before. And they were firing from far away — almost from beyond the bar... the horizon, that is. Who gave those yobs a terrifying contraption like that?"
  - After: "No idea, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Fast, long-range, never seen the like."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My bad, there, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Senior flyer... Senior pilot Nimas, appointed by the senior deck officer to serve on your personal shuttle."
  - After: "Senior pilot Nimas, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm awful sorry, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but... I can't. The Emperor saved us once, but if they shoot at us again, we'll be blown to smithereens for sure. If I get Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} killed in such a daft fashion, {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Saint Drusus{/g} will make me polish white-hot wing flaps with my tongue after I kick the bucket!"
  - After: "I can't, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They'd blow us apart. Kill Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Saint Drusus{/g} would punish me!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her voice quivers slightly, but even her fear cannot stop her from using typical voidsman jargon,{/n} "That was some f-flight, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If we'd been a little less lucky, we'd be checking in at the port in the sky right now."
  - After: {n}Shaky:{/n} "Some f-flight, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Nearly died."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The kilotons of venom and {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}hubris{/d} in your voice have a miraculous effect on the rabble: the two trembling women instantly fall to their knees.{/n} "F-forgive us, my {mf|lord|lady}! Have mercy!"
  - After: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Nobility}hubris{/d} floors them.{/n} "F-forgive us, my {mf|lord|lady}!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something in your voice — genuine {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}sincerity{/d}, or notes of shame — causes both women to lower their gazes. One after another, they drop to their knees.{/n} "M-m-mercy! They bamboozled us... frightened us..."
  - After: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Shame}sincerity{/d} makes them kneel.{/n} "Mercy! They tricked us..."
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: {n}The red-haired woman breathes a sigh of intense relief.{/n} "Thank you! Thank you so, so, so much!"
  - After: {n}The redhead sighs.{/n} "Thank you!"
- **Gloomy Rebel**
  - Before: "That's enough whining, lads. We won't be getting any more visitors. We've {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}lopped the heads{/d} off all of them! And as for that coward, I gave her a taste of my true sight — where's she gonna go?" {n}The portly woman gestures toward the redhead. Her eclectic gear has clearly been scavenged from her less lucky friends as well as foes.{/n}
  - After: "Enough whining. We {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}lopped the heads{/d} off every visitor! That coward's had my true sight." {n}She points at the redhead.{/n}
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "Well, we... er... our entire crew joined the rebels and we tagged along. The Chief, well — he's the Chief. He's in charge because he used to work under the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Red Robes{/g} and man their heavy machinery. He's not here. He only comes over to check up on us every now and then! He wrote us a manual for operating this big boy, but it only does what it's supposed to do half the time! The previous shift got all maimed. We haven't been here long and we're already head to toe in burns. Let us go, will you? We won't be insurging again!"
  - After: "Our crew joined the rebels. The Chief once ran {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Red Robes{/g} machinery; he visits sometimes. His manual half works. The last shift got maimed. Let us go?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An ancient anti-aircraft battery of impressive proportions casts a dark shadow on the ground. Kneeling in the shadow is a red-haired woman with gaping black holes where her eyes once were. She is feverishly scrambling for something on the ground around her, dully repeating, "Light... light... light..."{/n}
  - After: {n}Beneath the battery, the blinded redhead gropes about, muttering, "Light... light..."{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g} cannot hide his amazement as he listens to the confessions of this paper press operator, who has been unceremoniously thrust into the ranks of the gunners and is now in charge of aiming this formidable anti-aircraft battery. His visor's lens gradually turns scarlet.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s visor turns scarlet.{/n}
- **Gloomy Rebel**
  - Before: "We may be rebels, but you — you're all blind! But don't worry... you'll be made to see! For Aurora and the Final Dawn!"
  - After: "You're blind! You'll be made to see! For the Final Dawn!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/TaintedStreets/Hostages_RM/Hostages_RM_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "You believed the heretic lies. You sold your soul to the Archenemy. But if you renounce this path, you will still have a chance to be truly saved."
  - After: "You believed heretic lies and sold your soul. Renounce this path and you may still be saved."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Think about it. What good has the Final Dawn done for anyone at all? Some have died. Some have had their eyes burnt out. Some have gone insane."
  - After: "What good has the Final Dawn done? People died, were blinded, went insane."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kill the old man] "Your family will be taken care of. As for you, I condemn you to death."
  - After: [Kill the old man] "Your family will be cared for. You, I condemn to death."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What are you trying to 'save' them from, and who is behind all of this?"
  - After: "Save them from what? Who is behind this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "No, you tell me: who are you and what are you doing to these unfortunates?"
  - After: "No, you tell me: who are you, and what are you doing to them?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have been torturing your own family in order to 'save' them? You have been blinding them so that they could see the truth?"
  - After: "You torture your family to 'save' them? Blind them to make them see?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I, Rogue Trader von Valancius, order you to release the hostages at once!"
  - After: "I, Rogue Trader von Valancius, order you to release the hostages!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What you are doing is no salvation. Stop taking your fear out on the innocent. It will neither ease your suffering nor rid you of fear."
  - After: "This is no salvation. Hurting the innocent won't ease your suffering or your fear."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Aurora, whoever that is, has exploited your naivety. Can't you see you are causing nothing but suffering?"
  - After: "This Aurora exploited your naivety. Can't you see you only cause suffering?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Arguing with you is pointless. Prepare to die!"
  - After: "Arguing is pointless. Prepare to die!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Look what fear has done to you! I see my past self in you — broken, humiliated, cloaked in disgrace! Is that how you wish to be remembered by the Emperor's servants?"
  - After: "Fear has broken you, as it once broke me — disgraced. Is that how the Emperor's servants should remember you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your family may go. And so may you — but make sure I do not ever see you again."
  - After: "Your family may go. You too — but never let me see you again."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Some ten people, children among them, are huddling together in fear. The elder family members are doing what they can to calm the young. Several armed insurgents are watching the frightened yet {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}unharmed{/d} hostages, but the watchers themselves are looking around nervously.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ten hostages, children too, huddle {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}unharmed{/d}. Nervous insurgents guard them.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Some ten people, children among them, are huddling together in fear. You see that half of them have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}black holes where their eyes used to be{/d}. Some maintain a gloomy silence. Others are wailing. Several armed insurgents are carefully watching over the terrified hostages, snapping every now and then at someone for shaking too much or crying too loudly.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ten hostages huddle, half with {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}black holes where their eyes used to be{/d}.{/n}
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "Come to your senses, Aryld! Look what you're doing to your own family!" {n}A woman of about sixty, grey-haired but still strong, is kneeling before a stocky man with a thick pure-white beard, stretching her arms toward him.{/n} "Take pity on us! Let us go!"
  - After: "Aryld, stop!" {n}A grey-haired woman kneels before a white-bearded man.{/n} "Let us go!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Can't you see I'm trying to save you?" {n}The man clutches his weapon tightly.{/n} "Only Aurora can help us! Why can't you understand that?" {n}Upon seeing you, the man points his weapon at you. The other insurgents do the same.{/n} "Who are you and what do you want?"
  - After: "I'm saving you!" {n}He grips his weapon.{/n} "Only Aurora can help!" {n}He aims at you.{/n} "Who are you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Stop talking and embrace redemption! Our children have gained true sight, while you still believe the lie!" {n}Upon seeing you, the man points his weapon at you. The other insurgents do the same.{/n} "Who are you and why are you here?"
  - After: "Our children have true sight!" {n}He aims at you.{/n} "Who are you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The old man gestures to the other insurgents, who lower their weapons. Then he shifts his gaze to you, trying to hold back tears.{/n} "What happens to us now?"
  - After: {n}He lowers his men's weapons, near tears.{/n} "What now?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The old man's body falls to the ground. As soon as the hostages see it, they start moving faster and soon disappear around the bend.{/n}
  - After: {n}He falls. The hostages flee.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm the Chief. My former name, Aryld, is meaningless now. I am a father leading his family to deliverance from woes — to salvation! Aurora has opened my eyes to the truth — and my children will see it!"
  - After: "I'm the Chief, not Aryld. A father leading his family to salvation!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The old man sighs heavily.{/n} "I don't need your mercy. Protect my family — and as for my own fate, I place it in your hands!"
  - After: {n}He sighs.{/n} "Protect my family. My fate is yours."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Aurora is no enemy of mine! No one will take the light of truth away from me!"
  - After: "No one takes Aurora's light from me!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No! They will be saved and you can't stop it! Attack!"
  - After: "They will be saved! Attack!"
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: {n}The old woman rises from her knees and approaches her husband.{/n} "I know you were trying to save us. But {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}there's still a way to set things right{/d}."
  - After: {n}His wife approaches.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Early}You can still set it right{/d}."
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "There's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}no washing{/d} the blood from your hands. But you could at least let us go, Aryld! The ones you haven't mutilated yet."
  - After: "There's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}no washing{/d} that blood off. Let the rest go!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "All of my adopted and blood children are here. I raised them all as my own. And now I must protect them. Help them see."
  - After: "All my children, adopted and blood. I must help them see."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "At Aurora's behest! Aurora is a great prophet and a great warrior. Their face is shrouded, but their gaze pierces the veil of time and sees into the future! I always knew the governor's dogs were hiding the truth from us, and now, the day has come: a prophet has come to Rykad Minoris and opened our eyes! The end of the world is coming — the Final Dawn. And only those who accept Aurora's truth will survive it!"
  - After: "Aurora commands it! A shrouded prophet-warrior who sees the future! The Final Dawn is coming — only Aurora's faithful will survive!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I remember when the Vizsier used to sew our eyes shut so that His young spinners would see the truth." {n}Kibellah's voice sounds hollow, but there are glowing embers of fury in her eyes.{/n} "Our ritual was one of service to Him. It tempered and prepared us for our duty. What you are working here is despicable heresy, a blasphemous mockery of our sacred disciplines."
  - After: "The Vizsier sewed our eyes shut in His service." {n}Kibellah seethes.{/n} "This is heresy mocking that rite."
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "Aryld! Spare us! Spare your children!"
  - After: "Aryld! Spare your children!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The hostages begin to leave and soon the group disappears around one of the bends. The old man looks away from them and walks in the opposite direction. His shoulders shake with sobs every now and then.{/n}
  - After: {n}The hostages leave. The old man walks away, sobbing.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Those who lack faith cannot grasp the truth and will not be saved!" {n}The old man is obstinate, but you sense that the confidence in his voice has diminished.{/n}
  - After: "The faithless won't be saved!" {n}He wavers.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You will not lead me astray from the true path! I will save you, my children!"
  - After: "I'll save you, my children!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "His mind and soul are pierced by shards of a colourful deception. Hues once twisted by despair and the Immaterium's influence can never be the same again."
  - After: "Colourful deception pierces his soul. Twisted hues never mend."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But... all I wanted was to save... I..." {n}The man drops his weapon and covers his face with his hands in desperation. You hear several short sobs.{/n}
  - After: "I only wanted to save..." {n}He drops his weapon, sobbing.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's vox hisses furiously,{/n} "Layperson, cognition is not your primary function. You are saving your kin by holding them at gunpoint and believe that burning their eyes will grant them sight. It is evident that the author of the demagogic teaching that confused you meant to make a mockery of your deplorable intellect."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's vox hisses,{/n} "Layperson, burning eyes grants no sight. This doctrine mocks your feeble intellect."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But... they said the end was near! They promised salvation! I wanted nothing else!" {n}The man's weapon falls from his hands to the ground. He clutches his head.{/n}
  - After: "They promised salvation!" {n}He drops his weapon.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard's face turns a deep red.{/n} "To cast your own children into the thrall of heresy... To drown your progeny in this filth with your own hands!"
  - After: {n}Abelard flushes.{/n} "Drowning your children in heresy!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/TaintedStreets/StolenVox/StolenVox_RM_dialog

  - Before: "So we have taken back the caster and now we are going to return it to the governor. You will not be spied on anymore."

- **Player**
  - Before: [Enter the code from the found note]
  - After: [Enter the code from the note]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Now I see you were not responsible for the ambushes."
  - After: "I see you weren't behind the ambushes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Those who allowed this vox-caster to end up in the wrong hands are guilty of criminal negligence."
  - After: "Whoever let this vox-caster fall into wrong hands is criminally negligent."

  - After: {n}The screen glows green.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

Let it be revealed to you that the enemy is about to receive reinforcements. Remember the name: {name} von Valancius. {mf|His|Her} ship has already entered the system. We should expect this enemy to appear near our positions. Whoever rids our comrades of this threat will be granted Aurora's special blessing: a chance to stand at the prophet's side when the hour comes. Be vigilant!
Let the Final Dawn come!"{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}New missive: "Aurora's Harbingers wish you to know, comrades, that the von Valancius ship is heading for the Navigators' station. You've got {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}time{/d} to prepare a warm welcome for the enemy."{/n}
  - After: {n}"Von Valancius heads for the Navigators' station. You have {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}time{/d} to prepare."{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

But you must anticipate the worst and do everything to make sure von Valancius's path definitively {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}ends{/d} on Rykad Minoris."{/n}
  - After: {n}"Von Valancius left for Rykadi Philia. If they survive, their path {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Raycad_Late}ends{/d} on Rykad Minoris."{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} look favourably upon you. You overcome the cogitator's defences.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} favour you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}This time, the {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} are apathetic toward your cause. You fail to overcome the cogitator's defences.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} ignore you.{/n}
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: "If you say so, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. But I'd imagine those folks are goners already. You can't exactly call them to account now."
  - After: "Sure, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. They're likely dead anyway."
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: "Yes... looks like one of ours — all our squads use them... So, does this mean those bastards could have been eavesdropping on us all this time? That was why my squad got ambushed!"
  - After: "One of ours... So they heard everything? That's why my squad got ambushed!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A message archive loads up. Judging by the accompanying notes, the messages were meticulously transferred from paper to the sacred machine storage.{/n}
  - After: {n}A message archive loads.{/n}
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: "Good. That means at least my comrades didn't die for nothing... There won't be any more ambushes thanks to them — and you!"
  - After: "Good. My comrades didn't die for nothing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator's screen reads: "Access code required."{/n}
  - After: {n}"Access code required."{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Looks like? Are you blind, layperson? Every vox-caster is unique! The distinct defects on the cover, the number signature on the antenna, the scintillating spectrum of the vid-screen! How can you possibly mistake one for another?" {n}Rasping indignantly, the Tech-Priest pokes a finger at the vox-caster, which looks completely indistinguishable from any other vox-caster you have ever seen.{/n}
  - After: "Looks like? Every vox-caster is unique, layperson!" {n}Pasqal jabs at a perfectly ordinary vox-caster.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}"Tell the Harbingers we've intercepted a convoy of the governor's underlings who were supposed to meet that von Valancius {mf|bloke|lass}. Only one out of the whole convoy got away, but he's not long for this world. No one's making it to the governor's hole — not that youngster or the ones he's supposed to meet. Our comrades have got their hands on a guard's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-caster{/g}, and these fools have no clue we can hear all their comms! We know their every movement and we're going to throw them a fine welcome party. Aurora must have no doubts that we'll do whatever it takes to stop her enemies.
Let the Final Dawn come!"{/n}
  - After: {n}"We ambushed the governor's convoy meant to meet that von Valancius {mf|bloke|lass}. One escaped, dying. With a stolen {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox-caster{/g} we hear their comms.

- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: "Like I'd expect anything different... Accusations is all you nobles ever do..."
  - After: "Figures. Nobles only accuse..."
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: "Phew... thank you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I'm telling you — I would never — I'm no rat!"
  - After: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I'm no rat!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/TaintedStreets/YoungGuard

- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not require an escort. I can get there on my own."
  - After: "I need no escort. I'll go alone."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/TaintedStreets/YoungGuard/YoungGuard_RM_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Enough talking. Let's go to the command centre."
  - After: "Enough. To the command centre."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is it, soldier? Why are you so nervous?"
  - After: "Why so nervous, soldier?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your uniform looks odd on you, soldier. As if it belongs to someone else."
  - After: "Your uniform looks like someone else's, soldier."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Has the governor tried negotiating with the insurgents? Offering them aid? Tax relief?"
  - After: "Has the governor tried negotiating? Aid? Tax relief?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How did you make it out alive if your entire convoy perished?"
  - After: "How did you survive when your whole convoy died?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What can you tell me about the insurgency?"
  - After: "What about the insurgency?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you implying that it is the governor's fault and he has been failing in his duties?"
  - After: "You imply the governor failed in his duties?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not dare badmouth your lawful governor, let alone justify the rebellion, in the presence of a Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Never badmouth your governor or justify rebellion before a Rogue Trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There's not a lot to tell... We were taught that the ungrateful rabble often rebels against the lawful authorities," {n}comes Camille's rote answer. But then he continues in a slightly different tone.{/n} "For the past couple of years, we... er... haven't been doing very well."
  - After: "Rabble rebel," {n}Camille recites, then softens.{/n} "But times have been bad."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The ungrateful rabble rose in rebellion against the planet's lawful governor and His Lordship Calligos Winterscale, our ruler by the will of the Emperor! They are all heretics deserving of a most terrible death. Order will be restored. The guilty will be punished!"
  - After: "Heretics rose against the governor and Lord Calligos Winterscale! They'll burn!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Two major earthquakes in both hemispheres, with lots of casualties and destruction. Then the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} tinkered with something they shouldn't have, and we had lives lost to a series of substation explosions. Then, on top of all that, there were the new taxes. The governor needed to be able to report to His Lordship Calligos that the army's numbers and equipment supplies had increased as planned..." {n}The young man falls silent and looks at you with apprehension.{/n}
  - After: "Two deadly earthquakes. {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} blew up substations. Then taxes, to swell the army for Lord Calligos..." {n}He falls silent.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s words make Private Regias grow pale and instinctively pull his helmet down tighter.{/n}
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s words make Regias pale.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The soldier grows paler still.{/n} "Please forgive me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I... was left all alone... and it's been scary, waiting for you. That's why..."
  - After: {n}He pales.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Waiting alone was scary."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!" {n}The soldier draws himself up and goes to adjust his gear.{/n} "It's a new uniform. The guards are in a difficult situation right now, so we often get issued whatever's left... and it isn't always the right size."
  - After: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!" {n}He adjusts it.{/n} "We get whatever uniforms are left."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I beg of you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I'm not implying anything! Why would I? I'm just... telling you what's been happening."
  - After: "I imply nothing, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't know, I just... did somehow? There was an ambush, everything was going boom and bang around me, and I kept firing back till I saw our commander lying there with a hole in his head, and everybody else, too... I was alive, and the enemy had retreated."
  - After: "I don't know! Ambush, explosions, I kept firing — then everyone lay dead."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protected me!" {n}the soldier replies with confidence.{/n} "I didn't run, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, if that's what you're thinking! I was by my commander's side until the very end. I shot the last rebel from the gang that attacked us. But alas... the captain succumbed to his wounds, and the others had already died. The Emperor rest their souls!"
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protected me!" {n}he says firmly.{/n} "I didn't run, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I shot the last rebel, but the captain died."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't know when they first began to appear but they've definitely been out there for at least a year. Some got caught and burned, of course. But heretic burnings aren't exactly rare. They catch someone every month. That's why nobody noticed the new ones for a while. But as soon as the rebellion started, there were hundreds of them coming out of the woodwork. Wandering about, muttering away... and none of them had eyes. You'll see for yourself, there's plenty of them on this highway. So that's that. You can't tell anymore if the rebellion's just because of the taxes and the disasters or... if the end of the world really is coming."
  - After: "They've been around a year, unnoticed. When the rebellion began, hundreds appeared, eyeless. Is it taxes and disasters... or the end of the world?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Your mouth is full of mud, soldier. You are hiding something behind beaming hues of faith and loyalty... What is it?"
  - After: "Your mouth is full of mud, soldier. What do you hide?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The soldier gulps nervously under the stern gaze of Cassia's ruby eyes.{/n} "F-fear, I guess? In times like these, if you give in to weakness, you're done for. And I'm not done with life just yet."
  - After: {n}He gulps under Cassia's gaze.{/n} "F-fear? Weakness gets you killed."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira winces, glances at you, then shakes her head.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira winces, shaking her head.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So, about the rebellion — where was I... well, there were rumours that it was all happening for a reason. The earthquakes, the red robes' problems... And then there were those weird prophets. No eyes — scratched them out themselves, by the looks of it — and they kept going on about the Final Dawn. You know, the end of the world is near, repent or you'll be doomed, that sort of thing."
  - After: "Rumour said it happened for a reason. Then self-blinded prophets preached the Final Dawn."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! The command centre is a straight walk from the starport. It's at the end of the Upperway, not too far from here. But we must proceed carefully. Emperor forbid we get ambushed again..."
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! The command centre is at the end of the Upperway. Carefully, though..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. We have to take this avenue: it leads from the starport right to the command centre. It's a short walk!"
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. This avenue leads to the command centre."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The success-to-failure ratio of combat objectives completion for this world's military speaks to its subpar efficiency. I will advise the local ruler to seek my fraternity's aid in upgrading their troops to servitor maniples."
  - After: "Subpar military. I'll advise upgrading them to servitor maniples."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The soldier sinks his head into his shoulders.{/n} "Understood, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Apologies, {mf|sir|ma'am}!"
  - After: {n}He cringes.{/n} "Yes, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Apologies, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ha! When has any noble ever tried negotiating with riffraff?" {n}The soldier bites his tongue.{/n} "Which is to say no, he hasn't. And to tell you the truth... I don't think it would've helped. There's more to this rebellion than meets the eye..."
  - After: "Ha! Nobles negotiating?" {n}He bites his tongue.{/n} "No. There's more to this rebellion..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young man in a planetary guard uniform looks very pale. There is a feverish gleam in his eyes.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship? At last! Private Camille Regias at your command! I—" {n}He hesitates.{/n} "I was in the convoy the governor sent out to meet you. The convoy was ambushed by rebels! I'm the only survivor. Nevertheless, I'm ready to show you the way to the command centre where the governor is awaiting you!"
  - After: {n}A pale, feverish guardsman.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Private Camille Regias! I—" {n}He hesitates.{/n} "Rebels ambushed your escort convoy; I alone survived. I'll take you to the governor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A young man in a planetary guard uniform salutes you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Private Camille Regias, ready to escort you to the command centre for your meeting with the governor! I regret to say that the convoy sent to meet you was ambushed and took critical losses in heavy fighting against the rebels. In other words, I'm the only survivor. However, the rebel force was destroyed as well. We can set out for the command centre!"
  - After: {n}A guardsman salutes.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Private Camille Regias! Rebels ambushed your escort; I alone survived, but they're dead. To the command centre!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/TaintedStreets/YoungGuardSuspected/YoungGuardSuspected_RM_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Cowardice is shameful for a soldier of the Emperor."
  - After: "Cowardice shames a soldier of the Emperor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The battlefield looks highly suspicious. Half of your comrades never even had the chance to draw their weapons. And the direction of the shots, as well — the attackers knew exactly what path the group would take and how large it would be."
  - After: "Suspicious. Half your comrades never drew weapons, and the shots show the attackers knew your route and numbers."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Aim your weapon at the private] "Too many parts of your story fail to add up. I am beginning to wonder if you are a traitor."
  - After: [Aim your weapon at the private] "Your story doesn't add up. Are you a traitor?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Glory to the fallen warriors! They will not be forgotten. Let's keep walking."
  - After: "Glory to the fallen! They won't be forgotten. Let's go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is that what your gift of prophecy is telling you?"
  - After: "Is your gift of prophecy telling you that?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "So, you are the traitor. You led your convoy into an ambush, didn't you?"
  - After: "So you're the traitor. You led your convoy into the ambush?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kill the private] "In times of war, it is better to execute an innocent than to have a mole in one's ranks!"
  - After: [Kill the private] "In war, better to execute an innocent than keep a mole!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How curious. That is the second squad under your lead that ended up in a rebel ambush. Do you have anything to say in your defence, private?"
  - After: "Curious. The second squad you led into a rebel ambush. Your defence, private?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Help the wounded man] "It is all right. We're going to bandage you up and continue on our way."
  - After: [Help the wounded man] "It's all right. We'll bandage you and move on."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Help the wounded man] "I shall help you now, but as soon as we reach the governor, you are going into custody."
  - After: [Help the wounded man] "I'll help you, but at the governor's you go into custody."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Finish the wounded man] "Enough. I cannot afford the risk of dragging a potential rebel spy along."
  - After: [Finish the wounded man] "Enough. I can't risk dragging a rebel spy along."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Watch your tongue, Tlass. Say another word and you will be next."
  - After: "Watch your tongue, Tlass, or you're next."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let's go. Now is no time for grief."
  - After: "Let's go. No time for grief."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Our poor lads... they deserve proper last honours... not to be lying here like this..." {n}Camille looks away from the bodies.{/n}
  - After: "Our poor lads..." {n}Camille looks away.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young man sighs.{/n} "The remains of my squad. Once we've put down the rebellion, they'll be given the last honours they deserve as soldiers fallen in a righteous battle."
  - After: {n}He sighs.{/n} "My squad. They'll get honours later."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The soldier looks around, a little dazed. He is pressing his hand down on a fresh wound.{/n} "How is this possible..."
  - After: {n}Dazed, he presses a fresh wound.{/n} "How..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The wounded young man looks at you spitefully and hisses,{/n} "Your victory means nothing! Aurora will come for you... and even if she doesn't — no one will escape the Final Dawn!"
  - After: {n}He hisses,{/n} "Aurora will come! No one escapes the Final Dawn!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young man looks at you in slight confusion.{/n} "I don't know what you're talking about... Yes, we were ambushed... but it was all over so quickly. It's a miracle I survived. I was lucky to be behind cover when it began."
  - After: {n}Confused.{/n} "It was fast. I was lucky to be in cover."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The enemy is smart and cunning. Perhaps they were watching us? I must report this to the governor!"
  - After: "Were they watching us? I must tell the governor!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Warped if I know. With this cacophony in my head there's no damn telling if it's their voices or my gut feeling. Either way, my instinct tells me that he's innocent."
  - After: "Warped if I know. My gut says he's innocent."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ha ha ha... no! Your entire convoy's gone. I took that whining pup Camille's uniform. Six months with the governor's underlings taught me their ways. I had no trouble posing as one of them. I had to make sure you scum didn't decide to turn around and fly home, instead of walking straight into the ambush." {n}The young man rasps and spits bloody foam.{/n} "Don't let it go to your head that you took us down. My comrades are many and they are coming for you. And if they are not... Anyway, you'll see for yourself!"
  - After: "Ha! Your convoy's dead. I took that pup Camille's uniform and led you into the ambush." {n}He spits blood.{/n} "My comrades are coming!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A spark of madness flashes through the young man's eyes.{/n} "Aurora is the hidden truth. No one is worthy of seeing her face! But those who are loyal to her will stand by her side at the hour of the Final Dawn that will consume all! They will, but not you. You are an enemy of Aurora, and so you will be vanquished."
  - After: {n}Madness flashes.{/n} "Aurora is the hidden truth! Her faithful will stand beside her at the Final Dawn. Not you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do not fear death at the hands of filthy dogs mired in their own lies! Take my soul, Aurora!"
  - After: "I don't fear liars! Take my soul, Aurora!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The guard opens his eyes widely, incredulous to the last that this is the end.{/n}
  - After: {n}His eyes widen in disbelief.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Blast you, scum! Aurora will get you all the same! Aurora and the Final Dawn!"
  - After: "Blast you! Aurora and the Final Dawn!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Uh-huh," {n}the guard says gloomily and looks away.{/n}
  - After: "Uh-huh," {n}he mutters.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What? No! I'm— I'm not a traitor! I'd never lead my fellows into the line of fire... Never!"
  - After: "No! I'm no traitor!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young man's eyes widen. Until his very last moment, they are filled with shock and disbelief at the crushing reality he is facing.{/n}
  - After: {n}He dies in shock.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why, what did I do? Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, they won't even bother to look into the matter, they'll just march me to the wall and shoot me!" {n}The soldier lowers his head glumly, accepting his fate.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, they'll just shoot me!" {n}He bows his head.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I swear, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I may've gotten a few things mixed up from inexperience, and that's why they don't add up. Please, let's walk to the governor's command centre. I must carry out my orders. Once we get there, you can have the intelligence run a check on me if you wish. I'm a loyal soldier and that's the truth!"
  - After: "I swear, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I got mixed up! Intelligence can check me at the command centre. I'm loyal!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira opens and closes her mouth several times as if struggling to say something, but in the end merely bites her lip, drawing blood, and nods glumly.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira bites her lip bloody and nods.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}In your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}past life{/d}, the ability to tell whether someone was trustworthy or a rat often marked the line between life and death. Under your scrutiny, the trooper seems far too calm — a sure sign the wretch is labouring to mislead you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}past life{/d} taught you to spot rats. He's too calm — lying.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Please, let's make a move — the sooner we get there, the better!"
  - After: "Of course, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Hurry!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira sniffs and says gently,{/n} "Reconsider, Lord Captain, have mercy on the boy. He's been so awfully stressed, it's a wonder he can even talk. Bit of a simpleton, that's all. I sense no cunning in him."
  - After: {n}Idira sniffs.{/n} "Mercy, Lord Captain. He's just a terrified simpleton."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "It certainly is, but if he were a coward, he'd have chucked his lasgun in a ditch long ago and taken to his heels. Yet there he is, leading you and doing his duty, never mind his chattering teeth."
  - After: "A coward would've run. He's doing his duty, teeth chattering."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Do not believe him, Lord Captain! Pale green is seeping from his every word, and I know this colour of deceit well. I once mistook Felek's words, so humble and full of sweetness, for sincerity. In truth, they were... poison."
  - After: "Don't believe him! His words seep the green of deceit, like Felek's sweet poison."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Updating data catalogue. The characteristic tendency of the planetary defence forces of Rykad Minoris to run into ambushes is not a consequence of chance or negligence. It can only be explained as some twisted variation of combat tactics. This phenomenon is depressing."
  - After: "Rykad Minoris's forces run into ambushes as a tactic, apparently. Depressing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What? No! What doesn't add up? I'm the only survivor out of my entire squad, do you understand? All of my friends are dead — they're lying over there! I could have fled or hidden, but I chose to come all the way here to warn you... and you..."
  - After: "My whole squad's dead! I came to warn you... and you..."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/Triumph/AfterSun/AfterSun_RM_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Does anyone have any idea what just happened?"
  - After: "Anyone know what just happened?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "All we can do now is try to make it to the starport."
  - After: "We make for the starport."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We're not abandoning people in distress. Everyone can come with us."
  - After: "We abandon no one. Everyone comes with us."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am under no obligation to save anyone. It is every man for himself."
  - After: "I owe no one rescue. Every man for himself."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your {g|Encyclopedia:CommBead}comm-bead{/g} comes alive. Vigdis's voice struggles to get through the thundering static.{/n} "Lord... tain, this is... x Master! Please sta... ll immed... ly send a..."
  - After: {n}Vigdis on the {g|Encyclopedia:CommBead}comm-bead{/g}:{/n} "Lord... tain... send a..."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix removes his hands and shakes his head as if trying to drive away whatever is assailing him. His voice trembles when he says,{/n} "A simple solution to stabilise your condition. Keep it together. Do not give in to the force trying to take hold of you."
  - After: {n}Heinrix pulls back, shaken.{/n} "Don't give in."
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: {n}Camille runs up to you, his weapon still in hand.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! What are your orders? We have no idea what's going on! Civilians are fleeing in panic and we can't get through to the governor or our senior officers!"
  - After: {n}Camille runs up.{/n} "Orders, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship? Civilians are panicking!"
- **Fanatical Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The old man peers at you gloomily.{/n} "You told me my faith was false. You made me turn away from Aurora. Now what do you say, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}? Who was right? Here it is — the Final Dawn!" {n}He makes a sweeping gesture with his hand.{/n}
  - After: {n}The old man glowers.{/n} "Who was right, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}? The Final Dawn!" {n}He gestures.{/n}
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "Hold your tongue, Aryld! Dawn or no dawn, I'll die before I let those eyeless freaks maim me! So keep quiet and do as {mf|His Lord|Her Lady}ship says! {mf|He|She}'ll tell us what to do!"
  - After: "Quiet, Aryld! Listen to {mf|His Lord|Her Lady}ship! {mf|He|She}'ll lead us!"
- **Pilot Nimas**
  - Before: {n}Jaspar clasps his fiancée's hand firmly.{/n} "To the abyss with this masquerade! The whole place's gone insane and here I am, dressed in civvies and without my vox-caster! What do we do, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship? Raquel says we have to fight our way to the starport. That's where her shuttle is, and yours as well, I suppose."
  - After: {n}Jaspar grips Raquel's hand.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, Raquel says fight to the starport shuttles."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Less talk, more action! What's Vigdis saying, Lord Captain? Are they going to send a shuttle for us?"
  - After: "Is a shuttle coming, Lord Captain?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Friendly... agents... of th-the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}... make me so n-nervous!"
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} agents... make me n-nervous!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Pull yourself together, Lady Tlass. And do not resist. It's a simple technique that will bring you relief." {n}Heinrix leans over Idira and puts his hands on her temples.{/n}
  - After: "Hold still, Lady Tlass." {n}Heinrix touches Idira's temples.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I'm not being friendly. What's happening is beyond normal cultist scheming. We can't afford to lose a single fighter."
  - After: "Not friendly. We need every fighter."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Red, black, red, black... and lots of blinding white fear. The whole city's quaking! No — the whole world!"
  - After: "Red, black... white fear. The world is quaking!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I shall fear no darkness, for light is within me, the light of my faith in {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Thee{/g}. I shall flee before no enemy, for there is no enemy more terrible than cowardice, and I shall overpower it..." {n}Argenta prays aloud, all the while checking her equipment with deft fingers.{/n}
  - After: "My faith in {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Thee{/g} is my light..." {n}Argenta prays, checking gear.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "We must move out toward the starport at once. The shuttles aren't going to find us here even if the comm link stabilises. Which it won't."
  - After: "To the starport. No shuttle will find us here."
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: {n}The red-haired ex-rebel sits down on the pavement, tears running down her face.{/n} "When will this end already... when... I wanna go hooome!"
  - After: {n}The ex-rebel weeps.{/n} "I wanna go hooome!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The comm falls silent. Many eyes stare at you.{/n}
  - After: {n}The comm dies. All eyes on you.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Only an incomplete picture." {n}Heinrix sounds deadly serious.{/n} "Every warp-active person on this planet is sensing the presence of sorcery... It's rising like a tsunami. I have hardly ever encountered anything like it in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. And, most remarkably, the sorcery is still growing. I cannot, however, say what set off this reaction or where the light has gone."
  - After: "Partly." {n}Heinrix is grave.{/n} "Sorcery rising like a tsunami — rare in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. The cause, I can't say."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira is holding her nose, trickling with blood.{/n} "I saw blurry shadows reaching for a ball of bright fire and pulling it away. And another shadow, much larger and more terrifying, that followed them. It opened its colossal eye when the others were gone with their loot. I saw no connections, no complicity... it was like a loop catching on a hook. A small terror made another, greater one, crawl out of its lair and act. That's the best I can explain it."
  - After: {n}Idira's nose bleeds.{/n} "Shadows stole a fire. A greater shadow woke and followed."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "But what I can say is that I only see death in Rykad Minoris's future. Death and nothing else. And I mean its immediate future! In other words, it's time to leg it."
  - After: "Only death awaits Rykad Minoris. Let's leg it."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira looks askance at Argenta.{/n} "Patience, everybody. Holy sis here is almost done powdering her nose..."
  - After: {n}Idira eyes Argenta.{/n} "Holy sis is still powdering her nose..."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The Final Dawn!" {n}Argenta says furiously.{/n} "We stopped short of puzzling out the enemy's entire plan... O Emperor, forgive us for this negligence. I swear we will find a way to right it!"
  - After: "The Final Dawn!" {n}Argenta seethes.{/n} "Emperor forgive us. We'll right it!"
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: "We'll follow behind you, keeping a bit of distance. We must escort the remaining civilians. Without the guard's help, they'll scatter or fall into the enemy's hands."
  - After: "We'll follow behind, escorting the civilians."
- **Pilot Raquel**
  - Before: "Jaspar and I must get weapons — any weapons. We'll catch up with you at the starport. We might even pick up some people from the garrison or civilians along the way."
  - After: "We'll find weapons and meet you at the starport."
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "And us? What about us? Can we go with you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship? Please, don't leave us behind!"
  - After: "Can we come, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship? Don't leave us!"
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: {n}The old woman looks at you, not particularly hopeful and a little distrustful, as if she is reluctant to ask her question.{/n}
  - After: {n}The old woman eyes you warily.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sense of alarm keeps growing stronger. As does the sensation of an intent gaze fixed upon you.{/n}
  - After: {n}You feel watched.{/n}
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "I'm no fast walker. But I'll hobble after you. If you get into a fight, it's not like you'll want an old woman to get in your way anyway. And I think there will be more fighting..."
  - After: "I'm slow, but I'll hobble after you."
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "Th-thank you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I'll walk behind you... yes..."
  - After: "Th-thank you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"
- **Fanatical Old Man**
  - Before: "There sure will be. It looks like some of my former comrades are still on the loose." {n}The old man's voice sounds lethargic and almost robotic.{/n}
  - After: "Some of my old comrades are still loose." {n}His voice is robotic.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader! We must help these people evacuate. The Emperor Himself has entrusted their fate to us."
  - After: "Rogue Trader! The Emperor entrusted these people to us!"
- **Private Camille Regias**
  - Before: {n}Camille frowns but salutes nonetheless.{/n} "Good luck, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"
  - After: {n}Camille salutes, frowning.{/n} "Good luck, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "You, soldier! Care to help a lone, exploited civilian save herself?" {n}The red-haired woman hooks her arm through the soldier's resolutely.{/n}
  - After: "Soldier! Help a poor civilian?" {n}She takes his arm.{/n}
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "I won't run off. I promise!" {n}The red-haired woman hooks her arm through the soldier's resolutely.{/n} "It's so good to have someone who'll protect you and take you to safety..."
  - After: "I won't run off!" {n}She takes the soldier's arm.{/n}
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "Let's go, Aryld." {n}The old woman takes her husband by the hand wearily.{/n} "Perhaps we'll find our grandchildren and sit with them one last time. And if we don't... then it'll just be the two of us."
  - After: "Come, Aryld." {n}She takes her husband's hand.{/n} "Maybe we'll find our grandchildren."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sense of alarm is now almost physically drilling through your temples. The fleeting little whispers at the edge of your hearing are sinister and gleeful.{/n}
  - After: {n}Gleeful whispers drill into your temples.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A chill runs down your spine. You seem to feel Aurora's gaze upon you once again... only it is not coming from her corpse any longer, but from everywhere.{/n}
  - After: {n}Aurora's gaze is on you — from everywhere.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An otherworldly cacophony, which until now resembled the rumbling of distant cannons, suddenly swallows you with its full intensity — the warp energies seemingly bursting out of thin air, rushing inside your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}exposed mind{/d} like an unstoppable wave of filth. For a moment it feels like your head might explode... but then the sensation retreats, leaving in its wake a different one — that of someone's touch on your temples.{/n}
  - After: {n}The warp floods your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Psyker}exposed mind{/d}, until someone touches your temples.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah gives you a faint smile and whispers,{/n} "A great dance begins. But I am still with you, Domin. Fear not, for I will not let your soul fall into the clutches of the unclean. If it comes to it... I will be quicker than them."
  - After: {n}Kibellah smiles.{/n} "A great dance begins. The unclean won't have your soul, Domin."

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/Triumph/AuroraDead/AuroraDead_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I have won, and you have perished along with your plans."
  - After: "I won. You perished with your plans."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will hunt down all of your accomplices, wherever they may be. And they will all follow you into the fire."
  - After: "I'll hunt your accomplices. They'll follow you into the fire."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Step away from the corpse]
  - After: [Step away]
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish I could learn your secrets, Aurora. You died too soon and never revealed them to me."
  - After: "You died too soon, Aurora, secrets and all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Surrounded by evil-repelling emblems, Aurora's corpse looks like a tiny island of gloom in the glorious ocean of your impending Triumph. The governor's people must have put a lot of work into protecting the body from decay as well as sawing off the grim iron face mask.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ringed by wards, Aurora's unmasked corpse is a spot of gloom in your Triumph.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Not a sound comes in response. But as soon as you blink, the corner of the corpse's mouth seems to move upward by a hair's breadth. Or is it just your imagination?{/n}
  - After: {n}Silence. Then her mouth seems to twitch upward.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The dead prophet has the weary, unremarkable face of an utterly nondescript commoner. The one aberration of her appearance is the many small mouths on her cheeks and forehead. They have been painstakingly sewn shut with a thick thread and plastered over with a layer of face powder. The cosmetics transform the heretic's face into an eerie mask. The corner of her mouth is frozen in a hint of a grin, wryly mirrored by her lesser mouths. "Are you pleased, enemy mine?" the grin seems to ask.{/n}
  - After: {n}A plain face, save for many small mouths sewn shut and powdered over. Her faint grin asks: "Are you pleased, enemy mine?"{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/Triumph/Bestowal/Bestowal_RM_dialog

  - Before: [Greet the people] "It is my pleasure to protect an Imperium world and its honest inhabitants! May the light of the eternal Terra shine on us all!"
  - After: [Greet the people] "I'm glad to protect you! May Terra's light shine on us!"

Get over here and greet {mf|His Lord|Her Lady}ship!"

  - Before: "I'm coming, I'm coming..." {n}The old man trailing his wife is the one whose life you spared despite his links to Aurora's cultists. He casts an apprehensive sideways glance at the prophet's corpse, but quickly looks away and bows to you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"

- **(conversation owner)**

- **Pilot Raquel**

It isn't until you take a closer look at her face that you recognise her as Captain Raquel, the pilot you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_RakelHelped}met{/d} on Rykadi Philia.{/n}
  - After: "Glory to {name}, {mf|hero|heroine} of Rykad Minoris!" {n}Captain Raquel, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_RakelHelped}met{/d} on Rykadi Philia.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Standing next to her is her fiancé, Jaspar, the vox operator you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_JasperSurvived}rescued{/d} at the starport during your first visit to the planet. He, too, is wearing civilian clothes.{/n}
  - After: {n}Beside her is Jaspar, whom you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_JasperSurvived}rescued{/d}.{/n}
- **Master of Ceremonies**
  - Before: "Rykad Minoris honours the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} and bows to His most loyal servants, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}!"
  - After: "Glory to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} and His {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The soldiers in the cordon exchange perplexed glances, but their trained discipline prevails and they turn toward the spectators, preparing to lead the crowd away.{/n}
  - After: {n}The soldiers lead the crowd away.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Nothing. Nothing strange. The crowd's salutatory clamour; the prophet's motionless corpse. Only the air is oddly still, as before a thunderstorm.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nothing. The air is still, as before a storm.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "What... what... they're coming out of the darkness, they're stealing the light... the darkness is insatiable... and behind them, behind these thieves, an ineffable eye follows, watching, watching... aargh!"
  - After: "They're stealing the light... an eye follows, watching... aargh!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I— I'm... sensing something. Boundless. Blue... golden... dark..."
  - After: "I sense something. Blue... golden... dark..."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}A grimace contorts Heinrix's face. The Interrogator lifts a hand to his temple, as though struck by a sudden migraine.{/n} "What..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix clutches his temple.{/n} "What..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Behold! Behold! Behold the Final Dawn!"
  - After: "Behold the Final Dawn!"
- **Master of Ceremonies**
  - Before: "The grateful citizens wish to present gifts to their redeemer!" {n}The master of ceremonies' sugary voice almost brings a taste of honey to your mouth.{/n}
  - After: "The grateful citizens bring gifts!" {n}His voice drips honey.{/n}
- **Elderly Citizen**
  - Before: "What was the point of herding us here? Celebrating? I could've just as well celebrated at home..." {n}An elderly woman — the one you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_OldPeopleSurvived}saved{/d} along with other hostages from her crazed husband — shuffles toward you.{/n}
  - After: "Why herd us here?" {n}The old woman you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_OldPeopleSurvived}saved{/d} shuffles over.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}For whatever reason, you know for certain that right at this moment, the "gaze" of Aurora's dead, empty eye sockets is fixed upon the back of your head. A thought surfaces in your mind, not a voice inside your head, no, a mere thought: "They are all going to die. Befuddled, deprived, never having seen the Truth. And it is all because of you, enemy mine."{/n}
  - After: {n}Aurora's dead gaze: "They will die because of you, enemy mine."{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Something is coming, Domin. An unholy death contrary to His will." {n}Kibellah's eyes are blank as she digs a steel claw into an unhealed wound.{/n}
  - After: "An unholy death comes, Domin." {n}Kibellah claws a wound, blank-eyed.{/n}
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "Thank you to our protector! Our benefactor!" {n}The spirited red-headed woman is jumping up and down and waving her hands. However, once she gets close enough to see your face, her eyes widen with shock.{/n} "Uh-oh. Uh... oh. Weren't you the one the Chief sent to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_RedLiedTo}take over{/d} from us? Err... I mean... I'm really glad to see you alive and well!"
  - After: "Our protector!" {n}The red-head freezes.{/n} "The Chief's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_RedLiedTo}replacement{/d}? Er... glad you're well!"
- **Frightened Rebel**
  - Before: "Thank you to our protector! Our benefactor!" {n}The spirited {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_RedSurvived}red-headed woman{/d} is jumping up and down and waving her hands.{/n} "Thank you for being merciful!"
  - After: "Our protector!" {n}The {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Triumph_RedSurvived}red-head{/d} waves.{/n} "Thanks for your mercy!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch1/RaycadMinoris/Triumph/StartTriumph/StartTriumph_RM_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to start the Triumph at once. Give the order!"
  - After: "Start the Triumph now. Give the order!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "This is disgusting. I do not want a staged show of 'gratitude.' Allow the ordinary people of Rykad Minoris to speak to me or skip this farce altogether!"
  - After: "Disgusting. No staged 'gratitude.' Let ordinary people speak to me, or skip this farce!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "An excellent plan. I am ready to start the Triumph!"
  - After: "Excellent. I'm ready to start the Triumph!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, peerless {mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius! I am the master of ceremonies of Rykad Minoris. Everything is in place for your Triumph. Allow me to give you a brief summary of the upcoming event."
  - After: "{mf|Lord|Lady} von Valancius, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Your Triumph is ready. A summary?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You will take the road, now familiar to you, from here to the starport. You will be accompanied by your comrades-in-arms and a guard of honour. The body of the heretic known as 'the prophet Aurora' will be pulled in your wake as a battle trophy. A stop is planned in the middle of the road. There, grateful citizens will rush toward you, praising you for their salvation."
  - After: "You'll ride to the starport, Aurora's body in tow. Midway, citizens will praise you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Once they have said their praise, the procession will move on. Governor Medineh will await you by the starport. It is also where the pyre has been built for burning the body of the heretic known as Aurora. You will be handed a flamer blessed by a representative of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g}. You can choose to personally perform the burning. But if you wish to underscore the amicable alliance between House von Valancius and House Winterscale, it will be fitting to pass the honour of the burning to Governor Medineh. However, the choice is yours!"
  - After: "Then Governor Medineh awaits at the starport pyre. You'll get an {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g}-blessed flamer. Burn Aurora yourself, or honour House Winterscale by letting Medineh do it. Your choice!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Not to worry: this is a thoroughly choreographed interlude! The group of the grateful people will be composed exclusively of loyal citizens vetted by us. Members of the military. Young people, attractive and physically fit. A few healthy children."
  - After: "It's choreographed! Only vetted loyalists."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The master of ceremonies' eyes widen.{/n} "My sincerest apologies, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! No thought could be further from my mind than incurring your anger! Let the, er, ordinary people through, you say? I'll see what can be done!"
  - After: {n}His eyes widen.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Ordinary people? I'll see what can be done!"

  - Before: "I wish to know what you think of your fellow crew members."

  - Before: "I want to know more about the people who buy our plunder."

  - Before: "I suggest we change the subject."
  - After: "Let's change the subject."

  - Before: "I have changed my mind. Expressing my gratitude in a personal conversation will be enough."

  - After: "Vigdis mentioned a servitor problem. What happened?"

  - After: "No. Tell me what it means now."

  - After: "Lady Cassia's servant delivered it to my chambers."

  - Before: "I am not fully certain, but I can make an educated guess."
  - After: "I can make an educated guess."

  - Before: "Find the most exquisite perfume in the Calixis Sector."
  - After: "Find the Calixis Sector's finest perfume."

  - After: "Give the Sanctum Navis a superb library."

  - Before: "I wish to give Jae a present. You shall make the arrangements."

  - Before: "I'd like to hear your opinion of Kunrad Voigtvir, the former Master of Whispers."

  - Before: "Upon further consideration... I think Jae will make do without gifts."

  - After: "I need time to think."

  - Before: "What is every smuggler's desire? Her own voidship, which I will gladly give her."
  - After: "Every smuggler wants her own voidship. I'll give her one."

  - Before: "I wish to hear news about the protectorate. To keep apprised of things."

- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you have to say about Vox Master Vigdis Toliman?"
  - After: "What about Vox Master Vigdis Toliman?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would like to introduce Kibellah to some of the customs practised among people of my stature — show her what life is like on the upper decks, so to speak."
  - After: "I want to show Kibellah the customs of the upper decks."

  - After: "You're not embezzling for the orphans, are you?"

  - Before: "Lavish spending is out of order. Concentrate on your duties."
  - After: "No lavish spending. Focus on your duties."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I trust you with this matter. Spend as much as you deem necessary."
  - After: "I trust you. Spend as needed."

  - Before: "How about a social event?"

  - Before: "I was counting on you to choose an appropriate ritual."
  - After: "You choose a fitting ritual."

  - Before: "Have you recovered from Nemesite's attack yet? You came very close to death in the chapel."
  - After: "Recovered from Nemesite's attack? You nearly died in the chapel."

  - After: "Yes, Pasqal comes with me."
