The inhabitants there supposedly live under the patronage of Rogue Trader Winterscale — I shudder to think what he has created there!"
  - After: "This could mean generations of war, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, like Winterscale's planet by the Nameless Star!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae nervously licks her lips — she clearly did not expect this response to her remark.{/n} "Atilius, I do not think the Exalted One has any particular desire to see you lobotomised and turned into a mindless clanking ghoul just because someone somewhere changed a law..."
  - After: {n}Jae licks her lips.{/n} "Atilius, the Exalted One doesn't want you lobotomised over a law change..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm afraid you do not understand! The Administratum no longer has any need for Atilius Quint. My life and career are over, but my service — oh, my service is just beginning!"
  - After: "You don't understand! My career is over, but my service is just beginning!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh, yes, of course, of course..." {n}Atilius hurriedly returns the skull to the container.{/n}
  - After: "Of course..." {n}He puts the skull away.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ah! My deepest apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! I did not mean to offend you!" {n}Atilius bows low, trembling from head to toe.{/n}
  - After: "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}He bows, trembling.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I knew you would appreciate my efforts to serve the Imperium as the law commands, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: "I knew you'd approve, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae looks at the secretary with sincere pity.{/n} "The willingness to jettison everything that makes you you... I'll never understand it. Never."
  - After: {n}Jae looks on with pity.{/n} "Discarding yourself... I'll never understand."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae lets out a breath, obviously relieved.{/n} "That is wonderful, Atilius, just wonderful... Just don't go poking at your eyes with a long needle — at least until you receive a direct order to do so from your precious Administratum..."
  - After: {n}Jae exhales.{/n} "Wonderful, Atilius. Don't stab your eyes until ordered..."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet grits her teeth and burns you with a look of utter disdain.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet glares at you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Atilius's mechanical fingers fly over the scroll as he fills in another line.{/n} "And of course, what great fortune it is to see, for the very first time in all my years of service, an emissary of the Navis Nobilite here on Janus! I humbly welcome the esteemed..."
  - After: {n}He writes on.{/n} "And a Navis Nobilite emissary on Janus! I welcome the esteemed..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella, Lady Navigator of House Orsellio." {n}Everything from her condescending gaze and confident bearing to her calm but commanding voice marks Cassia as the heiress of a great bloodline. Awestruck, the secretary writes down each letter of her name with particular fastidiousness.{/n}
  - After: "Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella, Lady Navigator of House Orsellio." {n}He writes it, awed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You cast a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}practised eye{/d} over the intelligence provided to you and instantly get a grasp on the situation.{/n}
  - After: {n}With a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Militarum}practised eye{/d}, you grasp it at once.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I hope your subordinates will have the presence of mind not to kill the culprits on the spot and instead question them, learn the identities of other rebels, and carry out a series of interrogations and punishments first. Other than that, the approach is valid."
  - After: "Interrogate the culprits before killing them. Otherwise, valid."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}The Manipulus moves swiftly to loom over Atilius, examining his cranium with curiosity and completely ignoring the prefectus's stricken expression.{/n} "I must note, this is an exceptionally well-preserved xenos specimen. Rogue Trader, observe the flattened edge of the incisors, the smooth brow ridges, the absence of the third pair of molars typical for the Aelda— what is it, Nuncius?" {n}Eogunn stops abruptly.{/n} "Yes, I did indeed get carried away, forgive me."
  - After: {n}Eogunn looms.{/n} "A fine xenos specimen. No third molars, typical for the Aelda— what, Nuncius?" {n}He stops.{/n} "Yes, carried away."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "What a sage decision, shereen. Let the rebels' innocent children and relatives rot on the rack as a lesson to all heretics. I swear to the Exalted One, your name will be fondly remembered on Janus!"
  - After: "How wise, shereen. Torture their innocent kin. Janus will adore you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I must confess that as yet I have not had the pleasure of filling out a sacred tithe protocol form, as the last Imperial ships to come here did so under my predecessor. Come to think of it, that would have been several decades ago... I do hope the logisticians responsible for such an unforgivable oversight lose their heads over this!"
  - After: "The last Imperial ships came decades ago, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Heads should roll!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh... I must confess, the news of her arrest has shaken me to my core... May I speak openly? I admit that I haven't got a bad word to say about Governor Vyatt, and I hope that when you appraise her efforts, your anger will change to mercy."
  - After: "Her arrest shook me. I've nothing bad to say of Governor Vyatt. I hope for your mercy."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites reach toward Atilius with interest, seeming to unnerve him a little.{/n} "Adequately preserved. It is a pity that it is empty inside — it could have become a proper servo-skull herald for the Rogue Trader. Unorthodox."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites reach for it.{/n} "Well preserved. Pity it's empty, or it'd make a servo-skull herald."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Atilius Quint nervously tugs at the hem of his dusty cloak and bows respectfully.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the subjects of Janus welcome you! What cares have brought you to our humble world on this occasion?"
  - After: {n}Atilius bows.{/n} "Janus welcomes you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What brings you?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae's expression is pensive as she twists a lock of hair around her metal finger.{/n} "Interesting, shereen. I assumed we would be dealing with servitors, but no — some places in your domain still have this work being performed by people of flesh and blood!"
  - After: {n}Jae twirls her hair.{/n} "Interesting, shereen. Some of your domain still uses flesh-and-blood clerks!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/GovernorVoxCall/GovernorVoxCall

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} crackles to life. Relief rings in Vistenza Vyatt's voice.{/n} "...{name}? You're all right! What a relief! Please, for your own safety, come inside the estate. We shall continue our conversation in my parlour — I imagine you wish to hear an explanation of what has occurred."
  - After: {n}Your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} crackles: Vyatt, relieved.{/n} "{name}, you're safe! Come to my parlour; I'll explain."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/RebelServant_Dialogue/RebelServant_Dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You helped the rebels gain access to the estate!"
  - After: "You let the rebels into the estate!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your accomplices will answer for your treachery in your place."
  - After: "Your accomplices will pay for your treachery."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Say whatever it is you want to say. And be quick about it."
  - After: "Say your piece. Quickly."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You accuse the governor, with only conjecture and rumour to back up your words? How dare you!"
  - After: "You accuse the governor on rumour alone? How dare you!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What else is going on in the settlements?"
  - After: "What else is happening in the settlements?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What did you inject yourself with?"
  - After: "What did you inject?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Execute the servant] "Death to traitors of the Imperium."
  - After: [Execute the servant] "Death to traitors."
- **Player**
  - Before: "No! I have not asked all my questions!"
  - After: "No! I'm not done asking!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will keep your secret."
  - After: "I'll keep your secret."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hearing your footsteps, the elderly servant grabs an injector and stabs it into his arm. The area around the needle immediately starts turning black.{/n} "You're too late, Vyatt's dogs! I'm the master of my own fate!" {n}But when he gets a better look at you, the man drops the injector in astonishment, and seems poised to prostrate himself on the floor before you.{/n} "It's you! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! The God-Emperor must have brought you here! I beg you, help the rebels and save Janus!"
  - After: {n}An old servant injects himself; his arm blackens.{/n} "Too late, Vyatt's dogs!" {n}He recognises you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Help the rebels, save Janus!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I swear I'm not lying! Pray for me, holy sister... for me and for Janus!"
  - After: "It's true! Pray for me and Janus, sister!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Fresh meat to entertain the nobility... some things never change, whether you're on my planet, or anywhere in the righteous Imperium."
  - After: "Fresh meat for nobles. Same everywhere."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, could I have done otherwise? No, I could not... not after everything I've seen in the palace! People being shipped in and tortured. Servants being driven mad. For a long time I thought it was only going on inside the estate... but when I was contacted by people on the outside, I learned that all of Janus is under threat! Only your mercy and the light of the God-Emperor can save us!"
  - After: "How could I not, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? People tortured, servants maddened, and outsiders say all Janus is threatened! Save us!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No! Don't waste your time on somebody who's as good as dead already... I'll depart this world happily knowing that I'm free from the clutches of that monster sitting on the governor's throne..."
  - After: "Don't bother. I die free of that monster on the throne."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In the name of the Golden Throne, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, show mercy on the humble workers, the salt of Janus — save them! Vistenza Vyatt, the untouchable governor and leader of the nobility, is creating something monstrous behind closed doors. She uses the Imperium's interests as a smokescreen and purports to be a scholar, but her actions... her actions are poisoning our planet!"
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, save Janus's workers! Vistenza Vyatt, posing as a scholar, makes something monstrous in secret. She's poisoning our planet!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hidden chambers deep within the palace. I've never been inside... thankfully. The servants who are allowed in, the ones the governor trusts... they change. She changes them. Pretties them up. Defiles them."
  - After: "Hidden palace chambers. Trusted servants go in and change. She defiles them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm prepared to swear on my life and soul, may the light of the Emperor preserve it, that it is not conjecture. We have been living under Vyatt's rule for decades now, and things have gotten worse and worse with every passing year... The people can no longer tolerate the nightmare that lurks within the walls of this estate!"
  - After: "I swear it's true, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Decades under Vyatt, worse every year. We can't bear it!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Did you know that the settlements that fail to pay their due tithes on time have been allowed to pay with people instead? They even deliver them to order — sometimes old folks, sometimes children..." {n}He lowers his voice to a whisper and leans toward you.{/n} "I've seen those people. I've seen them being delivered to the estate... and then they're never seen or heard from again. They go into the secret rooms and they don't come out again, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Ever."
  - After: "Late settlements pay tithes in people: elders, children..." {n}He whispers.{/n} "They go into the secret rooms and never come out, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'll tell you exactly what I was told by the people who contacted me. These tithes... some settlements have already switched to paying with people. They say that amenable settlements get special treatment from the governor's dogs. They arrange for medicine to be supplied to the settlement. Then security. And then they completely isolate them — all contact between those inside the settlement and the outside world is cut off!"
  - After: "Settlements paying in people get medicine, then guards, then total isolation!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "One lad managed to get out — he's the one who told me all this... that the people are rotting alive in there! Strange growths, yellow eyes, stinking like dead bodies... The worst-looking ones are rounded up and taken away... The fellow who escaped, he seemed fine, but within a couple of days of the rebels picking him up, he started seeing monsters instead of people. They had to lock him up away from other folks, the poor sod, and then he... his wrists..."
  - After: "An escaped lad said they rot alive: growths, yellow eyes. The worst are taken. Days later he saw monsters everywhere. Then... his wrists..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Deliverance... from what Vyatt's dogs would do to me if they caught me." {n}He forces a smile onto his face.{/n} "I was given the vial along with the instructions about when to let our liberators into the estate."
  - After: "Escape from Vyatt's dogs." {n}A forced smile.{/n} "It came with orders on when to let the rebels in."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The old man drops to the floor like a lead weight. Blood dribbles from his mouth onto his chin, an expression of surprise frozen in his glazed eyes.{/n}
  - After: {n}The old man drops dead, bleeding from the mouth.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He doubles up, hugging himself, and is wracked by coughing that leaves his lips wet with blood.{/n} "...Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If only I'd known it was you. My eyes deceived me! We have little time now, but I swear I'll tell you everything!"
  - After: {n}He coughs blood.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Little time, but I'll tell all!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Throne damn you, old man, where did you get this stuff? Poison capsules of this sort are a popular choice among desperate ashmags who are done with being tortured by mad fanatics or worse. Here on Janus, though... there's no antidote."
  - After: "Damn it, old man! Ashmag poison capsules. No antidote on Janus."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Peasants who were taken to Eurac V to serve House Orsellio were never seen or heard from again either. They became loyal servants and toiled for the good of a great dynasty — why should they ever return to their filthy, squalid abodes?"
  - After: "Peasants taken to Eurac V for House Orsellio never returned either. Why would they?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "I see no shadows of deceit behind your words, and even so... I would have noticed. I know I would have noticed the signs of which you..." {n}Yrliet's face tenses like a taut string, and doubt creeps into her expression.{/n} "Except, whenever Vistenza hosts one of her dances at the palace, she sends me away to search for the rebels. Into the forests, far from human settlements."
  - After: "No deceit... but I'd have noticed." {n}Yrliet doubts.{/n} "Though during her palace dances, Vistenza sends me hunting rebels in the forests."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah picks up a drop of poison from the needle with her claw and carefully puts it on her tongue. She makes an approving sound.{/n} "A strong toxin. We apply something similar to the lips of new initiates of the Bloodspun Web. It kills minor nerves and purges one's sensitivity to pain. For this layman, though, it is a certain and violent death."
  - After: {n}Kibellah tastes the poison.{/n} "Strong. Bloodspun Web initiates use similar to kill pain. For him, certain death."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "The aristocracy is known for its countless reprehensible inclinations. However, unless these foibles give reason to doubt the planet's loyalty to the Imperium, they do not warrant a death sentence."
  - After: "Noble vices don't merit death unless they threaten Imperial loyalty."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn picks up the injector with his mechadendrite and expels the remnants into the alembic on his shoulder, as the liquid inside instantly turns a sombre black.{/n} "A nerve agent of peripheral action. Neutralisation is impossible outside the ship's infirmary. Estimated time until death... is a matter of minutes. I am sorry."
  - After: {n}Eogunn tests the dregs.{/n} "Nerve agent. Only the ship's infirmary could help. Minutes left. I'm sorry."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Don't waste time asking obvious questions, {name}! He won't last long — make your questions count!"
  - After: "He's dying, {name}! Make your questions count!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You accuse the Rogue Trader's appointed governor of heresy. If your words are false, they themselves are tantamount to heresy. But if what you say is true... if it's true, then your sacrifice will be to your credit, my good man!" {n}Argenta utters these last words with impassioned conviction.{/n}
  - After: "Accusing the governor of heresy is heresy if false. If true, your sacrifice honours you!" {n}Argenta is impassioned.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Looking closely at the old man, the Tech-Priest utters,{/n} "Nerve toxin. The inevitable cessation of vital functions is expected in no more than sixty seconds." {n}Silent clicks emitted by the visor indicate an ongoing pict-recording.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal studies him.{/n} "Nerve toxin. Death within sixty seconds." {n}His visor records.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/RebelSurvivorDialogue/RebelSurvivorDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me, or I'll tear this world apart to get rid of garbage like you and your brethren!"
  - After: "Talk, or I'll tear this world apart to purge your kind!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "There will be no end to the war on this planet until I get a handle on the situation. But to do that, I need to meet with your leader."
  - After: "This war won't end until I meet your leader."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am {name}, Rogue Trader and sovereign of this planet. In the name of the Emperor, open this door!"
  - After: "I am {name}, Rogue Trader and sovereign here. Open, in the Emperor's name!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the officer] "I'm done. Proceed with the clearance operation."
  - After: [Address the officer] "Proceed with the clearance."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why should I listen to a filthy insurgent?"
  - After: "Why listen to an insurgent?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Get up and come with me. I give you my word as a Rogue Trader, you will live."
  - After: "Come with me. On my word, you'll live."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare you rebel against a vassal of the Imperium!"
  - After: "You dare rebel against an Imperial vassal!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You're telling me people are seeing evil spirits?"
  - After: "People see evil spirits?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Execute the rebel] "I'm done listening to you, rebel."
  - After: [Execute the rebel] "Enough, rebel."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Give the rebel an easy death] "The people waiting outside will put you through far worse torment than I will. Goodbye."
  - After: [Give the rebel an easy death] "The crowd outside would be crueler. Goodbye."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}When you approach the solid-looking door, a high, boyish voice shouts out,{/n} "Piss off! You won't take me alive! Better to put a bullet in my brain than let the governor's dogs get their hands on me!"
  - After: {n}A boy shouts from inside:{/n} "Piss off! Shoot me first, governor's dogs!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "This is one of the elusive and cunning rebels the governor's been fighting for months? Really?"
  - After: "This is a cunning rebel? Really?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The boy's body goes limp and drops to the floor.{/n}
  - After: {n}The boy drops dead.{/n}
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: {n}The shaking rebel curls up on the ground under your gaze.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, no! Please, don't hurt the others!"
  - After: {n}He cowers.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, spare the others!"
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "I... no! No, I'd rather die!" {n}The rebel, shaking in terror, brings his hands together and begins to pray.{/n}
  - After: "I'd rather die!" {n}He prays, shaking.{/n}
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: {n}The boy hesitates for a few seconds, and then his head drops limply.{/n} "As long as you keep your word..."
  - After: {n}He slumps.{/n} "Keep your word..."
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: {n}He swallows nervously and looks at you with fear.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg you, don't ask me that! I can't sell out the others... I won't betray them!"
  - After: {n}He trembles.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I won't betray them!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A few powerful blows, and the door flies open, revealing the way inside.{/n}
  - After: {n}The door flies open.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}After several blows, you realise that breaking down this obstacle is beyond your abilities. You can feel the wardens swapping glances behind you, and the back of your neck grows hot.{/n}
  - After: {n}The door holds. The wardens trade glances.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It takes you half a minute to figure out the archaic mechanism. With a soft click, the door opens, allowing you to enter.{/n}
  - After: {n}The old lock clicks open.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The lock refuses to surrender, despite your efforts. What's more, it seems one of the springs inside has shifted around, turning the closed lock into an immovable deadbolt.{/n}
  - After: {n}A spring shifts, jamming the lock for good.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}For a long time, nothing happens. Then, the door opens with a quick click.{/n}
  - After: {n}At last, the door clicks open.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do you think I'm an idiot? Take your lies and choke on them, you and your damn mistress!"
  - After: "Choke on your lies, you and your damn mistress!"
- **Security Officer**
  - Before: "Wilco, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Please, stand back — I don't want you to get hurt."
  - After: "Wilco, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Stand back."
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "From Governor Vyatt! Everybody here knows what she's doing to us. We've put up with it for a long time, hoping that somebody would intervene and help us... But nobody ever did..."
  - After: "From Governor Vyatt! Nobody ever helped us..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The space is small, the corners filled with inky black shadows, but you can still make out the person in the room. He is desperately gripping a discharged lasgun in his hands. The rebel looks at you in amazement.{/n} "It really is you..."
  - After: {n}A rebel clutches a spent lasgun, amazed.{/n} "It's you..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Inside is poorly lit, but you spot a person standing in the far corner. He is desperately gripping a discharged lasgun in his hands. At the sight of you, his eyes widen in recognition — and fear.{/n} "It c-can't be... The Rogue Trader!"
  - After: {n}A rebel clutches a spent lasgun, terrified.{/n} "The Rogue Trader!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The solid door is dutifully blocking your path inside. Trying to break down this slab without some kind of battering ram would be a fool's errand. Your gaze falls on the lock — a military design, typically used for external doors on government buildings.{/n}
  - After: {n}Too solid to break without a ram. The lock is a military design for government doors.{/n}
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: {n}He swallows nervously and looks at you with fear.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg you, don't ask me that! I can't sell out my brethren! It's over for me, but the others... I won't betray them!"
  - After: {n}He trembles.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm done for, but I won't betray my brethren!"
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "I... My little sister was taken to the palace. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, she was so little... Whenever I think about what happened to her, I want to kill everyone, the governor and everyone protecting her." {n}The boy swallows.{/n} "All of us are grieving our own losses."
  - After: "The palace took my little sister, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I want them all dead." {n}He swallows.{/n} "We all grieve someone."
- **Security Officer**
  - Before: "Allow us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. This rat has had free rein on the estate for long enough. We'll take care of the problem in just a minute — but please step back from the building."
  - After: "Allow us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Step back; we'll handle this rat."
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: {n}The rebel looks at you in bewilderment, and then bows low before you. When he speaks, his voice trembles:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... thank you! Thank you for this kindness... I never thought I'd survive this..."
  - After: {n}He bows, trembling.{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The door looks solid and formidable, but you notice dark marks on the hinges — a sure sign that the material is degraded. The lock doesn't look new either — with a suitable tool, it could easily be opened.{/n}
  - After: {n}The hinges are degraded; the old lock could be picked with a tool.{/n}
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "I've never been in their camp — none of us have. Only the chief saw one person from their base: he came a few times, bringing weapons and orders — he said he represented a greater force than we could imagine... and he said that the governor's dogs will pay for their reprisals in the settlements. But that's not where they're hidden — they keep their distance from ordinary folks."
  - After: "Only our chief met their envoy, who brought weapons and orders from 'a greater force.' Their base is far from the settlements."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The young man, practically a boy, falls to his knees and stretches out his bloody hands toward you. His clothes are burned on one side and grimy with baked-in blood.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, have mercy! You are the sovereign of this planet! Only you have the power to save us!"
  - After: {n}The bloodied boy kneels.{/n} "Mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Only you can save us!"
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "She... she's turned the whole world into a slaughterhouse! People are rounded up like {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} from the settlements, supposedly to go to the palace, and they're never seen again! Her servants pour something over the fields and then people lose their minds — they start hearing voices and seeing evil spirits! And while we're dying, she's sitting behind her white walls and feasting on our bones!"
  - After: "She's made this world a slaughterhouse! People are herded like {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}grox{/g} to the palace and vanish. Her servants spray the fields and people go mad, seeing spirits!"
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "You... you can't just stand aside while your vassals are destroying your worlds! The governor is doing whatever she wants! Rounding up families, razing whole settlements!"
  - After: "The governor razes settlements! You can't stand aside!"
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "Yes! Others are going feral and attacking their loved ones... And then there's..." {n}The boy lowers his voice.{/n} "People say that in some settlements... well... they've stopped upholding the law altogether. Imperial law, and... and... the law of basic, human decency. People are turning into animals."
  - After: "Yes! People turn feral..." {n}He whispers.{/n} "Some settlements have abandoned all law and decency."
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "We have it all worked out so that if anyone gets caught, the others aren't caught with them. But I swiped the chief's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}... I thought, after I killed the governor, I could use the message coordinates to find the base and hide out there..." {n}The boy retrieves a vox from his pocket and holds it out to you with a shaking hand.{/n} "That's everything I know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "I stole the chief's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}; its coordinates lead to their base." {n}He hands it over.{/n} "That's all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Youth is a time of recklessness. I heard that said more than once in the Schola Progenium and during my novitiate. But youth is also a time of directness! Let us listen to this young man before we judge him."
  - After: "Youth is reckless, but direct. Let's hear him first."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I was taught that peasants have a tendency to exaggerate their suffering due to sloth and weakness of spirit. But this young man... Vermilion thorns pierce every centimetre of his body, and grey shackles bind his hands, feet, and neck... There are no lies in his words. Only terror and desperation without end."
  - After: "I see thorns and shackles all over him. He isn't lying; he's terrified."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's face twists.{/n} "Sacrifices, madness, pain, and death... even in so primitive a society as this, such rites seem... senseless, not worthy of such efforts. What is this, a random quirk of nature, or something darker?"
  - After: {n}Yrliet grimaces.{/n} "Senseless rites. Nature's quirk, or something darker?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira looks at Argenta a little confused, as if she did not expect such gentleness from her.{/n} "I agree with the sister here. People don't become rebels because everything in their lives is rosy. And the kid's green as grass, it'd be a shame to kill him for nothing... Something is wrong on Janus, I can feel it — maybe he can shed some light on what's going on."
  - After: {n}Idira glances at Argenta.{/n} "Agreed. Killing the kid would be a waste. Something's wrong on Janus."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "This is not sufficient evidence for a proper accusation, but the Arbites doctrine extols vigilance. I propose we verify whether this is disinformation that the leaders of the rebellion are feeding to their underlings, or genuine testimony."
  - After: "Not enough to accuse. We should verify if it's rebel disinformation."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/SecurityOfficerDialogue/SecurityOfficerDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I want to talk to the person inside."
  - After: "I want to talk to him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are obviously busy. I won't disturb you further."
  - After: "You're busy. I'll go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You're going to poison the rebel?"
  - After: "You'll poison the rebel?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "All right, fine. I'll take a look around after you've finished up."
  - After: "Fine. I'll look around after."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You dare to question me? Out of my way."
  - After: "You question me? Move."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I want to solve this problem without too much blood or fuss."
  - After: "I want this solved without bloodshed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Escort this man safely to the perimeter of the estate. He is free to go."
  - After: "Escort him off the estate. He's free."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This man is now under my protection. See to it that he is held safely in custody until his fate is decided by a fair trial."
  - After: "He's under my protection. Hold him until a fair trial."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Make an example of this scum. Publicly flay him and string up his corpse outside his family home as a warning. If anyone tries to remove it — shoot them."
  - After: "Flay him publicly and hang him at his family's home. Shoot anyone who removes him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What's so special about this building?"
  - After: "What's special about this building?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "This man will serve Janus yet. Consult your advisors and see to it that this rebel is made into a useful servitor."
  - After: "He'll still serve Janus. Make him a servitor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A hulking man dressed in a uniform marking him out as an officer of the gubernatorial wardens is closely monitoring his subordinates as they surround the building. Sensing your approach, he whips around, his face going pale, and he offers a low bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Please, do not stray too close to the building. One of the terrorists from today's attack has holed himself up in there. He could be dangerous."
  - After: {n}A warden officer pales and bows.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Stay back. A terrorist is holed up inside."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer tugs nervously at his collar, which appears to have suddenly become too tight for his comfort.{/n} "W-we will fix this. Right away, I swear it on the Throne!"
  - After: {n}He tugs his collar.{/n} "W-we'll fix it, I swear!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I have only one question, officer — why have you not already done it? The Rogue Trader is here, and the longer you delay, the more you put {mf|his|her} life needlessly at risk!"
  - After: "Why the delay? You're risking {mf|his|her} life!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer flinches slightly at Abelard's snarl.{/n} "It is inexcusable, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! The barrels of poison were only just delivered... But we're... we're ready to begin now!"
  - After: {n}He flinches.{/n} "The poison just arrived, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We're ready!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ready to report, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We conducted a sweep of the area after the attack. All of the assassins were arrested or neutralised except for one..." {n}The officer scowls darkly.{/n} "He's sealed himself inside. He already injured two wardens who tried to reach him. But there's no need to worry — we'll poison him and clear the last dregs of dirt from the estate."
  - After: "One assassin remains, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}He scowls.{/n} "He wounded two wardens. We'll poison him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer's brow furrows.{/n} "To tell the truth, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm more concerned with clearing the area right now than with his identity. We're not expecting to get any valuable intel from him — unless we find something on his corpse after we've done our job."
  - After: {n}He frowns.{/n} "Doesn't matter, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We'll search his corpse."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am the madam governor's security officer. I regret that you had to witness today's incident, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I assure you, nothing of the sort will ever happen again."
  - After: "The governor's security officer. Today won't happen again, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Are you sure? It's not exactly safe, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The officer's eyes involuntarily sweep over you, sizing you up.{/n}
  - After: "It's not safe, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}He sizes you up.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Wilco, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Wardens! Get to it!"
  - After: "Wilco, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Wardens, go!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer seems to remember himself and offers another low bow.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Act as you see fit!" {n}At the officer's signal, the other wardens take a deferential step back, clearing your path to the door.{/n}
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The wardens step aside.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We will be finished in just a few minutes." {n}The officer bows low to you once more, then turns to his soldiers.{/n} "Begin!"
  - After: "A few minutes." {n}He turns.{/n} "Begin!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer nods.{/n} "We're using insecticide from our stockpiles, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We don't have any military-grade poisons, but we don't need them, not for this parasite."
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "Insecticide, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Enough for this parasite."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer takes a breath.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}At the officer's signal, the other wardens take a deferential step back, clearing your path to the door.{/n}
  - After: {n}He breathes.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}The wardens step aside.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The officer of the wardens casts a disdainful look over the rebel before turning his gaze on you.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I honour your bravery. Please, allow me to get rid of this rat for you."
  - After: {n}The officer sneers at the rebel.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, let me kill this rat."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Gladly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Drag this carrion to a cell, lads."
  - After: "Gladly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. To a cell, lads."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A dumbfounded expression appears on the officer's face.{/n} "With the deepest respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}The officer thinks better of his next words and abruptly bows.{/n} "It will be done."
  - After: {n}He gapes.{/n} "With respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}He bows.{/n} "It will be done."
- **Wounded Rebel**
  - Before: "What? No! Anything but that—"
  - After: "No! Anything but that—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "At once, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The officer gives his subordinates a signal.{/n}
  - After: "At once, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}He signals.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It's one of the utility buildings. Fortunately, it was empty at the time of the attack — there were no potential hostages or innocent people inside. If you ask me, I think this was the first place the killer came to when he was beating his retreat. We managed to round up all the others, but this one holed himself up in there."
  - After: "A utility building, empty during the attack. He fled here."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "One ashmag is up against all the wardens on this estate, yet he is still causing trouble? On Efreet, he would have already been made captain and put in charge of the governor's security — for the Exalted One knows that he has more brains than all of you combined!"
  - After: "One ashmag holds off all your wardens? He's smarter than all of you!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This is not an empty utility building, but an inactive backup crypt for storing refrigerant and freezing equipment. This is obvious. Your ignorance is depressing, servant."
  - After: "It's a backup refrigerant crypt. Obviously."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/TechSpecialist_Dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What are you talking about? I can't believe it! We need to deal with this urgently!"
  - After: "Unbelievable! We must deal with this now!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Growling menacingly] "Shut up, you fool. Tell anyone about this, and I will kill you."
  - After: [Growling menacingly] "Shut up. Tell anyone, and you die."

  - Before: "Don't talk nonsense, cog. Do your work instead of trying to catch fictional conspirators!"
  - After: "Nonsense, cog. Do your work, not conspiracy hunting!"

  - Before: "Thank you for the information."
  - After: "Thank you."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/TechSpecialist_Dialogue/TechSpecialist_Dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "How many servants of the Adeptus Mechanicus are there on the planet?"
  - After: "How many Mechanicus servants are here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you do here on Janus?"
  - After: "What do you do on Janus?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What pathologies in the flora and fauna?"
  - After: "What pathologies?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How is the governor dealing with 'undesirable pathologies'?"
  - After: "How is the governor handling them?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Traces of xeno-activity?"
  - After: "Xeno-activity?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I found this on the body of a dead rebel. Can you tell me anything about these specimens?"
  - After: "I found these on a dead rebel. What are they?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How are things with you and your fellows?"
  - After: "How are you and your fellows?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Draped in a red cloak, the Magos's body barely looks human. Wires, tubes, and metal manipulators turn him into a whimsical machine, while implants hide his face behind a sinister mask. The Tech-Priest intermittently dictates something in Techna-Lingua to the servo-skull floating next to him, but at your approach, he falls silent and offers a reserved bow.{/n} "Greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Lexmechanic Vinzelex. How may I serve you?"
  - After: {n}A red-cloaked Magos, more machine than man, bows.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Lexmechanic Vinzelex, at your service."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Magos notices you and offers a dignified bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. How may I help you?"
  - After: {n}The Magos bows.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. How may I help?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Interesting... It is often what seem to be insignificant anomalies like these that lead to greater troubles."
  - After: "Small anomalies often bring greater troubles."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The changes may be artificial. Has the possibility been considered that someone is manipulating the ecosystem to reduce our living space?"
  - After: "Could someone be altering the ecosystem deliberately?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Due to the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarEliminated}eradication{/d} of the anarchic elements and the xenocreatures who manipulated them, there is a positive trend in the field of research into the remote forest regions of the planet. The remains of the xenocivilisation of the Aeldari, whose insignificant settlements existed on the planet in the distant past, have been discovered and subjected to primary cataloguing."
  - After: "With the anarchists and xenos {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarEliminated}eradicated{/d}, forest research progresses. Ancient Aeldari ruins have been catalogued."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The algorithms of my comrades' work have been subjected to interrogation, all orders of the former governor have been removed from the procedural queue in order to avoid a secret corrupting influence on the sacred works of the servants of the Deus Mechanicus."
  - After: "Our work is audited; the former governor's orders are purged."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Be blessed, tech-brother. Your diligence and the diligence of those like you turns anarchy into order, and bestows classification to Knowledge." {n}One of Pasqal's mechadendrites lightly touches the Lexmechanic's body. The Tech-Priest bows respectfully in return, clearly a little startled.{/n}
  - After: "Be blessed, tech-brother. Your diligence makes order." {n}Pasqal's mechadendrite touches the startled Lexmechanic.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Observation of remote forest regions is difficult due to the activity of xenocreatures. The level of threat shown is low. Protocols for avoiding contact have been introduced into the Standard Procedures in order to avoid provocations of aggression."
  - After: "Xenocreatures hinder forest surveys. Threat low; we avoid contact."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Initialising report. The planet's soil possesses a unique composition suitable for the re-engineering of the planet and the mass production of foodstuffs. Significant cultivation of the eastern hemisphere with the aim of improving production processes and logistics operations. Traces of xeno-activity that do not pose an immediate threat to ongoing operations. Undesirable pathologies of flora and fauna have been noted, which may pose a threat in the short term."
  - After: "Report: fertile soil, east heavily farmed. Xeno traces, no immediate threat. Flora and fauna pathologies may become one."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your blessing for the examination, Magos?" {n}The Lexmechanic waits respectfully until Pasqal nods.{/n}
  - After: "Your blessing, Magos?" {n}He waits for Pasqal's nod.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Genetic and chemical pathologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Harmless species mutate and become aggressive, while plants change their chemical composition and become poisonous. This is happening more and more often, and if no action is taken, the ecosystem of the world will be irreparably disrupted."
  - After: "Harmless species turn aggressive, plants poisonous, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Unchecked, the ecosystem will collapse."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have analysed the genome of the affected species and I am currently developing suppressor genes to make the planet's organisms resistant to pathology, but so far I have not been able to solve the problem. Further exploration of the planet would perhaps speed up these processes, but the administrative apparatus has imposed a ban on expeditions that are not directly aimed at improving production."
  - After: "My suppressor genes haven't worked yet. Exploring would help, but the administration bans non-production expeditions."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest's mechanical voice comes from the speaker on his neck.{/n} "By the order of the Adeptus Mechanicus, I have been entrusted with the management of the Adeptus Administratum, in order to catalogue agronomic data and analyse information about the planet during the process of subjugating it to the will of the Imperium."
  - After: {n}His neck speaker crackles.{/n} "The Mechanicus sent me to catalogue agronomic data for the Administratum."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "According to data obtained during the initial survey, ruined structures of non-human origin were noted in different sectors of the planet, but I did not have the administrative capacity to study them in more detail. For now, I must defer the Quest for Knowledge."
  - After: "Xenos ruins dot the planet, but I lack authority to study them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest studies the dried berries and goes still. You hear the distinct clicks as his cerebral {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitators{/g} process this information.{/n} "Creeping creeweed, a typical plant of the western hemisphere. We have studied the possibility of industrial cultivation, but the process was found to be inefficient due to the specific requirements of the soil, which is found in the right composition only in the archipelagos of the planet."
  - After: {n}His {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitators{/g} click.{/n} "Creeping creeweed, western hemisphere. It grows only in archipelago soil, so farming it failed."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn replies to the Lexmechanic with a brief phrase in Lingua-Technis. Vinzelex bows respectfully before the Manipulus in return.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eogunn speaks in Lingua-Technis; Vinzelex bows.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}The Genetor nods gravely.{/n} "A worthy endeavour. Only statistical data, when compiled with sufficient diligence, can serve as the foundation for hypotheses worthy of consideration."
  - After: {n}The Genetor nods.{/n} "Worthy. Data underpins hypotheses."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "No, Nuncius, that sounds like too great of an assumption. We cannot accept as fact that the entire biosphere of Janus is a single organism exhibiting an immune response to a stimulus in such a manner. Relying on conjecture instead of proven data is unacceptable."
  - After: "No, Nuncius. Janus as one organism with an immune response is conjecture, not data."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "So the Adeptus Administratum seeks to increase the efficiency of agricultural production, yet concurrently vetoes all research and remediation of genetic anomalies within the local flora and fauna?" {n}The Manipulus arches his eyebrow sceptically.{/n} "The decision is contradictory at its very foundation. What is to blame — a lack of competence, or deliberate sabotage?"
  - After: "They want efficiency yet veto research into the anomalies?" {n}Eogunn arches a brow.{/n} "Incompetence, or sabotage?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vinzelex emits a mournful binharic trill.{/n}
  - After: {n}Vinzelex trills mournfully.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your blessing for the examination, Magos?" {n}The Lexmechanic waits respectfully until Eogunn nods.{/n}
  - After: "Your blessing, Magos?" {n}He waits for Eogunn's nod.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your blessing for the examination, esteemed Magi?" {n}The Lexmechanic respectfully awaits the permission of Pasqal and Eogunn.{/n}
  - After: "Your blessing, Magi?" {n}He awaits Pasqal and Eogunn.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Are you suggesting that the planet is quite literally a living being, esteemed Genetor?"
  - After: "The planet is alive, Genetor?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "It is the Lilaethan's wrath — wrath that is becoming manifest in nature itself, in the workings of this world... May the gods preserve us, how did we not notice this sooner..." {n}Yrliet glances at you before immediately looking away.{/n}
  - After: "The Lilaethan's wrath, in nature itself... How did we miss it?" {n}Yrliet glances away.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "Nuncius believes so, colleague. Pay it no mind, it is merely an unverified hypothesis."
  - After: "Nuncius thinks so. Unverified."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Lexmechanic utters these final words with distinct envy, keeping his eyes locked on Genetor Februs.{/n}
  - After: {n}He eyes Genetor Februs enviously.{/n}

  - Before: {n}The Lexmechanic utters these final words with distinct envy, keeping his eyes locked on both Magos Haneumann and Genetor Februs.{/n}
  - After: {n}He eyes Magos Haneumann and Genetor Februs enviously.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "According to the data stored in my {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, all infrastructure nodes for food harvesting and processing have their own contingent of technomats — the total number amounts to two hundred and fifty-three.   - After: "My {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} says two hundred fifty-three technomats. Correction: two hundred eleven."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal and the Lexmechanic exchange trills of binharic greetings. The series of sounds issued by Vinzelex sounds much longer and more deferential than those of Pasqal.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Lexmechanic speaks the last words with distinct envy, his eyes fixed on Magos Haneumann.{/n}

  - Before: "Not at all, venerable Magos. I... Our tech-comrades from the Magos Biologis are humble workers, not warriors. They could not have come up with a thought of such a militant nature."

  - Before: "The current situation on the planet is assessed as — stable. The progress of the prospects is assessed as — encouraging."
  - After: "Situation: stable. Prospects: encouraging."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest's voice suddenly becomes grumpy.{/n} "Reporting: the current planetary leadership is also suspected to be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarGovern}compromised{/d}. The order to form the 'L-Than Restricted Forest Area' limits our ability to comprehend and presumably serves the purpose of protecting region of the xenos population. Circumstantial evidence indicates that senior leaders of the colony are in contact with these xenocreatures and may be under their control. I request an investigation."
  - After: {n}He turns grumpy.{/n} "Report: leadership is suspected {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusEldarGovern}compromised{/d}. The 'L-Than Restricted Forest Area' likely shields xenos, who may control colony leaders. I request an investigation."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/YrlietConfession/YrlietConfession

- **Player**
  - Before: "Why did you not say anything?"
  - After: "Why stay silent?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What an unexpected and suspicious revelation."
  - After: "A suspicious revelation."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Better late than never, I suppose. Show me the way."
  - After: "Better late than never. Lead on."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'd rather show you the way — to your grave. Wardens, seize her!"
  - After: "I'll show you your grave. Wardens, seize her!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If one of the Imperium's worlds is in danger — so be it, I will follow you."
  - After: "If an Imperial world is in danger, I'll follow."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What calamity are you talking about? You're still holding back information!"
  - After: "What calamity? You're still hiding things!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I don't believe you. You're luring me into a trap. Wardens, seize her!"
  - After: "It's a trap. Wardens, seize her!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Excellent — I was beginning to get bored without living targets to shoot at."
  - After: "Good, I was bored without targets."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "I am tired of your lies!"
  - After: [Attack] "Enough lies!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Elantach!" {n}Yrliet gestures for your attention.{/n} "As you once sought my help, now I am seeking yours. The time has come to dispel the final shadows on our path."
  - After: "Elantach!" {n}Yrliet beckons.{/n} "Now I need your help."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No other path was open to me, but now our paths are aligned. And my decision was motivated not by caprice, but by reason, which compels me now to be honest with the person who can fix all of this."
  - After: "I had no choice. Now reason demands honesty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Everything you have discovered, everything you have learned from your kind, they are all traces of the same calamity. A calamity that will eclipse all the strife and wars on the face of this world. All the signs were plain to see, but I was here and the mon-keigh failed to recognise the coming storm... Please, follow me, {name} — you must, if this world truly matters to you!"
  - After: "All you've found traces one calamity, worse than any war here. Follow me, {name}, if this world matters to you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Perhaps my admission does sound like that... but please believe one thing — what propels me now is much more important than my earlier silence."
  - After: "Perhaps. But this matters more than my silence."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Let's go, elantach. I pray to the gods that we are not too late..."
  - After: "Come, elantach. Pray we're not too late."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You have chosen the wrong path, mon-keigh — the path of pain and despair. Farewell."
  - After: "You chose despair, mon-keigh. Farewell."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thank you, elantach. You truly must have been brought here by providence, for— no. It was your will alone that brought you here, which has become a blessing for the Lilaethan."
  - After: "Thank you, elantach. You are a blessing for the Lilaethan."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I will reveal the truth very soon, but not here, not in the place where it seems evil has made its nest... Have patience, elantach — and trust me."
  - After: "Soon, not here. Trust me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Please restrain your bloodlust — while I am with you, nothing will threaten us."
  - After: "Restrain your bloodlust. With me, we're safe."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I don't think the Rogue Trader needs your revelations right now, xenos... that is even assuming that you are not lying now as well."
  - After: "We don't need your revelations, xenos. Or lies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have hidden the truth from you. I know a great deal about those who are disturbing the peace of the local ruler, and I also know where they are hiding. Allow me to show you the way — on the condition that you bring me to them."
  - After: "I know where the governor's enemies hide. I'll lead you, if you take me to them."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae lets out a faint chuckle.{/n} "Your kind are usually a bit better at bargaining. Always offer what can't be obtained with torture or thrones."
  - After: {n}Jae chuckles.{/n} "Bad bargain, xenos."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "The xenos thinks she can dictate terms to us — Vyatt is a poor handler indeed. I keep asking myself why she would want to keep such an unruly creature at her beck and call."
  - After: "The xenos dictates terms? Vyatt is a poor handler."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/AgriworldTown/Yrliet_BaseDialogue/Yrliet_BaseDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I will speak with you, Yrliet Lanaevyss. But keep your hands where I can see them."
  - After: "I'll talk, Yrliet Lanaevyss. Hands where I can see them."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader von Valancius will never speak to vermin such as xenos as if they were equals. So, if you want to live, you will address me with the proper respect."
  - After: "Von Valancius doesn't speak to xenos vermin as equals. Show respect if you want to live."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "I don't converse with the enemies of Humanity!"
  - After: [Attack] "I don't talk to Humanity's enemies!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have ten seconds to get out of my sight, xenos. Starting now."
  - After: "Ten seconds to leave my sight, xenos."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So you're the governor's mysterious helper?"
  - After: "You're the governor's mysterious helper?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "To be honest, the only part I understood was that you have no desire to fight. That is one thing we have in common."
  - After: "All I understood is you don't want to fight. Nor do I."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you helping the governor?"
  - After: "Why help the governor?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you know about the rank-and-file rebels?"
  - After: "What about the rank-and-file rebels?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you want, you can join me. None of the locals will dare to look askance at you in the Rogue Trader's presence."
  - After: "Join me. No local will dare look askance at you with me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave."
  - After: "I must go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How did you come to be on Janus?"
  - After: "How did you come to Janus?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you call me 'elantach'?"
  - After: "Why call me 'elantach'?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your answers are not particularly helpful."
  - After: "Your answers aren't helpful."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I spoke to the Magos in charge of operations on the planet. He says something's gone wrong with this world — there are spontaneous mutations, animal attacks. Maybe you have something to say about that?"
  - After: "The Magos says this world is wrong: spontaneous mutations, animal attacks. Thoughts?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The rebel that survived talked about strange experiments being conducted on the people of Janus. It is said that people are brought to the estate and never seen again. Do you know anything about that?"
  - After: "The surviving rebel spoke of experiments: people taken to the estate, never seen again. Know anything?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I examined the bodies of the rebels — they showed traces of mutation. Is that typical for Janus?"
  - After: "The rebels' bodies showed mutation. Is that typical for Janus?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Look at this skull. It was given to the governor's secretary by one of the governor's retinue. It looks like you and the deceased share a resemblance..."
  - After: "This skull came from the governor's retinue via her secretary. It resembles you..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you know who is behind the uprisings on the planet?"
  - After: "Who is behind the uprisings?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The bizarre creature before you only vaguely resembles a typical human. An elongated body, slender limbs, pointed features — every aspect of its appearance is unnatural and alien. The creature turns its head to you.{/n} "Yrliet Lanaevyss greets you, elantach."
  - After: {n}A slender alien turns to you.{/n} "Yrliet Lanaevyss greets you, elantach."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Would you look at this! Xenos — azhi devour them — mingling with humans!" {n}Jae tilts her head to the side.{/n} "Don't your lot think themselves above that? Anyway, it doesn't change the fact that it's a xenos that's been cosying up to Vyatt, not a mutant."
  - After: "A xenos, azhi devour them!" {n}Jae tilts her head.{/n} "Vyatt's pet isn't a mutant."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix tosses out some words in a strange language — there is a hint of musicality to it, but the Interrogator's rendering is harsh and off-putting. After meeting the gaze of the unknown being, Heinrix turns to you.{/n} "Regrettable news, {name}. This creature is not a mutant as the locals assumed, but a representative of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} — one of the myriad enemies of Humanity. You should not trust this creature. Do not communicate with it any longer than necessary."
  - After: {n}Heinrix speaks a harsh alien phrase.{/n} "{name}, it's an {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}, Humanity's enemy. Don't trust it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet seems to look through you.{/n} "Elantach."
  - After: {n}Yrliet looks through you.{/n} "Elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is no need to mutilate my language, mon-keigh — I speak yours well enough to converse with elantach without a translator. And since you have discerned my path, I will be direct in my speech."
  - After: "Don't mangle my language, mon-keigh. I'll be direct."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "{name}, with all due respect... are you sure this is the right decision? We know nothing about this xenos or why she has wormed her way into the governor's confidence. As far as I can tell, she isn't especially keen to help us — and yet for some obviously dark reason she has decided to take part in our investigation..."
  - After: "{name}, are you sure? We know nothing of this xenos or why she joins us."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Whoa... you've got to be the dumbest xenos in the galaxy, or you're braver than a whole Imperial Guard regiment. Must be a bit of both, if you're talking to {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} the Rogue Trader in that tone!"
  - After: "Whoa... dumbest or bravest xenos ever, talking to {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} like that!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am here at the behest of the ruler of these people. Your commands mean nothing to me, elantach."
  - After: "I serve this people's ruler, not you, elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Among my kin, respect is born of greatness, elantach. There are very few among your kind that are worthy of our respect. I will not change my path in favour of yours — but you may yet earn the esteem that your soul seeks."
  - After: "My kin respect only greatness. You may yet earn it, elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet inclines her head by an infinitesimal amount.{/n} "I have banished the shadow of doubt from your thoughts regarding my nature. Now you will answer my question — why have you sought me out?"
  - After: {n}Yrliet barely nods.{/n} "Why have you sought me out?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "You have not yet spent enough time among humans if you think threats will dispose me more favourably toward you. The decision is yours, Rogue Trader, but let me be clear — I will terminate your pet xenos at the first sign of her noncompliance."
  - After: "Rogue Trader, I'll kill her at the first sign of defiance."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am, elantach. My hand parried the death promised to the ruler of these people, and I aided you in battle against the lost ones."
  - After: "I am. I saved the ruler and fought the lost ones beside you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But you are not asking for help, elantach — you are merely asking questions, the answers to which are either unimportant or wreathed in shadow. Explore this place. Speak to those who know..." {n}Yrliet hesitates and then adds more quietly,{/n} "A simple task for you and an insurmountable challenge for me, since my very appearance provokes fear and suspicion. When you learn anything, tell me. Perhaps then my answers will be helpful to your search."
  - After: "You ask, not help. Speak to those who know..." {n}Quietly:{/n} "My face provokes fear. Tell me what you learn."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This world is in distress. I wish to protect it from unnecessary suffering."
  - After: "This world suffers. I would protect it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Only that they threaten the established order. There is much risk to this world should the ruler die."
  - After: "They threaten order. The ruler's death would endanger this world."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet is silent for several seconds, her gaze fixed on something beyond you. Slowly, drawing out her words, she replies,{/n} "So be it. I will go with you."
  - After: {n}Yrliet pauses.{/n} "So be it. I will go with you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The world you call Janus was once created by the will of my kin. I have far more right to be on the Lilaethan than any of you."
  - After: "My kin made Janus. The Lilaethan is more mine than yours."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am ready, elantach. Let us go forth."
  - After: "I am ready, elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Lilaethan is expressing her wrath..." {n}Yrliet pauses.{/n} "For centuries, this world has resisted the brutality inflicted upon it by soulless machines and unmindful creatures. But what the machine man told you — that is something else, something more frightening. The planet is fighting an evil that has taken root in its very cradle."
  - After: "The Lilaethan rages..." {n}She pauses.{/n} "She fights an evil rooted in her cradle."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I witnessed prisoners being delivered to the rear doors under cover of darkness, but what became of them I know not. And it is not my concern what you humans do to your fellows..." {n}Yrliet touches a sparkling gem on her chest, as though checking it is there.{/n}
  - After: "Prisoners came by night. Not my concern." {n}She touches her gem.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This world was pure, until your kind sullied it with its presence. The Lilaethan does not possess such powers — another force must be at play."
  - After: "The Lilaethan can't do this. Another force is at play."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet looks at the skull in your hands with unconcealed astonishment that quickly turns to anger.{/n} "You are right, elantach. Oh, Muaran, such vileness! And this is the price of your fate? The price of your path?" {n}The enraged Aeldari looks at you and turns her back.{/n} "Take that away... please..."
  - After: {n}Yrliet rages.{/n} "Muaran, such vileness!" {n}She turns away.{/n} "Take it away... please..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Because that is what you are. Elantach means stranger from the darkness amidst the stars. You descended on flame-winged machines in a dark time, when the air of the planet is soaked in blood and pain... Will you be the one to bring peace to the Lilaethan?"
  - After: "Elantach: stranger from the starry dark. Will you bring the Lilaethan peace?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix makes a sound of disapproval.{/n} "Reckless."
  - After: {n}Heinrix scoffs.{/n} "Reckless."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Must I remind you, Master van Calox, that the Warrant endows Rogue Traders with the sacred right to have dealings with xenos when necessary? That exceptional memory of yours seems to have let you down."
  - After: "The Warrant permits dealing with xenos, Master van Calox."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is a malevolence here that drives your kin down the path of violence."
  - After: "A malevolence here drives your kin to violence."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Elantach... everything you have told me stirs doubt and alarm in my soul. I must take time to contemplate. Do not disturb me further..." {n}Yrliet turns away from you, clearly burdened by her thoughts.{/n}
  - After: "Your words alarm me, elantach. Leave me be." {n}She turns away, troubled.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Your attempts to intimidate me are as hollow as the lies seeping from your lips. Only the Domin's grace stands between my blade and your throat, xenos."
  - After: "Only the Domin's grace spares your throat, xenos."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The proud xenos hears the words but does not see the blade that stands behind them. Good. An enemy who is careless and overconfident is an enemy that poses little threat."
  - After: "The xenos ignores the blade behind the words. Good. Overconfidence is weakness."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet stares at you with her strange eyes, wearing an expression that is remarkably difficult to interpret. At last, she arches one eyebrow so subtly you almost miss it.{/n} "I have met souls like you before. You travel a path that offers you enlightenment — a rare gift among your limited kind."
  - After: {n}One alien brow lifts.{/n} "Your path offers enlightenment, rare among your kind."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is fear in your words. You know what I am, and so I may no longer follow the shadowed path and must be direct."
  - After: "You fear me. So I'll be direct."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "But, Domin, this is... a xenos. The Tenets of the Bloodspun Web warn us about their deceitful and vicious nature. They compel us to destroy them on sight. She is an enemy of the Undying Emperor, and she is driven by dark designs."
  - After: "Domin, the Tenets of the Bloodspun Web demand we kill xenos on sight!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's face is unreadable, but you detect a strange tension in her voice, as though she is choosing her words carefully.{/n}
  - After: {n}Her voice is guarded.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do I need any other reason to come to the aid of those in need?"
  - After: "Must I have a reason to help?"

  - Before: {n}To the side, keeping some distance from Drivestem, stands a young woman whose face bears an uncanny resemblance to that of Abelard Werserian.{/n}
  - After: {n}Apart stands a young woman resembling Abelard Werserian.{/n}
- **Governor Urbend Drivestem**
  - Before: "We were talking about the brutal {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} raid on our fair Dargonus. So many victims, so much damage to our industries..."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} raid on Dargonus. So many victims..."

  - Before: "Thank the Emperor that you are our protector. If it weren't for you, the cursed invaders would have obliterated the whole planet." {n}He offers you a thin and obsequious smile.{/n}

- **Governor Urbend Drivestem**
  - Before: "Such a terrible shame it is that the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} currents delayed our protector's arrival..." {n}There is an acidic hint to his words, but it is too faint for you to call him to account. - **Hetka Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Sauerback blushes and raises his chin.{/n} "House Sauerback is stalwart in its faith, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: {n}Sauerback blushes.{/n} "House Sauerback is stalwart, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **Hetka Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Sauerback flushes and mumbles incoherently,{/n} "The honourable Macharius... forbade... but I wanted... did not let me go to battle..."
  - After: {n}Sauerback mumbles,{/n} "Macharius... wouldn't let me fight..."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor standing among the guests offers a thin smile.{/n} "It must have been difficult for this youth to foster such bloodlust toward enemies of the Imperium without ever having seen one at a blade's distance."

- **Hetka Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Sauerback raises his chin proudly and glances at the austere decorations in the palace — the weapons, the sacred banners, and the glorious trophies.   - Before: {n}The Inquisitor standing among the guests clears his throat — quietly, but Gaprak's face instantly pales and sours.{/n}

- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}He responds with a dignified bow, his proud face calm and unfaltering.{/n} "And my greetings to you, esteemed {name} von Valancius. May shadows never darken the light of the {g|Encyclopedia:Astronomican}Astronomican{/g} that guides you."

- **Astartia Werserian**

  - Before: "Absolutely, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. - **Astartia Werserian**
  - Before: "But I was so much more amazed by your generosity. The provisions that are being handed out in the streets of the capital will make the difference between life and death for many of those who lost everything in the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} attack."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Which could be quite advantageous to Lady Gaprak — after all, the disaster on Kiava Gamma has left her family in an extremely vulnerable position. The Werserians stand apart, their exclusion from the rest palpable.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "He is alive and well, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I imagine you will see for yourself soon. And please accept my gratitude for being so kind as to lend him your shuttle. The Inquisition values the assistance of the truly faithful children of the Emperor."

  - Before: {n}You begin to ponder the intricacies of the political landscape of your capital, but your only reward for the effort is a headache.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Drivestem exchanges telling glances with young Sauerback, who, judging by his face, is suddenly finding the collar of his expensive frock coat uncomfortably tight.{/n}

  - Before: {n}The Lord Inquisitor appears to be in amiable temper today. His expression is relaxed, and his calm gaze does not bode any immediate or harsh punishment.{/n}

  - Before: {n}Among the many {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmentations{/g}, what stands out is the horribly melted, deformed {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} connected to the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s head.
