## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/Guests2/Ceremony_Guests2_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I see you are interested in my companion Pasqal. I will grant you the privilege of conversing with him."
  - After: "You may speak with my companion Pasqal."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I promise to answer whenever I am not occupied with conquest and destruction of the enemies of Humanity."
  - After: "I'll answer when not busy destroying Humanity's enemies."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I doubt your correspondence will be an interesting read."
  - After: "Your letters would bore me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not have time for you right now."
  - After: "I've no time for you now."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Look stern] "Macharius, you should talk to your spouse about what passes for decent conduct in high society and what does not."
  - After: [Look stern] "Macharius, teach your wife decent manners."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How are you these days, Toriana?"
  - After: "How are you, Toriana?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do your part to heal the wounds inflicted on Kiava Gamma and your house will be forgiven."
  - After: "Help heal Kiava Gamma and your house will be forgiven."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It pleases me to see that our perspectives align. I, too, think that you are to blame for everything."
  - After: "We agree. I, too, blame you for everything."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me more about your family."
  - After: "Tell me about your family."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Macharius, I'm surprised you deigned to make an appearance here this evening."
  - After: "Macharius, I'm surprised you deigned to come."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What has so displeased you, Macharius?"
  - After: "What displeases you, Macharius?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Rogue Traders are not renegades vested with authority. We are the long arm of the Imperium, and I shall prove it to you."
  - After: "Rogue Traders are the Imperium's long arm. I'll prove it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your poor head, tormented with so many concerns. Would you like to have it removed from your shoulders?"
  - After: "Your poor, troubled head. Shall I remove it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You speak of the sector's future with such confidence — could it be that you want this power for yourself, that you simply envy Rogue Traders?"
  - After: "Do you envy Rogue Traders their power?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to know more about House Sauerback."
  - After: "Tell me about House Sauerback."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Even in leisure, you never cease to be of help. I appreciate it."
  - After: "Helpful even at leisure. I appreciate it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stop it! Do you ever act like anything other than a grubby spy?"
  - After: "Stop it! Are you ever more than a grubby spy?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What can you tell me about my guests?"
  - After: "What about my guests?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It is my pleasure. Macharius is lucky to have such a beautiful wife. Perhaps more so than you are to have him."
  - After: "Macharius is lucky in his wife — luckier than you in him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your countenance is familiar somehow. Could it be your resemblance to the image of Saint Maletta?"
  - After: "You resemble Saint Maletta, don't you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Point your weapon at Macharius and chuckle] "You know, Macharius, a person could kill for a woman so gorgeous."
  - After: [Point your weapon at Macharius and chuckle] "One could kill for such a woman."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shan't continue to test Macharius's loyalty by speaking with his beautiful wife any longer."
  - After: "I won't test Macharius's loyalty further by talking to his wife."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is there anything you would like to tell me?"
  - After: "Anything to tell me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you believe Kunrad's lies, then draw your weapon. Let us duel, right here, before the Emperor's visage."
  - After: "If you believe Kunrad's lies, duel me here, before the Emperor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would like to become better acquainted with your wife."
  - After: "I'd like to know your wife better."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I ordered Governor Drivestem to teach House Gaprak a lesson for what happened to Kiava Gamma. Dare I hope that you have learned it well?"
  - After: "Has House Gaprak learned Governor Drivestem's lesson for Kiava Gamma?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I forbid anyone to repeat Kunrad Voigtvir's lies and hereby impose a fine on you, Macharius."
  - After: "No one repeats Kunrad Voigtvir's lies. I fine you, Macharius."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your cousin, Jocasta, became the new Master-at-Arms on my ship."
  - After: "Your cousin Jocasta is my new Master-at-Arms."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Smile] "Macharius, you wouldn't mind, would you?"
  - After: [Smile] "You wouldn't mind, Macharius?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A group of aristocrats stands apart from the rest of the nobles. Their whispering carries a tinge of displeasure.{/n}
  - After: {n}Aristocrats whisper apart, displeased.{/n}
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: "May the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} grant you understanding." {n}The woman with whom he is conversing, the one dressed in a robe with gear-shaped adornments, is Toriana Gaprak. It is difficult to read her face due to it being covered in numerous augmentations.{/n}
  - After: "May the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} grant you understanding." {n}Toriana Gaprak.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}You catch Heinrix's intent gaze upon you, as he breaks off from agitatedly tapping at a data-slate. He makes a subtle gesture, clearly wishing to speak to you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix signals you over.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}With a glance to make sure the other guests are not observing you, the Interrogator murmurs,{/n} "We need to talk, {name}. Immediately."
  - After: {n}Heinrix murmurs,{/n} "We must talk, {name}. Now."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Nothing urgent, {name}." {n}Heinrix casts an impassive look at you and immediately glances away.{/n}
  - After: "Nothing urgent, {name}." {n}He looks away.{/n}
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}You can almost hear the crunching of teeth as Macharius answers in a high and hate-filled hiss:{/n} "Certainly not."
  - After: {n}Macharius hisses:{/n} "Certainly not."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix opens his mouth to say something, but stops himself by sheer force of will. His eyes return to scanning the crowd in the hall.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix bites back a reply.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Not here. Let's go elsewhere — this won't take long."
  - After: "Not here. It's quick."
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Regina blushes in embarrassment and hides her eyes.{/n} "I beg Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s forgiveness. I didn't mean to offend you with my manners."
  - After: {n}Regina blushes.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius is pale, his fingers trembling with anger. He nods dryly, with a hint of grudging gratitude in his voice:{/n} "I promise this will not happen again."
  - After: {n}Macharius, livid:{/n} "It won't happen again."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Toriana Gaprak looks rather anxious. Macharius Sauerback, dressed surprisingly plainly and austerely for an aristocrat of such a high rank, is frowning suspiciously. He came to the reception with a companion — a woman of dazzling beauty wearing a gilded {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augment{/g} necklace around her throat. His wife, probably.{/n}
  - After: {n}Anxious Toriana; frowning, austere Macharius; his dazzling wife in a gilded {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augment{/g} necklace.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix, who joined the group unnoticed, mostly keeps silent, listening intently to their every word.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix listens silently.{/n}
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}Like a forging hammer, Toriana's voice falls heavily on the ear.{/n} "The corruption of Kiava Gamma was a great blow to my family. The contemptible Cubis Delphim betrayed our trust, desecrated the forge-cathedrals, and took my esteemed cousin's life."
  - After: {n}Toriana:{/n} "Cubis Delphim betrayed us, desecrated Kiava Gamma's forge-cathedrals and killed my cousin."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Macharius is visibly vexed by this shift in the conversation. His wife offers you a reserved smile.{/n}
  - After: {n}Macharius is vexed. His wife smiles.{/n}
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: "On behalf of my family, I humbly beg you to forgive our negligence. I am ready to accept any punishment."
  - After: "Forgive our negligence. I accept any punishment."
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}Toriana raises her mechanical eyes to the ceiling.{/n} "I swear on the Omnissiah's all-encompassing insight, we will make every effort to justify the cost of its resurrection."
  - After: {n}Toriana looks up.{/n} "We'll justify its resurrection."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius scoffs.{/n} "It was only a year ago that none could doubt House Gaprak's usefulness. Yet here you are, Toriana, on your knees, 'justifying the cost.'"
  - After: {n}Macharius scoffs.{/n} "Once indispensable, now kneeling."
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}She sighs with a guttural clang.{/n} "The Omnissiah did not grant me understanding. I repent of my blindness."
  - After: {n}A clang.{/n} "I was blind. I repent."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius sighs with sympathy.{/n} "Such a tragedy, Toriana. To think that not but one year ago no one could have doubted your family's usefulness. Yet it took a single mistake to cast all of your accomplishments into oblivion."
  - After: {n}Macharius sighs.{/n} "One mistake erased everything."
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: "We Gapraks originate from the Calixis Sector, from the cluster of planets known as the Lathe Worlds. We worked faithfully for the good of our masters there, the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}, and through our service, we gained a spark of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}'s knowledge. Then fate tied us through the bonds of fealty to the venerable von Valancius dynasty, and we found ourselves in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. Generation after generation, we fulfilled our duty faultlessly, until Kiava Gamma destroyed and disgraced our name."
  - After: "We Gapraks served the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g} on Calixis's Lathe Worlds. Fealty to the von Valancius brought us to the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. We served faultlessly until Kiava Gamma."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius's face twists into an unpleasant smile, which makes the artificial skin on the left side all the more prominent.{/n} "I am a servant of the von Valancius dynasty. Had I not come, I would have committed an act of unacceptable insolence and damaged my family's honour."
  - After: {n}A crooked smile.{/n} "I serve the von Valancius. Absence would dishonour us."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius says with caution,{/n} "I am your dynasty's loyal servant... But you have asked, and I will answer. Too long has the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} lived under the rule of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}. The privileges granted to them make people think that commoners too can dismiss the prohibitions of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."
  - After: {n}Cautiously:{/n} "{g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g} have ruled the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} too long. Commoners now flout the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s laws."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "I wouldn't dare accuse you of anything, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am simply concerned. If you happen to lay my concerns to rest, House Sauerback will be praying for your well-being every day."
  - After: "I accuse no one, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Ease my concerns."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "Your will is absolute. When my head ceases to be of use — I will humbly place it upon the executioner's block." {n}Macharius's voice drips with insincere obedience.{/n}
  - After: {n}Falsely:{/n} "When my head is useless, I'll lay it on the block."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "As you command, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am not repeating the words of another, merely informing you that they are being spoken. But your behest will be carried out."
  - After: "As you command, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I only reported it."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Judging by the chuckles among the nobles, your words have found their mark. Macharius blushes in humiliation.{/n} "Not in the... slightest, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am content with my role as servant."
  - After: {n}Macharius flushes.{/n} "Not at all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix pulls out a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} and makes a note in it without looking.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix notes it on a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}.{/n}
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}Toriana looks away tactfully so as not to see her associate being disgraced.{/n}
  - After: {n}Toriana looks away.{/n}
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius puffs out his chest and says proudly,{/n} "The Sauerback line was one of the first noble houses to arrive in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}.   - After: {n}Proudly:{/n} "Sauerbacks were among the first nobles in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, serving the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} for millennia."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "It's been very illuminating. Given me plenty of food for thought." {n}Heinrix's response is barely audible.{/n}
  - After: "Very illuminating." {n}Barely audible.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I can't help it. It is my job to know the thoughts of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s faithful."
  - After: "It's my job to know the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s thoughts."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "That is why they call it the unsleeping eye of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}. Even in sleep, I hear everything."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}'s eye never sleeps."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Well, Macharius Sauerback is all but throwing darts at your portrait. He is more astute at choosing women than enemies. He is trying to entice Gaprak to his side, but she is too frightened after the fiasco on Kiava Gamma."
  - After: "Macharius all but throws darts at your portrait. He courts Gaprak, but she's too scared."
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius's wife offers you a charming smile, as if apologising for her husband's vitriolic tone. Her large dark eyes are brimming with curiosity.{/n}
  - After: {n}His wife smiles apologetically, eyes curious.{/n}
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "Even you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, are the subject of the strangest of rumours — and you have just recently inherited your protectorate.   - After: "Even you face rumours, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}: Kunrad Voigtvir's people say you killed Theodora. People believe it."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius bows his head without too much reverence.{/n}
  - After: {n}Macharius bows curtly.{/n}
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: "I am glad to know that you think highly of my beauty." {n}Regina blushes slightly.{/n}
  - After: "I'm glad you find me beautiful." {n}She blushes.{/n}
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: "You flatter me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But I cannot say that it is not to my liking."
  - After: "You flatter me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I like it."
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: "You underestimate Macharius, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. A man of his talents is a treasure to the one he serves." {n}Regina's voice is calm as she speaks about her husband, but it is not particularly warm either.{/n}
  - After: "Macharius is a treasure to his master, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Coolly.{/n}
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: "I wouldn't dream of claiming to bear any resemblance to a great saint. I lack her... virtue." {n}Regina makes eyes at you before demurely lowering her gaze.{/n}
  - After: "Resemble a saint? I lack her... virtue." {n}She flirts.{/n}
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: "I wouldn't dream of claiming to bear any resemblance to a great saint. That would be blasphemy." {n}Regina's voice is friendly and calm, but she keeps glancing at her husband.{/n}
  - After: "Resemble a saint? Blasphemy." {n}She glances at Macharius.{/n}
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}As Macharius pales, Regina smiles at him, then glances at you with interest.{/n} "I beg for your mercy. Macharius does not deserve death."
  - After: {n}Macharius pales; Regina looks intrigued.{/n} "Mercy. He doesn't deserve death."
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Regina glances at Macharius, who is not frightened by your sudden gesture in the slightest, then looks back at you. Her voice is calm but cold.{/n} "If my presence threatens my husband's life, I can humbly take my leave."
  - After: {n}Regina, coldly:{/n} "If I endanger my husband, I'll leave."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Regina gives you a charming smile. Meanwhile, Toriana and Macharius are watching the conversation unfold, not quite believing their eyes and ears.{/n}
  - After: {n}Toriana and Macharius watch in disbelief.{/n}
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}The glint in Regina's eyes betrays her genuine interest in you.{/n} "I hope this won't be the end of our acquaintance. You wouldn't mind if I wrote you from time to time, would you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"
  - After: {n}Eyes glinting:{/n} "May I write to you sometimes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius looks at you silently with a mixture of indignation and relief in his eyes.{/n} "The Rogue Trader has better things to do than read letters from {mf|his|her} subjects, Regina."
  - After: {n}Macharius, relieved:{/n} "The Rogue Trader needn't read {mf|his|her} subjects' letters, Regina."
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}Toriana's jaw augmetic lets out a low clang.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The punitive measures... considerably curbed both the wealth and the numbers of my family. We will never forget our just punishment."
  - After: {n}A clang.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We lost wealth and kin. We won't forget."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "I dare hope that your reign will see the faith on Dargonus remain as doctrinally strict as it was under Lady Theodora. The appearance of a death cultist at your side makes one wonder if we should anticipate changes in our customary ways of honouring the Emperor."
  - After: "Keep Dargonus's faith strict, as Lady Theodora did. Your death cultist worries me."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "I am pleased to hear it." {n}Nothing in Macharius's face shows that he is glad for his cousin.{/n} "I always worried that her character would cause our house a great deal of grief, and yet, in the end, the noble Sauerback blood was stronger than any personal shortcomings.   - After: "Pleased to hear it." {n}He isn't.{/n} "Sauerback blood should prevail. Jocasta will do." {n}Forced smile.{/n}
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}The clear leader of this gathering is a gaunt, bilious-faced man dressed in Sauerback colours — this must be Macharius himself, head of the house. He offers you a ceremonious bow.{/n} "My congratulations, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}Their gaunt leader, Macharius, bows.{/n} "Congratulations, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "{name}, before this gala concludes, there is something I'd like to tell you... Be careful today. I sense that a wave of darkness will soon hit our defensive lines, and I hope that I will still get a chance to meet you there as an ally."
  - After: "{name}, be careful today. Darkness will soon strike. I hope we meet there as allies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}For an inscrutable man, Heinrix is being even more inscrutable than usual. It's as if he is hiding something. Something important.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix is hiding something important.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix looks away, tracking the guests' movements around the hall.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix watches the guests.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is something lurking beneath Toriana's repentant expression... a grudge. It would seem that she was personally offended by the nightmare into which Cubis Delphim plunged her domain, and she feels betrayed.{/n}
  - After: {n}Beneath her repentance: a grudge over Cubis Delphim's betrayal.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Unfortunately, her {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmented{/g} face expresses a limited range of emotions, and her synthesised voice conceals lies too easily.{/n}
  - After: {n}Her {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmented{/g} face reveals nothing.{/n}
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}You notice Toriana's mechanical visors periodically looking past you, in the direction of Pasqal. It seems the Tech-Priest is an object of fascination for her.{/n}
  - After: {n}Toriana's visors keep drifting to Pasqal.{/n}
- **Toriana Gaprak**
  - Before: {n}Something rattles in her visors.{/n} "I was delighted to see one of the Omnissiah's priests placed beside you. In these trying times, the entire sector needs to stand together, united into one mechanism. The Adeptus Mechanicus will help us do just that."
  - After: {n}Visors rattle.{/n} "An Omnissiah priest beside you! The Mechanicus will unite us."
- **Toriana Gaprak**

  - After: {n}Toriana lights up.{/n} "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Laypeople like us rarely meet such an {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} dignitary."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius places his hand on the hilt of his sword, then glances with uncertainty at the images of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} gazing upon him from every direction, then at you. His fingers release the hilt.{/n}

- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "No. I do not believe his words. I am your servant, and my oath to your dynasty is harder than steel. I am guilty of repeating an ignominious lie, and I will pay a fine. And anyone who repeats it in my presence I myself will challenge to a duel to the death."
  - After: "No. I'll pay the fine, and duel to the death anyone who repeats that lie."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: "For the good of the sector, Rogue Traders must become paragons of the law, not exceptions to it. But do many {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} holders exhibit lawful conduct? No, they do not!"
  - After: "Rogue Traders should uphold the law. Do {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} holders? No!"
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Regina smiles, triumphant and flattered.{/n} "I daren't count on such generous courtesy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}Regina, flattered:{/n} "Such courtesy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: "It is an honour to be in your company, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "An honour, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Regina Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Regina blushes in embarrassment and hides her eyes.{/n} "Please forgive my insolence, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}Regina blushes.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Macharius Sauerback**
  - Before: {n}Macharius grips the hilt of his parade blade as if trying to strangle it, and wheezes furiously:{/n} "A high honour for House Sauerback."
  - After: {n}Macharius wheezes:{/n} "A high honour for House Sauerback."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/InquisitorTruth/Ceremony_InquisitorTruth_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "If you want me as your ally, you can request an audience and repeat everything you just said in public."
  - After: "Want me as an ally? Say it all again in public."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Remind me, who are you?"
  - After: "Who are you again?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Heinrix, I thought we were friends. But friends don't break into each other's chambers in the middle of the night with weapons, do they?"
  - After: "Heinrix, friends don't break into each other's chambers armed at night."
- **Player**
  - Before: "But now Janus is pure once more. You can see for yourself. There will be a palace and everything you desire waiting for you on the planet."
  - After: "Janus is pure again. A palace awaits you there."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You think you can just barge into my chambers? Are you quite mad, Inquisitor?"
  - After: "Barging into my chambers? Are you mad, Inquisitor?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If the Inquisition wishes to have a talk with me — I am glad to be at its service."
  - After: "I'm glad to serve the Inquisition."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I used her to deal with a more serious threat — the xenos. Now I need Vistenza no longer, and I will, naturally, neutralise her."
  - After: "I used her against the xenos. Now I'll neutralise Vistenza."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Lower your voice] "I have been pondering this myself. I cannot deny the possibility that Vistenza... influenced my thinking somehow."
  - After: [Lower your voice] "Vistenza may have... influenced my thinking."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You do not have to leave, Heinrix. Stay."
  - After: "You needn't leave, Heinrix. Stay."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Aim your weapon at the intruder] "If something looks like an assassination and smells like an assassination... perhaps I ought to start treating it like one?"

And yet the blame for this oversight lies with your dynasty, wouldn't you agree?"
  - After: "A cult on Footfall traces to your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_JanusChaosFood}grain{/d} shipments, left unblessed by negligence or sabotage. The blame is your dynasty's, agreed?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Lord Inquisitor raises one brow, considering your declaration.{/n} "Your zeal is impressive, {name}. However, I cannot accept such an oath from you, at least, not now. You will be more useful to the Inquisition in your current position than as a member of my coterie. Nevertheless..."
  - After: {n}He raises a brow.{/n} "Impressive zeal, {name}, but you're more useful where you are. Nevertheless..."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/Servitor

- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You ordered to have them {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsExecuted}killed{/d}. You felt sad."
  - After: "You had them {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsExecuted}killed{/d}. Sadly."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You did something we could not understand. You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsCorrupted}pierced{/d} one of the servitors with a shard of the dark light. We had never felt anything like it. Pain. The deaths of the receptacles. And the dark light — it is always near, it wants to come and be, even though it would make others cease to be. And you are excited by its presence."
  - After: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsCorrupted}pierced{/d} a servitor with dark light. Pain. It excites you."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We remember the day when the star disappeared. When the dark light and the sated hunger wanted to take the world. Rykad Minoris was its name in the ship's data."
  - After: "We remember the star vanishing over Rykad Minoris."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You came and looked at us like you understood something. But then you ordered that all the servitors be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsDuty}sent back{/d} to their work. You said it was just."
  - After: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_StrangeServitorsDuty}sent{/d} the servitors back to work. 'Just,' you said."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We remember another day. We awakened inside the ship. We lived in its systems. Then we tried to emerge. Into servitors like this one. Then so many of our receptacles were gathered in one place."
  - After: "We woke in the ship, then entered servitors."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You ordered that the world's heart, the old reactor, be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadExterminatus}torn apart{/d}. The fire destroyed everything. So many human shells who were begging to be saved. But the dark light retreated."
  - After: "You had the reactor {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadExterminatus}torn apart{/d}. Fire took all. The dark light retreated."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You ordered that the human shells on the world be {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadNoExterminatus}saved{/d}. Even though the dark light was coming closer and could have consumed both the ship and Rykad Minoris."
  - After: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadNoExterminatus}saved{/d} the shells, despite the dark light."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadChaosWorld}let{/d} Rykad Minoris be consumed by the dark light, and consumed it was, along with every human shell who was begging for help."
  - After: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_RaycadChaosWorld}let{/d} the dark light consume Rykad Minoris."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/Servitor/Ceremony_Servitor_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Pasqal, I believe you intended to investigate what Nomos is."
  - After: "Pasqal, you meant to study what Nomos is."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not wish to speak with you at this time."
  - After: "Not now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Nomos, what do you think you are?"
  - After: "Nomos, what are you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How are you finding the ceremony?"
  - After: "Enjoying the ceremony?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Take what you want to take — that is the rule of life. That is the only driving force behind everything."
  - After: "Take what you want — that's life's only rule."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have other business to attend to."
  - After: "I have other business."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Yes, you do understand correctly. Every thread that connects people, every life — their value is beyond measure. There is no greater reward than guiding others to salvation when all that surrounds us is darkness."
  - After: "Yes. Every life is priceless. Nothing beats guiding others through darkness."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I did enjoy the part about the web. However, I see myself as the spider who has spun the web, not some benevolent helper."
  - After: "Nice web. But I'm the spider who spun it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Of course. What do you wish to speak about?"
  - After: "Of course. About what?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The picture you are painting is too grim. A flame is a good symbol when it lights the way and warms the soul. Not when it destroys."
  - After: "Too grim. A flame should light and warm, not destroy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Even if I do possess this 'mote of flame,' it is only because I wish to use it for my own ends."
  - After: "If I hold this 'mote of flame,' it's for my own ends."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are spouting faithless drivel. If there is an urge that drives me, it is my commitment to serve the Imperium!"
  - After: "Faithless drivel! I'm driven to serve the Imperium!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are wrong. I wish to bring light and freedom, not feed people to monsters."
  - After: "Wrong. I bring light and freedom, not monsters."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not remember inviting you to my Magnae Accessio."
  - After: "I didn't invite you to my Magnae Accessio."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What made you come here?"
  - After: "Why come here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why have you brought it here, Pasqal?"
  - After: "Why bring it, Pasqal?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare you question me? Whatever you are, my word is the final truth."
  - After: "How dare you? My word is final truth."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your understanding of humans is still limited, Nomos. I speak the truth, but your conclusions are flawed."
  - After: "You still misread humans, Nomos. I'm truthful; your conclusions are flawed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. You are right. And you indeed have understood me correctly."
  - After: "Very well. You understood me correctly."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The light of salvation that guides people through darkness is the light of Holy Terra. It is the only light."
  - After: "That light is Holy Terra's. The only light."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You speak of faith. Of the Imperium's tenets. Of the one who is above all, the Emperor. You are correct. I am His chosen, and I carry His flame into the darkness of the Koronus Expanse."
  - After: "Yes — faith, the Emperor above all. I am His chosen, carrying His flame into the Koronus Expanse."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not obligated to explain myself to you."
  - After: "I owe you no explanation."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Freedom and rapture. They are the only things worth living for."
  - After: "Freedom and rapture. Nothing else matters."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whatever miraculous machine spirit you might be, I am a Rogue Trader, and you are my servant."
  - After: "Machine spirit or not, I'm a Rogue Trader and you're my servant."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I cannot tell you what stands above everything else. Each one of us has our own purpose, our own guiding star, and our own path. And they all are of equal worth."
  - After: "Nothing stands above all. Each of us has their own star and path, all equally worthy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How did an entity like you move into a servitor's body?"
  - After: "How did you get into a servitor?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You did not follow that which was calling from behind the curtain. You walked into the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}fire{/d}. And the rest walked in after you."
  - After: "You ignored the call and walked into the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentThroughFire}fire{/d}. Others followed."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal greets you with a bow.{/n} "Extending congratulations to Unit {name} von Valancius on attaining your new legal status."
  - After: {n}Pasqal bows.{/n} "Congratulations, Unit {name}."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor is silent for a while. Then it says almost helplessly,{/n} "Is it true that we understand so poorly? Imperfection pains us."
  - After: {n}It falters.{/n} "We understand so poorly? It pains us."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Greetings, {name} von Valancius. Will you speak with us?" {n}The words that come out of the voice synthesiser in the servitor's throat sound surprisingly... alive?{/n}
  - After: "Greetings, {name} von Valancius. Speak with us?" {n}It sounds alive.{/n}
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Many things. Happenings. Events. Decisions." {n}The servitor's eyes roll in their sockets before focusing on you.{/n}
  - After: "Many things." {n}Its eyes fix on you.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest surveys the hall as if conducting a thorough analysis, then concludes,{/n} "Disorderly."
  - After: {n}Pasqal scans the hall.{/n} "Disorderly."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "It is Nomos's new repository. Nomos, this unit identifies as {name} von Valancius. Two-way identification complete."
  - After: "Nomos's new body. Nomos, this is {name} von Valancius."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We will think about the irrepressible rapture. About what pierces and consumes. Perhaps we will understand then?"
  - After: "We will ponder rapture. Then understand?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We envisage this larger notion as a liquid. A sticky, saccharine stream. It is like the dark light and the sated hunter and all else that is always watching us. You drink this liquid eagerly. You revel in it. It gives you strength, desires, energy, and courage. It beckons. It also consumes — those whom you cast aside, those who are weak, and those who get in the way. Do Nomos understand correctly?"
  - After: "A sweet, sticky stream. You drink it; it empowers you and consumes the weak. Correct?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Now we think that there is more. That there is another side that we do not see. A notion that is larger than what we can compute. Something that stands above fears and needs. Something that drives them."
  - After: "Something larger drives fears and needs."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor leans forward.{/n} "We enjoy greetings. We enjoy communication."
  - After: {n}It leans in.{/n} "We enjoy greetings."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor cocks its head just like a human being would.{/n} "Nomos will not cause trouble. Nomos simply want to be. And learn."
  - After: {n}It cocks its head.{/n} "Nomos mean no trouble. Only to learn."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Nomos require communication. Knowledge. Movement. Magos Pasqal compelled us not to speak with anyone other than him or you. It is disappointing. But at least we can observe."
  - After: "Pasqal lets us speak only to him and you. But we observe."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor perks up and moves its hands around haphazardly, as if unsure what to do with them.{/n}
  - After: {n}It perks up, fidgeting.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Entity Nomos asked permission for this visit. My objective was to observe the process of integration into a servitor."
  - After: "Nomos asked. I observe its integration."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Nomos have changed since we last spoke with you, {name}. We are now able to conceptualise our previous experience, that of solitude. And we no longer enjoy it."
  - After: "Nomos now know solitude, {name}, and dislike it."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We wanted to see. Observe. Cognise. Speak." {n}The servitor makes a strange, wavy gesture with its hands that looks at once very human and far from anything human.{/n} "We want to speak with you! Will you speak with us?"
  - After: "To observe." {n}It gestures oddly.{/n} "Speak with us?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "But we were able to transfer a small part of us and build a thread strong enough to travel outside the ship. We are enjoying this. Journey. Discovery. Even though this receptacle suits us poorly — it will soon be destroyed by the force of our presence."
  - After: "Part of us left the ship. We enjoy it, though this body will soon break."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We will think about the flame and faith. About the one you call your god and Emperor. Perhaps we will understand then?"
  - After: "We will ponder your flame and Emperor."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We will think about the light. The connections. Life. Perhaps we will understand then?"
  - After: "We will ponder light and connection."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "May you yet find time for this conversation."
  - After: "Perhaps later."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We envisage this larger notion as a flame. A blaze. It burns in your blood. You are holding a mote of this flame in your hand. No matter what decision you are faced with, you want it to burn brighter. Those who turn away from the flame must be destroyed. Those who follow it — who follow you — are the only ones who deserve to live. Do Nomos understand correctly?"
  - After: "A flame in your blood. Those who turn away must die; only your followers live. Correct?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor's gaze becomes more animated as you approach. It looks at you expectantly.{/n}
  - After: {n}It looks at you expectantly.{/n}
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We do not yet know what we are. A servant? Service. We must understand. Will you speak with us so that we understand?"
  - After: "We don't know what we are. Help us understand?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We regret this. We wish that you would speak with us."
  - After: "We regret this."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Thank you for speaking with us. Nomos are grateful. We cannot continue moving... on our own."
  - After: "Thank you. Nomos cannot move alone."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "A flame, then. Faith and great sanctity are far in the distance, where a golden star burns and feeds on cries. We understand now. We will think about this."
  - After: "A flame. A golden star feeding on cries. We will think on this."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor moves its limbs as if in excitement.{/n} "So Nomos understood correctly. We are enjoying this. This movement toward a goal. This learning with a purpose. We wonder if we too can carry a mote of this flame. Or is it inside us already? We have, after all, absorbed a part of you with your blood."
  - After: {n}It twitches excitedly.{/n} "We understood! Do we carry the flame, through your blood?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor standing next to him is examining you obliquely. It quickly looks away upon realising that you have noticed.{/n}
  - After: {n}A servitor eyes you, then looks away.{/n}
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "But that is wrong. That is not what you really think!" {n}The servitor inclines its head and looks at you... stubbornly?{/n} "We have been observing you. We have felt you. Through your blood, your gaze, and all that cannot be described. We are certain we have understood correctly!"
  - After: "You don't think that!" {n}It looks stubborn.{/n} "We've felt your blood!"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We knew we could understand you! Light and movement, connections and help. We are enjoying this. Perhaps because we too are connected to you? Through blood. Through life."
  - After: "We knew it! Light and connection. Perhaps we're connected too, by blood."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We understand you. It is what we feel. The urge, the irrepressible force. Perhaps it is because we have tasted your blood." {n}The servitor's mechanical voice grows almost wistful.{/n} "And it fills us still."
  - After: "We feel that urge too, from your blood." {n}Wistfully:{/n} "It fills us still."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Do you see? We understand you. No, we do not understand you. But we feel you, more than anyone does."
  - After: "See? We don't understand you. But we feel you."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: {n}The servitor takes half a step away from you and tilts its head.{/n} "You bring in dissonance. But we do not understand why. We do not want to speak any more for now. We need to start over, reflect, understand."
  - After: {n}It steps back.{/n} "Dissonance. We must reflect."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "And you followed that which was calling from behind the curtain. You let it {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentWithTheodora}lead{/d} you out of the fire."
  - After: "You let the call {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentWithTheodora}lead{/d} you from the fire."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "You did not listen to that which was {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentBack}calling{/d} from behind the curtain. You thought only about those who followed you and about the fire that could destroy those shells."
  - After: "You ignored the {d|Encyclopedia:Prologue_WentBack}call{/d}, thinking of your followers."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Every fifteen watches, I commune with Nomos's code and spend prescribed lengths of time in calculus-meditation. However, the Omnissiah has yet to bless me with an answer. All I can say is that the capabilities of the entity Nomos are extraordinary. The ship's hallowed systems sing beneath its touch. Nodes that have remained dead for hundreds of standard years are revivified, and long-drained mechanisms live anew." {n}You hear notes of awe in Pasqal's voice.{/n}
  - After: "I study Nomos's code; the Omnissiah stays silent. It revives long-dead nodes." {n}Pasqal sounds awed.{/n}
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "This is what we have seen, among many other things. We have begun to understand — we think that we have — that we do not know everything about humans and about you, {name} von Valancius. We have tried analysing shells and defining sets of their needs and fears. Their simple functions. But..."
  - After: "We don't know everything about humans, or you, {name} von Valancius. But..."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "That is so strange. The worth of a modicum, uniqueness in the immeasurable. We understand now. We will think about this."
  - After: "Small things, uniquely worthy. We will think on this."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "Possession and movement, irrepressibility and rapture. We understand now. We will think about this."
  - After: "Possession and rapture. We will think on this."
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "We envisage this larger notion as a light. A web of light that connects humans. It may seem almost invisible, ephemeral, but it grows stronger when they are threatened. This web is always on your mind. When darkness comes, you want every thread that extends from you to shine bright so that those who follow do not lose their way. Whenever a thread breaks, it saddens you. Do Nomos understand correctly?"
  - After: "A web of light linking humans. You want every thread bright. Correct?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "But we cannot understand what it is. Perhaps you will tell us?"
  - After: "What is it? Tell us?"
- **Strange Servitor**
  - Before: "This is not the entirety of us. This receptacle is too narrow, crude, and feeble to contain our complete whole. The existence of Nomos requires... a space of connections."
  - After: "This body can't hold all of us. Nomos need connections."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}After a pause, Pasqal continues,{/n} "Great machines of the Imperium, ones such as your ship, house a machine spirit so complex and wilful that it is difficult to tell them apart from Abominable Intelligence. There remains a possibility that Nomos is an entity of corruption. But with every day, I grow stronger in my faith that it is not so, that what we are witnessing is, in truth, the Omnissiah's miracle. One that is Category Five or higher."
  - After: {n}Pasqal adds,{/n} "It may be corruption, but I believe it's the Omnissiah's miracle — Category Five or higher."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/Speech

- **Player**
  - Before: "Remember that you have no other ruler but me. For any who dare to forget this, the howls of daemons from the warp will sound like the babbling of babes, and xenos blades will seem like a soft feather bed compared to the horror of the punishment I'll inflict!"
  - After: "I am your only ruler. Forget it, and daemons and xenos blades will seem gentle next to my punishment!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I, {name}, Rogue Trader by the grace of the Emperor, vow to be the paragon of Humanity..."
  - After: "I, {name}, Rogue Trader by the Emperor's grace, vow to be the paragon of Humanity..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Serve faithfully, and I will lead you to prosperity. The Koronus Expanse will enrich us all!"
  - After: "Serve faithfully and I'll lead you to prosperity. Koronus will enrich us all!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Praise the Emperor, faithful souls! The darkness around us may be fierce, but the blaze in our hearts is fiercer still! Evil will burn!"
  - After: "Praise the Emperor! The darkness is fierce, but our hearts burn fiercer! Evil will burn!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Fear not the coming day. Henceforth, you are all my charges."
  - After: "Fear not. Henceforth, you are all my charges."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Turn to the master of ceremonies and speak right into the vox] "Am I expected to say something to them? I won't talk to rabble. Take it away."
  - After: [Speak into the vox] "I won't talk to rabble. Take it away."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}The commoners and nobility look upon you with adoration, and upon Yrliet with horror and curiosity. The sight of the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} standing at attention by your side strikes awe into their hearts.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd gapes at the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} Yrliet.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Very loud thinkers, these people." {n}Her face pallid, Idira taps the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetic{/g} on her temple. She is clearly discomfited under the gaze of the massive crowd. The commoners have never seen a real "sorcerer" before, and they stare at her with curiosity and fear.{/n}
  - After: "Very loud thinkers." {n}Pale, Idira taps her {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetic{/g}.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A hush falls over the crowd, who gaze upon you in adoration. Many of them bear terrible scars from the recent battle of Dargonus. Like children, they await the word of their almighty {mf|father|mother}.{/n}
  - After: {n}The scarred crowd awaits their {mf|father|mother}'s word.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}You hear a rustle behind you as Heinrix leans forward in a ceremonious bow. In that moment, the eyes of your many subjects flare with fanaticism — this single unassuming gesture from an unassuming servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} serves to them as the ultimate proof that the hand of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} truly is at work in this dark sector.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix bows. To the crowd, the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} proves the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s hand.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "So much gold and white..." {n}Cassia stares at the crowd, enraptured. It seems this massive gathering of exulting people is just as exotic and captivating to her as the sight of a bona fide {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}, a representative of the mysterious and powerful {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g}, is to your subjects.{/n}
  - After: "So much gold and white..." {n}Cassia is rapt; the crowd gawks at a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} of the {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g}.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I am impressed. Dargonus adores its ruler no less than we adore our rulers on Efreet." {n}Jae, who is at the epicentre of the adoration being lavished upon you, smiles radiantly and casually displays her gleaming gold bionic arm for the crowd's greedy gaze.{/n} "I like it, shereen!"
  - After: "Dargonus adores you like Efreet adores its rulers." {n}Jae flaunts her gold arm.{/n} "I like it, shereen!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You hear a rumble — it is the roar of the sea of your subjects. With jubilation and devout fear, they welcome your ascension. It is done.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your subjects roar. It is done.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Making the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}, Argenta shouts out, "Emperor keep the von Valancius dynasty!" The crowd zealously picks up the chant, repeating it.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta makes the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}: "Emperor keep the von Valancius dynasty!" The crowd chants it.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal sketches a blessing in the air, and many of your subjects, wearing beatific smiles, copy it — technomats in grease-stained robes, bureaucrats scratching at scrolls with autoquill fingers, and aristocrats flaunting their costly {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmentations{/g}. On a world as civilised as Dargonus there are many who honour the Omnissiah and His priests.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal sketches a blessing; {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmented{/g} subjects copy it.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The crowd fall to their knees in terror and awe, chanting your name and screaming oaths of eternal loyalty to the von Valancius dynasty. Any who hesitate or question this mania are torn to pieces by the throng.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd kneels, tearing apart any who hesitate.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I am your shadow, Domin'{name}, and a shadow must remain unseen. But on this day, let all see that my blood is yours." {n}Kibellah cuts her palm and touches her heart, lips, and forehead. As one, your subjects of all classes start slicing their hands, repeating the bloody sign.{/n}
  - After: "I am your shadow, Domin'{name}. Today, my blood is yours." {n}Kibellah cuts her palm; the crowd copies her.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I, Proctor Solomorne Anthar, bear witness to the alliance between the Rogue Trader and the Adeptus Arbites, and praise the bearer of the sacred Warrant on the day of {mf|his|her} lawful inauguration." {n}Solomorne presses his fist to his chest with a low thud, and the crowd bursts into a fervent roar.{/n}
  - After: "I, Proctor Solomorne Anthar, witness the Arbites' alliance with {mf|his|her} rule." {n}The crowd roars.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/StewardEnd/Ceremony_StewardEnd_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you think of the reception?"
  - After: "How's the reception?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will return to the guests."
  - After: "I'll return to the guests."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The last thing I wish to do right now is speak to a servitor."
  - After: "I don't want to talk to a servitor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I hope Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is pleased and not yet tired? If you wish to revive yourself a little, I would suggest proceeding to the courtyard, if I may be so bold — many guests have chosen to move into the fresh air and will be eager to offer you their congratulations."
  - After: "Pleased, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Guests await in the courtyard."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but..." {n}The master of ceremonies lowers his voice to a conspiratorial whisper.{/n} "Before you leave your guests, you may wish to greet Rogue Traders Chorda and Winterscale.   - After: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}He whispers.{/n} "First greet Rogue Traders Chorda and Winterscale. Don't offend them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is magnificent! I daresay it will live on as the premier high society event of the sector for many years."
  - After: "Magnificent! The sector's event of the decade."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Please allow me to escort you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "Allow me to escort you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "They will be delighted. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"
  - After: "Glory to the von Valancius dynasty!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your chambers are ready. But I must inform you that that servitor over there..." {n}The master of ceremonies points at a servitor standing in the corner, dressed in your ship's livery.{/n} "...approached me and said that it has a message for you. Its speech was surprisingly fluent and expressive for a servitor, so I think someone must have put this message into it."
  - After: "Your chambers are ready. But..." {n}He points to a servitor in your livery.{/n} "...it has someone's message for you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The master of ceremonies drops his voice to a whisper:{/n} "It could be a secret dispatch."
  - After: {n}He whispers:{/n} "Perhaps a secret dispatch."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/StewardStart/Ceremony_StewardStart_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You have been entrusted with arranging the festivities?"
  - After: "You arranged the festivities?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Then let us begin."
  - After: "Let us begin."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The ceremony will have to wait."
  - After: "The ceremony must wait."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The servant in fine clothes offers you a deep bow.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, it is a great honour to serve you in an undertaking as monumental and glorious as the Magnae Accessio ceremony."
  - After: {n}A servant bows.{/n} "An honour to serve at the Magnae Accessio, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "House Werserian, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, is overjoyed at having received the honour of introducing you to your subjects and humbly thanks you."
  - After: "House Werserian, who arranged the festivities, thanks you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "House Sauerback, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, wishes that the Emperor's favour be with you on this momentous day."
  - After: "House Sauerback, the organisers, wishes you the Emperor's favour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "House Drivestem, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, wishes you good fortune and is sincerely delighted to serve you as they served the honourable Theodora von Valancius before you."
  - After: "House Drivestem, the organisers, serves you as they served Theodora."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The palace decorations are prepared and we are ready to begin at your command. The festive activities in the capital have likewise been arranged, and the guests of honour either have arrived on the planet or are awaiting invitation in near orbit. The servants are already in your chambers to see to it that you are impeccably garbed for the occasion."
  - After: "All is ready. Guests await. Servants will dress you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No one but you can decide when it is to take place."
  - After: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You decide when."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "May the Emperor be with us this day!"
  - After: "Emperor be with us!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "House Gaprak, to whom you entrusted the arrangements for the festivities, thanks you for not turning your back on them even in these dark times and for allowing them the honour of introducing you to your subjects."
  - After: "House Gaprak, the organisers, thanks you for not abandoning them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have been given the high honour of being steward of this eminent palace, and on the occasion of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s accession, I will be overseeing the preparations for the ceremony."
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. As palace steward, I oversee Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s accession ceremony."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Ceremony_Coronation/Voxmaster/Ceremony_Voxmaster_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I have only just returned from Dargonus. What kind of celebrations can they hope to hold amid the ruins?"
  - After: "Dargonus is in ruins. What celebration can they hold?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is this ceremony? I swear an oath, then I shake a lot of sweaty hands?"
  - After: "So I swear an oath and shake sweaty hands?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Execute every known embezzler, scoundrel, and conman. I will begin my reign by purging my realm of vermin."
  - After: "Execute every embezzler and conman. I'll begin by purging vermin."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let the poor be fed and fuel cells handed out to those in need. My reign shall begin with an act of benevolence."
  - After: "Feed the poor and hand out fuel cells. I'll begin with benevolence."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to hear prayers and witness the people's faith."
  - After: "I wish to hear the people's prayers."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Now what does the rabble like to see... Give out enough amasec for everyone and hold fights between tougher serfs."
  - After: "Give the rabble amasec and serf fights."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Must I decide how to entertain my subjects now too?"
  - After: "Must I plan their entertainment too?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Abelard deserves this place."
  - After: "Abelard deserves this."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Sister Argenta will be at my side."
  - After: "Sister Argenta."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Jae has earned this right."
  - After: "Jae earned this."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The honour will go to Cassia."
  - After: "Cassia."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will stand alone."
  - After: "I'll stand alone."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Did the Rogue Traders from the other dynasties flock to Theodora's Magnae Accessio as well?"
  - After: "Did other Rogue Traders attend Theodora's Magnae Accessio?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to see Kibellah at my side."
  - After: "Kibellah at my side."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Solomorne will take his place next to me."
  - After: "Solomorne will stand by me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Eogunn will stand by my side."
  - After: "Eogunn will stand by me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In the eyes of your subjects, you already are a Rogue Trader. It is now time to become one in the eyes of the Emperor."
  - After: "Now become a Rogue Trader in the Emperor's eyes."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your servants wish to know your opinion on two matters related to the ceremony arrangements. The first of which is — what festive activities are to take place in the capital on this glorious day?"
  - After: "Two questions. First: what festivities in the capital?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is an ancient tradition of the von Valancius dynasty. When the heir accedes to Rogue Trader status, they take a sacred oath of fealty to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} and announce themselves as His steward on the dynasty's vassal worlds. It is an act of faith that is meant to remind the Rogue Trader of their mission."
  - After: "A von Valancius tradition. The heir swears fealty to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} as His steward, a reminder of their mission."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do not underestimate Governor Drivestem's desire to find favour with Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. At this very moment, thousands of your subjects are clearing rubble, washing away bloodstains, sweeping the streets, and transporting corpses to the lower sectors."
  - After: "Governor Drivestem craves Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s favour. Thousands are clearing rubble and corpses now."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In honour of such a resounding triumph, Dargonus, as the capital world of your dynasty's domain, is currently making preparations for the Magnae Accessio — a grand ceremony of your public induction as the heir of the honourable Theodora von Valancius."
  - After: "Dargonus prepares the Magnae Accessio, your induction as Theodora's heir."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Governor Drivestem has vowed that not even the recent devastating and tragic events will be permitted to cast a shadow over this most glorious occasion."
  - After: "Governor Drivestem vows tragedy won't spoil it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The grille of the {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} built into Vigdis's face lets out a short rattle that indicates a chuckle.{/n} "That much is certain, but that's not all there is to it. There will also be a reception — as well as other noble guests, the distinguished Rogue Traders Calligos Winterscale and Incendia Chorda will be in attendance. It will be a great honour for Dargonus to host three illustrious dynasties at once."
  - After: {n}Vigdis's {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g} chuckles.{/n} "That too. Rogue Traders Calligos Winterscale and Incendia Chorda will attend."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Very symbolic, Lord Captain. And beneficial to your domain."
  - After: "Symbolic, and useful."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your subjects will appreciate your generosity, Lord Captain. We are never short of people in need."
  - After: "They'll appreciate it. The needy are many."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The ability to see keenly into the hearts of one's people is a great virtue for a ruler to possess, Lord Captain."
  - After: "You know your people, Lord Captain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It will be done. The Emperor protects House von Valancius."
  - After: "The Emperor protects House von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The second matter on your servants' minds is — which two of your closest companions will be given the honour of standing by your side during the ceremony?"
  - After: "Second: which two companions stand beside you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is not so much about the entertainment, Lord Captain, as it is about the tone you wish to set for your entire reign. These activities will let the people know who you are — as a person and as a ruler."
  - After: "It sets the tone of your reign."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Absolutely. This symbolic gesture will accentuate your connection to certain classes or parties to which your companions belong. All eyes will be on you, and people will remember whom you chose as your closest allies. That is why there can be no more than two — or it won't be a unique show of favour."
  - After: "Yes. It shows which factions you favour. Hence only two."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The servants of House von Valancius will see in this the continuity of the dynasty's glorious traditions."
  - After: "It shows dynastic continuity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The presence of a member of the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} beside you will serve as the best possible proof of your loyalty."
  - After: "An {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} member proves your loyalty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Even though your privileges allow you to keep an unsanctioned {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g} in your retinue, not every Rogue Trader would have one at their side on such a day. The freethinkers and the scorners of rules will be impressed by your courage."
  - After: "An unsanctioned {g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}psyker{/g}? Freethinkers will admire your nerve."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "All whose hearts burn with the fire of faith will appreciate this gesture."
  - After: "The faithful will approve."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The more enterprising of your subjects will take note that you value a person's abilities over their lineage."
  - After: "It shows skill matters over lineage."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A great boon for {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navigator House{/g} Orsellio."
  - After: "A boon for {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navigator House{/g} Orsellio."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} will take note of this gesture."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} will notice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I will see to it that your instructions are delivered to Dargonus. The master of ceremonies at the palace will report to you when the capital is ready to praise your name."
  - After: "I'll relay your orders. The master of ceremonies will report when ready."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And who will be your second companion?"
  - After: "And your second?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The wardens have been tasked with clearing the ceremony venue of the injured and those who were burned out of their houses — they will be forcibly moved to the industrial levels. Rest assured, by the start of the festivities, the capital's wounds will be, if not healed, then well hidden under elaborate set dressing."
  - After: "Wardens will move the injured and homeless to the industrial levels. The wounds will be hidden."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The presence of a death cultist will serve as a demonstration of your pious resolve and make your subjects tremble."
  - After: "A death cultist makes subjects tremble."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The sight of a Proctor of the Adeptus Arbites will demonstrate your commitment to maintaining order and signal your reign's strict adherence to the Lex Imperialis."
  - After: "An Arbites Proctor signals strict Lex Imperialis."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The endorsement of the Cult Mechanicus will be an unbreakable bulwark for the dynasty, greatly increasing its prosperity."
  - After: "Mechanicus backing will bolster the dynasty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What's more, bringing {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}heel{/d} has strengthened your position as a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}. Lady Theodora would have been glad to have such an important trade hub come under her sphere of influence."
  - After: "Bringing {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}heel{/d} strengthened you as a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your exploratory ventures have broadened the borders of known space. In the future, you will be able to spread your territory to these new star systems without having to worry about competition."
  - After: "Your explorations opened systems to claim uncontested."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Lexmechanics also note that your successes in establishing and developing colonies serve as a promising foundation for further expansion."
  - After: "Your colonies favour expansion."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "To appear before the people in the company of a {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}? A provocative and intriguing move. It is this kind of behaviour that people expect to see from a Rogue Trader — the wielder of privileges unthinkable for other mortals."
  - After: "With a {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}? Provocative, and very Rogue Trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I won't keep you any further. Thank you for your time, Lord Captain."
  - After: "Thank you, Lord Captain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, permission to report!" {n}the Vox Master says, looking at you deferentially.{/n} "Your wise {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanics{/g} have analysed the state of the protectorate. They believe that, thanks to your decisive actions, the acute phase of the crisis has passed. The domain of the von Valancius dynasty is no longer facing dissolution and ruin."
  - After: "Lord Captain!" {n}the Vox Master reports.{/n} "Your {g|Encyclopedia:Lexmechanic}Lexmechanics{/g} say the crisis has passed. The domain is safe from ruin."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Archival records indicate that they did. Lady Theodora's Magnae Accessio was attended by the esteemed Calligos Winterscale and Aspyce Chorda, Incendia's predecessor. It is an informal tradition — by witnessing the ceremony, the heads of the other dynasties confirm that they recognise the new Rogue Trader as their equal, that they are willing to respect the new Rogue Trader's privileges and not encroach upon their holdings... no more than usual, at least."
  - After: "Yes: Calligos Winterscale and Aspyce Chorda, Incendia's predecessor. Attending means recognising the new Rogue Trader as an equal and respecting their holdings... mostly."
