But before I could get rid of all the picts and documents I had gathered, the palace was besieged. I had to take a risk and... burn it all. The xenos surrounded me when I was setting fire to the last remaining orders. And they decided to... have fun with me."
  - After: "The attack came while I was at the Administratum. I burned the documents before the xenos caught me... and had fun."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The Interrogator examines the room, the evidence of a struggle, and Achilleas himself.{/n} "You {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}did well{/d}. You held your own. I'm glad we made it in time."
  - After: {n}Heinrix nods.{/n} "You {d|Encyclopedia:CompHeinrix_Humane}did well{/d}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His burnt lips twist into a bitter smile.{/n} "Oddly enough... I was, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Drukhari had no idea that a mere Adeptus Administratum secretary could understand their alien speech. While they were deliberating over how they were going to kill me, they mentioned that other 'mon-keigh' had been helping them all this time. Renegades, or pirates, or... something of the sort. It will take time to identify these traitors to Humanity, but I give you my word that they will pay for what happened on Dargonus!"
  - After: {n}A bitter smile.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I understood them: human renegades or pirates helped them. They'll pay for Dargonus!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas looks you in the eye, his gaze unexpectedly clear.{/n} "Nothing. But... they didn't ask me anything. They didn't look for anything. They didn't so much as poke around the place... Strange."
  - After: {n}Clear-eyed.{/n} "Nothing. They asked nothing, searched nothing. Strange."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I've been praying to the Immortal One for your swift return! The people of Dargonus fought to the last, but the onslaught of the enemies of Humanity... was vicious and brutal."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I prayed you'd return! Dargonus fought, but it was brutal."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I... I focused all my attention on investigating the attacks across your protectorate. I suspected that there was something bigger behind the xenos attacks, but... an assault on the Rogue Trader's capital? Foolhardy, even for Drukhari. I'd never have thought..." {n}He closes his eyes, grimacing with guilt.{/n}
  - After: "I watched the protectorate's raids. But an assault on your capital? Too foolhardy, even for Drukhari..." {n}He winces.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "It is the Drukhari's favourite pastime to torture people for amusement. I doubt they had any inkling you were an agent of the Inquisition."
  - After: "Drukhari torture for fun. They didn't know you were Inquisition."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why?" {n}Achilleas lets out a slight chuckle.{/n} "Such is the nature of the enemies of Humanity, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They have a taste... for our pain."
  - After: "Why?" {n}A chuckle.{/n} "They enjoy our pain, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas's body is covered in an unthinkable number of cuts and injuries — the Drukhari put great effort into filling his every moment with searing pain. However, none of his wounds are life-threatening.{/n}
  - After: {n}Countless painful cuts. None life-threatening.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It's difficult to assess how badly Achilleas is wounded. He can still stand, but his body is covered in hundreds of cuts and injuries. It would be best if he were transported to a medicae facility, into the care of healers, as soon as possible.{/n}
  - After: {n}Hundreds of cuts. He needs a medicae soon.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas glances at Heinrix, his expression pained.{/n} "I..." {n}He coughs weakly.{/n} "I've failed you, Master van Calox."
  - After: {n}He looks at Heinrix.{/n} "I..." {n}A cough.{/n} "I've failed you, Master van Calox."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas frowns, presses his burnt lips together, and drops his gaze.{/n} "And yet... And yet I still failed you."
  - After: {n}He looks down.{/n} "Yet I failed you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As you hastily close one wound, another starts bleeding. Alas, you couldn't offer Achilleas any substantial assistance in such a short time.{/n} "There's no need, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I have enough strength to walk to the infirmary."
  - After: {n}It's not enough.{/n} "No need, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I can walk to the infirmary."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are too kind to me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We have more important matters to consider than a few broken ribs. Please do not trouble yourself about it."
  - After: "Too kind, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Broken ribs don't matter."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas doesn't try to dodge or cover his face. His split lip swells immediately, and a thin rivulet of blood runs down his chin and disappears inside his collar.{/n} "And I will give my life to atone for my faults."
  - After: {n}His lip splits.{/n} "I will give my life to atone."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "And therein lies the reason for your failure, burnt mon-keigh. Your mind was narrow, as the minds of your kind are wont to be."
  - After: "Hence your failure, burnt mon-keigh. A narrow mind."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas shoots Yrliet a hateful look and mutters through his teeth,{/n} "I... am... aware..."
  - After: {n}He glares at Yrliet.{/n} "I... am... aware..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "When you're up against Drukhari ashmags, you plan for the absolute worst scenario. But before you do, you multiply that abysmally bad scenario by ten... or better yet, by thirty."
  - After: "Against Drukhari, plan for the worst. Then multiply it by thirty."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}You notice a brief flash of sympathy in Yrliet's eyes.{/n} "There is no wisdom in blaming yourself — a mon-keigh's intellect is weak and can never fathom the depths of my dark kin's treachery and twistedness of thought. Had there been another mon-keigh in your place, the paths of fate would have remained unchanged."
  - After: {n}Yrliet softens.{/n} "Do not blame yourself. No mon-keigh could fathom my dark kin."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia reaches a hand out to Achilleas's shoulder and gingerly removes something unseen from it.{/n} "Your hues... are covered in a layer of soot and ash, Master Scalander. I can see the loud, bleeding colours underneath. May I... put them at ease for you?"
  - After: {n}Cassia touches his shoulder.{/n} "Your hues are ashen and bleeding, Master Scalander. May I soothe them?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Or it is that you do not remember anything, mon-keigh. And it was their intent that you did not."
  - After: "Or they made you forget, mon-keigh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas bows his head guiltily.{/n} "It is a great honour to hear such words from Lady Orsellio herself, and still... I must refuse. My scars, both physical and spiritual, are my reminder of the mistake I made. And my key to—" {n}A coughing fit interrupts his words.{/n} "...redemption."
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "Thank you, Lady Orsellio, but no. My scars remind me. And my key to—" {n}He coughs.{/n} "...redemption."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "His wounds are shallow — the foe did not want to cut his thread. And yet each wound has touched a nerve, to plunge the victim into a pit of agony. Every cut is a message — not to us, but to the one whose body has become a sheet of parchment." {n}Kibellah's lip curls in disgust.{/n} "A message of unclean words."
  - After: "Shallow wounds, each on a nerve: agony, not death. Every cut is a message." {n}Kibellah sneers.{/n} "Unclean words."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas closes his eyes shut.{/n} "Holy Emperor, deliver me from the memories!"
  - After: {n}Eyes shut.{/n} "Emperor, deliver me from the memories!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His burnt lips twist into a bitter smile.{/n} "Funnily enough... I was, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The Drukhari had no idea that a mere Adeptus Administratum secretary could understand their alien speech. Over the course of my torture, I came to understand that the xenos had been receiving help from humans all this time. Renegades, or pirates, or... something of the sort. It will take time to identify these traitors to Humanity, but I give you my word that they will pay for what happened on Dargonus!"
  - After: {n}A bitter smile.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I understood them: human renegades or pirates helped them. They'll pay for Dargonus!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}You feel a gust of cold that brings shivers to your skin. A moment passes, and Achilleas takes another breath — this one much deeper and steadier. The smaller cuts close almost completely, but the deeper wounds continue to bleed.{/n}
  - After: {n}A cold gust. Small cuts close; deep ones bleed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Gritting his teeth, Achilleas bows and withdraws to the gatehouse in front of the palace.{/n}
  - After: {n}He bows and goes to the gatehouse.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I thought I was done for. Thank the Emperor you arrived when you did." {n}Achilleas gives you a strange look, as if still not fully believing his luck.{/n}
  - After: "Thank the Emperor you came." {n}He stares, amazed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I... You shouldn't have, Master van Calox. Your powers are wasted on me."
  - After: "Master van Calox, you waste your powers on me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your fast efforts pay off: your knowledge of medicae allows you to stop the bleeding in several areas and somewhat ease his pain.{/n} "You... shouldn't have wasted your time on me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}You stem some bleeding.{/n} "Don't waste time on me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Siege/Clemence/Clemence_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "The Drukhari are after living victims above all else — why would they waste their forces assaulting the palace when they could be storming another city?"
  - After: "Drukhari want live victims. Why attack the palace, not a city?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I need details. What has transpired on the planet?"
  - After: "What happened here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What's the current situation?"
  - After: "What's the situation?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Enough talking. I'm going in."
  - After: "Enough. I'm going in."
- **Player**
  - Before: "When all of this passes, expect mass executions among the planet's defenders. All of you have failed those you swore to protect!"
  - After: "Expect mass executions. You all failed your people!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You did all you could. Xenos are dangerous opponents."
  - After: "You did all you could."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I vow to make the xenos pay dearly for every human life they've claimed!"
  - After: "The xenos will pay for every life!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I don't see a single Arbitrator. Have they decided to cower behind the walls of their headquarters?"
  - After: "No Arbitrators? Are they cowering?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Begin a detailed assessment of the damage as soon as we're done here."
  - After: "Assess the damage afterwards."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This is an outrage! Xenos have pillaged my palace? My precious residence?"
  - After: "Xenos pillaged my precious palace?"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Clementia looks haggard, with deep shadows under her eyes and her hands trembling slightly. She is staring at you with a mixture of amazement and bitterness.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... is it really you? We'd {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}lost all hope{/d} of seeing you again!"
  - After: {n}Clementia looks haggard.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? We'd {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}lost hope{/d}!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Clementia is looking a little dishevelled, but her appearance otherwise remains unchanged — her steely gaze and tightly pressed lips speak of perfect composure.{/n} "Praise the Throne, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}you're here{/d}! Your subjects need you now more than ever!"
  - After: {n}Clementia is composed.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}you're here{/d}! We need you!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "All guilty parties will receive severe punishment, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but until then, we must rely on the surviving defenders — please, let us postpone the trials and executions until the situation has stabilised!"
  - After: "The guilty will pay, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but we need the survivors now. Delay the executions!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "The attack began a few hours before dawn over the capital. They first attacked the fleet — we received boarding calls right before we lost communication with the crews. Their sacrifice wasn't for naught — the ground troops had the time to start mobilising, and the civilians went on to organise the defences."
  - After: "It began before dawn. They hit the fleet first, buying our troops time to mobilise."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "The PDF is in the process of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}exterminating{/d} the enemy forces on the planet. Extra batteries have been assigned to the assault on the palace, but without a strike force that could make it inside, we won't break their resistance."
  - After: "The PDF is {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusEarly}exterminating{/d} them. But only a strike force inside can take the palace."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Clementia closes her eyes for a second, giving in to the overwhelming exhaustion.{/n} "The PDF is on its last legs, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We've been waging a war of attrition for {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}too long{/d}, without any chance of support from outside. I pray to the Emperor that your arrival will change the tide of this operation."
  - After: {n}She's exhausted.{/n} "The PDF is failing, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We've fought {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_DargonusLate}too long{/d} alone."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Clementia bows.{/n} "With awe and gratitude, I transfer the command of the ground operation over to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The local troops are at your service. I beg of you — save Dargonus!"
  - After: {n}She bows.{/n} "Command is yours, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Save Dargonus!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Several hive cities managed to hold their perimeters, others sustained greater losses... and two cities were completely devastated. Our intelligence still knows nothing about the fates of millions of people. There is a high likelihood that we've lost them forever."
  - After: "Some hives held. Two cities fell. Millions are likely lost."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "The secretary's exact whereabouts are unknown. But, under normal circumstances, he hardly ever set foot outside the palace grounds... I'm sure you realise what this could mean."
  - After: "Unknown. But he rarely left the palace..."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "I'm afraid so, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The attack on the palace began later than the rest, once the reserve forces had been transferred to other regions. Which is... particularly odd..." {n}Clementia falters.{/n} "They weren't tempted by an entire city, at the apex of which your residence stands. No, the wedge of the enemy forces targeted the palace specifically."
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Oddly, they" {n}she falters{/n} "ignored the city and targeted the palace."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "We've cut off the periphery forces from those that made it inside the palace, and we continue to storm the building. We've killed so many of those beasts, but the xenos are repelling our assault with ferocity — it's as if they're waiting for the right moment. Or perhaps they haven't yet completed whatever goal they're pursuing inside the palace."
  - After: "We keep storming it, but they hold, as if waiting, or still after something inside."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "I pray to the God-Emperor that the Adeptus Arbites will repel the enemy and have time to aid the other parts of the hive."
  - After: "Pray the Arbites hold."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "I have a feeling that the palace is the anchor point of the enemy's raid. Our vox engineers are registering unknown signals coming from your residence to other areas on the planet — the scum must have set up a control centre inside. We take out their command — and we'll weaken their peripheral forces."
  - After: "The palace is their command centre, signalling the other forces. Take it, and they weaken."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Lady Werserian, where is Achilleas Scalander? I thought I'd see him here, by your side."
  - After: "Lady Werserian, where is Achilleas Scalander?"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Dargonus has been hit by a mass xenos attack. The fleet's resistance was broken in mere hours, then the invaders commenced a planetary raid. The planetary defence forces were able to hold the inner perimeters of several cities, two of the attacks were stifled on the approaches to settlements, but the fights continue — here as well, in the von Valancius palace."
  - After: "A mass xenos raid. The fleet broke in hours. Several cities held, but fighting continues, including at the von Valancius palace."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Alas, I don't know the answer, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. When the xenos attacked the palace, they sent a force so great that the increased warden presence and the defence perimeter were wiped out in minutes. By the Throne, whatever they're looking for in there, they've spared no troops to get their hands on it!"
  - After: "I don't know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They overwhelmed our defences in minutes. They want something there badly!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "The governor is currently protected within a well-fortified bunker... as are the heads of the other noble houses." {n}Clementia grinds her teeth audibly.{/n} "Still, each family has provided all available resources to the defence of Dargonus — or rather, the defence of their respective regions."
  - After: "In a bunker, like the other nobles." {n}She grits her teeth.{/n} "Each house defends only its own region."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Not at all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. There are approximately one hundred Arbites in the capital right now, and they are all defending the Administratum. Thanks to their bravery and fighting prowess, it is one of the few places in the hive that the xenos have failed to overrun."
  - After: "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. A hundred Arbites hold the Administratum, one of few places not overrun."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but once the battles have concluded, I would still like to launch a large-scale inspection in the Defence Forces. Our losses are too great — I want to make sure that this is all due to our accursed enemy's superior numbers, not traitors in our midst!"
  - After: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but I'll inspect our forces for traitors. Our losses are too great!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Oh, what I wouldn't give to join the punitive expedition, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but my duty is to the welfare of this planet, not military operations." {n}Clementia's voice grows sterner, and she practically spits out,{/n} "This is my plea to you, Rogue Trader — make them rue the day that they decided to assault Dargonus!"
  - After: "My duty is this planet, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}She spits it.{/n} "Make them rue this day!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Indubitably — as soon as the situation on the planet stabilises. In addition to our own territories, serious damage was done to the Adeptus Administratum department stationed on Dargonus — I hope this won't lead to any kind of accusations against House von Valancius..."
  - After: "Of course. The Administratum office was damaged too. I hope House von Valancius isn't blamed..."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I received a message on the Arbitrators' vox-frequency — they are successfully defending the spire entrusted to them. Even if all Dargonus falls, that place will hold."
  - After: "The Arbitrators report their spire holds, even if Dargonus falls."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Siege/ClemenceAftermath/ClemenceAftermath

- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not hearing enough awe and servility in your voice, Clementia. Is this how you show your gratitude to your saviour? Try one more time."
  - After: "Not enough awe, Clementia. Thank your saviour properly. Again."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I was doing my duty, nothing more."
  - After: "I only did my duty."
- **Player**
  - Before: "After such a debacle in our defences, Clementia, you and the other mediocrities who supposedly look after my capital world can expect a thorough purge in the near future."
  - After: "After this debacle, you and the other mediocrities running my capital can expect a purge."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stop wasting time talking and attend to your duties. There is still much work to be done."
  - After: "Stop talking and get to work."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Thanks to your breakthrough, we were able to clear out the estate. Right now, with the aid of your ship's augurs from orbit, the surface troops are sweeping the streets of the hive. Squads have been sent deeper into the city, several units have been assigned... my apologies, of course you will learn of all this from the reports."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the estate is clear. Troops sweep the hive with your ship's augurs."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "We have transported Secretary Scalander to the medicarium. His recovery will take time, but the healers' prognosis is optimistic."
  - After: "Secretary Scalander is in the medicarium. He'll recover."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Your appearance on Dargonus is a boon from the God-Emperor, who has brought us salvation. On behalf of all of Dargonus and House Werserian, I thank you for delivering us from our foes."
  - After: "House Werserian and Dargonus thank you for saving us."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Clementia clears her throat, momentarily at a loss.{/n} "I... please forgive the brevity and clumsiness of my words, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... It's just, the situation... and the circumstances..." {n}She recomposes herself and begins firmly and steadily,{/n} "O great Rogue Trader, the God-Emperor's anointed, bearer of the sacred Warrant, deliverer of His will! On this day, solely by your will, we, dirt-dwelling worms, have been left our lives, though their worth is less than a single beat of your heart!"
  - After: {n}She falters.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}..." {n}Firmly:{/n} "O great Rogue Trader! By your will alone, we worms live!"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "I will see to it that everyone responsible is informed of your wishes." {n}If Clementia is frightened, she does nothing to reveal it.{/n}
  - After: "I'll inform them." {n}She shows no fear.{/n}
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "We offer our lowly thanks for the grace bestowed upon us by your mercifulness. May the von Valancius name be praised through the ages! May all worlds to the ends of the galaxy know of your virtues! May His grace be with you till the end of time! All hail the Rogue Trader, saviour of Dargonus!" {n}Clementia catches her breath, then adds in a lowered voice,{/n} "With your highest consent, there is one more thing..."
  - After: "Praise von Valancius! Hail the saviour of Dargonus!" {n}Quietly:{/n} "One more thing..."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "And by your will, you have preserved countless lives, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Dargonus owes you a debt that can never be repaid."
  - After: "You saved countless lives, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We owe you."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But from now on, the bulk of the worries will be shouldered by your subjects."
  - After: "Indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We'll handle it."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Mistress Toliman has sent a message requesting an audience. She has a critical report to deliver and she will be waiting for you on the ship's bridge."
  - After: "Mistress Toliman awaits you on the bridge with a critical report."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae winces bitterly.{/n} "I never thought words of praise could make my soul feel as if it were being suffocated. All this bowing and scraping seems wildly over the top."
  - After: {n}Jae winces.{/n} "All this bowing is suffocating."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Siege/MarazhaiTriumph/MarazhaiTriumph_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You deceived me when you appointed the place of our final battle!"
  - After: "You lied about our final battleground!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "You will pay for every slain servant of the Imperium!"
  - After: [Attack] "You'll pay for every slain Imperial!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "One xenos is down. One more remains."
  - After: "One xenos down. One to go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why did you attack the palace?"
  - After: "Why attack the palace?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you have any idea how much your raid has cost me? One tanned xenos hide won't be enough to pay for the damage!"
  - After: "Your hide won't cover this raid's cost!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tazarra was under the impression that we were working together — what nonsense did you put in her head?"
  - After: "Tazarra thought we were allies. Why?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "I've grown tired of you — it is time to die."
  - After: [Attack] "Time to die."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai casually gestures with his hand, either welcoming you or inviting you to admire the brutalised hall.{/n} "At last! I was beginning to think that your lumbering bucket had perished on the way back! Such a resolution would have satisfied neither you nor me, would it?"
  - After: {n}Marazhai gestures at the ruined hall.{/n} "At last! I feared your bucket had sunk."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are still with {mf|him|her}, cousin?" {n}Marazhai's voice is dripping with saccharine mockery.{/n} "How fares your search for your lost family? Or is being at a mon-keigh's beck and call occupying all your thoughts and time?"
  - After: "Still with {mf|him|her}, cousin?" {n}He mocks.{/n} "Found your family, or busy serving mon-keigh?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}The sight of a xenos lounging on the dynastic throne makes Abelard's face turn crimson.{/n} "What... How did... You will cease defiling a relic of the Imperium with your presence, xenos scum!"
  - After: {n}Abelard flushes.{/n} "Off that Imperial relic, xenos scum!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What, this abomination?" {n}The Drukhari taps a finger on the armrest.{/n} "With pleasure. But first, I will finish my conversation with your master, mon-keigh."
  - After: "Gladly." {n}He taps the armrest.{/n} "After I talk to your master."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "You will be silent, Dark One, or I will silence you myself!"
  - After: "Silence, Dark One!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari freezes for a moment.{/n} "Oh, I can feel your anger... your rage... and your pain from witnessing the state of your halls. I trusted that you would appreciate our efforts here. I could have long vanished in the tangles of the Webway without awaiting your arrival, mon-keigh... but I could not refuse myself the small pleasure of savouring your torment at the sight of what I have done to your home."
  - After: {n}He pauses.{/n} "I feel your pain at your ruined halls. I stayed only to savour it, mon-keigh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The sole thing that your kind is good for, mon-keigh, is your ability to suffer. I have long been surfeited with physical pain — your kin provide it in abundance from their cages in Commorragh. The pain of the soul, on the other hand... is a rare delight. After all, I had to recompense you for all the trouble you have caused me."
  - After: "Your kind is good only for suffering. Soul-pain is a rare delight."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "However, did I not give you a gracious gift as well? That pesky, meddling Tazarra who harrowed your little worlds for so long... you have garnered her head, and I — a peaceful existence where she is not constantly in my way." {n}He gives you a thin smile.{/n} "To die at the hands of a mon-keigh is the worst possible punishment for a champion of the gladiatorial arenas of Commorragh. Her final moments were torturous."
  - After: "And I gave you Tazarra's head, rid of her meddling." {n}A thin smile.{/n} "Death by mon-keigh is an arena champion's worst fate. She suffered."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do not get greedy, mon-keigh — you should be satisfied with the handouts that I so kindly throw you."
  - After: "Don't be greedy, mon-keigh. Take my scraps."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Mm? The pompous waste of skin thought that I would associate with mon-keigh? I wish I did not leave her death to you and instead cut out her heart myself. Still, to take note of my interest in your person was quite perceptive — even more so for a brainless arena Wych."
  - After: "That wretch thought I'd ally with mon-keigh? Still, sharp of a Wych to notice my interest in you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Now that our meeting has taken place, my business here is done. I have spent enough time in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}, and it is time to bid you goodbye."
  - After: "My business is done. Enough {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. Goodbye."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Deceived? Equals can be deceived — but you I merely used. You played the part given to you perfectly — you were exactly where you were supposed to be, and did exactly what you were supposed to do. Everything except die."
  - After: "I deceive equals. You I used. You played your part perfectly, except dying."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Dargonus/Siege/TazarraFinalEncounter/TazarraFinalEncounter_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Aren't you glad to see me, Tazarra?"
  - After: "Not glad to see me, Tazarra?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "In the name of the Emperor, for the glory of Humanity — die, monster!"
  - After: [Attack] "For the Emperor, die, monster!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "Me? Working with a xenos? Die for your blasphemy, you beast!"
  - After: [Attack] "Me, with xenos? Die, beast!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me what your objective is in the palace — and I might grant you a swift death."
  - After: "Your goal here, for a swift death?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Wait, what cur are you talking about?"
  - After: "What cur?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "Your little raid has cost me a fortune — I do not forgive such losses! Die!"
  - After: [Attack] "Your raid cost me! Die!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "How does it feel to be used, Tazarra? You have entertained me well — now do me a favour and die."
  - After: [Attack] "Enjoy being used, Tazarra? Die."
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: {n}When Tazarra notices you, her face contorts into a mask of rage. The Drukhari's lips stretch into a predatory grin that bears no trace of her former haughtiness — only the promise of pain.{/n} "You! Malformed mon-keigh, putrid vermin! You will pay for every moment that I have spent on this pitiful planet!"
  - After: {n}Tazarra grins with rage.{/n} "You! Mon-keigh vermin! You'll pay for this!"
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: {n}She lets out a battle cry — and charges forward.{/n}
  - After: {n}She charges.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "This is it — the true face of the Dark Ones. Her anger at you is so great that she has shed her mask — and revealed the beast beneath!"
  - After: "Her rage reveals the true Dark One."
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: "Oh, now that you have finally arrived, I am filled with anticipation — the anticipation of skinning you, impaling you on hooks, and making you dance for mine and the Archon's amusement!"
  - After: "I'll skin you and hang you on hooks for the Archon!"
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: "I will not stoop to explain myself to a mon-keigh — let alone a worm like you. A swift death? I will teach you the true art of killing — one drop of blood, one moment of insufferable agony at a time!"
  - After: "Swift death? I'll kill you one drop at a time!"
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: "Then I will say that I have had enough of others' games. Sisters, praise the Muses!"
  - After: "Then I'm done with games. Sisters, praise the Muses!"
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: "Enough..." {n}Tazarra bares her sharpened fangs.{/n} "I will beat the truth out of your dead bodies — yours and Marazhai's. Sisters, attack!"
  - After: "Enough..." {n}Fangs bared.{/n} "I'll beat the truth from your and Marazhai's corpses. Attack!"
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: "Little Asuryani, the mon-keigh's obedient servant. Try to survive the future, and then the two of us will still have plenty of fun." {n}The Drukhari licks her lips with her forked tongue.{/n}
  - After: "Little Asuryani pet. Survive, and we'll play later." {n}She licks her lips.{/n}
- **Tazarra**
  - Before: {n}Tazarra's shriek drops to a hiss.{/n} "I suspected that you and that Trueborn cur were working together. He did not make me and my sisters linger here on a whim — he had a reason, and that reason involves you. Yes? Is that it? Tell me... just nod, so I can stand before the Archon and accuse him of treachery and compromising the raid!"
  - After: {n}She hisses.{/n} "That Trueborn cur kept us here for you. Nod, and I accuse him before the Archon!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The horrible scars the cyber-eagle's talons left on her face are a vivid reminder of your previous encounter. The scarlet glint of her battered eye fixes upon you in anticipation of revenge.{/n}
  - After: {n}Her eagle-scarred eye glints for revenge.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Squabbles between false allies is the favourite sport of the Drukhari. After torture, that is." {n}Heinrix sounds pleased — he is clearly enjoying the sight of the xenos's rage.{/n}
  - After: "Drukhari love betraying allies." {n}Heinrix is pleased.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/DaringHeirGuttedShip/MutatedNavigator_dialogue/Dialogue_MutatedNavigator_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What happened to the ship and the crew, Hann?"
  - After: "Hann, what happened here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you are a true son of the Navis Nobilite, you know what you must do. Don't let the corruption that has touched you devour your soul."
  - After: "A true Navis Nobilite knows what to do. Don't let corruption take your soul."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "You've all been tainted by Chaos. Death to the mutants!"
  - After: [Attack] "Chaos-tainted mutants! Die!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The affairs of a Rogue Trader do not concern you. Do not trouble yourself with needless questions."
  - After: "A Rogue Trader's affairs aren't your concern."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You can come with me, but the remnants of the crew will be terminated. These people are beyond salvation — they're corrupted by Chaos."
  - After: "You may come, but the corrupted crew will be terminated."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So the 'Chaos bomb' package was meant for me? Who's the sender?"
  - After: "The 'Chaos bomb' was for me? Who sent it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm taking you aboard my ship. There, my word is law, and no one will dare to take issue with you, despite the mutations."
  - After: "Come aboard my ship. My word is law there; none will challenge your mutations."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where's the artefact now?"
  - After: "Where's the artefact?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "You have dealt me a mortal insult, one that can only be washed away by blood."
  - After: [Attack] "Only blood washes away this insult."
- **Player**
  - Before: "According to the Imperial Navy law, with which I am intimately familiar, I am the supreme authority on this ship, not you, Hann Cassini. Obey the Lord Captain!"
  - After: "By Navy law, I command here, Hann Cassini. Obey the Lord Captain!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Were you not affected by the mutations and madness?"
  - After: "Weren't you affected?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not dare accuse me of colluding with Chaos. Do not even suggest it."
  - After: "Don't dare accuse me of serving Chaos."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not tainted by Chaos, and I knew nothing of this package. I give you my word as a Rogue Trader."
  - After: "I'm untainted and knew nothing of it. My word as Rogue Trader."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would still like to take a look at the artefact."
  - After: "I still want to see the artefact."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Face it, Hann Cassini. You can't leave this ship. The corruption of the Chaos bomb did afflict you, albeit not as strongly as the others. And you know this, I can tell by your reaction."
  - After: "You can't leave, Hann Cassini. The Chaos bomb touched you too. You know it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We could lay mines in what remains of the ship and blast it along with the artefact from a safe distance. I have the resources and the knowledge to do it."
  - After: "We could mine the ship and blast it, artefact and all, from afar. I can do it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Trust me. I will take the sarcophagus that holds the artefact and deliver it to those who can destroy it safely."
  - After: "Trust me. I'll take the sarcophagus to those who can destroy it."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "You stand between me and that which is mine. You will die for this!"
  - After: [Attack] "You stand between me and what's mine. Die!"
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}The leader of the ravaged ship's crew wipes the sweat from his brow in a motion characteristic of {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} — not with his whole hand, but with two fingers moving from left to right and back so as not to touch his third eye by accident. This movement is the only sign of fatigue he allows himself. His posture is immaculate, shoulders wide, eyes front — as if he did not just emerge from a gruelling battle and is simply greeting you on the bridge on an uneventful day.{/n}
  - After: {n}The leader wipes his brow with two fingers, as {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigators{/g} do. His posture is immaculate.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As Hann speaks, others glare at you with dour tension. Up close, you can plainly see that every one of them is a mutant. Their faces and bodies bear the mark of incredibly grotesque deformities, the same as the muttering madmen who attacked you. However, Hann's associates seem perfectly clear-eyed, showing no signs of madness.{/n}
  - After: {n}All his people are grotesque mutants, yet sane.{/n}
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "The disaster struck during the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} jump. I will never know all the details, as I was preoccupied with my primary duties, but for some reason, the captain decided to open the package. That, as you may have noticed, had a most destructive impact on the crew."
  - After: "During the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} jump, the captain opened the package. You see the result."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Hann frowns.{/n} "The package contained a {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Chaos{/g} artefact. A Chaos bomb, if you will. The moment it was removed from its protective cocoon, the crew began to lose their mind and mutate. The first to be afflicted was the captain and the senior officers, but the effect spread with incredible speed. Every deck was consumed by it, every last one. The raging mutants, no longer sane, damaged many systems. The ship was in distress and would have almost certainly been destroyed had I not resorted to making an emergency exit from the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}."
  - After: {n}Hann frowns.{/n} "A {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Chaos{/g} artefact. A Chaos bomb. Unsealed, it drove every deck mad and mutated. I made an emergency exit from the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} before the ship died."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "The people you see here are the only survivors. Or rather, the only ones who were able to retain both their lives and sanity. I gathered everyone I could, isolated the source of danger, and sent out a distress signal. We were adrift, waiting for help to come and fighting off mad crew members. Then you arrived."
  - After: "These are the only sane survivors. I isolated the artefact and called for help."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}He gives you a searching look, then bows his head.{/n} "I beg your pardon, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I saw the terrible death of the entire crew with my own eyes, I was forced to bring the ship out of the warp by means of an emergency manoeuvre, and then I had to fight my former comrades, insane and twisted. I am tired."
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I watched my crew die and fought them after. I am tired."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "Well, that depends — I was born a mutant, you see." {n}Hann smiles, grimly and wearily.{/n} "Navigators are taught to resist the influence of Chaos, and so I have been, as best I could. But I will be frank with you — I cannot be certain that I have avoided it completely. There have been no visible indications. Yet."
  - After: "I was born a mutant." {n}A weary smile.{/n} "Navigators resist Chaos, but I can't be sure. No signs. Yet."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "As far as I am aware, the order came from Kunrad Voigtvir, the Master of Whispers in the Rogue Trader's retinue. It is likely that he arranged the delivery, either personally or through intermediaries."
  - After: "Kunrad Voigtvir, your Master of Whispers, ordered it."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "However, the sender wanted all of this," {n}Hann makes a sweeping gesture at the destruction and the corpses of crew members around him,{/n} "to happen to your ship, not ours."
  - After: "But this" {n}he gestures at the corpses{/n} "was meant for your ship."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}The exhaustion and tension in Hann's posture finally get the better of him. His head drops, and he rubs his forehead once more.{/n} "I've been gazing into the eyes of the warp for as long as I can remember, yet I've never been so close to it. It's taken all my strength to keep it at bay. But for how much longer can I hold on? I don't want to go mad and become like the others."
  - After: {n}Hann sags.{/n} "I've never been this close to the warp. Holding it back takes everything. I don't want to become like them."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "I have been gazing into the eyes of the warp for as long as I can remember. I can fight it!" {n}There is pride and aloofness in Hann's voice.{/n}
  - After: "I've faced the warp all my life. I can fight it!" {n}Proudly.{/n}
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Your words give Hann pause, but he seems convinced. He relaxes a little, but then asks — cautiously, as if testing the waters,{/n} "What about me and the crew? Will you take us with you?"
  - After: {n}Hann relents, then asks,{/n} "And me and the crew?"
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}The tension in his posture and gaze becomes even more noticeable.{/n} "I have placed it inside a protective sarcophagus, more reliable than the previous repository. Unfortunately, an artefact as powerful as this one could not be destroyed under these circumstances — or rather, I had no assurances that it would not disintegrate every one of us and scatter us across several light-hours of neighbouring space. But once we are off the ship, I will absolutely find a way to destroy the vile thing."
  - After: {n}He tenses.{/n} "Sealed in a sarcophagus. Destroying it here could kill us all."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Suspicion mounts in Hann's eyes.{/n} "You want to see the trinket that nearly wiped out a whole ship? Why? I have seen enough to stop anyone else from coming anywhere near it. I will give my life, if I must, to prevent that thing from hurting any more people."
  - After: {n}Suspicious.{/n} "See the thing that killed a ship? Why? I'll die before it hurts anyone else."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hann does not appear to be lying. It is impossible to gauge the extent of the artefact's influence on him.{/n}
  - After: {n}He seems honest. Its hold on him is unclear.{/n}
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Hann jerks his chin up.{/n} "These are my people. We lived through this nightmare together. I am responsible for them. All of us leave this ship, or none of us do."
  - After: {n}Chin up.{/n} "My people. All of us leave, or none."
- **Mutated Enforcer**
  - Before: "He's abandoned us — everybody has!" {n}You see fear and despair in the eyes of the mutants, now leaderless. Shuddering, they reach for their weapons.{/n}
  - After: "He's abandoned us!" {n}The mutants grab weapons.{/n}
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "Thank you." {n}Hann salutes you before adding,{/n} "Lord Captain."
  - After: "Thank you." {n}He salutes.{/n} "Lord Captain."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "A noble choice..." {n}whispers Argenta. Her eyes are wide and gleaming with sorrow.{/n} "He chose death over letting the corruption consume him entirely."
  - After: "A noble choice..." {n}Argenta whispers.{/n} "Death over corruption."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "Lady Navigator, what an unexpected and pleasant meeting, considering the circumstances." {n}Hann decorously dips his head to Cassia.{/n} "I have not had the honour of being personally acquainted with you, but of course I know the emblem of House Orsellio. How fares the honourable regent?"
  - After: "Lady Navigator." {n}He bows to Cassia.{/n} "House Orsellio. How fares the regent?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Cassia Orsellio." {n}She offers a reserved nod.{/n} "Cordiality will not disguise the ice-blue coldness of your words, Navigator Hann. However, I will tell Regent Aaronto that you enquired after his health. You may pass on my best wishes to {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novator{/g} Cassini. And now let's set the pleasantries aside. I'm sure the Rogue Trader would like to ask you a few questions."
  - After: "Cassia Orsellio." {n}A cool nod.{/n} "You're icy, Navigator Hann. I'll tell Regent Aaronto. Regards to {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novator{/g} Cassini. Now, questions."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "What are you saying?" {n}The usually reserved Cassia glares at you.{/n} "Does the Rogue Trader have so low an opinion of Navis Nobilite blood? If the corruption of the Immaterium could so easily break our will and maim our soul, the Emperor would never have entrusted us with our sacred duty!"
  - After: "What?" {n}Cassia glares.{/n} "So little faith in Navis Nobilite blood? The Emperor trusted us for a reason!"
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "My greetings, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. There is no need for introductions — I know the heirs of the von Valancius line by sight. I am Hann of House Cassini, the Navigator on this vessel, and, as the senior surviving officer, I assumed command after the incident."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I'm Hann of House Cassini, Navigator, now in command."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Hann pauses, then adds bluntly, almost brazenly,{/n} "Your reaction suggests that you were not expecting a package of this sort. That is good to know. I had almost convinced myself that the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} was deliberately collecting Chaos artefacts."
  - After: {n}Bluntly:{/n} "You didn't expect it. Good. I nearly thought the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} collected Chaos artefacts."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard's face turns a deep puce.{/n} "That blasted traitor beat us to Dargonus and is now free to act with impunity! It would not surprise me to find out that this was the work of sorcery — how else could he have reached the world in such a short time?"
  - After: {n}Abelard flushes.{/n} "That traitor reached Dargonus first! Sorcery!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "A heretic who is vested with legitimate power and whose latest activities remain a mystery to all... Believe me, {name}, an individual like your former Master of Whispers will not stop at sending a Chaos artefact in his attempts to destabilise your protectorate."
  - After: "A heretic with real power, {name}. Your old Master of Whispers won't stop at one artefact."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Hann hesitates for a while, torn between duty and pride. Then he bows his head.{/n} "I am of the Navis Nobilite and thus do not answer to the Imperial Navy... and yet I cannot disobey the bearer of the highest title of the Dargonus fleet. I will disembark the ship with you..."
  - After: {n}Torn, he bows.{/n} "The Navis Nobilite don't answer to the Navy, but I can't defy the Dargonus fleet's highest title. I'll come."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "This ship is assigned to the port of Dargonus. Some time ago, the captain was instructed to deliver a package. Urgently, by hand — to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We were even shown a {g|Encyclopedia:Pict}pict{/g} of your face." {n}The Navigator's voice seems calm. Yet there is tension in his eyes, which are trained on you.{/n}
  - After: "We were ordered to hand a package to you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We had your {g|Encyclopedia:Pict}pict{/g}." {n}His eyes are tense.{/n}
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "Trust the intended recipient of the damned package? Rogue Trader or no, you are asking too much of me. No, either I will personally see that abomination destroyed, or I will not leave this ship."
  - After: "Trust its intended recipient? No. I see it destroyed, or I stay."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Hann grows pale, but raises his head. After a minute's pause, he says hoarsely,{/n} "You're right. I've been struggling against the inevitable for too long."
  - After: {n}Hann pales.{/n} "You're right. I've fought too long."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: "I beg your pardon. I am too tired to speak diplomatically."
  - After: "Forgive me. I'm too tired for tact."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}All signs point to Hann telling the truth. But you also notice clear evidence of just how difficult it is for him to struggle against the corruption. He is extremely tired, practically exhausted.{/n}
  - After: {n}He's honest, but exhausted from resisting the corruption.{/n}
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Something resembling grim desperation momentarily emerges in his eyes. But he nods.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}Grim, he nods.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Navigator**
  - Before: {n}Hann gives you a scrutinising look, then nods.{/n} "I will have to take you at your word, as I have no other choice. But what will become of me? And of the remaining crew?"
  - After: {n}Hann nods.{/n} "I must trust you. But what of me and the crew?"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/DaringHeirGuttedShip/NotDoneWithYou/NotDoneWithYou_dialog 

- **Player**
  - Before: [Give the order to lay the mines] "This thing must be destroyed along with the ship."
  - After: [Give the order to lay the mines] "Destroy it with the ship."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Give the order to lay the mines] "We have sufficient resources and knowledge — we'll destroy this thing along with the ship."
  - After: [Give the order to lay the mines] "We can destroy it with the ship."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The container is covered in a fine ornament of symbols, among which the seal of the {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} and the personal coat of arms of House Cassini stand out. The container is closed and sealed, but the lock does not seem particularly tricky.{/n}
  - After: {n}A sealed container: {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} seal, Cassini arms, simple lock.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard winces as if from toothache.{/n} "Look who's decided to resurface. It will be my honour to rid us of this 'pursuer' if he ever comes within shot."
  - After: {n}Abelard winces.{/n} "I'll gladly shoot this 'pursuer'."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You realise you have fallen under the effects of the artefact. It appears that your vox was enchanted with your own blood, which Kunrad stole on the day of your confrontation. The artefact was supposed to work like a siphon, draining the soul of whoever opened the container and of everyone around them — but the crew of the ill-fated ship took the brunt of the attack. The residual effects of the artefact are not strong enough to do you any serious harm.{/n}
  - After: {n}The artefact struck you. Kunrad bound your vox with your stolen blood to drain the souls of all nearby — the ship's crew took the brunt. The remnant can't harm you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You can tell you have fallen under the effects of the artefact, but you are unsure of the details of what just transpired. The remaining silence feels as deep as a well and full of the same dark terror as the blackness inside one.{/n}
  - After: {n}The artefact affected you somehow. The silence feels dark as a well.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You feel slightly nauseous. A cacophony of rasping, muttering voices emerges somewhere at the edge of your consciousness, whispering unintelligible words.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nausea. Voices whisper at the edge of your mind.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As you touch the sarcophagus, a slight shiver runs through you. The lock gives in easily, but it feels like the temperature in the room drops several degrees the moment the lid opens. Inside is an ordinary {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}. A series of scratches runs along the casing, forming odd symbols. Tiny red balls are sliding and rolling between them — it is blood, behaving like mercury.{/n}
  - After: {n}The room goes cold as the lid opens. Inside, a scratched {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}, blood rolling over it like mercury.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You know who this is. You know I'm close and will never leave you be. Enjoy the power you stole from me while you can. But I'm not done with you yet!"
  - After: "You know who this is. Enjoy my stolen power. I'm not done with you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The device seems vaguely familiar. Could this be your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}, the one the mutineers took from you the day Theodora died? Under your gaze, the balls of blood begin to scurry along the casing frantically, then suddenly go still. The vox springs to life and, through hoarse crackling, lets out a series of short phrases. The voice that speaks them is just as well known to you as the device is — it is the voice of the former Master of Whispers, your rival and a Chaos collaborator.{/n}
  - After: {n}It's your {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}, taken the day Theodora died. It crackles with the voice of the former Master of Whispers — your rival, a Chaos collaborator.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The voice in the vox falls silent, but the silence only lasts a moment. Then a chorus of voices — hundreds, possibly thousands — explodes inside your head, repeating Kunrad's last phrase over and over again. Just like the mutants who attacked you. The chorus is so loud and fierce that you feel your eardrums might burst from the tension. Reaching a crescendo, the voices erupt in an agony of death cries and rattles. Then they fall silent. You feel your blood pounding in your ears.{/n}
  - After: {n}Thousands of voices scream Kunrad's phrase in your head, like the mutants did, then die in agony. Your blood pounds.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Eh, no. Get in line. My little pal Kunrad's going down just as soon as he shows himself..."
  - After: "Get in line. Kunrad's mine."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "So few words, but so many emotions... I hear the echo of deep-seated, long-nurtured enmity. The kind that exists only between lovers or blood relations."
  - After: "An enmity known only to lovers or kin."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}With the pincers on his mechadendrites snapping loudly, Pasqal bites out,{/n} "The spirit of this machine has been wounded by something unknown. I sense it in its electromagnetic respiration. I recommend immediate purification."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's pincers snap.{/n} "This machine spirit is wounded. Purify it now."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The voice in the vox falls silent. A moment later, a torrent of voices crashes against your sanity, yet fails to do you any harm. Relying on the lessons you learned in your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}past life{/d}, you instinctively clear your mind of all thought and your heart of all doubt to shield yourself from the dark powers. You have parried the strike aimed at you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Voices crash against you, but your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Signs}past life{/d} taught you to empty your mind. You parry the strike.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "The Adeptus Arbites will never recognise that heretic as a rightful ruler. If he shows his face on Dargonus, we will place the traitor in chains immediately and deliver him to you."
  - After: "The Arbites won't accept that heretic. If he comes to Dargonus, we'll chain him for you."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}The galvanic cells embedded within Eogunn's core emit a warning thrum, glowing with a blue light. The Manipulus studies the contours of the mechanism with keen interest.{/n} "The machine spirit of this device is overflowing with emanations of a nature unknown to me. The currents of the Motive Force coursing through it have revealed this to me. Its hunger to be heard is truly immense! I propose we perform an exploratory act of communication with the spirit inhabiting this vox."
  - After: {n}Eogunn's cells thrum blue.{/n} "Its spirit overflows with unknown emanations. Let us try speaking with it."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/DeadlyGardens/MarazhaiHelloAgain/MarazhaiHelloAgain_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "We met on the mining world. You are one of the xenos who got away."
  - After: "You fled the mining world."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My, my, this beast can speak our language!"
  - After: "My, the beast speaks!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What are you talking about?"
  - After: "What do you mean?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Yrliet helped me. Now it is my turn to help her."
  - After: "Yrliet helped me. Now I help her."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm tired of you, xenos. Prepare to die!"
  - After: "Enough, xenos. Die!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Point at Heinrix] "My friend from the Inquisition introduced me to the right people. You can thank him yourself."
  - After: [Point at Heinrix] "My Inquisition friend helped. Thank him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Aggravating, is it not — having someone best you at your own game?"
  - After: "Aggravating, being bested at your own game?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Not so fast. I answered your question. Now you answer mine."
  - After: "I answered you. Now answer me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why go anywhere? I will kill you right here."
  - After: "I'll kill you here."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I keep hearing about an Archon. Who is that?"
  - After: "Who is this Archon?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What are you doing on my planets? Why are you attacking us?"
  - After: "Why attack my planets?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Conversations end when I say they do!"
  - After: "Conversations end when I say!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "It's about time!"
  - After: [Attack] "About time!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you and your band the ones responsible for stealing the sun?"
  - After: "Did you steal the sun?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will be there, xenos. You can count on it."
  - After: "I'll be there, xenos."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We certainly worked over enough of you xenos scum at your little bash — not the type of thing one forgets."
  - After: "We butchered plenty of you at your little bash."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Hmm? Oh, you're finished pontificating? I think I dozed off there for a second — do you mind repeating the whole thing from the start?"
  - After: "Finished pontificating? I dozed off — repeat it all?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What wreck stuffed full of mon-keigh? Answer me!"
  - After: "What wreck of mon-keigh? Answer me!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "That is none of your business, filth."
  - After: "None of your business, filth."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I know how heavily this mystery weighs on Yrliet. I wish to lighten her burden."
  - After: "I want to ease Yrliet's burden."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have a burning desire to find those xenos and arrange a great hunt."
  - After: "I want to hunt those xenos."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} in ornate black armour turns his head to you. His thin, pale face is covered in tattoos and blood spatters. After a moment, his thin lips stretch into a crooked, unpleasant smile.{/n} "At last. You took your time coming to meet me, {g|Encyclopedia:MonKeigh}mon-keigh{/g}." {n}A couple of seconds pass before you realise that the {g|Encyclopedia:Elucidator}Elucidator{/g} is silent — the xenos is addressing you in Low Gothic.{/n}
  - After: {n}A tattooed {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} in black armour smiles crookedly.{/n} "At last, {g|Encyclopedia:MonKeigh}mon-keigh{/g}." {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Elucidator}Elucidator{/g} is silent — it's Low Gothic.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "How is it that out of all of your kind, you are the only one to discover our feasts in advance? Usually, you are all so slow and sluggish that my kin always have enough time to leave the battlefield before aid arrives. But still, time and time again, your dogs have been there to stand in the Kabal's way." {n}He pauses, waiting for your answer.{/n}
  - After: "How do you alone foresee our feasts?" {n}He waits.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You ruined the reception that our poor little Tazarra had worked so hard to arrange. Now it is the Succubus's dream to drag you to Commorragh and have her way with you. What a terrible disappointment it would be for her if something were to happen to you before then... But we should not get ahead of ourselves, yes? First, mon-keigh, allow me to get a good look at you."
  - After: "You ruined Tazarra's reception. The Succubus wants you alive in Commorragh. Let me look at you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, mon-keigh. Revel in those memories while you still can, because I will make you regret that stunt of yours yet. But for now — for now, I will take this opportunity to study you."
  - After: "Revel while you can. You'll regret it. For now, I'll study you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your joviality is unwise, mon-keigh. If only you knew who it is you have offended, you would slit your own throat this instant to escape retribution. But there will be time for that later."
  - After: "Unwise. Knowing whom you offended, you'd slit your own throat."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Speaking your language is slightly less trying for my patience than being forced to listen to a mon-keigh machine butchering our tongue. Besides, I want you to understand well what I am about to tell you."
  - After: "Better than your machine butchering our tongue. And I want you to understand me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He clicks his tongue.{/n} "So you do serve her. Very well. There is something I can tell you, Yrliet... after I am done with these mon-keigh. Step out of my way."
  - After: {n}He clicks his tongue.{/n} "So you serve her. I'll tell you something later, Yrliet. Step aside."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Naive little beast. I won't be soiling my blades with your guts today. My subjects, however... they will gladly amuse themselves with you."
  - After: "Naive beast. My subjects will deal with you."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix lowers his voice.{/n} "{name}, something isn't right here. An Archon wouldn't miss an opportunity to lead a raid and revel in the violence and pain herself. What is she planning? Is this a distraction to mask her true intentions? Or an attempt to get rid of her subordinate?"
  - After: {n}Heinrix, quietly:{/n} "{name}, Archons never skip raids. A distraction? A purge?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Are you trying to convince me that a mon-keigh, even a well-trained mon-keigh pet, is capable of perceiving the designs of the {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g}? Both you and your 'friend' will pay for this audacity."
  - After: "A mon-keigh pet reading {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} designs? You'll both pay."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I take it thanks will not be forthcoming."
  - After: "No thanks, then."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And? That's it? Just an assertion that your kind are not as brainless as you appear to be? This answer does not satisfy me."
  - After: "That's it? Unsatisfying."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I suppose you are forthright in that regard. But simple riches do not change the fact of your weak, short-sighted, deficient nature. No, there is another reason why the mon-keigh have so suddenly become so astute."
  - After: "Riches don't fix your deficient nature. There's another reason."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You think too highly of your deeds — however insignificant they may be."
  - After: "You overrate your petty deeds."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hmph. Very well. Amuse me."
  - After: "Hmph. Amuse me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My name is Marazhai Aezyrraesh. Dracon of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest. First blade to Lady Yremeryss. Eviscerator of Illiridos, Blaze of the Barkhag Kingdom, and Slayer of Carrocius the Pale."
  - After: "Marazhai Aezyrraesh, Dracon of the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest, first blade to Lady Yremeryss, Eviscerator of Illiridos, Blaze of the Barkhag Kingdom, Slayer of Carrocius the Pale."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Mistress of the Kabal whose hunting grounds lie in this region of realspace. It was she who ordered her subjects to gut mon-keigh worlds in order to replenish the supply of meat in the cages of her arenas."
  - After: "Mistress of the Kabal hunting here. She had mon-keigh worlds gutted to restock her arenas."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Because that is the way of things, mon-keigh. You run. We hunt. You die suffering. We relish every moment of it. When immediate torment loses its lustre and we seek ways to extract something more exquisite from our victims, well... Your kin are frequent guests in my home realm, albeit not of their own volition."
  - After: "You run, we hunt, you die screaming. Some we take home."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "An unfortunate necessity. Sometimes I am forced to speak to the likes of you — when the eloquence of the whip does not suffice."
  - After: "When the whip isn't enough."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I suppose I should not have expected anything compelling from a mon-keigh. Your questions breed boredom. The conversation is over."
  - After: "You bore me. We're done."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh, mon-keigh. I do not play by your rules."
  - After: "I don't play by your rules."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos lowers his head pensively, but what catches your attention is something else — a barely noticeable twitch of his fingers in his armoured gauntlet. He is signalling to someone standing behind you.{/n}
  - After: {n}His fingers twitch — signalling someone behind you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos lowers his head, clearly considering your words.{/n}
  - After: {n}He considers your words.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Stealing the sun? The {g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} are capable of that and much more, mon-keigh — Commorragh bathes in the light of three stars stolen by my kin. But if you think I had a hand in this or any other theft of suns — you are mistaken."
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:Drukhari}Drukhari{/g} stole Commorragh's three stars. This one wasn't me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Splendid, mon-keigh. Well, now that the offer has been extended... I must take my leave. I hope you prove diverting for my subjects, whom I leave in my stead."
  - After: "Splendid. I leave you to my subjects."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In any case, I have grown quite tired of your attempts to delay the inevitable. Surely you too have run yourself ragged chasing us between the stars. Let us put an end to this. Finish this standoff. My forces against yours. Once and for all."
  - After: "Enough delays. My forces against yours, once and for all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do you wish to find it?" {n}His eyes flash with dark delight, and his voice becomes mockingly obliging.{/n} "Well then, mon-keigh, I suggest you send your servants beyond the Cinerus Maleficum. I'm sure they will return with surprising results."
  - After: {n}He smirks.{/n} "Send your servants beyond the Cinerus Maleficum. They'll be surprised."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Hold your foul tongue, abomination! Such filth will not use that tone with the Emperor's chosen!" {n}Abelard is white with fury.{/n}
  - After: "Hold your tongue before the Emperor's chosen, abomination!" {n}Abelard is livid.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos tilts his head to one side.{/n} "Why? I sent an invitation — by way of the cattle that dwelt on this world — and the 'chosen' has so obediently appeared. How are my words anything but the truth?"
  - After: {n}He tilts his head.{/n} "I invited the 'chosen', and here you are. Where's the lie?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He turns to Yrliet in a snakelike motion.{/n} "One of my soft-bodied kin. What meagre offering tempted you to lower yourself to attending these animals? Or does their company remind you of being among your lost brothers and sisters?"
  - After: {n}He turns to Yrliet.{/n} "A soft cousin serving animals? Like your lost kin?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet freezes — only her wide eyes betray her dismay and anger.{/n} "What do you know about my brothers and sisters, Dark One?"
  - After: {n}Yrliet freezes, furious.{/n} "What do you know of my kin, Dark One?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He lets out an unpleasant laugh.{/n} "Only that they wander, blind and helpless, robbed of their home and hope... But why am I telling you this? Isn't it your duty to watch over your kin, Outcast?"
  - After: {n}He laughs.{/n} "They wander blind, homeless, hopeless. Isn't that your concern, Outcast?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix narrows his eyes.{/n} "How disappointing. This clearly isn't Yremeryss, the Kabal's Archon whom we had the displeasure of meeting on Vheabos VI. Once again we are dealing with a pawn instead of the true root of the problem."
  - After: {n}Heinrix squints.{/n} "Not Yremeryss, the Archon from Vheabos VI. A pawn."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos lets out a hiss of irritation.{/n} "The little mon-keigh remembered the Archon's name? Such a clever thing you are... You might just make a good pet — after you have been properly trained and stripped of your misplaced arrogance."
  - After: {n}He hisses.{/n} "Clever pet. You'll be trained out of that arrogance."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Let's add a couple more titles, shall we? The Runner for the Hills of Vheabos VI and the Insufferable Blatherer of Grantis."
  - After: "Add Runner for the Hills of Vheabos VI and Insufferable Blatherer of Grantis."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos hisses in irritation.{/n} "Do not try my patience, mon-keigh."
  - After: {n}He hisses.{/n} "Don't try my patience."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "That thing is perceptive." {n}You hear the undercurrent of worry in Heinrix's murmur.{/n}
  - After: "That thing is perceptive." {n}Heinrix is worried.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "And it is all to prevent your putrescent souls from wasting away in the scorching corruption of Sai'lanthresh." {n}Yrliet practically spits out her words.{/n} "Day after day, century after century, you chase after the torment of others in hopes that the whispers of She Who Thirsts might fade from your ears at last."
  - After: {n}Yrliet spits,{/n} "All to hide your rotten souls from She Who Thirsts, in Sai'lanthresh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari cocks his head and looks at Yrliet with feigned pity.{/n} "Spoken by one who has willingly locked herself in a cage of rules and taboos. Tell me, Asuryani: what part of you is true Aeldari? Have you ever in your life let yourself be consumed by pure euphoria? Have you ever felt real passion? I invite you to join me. I will initiate you into the art of pain and unveil all that your Paths keep hidden."
  - After: {n}He feigns pity.{/n} "Says one caged in taboos. Join me, Asuryani. Learn the art of pain."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae shrugs half-heartedly.{/n} "Look at that. A xenos family fight. At least in that regard they are reminiscent of blessed Humanity."
  - After: {n}Jae shrugs.{/n} "A xenos family fight. Just like Humanity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Perhaps I was mistaken, and it is not my craftworld cousin who follows you — perhaps it is you who serves her? Why would a mon-keigh concern {mf|himself|herself} with the fate of those you call xenos? Do you not consider them — us — your mortal enemies?"
  - After: "So you serve my cousin? Why trouble {mf|himself|herself} over xenos?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's keen gaze pierces you. Emotions flash across her face in quick succession, and a spark of light appears in her eyes.{/n}
  - After: {n}A spark lights Yrliet's eyes.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet curls her fists. After a moment's pause, she whispers,{/n} "No, Dark One. That... will not come to pass."
  - After: {n}Yrliet clenches her fists.{/n} "No, Dark One. That will not happen."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Your hesitation speaks volumes, xenos." {n}Heinrix's voice is icy with contempt.{/n}
  - After: "Your hesitation speaks volumes, xenos," {n}Heinrix says icily.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Then I have nothing to say to you."
  - After: "Then I've nothing to say."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's scornful gaze pierces you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet glares at you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos pauses, mulling over something. Then he continues in an unmistakable tone of weary boredom,{/n} "I will tell you this, mon-keigh... I know you might be lying to me. Or you might even be unaware of who is guiding your hand. In any case, I have grown quite tired of your attempts to delay the inevitable. Surely you too have run yourself ragged chasing us between the stars. Let us put an end to this. Finish this standoff. My forces against yours. Once and for all."
  - After: {n}Bored,{/n} "Enough delays. My forces against yours, once and for all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari tilts his head.{/n} "I am starting to like you, mon-keigh."
  - After: {n}He tilts his head.{/n} "I'm starting to like you."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae shudders.{/n} "If a Drukhari took a shine to me, shereen, I'd know to expect nothing good out of it. You are too popular, even with your enemies."
  - After: {n}Jae shudders.{/n} "A Drukhari's fondness bodes ill, shereen."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "You forgot one title, xenos. Your final and true title: the Dead."
  - After: "You forgot your final title, xenos: the Dead."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The mask of composure vanishes from the xenos's face — spitting out a florid, vehement tirade, he draws his weapon.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cursing, he draws his weapon.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You wander among the stars, so you must know of this place. An ancient reach where the echo of stellar agony rings still. A place that serves as a graveyard for old stars, still filled with residual emissions and glittering dust. The place that buried your wreck stuffed full of delicious, frightened mon-keigh and the horrors that devoured them. The threshold of our domain. Your kind call it the Cinerus Maleficum. That is where our disputes will be settled. The Kabal of the Reaving Tempest will be waiting for you, mon-keigh — do not come unarmed."
  - After: "Your wreck lies in a graveyard of stars — the Cinerus Maleficum, our threshold. We settle this there. Come armed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do not play the fool, Rogue Trader. The mon-keigh know when their world or vessel is due for reaping. The mon-keigh hide or attempt to bare their teeth. Somehow, the mon-keigh know what we know — and I suspect that the search for this leak ought to start with you. After all, it was with you that this series of setbacks began."
  - After: "Don't play the fool. Your kind know when we strike. The leak began with you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos pauses and raises his chin slightly, examining you.{/n} "There is deplorably little to distinguish you from the rest of your dull-witted species. And yet, mon-keigh... and yet you are different. After all, you are from the caste of their rulers, are you not? 'Rogue Trader' — that is what they call you? Well, then, Rogue Trader, since you nevertheless deigned to come to this meeting, tell me your little secret."
  - After: {n}He studies you.{/n} "Dull, yet different. Tell me your secret, Rogue Trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A bizarre-looking artefact on the xenos's chest flashes with otherworldly fire — and in a deft movement, he dodges the shot. His voice takes on a mocking tone.{/n} "I am not finished, mon-keigh."
  - After: {n}His chest artefact flares; he dodges.{/n} "I'm not finished."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos clicks his tongue.{/n} "Predictable. Boring."
  - After: {n}He clicks his tongue.{/n} "Boring."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/DrukhariSE_03/CrewTraitorDialogue/CrewTraitorDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Point at the patch on the man's sleeve] "Your crew's not stationed in this section. Explain yourself."
