  - After: [Point at the patch on the man's sleeve] "Your crew isn't posted here. Explain."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Put this body out of an airlock along with all the others."
  - After: "Space the body with the others."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me about these hallucinations. When did they start?"
  - After: "When did these hallucinations start?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are clearly seriously injured. You must be taken to the infirmary."
  - After: "You're badly hurt. Go to the infirmary."
- **Player**
  - Before: "There are no Guards here. You are on board the Rogue Trader's vessel... and knee-deep in xenos blood and entrails."
  - After: "No Guards here. This is the Rogue Trader's ship, knee-deep in xenos gore."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stand when the Lord Captain is speaking to you, you worm!"
  - After: "Stand when the Lord Captain speaks, worm!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you here and not on your assigned deck?"
  - After: "Why aren't you on your deck?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It seems you were not in your right mind."
  - After: "You weren't in your right mind."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I don't know what happened to you, but you led xenos to the very heart of this vessel and almost killed us all!"
  - After: "You led xenos into this ship and nearly killed us all!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'll string up your skinned corpse on the main deck as a warning to other traitors!"
  - After: "I'll hang your skinned corpse on the main deck as a warning!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Execute the traitor] "In the name of the Emperor, death to all heretics!"
  - After: [Execute the traitor] "In the Emperor's name, death to heretics!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Contact the Vox Master] "Take the body to the infirmary and try to identify the cause of his madness."
  - After: [Contact the Vox Master] "Take the body to the infirmary. Find the cause of his madness."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Let the officer slip into the hallucination] "I think I hear your son calling you."
  - After: [Let the officer slip into the hallucination] "I hear your son calling."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If your spawn truly is somewhere around here, the only way you will find him is in pieces."
  - After: "If your spawn is here, he's in pieces."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}With your experience{/d}, you can tell from a single look at the standard patch on the crewman's clothes that he belongs to the middle decks and therefore has no business being here.{/n}
  - After: {n}{d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}With your experience{/d}, you see his patch: middle decks. He doesn't belong here.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "What? Tacitus?" {n}The man laughs weakly, his eyes now fully clouded with madness.{/n} "Tacitus, my boy... I'm coming..." {n}The officer's body slides to the floor and convulses for a time before going still. Despite his agonising death, the dead man's face shows no signs of suffering — he had found peace before the end.{/n}
  - After: "Tacitus?" {n}He laughs weakly.{/n} "I'm coming..." {n}He dies, at peace.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "I believe this mon-keigh is not here by chance — he has been in the clutches of the Dark Ones. His current state may be the bitter fruit of time spent alongside those masters of torment and madness."
  - After: "The Dark Ones had him. This is their work."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}Something shifts in the officer's expression and the feverish gleam in his eyes goes out.{/n} "Tacitus, my boy... Swamp devils dragged him off. I'm where I'm supposed to be. I'm looking for my son."
  - After: {n}His fever fades.{/n} "Swamp devils took Tacitus. I'm looking for my son."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard clutches his head.{/n} "Motive Force strike me down, I think I've got it! The xenos that the crew smoked out during the recent warp jump! This poor madman must have taken him for a Guardsman... Remember, Lord Captain? The enraged Drukhari who had bent several crew members to his will?"
  - After: {n}Abelard clutches his head.{/n} "The Drukhari we smoked out during the warp jump, who enthralled crewmen! He took him for a Guardsman."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta's voice trembles with sorrow and rage.{/n} "Until the last beast among the enemies of Humanity is dead, the innocent will continue to suffer torment... Is this not a sign that we must work doggedly to rid the universe of xenos?"
  - After: {n}Argenta shakes with rage.{/n} "Innocents suffer while xenos live. Purge them all."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "The massacre? The massacre... yes, the massacre... the swamp devils jumped right out of the water, and Tacitus, my boy... He must be somewhere around here, in the marshes. Could he have fallen into the water? I hope he's not injured."
  - After: "Swamp devils leapt from the water... Tacitus is somewhere in the marshes. I hope he's unhurt."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}The man raises his hand as though requesting permission to speak.{/n} "Don't... I don't deserve to live after what I've done. My mind is probably corrupted for good already — even now, I'm looking at you, and I can see behind you the marsh where Tacitus vanished..."
  - After: {n}He raises a hand.{/n} "Don't. I don't deserve to live. I see the marsh where Tacitus vanished..."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's mouth twists.{/n} "Our cousins are adept at creating concoctions that turn sentient beings into mere beasts shrieking in agonising pain. Sometimes the effect is quick, sometimes it leaves just enough time for the victims to divulge all that they know."
  - After: {n}Yrliet grimaces.{/n} "Our cousins' potions make minds shrieking beasts — slowly enough to extract secrets."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae looks at you.{/n} "Whatever they did to him, shereen, there is no way back for him now... If it were up to me, I would let him slip back into the illusion, where there is still hope of finding Tacitus. Let him go at peace with himself, and not as a traitor."
  - After: {n}Jae looks at you.{/n} "He's lost, shereen. Let him die dreaming of Tacitus, at peace, not as a traitor."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "The Guards, they weren't... very chatty. One of them called me something strange — 'mon-keigh,' I think? And I heard them talking among themselves. Something about... 'seizing the ship'... 'don't let them through'... through to where, I don't know... oh, it's coming over me again!"
  - After: "The Guards called me 'mon-keigh'. They spoke of 'seizing the ship'... 'don't let them through'... It's coming over me again!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Could it be the 'Dracon' who sent us here to this rendezvous? My, my, a xenos who eviscerates human worlds has set a trap for us instead of meeting us in an honest duel! How unexpected!"
  - After: "The 'Dracon' who sent us here set a trap, not a duel? How unexpected!"
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}The officer slowly runs his hands over his face, shuddering as he touches his nose.{/n} "Must have been the devils... They're fast — one of them jumped on my neck and sank its claws into my face just now. Yes, that must have been what happened..."
  - After: {n}He touches his face, shuddering.{/n} "A devil clawed my face. Yes..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The patch on his jacket shows a crest that is vaguely familiar, but you have no idea which particular compartment it is linked to. The only thing you know is that he is wearing a von Valancius voidship officer's uniform.{/n}
  - After: {n}You can't place his patch; he wears a von Valancius officer's uniform.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "I don't understand... Xenos? What... xenos...?" {n}For an instant, awareness returns to the officer's eyes, and he seems to see his surroundings for the first time. His face slowly stills in horror.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
  - After: "Xenos?" {n}Horror dawns.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "What?" {n}The man tries to stand up, but he slips and falls back to his knees.{/n} "No, no. There's still hope. Tacitus can't have fallen into the devils' hands just like that — the Guards will save him. They have to..." {n}The officer's gaze suddenly clears and he seems to be aware of where he is — his bloodied face slowly stills in horror.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
  - After: "What?" {n}He slips.{/n} "The Guards will save Tacitus..." {n}His gaze clears.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae laughs darkly.{/n} "Blow up the reactor bay, damage the engines... and then disembowel the helpless ship to your xenos heart's content. Oh, yes, that sounds just like my 'partners.'"
  - After: {n}Jae laughs darkly.{/n} "Blow the reactor, cripple the engines, gut the ship. My 'partners', all right."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "I think you're right, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Reason has fled me, I can't hold out — even now, I can see the marsh where Tacitus vanished just behind you..." {n}The man's face twists in a mask of pain and grief, and a powerful spasm wracks his body.{/n}
  - After: "You're right, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I see the marsh where Tacitus vanished..." {n}He spasms.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}The officer's death throes last for several minutes — his eyes are still hazy, seeing the false vision, and his screams are interspersed with piteous attempts to call for his dead son and pleas to the Lord Captain for forgiveness. At last, his body collapses to the floor, where it convulses for a few moments longer. The dead man's face is twisted in indescribable agony.{/n}
  - After: {n}He dies slowly, screaming for his son and your forgiveness, face twisted in agony.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "I... don't remember? It's so strange... It's like I'm here and I'm there at the same time... But... I remember, many watches ago, a visit from a Guardsman, after the swamp devils attacked, it seemed. He treated my injuries... did something to my face... and said that his comrades would come and do what they had to do. And when the rest of them came, they told me to show them the way to the nest... but we're on the ship... where did I take them?"
  - After: "I'm here and there at once... A Guardsman treated me after the swamp devils came, did something to my face. His comrades had me lead them to the nest... but we're on the ship... where did I take them?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I'll be damned if this officer has a son... Perhaps he did once, but he embarked without any family in tow." {n}Abelard sighs heavily.{/n} "He's cracked, the poor wretch..."
  - After: "He boarded without family." {n}Abelard sighs.{/n} "He's cracked."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}A furrow appears between Heinrix's brows as he considers this.{/n} "It sounds like a mental distortion — the work of xenos... Drukhari are capable of ensnaring their prey without shackles or fetters — they twist and violate their victim's mind using unholy instruments. Your subject has been forced to experience a nightmare from the past in order to wreak a nightmare upon the present."
  - After: {n}Heinrix frowns.{/n} "Drukhari twist minds. He relived an old nightmare to make a new one."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Interesting..." {n}The Interrogator's face takes on a strange expression — stoic sufferance and grim humour.{/n} "How many more like him are roaming the decks waiting for their new masters to give them an order? At least they do not have any means of remote communication. A small comfort, but comfort nonetheless."
  - After: {n}Heinrix smiles grimly.{/n} "How many more await orders? At least they can't vox each other."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}A man in an officer's uniform is kneeling and scrabbling around in the mess of blood and dirt on the floor. As soon as you draw nearer, you hear his feverish muttering.{/n} "No, no, no... Where is he? Where is my son?" {n}The lower half of the officer's face is grimy with some strange substance too pale and lumpy to be blood. The officer pays you no attention — his eyes are fixed on the floor.{/n}
  - After: {n}A kneeling officer scrabbles in blood.{/n} "Where is my son?" {n}Pale muck smears his face.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira tilts her head to one side.{/n} "Those words, Lord Captain... 'Don't let them through'... have set my little voices singing. I hear them singing about a fine thread that leads to the heart of your territory... I hear them sing of Dargonus... of a black dragon..."
  - After: {n}Idira tilts her head.{/n} "'Don't let them through'... My voices sing of Dargonus... a black dragon..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The patch on his jacket bears a familiar crest — it is the symbol of one of the middle decks, one that has no connection to this compartment. The officer's presence here on its own is a violation of the ship's regulations.{/n}
  - After: {n}His patch marks an unrelated middle deck. He's breaking regulations.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}You take another step toward the man and peer into his face. Blue veins bulge under his scab-mottled skin, and his bloodshot eyes are darting in every direction, sometimes rolling back into his head so that only the whites are visible. The strange stuff covering the officer's face is lumpy pink slime mixed with blood that is streaming from his disfigured nose.{/n}
  - After: {n}Bulging veins, rolling eyes, pink slime streaming from his ruined nose.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}Your outburst lands like a slap to the officer's face: he jolts and looks at you with a cleared gaze that immediately fills with horror when he notices his surroundings.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
  - After: {n}He jolts, gaze clearing.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "I'm sorry! It's all a xenos illusion... Even now, I can see the marsh where Tacitus vanished just behind you..." {n}The man's face twists in a mask of pain and grief. He coughs violently and slumps forward as though he is falling asleep.{/n}
  - After: "Sorry! A xenos illusion... I see Tacitus's marsh..." {n}He slumps.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}Tears start to run down the traitor's cringing face.{/n} "I didn't know I was betraying Humanity to the xenos... I didn't know... Even now I look behind you and I see the marsh where Tacitus vanished..."
  - After: {n}He weeps.{/n} "I didn't know I betrayed Humanity... I see the marsh..."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}You bend over the body. Despite the numerous bloodstains on his skin and clothes, the officer had not been seriously wounded. The only noticeable injury is on his face — his nose is disfigured, and a red, slimy substance is streaming from it, staining his mouth and chin.{/n}
  - After: {n}His only wound: a ruined, slime-oozing nose.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}In one sudden movement, the man falls at your feet, an expression of stoic acceptance frozen on his face.{/n}
  - After: {n}He falls at your feet, resigned.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Wait... He's an operational officer from Deck 67-3. Not from one of the local clans, which is why I remember him. He helped me bring up the new recruits from the planet. What is he doing here?"
  - After: "An operations officer from Deck 67-3. Helped me with recruits. Why's he here?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah purses her lips.{/n} "Only a heretic would suggest something like this. To die with one's mind dazed by xenos influence? No. Let him die a man who is aware of the betrayal he has committed. Only then will he find his way into the Undying One's hands."
  - After: {n}Kibellah frowns.{/n} "Heresy. Let him die aware of his betrayal, so the Undying One takes him."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: "The Emperor's valiant Guards came to save my boy. I showed them where the swamp devils dragged Tacitus. I led them right here like they asked. They'll make short work of the nest of those beasts... and I'll keep looking for my boy in the meantime. {mf|Master|Mistress}, will you help?" {n}The man's face contorts in a monstrous grimace — a mixture of pain, hope, and madness.{/n}
  - After: "The Emperor's Guards came for my boy. I led them here to the swamp devils' nest. {mf|Master|Mistress}, help me look?" {n}He grimaces madly.{/n}
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}The man jerks his head up, apparently seeing you for the first time. But just as he opens his mouth to reply, his whole body begins to shudder — and his newly cleared gaze passes over the chamber. His blood-filled eyes go wide in horror.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
  - After: {n}He looks up, shudders, sees.{/n} "Emperor preserve us..."
- **Surviving Crew Member**
  - Before: {n}The man sneezes, and the lower half of his face is coated anew in the slime streaming from his nose. The officer casts you a pleading look.{/n} "What is this nightmarish scene? I was leading the Emperor's Guards to the swamp devils' nest across the marshlands of my homeworld... but instead of that I was showing the way to... them?" {n}He points at the corpses of the xenos with a trembling hand.{/n} "Hallucinations... A heretical mirage..."
  - After: {n}Slime streams from his nose.{/n} "I was leading Guards to the devils' nest on my homeworld... but I led them?" {n}He points at the xenos dead.{/n} "A heretical mirage..."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Atrium/ChordaAgent/ChordaAgent_Footfall_c2_dialog

  - Before: {n}A well-groomed young man calls out to you. He is clean-shaven and dressed in clothes that are expensive but unshowy, with a bright Aquila embroidered in a prominent spot.{/n}

  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}{/d}, a minute! Bastian of Chorda, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} envoy, by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s grace."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Noble {mf|sir|lady}, a minute of your time, if you please! I am Bastian in Derama Bastaal-Chorda, youngest cousin of House Chorda, envoy of Incendia Bastaal-Chorda, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of the Koronus Expanse by the grace of the most holy {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. And you must be an {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}envoy{/d} of Theodora von Valancius? I noticed that you arrived on the esteemed lady's ship."
  - After: "Noble {mf|sir|lady}, a minute! I'm Bastian of Chorda, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} envoy, by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s grace. You're Theodora von Valancius's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}envoy{/d}?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Splendid. It's a pleasure to be speaking with an equal — truth be told, I get a little flustered in the presence of the powers that be..." {n}Bastian smiles meekly.{/n}
  - After: "Splendid, an equal! The powerful fluster me." {n}He smiles meekly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Bastian's eyes go wide for a moment as he processes the new information.{/n} "What a tragedy! What a terrible loss... Please accept my condolences, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! May the Emperor's light be with the righteously departed, may their brilliance never dim in the memory of their descendants... And please likewise accept my congratulations on attaining the status of Rogue Trader, albeit as a consequence of such a tragic event."
  - After: {n}Bastian's eyes widen.{/n} "A tragedy! My condolences, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and congratulations."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The Emperor's most loyal servants should be more concerned with carrying His will through the stars and less with divvying up profit among themselves," {n}Argenta says disapprovingly, but quietly enough so as not to interrupt the negotiations.{/n} "Especially when the well-being of one of the Imperium's worlds is at stake, even one such as Footfall."
  - After: "His servants should carry His will, not divvy up profit," {n}Argenta mutters.{/n} "Not with a world at stake."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Not at all. Would you like to take these negotiations somewhere more suitable so that I may go over the details?"
  - After: "Not at all. Shall we discuss details somewhere private?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A shame, truly a shame... Perhaps we could meet later? At a time that is more convenient for you?"
  - After: "A shame... Perhaps later?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A matter of the utmost delicacy... You see, you've been to the residence of the Liege. Vladaym almost certainly appealed to you for assistance in the arrangement of shipments to Footfall. The von Valancius protectorate is famed for the abundance of its main {g|Encyclopedia:AgriWorld}agri-world{/g}, Janus. It would be odd for him not to seize on such an opportunity when Footfall is on the verge of famine."
  - After: "Delicate matter. The Liege surely asked you to ship food from Janus, your {g|Encyclopedia:AgriWorld}agri-world{/g}, with famine looming."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "However, the Chorda dynasty pursues its own interests on Footfall. We have already announced our terms to the Liege, but he is stalling — I imagine, in hopes of getting a better offer from you. The Chorda dynasty believes..." {n}Bastian smiles and gives a slight shrug.{/n} "...that cooperation would be preferable for both Rogue Trader houses. If you refuse Vladaym, thereby forcing him to agree to a deal with us — the Chorda dynasty can promise you a share of the profits from the future contract, as well as certain other perquisites. Everybody benefits!"
  - After: "But Chorda wants this deal." {n}He shrugs.{/n} "Refuse the Liege, force him to us, and we share the profits. Everybody benefits!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It's simply business. Honest and straightforward. Footfall is a den of bandits and profiteers. They may not be outright heretics, but they are far from the light of the Imperium. They should be grateful that Rogue Traders allow this den to exist in the first place. Demanding fair payment from them is only right."
  - After: "Honest business. Footfall is a bandit den we allow to exist. Fair payment is only right."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That's wonderful to hear. I had no doubts about our dynasties' mutual interests."
  - After: "Wonderful. I knew our interests aligned."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Strong words. Perhaps you would like to give my proposal a little more consideration?"
  - After: "Strong words. Reconsider?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Bastian smiles and opens his mouth to offer another piece of sugar-coated courtesy, when suddenly...{/n}
  - After: {n}Bastian starts another courtesy, when suddenly...{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira, who was yawning in boredom a moment ago, flinches and clutches her face, her fingernails digging into her skin.{/n} "They're coming! Again! Brothers of the ones who came before! I just don't get it — do they all have a death wish?"
  - After: {n}Idira clutches her face.{/n} "They're coming! Again! Do they all want to die?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Behind your smile, Master Bastian, teal shadows swirl. Others may not see them, but your worry cannot escape my eye. What are you afraid of? Your house's wrath should these negotiations prove fruitless? Or the wrath of House von Valancius?"
  - After: "Teal shadows swirl behind your smile, Master Bastian. Do you fear your house's wrath, or ours?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Chorda, hmm. They are some of the most influential Rogue Traders in the Koronus Expanse. But not on Footfall — this station is under the control of House Winterscale. Something tells me that we are about to hear a most curious offer..." {n}says Abelard under his breath so that only you can hear him.{/n}
  - After: "Chorda — powerful, but Footfall is Winterscale's. Expect a curious offer..." {n}Abelard murmurs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What?" {n}Bastian stares at you in surprise, then turns around...{/n}
  - After: "What?" {n}Bastian turns around...{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Vladaym may be a putrid-mouthed ashmag, but he's no fool. The terms of the deal must have been ludicrous for him to refuse a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s offer. Catastrophically unfavourable, I'd say."
  - After: "Vladaym's an ashmag, but no fool. Refusing a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}? The terms must be catastrophic."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why? For a missionary, his temple is the patch of deck beneath his feet. From where I stand, I can clearly see the life of my flock, all its bustling, blooming, and wilting. Here I can see their vile urges, futile hopes, and flashes of sincerity."

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His smile dims.{/n} "It is true. Death would have been too easy a liberation for me. To live knowing what depths of wickedness my soul is capable of is truly an agonising fate. And yet in that agony, there is serenity."

- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "Forgive me, Lord Captain. I lacked respect."

  - Before: {n}He studies you with his heavy gaze, then erupts into a fit of laughter, his voice so hoarse, you fear his vocal cords are about to snap.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well, at least you're not lying to yourself. You are a filthy blasphemer and a blight in His eyes. As am I. As are we all. This is the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, and there is no virtue here, only profaners steeped in villainy."
  - After: "Honest, at least. You're a blasphemer. So am I. So are we all. No virtue in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What am I doing in this den of blasphemers, pagans, and the vilest of souls, you mean to say? Well, Footfall is the first and last stop in the Koronus Expanse. It is the point of arrival for those who have just started on their path, and it is also where those who are reaching its very end return, their souls wounded and bleeding. I embrace both the former and the latter, so that they may cast an honest eye over their impurity."
  - After: "Footfall is the Expanse's first and last stop. I tend both newcomers and the wounded returning, so they face their impurity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Furthermore, rumours from across the entire sector amass on Footfall. If I hear crewmen whispering about a reclaimed shrine world or expressing desire to carry the Emperor's light into the darkness among the stars, I help my flock in their sacred duty. Devoted trailblazers need assistance both spiritual and material: tools, equipment, even garments and simple everyday items — anything that might help pilgrims on their long journey and during the first days of the harsh frontier life is worth its weight in gold to us. May any help you offer to the effort of gathering such things be blessed."
  - After: "Rumours gather here. When my flock seeks to carry His light outward, I help. Pioneers need tools, equipment, clothes. Any help you give is blessed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I bear another, darker duty. The Expanse is filled with the tainted creations of unholy heretics. These insidious objects are a danger to the soul, but I know what to do with them. Should you on your travels come upon dangerous, corrupted objects — bring them to me, and the reward for your vigilance will be even more generous. The Drusian mission has much to share with the Rogue Trader."
  - After: "And a darker duty: bring me the heretics' tainted objects you find. I'll reward you generously."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My sermon planted the seed of faith in the heart of another Rogue Trader once — Incendia Chorda. Perhaps you are destined to become my second fledgling."
  - After: "I once seeded faith in Incendia Chorda. Perhaps you'll be my second."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Neither my past nor my present hold any secrets. But take heed when gazing into my heart, for many dark thoughts lurk within."
  - After: "I hide nothing. But dark thoughts lurk within."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am surprised that you had any to begin with."
  - After: "I'm surprised you had any."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We are a sanctioned Imperial cult which honours Saint Drusus, Scourge of the Bale Childer, Bane of Xenos. Just as he once fearlessly ventured into the Calixis Sector and spearheaded its conquest, so do we travel to untamed reaches and expand the Imperium's borders. We are pilgrims and scouts who descend into the darkness of lawless sectors, and our eyes are inured to vice and filth."
  - After: "A sanctioned cult of Saint Drusus, Bane of Xenos. Like him, we push the Imperium into lawless sectors."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "He was a great saint, irrepressible and decisive. Drusus served the Emperor as a simple member of the Guard, who fought in the glorious Angevin Crusade and rose to the rank of general. It was a gruelling conquest — the Imperium invaded the Calixis Sector, back then a savage expanse populated by xenos and heretics. Drusus delivered many defeats unto the enemies of Humanity — he brought down the Twisted Kings on Acreage, liberated the planet Dreah from the unholy Dark Daemons, and had many triumphs."
  - After: "A great saint. A Guardsman in the Angevin Crusade who became general as Calixis was conquered. He felled the Twisted Kings on Acreage and freed Dreah."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But then they encountered a race of unholy xenos. Rivers of blood flowed. Golgenna Angevin died in his headquarters, the crusade was about to crumble, but then... we received unexpected help from a foe."
  - After: "Then came unholy xenos. Golgenna Angevin died, the crusade faltered, but... a foe helped."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A wretched fiend. Blinded by my ambitions, I served in my home planet's {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g} division. I was a shrewd and sly bureaucrat, and I soared to great heights, to the very chair of prefect. In thirty years, I turned my home from a withered fringe colony into a prosperous world. Our wealth grew as we bloomed."
  - After: "A wretch. Ambition made me prefect in my world's {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g}; I made it prosperous."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But the bloom was a veneer for rot. Opulence had depraved us, and luxury had seduced us with its sordid promises. The planet's denizens no longer wished to pray or work, they only sought entertainment and dangerous philosophies. A thousand vile heresies and a million appalling vices bred on my world like mould on a nutribar."
  - After: "But the bloom hid rot. Luxury bred heresy and vice like mould on a nutribar."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Who said I had redeemed myself? I doomed an entire planet to degeneracy. You think a decade or two of wandering with a mission is enough to atone for that? No, I am a poor excuse for a shepherd in His eyes."
  - After: "Redeemed? I doomed a planet. Wandering can't atone. I'm a poor shepherd."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He nods calmly.{/n} "You are quite right. I am a wicked, irredeemable scoundrel. Shall we embrace, {mf|brother|sister}?"
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "True. Embrace, {mf|brother|sister}?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You think it is so easy to put into words His essence and splendour? The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} is the perfect deity that reads our hearts and grants us His light. He led Humanity out of darkness and horror, He created our great home. He experienced torment and pain, which only made Him stronger. That is a lesson to us all — purity is not to be found at the bottom of the dirtiest hive or in golden palaces, but only among the ranks of those who suffer."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} led Humanity from darkness and grew stronger through torment. Purity lies with those who suffer."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Pray to Him, destroy His enemies, and touch not their poisoned gifts. Cast aside all doubt and be vigilant against the weak souls beside you. When you see a sign of taint — burn it away without pity. Pain is good, it tears the crust of vileness from one's soul. And remember that if you see no fault in you or around you, then you are not being diligent enough in your search. Or you are being too lenient on yourself, averting your eyes from the truth."
  - After: "Pray, kill His enemies, burn taint without pity — pain cleanses. If you see no fault, look harder."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Think nothing of it, young von Valancius."
  - After: "Think nothing of it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It has three faces. The inhuman {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, who wish death upon us simply because they are unlike us. And the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g} that reigns in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}, which wishes death upon us by its very nature."
  - After: "Three faces: {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, envious mutants, and the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g} of the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}Immaterium{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You speak of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Adeptus Ministorum{/g}? Well, these heralds of His word hold great power. Every priest, myself included, is part of its hierarchy, and the Ecclesiarchy possesses the unique right to judge what is virtuous and what is malign. The Adeptus Ministorum prays and cares for the temples, it sends missions such as my own to every corner of the dominion of Humanity, it fights against heresies."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Adeptus Ministorum{/g}. It alone judges virtue, keeps temples, sends missions, fights heresy."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Have you heard of Aspyce Chorda — pirate, blasphemer, xenophile, and egregious apostate? Incendia is her heir, and a rarity among Rogue Traders.   - After: "Heir of Aspyce Chorda, pirate and apostate. Yet the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} hasn't killed her conscience."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "She relentlessly hunts down pirates and firebrands, and brings rebelling colonies to repentance, establishing strict discipline.   - After: "She hunts pirates and rebels, ringing colonies with orbiting heretic corpses. As her confessor, I rejoice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You think that His mercy extends that far? I have seen many who wish to be our shepherds. Power clouds their vision, and their greedy hands scoop up all that they can reach. The Ecclesiarchy is long overdue for a cleansing."
  - After: "That far? Many shepherds are greedy. The Ecclesiarchy needs cleansing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And rightly so. The Ecclesiarchy harbours plenty of covetous and power-hungry recidivists. They've forgotten what it means to be a shepherd. They've grown soft and sluggish. For too long have their souls and bodies gone without suffering."
  - After: "Rightly. It's full of soft recidivists."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus pauses, then adds grimly,{/n} "However, these are nothing but words. The real Ecclesiarchy is far more frightening, vile, and dark than it once was."
  - After: {n}He adds grimly,{/n} "The real Ecclesiarchy is far darker."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It's good that you realise this. It may be difficult to admit, but mercy is a weakness and a gateway for degradation."
  - After: "Good. Mercy is weakness."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "They aren't massacres. This is a war on apostasy and treason, and in this war, Incendia Chorda is inflicting grievous wounds upon the wicked."
  - After: "Not massacres. War on apostasy, and Incendia wounds the wicked."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He chuckles.{/n} "What good are her riches to us? Faith gives us all we need.   - After: {n}He chuckles.{/n} "Faith suffices. She owes us — {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusians{/g} found Aspyce's cryo-vault holding her."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have heard many exalt the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}deeds of your intellect{/d} and call your wisdom a gift from the Emperor Himself. Fools! Do they not know that the seeds of heresy sprout quickest in an enlightened mind? Understanding only erodes the will to act!"
  - After: "Fools praise the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}deeds of your intellect{/d}. Heresy sprouts quickest in enlightened minds!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "This priest speaks the truth as a wise spinner would." {n}Kibellah uses her blade to reopen a recently healed ritual wound on her hand.{/n} "As we accept the Undying One's blessings, so must we accept pain, for it brings us closer to Him."
  - After: "The priest speaks true." {n}Kibellah reopens a wound on her hand.{/n} "Pain brings us closer to the Undying One."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus looks at Kibellah calmly, without the fear that you have seen in many. He says quietly,{/n} "A spinner of the Bloodspun Web... People have mentioned your cult to me in their confessions. My mission does not approve of your... barbaric ways, which too often cross the line. And yet we respect the depth of your devotion to Him."
  - After: {n}Calmly:{/n} "A spinner of the Bloodspun Web. We dislike your barbarism, but respect your devotion."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "You forget yourself, priest — it is the Emperor's decree, signed in His blood, that the Warrant of Trade be passed down through inheritance. If you are displeased, then do your brooding in silence, but let no thought of yours challenge His Law."
  - After: "By the Emperor's decree, the Warrant of Trade is inherited, priest. Don't challenge His Law."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do not preach to me about the letter of the Lex Imperialis. What is faith worth if one knows only that which is written? What good is virtue if one turns a blind eye to odious vices? Reflect on this, if you are not yet so lost to hubris as to put collections of statutes above the Imperial Creed."
  - After: "Don't preach the Lex Imperialis to me. Don't place statutes above the Imperial Creed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But before you start on a path toward your new destiny — I have a request to make of you and your companion. Many among my flock are from the poorest, most dispossessed people on Footfall. They've brought me troubling news from Footfall's Shadow Quarters. In the darkest corners, where the Liege's wardens do not venture, taint has taken root."
  - After: "But first, a request for you both. My flock reports taint in the Shadow Quarters, where the Liege's wardens don't go."

  - After: [Select "Welcome"]

  - Before: {n}The sight of this {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g} would be enough to break any {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s heart — the machine is leaning slightly to one side, grimy, covered in scrawled drawings, with frivolous writing scratched here and there on the casing. Several keys are missing, and the rest are coated with dust.{/n}
  - After: {n}A grimy, scrawled-on {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, missing keys — a {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priest{/g}'s heartbreak.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}While you're pressing the keys, the cogitator appears dormant, but as you enter the last letter of the second word, it suddenly comes to life. Triumphant music pours out of it, followed by a voice. A man's voice, pleasant, with a somewhat dated pronunciation of Gothic.{/n} "Greetings!"
  - After: {n}The cogitator wakes with triumphant music and an old-fashioned voice.{/n} "Greetings!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator flickers and grunts before displaying a tapestry of text.{/n} "The great Parsimus Dewain intends to conquer the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} and build the most grandiose structure, which will shine through the ages, praising the names of its creator and his descendants — Footfall, the palace in the stars. The glory of the great Parsimus's deeds will live on throughout the ages, and his grand designs..." {n}The cogitator hisses and grunts as it tries to clean its insides by spewing out dust and detritus through its cracks.{/n}
  - After: {n}Text appears.{/n} "Parsimus Dewain will conquer the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} and build Footfall, a palace in the stars..." {n}It hisses, spewing dust.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Footfall Station has been envisioned by the great Parsimus Dewain as a palace in the stars, as majestic as the spirit and mind of its creator. As of the year of this cogitator's installation, merely a small fraction of the great Parsimus's designs has yet been made a reality, but already their audacity and grandeur are staggering. Footfall is to become the gateway to the savage and barely explored {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, a foothold for future conquests by the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} and the noble Parsimus Dewain, who acts by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s will..."
  - After: "Parsimus Dewain's Footfall, barely begun, will be the gateway to the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} for the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}, by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s will..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Footfall's sights are their own reward. However, I have prepared a gift for those who might unravel my riddle. Approach my statue, for the gift awaits you there. Remember: nothing must stand between you and your design, no matter how audacious and grand it may be!" {n}The voice quiets. You hear a click from the statue of Footfall's founder, as if some hidden locking mechanism has been released.{/n}
  - After: "Your gift awaits at my statue. Let nothing stop your design!" {n}The founder's statue clicks open.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}After a series of creaks and groans, the cogitator's dusty screen lights up. On it are several lines of text — section headings.{/n}
  - After: {n}The screen lights, showing section headings.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The attempt to fix the ancient cogitator ends poorly — after a long, rasping groan, the cogitator goes quiet. For good, apparently.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogitator groans and dies for good.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator whirrs and the screen turns back on.{/n}
  - After: {n}The screen whirrs back on.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "One of the first structures on Footfall was the colossal statue of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. A whole asteroid was used for the creation of this sculpture, but even its titanic proportions cannot convey the awe that every faithful servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} feels before the Master. The statue is the centre of Footfall in the same way that the Emperor is the centre and heart of the Imperium. As construction progresses, new, smaller asteroids are being attached to the statue, their surface serving as a foundation for glorious palaces and temples, and their inner tunnels as home for the commoners and rabble."
  - After: "First came the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s statue, carved from an asteroid — Footfall's centre, as He is the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s. Asteroids added around it hold palaces above, commoners' tunnels below."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator wheezes and blinks, clearly trying to shut down.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogitator wheezes, shutting down.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator hisses for a while, then the screen flickers and once more shows the words,{/n} "The great Parsimus Dewain intends to conquer..."
  - After: {n}It repeats,{/n} "The great Parsimus Dewain intends to conquer..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Lord Captain Parsimus Dewain, one of the trailblazers of the Koronus Expanse and this station's founder! I've read about his great deeds. Lord Dewain was once a colonel of the {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Astra Militarum{/g}, but, by His will, later inherited a {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g}. He accumulated enough power to gather a small fleet of loyal allies and venture out to conquer the Koronus Expanse."
  - After: "Parsimus Dewain, the station's founder! An {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Astra Militarum{/g} colonel who inherited a {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} and led a fleet into the Expanse."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "They say Footfall was meant to be his personal palace world, but the construction dragged on for decades, and Lord Parsimus... eventually died of old age. His enemies instantly tore Footfall to pieces and turned it into the bastion of Humanity we know today. One that is full of bandits, privateers, hustlers, and... Rogue Traders." {n}Pleased with herself, Cassia nods slightly to let everyone know that the lecture is over.{/n}
  - After: "He died of old age before his palace was done. Enemies carved it up into today's den of bandits and... Rogue Traders." {n}Cassia nods, done.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}As he finishes studying the cogitator and its faintly glinting, dusty vid-screens, Eogunn exhales a deep rumble of a sigh.{/n} "The vital functions of this blessed machine are on the verge of dying. I will do for it what lies within my power, yet this cogitator is a tragic testament to the fact that even the works of the Omnissiah are mortal."
  - After: {n}Eogunn sighs.{/n} "This machine is dying. Even the Omnissiah's works are mortal."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn's mechadendrite moves gently, almost tenderly, across the hull of the cogitator, releasing a few galvanic flashes.{/n} "The will of the Machine God has held back this device from the brink of death, Rogue Trader. Treat it gently."
  - After: {n}Eogunn's mechadendrite sparks over it.{/n} "The Machine God spared it. Treat it gently."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The screen flickers a few times before revealing to the world a text in Low Gothic:{/n} "In the name of the founder of Footfall Station, conqueror of stars, builder of outposts, the noblest {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Parsimus Dewain, and on behalf of all his descendants, I welcome you! This cogitator was installed on the order of the illustrious Parsimus so that the needy may tap into the flow of his wisdom. Cast your eyes upon the list of sections and choose what you wish to know!"
  - After: {n}Text appears:{/n} "In the name of Footfall's founder, the noble {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Parsimus Dewain, welcome! Choose a section!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's vox wheezes mournfully,{/n} "The spirit of this machine is enraged and will perform its function no more. I will see to it that the profaners responsible for its maintenance are marked for servo-penance."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's vox wheezes,{/n} "The spirit is enraged and dead. Its keepers deserve servo-penance."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's respirator lets out a mournful hiss before he says grimly,{/n} "The Rite of Operation has been repeatedly and blasphemously violated. Requesting the identification and punishment of the deplorable acolyte entrusted with caring for the spirit of this machine."
  - After: {n}Pasqal hisses.{/n} "The Rite of Operation was violated. Punish the acolyte responsible."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Praise the Omnissiah. The machine spirit of this cogitator is aggrieved but willing to serve." {n}Accompanied by the crackling of a binharic prayer, Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} gently place a couple of keys lying on the floor back into place.{/n}
  - After: "Praise the Omnissiah. The spirit will serve." {n}Pasqal's {g|Encyclopedia:Mechadendrite}mechadendrites{/g} replace fallen keys.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Greetings to you, keen wanderer who found my message and solved my riddle! I, Parsimus Dewain, master of Footfall, trailblazer of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}, am pleased to welcome visitors to my magnificent palace in the stars."
  - After: "Greetings, riddle-solver! I, Parsimus Dewain, master of Footfall, trailblazer of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}, welcome you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Footfall is my great creation. It is what marked the beginning of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s triumphant march into the Koronus Expanse. You are here because you managed to discover the message in the almanac of Footfall published on my orders and find the caches I had installed at select sites. You have seen the view from the dome of the Great Cathedral, the void-piercing arches of the Providence Bridge, the stars' cold gaze through the windows of the Small Quay. Only thus, step by step, can one experience the scale and the elegance of my creation."
  - After: "Footfall began the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s march into Koronus. You followed my almanac's message to my caches: the Cathedral dome, Providence Bridge, the Small Quay."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard's brow furrows.{/n} "Parsimus Dewain? I've never heard of such a Rogue Trader house..."
  - After: {n}Abelard frowns.{/n} "Parsimus Dewain? Never heard of him..."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Whoever this Parsimus was, he sure thought big!"
  - After: "This Parsimus sure thought big!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Atrium/RefugeesInTrouble/RefugeesInTrouble_Footfall_c2_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: [Raise your voice] "I am the judge of the worthless and the executioner of cowardice, for I come from the Officio Prefectus. Which one of you void rats just dared to address me without the proper respect?"
  - After: [Raise your voice] "I am judge and executioner, of the Officio Prefectus. Which void rat dared address me so?"

  - Before: "A concerned citizen. An armed one. I suggest you think well before giving me lip."
  - After: "A concerned, armed citizen. Think before giving me lip."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am the {mf|master|mistress} of Kiava Gamma, and if these people are my subjects, then I am the only one who can decide what to do with them. I command the onlookers to disperse, as for the rest of you — go to the docks and await further instructions."
  - After: "I am {mf|master|mistress} of Kiava Gamma; these are my subjects to judge. Onlookers, disperse. The rest, go to the docks and wait."

  - Before: "I represent the von Valancius, masters of Kiava Gamma, and thus I have the right to decide what to do with these people. I command the onlookers to disperse, as for the rest of you — go to Dock Alpha-Rho and await further instructions."

  - After: "Onlookers, go home. Refugees, go to Dock Alpha-Rho — I'll speak to you later. Comply or else."

  - Before: [Nod at the rabble-rousers in the crowd] "The people before you insult those instated by the Throne to be above them, and thus they deserve death."
  - After: [Nod at the rabble-rousers] "They insult their Throne-appointed betters. They deserve death."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the refugee] "Those are serious accusations you're spouting. I hope you have proof to back them up."
  - After: [Address the refugee] "Serious accusations. Got proof?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The buzzing crowd has closed in on several harried-looking individuals. Some of their faces are smeared with fresh blood. The angry cries and twisted faces leave no doubt — a massacre is about to take place.{/n}
  - After: {n}A crowd corners several bloodied people. A massacre looms.{/n}
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "No, no cutting! We get their blood on us, we'll be tainted too! Better burn 'em!"
  - After: "No cutting! Their blood taints! Burn 'em!"
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "Be quiet, you scoundrel!" {n}A priest, clad in a simple black raiment, cuts through the crowd like a voidship crossing the sky.{/n} "You dare pass judgement on others? What arrogance, to think you have the right!"
  - After: "Quiet, scoundrel!" {n}A black-clad priest pushes through.{/n} "You dare judge others?"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "And what makes you think we'll listen to you? Maybe you're one of them, here to help out your heretic buddies, huh?"
  - After: "Why listen to you? Maybe you're a heretic too!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: {n}The rabble-rouser turns to you and bows deeply.{/n} "Don't you worry none, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We'll go with these... people, we'll watch them and make sure they keep their traps shut about you!"
  - After: {n}He bows deeply.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! We'll keep them quiet!"
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "The arrogance and self-righteousness of a malefactor..." {n}The priest shakes his head disapprovingly. Then his eyes shift to you.{/n} "I am Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, head of the {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusian{/g} mission here on Footfall. I thank you for stepping in. Please come see me when you have the time — we can talk then."
  - After: "Malefactor." {n}He turns to you.{/n} "I am Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusian{/g} mission head. Thank you. Visit me."
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "Reverend! But these are heretics! Real heretics! Their whole planet is plagued, folks say they all died over there, and why is that, huh? 'Cause they're heretics, and the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} punished them!"

- **Refugee**
  - Before: "We're no heretics!" {n}One of the people surrounded by the crowd raises his chin.{/n} "We ran from the heretics, barely escaped with our lives! And there was no plague on our planet — only the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s minions, a whole army of them!" {n}He spits on the ground.{/n} "And if you want to blame anyone — blame those who abandoned our world!   - After: "We fled heretics!" {n}A refugee bristles.{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}'s army, not plague! Blame the governor, the {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g}, Kiava Gamma's masters!" {n}He spits.{/n}
- **Instigator**
  - Before: {n}Several dozen gazes bore into you.{/n} "And who are you s'posed to be?"
  - After: {n}Dozens stare.{/n} "And who are you?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "There is one guy, I bet you've heard of him — his name's Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius. He ran from us not too long ago, after having his ass handed to him. He must be itching to get even."
  - After: "Kunrad Voigtvir von Valancius, maybe. We beat him. He'll want revenge."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Get even by besmirching the dynasty to which he belongs and supremacy over which he laid claim? He is scum, but he's no idiot. No, I think this is something else. There are many who wish to weaken House von Valancius."
  - After: "Smear his own dynasty? He's scum, not stupid. Many want us weakened."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Either that or it's much simpler — these people aren't lying and their planet was captured by heretics, and the rest of it they made up themselves. I can sense darkness in their past. I may not be an expert on Kunrads and their schemes, but when it comes to things like this — I know what I'm talking about."
  - After: "Or heretics took their planet and they invented the rest. I sense darkness in them."
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "Plagued or not, victims of heretics or actual heretics — how are we to know? Let's just cut their throats. Better safe than sorry!"
  - After: "Plagued or heretic, who knows? Cut their throats to be safe!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: {n}The rabble-rouser laughs uproariously.{/n} "And I'm Incendia Chorda! Cut the guff. {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}Her Ladyship Theodora{/d} is head of the von Valancius line, I saw her with my own eyes when she came to Footfall! And you don't look much like her!"
  - After: {n}He laughs.{/n} "And I'm Incendia Chorda! {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}Lady Theodora{/d} heads the von Valancius. You're not her!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: {n}The rabble-rouser's expression changes completely, and he makes a clumsy attempt at a bow, then crumples to his knees.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}{/d}! I'm s-sorry! Sorry for not recognising you! Y-you see, it's... it's just that... it's your first time on Footfall, and... we didn't know..." {n}Terrified, he falls silent.{/n}
  - After: {n}He drops to his knees.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}{/d}! S-sorry!" {n}He falls silent.{/n}
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "You better stay out of this, or we'll get you too. And you, Reverend — you can look away or whatever while we handle this!"
  - After: "Stay out or you're next. Look away, Reverend!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "We were just, uh... rooting out heresy here. These scrawny ones, they're from the ship that came from the bowels of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. They've got plague there! And mutants! And now they're spreading that rot everywhere, that taint! They're all—"
  - After: "Their ship came from the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}. Plague, mutants, taint!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}come from Lady Theodora{/d}?" {n}The rabble-rouser bows his head respectfully.{/n} "Pardon me, noble {mf|sir|lady}."
  - After: "You {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}come from Lady Theodora{/d}?" {n}He bows.{/n} "Pardon, {mf|sir|lady}."
- **Instigator**
  - Before: {n}The rabble-rouser gives you an appraising look.{/n} "You've got a point there. I wonder if you can back it up..."
  - After: {n}He sizes you up.{/n} "Can you back that up?"
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "Silence! You must be completely out of your minds. A band of woefully dim-witted reprobates who think themselves bringers of justice! Who are you to pass judgement on anyone? All you ought to be doing is suffering and repenting till the end of your days!"
  - After: "Silence! Dim-witted reprobates playing judge! Repent instead!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "And what's so wrong about that, Reverend? We just want to put these heretics to death."
  - After: "What's wrong, Reverend? We just want heretics dead."
- **Refugee**
  - Before: "We're not heretics!" {n}The haggard man is on the verge of tears.{/n} "We're refugees! I swear it on the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} — we served the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} faithfully until they hung us out to dry! Where were the protectors that were meant to shield the lands of Humanity from nightmares? Traitors! Traitors and heretics, the lot of them!"
  - After: "We're refugees!" {n}He nears tears.{/n} "By the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g}, we served the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}! It abandoned us!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "Hey, you lot heard what {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} said? Get to the docks!"
  - After: "You heard {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}! Docks!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: {n}The rabble-rouser looks at you morosely.{/n} "I don't want to get in trouble over this lot..."
  - After: {n}He sulks.{/n} "I don't want trouble..."
- **Refugee**
  - Before: "What more proof do I need?" {n}the man shouts.{/n} "Kiava Gamma used to be a prosperous world, my family transported goods from there for generations! And then they came. And they even reached us in our ship with some blight that made half our crew take their own lives! We barely escaped, we barely made it here... Why? Why did this happen to us?"
  - After: "Proof?" {n}he shouts.{/n} "Kiava Gamma was prosperous. Then they came, sacrificing whole blocks to darkness! Half the wardens joined them. A blight drove half our crew to suicide! Why us?"

  - Before: "I wonder what all this is about. Is our planet really under attack? Or did some devious opportunist send these slanderers here to undermine the might of the von Valancius dynasty? Who could it be, I wonder..."
  - After: "Is our planet attacked? Or are these slanderers sent to undermine us?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}None of the people dare defy you. They back away carefully, trying not to look at you.{/n}
  - After: {n}They back away, eyes down.{/n}
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "Filth and vileness in each and every one of them." {n}The priest shakes his head disapprovingly.{/n} "I am Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, head of the Drusian mission here on Footfall.   - After: "Filth." {n}The priest frowns.{/n} "I am Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, Drusian mission head. Your fury is hollow. Visit me."
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "Sure, you say you're a von Valancius envoy, but void knows if it's true. Just stay out of this. You too, priest!"
  - After: "Envoy? Says you. Stay out. You too, priest!"
- **Instigator**
  - Before: "Just cut their throats already! What were they thinking letting that ship dock at Footfall — they're all stricken!"
  - After: "Cut their throats! They're all stricken!"
- **Refugee**
  - Before: {n}The refugees use the interruption to make off in the direction of Dock Alpha-Rho.{/n}
  - After: {n}The refugees slip off to Dock Alpha-Rho.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Seeing that the crowd's attention is distracted, the refugees from Kiava Gamma make a run for the docks.{/n}
  - After: {n}The refugees flee for the docks.{/n}
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "Go on, then! Wreak your depravity! The Emperor already sees all the rot and baseness that reign in your souls, and I place my hopes in His judgement!"
  - After: "Go on! Let the Emperor judge your rotten souls!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Mob justice is not that rare a sight on Footfall. Why is that sanctimonious priest acting so surprised?" {n}Jae gives the crowd an unusually grim look.{/n} "Few people go to the trouble of looking more deeply into things..."
  - After: "Mob justice is common here. Why's the priest surprised?" {n}Jae looks grim.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A murmur runs through the crowd. The people gawk at you, at the priest, at the wretched group huddling in the centre.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd murmurs, staring.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta starts at the sight of the elderly priest.{/n} "That's Reverend Hieronymus! I'm surprised he's decided to intervene in a street squabble..."
  - After: {n}Argenta starts.{/n} "Reverend Hieronymus! Odd he'd intervene..."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I hope you don't plan on letting this insult to your house slide!" {n}Abelard is glaring at the crowd before you, furious.{/n}
  - After: "Don't let this insult slide!" {n}Abelard glares.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "How tiring... The motley sea of colours that fills this restless crowd is hard on the eyes. So many hues, but most of them are acid yellow streaks of fear, their red buds swelling, ready to burst and paint all who are gathered here." {n}Cassia looks at the crowd of troublemakers wearily, and they shudder at the very sight of her.{/n}
  - After: "How tiring... Acid-yellow fear everywhere." {n}The troublemakers shudder at Cassia.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "As for the hearts of those who have been forced to defend themselves, they are shrouded in purplish-black grief, but their words are as transparent as the ice that lies at the top of a glacier. But commoners are always deaf to others' suffering, for such is their nature. Interfering in their affairs is hardly worthy of you or me, {name}."
  - After: "The accused grieve, and speak true. Beneath us, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The crowd shrinks away from your booming voice as if physically struck — although that isn't far from the truth. They avert their eyes and cower under your burning gaze as it sweeps over the gathered riffraff. Finally, one trembling rabble-rouser is pushed forward.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd cowers. A trembling rabble-rouser is shoved forward.{/n}

  - Before: "Only those who have violated the Lex Imperialis, their accomplices, and possible contacts — their names, features, and the locations of potential hideouts. An Arbitrator who cannot instantly identify a dangerous criminal or their associates is useless."

I know every one of you, and I would be astonished to discover anyone here who truly mourns this loss."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Atrium/UnderworldQuest/DeadPirate/DeadPirate_Footfall_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "This is very grand for a pirate's funeral. Is this normal for Footfall?"
  - After: "A grand funeral for a pirate. Normal for Footfall?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Whoever prepared the body of the grey-haired man lying in the coffin, they did a good job — even in death he looks majestic.{/n}
  - After: {n}The grey-haired corpse looks majestic.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}Solomorne looks at the dead man's face and says sternly,{/n} "Jerrycan Denz, a pirate. Wanted for countless robberies and attacks on trade vessels. He was never caught assaulting tithe ships, but the Arbites still added his name to the list of high-risk suspects, with a note stating, 'Elimination recommended.'"
  - After: {n}Solomorne, sternly:{/n} "Jerrycan Denz, pirate. Countless raids on trade vessels. Arbites file: 'Elimination recommended.'"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Now I remember. Reverend Hieronymus mentioned the name Master Bellardo as one of the biggest donors to the temple."
  - After: "I remember! Reverend Hieronymus named Master Bellardo a top temple donor."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Folks on Footfall are known to turn a blind eye to many things, but even the locals aren't so unscrupulous as to honour pirate scum a few paces away from the Liege's residence. But no one has heard of Denz for so many decades... I barely recognised him myself, and I've seen his face on picts a fair few times back then. I assume he retired and started a more or less honest life under a new name. What was it they were calling him? Master Bellardo?"
  - After: "Footfall wouldn't honour pirate scum by the Liege's residence. But Denz vanished decades ago, likely retiring under a new name. Master Bellardo?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard maintains a grave expression befitting the occasion — until he sees the face of the deceased. He frowns. He peers at it with suspicion. Then he gasps, astonished, almost dazed.{/n} "I'll be! This is quite the meeting... if it can be called such, under the circumstances."
  - After: {n}Abelard sees the face and gasps.{/n} "I'll be! Quite the reunion..."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Do I! I would tell you all about this man, but the words I'd use would be improper for a funeral! This, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, is Jerrycan Denz, known back in the day as one of the most notorious pirates in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}."
  - After: "Do I! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, this is Jerrycan Denz, once the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}'s most notorious pirate."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "They nicknamed him 'Jerrycan' for his habit of having a jug or two of {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} on hand — he did love burning things. Oh yes, he was a menace back then... how long ago was it? Sixty years ago? I was serving my last days in the Navy when news came of his latest attack..."
  - After: "'Jerrycan' for his {g|Encyclopedia:Promethium}promethium{/g} — he loved burning things. A menace, sixty years back, near my Navy's end..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It's hard to glean anything from the deceased's appearance apart from the fact that he must have been wealthy — his clothes look expensive, and his {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} are new and rare.{/n}
  - After: {n}He was clearly wealthy: expensive clothes, rare new {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g}.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard distractedly runs a hand through his hair.{/n} "Well, well... There was a time when the sight of Jerrycan in a coffin would have been enough to make me dance. Quite literally! By the Throne, I would have danced a jig on the spot! But now... I don't know. No more jumping into the warp right from under the cruiser's nose, eh, you old beast? Who would've thought I'd be at your funeral..."
  - After: {n}Abelard rubs his hair.{/n} "Once I'd have danced a jig. Now... No more slipping into the warp under our guns, eh, you old beast?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His face seems unfamiliar at first... but then a realisation strikes you. Age has greatly changed this man's features, but you've seen him before — on picts and posters saying, "Wanted: Highly Dangerous Pirate." Decades ago, the one who is currently lying before you in a coffin used to go by the name Jerrycan Denz and was known as one of the most infamous pirates in the Koronus Expanse.{/n}
  - After: {n}Then you recognise him from old wanted posters: Jerrycan Denz, infamous Koronus Expanse pirate.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}After a pause, he adds, with feeling,{/n} "The bastard escaped justice after all."
  - After: {n}He adds, bitterly,{/n} "The bastard escaped justice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} left in the deceased's body speak of his high standing — expensive tech is typically extracted from the dead, and only the most prominent and wealthy avoid this fate upon their death.{/n}
  - After: {n}His {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} weren't harvested: a sign of great wealth and standing.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Atrium/UnderworldQuest/PirateChaplain/PirateChaplain_Footfall_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Not long before his death, Denz mentioned something about 'dead eyes' looking at him."
  - After: "Before he died, Denz spoke of 'dead eyes' watching him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Given your speech during the ceremony, I take it you're not fond of the other attendees."
  - After: "From your speech, you don't like the other attendees."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So you think this woman is our Fidelio?"
  - After: "So this woman is our Fidelio?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "A question, if I may — how was it that an Ecclesiarchy missionary came to be a friend and associate of a famous pirate?"
  - After: "How did an Ecclesiarchy missionary befriend a famous pirate?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "There's an entry in the book of remembrance about repentance. The writing looks fresh. Could Fidelio have left it?"
  - After: "There's a fresh entry about repentance in the book of remembrance. Could Fidelio have written it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have serious reason to suspect that someone here wanted to kill Fidelio."
  - After: "I suspect someone here wanted Fidelio dead."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Call all the parties involved. It is time to discuss the matter of the will."
  - After: "Call all parties. Time to discuss the will."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I think I need more time. I'll get back to you."
  - After: "I need more time. I'll get back to you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So Bellardo has left all his worldly possessions to a certain Fidelio. Who is this mysterious person?"
  - After: "Bellardo left everything to some Fidelio. Who is that?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have a strong suspicion that someone here wants me dead."
  - After: "I suspect someone here wants me dead."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Maybe Fidelio will make themselves known once Denz's will is made public?"
  - After: "Maybe Fidelio will appear once Denz's will is public?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Truth be told, I don't even know myself."
  - After: "Truth be told, I don't know myself."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Thank you for speaking with me. I must go."
  - After: "Thank you. I must go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "On the matter of the inheritance... when can I claim it?"
  - After: "The inheritance... when can I claim it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "No, I did not. I came here by chance."
  - After: "No. I came here by chance."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It's an item of some sort, and probably one of great value. A weapon, possibly."
  - After: "An item, probably valuable. A weapon, maybe."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let's go over everything we know. Denz supposedly left his possessions to Fidelio — a woman who wanted to take revenge on him for killing the captain of the ship Repentance. The word Repentance is written in the book of remembrance, and the entry is new. Does this mean that our Fidelio is somewhere close by?"
  - After: "Recap: Denz left everything to Fidelio, a woman who sought revenge for his killing the captain of the Repentance. 'Repentance' is freshly written in the book. Is Fidelio nearby?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It could be a name — the name of a ship, for example."
  - After: "It could be a name — a ship's, say."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I don't know just yet."
  - After: "I don't know yet."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I think I might know the answer."
  - After: "I might know the answer."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Clearly it's his desire to atone for his past."
  - After: "His desire to atone for his past."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The influence of a warp entity. It settled in Denz's home and poisoned his mind."
  - After: "A warp entity in Denz's home poisoned his mind."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to intervene in the matter of the inheritance left by Master Bellardo."
  - After: "I wish to intervene in Master Bellardo's inheritance."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would like to discuss with you what I've been able to uncover in regard to the mysterious Fidelio."
  - After: "Let's discuss what I've uncovered about Fidelio."
- **Player**
  - Before: "That is all I've been able to learn so far."
  - After: "That's all I've learned so far."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Well, it looks like we've cleared up the Repentance part."
  - After: "So that explains the Repentance."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Up close, Chaplain leaves an even stronger impression — a tall, burly man, whose face and hands bear numerous scars. His entire visage seems to tell the story of many heretics who met their end upon their encounter with this adept of true faith.{/n}
  - After: {n}Chaplain: tall, burly, scarred.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Chaplain gives you a friendly nod, but his gaze is intense, like he's trying to get a sense of who you are.{/n} "Pleasure to meet you, {mf|Master|Mistress} Fidelio. I prefer to go by Chaplain — it is both my name and my occupation."
  - After: {n}Chaplain nods, studying you.{/n} "{mf|Master|Mistress} Fidelio. Call me Chaplain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Chaplain gives you a respectful nod.{/n} "May Saint Drusus protect you from illness and misfortune. I'm surprised to see a noble figure such as yourself here. Did you know Denz? I mean, Master Bellardo."
  - After: {n}Chaplain nods.{/n} "Saint Drusus protect you. Did you know Denz — Master Bellardo?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I didn't, that's for sure. I can't imagine what he meant by it."
  - After: "Not me. I can't imagine what he meant."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - Before: "And the ones he robbed were mostly types that no true subject of the Imperium would shed a tear over. {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}Xenos{/g}, heretics. Not all of them, of course... but the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} will judge if Denz was a decent man."

  - Before: "Let me just ask you — are you sure you're ready to resolve everything now? Maybe you'd like to talk to all sides, form your own opinion of the claimants? Find out who Fidelio is, if nothing else?"
