  - After: {n}It burns like acid. You cough blood.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana looks at you in worry.{/n} "Throne have mercy, are you all right, {mf|sir|ma'am}? You shouldn't have ordered the octane blend — I've got something else set aside for folks with a more refined palate..."
  - After: {n}Octaviana looks worried.{/n} "Throne, all right, {mf|sir|ma'am}? Try something more refined..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana chuckles.{/n} "What makes you say that? Do you know where you're standing? On the deck of the Martyr's Endurance, a sacred vessel that once belonged to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g}! A hundred years ago, the bureaucrats sent a mission here to establish a department, set up some kind of record-keeping, overhaul Footfall, and make everything here follow a billion laws to the letter. As you can see, it was the Martyr's Endurance and its inhabitants that got overhauled in the end. I don't know what happened to them, but the locals like to come here to make deals and count their money like before, in this temple of the Imperium's accountants. Over there, you can see even the sign's been preserved... partially."
  - After: {n}She chuckles.{/n} "This is the Martyr's Endurance, an {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g} ship sent a century ago to bring Footfall to law. Footfall won."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This one might interest you — a tale I heard from a tipsy voidborn from a cargo barge. They exited the warp halfway between Furibundus and the Aviorus System and came upon a shuttle wreck adrift. The shuttle was registered to the Inevitable Triumph — a merchant ship that disappeared decades ago. She was bound for Footfall, her cargo holds brimming with valuable goods, but she never made it. If anything at all survived the shipwreck, it could be quite the lucky find!"
  - After: "A voidborn found a shuttle wreck between Furibundus and the Aviorus System, from the Inevitable Triumph — a merchant ship lost decades ago, holds full. Could be a find!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That's right. There are far more Kasballican agents in the Expanse than most people think. We prefer to operate discreetly, it's as simple as that. Why reveal the entire network when you can do business through a few public contacts? Vladaym used to represent our interests on Footfall. Now our leadership wants me to become the face of our organisation."
  - After: "Yes. Kasballican agents are everywhere, discreetly. Vladaym was our face on Footfall. Now I am."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We are a business enterprise, not a blood fraternity. In a situation where one Rogue Trader is encroaching upon our assets, we would rather secure the support of another house than feud with it. And Vladaym's death makes no difference."
  - After: "We're a business, not a blood fraternity. With another Rogue Trader encroaching, we'd rather ally with you. Vladaym's death changes nothing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You protected the interests of our organisation on Footfall by {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaDead}ridding us{/d} of Chorda's dictatorship. That means a great deal more to the Kasballica than Vladaym's death. We are a business enterprise, not a blood fraternity."
  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaDead}Ridding us{/d} of Chorda outweighs Vladaym's death. We're a business, not a blood fraternity."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana offers you a clear glass — probably the clearest one in this entire establishment. The cold water is odourless — something many Footfall residents have never experienced in their whole lives.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cold, odourless water — a Footfall rarity.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If you're looking for the relics of the Saint Drusus mission, talk to Chaplain. After the reverend's death, he became the Drusian leader of sorts here on Footfall. The reliquary will surely be safe under his watch — the man is as hard as plasteel."
  - After: "For the Saint Drusus relics, see Chaplain. He leads the Drusians since the reverend died."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Silence falls over the room. The patrons' expressions are solemn, respectful, and mournful. After an appropriate pause, a voidsman says in a deep, resounding voice,{/n} "A safe journey to the fallen, and a long life to House von Valancius."
  - After: {n}Solemn silence. A voidsman intones,{/n} "Safe journey to the fallen; long life to House von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Come to think of it, his fall was only a matter of time. He let his guard down and started making mistakes. He signed his own death warrant when he decided to go against Chorda instead of looking for ways to negotiate. What you did was just the finishing touch."
  - After: "He got careless and fought Chorda instead of negotiating. You just finished him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana shrugs sullenly.{/n} "I don't know if Footfall even needs the Amasecus anymore. I might have to close up shop and start some new business. But the enforcers don't bother us anymore — Vladaym was the problem. He forgot he was a smuggler and started playing the rebel."
  - After: {n}She shrugs.{/n} "I might close up. The enforcers leave us alone now — Vladaym forgot he was a smuggler and played rebel."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A deafening wave of jubilation washes over the room. From every direction, you hear shouts of praise for you and House von Valancius. Octaviana joins in while readying bottles and tankards — she knows what will happen the moment you leave the bar.{/n}
  - After: {n}The room erupts in cheers for you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As for old Ryzza, I have good news for you. Yes, she passed on, but her hoards of plunder are still on Footfall. One numbskull from her crew is always hanging about the bar. You should talk to him. You'll recognise him by his daft way of speaking and his stuttering."
  - After: "Old Ryzza's dead, but her plunder's still on Footfall. A stuttering numbskull from her crew hangs about the bar. Talk to him."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's respirator hisses quietly, and he says in an insinuating tone,{/n} "The alchemical composition of this substance is known to me. But never before have I come across such an unusual application. An exquisite path of martyrdom in honour of the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's respirator hisses.{/n} "An exquisite martyrdom for the {g|Encyclopedia:Omnissiah}Omnissiah{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The patrons make the sign of the Aquila and utter discordant prayers to the Emperor and expressions of their piety. The sincerity of their words is doubtful, but their awe and fear of your ire are quite convincing.{/n}
  - After: {n}Patrons make the Aquila — doubtful piety, real fear.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana's expression turns stony, and even her jaw prosthetic stops squeaking for a moment.{/n} "Heydari... My people found something in the sewer tunnels, something that once belonged to her. Please, {mf|sir|ma'am}, take this to remember Jae. I... I don't need keepsakes to raise a glass in that mad vixen's memory."
  - After: {n}Octaviana's face turns stony.{/n} "Heydari... We found something of hers in the sewers. Please, {mf|sir|ma'am}, take it to remember Jae. I'll drink to that mad vixen without it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana glances at Heinrix.{/n} "Judging by your company, I take it you're here for business rather than pleasure?"
  - After: {n}She glances at Heinrix.{/n} "Business, then?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I am merely tagging along this time around."
  - After: "I am merely tagging along."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix narrows his eyes.{/n} "I speak from personal experience, {name}. Don't."
  - After: {n}Heinrix narrows his eyes.{/n} "From experience, {name}. Don't."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She shrugs.{/n} "It's the best Footfall has to offer. Especially if you know what you're looking for."
  - After: {n}She shrugs.{/n} "Footfall's best."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Octaviana's expression changes dramatically when she sees Kibellah.{/n} "You there. You should know that if I see one dead body around here, I'll have you thrown out of my bar with a hole in your head. Your kind don't scare me, and I'm not about to let you ruin my business by leaving corpses all over the room. You being here is already making half my clients feel less thirsty."
  - After: {n}She glares at Kibellah.{/n} "One body here and you're out with a hole in your head. You're scaring off my clients."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "I have heard your threat. Do not fear: if I must kill someone here, you will not find the bodies."
  - After: "If I kill here, you will not find the bodies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Life is better than ever, thanks to you. At least, it is if you can stand up for yourself, or if you're useful to Vladaym. I guess that's not what you wanted to hear — you were hoping I'd say that the supplies have found their way into the empty bellies of the hungry and all is right with the world, yes? But let's be realistic — who's the food going to first? That's right, not the poor starving folk, but the people with the heaviest pockets and the loudest guns. Whoever's got their arse perched highest on the pole. Or who knows which arse to kiss..."
  - After: "Better, thanks to you — for the strong and Vladaym's friends. Food goes to the loudest guns, not the starving."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her face drops when she notices Solomorne.{/n} "First time I've seen an Arbitrator walk into our establishment. I doubt you're here to wet your whistle, so I'll lay it out for you: we don't have any Lex violators in here, just simple, modest folks who need a drink."
  - After: {n}Her face drops at Solomorne.{/n} "An Arbitrator? No Lex violators here, just thirsty folk."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "You can relax. If I were here to detain someone, this conversation would have started with a flash grenade and some suppressive fire."
  - After: "Relax. An arrest would've started with a flash grenade."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "Side effects: optic nerve damage, heart rhythm disruption, coma..." {n}Eogunn offhandedly lists the potential consequences.{/n} "Nuncius and I will prepare the resuscitation rituals. I believe that upon consuming this substance, an unforgettable transcendent experience awaits you."
  - After: "Side effects: blindness, arrhythmia, coma..." {n}Eogunn lists offhandedly.{/n} "We'll prepare resuscitation rituals."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You like it? I'm flattered. It's not often that we get important visitors here, and it's even less often that they really appreciate this place."
  - After: "Flattering. Important visitors rarely appreciate it."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta stops Octaviana's torrent of adoration with a calm gesture.{/n} "No more. I seek retribution against transgressors, not glory for myself." {n}Despite her words, you catch a glint in Argenta's eyes — you can tell she is enjoying this enraptured attention.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta raises a hand.{/n} "Enough. I seek retribution, not glory." {n}Yet she's enjoying it.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Haven't been to our fine station for a while, have you, {mf|sir|ma'am}? As per usual, there's never a dull moment. Either someone's getting shot in a square, or some rich guy's going on a safari to hunt commoners in the Shadow Quarters. Sure, the Liege makes sure that the local shenanigans don't get in the way of business on the station, but what happens on the outskirts adds a little spice to our lives."
  - After: "Never dull, {mf|sir|ma'am}: shootings, rich folk hunting commoners in the Shadow Quarters. The Liege just protects business."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} is always with us, {mf|sir|ma'am}. Did you even see the statue outside? It's kinda hard to miss. The thing is visible through every crack. The Immortal One watches over us, and since He hasn't yet blown this sorry excuse for a station to smithereens — and this bar along with it — I guess it suits Him just fine."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} is always with us, {mf|sir|ma'am} — see the statue? He hasn't blown us up yet, so it suits Him."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Cantina/JaeHasAnOfferForYou/JaeHasAnOfferForYou_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave."
  - After: "I must go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am {name}, trade envoy of House von Valancius."
  - After: "{name}, trade envoy of House von Valancius."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Remind me, what is your predicament?"
  - After: "Remind me of your predicament?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm not interested."
  - After: "Not interested."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If the Liege is neglecting his duties, I shall become your patron."
  - After: "If the Liege won't, I'll be your patron."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What can you offer in terms of payment?"
  - After: "What's the payment?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What kind of cargo was stolen from you?"
  - After: "What cargo was stolen?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you asking an upstanding citizen to be party to the trafficking of xeno-artefacts?"
  - After: "You want me trafficking xeno-artefacts?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I should have you executed on the spot for such a suggestion! Your cargo is nothing but foul xenoheresy!"
  - After: "I should execute you! Your cargo is xenoheresy!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to ask you a few questions before I decide."
  - After: "I have questions first."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I suspect that Vladaym wants to keep the cargo out of your hands. And I want to put him in his place."
  - After: "Vladaym wants the cargo kept from you. I'll put him in his place."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Actually, I'm here for you, Jae. I would like to see you in my retinue."
  - After: "I'm here for you, Jae. Join my retinue."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How is life treating you, Jae?"
  - After: "How's life, Jae?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "So far, you have shown me nothing but bluster. Prove your usefulness. Now."
  - After: "All bluster. Prove your usefulness. Now."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Have we met somewhere before?" {n}The woman looks at you with the glassy eyes of a drunk, and you notice the two empty bottles that had been keeping her company before you arrived. She looks completely out of place in this dingy, smoky bar. The fancy attire, the abundance of jewellery, the {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} plated with precious metals — her appearance not only screams wealth, but also audacity, for only an audacious person would flaunt their wealth in a place like this.{/n}
  - After: "Have we met?" {n}A glassy-eyed drunk in finery and gilded {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g}, brazenly rich in this dive.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You see, shereen... There's one cardinal rule on Footfall — anything goes as long as it doesn't get in the way of business. I'm someone who's been able to exploit that rule to the fullest, and in recent years I've hit it so big I've become a speck of sand in someone's green eye. They used to throw small wrenches into my dealings here and there, but now they've decided to really put their backs into it. Some rat's stolen my cargo and dragged it off to the seediest part of the Shadow Quarters — a crummy place, even for connoisseurs of Footfall's unique atmosphere."
  - After: "I've done too well on Footfall, shereen, and made enemies. A rat stole my cargo into the Shadow Quarters' worst corner."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, honey to my ears! A balm to a spurned soul!" {n}Jae gracefully tosses her jet-black hair out of her face and gives you a beaming smile.{/n} "I knew the God-Emperor would bring us together right when you needed my services! Me and my talents are at your complete disposal."
  - After: "Honey to my ears!" {n}Jae beams.{/n} "The God-Emperor brought us together! My talents are yours."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Life? What kind of life can a distressed servant of the Exalted One have, left at the mercy of Footfall's slavering dogs? My situation is still precarious, shereen... and I'm still desperate for help, for which I'm willing to pay handsomely."
  - After: "Still precarious, shereen. I'll pay handsomely for help."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Right... Here, that's where those ashmags are keeping the stolen cargo. Out the bar, over the bridge, and to the left — there, in the depths, you'll find a small courtyard through which you can get to the place. I'll be waiting nearby — you can come when it suits you, but the sooner you do, the better. I'll see you then, shereen!"
  - After: "Out the bar, over the bridge, left, through a small courtyard. I'll wait nearby, shereen!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "When I asked the Liege for protection, we had a mutual misunderstanding. I believe Vladaym, in a most lamentable fashion, has forgotten his duties as guardian of the downtrodden and wronged... so I'm in desperate need of a new one. And you, shereen, fit the bill perfectly. All I need is for you to drop by one dark corner of Footfall's Shadow Quarters and pound it into the thieves' heads that taking Heydari's property carries certain risks."
  - After: "The Liege refused me protection, so I need a new patron — you, shereen. Teach the thieves in the Shadow Quarters that robbing Heydari is risky."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Of course, I am aware that my personal means cannot compare to yours, shereen, so I do not hope to impress you with money. But I can offer something else — my boundless knowledge! Surely you will appreciate the services of an expert on trading operations. Where I'm from, they call this kind of deal 'wisdom selling.'"
  - After: "My money can't impress you, shereen. But my trading expertise can. 'Wisdom selling,' we call it."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I have heard a great deal about how... open-minded the members of the von Valancius dynasty are. And Lady Theodora especially."
  - After: "I hear the von Valancius are open-minded. Lady Theodora especially."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae appears to be a serious operator on Footfall. The Liege's refusal to help means the loss of a potential ally. So Jae is encroaching on his turf. If Vladaym is not responsible for the disappearance of Jae's cargo, he will certainly benefit greatly from it.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae encroaches on the Liege's turf. Vladaym profits from her loss.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It seems Jae is too minor a player for someone in the Liege's position to devote any attention to her problems.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae is too minor for the Liege.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Goods of incredible rarity, shereen. But it's not just that — two dozen of my people lost their lives in the impenetrable emptiness of the void to acquire them. I cannot leave their families with nothing."
  - After: "Incredibly rare goods, shereen. Two dozen of my people died for them. Their families need paying."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ordinary smugglers do not dress so ostentatiously or behave so brazenly, and they are unlikely to spoil the mood of the Liege of Footfall with their mere appearance. This woman lost many people to obtain these "rarest of goods," and to get them back, she turned to Vladaym Tocara, the patron of all Cold Trade in the Expanse. Her cargo can be nothing other than xeno-artefacts — creations of the enemies of Humanity, branded with heresy.{/n}
  - After: {n}She sought Vladaym Tocara, patron of the Cold Trade. Her cargo must be heretical xeno-artefacts.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A simple and obvious thought occurs to you: the ostentatious outfit, the deliberately brash behaviour, the tales about valuable cargo — it is all smoke and mirrors. Most likely, Jae is a small-time smuggler eager to latch onto a bigger fish. She failed with Vladaym and now she has set her sights on you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Smoke and mirrors. Jae's a small-time smuggler who failed with Vladaym and now targets you.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I thought we were on the same page from the start, shereen. Please accept my sincerest apologies if that is not the case, and allow me to explain myself."
  - After: "I thought we understood each other, shereen. Let me explain."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "If I had told you directly, you would have become... shall we say, complicit. But since those illicit words did not escape my lips, you would hypothetically be agreeing merely to help me recapture a few containers. And if the azhi suddenly decided to thwart our plans, then all the void dogs would be unleashed on me alone. My sincerest wish was to protect you from any unnecessary trouble, shereen. I swear by the Exalted One!"
  - After: "Unsaid, you stay blameless; if the azhi object, they hunt only me. I swear it, shereen!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Should I take that as a no?"
  - After: "So that's a no?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "A fair deal, shereen." {n}Bridled excitement simmers in Jae's eyes.{/n} "If your heart desires, we'll split the recovered cargo... fifty-fifty. That will be fair. But if goods of incredible rarity do not interest you, then I'll make it worth your while with some bonds equal in value to a couple of full holds."
  - After: "Fair, shereen." {n}Her eyes gleam.{/n} "We split the cargo fifty-fifty. Or bonds worth a couple of full holds."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Ask as many as you wish, shereen. Trust is the key to a successful endeavour."
  - After: "Ask away, shereen. Trust is key."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix coughs and says quickly and quietly,{/n} "She's a Cold Trader, a smuggler who deals in xenos artefacts. Apart from this heresy, I know of no other grave crimes committed by her."
  - After: {n}Heinrix, quietly:{/n} "A Cold Trader in xenos artefacts. No other grave crimes I know of."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Her dark eyes light up with keen interest.{/n} "You truly know how to do business, shereen! You demand payment before giving an answer because you're aware of the weakness of my position... I respect that. And I don't know if it's the alcohol talking or just a feeling I have, but I want to take that risk with you."
  - After: {n}Her eyes light up.{/n} "You know business, shereen! Pressing my weak position... I respect that. I'll risk it with you."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae salutes you with her glass in greeting.{/n} "Shereen! Glad to see you in good health! Have you, perchance, been moved from indifference to sympathy already? With regard to my predicament and all."
  - After: {n}Jae raises her glass.{/n} "Shereen! Moved to sympathy yet?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}She reaches into her polished boot and produces a small package, which she offers to you.{/n} "True jewels are meant to be held in the hands of the worthiest, shereen. Please, accept this humble gift." {n}Jae smiles mysteriously and takes a sip of her fragrant drink.{/n}
  - After: {n}She pulls a package from her boot.{/n} "Jewels for the worthiest, shereen." {n}She smiles.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae's eyes lose some of their lustre.{/n} "That's too bad... too bad. Well, in that case, thank you for listening to the tragic tale of a lady down on her luck. If you happen to change your mind, I'll be around here somewhere... actually, probably right here." {n}Jae bids you goodbye and turns to the bar.{/n} "Hey, Octaviana! Get me another bottle!"
  - After: {n}Jae dims.{/n} "Too bad. I'll be right here if you change your mind." {n}She turns away.{/n} "Octaviana! Another bottle!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah narrows her eyes in contempt.{/n} "Your trade is heresy. Your every word and gesture reeks of vice. Vice is all you can peddle."
  - After: {n}Kibellah sneers.{/n} "Your trade is heresy. You peddle vice."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I've heard about a Heydari from Footfall, a local Cold Trader of little prominence." {n}The Proctor nods slightly to himself.{/n} "Not worth my time."
  - After: "Heydari — a minor Cold Trader." {n}The Proctor nods.{/n} "Not worth my time."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae's smile grows even more dazzling.{/n} "I do hope this cursory and altogether inappropriate character assessment from the distinguished Arbitrator will not hinder you from forming your own opinion of my many illustrious talents!"
  - After: {n}Jae's smile dazzles.{/n} "Judge my talents yourself, not by the Arbitrator's verdict!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}She smiles somewhat groggily as she examines you over the glass that is raised to her lips.{/n} "Greetings, shereen. With whom do I have the honour of speaking?"
  - After: {n}She eyes you groggily.{/n} "Greetings, shereen. And you are?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Jae Heydari, at your service. Professional trader, shrewd commercial broker, and — may azhi steal my tongue if I'm lying — the most honest dealer on Footfall. Nonetheless, we all have our problems, and at times even one's many merits aren't enough to solve them. Perhaps it would be no trouble for a person with your kind of power and standing to assist someone with my kind of predicament?"
  - After: "Jae Heydari: trader, broker, Footfall's most honest dealer. Might someone of your power help my predicament?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "May the Exalted One bless you and your progeny!" {n}Jae instantly pulls out a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g} and shows you a map of Footfall.{/n} "Then here's what we'll do. We shouldn't be seen together before we make it to the safe house. I'll head there first. I'll take my own special route so I won't be spotted."
  - After: "Exalted One bless you!" {n}Jae shows a map on a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}.{/n} "We mustn't be seen together. I'll go to the safe house first."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, shereen, wonderful to see you here! You're practically a regular at the Amasecus now — the local flavour is clearly to your taste." {n}Jae laughs and brings a glass of amber liquid to her lips.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, shereen! A regular at the Amasecus now!" {n}Jae laughs.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Better than the last time we met, shereen, may the Exalted One bless your path! However, it gets less and less comfortable for me on Footfall by the day — without the Liege's favour, this {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}-forgotten station is a rather dangerous place to be. Maybe I'll move somewhere far away, as soon as I figure out how to rid myself of some unwanted liabilities and offload some inconvenient goods..."
  - After: "Better, shereen! But without the Liege, this {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}-forgotten station is dangerous. I may leave once I offload some goods..."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Cantina/PirateVendorDialogue/PirateVendorDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Things are back to normal on Footfall, I see."
  - After: "Footfall's back to normal."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Who are these boys you work with?"
  - After: "Who are your boys?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let's see what you have to offer."
  - After: "Show me your wares."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pirates, in other words."
  - After: "Pirates, then."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What kinds of goods are you willing to buy?"
  - After: "What goods do you buy?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I better be going."
  - After: "I'd better go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How haven't you been arrested under Footfall's new patron? Have you not been approached by the confessors?"
  - After: "Why haven't the new patron's confessors arrested you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You seem to be at peace. Have you turned your back on heresy?"
  - After: "Have you turned from heresy?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Terribly noble of you!"
  - After: "How noble!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is that so? Very well, let's return to our discussion."
  - After: "Very well, back to business."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza falls silent, though her eyes don't leave your face. Her expression gradually shifts — from tactless interest to astonished deference.{/n} "I know you, {name}. Who would've thought a {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}high-flyer{/d} such as yourself would ever land in our neck of the woods... The audacious schemes you've pulled off, they're the stuff of legend — even the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g} could learn a thing or two. For somebody like you, I'll offer only the best prices. The real deal."
  - After: {n}Ryzza looks awed.{/n} "{name}! A {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}high-flyer{/d} who could teach the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}. Best prices for you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We call ourselves the Fellowship of the Void — an association of enterprising like-minded people who help the upstanding citizens of the Imperium rid themselves of the possessions that are weighing them down."
  - After: "The Fellowship of the Void. We relieve citizens of burdensome possessions."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza lowers her booming, raspy voice.{/n} "You heard about how the clipper Saint Cognatius got hit recently? The cargo was cleaned out, everything of value taken. Well, that was my boys' handiwork!"
  - After: {n}Ryzza lowers her voice.{/n} "The clipper Saint Cognatius got cleaned out? My boys!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She chuckles darkly.{/n} "Do you mean to threaten me, Tech-Priest? Well, then, I'll keep a record of this conversation, too. I wonder which of us will feel the harsh hand of justice first? Will it be me, standing in chains before your brethren, or you, standing in an airlock before my boys?"
  - After: {n}She chuckles.{/n} "Threats, Tech-Priest? Who goes first: me in chains, or you out an airlock?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I want to congratulate you on your initiative. {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymDead}Smacking Vladaym down{/d} in the moment of his triumph — that was a shrewd move. I think even he would see the poetic justice of it, if he wasn't currently floating headless in orbit with all the other fools whose luck ran out."
  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymDead}Smacking Vladaym down{/d} at his triumph — shrewd. Now he floats headless in orbit."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza nods solemnly.{/n} "It's a heavy burden, but someone's got to shoulder it, don't they? I'm glad you see where I'm coming from!"
  - After: {n}Ryzza nods solemnly.{/n} "Someone must bear the burden!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Tech is always the best. If it's broke — no sweat, we'll fix it or take it apart. And if you score something so nasty that your fussy everyday traders won't even look at it, fear not, just bring it on over. Leave it to me and my boys to find the right buyer!"
  - After: "Tech's best, broken or not. Too nasty for fussy traders? My boys will find a buyer!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And I'm almost used to the new leg." {n}She raps her knuckles on the augmetic.{/n} "It can break bones just like that, and it looks solid enough!"
  - After: "The new leg's good." {n}She raps the augmetic.{/n} "Breaks bones!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Nice doing business with you!"
  - After: "Nice doing business!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman looks to be in her forties, and she is surveying you with interest. Her right eye appears almost black against her dusky skin, while her left eye emits a greenish light filtered through the smudged lens of a prosthesis. Her arms are tattooed all the way from the base of her shoulders to her knuckles.{/n}
  - After: {n}A tattooed woman in her forties eyes you, one eye a green-glowing prosthesis.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I should also thank you for finally {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_HieronimusDead}shutting up Reverend Hieronymus{/d}! If trials really do cleanse the soul, then after weeks of listening to his shrill hectoring, I must have the soul of a saint."
  - After: "Thanks for {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_HieronimusDead}shutting up Reverend Hieronymus{/d}! Enduring him made me a saint."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza plasters a shocked expression on her face.{/n} "Please, no need to be so crude! Your esteemed self no doubt is aware that Hieronymus preaches that asceticism is a virtue, and that only by rejecting material wealth can we ascend in faith. Well, I couldn't agree more! We are merely helping the servants of the Imperium to be a little more like Hieronymus... and taking a small commission for our trouble."
  - After: {n}Ryzza feigns shock.{/n} "So crude! Hieronymus preaches rejecting wealth. We help folks follow him... for a commission."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As your esteemed self wishes."
  - After: "As you wish."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza nods seriously.{/n} "I have, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No more profane amulets or anything. All cultists and heretics who wormed their way into my crew took a long walk out through a short airlock. And the servants of the Ruinous Powers who took advantage of my moment of weakness and pushed me toward heresy were sent to meet their own Dark Gods." {n}Ryzza smiles nastily.{/n} "I doubt they'll recognise their minions after what I did to them, though."
  - After: {n}Ryzza nods.{/n} "I have, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Cultists in my crew went out the airlock, and those who corrupted me met their Dark Gods." {n}A nasty smile.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Confession? What are you on about? Old Ryzza just likes to embellish when she wants to make an impression! The nonsense she spouts in the presence of important people..."
  - After: "Confession? Old Ryzza just embellishes!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}You notice Abelard's face twist in disgust. It would seem he has a rather strong opinion on the individuals to whom Ryzza refers as the Fellowship of the Void.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard's face twists in disgust.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix gives you a look, one that is more amused than suspicious.{/n} "Quite the admirers you have, Rogue Trader..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks amused.{/n} "Quite the admirers, Rogue Trader..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "By the way, my boys have been buzzing in everyone's ears at the Amasecus, telling them about what happened in the Rykad System. And they didn't hold back when it came to describing their encounter with the kind {mf|lord|lady} who wasn't about to rob them of their already battered hides." {n}Ryzza nods meaningfully and gratefully.{/n} "Old Ryzza doesn't forget a good turn, and neither do her friends — you can take my word for it."
  - After: "My boys praise the {mf|lord|lady} who spared them in the Rykad System." {n}Ryzza nods gratefully.{/n} "I won't forget."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Welcome back!" {n}Ryzza raises her glass to you, smiles, and "winks" with her prosthetic eye.{/n}
  - After: "Welcome back!" {n}Ryzza raises her glass and "winks" her prosthetic eye.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ugh! What's a lawman doing here? I hear you got Sargona — groxes gore his soul. So, what? Now you've decided to go after the rest of us?"
  - After: "Ugh, a lawman! You got Sargona. Now you want the rest of us?"
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I am not here for you, heretic. So, keep your head down and remember that the next time we meet, I might feel more generous and spare a bullet or two just for you."
  - After: "Not you, heretic. Keep your head down, or next time I'll spare you a bullet."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I knew it, lawman — as long as we don't touch the tithe, it's like you can't see us." {n}The woman turns back to you, looking very pleased with herself.{/n}
  - After: "Leave the tithe alone and you can't see us, eh lawman?" {n}She turns back, smug.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So I don't know if I'd agree with your esteemed self that things are back to normal, but I'll gladly drink to the new normal. To your health!"
  - After: "I'll drink to the new normal. Your health!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Looking for something specific? You're buying, or maybe selling? Don't be shy, just ask — old Ryzza knows all kinds of folks. My boys will fetch you anything your heart desires!"
  - After: "Buying or selling? My boys fetch anything!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "How can old Ryzza serve your esteemed self? Does the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Rogue Trader{/d} wish to buy, or sell? No need to be shy — old Ryzza's boys will treat you right! And we've got special offers for business partners."
  - After: "Does the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Rogue Trader{/d} buy or sell? Partners get special offers."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The handling of sacred technology by laypersons uninitiated in the Omnissiah's priesthood is a Category Eight blasphemy. Incriminating evidence of profane acts perpetrated by the unit named 'old Ryzza' has been recorded for use in future judicial proceedings."
  - After: "Laypersons handling sacred tech: Category Eight blasphemy. Evidence against 'old Ryzza' recorded."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza's face breaks into a broad smile.{/n} "That old rascal! I thought he'd croaked in the mines a long time ago, but old man Bakhval's still {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_PiratesLetGo}alive and kicking{/d}, you say? Me and him have been through a lot of interesting scrapes together, and, oh, all the weird and wonderful things we've sto— acquired. Bakhval wouldn't send his regards along with just anyone — you must've done him a good turn. And because of that, old Ryzza's going to give you a special discount."
  - After: {n}Ryzza beams.{/n} "Bakhval's {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_PiratesLetGo}alive and kicking{/d}? We had scrapes together. You did him a good turn, so you get a discount."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well, how should I put it... with the Lord Inquisitor on the station, folks still have to keep a bit of a lid on their activities, but with Incendia and her hounds gone, I can definitely breathe easier. Shipments are slowly starting up again, anyone who worked with Chorda has been thrown for a loop Footfall-style, and folks can do business in the Amasecus again without any trouble."
  - After: "The Lord Inquisitor keeps a lid on things, but with Incendia gone, shipments resume."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What confessors? Haven't seen any confessors here." {n}She smiles grimly.{/n} "And if you hear folks say they saw some people enter a room and those people never came out — it's all gossip and slander. I got no problems with no confessors."
  - After: "What confessors?" {n}She smiles grimly.{/n} "People vanishing? Gossip."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Docks/ColdWelcome/ColdWelcome_Footfall_c2_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Fear not, young man. We took care of the attackers. Do you know who they were?"
  - After: "We dealt with them. Who were they?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What was that? An attack right on dock?"
  - After: "An attack on the dock?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What's the situation on Footfall?"
  - After: "What's happening on Footfall?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm ready to pay the Liege a visit."
  - After: "I'll visit the Liege."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would like to have a look around the station first."
  - After: "I'll look around first."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A gang of puny thugs attacked me — the Emperor's anointed, Rogue Trader von Valancius. Such a poorly organised attempt on my life can only be seen as a personal affront!"
  - After: "Thugs attacked me, Rogue Trader von Valancius! A personal affront!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stop quivering, unwashed worm, and answer me — who would dare to attempt such an outrageous attack?"
  - After: "Stop quivering, worm! Who dared this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Does this kind of thing happen often around here?"
  - After: "Does this happen often?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Go and report this to the Liege."
  - After: "Report this to the Liege."
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: "There are certain problems, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but the Liege can acquaint you with them far better than I."
  - After: "The Liege can explain, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: {n}The welcome procession is not particularly long, but it does attract attention. Everyone is dressed in their finest apparel, every button gleaming. Standing in front of the others is a woman with clearly expensive {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g}. She bows in a solemn curtsy.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Rogue Trader{/d}! Footfall welcomes you! On behalf of the Liege, Lord Vladaym Tocara, allow me to express my joy at your arrival. The Liege awaits you at his residence, but should you have other business to conduct on the station, I will be honoured to serve as your guide!"
  - After: {n}A woman with costly {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}implants{/g} curtsies.{/n} "Welcome, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallOfficial}Rogue Trader{/d}! Liege Vladaym Tocara awaits you."
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: "I'm here on the behalf of the Liege of Footfall, Lord Vladaym Tocara. The Liege awaits the chance to speak with you at his residence, but if you happen to have other business to attend to, I can serve as your guide and tell you about the station."
  - After: "Liege Vladaym Tocara awaits you, or I can guide you."
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, forgive me for not welcoming you with the appropriate obeisance. We were told that you would prefer to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}arrive on Footfall incognito{/d}, and so we are trying to attract as little attention as possible."
  - After: "Forgive us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You wished to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallIncognito}arrive on Footfall incognito{/d}."
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: {n}Behind her polite, soft tone, you detect the slightest hint of nervousness. It is as if she is reciting a reply she has carefully prepared beforehand.{/n}
  - After: {n}She sounds nervous, rehearsed.{/n}
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: {n}Her reply seems candid, her tone pleasant and smooth.{/n}
  - After: {n}She seems candid.{/n}
- **Servant**
  - Before: "Shooting, yes... Attacks on nobles, not very often... Unless it's the Anvers. They're vicious. Not a week goes by without them killing and gutting somebody. They're wicked h-heretics. They respect nothing. They f-follow no rules!"
  - After: "Attacks on nobles are rare... except by the Anvers. H-heretics!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I would wager that this was not an assassination attempt, but rather a common raid. The halfwits had no idea that they would run into you, Lord Captain. Still, it wouldn't hurt to be on our guard. The great have been known to fall to the pathetic, we can attest to this from our recent experience..." {n}Abelard frowns and rubs the bridge of his nose as if fatigued.{/n}
  - After: "A raid, not an assassination, Lord Captain. Still, stay alert." {n}Abelard rubs his nose.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard sighs and casually places his hand on his weapon.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard rests a hand on his weapon.{/n}
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Please, follow m—" {n}She doesn't get to finish.{/n}
  - After: "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Follow m—" {n}She's cut off.{/n}
- **Servant**
  - Before: {n}The shivering young servant looks up at you with horror in his eyes.{/n} "Emperor p-protect me... They killed... killed..."
  - After: {n}The servant shivers.{/n} "Emperor p-protect me... They killed..."
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! As you w—" {n}She doesn't get to finish.{/n}
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! As you w—" {n}She's cut off.{/n}
- **Liege Representative**
  - Before: "You really should talk to the Liege about this. I'm just—" {n}She doesn't get a chance to say the rest.{/n}
  - After: "Ask the Liege. I'm—" {n}She's cut off.{/n}
- **Servant**
  - Before: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, those guys were A-A-Anvers... they're a gang... they're the worst, I'm telling you! They're scared of no one, not even Liege Tocara..." {n}He glances around like he's expecting more bandits to appear.{/n}
  - After: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, those were Anvers! They fear no one, not even Liege Tocara..." {n}He glances around.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Every time. I warn them, and then they go all, 'Dear Emperor, our lord and saviour, how could this have happened, who could have thought?'" {n}Idira spits on the ground in annoyance.{/n}
  - After: "I warn them, then it's 'Dear Emperor, how?'" {n}Idira spits.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia's lip curls slightly.{/n} "This is so familiar — behind the amber-coloured scattering of words of welcome, far less appealing hues lurk, murky and diluted. The look of someone accustomed to lying and hiding their intentions."
  - After: {n}Cassia's lip curls.{/n} "Amber words, murky hues. A liar."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira jerks her head, shakes it, and hisses through her teeth,{/n} "Someone's coming. And they're coming for us. Watch out, Lord Captain."
  - After: {n}Idira hisses,{/n} "Someone's coming for us, Lord Captain."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Judging by the voices, there's a lot of them. Angry. They've got teeth, but they aren't that sharp. Their strength is their numbers..."
  - After: "Many, angry. Dull teeth, but numerous."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Pray, what are you talking about? What could you mean by such a cryptic pronou—" {n}She doesn't get to say the rest.{/n}
  - After: "What do you mea—" {n}She's cut off.{/n}
- **Servant**
  - Before: "Yes... I'm sorry, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... I'll just go report to the Liege... They killed her, they killed my lady, oh, this is terrible!"
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... They killed my lady!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Docks/ExploratorVendorDialogue/ExploratorVendorDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Are the servants of Footfall's new patron giving you trouble?"
  - After: "Is the new patron troubling you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I received an invitation to a meeting."
  - After: "I was invited to a meeting."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I want to make a trade deal."
  - After: "I want to trade."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Opticon-22? That's a strange name."
  - After: "Opticon-22? Strange name."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are an Explorator? Then why are you here instead of exploring faraway systems?"
  - After: "An Explorator? Why not exploring?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I seek the friendship of the Adeptus Mechanicus."
  - After: "I seek the Mechanicus's friendship."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave."
  - After: "I must go."

  - Before: "What payment can I expect?"
  - After: "What's the payment?"

  - Before: "I have no more questions."
  - After: "No more questions."

  - Before: "Why are you here and not, say, at the Liege's palace?"
  - After: "Why here, not the Liege's palace?"

  - Before: "I confirm I am willing to accept the payment."
  - After: "I accept the payment."

  - Before: "Pasqal, do these words have a translation?"

  - Before: "Right. How very straightforward."
  - After: "Right. Very straightforward."

  - After: "Eogunn, explain..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have some questions."
  - After: "I have questions."

  - Before: "You seem to be speaking Gothic, but..."
  - After: "That's Gothic, but..."

  - After: "Why want xenotech? Isn't it heresy?"

  - Before: "So what happened in the Tinaurus System?"
  - After: "What happened at Tinaurus?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You waited thirty years to pay up?"
  - After: "Thirty years to pay up?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are saying that my dynasty has had extensive business dealings with you?"
  - After: "My dynasty dealt with you a lot?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you want information about planets?"
  - After: "Why want planetary data?"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Docks/ForgeworldRefugess/ForgeWorldRefugees_Footfall_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "What became of the ship that you used to get here? It is the property of the von Valancius dynasty."
  - After: "Where's your ship? It's von Valancius property."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I need information. What happened on Kiava Gamma and how did you end up here?"
  - After: "What happened on Kiava Gamma, and how did you get here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You were hurling accusations at your masters. That is a sign of treason, and it must be punished accordingly. Do you realise this?"
  - After: "You cursed your masters. That's treason, and it will be punished. Understand?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm giving you one hour to hand the ones shouting profanities over to the enforcers on my ship. They will be executed. The rest of you are free to go."
  - After: "In one hour, hand the blasphemers to my ship's enforcers for execution. The rest may go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "All those who shouted profanities are to be handed over to the enforcers on my ship — they will be executed. The rest may join my ship's crew."
  - After: "Hand the blasphemers to my enforcers for execution. The rest may join my crew."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are pardoned. You may board my ship and continue to serve the von Valancius dynasty."
  - After: "You're pardoned. Board my ship and keep serving von Valancius."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "For insulting the rulers whose reign has been blessed by the Golden Throne, I sentence you to death!"
  - After: [Attack] "For insulting rulers blessed by the Golden Throne, I sentence you to death!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The refugees from Kiava Gamma are looking at you, some with apprehensive frowns, some with unconcealed gratitude.{/n}
  - After: {n}The refugees watch you warily.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}comes the discordant chorus of voices.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}they chorus.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The refugees offer deep bows, stuttering over their expressions of gratitude.{/n} "It will be done! We'll do as you say..."
  - After: {n}They bow.{/n} "It will be done!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Come now, shereen, relent. What can an illustrious Rogue Trader expect from wretches in rags whose weak spirit could not withstand a single blow of fate?"
  - After: "Relent, shereen. They're broken wretches."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira freezes, listening to something. Then she blurts out in a changed voice,{/n} "The first beast, its body wounded, crawled into a hole under the palace of an eminent lord. The second beast, its skin in ulcers, perished in an asteroid grave.
The third beast, its essence cursed, is curled up in the glow of a yellow sun..."
  - After: {n}Idira speaks in a changed voice,{/n} "The first beast hides under a lord's palace. The second died in an asteroid grave.
The third curls in a yellow sun's glow..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We told you everything back in the square... Things are rough on Kiava Gamma. Maybe there isn't even a Kiava Gamma anymore. The planet was attacked by a horde of heretics — they shouted unholy prayers and cut down people left and right. We heard everything from orbit, listening to one {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-cast after another. We realised there wasn't anyone left to save, so we thought we'd run... but then it was like our crew went mad somehow. The captain smashed his own head against a {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, and so did half of the officers. Everyone who survived did their best to steer the ship into the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} and here we are..."
  - After: "Heretics attacked Kiava Gamma, slaughtering everyone. We heard it on {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g}-casts and fled, then the crew went mad. The captain smashed his head on a {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}. We limped into the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}One by one, the refugees fall to their knees.{/n} "Please, have mercy! A few idiots shouted some things, that's all! We shut them up ourselves already. It was their grief and fear talking... Please don't punish the rest of us for it!"
  - After: {n}The refugees kneel.{/n} "Mercy! A few grieving idiots shouted, and we silenced them!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The refugees bow deeply and obsequiously.{/n} "It will be done! We'll do just as you say!"
  - After: {n}They bow.{/n} "It will be done!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Their eyes beam.{/n} "Praise be to the Emperor! We're saved and pardoned! We'll do as we're told, we won't say another word..." {n}Bowing hastily, the refugees back away from you.{/n}
  - After: {n}They beam.{/n} "Praise the Emperor!" {n}They back away.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The refugees grab their meagre possessions and all but run away.{/n}
  - After: {n}The refugees flee.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Only three ships made it out alive, ours being one of them. We don't know what happened to the other two, they never made it to Footfall. Maybe they disappeared in the warp, or maybe something else happened to them..."
  - After: "Only three ships escaped. The other two never reached Footfall."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Apologies... we couldn't save it. The ship was damaged during the escape — we're lucky it got us all the way to Footfall. It's at the far docks, but there isn't much use for it anymore — it doesn't look like it's going to fly anywhere, and the local recolligers have already removed some of the valuable parts. You can send your people to take apart whatever is left, scavenge some components."
  - After: "It's wrecked at the far docks. Your people can scavenge what's left."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal's voice sounds impassive and cold:{/n} "Vituperation directed at the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} was likewise registered. Denial is meaningless."
  - After: {n}Pasqal, coldly:{/n} "Insults to the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} were registered too."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix looks at the man closely, then at you.{/n} "Corrupted vox-casts... A special breed of heresy that requires knowledge of unholy arts. Kiava Gamma could have fallen under the influence of twisted {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} — having once succumbed to corruption, they forget all limitations imposed by faith and delve into unbridled and dangerous research."
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks at you.{/n} "Corrupted vox-casts mean unholy arts. Perhaps fallen {g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}Tech-Priests{/g} rule Kiava Gamma."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "The map of the Expanse was revealed to me before the Sea of Souls roiled and tangled the paths. How did you, desperate ones, reach Footfall all the way from the Cranach System without a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}?"
  - After: "How did you reach Footfall from Cranach without a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Frightened by Cassia's appearance, the refugee covers his face with his hands, trembling violently.{/n} "P-please forgive my w-worthless words... We were feeling our way in the dark, you c-could say — all we had is some old maps. We prayed to the God-Emperor day and night while our helmsman plotted the course. A m-miracle, it must have been, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: {n}The refugee cowers.{/n} "Old maps and prayer. A m-miracle, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "Induced insanity..." {n}Eogunn shifts his gaze from one refugee to another with interest.{/n} "Could a mere sequence of transmission waves have so cruelly crippled the minds of these people? I doubt it. The source of such a destructive vox-signal merits thorough investigation, and this is an incontrovertible fact."
  - After: "Induced insanity?" {n}Eogunn studies them.{/n} "The signal's source merits investigation."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Detecting a critically incorrect selection of a flesh-tongue lexeme by Genetor Eogunn Februs. 'Eradication' is the correct term for manipulations involving the described source."
  - After: "Correction, Genetor Eogunn Februs: 'eradication'."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Docks/InterogatorDialog/FootFall_Interogator_Dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: [Give him a dazzling smile] "Master van Calox! I knew you could not resist my charms!"
  - After: [Give him a dazzling smile] "Van Calox! You couldn't resist me!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am pleased to see you again, Heinrix."
  - After: "Good to see you, Heinrix."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Greetings, Interrogator. To what do I owe the pleasure of this latest visit?"
  - After: "Interrogator. Why this visit?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Step closer and lower your voice] "I am ever so glad to have you back."
  - After: [Step closer and lower your voice] "So glad you're back."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What exactly caused this need to rejoin my crew?"
  - After: "Why rejoin my crew?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I can't really say no, can I?"
  - After: "I can't say no, can I?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Heinrix, would you mind translating the torrent of verbiage you just unleashed upon me?"
  - After: "Heinrix, translate that verbiage?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I object to such an abuse of power by the Inquisition! I am a Rogue Trader, not some peasant to be pushed around!"
  - After: "I object to this abuse! I'm a Rogue Trader, not a peasant!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I, Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, welcome the agent of the Golden Throne aboard my ship and take on the responsibility of assisting him in the fight against the evil that threatens Humanity."
  - After: "I, {name} von Valancius, welcome the Throne's agent aboard to fight Humanity's foes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A sanctioned psyker with an Inquisitorial rosette in my retinue? For free, no less? The other Rogue Traders will be positively green with envy!"
  - After: "A sanctioned psyker with a rosette, free? Other Rogue Traders will envy me!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm not fond of the methods used by the Inquisition, but I will assist you in any way I can."
  - After: "I dislike Inquisition methods, but I'll help."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix sighs.{/n} "Your directness of expression does you credit. Alas, your ship will have to accommodate me once more."
  - After: {n}Heinrix sighs.{/n} "Direct. Alas, I'm aboard again."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix momentarily closes his eyes, as if your first remark has thrown him off and made him forget the speech he prepared.{/n} "Rogue Trader."
  - After: {n}Heinrix falters.{/n} "Rogue Trader."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The Inquisition? {name}, you never mentioned you socialised with such... distinguished servants of the Emperor. I'll bet it takes someone truly remarkable to warrant such eminent and close attention!" {n}Jae lets out a laugh.{/n}
  - After: "The Inquisition, {name}? Such distinguished friends!" {n}Jae laughs.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix glances at her and tilts his head slightly.{/n} "Mistress Heydari. Ever since my first visit to Footfall, I've been hearing about your colleagues and personal talents. But I'm afraid your full name escapes me — would you kindly refresh my memory?"
  - After: {n}Heinrix tilts his head.{/n} "Mistress Heydari. Your full name escapes me?"
- **Heinrix**

  - After: {n}A faint smile.{/n} "Glad. I hope that lasts once I explain."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Only to our mutual duty to Humanity. It is that duty that demands that I disturb your peace once more."
  - After: "Our duty to Humanity. It calls again."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I was able to contact my mentor and report the tragic events that transpired on Rykad Minoris. I also received some information from my agents regarding the movements and actions of enemies of Humanity, including the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} that we're assuming were involved in the theft of the star. According to their findings, the threat now hangs over other worlds... this time yours, Lord Captain."
  - After: "My agents say the {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} behind the star's theft now threaten your worlds, Lord Captain."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Not at all, First Officer Werserian — I'm not in the habit of leaving a trail. But I thank you for your concern."
  - After: "No, Werserian — I leave no trail. Thanks."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Laughter gets stuck in Jae's throat — she pales slightly, but still forces an apologetic smile.{/n} "I don't mind, shereen. Let my full name remain naught but a stray sound to you, plain and uninteresting."
  - After: {n}Jae pales.{/n} "Never mind, shereen."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Master van Calox!" {n}Cassia's voice is brimming with genuine joy, which she immediately hides behind a facade of highborn primness.{/n} "Since you are with us once more, I do hope you will find time to finish our conversation about the literary works of Kronhaller the Blessed."

- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I will make every effort, Lady Orsellio."
  - After: "I will try, Lady Orsellio."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix clears his throat and begins in a pointedly official tone,{/n} "By the order of Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar, whose duty is to stand sentinel over the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of House von Valancius is to take on board the agent of the Most Holy {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g} and provide escort and support in deeds great and small that serve to safeguard the territories of the Imperium against its enemies. This decree is effective immediately upon announcement and remains in effect until decided otherwise by His Excellency Calcazar."
  - After: {n}Heinrix, officially:{/n} "By order of Lord Inquisitor Xavier Calcazar of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} von Valancius shall host and aid the {g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}Inquisition{/g}'s agent against the Imperium's enemies, until Calcazar decides otherwise."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His mouth twists slightly.{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor has deemed that my presence aboard your ship and in your retinue would be significantly more beneficial to the fight against heresy and evil than my return to my mentor's side. Our parting before our arrival on Footfall was premature."
  - After: {n}His mouth twists.{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor wants me with you. We parted too soon."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The cause is the activity of Humanity's enemies, including the Cult of the Final Dawn. In my absence, the situation in the Koronus Expanse has changed. I have received an exhaustive report from my agents — this heresy has taken root in the region where the von Valancius worlds lie. You probably already know about the fate of the {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} of Kiava Gamma. If not, then I will share what details I know, but not here. Better to talk on board, where we will not be overheard."
  - After: "The Cult of the Final Dawn has spread near your worlds. Recall the {g|Encyclopedia:IndustrialWorld}industrial world{/g} Kiava Gamma. More on board, unheard."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix studies you for a moment — then ever so slightly, as if not wanting anyone else to see, shakes his head.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix subtly shakes his head.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}One barely noticeable motion — and a resplendent metal rosette flashes before your eyes, the symbol of the Inquisition's limitless power.{/n} "Control yourself, von Valancius. You are a step away from uttering words that could be interpreted as defiance of the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} — quite possibly the worst heresy that can be committed by a servant of the Emperor." {n}A moment passes, and the rosette vanishes in the folds of his cloak.{/n}
  - After: {n}A rosette flashes.{/n} "Careful, von Valancius. That nears defying the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}." {n}It vanishes.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I understand, {name}. But duty to the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} is seldom a pleasant burden to bear — especially for those in a position of great power."
  - After: "I understand, {name}. Duty to the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Golden Throne{/g} is rarely pleasant."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Not the most common response to the news that I will be constantly breathing down your neck. You aren't wrong, though. I prefer to repay favours in kind — assist me by ensuring that my work is unobstructed, and I will assist you in return."
  - After: "Odd reaction, but true. Let me work freely, and I'll help you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix gives a reserved nod.{/n} "An answer befitting a righteous servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}."
  - After: {n}A nod.{/n} "Fitting for a servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I must also deliver this to you." {n}Heinrix pulls out a sealed letter.{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor specified that the contents of this envelope are for your eyes only. I would ask you to read it as soon as you have the time."
  - After: {n}He hands you a sealed letter.{/n} "From the Lord Inquisitor. Your eyes only."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is everything for the time being. Are you headed to the ship? Or do you still have business on Footfall? Whatever the case, I can either wait for you on board or accompany you as part of your retinue."
  - After: "That's all. I'll wait aboard or join you."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira's whisper is barely audible:{/n} "All I got from it is that ridding ourselves of this snitch won't be easy."
  - After: {n}Idira whispers:{/n} "So we're stuck with this snitch."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "If duty has brought you aboard the Rogue Trader's ship once more, then such is the Emperor's will. Welcome back, Interrogator."
  - After: "The Emperor's will. Welcome back, Interrogator."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Thank you, Sister. It is an honour to be travelling with one of the blessed {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}."
  - After: "Thank you, Sister. An honour to travel with the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira stares at you in bewilderment, then at Heinrix, then bites her lip and snickers gleefully.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira snickers.{/n}
- **Abelard**

  - After: "Interrogator! Forget something in your cabin?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thank you." {n}Heinrix gives you a ghost of a smile before his face takes on its usual expression.{/n}
  - After: "Thank you." {n}A faint smile.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Docks/VoidshipVendor/VoidshipVendor_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What is your squadron doing here?"
  - After: "What's your squadron doing here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "From where do you source the components you sell?"
  - After: "Where do your parts come from?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would like to know more about the Merchant Fleet's operations in the Koronus Expanse."
  - After: "Tell me about the Merchant Fleet here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The vox-channel clicks, and, after a brief pause, a dry, low voice hails you:{/n} "Greetings, Lord Captain. I am honoured to speak with the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius, may your name be known through the ages. Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast, bearer of a free charter of the Merchant Fleet. How can I be of service?"
  - After: {n}A dry voice on the vox:{/n} "Lord Captain. Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast, Merchant Fleet. How may I serve?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A familiar voice cuts through the hissing of the vox-channel.{/n} "Greetings. What can I do for you?"
  - After: {n}A familiar voice.{/n} "Greetings. What can I do?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We develop supply routes for Chartists. You see, my ship is a representative of the Merchant Fleet in this part of Imperium territory, yet we do not have a fixed, charter-defined trade route. Our mission is to establish business contacts with voidfarers in need of regular ship repairs and those who are interested in specialised goods."
  - After: "We build Chartist supply routes, serving voidfarers needing repairs or special goods."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Are you asking me to disclose our suppliers to you?" {n}Thorfast laughs airily.{/n} "Well, frankly, they come from both everywhere and nowhere. We get our wares either from lucky voidsmen who stumble upon an abandoned or dilapidated ship somewhere in a neighbouring system, or from unlucky ones whose sorry tub arrives on Footfall in such a state that it's easier to take her apart than to restore her."
  - After: {n}Thorfast laughs.{/n} "Salvage: derelicts found by lucky voidsmen, or wrecks too far gone to fix."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "For the most part, all the Expanse has is fleets of different organisations and small flotillas of merchant ships. Uninterrupted communication between worlds is a matter of life and death for many outposts of Humanity, so even in this dark corner of the Imperium, there are Chartists and ships assigned to the various Adeptus. Alas, the Expanse has next to no stable trade routes, so the job can be precarious at times. Then again, no one is more intimately familiar with the hardships of local commerce than a Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Small flotillas, few stable routes. Contact between worlds is vital, but the work is precarious — as any Rogue Trader knows."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lord Cap'n, we have the flagship Drusus's Blessing with a small escort dead ahead. They are requesting a direct vox-channel. Patching you through..."
  - After: "Lord Cap'n, flagship Drusus's Blessing hailing. Patching through..."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/LiegeCourt/JaeOut/JaeOut_Footfall_c2_dialog

  - After: "I expected a welcome, not a scene."

Falco has it, doesn't he? So that's how you do business with your old friends these days?"

  - Before: "Other matters demand my attention."

  - Before: "There can be no misunderstanding between us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

  - Before: "I could have. But I'm certainly not going to," {n}Vladaym says in a bored and casual tone.{/n} "I wouldn't even under normal circumstances. And with the threat of famine hanging over the station and our prospects so unclear, well..."
  - After: "I could. I won't," {n}he says, bored.{/n} "Not with famine looming."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Which it has, essentially. The reports say that there hasn't been a living soul in the quarantine zone for days now. My people are in the process of dismantling the barricades, removing the mines, and preparing to purge the place thoroughly with fire."
  - After: "It has. All dead. We're clearing mines to purge it with fire."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I can't bar you from doing so. But I can't help but note that it's not the wisest course of action. With all due respect, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "I can't stop you. But it's unwise, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Out of the question. You would be putting both yourself and the station at risk."
  - After: "Out of the question. Too risky."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym clenches his teeth and remains silent for a moment.{/n} "Your imprudence could spell the end of you and the entire station! But — as you wish. I will have my people clear a small passage for you. It will take time, mind you..." {n}Vladaym scoffs.{/n} "The place has been mined properly. It will take days... if not more. But you will get your way in."
  - After: {n}He clenches his teeth.{/n} "This could doom us! As you wish." {n}He scoffs.{/n} "It's mined; a passage takes days."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm glad we've come to an understanding. We will wait until there is no one left alive who can spread the disease. Then we'll meticulously burn the place and fumigate it with a special compound. That should solve the problem."
  - After: "Good. Once all are dead, we burn it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is excellent news. Pleasure doing business with you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "Excellent. A pleasure, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The lockdown has been lifted and the entrances cleared. There have been no strange deaths in Utility Crew 3, the team that's stationed there. It's up to you to decide how great a risk you're willing to take."
  - After: "Lockdown's lifted. Utility Crew 3 there is fine. The risk is yours."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is a truly outstanding accomplishment, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Footfall can now rest easy. At least until the next mad hoodlum makes himself known."
  - After: "Outstanding, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Footfall can rest — for now."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No, there haven't. Attacking Footfall in general is not a particularly reasonable thing to do. Many ships are docked here at any given time, and even the listed weapons on board would make for a decent fighting force. And that's not even to mention the firepower that our esteemed merchants have shamefully hidden from the station's customs officials."
  - After: "No. Docked ships' guns, legal and smuggled, deter attackers."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm glad I've found such a generous and reliable patron. Naturally, your protectorate can count on Footfall offering the special consideration I promised you before."
  - After: "A generous patron. Your protectorate will get the consideration I promised."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I must admit, right up until the last moment I did not believe that you would come to our aid without an ulterior motive. Your ascension makes me wonder if life in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is changing in the most unexpected way."
  - After: "I never believed you'd help without motive. Perhaps the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is changing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym's gaze is slightly distrustful.{/n} "Such charity is a rare sight in the Koronus Expanse. Even figures as powerful as Rogue Traders do not show it often. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}Slightly distrustful.{/n} "Rare charity here. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym's face sours a little, but his voice is calm and dry.{/n} "New rules have been introduced, and many businesses are suffering losses and inconvenience caused by the actions of her confessional units. But we are Footfall. We know how to survive under Rogue Traders of all kinds. And none of them has yet been able to change this station's identity."
  - After: {n}His face sours.{/n} "Her confessors cost us. But Footfall outlasts every Rogue Trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym notices Jae standing behind you, and you see his jaw tightening with tension.{/n} "And what are you doing here?"
  - After: {n}Seeing Jae, he stiffens.{/n} "And what are you doing here?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Vladaym, Vladaym, you must have thought you were the only one on Footfall who knew how to make friends." {n}Jae shrugs and smirks condescendingly.{/n} "Told you I'd find a better deal."
  - After: "Thought only you made friends?" {n}Jae smirks.{/n} "Told you I'd find a better deal."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ignoring Jae, Vladaym pointedly addresses you.{/n} "I'm sure Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} had reason for getting mixed up with a small fry like her. Perhaps you were amused by her false promises of quick profit. Or some more intimate aspects of such... relationships. In any case, that's none of my business. Just remember that, here on Footfall, the truly good deals worthy of your attention can only come from me."
  - After: {n}Ignoring Jae.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Footfall's truly good deals come only from me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Without a doubt. Please forgive my digression. What brings you to me?" {n}His response is dry and reserved, but he never stops glaring at Jae.{/n}
  - After: "Forgive me. What brings you?" {n}He glares at Jae.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A hint of irritation creeps into Vladaym's otherwise impenetrable expression.{/n} "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I apologise for my lack of manners. I was... unprepared for this development."
  - After: {n}Irritated.{/n} "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Forgive me. I was unprepared."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen, your words warm the heart better than the finest Calixian wine!"
  - After: "Shereen, sweeter than Calixian wine!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Rest assured, I will be candid — my lips are bound by the oath of service. What exactly interests you on Footfall, this abode of merchants, xenotech traders, and — only a few — bandits?"
  - After: "I'm oath-bound to candour. What interests you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A ghost of a smile appears on Vladaym's pale lips.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. And now — shall we discuss more pressing matters?"
  - After: {n}A ghost of a smile.{/n} "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Business?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Glory to the Exalted One who cares for us all!" {n}Jae makes the sign of the Aquila over her chest with an uncharacteristically serious expression.{/n}
  - After: "Glory to the Exalted One!" {n}Jae solemnly makes the Aquila.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym grimaces in vexation.{/n} "In my experience, people like her tend to turn a new leaf only when the door of the airlock shuts behind them, and not a moment sooner."
  - After: {n}He grimaces.{/n} "Her kind reform only when the airlock shuts."
- **Heinrix**
