  - Before: {n}Heinrix responds with an equally reserved nod.{/n} "Good day, Liege. I am accompanying the Rogue Trader. Please pay no mind to my presence."
  - After: {n}Heinrix nods back.{/n} "Liege. I only escort the Rogue Trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your request is difficult to fathom and even more so to honour, Master van Calox. But I'm glad to hear there aren't other reasons for this visit... unlike your two previous ones."
  - After: "Hard to honour, Master van Calox. Still, better than your last two visits."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The mask of cold courtesy vanishes from Vladaym's face as soon as he takes in the air, which is permeated with the miasmas of sewer stench. He grimaces, desperately fighting the urge to turn his head away, but eventually regains his composure.{/n}
  - After: {n}The sewer stench cracks Vladaym's cold mask, briefly.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "The honoured Liege's words aren't devoid of sense, Lord Captain." {n}Abelard winces, as if he finds the very idea of agreeing with Vladaym on any matter profoundly distasteful.{/n} "I must say, venturing into a den of disease does not sound like the wisest of ideas."
  - After: "The Liege has a point, Lord Captain." {n}Abelard winces.{/n} "Avoid that den of disease."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Indeed, my dear Vladaym. The honest people of Footfall would love to know why their illustrious Liege is failing at his responsibilities — can't leave your house without a gun these days. Well... I suppose it's always been this way, but now, as well as a gun, you also need to bring a couple of goons with clubs. Oh, the expense!"
  - After: "Indeed. Why is our Liege failing? Now going out needs a gun and goons. Oh, the expense!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "How peculiar. I've never met anyone whose words appeared so smoky and hueless. You're like an exotic beast that changes its colour based on its surroundings. Observing you will be interesting."
  - After: "Peculiar. Your words are smoky and hueless, like a chameleon. How interesting."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Slightly alarmed by the unwanted attention, Vladaym bows his head respectfully.{/n} "I am always delighted to entertain the Lady Navigator with my humble personage."
  - After: {n}Alarmed, he bows.{/n} "Delighted to amuse the Lady Navigator."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym moves to stand up, but then pauses and gives you a look.{/n} "One more thing, as a gesture of my sympathy for you. Kiava Gamma — that world belongs to your protectorate, doesn't it? Footfall has heard rumours of some great trouble brewing in that colony. A ship arrived from there, and people are saying some utterly nonsensical things about the crew. Perhaps you'll be interested in hearing news about your property."
  - After: {n}He pauses.{/n} "One more thing. Rumour says great trouble brews on Kiava Gamma, your colony. A ship's crew from there is the talk of Footfall."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Officers from Port Wander, where you still have contacts from your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}days in the Navy{/d}, often talked about the whims of the Maw, the only route from the Imperium to the Koronus Expanse. Even so, Vladaym's words are particularly alarming — it seems that {g|Encyclopedia:CicatrixMaledictum}something{/g} has had a profound effect on the Maw.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Navy}days in the Navy{/d} taught you the Maw's whims, but this is worse — {g|Encyclopedia:CicatrixMaledictum}something{/g} has changed it.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym gives you a keen look.{/n} "I know enough about {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}who you were before{/d}, and what you do to people who oppose you without good reason. I will arrange to clear a passage in the barricade. Hopefully your rashness will not spell the death of this station..."
  - After: {n}A keen look.{/n} "I know {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}who you were before{/d}. I'll clear a passage. Pray it doesn't doom us..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I've heard much about your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}rare acumen{/d} — or I should say, about the profoundly impressive results you managed to achieve by using it. I have always had a fondness for individuals who can destroy their enemy or gain a powerful ally with just a few well phrased sentences or precisely issued orders." {n}The corners of Vladaym's mouth twitch, bringing his expression dangerously close to a genuine smile.{/n}
  - After: "Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Mind}rare acumen{/d} is famed. I admire those who win with words." {n}He nearly smiles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Upon noticing Kibellah, Vladaym quickly assumes a bored expression. Carefully, without making any sudden movements, he wipes his glasses and, as if absent-mindedly, puts a hand under the table.{/n}
  - After: {n}Seeing Kibellah, he feigns boredom and slips a hand under the table.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah gives him a thin smile.{/n} "You are far more interesting than you seem at first glance, Liege."
  - After: {n}Kibellah smiles thinly.{/n} "You're more interesting than you seem."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Vladaym responds with a vague smile of his own.{/n} "Yes, I am the most amusing man on this station, my lady."
  - After: {n}A vague smile.{/n} "Footfall's most amusing man, my lady."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Proctor." {n}The Liege's face takes on a most dispassionate expression.{/n} "I heard about Sargona's death and the successful reclamation of the tithe from Rykad Minoris. Do you require more information on any violators of the Lex Imperialis? I assure you, Sargona was the only heinous criminal of this calibre on all of Footfall."
  - After: "Proctor." {n}Coolly.{/n} "Sargona's dead, the Rykad Minoris tithe reclaimed. He was Footfall's worst."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I will be the judge of who is a criminal in the eyes of the Adeptus Arbites. As for my presence here — that's just to give you a reminder of the sound of the Lex Imperialis and the sight of Glaito's teeth."
  - After: "The Arbites judge who's criminal. I'm here to remind you of the Lex and Glaito's teeth."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Underbelly/BandLeader/BandLeader_FF_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Abelard, would you kindly inform this bandit vermin that we've come to execute him."
  - After: "Abelard, tell this bandit vermin we've come to execute him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You've ruled over all of Footfall with fear. That is a serious achievement. I could do with people like that. So let's talk — I prefer to use human resources rationally rather than charge in with guns blazing."
  - After: "You ruled Footfall with fear. I could use people like you. Let's talk instead of shooting."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you have something to say, then say it."
  - After: "If you have something to say, say it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm more fond of fire and metal."
  - After: "I prefer fire and metal."
- **Anver Kingpin**
  - Before: {n}The man with a shaggy mop of dark hair is dressed and armed about as well as everyone else in here. And yet he is unmistakably the leader. He takes a step toward you. He chuckles. He spreads his arms wide in a welcoming gesture.{/n} "My guests! What a joy it is to see you in my humble refuge. I see you've come here to be introduced to the truth. Which will you choose, then — words, or fire and metal?"
  - After: {n}The leader spreads his arms.{/n} "Guests! Words, or fire and metal?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You already know the answer, heretic!" {n}Argenta grasps her weapon.{/n}
  - After: "You know, heretic!" {n}Argenta grips her weapon.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard glowers menacingly and says in his best "officer" voice,{/n} "By the order of the head of the von Valancius dynasty, a fully recognised {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} with all the attendant rights and privileges, including authority on Footfall, you riffraff are hereby sentenced to death! May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} have mercy on your souls, for we will show none."
  - After: {n}Abelard glowers.{/n} "By the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s order, you riffraff die! The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} may show mercy; we won't."
- **Anver Kingpin**
  - Before: "Bow to the likes of you — the bloated old masters of the universe? I'd rather die."
  - After: "Bow to you bloated old masters? I'd rather die."
- **Anver Kingpin**
  - Before: {n}The man cringes.{/n} "Bloated old 'masters of the universe' who don't realise that their time has passed. You think you can scare me?"
  - After: {n}He sneers.{/n} "Your time's passed. Scared? Me?"
- **Anver Kingpin**
  - Before: "Do you even know what our name means, outsider? Footfall calls us the 'Anvers,' they do not stop to look, listen, learn." {n}The man pauses, then half-closes his eyes and proclaims in crude but clear High Gothic,{/n} "Auxilio non veniet. Help will not come. The {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g} has closed, the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is on its own now. A new era has come, and we are its sovereigns!"
  - After: "Anvers?" {n}In High Gothic:{/n} "Auxilio non veniet. Help won't come. The {g|Encyclopedia:Maw}Maw{/g} is shut; the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g} is ours!"
- **Anver Kingpin**
  - Before: "I will. Your time has passed. All of you — bureaucrats, the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}, conceited aristocracy, and other worthless trash — all of you will soon burn!"
  - After: "Bureaucrats, {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}, {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Traders{/g}, aristocrats — you'll all burn!"
- **Anver Kingpin**
  - Before: "Good. Fire and metal are the essence of life. People aren't worms, we are truly alive only when we're ripping our enemies apart!"
  - After: "Good. We truly live only tearing enemies apart!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Underbelly/CargoRetrieve/CargoRetrieve_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "What's in the containers, Jae? And don't even think about lying."
  - After: "What's in the containers, Jae? No lies."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This cargo belongs to the von Valancius dynasty. Is Lord Tocara trying to encroach upon the property of a Rogue Trader?"
  - After: "This cargo is von Valancius property. Is Lord Tocara robbing a Rogue Trader?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are absolutely right. I have nothing to do with this shipment or the woman standing next to it."
  - After: "Right. This shipment and this woman are nothing to me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I hope your vaunted 'wisdom' is worth all this trouble."
  - After: "I hope your 'wisdom' is worth this trouble."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish we could forget decorum entirely in each other's presence..."
  - After: "I wish we could drop decorum entirely together..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Jae Heydari, the owner of this cargo, is presently under my protection — under a Rogue Trader's protection. Tell your master that he should think twice before crossing her from now on."
  - After: "Jae Heydari is under a Rogue Trader's protection. Tell your master to think twice."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It's a pleasure to have such generous friends. Do send my regards to the Liege."
  - After: "Generous friends. My regards to the Liege."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Does Vladaym really think that my friendship can be so cheaply bought?"
  - After: "Vladaym thinks my friendship is that cheap?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You're offering a faithful servant of the Emperor a shipment of xenoheresy? Who do you think I am?"
  - After: "Xenoheresy, for a servant of the Emperor? Who do you think I am?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What, we're just going to leave your priceless cargo here unattended?"
  - After: "We're leaving your priceless cargo unattended?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'll take what we agreed to. But I never want to see you again."
  - After: "I'll take my payment. Never come near me again."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A Rogue Trader could use someone with your talents and connections, Jae. I would like to see you in my retinue."
  - After: "I could use your talents and connections, Jae. Join my retinue."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you want us to stay partners — no more secrets or half-truths."
  - After: "To stay partners — no more secrets or half-truths."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'll be merciful and give you a choice, heretic. You can atone for your deplorable crimes against the Imperium through your service to House von Valancius, or you can die where you stand."
  - After: "Choose, heretic: serve House von Valancius in atonement, or die."
- **Player**
  - Before: "When I do something and why is solely my decision to make, and I'm not going to explain my reasons to anyone."
  - After: "When and why I act is my decision. I explain to no one."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you mean, 'gift'? The cargo is mine either way — I had no intention of parting with it."
  - After: "'Gift'? The cargo is mine anyway — I never meant to part with it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm confiscating this shipment, not accepting it. And I'll have words with the Liege yet — I would very much like to know what prompted him to appropriate prohibited xenoheresy."
  - After: "I'm confiscating it. And I'll ask the Liege why he wanted xenoheresy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me about your 'business' on Footfall — the truth of it, and don't leave anything out."
  - After: "Tell me the whole truth about your 'business' on Footfall."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You could have told me from the start that you were up to your elbows in xenogoods. Do not try to be coy with someone who was once in the business {mf|himself|herself}."
  - After: "You hid the xenogoods? Don't be coy with one who ran them {mf|himself|herself}."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I see nothing wrong with making profit where it does no harm to oneself or the Imperium."
  - After: "Profit is fine if it harms neither me nor the Imperium."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Lines have a tendency to blur — usually unbeknownst to the person walking closest to them."
  - After: "Lines blur — usually without the one nearest noticing."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wanted to talk like normal people do. For a {mf|man|woman} of my status, it's a rare treat."
  - After: "I wanted to talk normally. For a {mf|man|woman} of my status, that's rare."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You were hardly forthcoming yourself — neither of us have been completely honest."
  - After: "You weren't forthcoming either — neither of us was honest."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your words are full of heresy. And you... you are simply repulsive."
  - After: "Your words are heresy. And you are repulsive."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A principled rogue who can think on her feet and is not afraid of inhumans. I like you more and more, Jae Heydari."
  - After: "A principled, quick-witted rogue unafraid of xenos. I like you more and more, Jae Heydari."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Two... Three... Five... Thank the Exalted One, those ashmags didn't have time to make off with anything yet!" {n}Jae carefully inspects the containers emblazoned with markings from some unknown freight operator, then smiles and touches the comm-bead in her ear.{/n} "Give me two minutes, shereen — I'll send the coordinates to my loyal crew who will deliver my property somewhere safe."
  - After: "Two... Five... Nothing's gone!" {n}Jae taps her comm-bead.{/n} "Two minutes, shereen — my crew will move it."
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: "I am Vladaym Tocara's personal agent." {n}The man hesitates, choosing his words carefully.{/n} "I came here to remove from criminal circulation a shipment, the distribution of which is banned in the lands of Footfall — horrendous xenoheresy that has been fraudulently delivered to a bastion of the holy Imperium." {n}He looks at Jae.{/n} "I do not doubt for a moment, most noble {name}, that your presence here is merely a misunderstanding brought about by another's manipulations..."
  - After: {n}He hesitates.{/n} "Liege's agent, here to seize banned xenoheresy." {n}He eyes Jae.{/n} "Surely, noble {name}, you were deceived..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Has anyone ever told you you have an incredibly piercing gaze?" {n}Jae's smile fades.{/n} "Well, shereen. This cargo is particularly valuable to me because it came from afar — from the Heathen Stars region. From distant trade partners of mine. Both the partners and the cargo are, shall we say, of a culture that is foreign to Humanity—"
  - After: "Piercing gaze." {n}Her smile fades.{/n} "Fine. It's from Heathen Stars partners. Both are... not human—"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae gives you a thin smile.{/n} "Lying? I hate lies. I'm all for clean deals, shereen. And I can assure you with utmost sincerity: my business secrets will not, in any way, shape, or form, cause harm to your reputation, your wallet, or your head."
  - After: {n}A thin smile.{/n} "Lie? Never, shereen. My secrets won't hurt you."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And... done!" {n}Jae removes her hand from her ear and turns to you.{/n} "We're good! Now how about we relocate to a more pleasant and private space to discuss the details of our deal, specifically, payment for your efforts?"
  - After: "Done!" {n}She turns.{/n} "Now, about your payment — somewhere private?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}You get a good look at the contents of one container whose lid is slightly ajar. Under the yellowed plastic, you see numerous cases of odd shapes and sizes. Some of them are transparent, and in the dim light, you can barely make out the strange objects within.{/n}
  - After: {n}Under yellowed plastic, oddly shaped cases hold strange objects.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, I know what you're talking about. I know a few guys who couldn't keep their hands to themselves and ended up losing them. I wouldn't be so good at what I do if I didn't know how to assess risk. Besides... the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects, shereen. It really is true. I've seen it myself time and time again."
  - After: "I know the risks. Besides, the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protects, shereen."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It's completely impossible to discern any details in this low light. And yet the mysterious silhouettes inside the box leave you with a vague sense of wrongness.{/n}
  - After: {n}Too dark to see, but the shapes feel wrong.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Listen, {name}. I'm genuinely sorry about this... confusion. Vladaym and I have had our difficulties, but I never thought he'd want to clean me out and do away with me in some dark corner... at least, not so soon. If you hadn't agreed to our deal, shereen, my gang and I would already be floating in orbit around one of Footfall's asteroids."
  - After: "Sorry, {name}. I never thought Vladaym would try to kill me so soon. Without you, shereen, we'd be floating in orbit."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And... yes, my shipment contains xeno-artefacts, possession of which is a death sentence for any commoner... But you, shereen, do not strike me as a commoner. If I had told you directly, you would have become, shall we say, complicit. But since those illicit words did not escape my lips, you would merely be agreeing to help an unfortunate soul — me — to recapture a few containers. My sincerest wish was to protect you from any unnecessary trouble, shereen. I swear by the Exalted One! And I do hope that this, ah, misunderstanding will not affect our future cooperation...?"
  - After: "Yes, xeno-artefacts — death for commoners. Unspoken, it kept you from complicity, shereen. I swear by the Exalted One! Still partners...?"
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: {n}He bows deeply.{/n} "He will be overjoyed to hear your words, no doubt. It is with a light heart that I part with you, my {mf|lord|lady}."
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "He'll be overjoyed, my {mf|lord|lady}."
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: {n}He looks away.{/n} "I am terribly sorry that my words have upset you — they were not meant as an insult. Please accept my deepest apologies. The cargo's fate is yours to decide — I will deliver your words to the Liege."
  - After: {n}He looks away.{/n} "Apologies. The cargo is yours. I'll tell the Liege."
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: "Yes... most certainly. I will deliver your words to the Liege." {n}He bows deeply.{/n}
  - After: "Certainly. I'll tell the Liege." {n}He bows.{/n}
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: "Stop right there, in the name of the Liege!" {n}The gaunt, pale-skinned man in grimy clerical robes glances at you — and immediately falls to his knees obsequiously.{/n} "Your Excellency! Please forgive my vehemence, most noble {name} — I never expected to encounter such eminent persons in this corner of Footfall!"
  - After: "Halt, for the Liege!" {n}Seeing you, the clerk kneels.{/n} "Forgive me, noble {name}!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}She shakes her head in disappointment.{/n} "That's too bad... Too bad. Well then, I thank you for your help. My people will deliver the promised reward to your ship. If you happen to reconsider, you'll find me at the same spot. Goodbye, shereen."
  - After: {n}She sighs.{/n} "Pity. Your reward goes to your ship. Goodbye, shereen."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Either way, I'm entirely willing to join your retinue. From now on, my knowledge and experience are entirely at your disposal!"
  - After: "Either way, I'm joining your retinue. My knowledge is yours!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I swear on the goodness of the Exalted One!" {n}Jae makes the sign of the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g} with an unexpectedly solemn expression.{/n}
  - After: "By the Exalted One!" {n}She solemnly makes the {g|Encyclopedia:Aquila}Aquila{/g}.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae shrugs.{/n} "Every business relationship has its quirks — if you want to call the shots, I don't mind. I'll gladly serve for the good of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} as long as it keeps my head on my shoulders."
  - After: {n}A shrug.{/n} "You're the boss. I'll serve the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} to keep my head."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae watches him hurry away, then looks at you.{/n} "I wish I could see Vladaym's face when he finds out he almost stepped on the toes of one of the most powerful people in the Expanse."
  - After: {n}She watches him flee.{/n} "Vladaym nearly crossed a Rogue Trader!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Exalted One bless you and your entire dynasty! I wouldn't say no to marking the occasion properly — it's not every day you embark on a brilliant new business partnership!"
  - After: "Exalted One bless you! This calls for a celebration!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "What a scandalous proposal!" {n}Jae lowers her eyes in feigned abashment, then immediately shoots you a sultry look.{/n} "Scandalous and tantalising."
  - After: "Scandalous!" {n}A sultry look.{/n} "And tantalising."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Well, what can I say, shereen? This isn't the first time someone's said that about me. Don't think it'll be the last time either. But it doesn't matter what we think of each other — what matters is... can we come to an agreement?"
  - After: "I've heard that before, shereen. Can we still deal?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Guilty as charged!" {n}Jae raises her hands in joking capitulation.{/n} "You're right on that one, so I guess I'm in no position to criticise."
  - After: "Guilty!" {n}Hands raised.{/n} "Fair point."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "That is so... human, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I guess people at the top have a lot more in common with regular folk than some might think."
  - After: "So human, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The top's not so different."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Absolutely, shereen. I didn't mean to ruffle your feathers."
  - After: "Of course, shereen. No offence."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae gives you a pearly smile.{/n} "We think alike, shereen. Well then, does this mean I can hope for our partnership to continue?"
  - After: {n}A pearly smile.{/n} "We think alike. Still partners?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, and one more thing... If you're interested in a rather lucrative offer, one that can give the von Valancius protectorate a leg up... I'd say now isn't the time to be thinking about such things, but once we get back to your ship... perhaps you could spare me a minute, shereen?"
  - After: "Oh — I've a lucrative offer for your protectorate. Later, on your ship, shereen?"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This statement is true, with the exception that you yourself are an uneducated laywoman and a thief who ought to stay away from the technological perversities of non-humans. I am now requesting your preventive disposal."
  - After: "True, but you're an ignorant thief. I request your disposal."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae opens her mouth to reply when you hear the sound of many footsteps behind you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Footsteps approach behind you.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Uneducated? Me? I've held things in my hands that you, cog for brains, can only dream of in your oil-soaked data-fantasies. Stop hiding behind piety and law — you're simply defending your clique's monopoly on anything and everything of interest and monetary value."
  - After: "Ignorant? I've held what you only dream of, cog-brain. You just guard your monopoly."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Mistress Heydari, you didn't answer the Rogue Trader's question." {n}Heinrix's voice sounds dull and almost bored.{/n} "I can assist you with that, if you wish."
  - After: "You didn't answer, Mistress Heydari." {n}Heinrix sounds bored.{/n} "I can help."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae gives him a look.{/n} "I don't think that will be necessary. I was just about to get to the point."
  - After: {n}Jae eyes him.{/n} "No need. I'm getting to it."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard gives you a look of reproach.{/n} "You sully the von Valancius name by inviting people like her into your retinue, Lord Captain. The decision is yours, but do not be surprised if unsavoury rumours start to spread on Footfall."
  - After: {n}Abelard frowns.{/n} "She sullies your name, Lord Captain. Expect rumours."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta regards Jae.{/n} "It is a strange circle you are forming around yourself, Rogue Trader..."
  - After: {n}Argenta eyes Jae.{/n} "A strange circle, Rogue Trader..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Sister Argenta..." {n}Jae gives her an almost lecherous once-over.{/n} "I've heard all about your deeds on Footfall, but I never would have guessed there was an angelic beauty behind all the idle gossip!"
  - After: "Sister Argenta..." {n}Jae leers.{/n} "An angelic beauty!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You used to transport goods of a similar nature {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}yourself{/d}. The container is packed with heretical works of xenos, enemies of Humanity whose creations nonetheless never fail to arouse enough interest to fetch a tremendous price on the black market.{/n}
  - After: {n}You smuggled such goods {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Criminal}yourself{/d}: xenos works worth a fortune on the black market.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae takes a step back and gives you a slightly puzzled but enraptured look.{/n} "So, I guess that makes us colleagues, then, isn't that right, shereen?"
  - After: {n}Jae looks enraptured.{/n} "So we're colleagues, shereen?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "There are no chance encounters when you are loved by the Exalted One. I like you more and more too, shereen." {n}Jae winks and flashes you a captivating smile.{/n}
  - After: "The Exalted One sent you. I like you too, shereen." {n}A wink.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And don't forget to tell him that I'm not mad. But I will be collecting the debt, sometime."
  - After: "Tell him I'm not mad. But I'll collect someday."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It is too great a coincidence that the Liege's representative should arrive in the Shadow Quarters just after Jae has recovered her rightful spoils. It seems that the guards reported the problems with the shipment over the vox, and not to just anyone, but to the Liege's personal agent. Vladaym Tocara knew about the shipment from the start and planned to take it for himself, and get rid of Jae if he could. Behold — the grubby, underhanded struggle between Cold Traders. And had it not been for your impromptu deal struck in the bar, Vladaym might have succeeded.{/n}
  - After: {n}Too convenient. Vladaym knew of the shipment all along, meaning to seize it and kill Jae. Without your deal, he'd have won.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}This is too convenient. You sense someone has been set up here. But who was the target? And who set the trap?{/n}
  - After: {n}Too convenient. Someone was set up — but who, by whom?{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Vladaym! That son of a grox! That void jackal! He was in on this from the start!" {n}Jae hisses through her teeth and reaches for the pistol at her hip, but she suddenly turns to you with a wary expression on her face.{/n} "You didn't believe a word that ashmag said, did you, shereen?"
  - After: "Vladaym! That void jackal!" {n}Jae grabs her pistol, then eyes you.{/n} "You didn't believe him, shereen?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Domin'{name}, if it is indeed your wish to let this heretic into your retinue, then allow me to carve a vow of service into her tongue. Let the pain prevent her from uttering words of deceit and remind her of obedience."
  - After: "Domin'{name}, let me carve a vow of service into her tongue."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Don't even think about it, you crazed kaskha, unless you want me to add a few extra bits of lead to the metal adornments on that sulky mug of yours."
  - After: "Try it, kaskha, and I'll add lead to your face metal."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}Solomorne folds his arms, his posture implacable and oppressive.{/n} "Joining the Rogue Trader's retinue is a rare chance for someone like you to leave her shameful activities behind and start serving the Imperium. Do not squander this opportunity to become an honourable person, peddler."
  - After: {n}Solomorne glowers.{/n} "Your chance to serve the Imperium honestly, peddler. Don't waste it."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae graces him with a furious smile.{/n} "Why, of course, I will do everything in my power to do what the Exalted One has blessed me to do best — increase the Rogue Trader's wealth! Would that not please Him, you think?"
  - After: {n}A furious smile.{/n} "Of course! I'll make the Rogue Trader rich. Surely He'd approve?"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn gazes benevolently upon the Cold Trader.{/n} "Well, an agile intellect paired with impulsivity, rapid neural reactions, and untainted judgement constitutes a somewhat rare assembly of phenotypic characteristics. Her yearning toward the comprehension of... unorthodox technologies is furthermore indicative of an extraordinary perspective."
  - After: {n}Eogunn approves.{/n} "Agile, impulsive, untainted judgement — rare traits. And a taste for unorthodox tech."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Most noble Excellency?" {n}Jae purses her lips slightly and shoots you a confused look.{/n}
  - After: "Excellency?" {n}Jae looks confused.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae flashes the Tech-Priest a saccharine smile.{/n} "I'll take that as a compliment, venerable Master! I'd be delighted if you ever chose to expand my perspective regarding our mutual interests."
  - After: {n}A saccharine smile.{/n} "Thank you, venerable Master! Do expand my perspective sometime."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "A detailed catalogue of these 'things' would greatly serve the cause of knowledge, Mistress Heydari. My colleague, as always, is far too hasty in his judgements."
  - After: "A catalogue of these 'things' would serve knowledge. My colleague is hasty."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And while we're at it... shereen, when were you going to reveal your true identity to me?" {n}Jae cocks her head to one side curiously.{/n} "I am infinitely flattered by your attention, but if I had known I was talking to a {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, not an envoy of one, I would've shown some decorum..."
  - After: "Shereen, why hide who you are?" {n}Head tilted.{/n} "Had I known you were the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, I'd have shown decorum..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "All right, then... This isn't my first year in the Expanse. It's not my first year in business either. I've sat at the negotiating table with all sorts — not just loot hunters or smugglers either, but with {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g}, ones intelligent enough to believe that mutual benefit was a better outcome of our meeting than mutual destruction. I know what the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g} has to say about that. But, speaking from the bottom of my heart — I know where the line is between an ordinary deal and a betrayal of Humanity. And I never cross it."
  - After: "Fine. I've dealt with everyone, even {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} who preferred profit to war. I know the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMinistorum}Ecclesiarchy{/g}'s view. But I never betray Humanity."
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: "The damned wench ran! A terrible shame, this is... Most noble {name}, I humbly beg your forgiveness for this unsightly scene! I hope that this episode won't affect any of your agreements with the Liege... whatever those may be!" {n}He hesitates for a moment, then seems to catch his breath.{/n} "Please accept the cargo taken from the accursed heretic as compensation!"
  - After: "The wench ran! Forgive me, noble {name}!" {n}He recovers.{/n} "Take her cargo as compensation!"
- **Vladaym's Agent**
  - Before: "No, no! Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I beg you to forgive this wretched serf! A terrible misunderstanding... a thousand apologies... I won't disturb you further..."
  - After: "Forgive me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! A misunderstanding... I'll go..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Nothing to worry about — after all the ruckus we've caused here, I doubt anyone will go anywhere near the containers. I am, however, infinitely flattered by your concern for my — now our — property!"
  - After: "No one will touch it now. But I'm flattered you care for our property!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Underbelly/Deratizer/Deratizer_Footfall_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I was able to infiltrate the quarantined area without your knowledge."
  - After: "I got into the quarantine zone unnoticed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The source of the disease was a pack of mutants. They have been exterminated. A few survivors remain within the perimeter, but they pose no threat."
  - After: "Mutants caused the disease. They're dead. A few harmless survivors remain."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So is the quarantine zone safe now?"
  - After: "Is the quarantine zone safe now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Utility workers again. I had to shoot a couple of your colleagues, you know."
  - After: "Utility workers again. I shot a couple of your colleagues."
- **Player**
  - Before: "So you don't know exactly what happened in the district? Disease, bugs, or something else?"
  - After: "So you don't know what happened? Disease, bugs, or else?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are the people trapped in the quarantine zone being provided with aid of any kind?"
  - After: "Is anyone aiding those trapped inside?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I bid you farewell. Carry on and remain vigilant!"
  - After: "Farewell. Stay vigilant!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How exactly did the victims die?"
  - After: "How did the victims die?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What measures have been taken to deal with the problem?"
  - After: "What's being done about it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The source of the disease was a pack of mutants. They have been exterminated."
  - After: "Mutants caused the disease. They're exterminated."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man stops and salutes you with his flamer.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What an honour! The whole of Footfall is talking about the new head of House von Valancius! Foreman of Footfall Utility Crew 3, at your service!"
  - After: {n}He salutes with his flamer.{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Foreman of Utility Crew 3, at your service!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Greetings, {mf|sir|ma'am}! What brings you here? Did you want to watch us break our backs out here, eh? Footfall Utility Crew 3 is proud to work for the good of the denizens and guests of the station!" {n}The man winks and salutes you with his flamer.{/n}
  - After: "Greetings, {mf|sir|ma'am}! Utility Crew 3, proud to serve!" {n}He salutes with his flamer.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ah, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Please don't be angry, but we haven't cleared a passage for you yet. Soon, though! Not that many mines left..."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, the passage isn't clear yet. Soon!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The foreman of Utility Crew 3 is whistling some jaunty tune.{/n}
  - After: {n}The foreman whistles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well, that depends. We figure everyone who could have died is dead and rotting. And disease and parasites don't usually live in corpses. We threw a few expendables in the quarantine zone, and we can say for sure that it was thirst that killed them in the end, not disease."
  - After: "Everyone's dead. Expendables we threw in died of thirst, not disease."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The man pales slightly, then gives you a rather strained smile.{/n} "Well... it happens! I hope they didn't die because you didn't like the way they'd fixed your privy, heh heh."
  - After: {n}He pales, smiling stiffly.{/n} "It happens! Hope it wasn't over a privy, heh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Of course they don't, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No threat whatsoever!" {n}He nods enthusiastically.{/n}
  - After: "Of course, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. No threat!" {n}He nods.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Just burning rats. And some trash, and some parasites of other sorts. The district's under quarantine, you see. It got hit by something nasty. A disease. Or maybe it isn't a disease, just some bugs an' worms what crawled out of some ship or other."
  - After: "Burning rats. The district's quarantined — disease, or bugs off a ship."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is a bit odd that it happened here and not at the docks, I'll grant you. Things like that usually start there. They even spray the place with some gunk to kill all the bugs an' worms. But I guess something slipped through. Two families in that block way over there snuffed it. And the Liege wasted no time getting the district surrounded so that nobody could leave."
  - After: "Odd it hit here, not the docks. Two families died. The Liege sealed the district."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A thousand apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, but no, we don't, and we'd rather not find out. Who in their right mind would want to get closer to whatever it is? We've contained the foulness — and that's good enough if you ask me!"
  - After: "Apologies, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, no. It's contained — good enough!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No. We don't. And we don't wanna find out. If something nasty's cropped up, the right move is to contain it and kill it with fire. Not go in to see what it is and why it's there."
  - After: "No. Contain it, burn it, don't go poking."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Pfft. Of course not. I mean, I heard Reverend Hieronymus has been praying for their souls — which sounded more like, 'Retribution fell upon them, and rightly so.' That's the most they can hope for."
  - After: "Pfft. No. Reverend Hieronymus prays for them — sort of: 'Retribution fell, rightly.'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You're looking at them! We stand here, burn the foulness, and we've got people standing guard so that no one escapes. Put some mines down — a whole load of them — for the same reasons. The water, the sewers — all blocked off, to stop any communications getting out. The air's open, I s'pose, but the foulness doesn't seem to be airborne — there haven't been any strange deaths outside the district."
  - After: "You're looking at them! We burn, guard, mined it, blocked water and sewers. Not airborne — no deaths outside."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But I... I just... Will do! I'll report it right away!"
  - After: "But I... Will do! I'll report it!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The foreman's smile becomes a little less sincere. His searching eyes wander over the ranks of his subordinates. Then, he sighs.{/n} "Normally, not even a rat can get past us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But you are no ordinary person. You possess special talents. I dare not judge. If you got in, you must have had a reason to."
  - After: {n}His smile thins; he sighs.{/n} "Not even a rat gets past us, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! But you must have had a reason."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The foreman looks you up and down with a long gaze full of suspicion. The barrel of his flamer turns in your direction with seeming nonchalance.{/n} "That's a load of groxwash, {mf|sir|ma'am}. We did a thorough job sealing off every passage, what with quarantine being about no one getting in — or out. Don't joke like that anymore, or I might take you at your word." {n}The flamer releases a noisy burst of fire into the air.{/n}
  - After: {n}His flamer drifts your way.{/n} "Groxwash, {mf|sir|ma'am}. Every passage is sealed. Don't joke like that." {n}Fire bursts skyward.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ah, you again. Greetings! We were just in the middle of removing the cordon, you see. The epidemic's over, apparently. If there ever was one, that is. Me and the lads are gonna light the place up a bit, and then it'll be right as rain!"
  - After: "You again! We're lifting the cordon — epidemic's over, if there was one."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ah, it's you again! An order came down in regard to your esteemed self — we're to clear out a passage and let you through. So here we are — clearing and disarming the mines... I don't know why you're in such a rush to bite it, but — eh, it's none of my business. You just wait, and we'll make a way in for you sooner or later."
  - After: "You again! We're clearing mines for your passage, as ordered. Wait, we'll get you in."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Who knows? They found them in their hovels, already dead. Blue sores on their bodies, and they stank something awful, which is why the lot that found them didn't even risk looting the corpses. Good on them, I guess. Doesn't mean we let them out, of course."
  - After: "Found dead in their hovels, blue sores, stinking — nobody dared loot them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, have mercy! I can't say no to you, but the danger is just as real to you as it is to the whole station! We'll... We'll clear a way for you. But it'll take time, a lot of time — it won't be easy to break down the barricades and disarm the mines." {n}He gives you a long look, likely hoping that you will reconsider. But, after receiving no reaction, he gives the order to his assistants.{/n}
  - After: "Mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! It's dangerous! We'll clear a way, but it'll take time." {n}He orders his assistants.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No dice. Not gonna happen. We're letting no one in. I'm telling you right now, bribes and intimidation won't work on me, so don't even try. You can file a petition with the Liege if you're so desperate. But my advice to you would be to go on your merry way. The void's got plenty of nasty, dangerous holes, you don't have to die in this one in particular. You'll go in and die, and that means I'll have more corpses to burn..." {n}He pointedly turns away.{/n}
  - After: "No. Nobody gets in, bribes or threats. Petition the Liege, or leave." {n}He turns away.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Negative — it does not 'happen.'" {n}Pasqal's voice turns peevish, and his visor lights up red.{/n} "As a representative of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}, I am registering a complaint with Footfall Station Services. The crematorium in which the burning of the late Denz Bellardo's body was to take place remains in an unsatisfactory state of maintenance. Two circuit stations within the sewer infrastructure are missing their standard support unit. That is unacceptable!"
  - After: "Negative — it does not 'happen.'" {n}Pasqal's visor turns red.{/n} "For the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}, I complain: Denz Bellardo's crematorium is poorly maintained, two sewer stations lack support units. Unacceptable!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Mutants, is it? Hmm... Funny thing about mutants — you keep burning them, and they just keep popping up! Well, thank you kindly for the help and the details. Footfall won't forget it. Me and the lads will drop by their lair and clean up, make sure there's no disease left!"
  - After: "Mutants? They keep popping up! Thanks. We'll clean their lair."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}His outburst over, Pasqal appears to calm down — the colour of his visor changes to blue, and his mechadendrites stop snapping so violently.{/n} "Report to your direct superior that I, {g|Encyclopedia:Magos}Magos{/g} Haneumann, have requested an immediate inspection."
  - After: {n}Pasqal's visor turns blue.{/n} "Tell your superior {g|Encyclopedia:Magos}Magos{/g} Haneumann requests an immediate inspection."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Underbelly/HungerRiot/HungerRiot_Footfall_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "What is going on here?"
  - After: "What's going on?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Brandish your weapon] "Hunger won't kill you this instant. But this might!"
  - After: [Brandish your weapon] "Hunger won't kill you now. This might!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stop! I will have food delivered from my ship to the Shadow Quarters to be handed out. There is no need for violence!"
  - After: "Stop! I'll send food from my ship to the Shadow Quarters. No violence!"
- **Citizen**
  - Before: "Open your larders! Give us all you've got! Or else we'll just take it ourselves!"
  - After: "Open your larders, or we'll take it!"
- **Guard**
  - Before: "Yeah, right! Run back to your holes, rats. If you've nothing to eat, it's not my problem!"
  - After: "Back to your holes, rats!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira observes the rabble dismally.{/n} "Back when I was a kid on my home planet, a whole district was left without rations, so we tried to pull this kind of stunt on a local shop... The owners just started shooting, no questions asked. Hah. Never took Footfall's wardens for pushovers..."
  - After: {n}Idira frowns.{/n} "Back home, they'd just shoot us."
- **Guard**
  - Before: "Please, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I'm not to blame for any of this! This riffraff wants to rob the bar! They say they got nothing to eat!" {n}The guard spits.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, riffraff robbing the bar!" {n}He spits.{/n}
- **Guard**
  - Before: "Just some riffraff what wants to rob the bar. They got nothing to eat, they say! Come over here, {mf|sir|ma'am} — have a bit of fun with us, we'll shoot 'em full of holes!" {n}The guard points his weapon at the crowd.{/n}
  - After: "Riffraff robbing the bar. Join us, {mf|sir|ma'am}!" {n}He aims.{/n}
- **Citizen**
  - Before: {n}The rioter backs away.{/n} "What the—? We just can't catch a break... Come on, people, all we're getting here is our brains splattered!"
  - After: {n}The rioter backs off.{/n} "Come on, we'll get shot!"
- **Citizen**
  - Before: "You can't scare us! We'll take your knives and your guns and sell them to feed our kids! Get 'em, lads!"
  - After: "You can't scare us! Get 'em!"
- **Guard**
  - Before: "Right, I've had enough of you scum."
  - After: "Enough of you scum."
- **Citizen**
  - Before: {n}The rioter stares at you in disbelief for a whole minute.{/n} "R-really? You'll help? The Emperor must have heard us, He must have! Please, send the food soon. Our whole neighbourhood is starving!"
  - After: {n}The rioter gapes.{/n} "R-really? The Emperor heard us! Hurry!"
- **Guard**
  - Before: "Found someone to beg from, did you? Now shove off! Quickly now, before I hurry you up with a bullet in the back."
  - After: "Got your handout? Shove off."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "These peasants are engulfed in flames of maroon and yellow. In a few moments, despair and hunger will overwhelm them, burn them from within, smother their fear of death... and become a storm of grimy crimson."
  - After: "Maroon and yellow. Soon, a storm of grimy crimson."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "You will, will you?" {n}Kibellah pulls a dagger out of her sleeve, the weapon's edge still damp with blood — either her own or someone else's.{/n} "What about this blade, which has opened the throats of more heretics than you have lived years — will you take it too?"
  - After: "Will you?" {n}Kibellah draws a bloody dagger.{/n} "It's cut countless heretic throats. Take it too?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "I think he's got a few scraps to spare. Come to think of it, it's about time someone cut HIS rations — the High Factotum's trousers go up a size every year."
  - After: "The High Factotum's trousers grow yearly. He can spare it."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Underbelly/MayITakeIt/MayITakeIt_FF_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Take what you want and get out of my sight."
  - After: "Take what you want and go."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Give alms] "Take what you need, and here's a little on top."
  - After: [Give alms] "Take what you need, plus a bit extra."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The urchin sniffles loudly to get your attention.{/n} "'ello there, Your Higherness! You're just like they say! So {mf|'andsome|pretty}! And strong! And your clothes are so sharp!"
  - After: {n}An urchin sniffles.{/n} "'ello, Your Higherness! So {mf|'andsome|pretty}, and sharp!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Right you are. I'm as good as gone!" {n}Glancing sadly at the boots on the corpse, the urchin darts away.{/n}
  - After: "I'm gone!" {n}Eyeing the corpse's boots, he darts off.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The urchin sniffles loudly to get your attention.{/n} "'ello there, {mf|sir|lady}! Nice job you did there with all this lot! Very 'eroic, it was!"
  - After: {n}An urchin sniffles.{/n} "'ello, {mf|sir|lady}! Very 'eroic, that!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Much obliged, {mf|sir|my lady}! I'll be done in a jiffy! The boots, the pockets — and it'll be like I was never 'ere!"
  - After: "Thanks, {mf|sir|my lady}! Boots, pockets, done!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He looks at the alms with suspicion, but then gives you a beaming smile with the remaining half of his rotten teeth.{/n} "Golly, thanks, {mf|sir|my lady}! Thanks a whole bunch! May the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} and all His angels protect ya!"
  - After: {n}He grins, half his teeth rotten.{/n} "Golly, thanks, {mf|sir|my lady}! {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} protect ya!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Er... Can I poke through the dead guys you just dropped real quick? I just wanna take a couple of things... like the boots on that fella over there..." {n}He gives you an obsequious look.{/n}
  - After: "Can I search the dead guys? Just the boots on that one..." {n}He fawns.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/Footfall/Underbelly/PlagueSurvivors/PlagueSurvivors_Footfall_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I've found you already. Open up."
  - After: "I've found you. Open up."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Try to move the metal sheet out of the way]
  - After: [Try to move the metal sheet]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Who are 'they'? Who is to blame?"
  - After: "Who are 'they'? Who's to blame?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Please, don't be afraid. I mean you no harm."
  - After: "Don't be afraid. I mean no harm."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Blow up the barricade along with the survivors] "I'm sorry, but I cannot risk leaving you alive."
  - After: [Blow up the barricade with the survivors] "Sorry, I can't leave you alive."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will verify your claim about the mutants."
  - After: "I'll verify your mutant claim."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You weren't lying about the mutants. They have been exterminated and won't infect anyone else."
  - After: "You were right about the mutants. They're exterminated."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You hear the sound of falling objects from behind the thick sheet of metal, followed by angry hissing:{/n} "Quiet! I said quiet! Before someone finds us!"
  - After: {n}A hiss behind the metal sheet:{/n} "Quiet! They'll find us!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Giving Jae a sidelong glance, Pasqal wheezes in displeasure,{/n} "I am putting forward a supposition that they traded in samples of xenotechnology. And those samples behaved as expected in the hands of the ignorant — they brought death and extinction to Humankind."
  - After: {n}Pasqal eyes Jae.{/n} "They likely traded xenotech. In ignorant hands, it kills."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I agree completely — ashmags need to be kept away from the Cold Trade. As for the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g}'s conviction that everyone other than themselves is a moron — that I disagree with."
  - After: "Agreed. But the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusMechanicus}Adeptus Mechanicus{/g} thinks everyone else a moron."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A cry of terror rings out from behind the barricade.{/n} "No! Never! We're not letting anyone in!"
  - After: {n}A terrified cry.{/n} "No! Never!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Please, have mercy! Don't kill us! We're not infected, I swear! It's them, they're to blame! It's them!" {n}Her pleading is cut short by a violent, wheezing cough.{/n}
  - After: "Mercy! We're not infected! It's them!" {n}She coughs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sheet is very heavy and must have been propped up with something from the other side or wedged shut. Moving it seems impossible.{/n}
  - After: {n}The sheet is wedged shut.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We'll tell you everything, just please, spare our lives! We know where the disease came from!"
  - After: "Spare us! We know the source!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We do... we know..." {n}Another coughing fit interrupts the woman's words.{/n} "It's them... those damned mutants! They have a hideout somewhere under our block, we used to see them skulking in the shadows all the time..."
  - After: "Mutants!" {n}She coughs.{/n} "They hide under our block."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The two families who died first, they had dealings with them. Traded something. And they caught some mutant blight. I know they did! Those mutants are very tough, they're always sick with something, but they don't die of it. But ordinary people definitely do!"
  - After: "The first two families traded with them and caught their blight. It kills people, not mutants!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We got lucky, though! We're alive, we're getting by — the disease couldn't claim us!"
  - After: "But we survived!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It is very quiet behind the metal sheet.{/n}
  - After: {n}Silence.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No! We don't deserve this! We don't! Oh, Mummy, I'm so scared... Mummy..."
  - After: "No! Mummy, I'm scared..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We're not lying! Look for their entrance, it has to be close by!"
  - After: "It's true! Their entrance is close!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Praise the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}! You... You'll tell them, right? Right? That Crew 3 or whatever they're called. Please tell them, then maybe they won't kill us..."
  - After: "Praise the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}! Tell Crew 3, so they spare us..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I see we are up against true masters of stealth, shereen. We should keep our voices soft and gentle, or else we might literally scare them to death."
  - After: "Masters of stealth, shereen. Speak softly."

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/ForgeHeart/DoomedPsykerDialogue/DoomedPsykerDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "No! We will save you, get you away from here — just hold on!"
  - After: "No! We'll save you — hold on!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kill the woman] "May the Emperor guard your soul."
  - After: [Kill the woman] "Emperor guard your soul."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "There is only one way to help you."
  - After: [Attack] "Only one way to help you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Hey! Hey, can you hear me? I want to help!"
  - After: "Hey! Can you hear me? I want to help!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "I shall rid you of your agonising existence."
  - After: [Attack] "I'll end your agony."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Don't be afraid. Tell me, who are you?"
  - After: "Don't be afraid. Who are you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pull yourself together, citizen! Shake off the compulsion and tell me who you are!"
  - After: "Shake off the compulsion, citizen! Who are you?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The dirty, dishevelled woman pays you no heed, lowering her head and looking at the ground with genuine interest, at something that either does not exist or is invisible to your eyes.{/n}
  - After: {n}A filthy woman stares at nothing.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman shoots you a crazed, inhuman look — and suddenly backs away with an agonising groan, clutching at her face.{/n}
  - After: {n}She glares, then recoils, clutching her face.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "She is a psyker — I can feel warp emanations roiling around her. One of the cultists' prisoners. How did she manage to get out of the cage and survive? Be vigilant — creatures like her remain dangerous even when they mean to do no harm."
  - After: "A psyker — an escaped cultist prisoner. Careful, she's dangerous even unwilling."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira looks at Heinrix with scorn but says nothing, just hisses venomously through her teeth.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira hisses at Heinrix.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A single blow is enough to end the psyker's pitiful existence. You examine the corpse and, with a start, realise the woman's facial features seem to have melted from extreme heat. Whoever or whatever had the poor creature in its thrall has now vanished without a trace.{/n}
  - After: {n}One blow ends her. Her face looks melted; whatever held her is gone.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her voice is barely audible, but you manage to make out the words:{/n} "I don't remember how I ended up here... don't remember what happened... there was a bright light, like from arc-welding... and then... the light reached out with its clutches..." {n}She moans and holds her head.{/n}
  - After: {n}She whispers:{/n} "I don't remember... a bright light, like arc-welding... it reached out..." {n}She moans.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman jerks her head and transfixes you with a delirious gaze. Only now do you notice a reddish black mark on her cheek — a many-pointed star, a symbol of Chaos. The prisoner bares her teeth, but you cannot tell whether she does so as a threat or simply out of fear.{/n}
  - After: {n}She stares deliriously, a Chaos star on her cheek, teeth bared.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman hesitates, looking at you warily. At last she sobs and replies meekly,{/n} "Stay away... In the Emperor's name, stay away from me..."
  - After: {n}She sobs.{/n} "In the Emperor's name, stay away..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman snarls, but a moment later, her growl becomes a desperate moan:{/n} "I can't... resist... Emperor, protect..."
  - After: {n}She moans:{/n} "Can't... resist... Emperor, protect..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With an unnatural roar, the psyker rears up — her features are drooping, melting like candle wax. Her swollen lips part, revealing sharp teeth, and her bright orange pupils expand to fill her eyes completely. The psyker slumps to the ground — and the smell of ozone gives way to a disgusting sulphurous stench.{/n}
  - After: {n}Roaring, her face melting like wax, she collapses. Ozone turns to sulphur.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A shot rings out, and the woman sags to the floor without a sound. The ozone smell immediately starts to dissipate, giving way to the usual scents of an industrial world.{/n}
  - After: {n}A shot; she drops. The ozone fades.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Even at this distance you can detect the distinct smell of ozone — too fresh for this stuffy room reeking of soot and industrial lubricant. The woman raises a maimed hand and absent-mindedly runs its two remaining fingers through her matted hair.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ozone cuts the soot. She combs her hair with two remaining fingers.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The light... is taking me over. It's everywhere already! Everywhere..." {n}The woman turns her head toward you and blurts out in an unexpectedly low and gruff voice,{/n} "Save me! Give me the Emperor's Peace! Please!"
  - After: "The light is everywhere..." {n}Her voice turns gruff:{/n} "Give me the Emperor's Peace!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah closes her eyes as if listening to something.{/n} "This tormented soul is beyond help. Grant her the gift of the Undying One while she still can accept it with gratitude."
  - After: {n}Kibellah listens.{/n} "She's beyond help. Grant her the Undying One's gift while she can accept it."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "What an unexpected bit of advice. I can't believe it's coming out of your mouth!"
  - After: "Advice I can't believe you'd give!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No! Too late! The light! The light is devoooOOOOAAARGH!" {n}The woman clutches at her face and recoils from you.{/n}
  - After: "Too late! The light is devoooOOOOAAARGH!" {n}She recoils.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/ForgeHeart/ForgeHeartCogitatorDialogue/ForgeHeartCogitatorDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Find a way to deactivate the cogitator's logical network]
  - After: [Deactivate the cogitator's logical network]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Walk away from the cogitator]
  - After: [Leave the cogitator]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Heinrix, have you ever seen anything like this before?"
  - After: "Heinrix, seen anything like this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I need the assistance of a servant of the Omnissiah."
  - After: "I need a servant of the Omnissiah."
- **Player**
  - Before: [See what the device is coated with]
  - After: [Check the coating]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Examine the image on the screen]
  - After: [Examine the screen image]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Take a close look at the letters on the screen]
  - After: [Read the letters on the screen]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Check for the presence of data-crypts]
  - After: [Check for data-crypts]
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator screen flickers as if the system is suffering a power failure. You reach out and touch the control panel but quickly jerk your hand back: the device is coated in some sticky substance.{/n}
  - After: {n}The screen flickers. The panel is coated in something sticky.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You make a show of removing your hand from the lever — and kick the power transfer relay located on the lower half of the cogitator's casing. The screen immediately shuts down and the snarling inside the machine peters out on its own. Checking the data-crypt port reveals the claws have unclenched, and you easily extract the data-crypt from its socket.{/n}
  - After: {n}Feigning retreat, you kick the power relay. The screen dies, the claws release, and you take the data-crypt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Not only do you fail to examine the log, even accessing it is quite an ordeal — any data projected to the blinking screen blurs and fades like images on melting film.{/n}
  - After: {n}The log blurs and fades like melting film.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}When you reach for the power shutdown lever, the growling from the depths of the machine intensifies and the screen starts filling with red. Your hand stops one centimetre away from its goal...{/n}
  - After: {n}You reach for the lever; the growling swells. Your hand stops short...{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You skim the report on the auxiliary screen. It seems the cogitator has been completely purged of data. If there is anything of value left in this machine, it will be on the external drives.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogitator is purged of data. Anything left is on external drives.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You try pressing keys and spinning a couple of reels. In response, a few lumens light up on the control panel, a low guttural growl reverberates through the machine, and a small auxiliary screen lights up, presenting you with information.{/n}
  - After: {n}Lumens light up, a growl rumbles, and an auxiliary screen shows data.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The data-crypt slots are occupied: two of them appear to be melted beyond repair, but you might extract the third one without incurring data loss if you successfully deactivate the logical network of the machine itself.{/n}
  - After: {n}Two data-crypts are melted. Deactivate the logical network to save the third.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}No matter how many reels you spin or how many buttons you push, all of the efforts remain futile: the control panel sways before your eyes, and the swirls on the screen start resembling letters on the cusp of forming coherent words...{/n}
  - After: {n}It's futile. The screen's swirls start forming words...{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You touch the data-stick and realise you cannot pull it out or pry your fingers away from its surface, it is as if your hand is being held in place by a powerful magnetic force!{/n}
  - After: {n}You touch the data-stick — a magnetic force holds your hand fast!{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You tear your gaze away from the screen and immediately feel your mind shake off the strange haze caused by the shifting images.{/n}
  - After: {n}You look away; the haze lifts.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You grab the lever and a powerful electric discharge surges through your body. You jerk your hand away and watch the lever go red-hot from the voltage, melt into a viscous goop, and trickle down into its own socket.{/n}
  - After: {n}The lever shocks you, then melts red-hot into its socket.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix gives the screen and the control panel a thorough examination.{/n} "Another manifestation of the same corruption we encountered on Kiava Gamma. Perhaps if we used an auxiliary connection system..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix inspects it.{/n} "The same corruption as on Kiava Gamma. Maybe an auxiliary connection..."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix pries a side panel open with a knife and receives a face full of sparks and caustic reagent. After swearing and wiping his singed face, the Interrogator manages to pull out a bunch of wires and cut the right cables, causing the cogitator to shut down. The claws holding the data-crypt unclench helplessly.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix pries a panel open, takes sparks to the face, swears, and cuts the right cables. The claws release the data-crypt.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priest starts chanting an infrasound litany that makes you feel slightly nauseous and approaches the cogitator. He places his hands on the control panel in one smooth motion and starts performing sacred manipulations. Most of the Magos's actions are a total mystery to you, and you watch as he flips toggle switches and ritually taps several relays while drawing protective symbols over others.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal chants a nauseating litany, flipping switches and drawing wards.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}At last, when the rituals are complete, your companion withdraws a cord from the folds of his red vestment and plugs it into one of the sockets. A discharge surges along the cable, making the Tech-Priest flinch and filling the air with the smell of burnt wiring, but the cogitator obediently shuts down, erasing the sinister entity from the screen and releasing the data-crypt from its port.{/n}
  - After: {n}His cord jolts him, but the cogitator dies, erasing the entity and releasing the data-crypt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You know enough to determine exactly what happened to the machine. Glitchy projectors, otherworldly sounds from inside the case, an oppressive atmosphere in the room — everything points toward a scrap-code infection, one of the stranger and more frightening creations of the Tech-Priests who devote themselves to the Ruinous Powers.{/n}
  - After: {n}It's a scrap-code infection, made by Tech-Priests sworn to the Ruinous Powers.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something is obviously wrong with the machine, but you fail to determine the exact reason for the malfunction.{/n}
  - After: {n}The machine is wrong, but you can't tell why.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As if satisfied by your retreat, the entity on the screen closes its spark-like eyes, but you can't rid yourself of the feeling that it is still watching you surreptitiously.{/n}
  - After: {n}The entity closes its spark-eyes, yet still seems to watch.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You shatter the monitor with a single blow. In its death thralls, the machine envelops you in acrid smoke that leaves behind a thin oily film. The claws holding the data-crypt twitch in agony, breaking the fragile device into metal splinters.{/n}
  - After: {n}You shatter the monitor. The dying claws crush the data-crypt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You tense every muscle in your body, plant one leg against the cogitator case, and pull. At last, the unknown force begins to give way and eventually lets go. You come close to falling flat on your back, but the data-stick is clenched in your hand, intact.{/n}
  - After: {n}You heave until the force gives. The data-stick comes free, intact.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You pull, twist, and tug at the data-stick with no visible result. At last you make peace with the inevitable and break the fragile device, ending the unnatural effect.{/n}
  - After: {n}It won't budge. You break the data-stick, ending the effect.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You smash the control panel with the first blow and the cogitator screens with the second. No one will be able to use this machine, whether for good or ill.{/n}
  - After: {n}You smash the panel and screens. No one will use this machine again.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You examine all the slots and sockets on the cogitator case, but to no avail. All that you manage to find is a single data-stick hidden behind a protective panel.{/n}
  - After: {n}You find only one data-stick behind a protective panel.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The eye-like sparks are yellowish orange in colour, but you are pretty sure this monitor cannot display such a vivid hue. You lean forward, and you hear a predatory growl coming from inside the device, a sound full of hatred and hunger.{/n}
  - After: {n}The spark-eyes glow impossibly orange. A hungry growl rises.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Perhaps if you can extract the data-crypts containing the scrap-code, you will be able to study it later in a controlled environment.{/n}
  - After: {n}Extract the scrap-code data-crypts to study them safely later.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}At the same moment, the cogitator releases a data-stick previously hidden beneath a protective panel, and the device drops to the floor right in front of you. It looks like a logic key used to access additional cogitator reserves. It may fit other systems in this part of the planet.{/n}
  - After: {n}It ejects a hidden logic key for cogitator reserves. It may fit other local systems.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The machine is obviously trying to tell you something, one letter after another. The gobbledygook on the screen aligns into a few words. You try to read them... and reel back, feeling the cursed phrase ravage your mind like a rabid beast, wiping away all thought and leaving behind a trace of primordial horror.{/n}
  - After: {n}Letters form words. Reading them floods your mind with primordial horror.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You insert the data-stick into one of the available slots. The machine reacts with purrs and clicks. A few moments later, both data-sticks are ejected and land on the control panel.{/n}
  - After: {n}You insert the data-stick. The machine clicks and ejects both data-sticks.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You spend a lot of time trying to establish a connection between the countless switches and reels on the control panel and the twisted symbols floating on the glitchy screen. At last you manage to complete the logical network, tame the rampaging system, and force it to disengage the data-crypt.{/n}
  - After: {n}You map switches to symbols, tame the system, and free the data-crypt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Tech-Priests would probably not approve of such rough treatment of their sacred machines, but in the end your efforts bear fruit: you manage to claim the data-crypt by disconnecting several wires and prying open the claws.{/n}
  - After: {n}Roughly, cutting wires and prying claws, you claim the data-crypt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You stick your hand in the socket and thousands of invisible sharp teeth sink into your fingers! You pull out the maimed limb, which is quickly growing numb, and clearly hear an evil hiss coming from the bloodstained slot.{/n}
  - After: {n}Invisible teeth bite your fingers! The bloody slot hisses.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something is moving on the cogitator's main screen, but it doesn't look like code. When you draw closer, the image starts to undulate this way and that, like the coils of an awakened snake. Two pinpricks of light appear on the screen — something is watching you from the darkness flickering between the unwinding coils.{/n}
  - After: {n}The screen coils like a snake. Two lights watch from between the coils.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator does not react to the buttons being pushed and the handles being turned: the screen continues to display what you saw when you first approached the machine.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogitator ignores your inputs; the screen is unchanged.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator appears to be in standby mode — the screen and sensors emit a dull glow, in no way reacting to your approach.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cogitator idles, dimly glowing, ignoring you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cogitator's case is covered with scratched symbols and signs thickly smeared in a pungent oily mass. You spot tiny bubbles emerging from the gleaming metal: it is almost as if the malodorous slime is seeping from these scratches like sweat oozes from pores on human skin.{/n}
  - After: {n}Scratched symbols cover the case, oozing a pungent oily slime like sweat.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The data-crypt is in place, but its slot is protected by two rows of metal claws growing straight out of the cogitator's casing. They flex under your scrutiny, clutching the device even tighter.{/n}
  - After: {n}Metal claws grow from the casing around the data-crypt, gripping tighter as you look.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch2_VS/ForgeWorld/ApostolFirstVisionDialogue/ApostolFirstVisionDialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You waste your time trying to tempt me. It is not blood that defines a person's deeds — only their will does. And my will is thus: begone from my mind!"
  - After: "Blood doesn't define deeds — will does. Begone from my mind!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am Rogue Trader {name}, sovereign of Kiava Gamma. The Warrant belongs to me alone."
  - After: "I am Rogue Trader {name}, sovereign of Kiava Gamma. The Warrant is mine."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where are we? Where have you taken me?"
  - After: "Where have you taken me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "He... said something about Theodora. About how the blood in my veins will lead me to serve Chaos."
  - After: "He spoke of Theodora. Said my blood will make me serve Chaos."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It doesn't matter. The sooner I forget about it, the better."
  - After: "It doesn't matter. Best forgotten."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are one of the Word Bearers — the cursed Legion that betrayed the Imperium."
  - After: "You're a Word Bearer — the traitor Legion."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The only way you are going to acquire my Warrant is by digging it out of the wreckage of my ship."
  - After: "Dig my Warrant out of my ship's wreckage, then."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am willing to give the Warrant to you in exchange for the blessing of your masters."
  - After: "The Warrant is yours for your masters' blessing."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am the sovereign of Kiava Gamma. This is my world, not a dominion of Chaos!"
  - After: "I rule Kiava Gamma. It's my world, not Chaos's!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Hold on. That servant of Chaos claimed that the soul of the psyker who was protecting me had already been marked by his 'lord.'"
  - After: "He said my protector psyker's soul was already marked by his 'lord.'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Sharp pain pierces your head, and the light dims in your eyes. You smell smoke and burning, you feel a wave of nausea, your legs buckle, and your knees hit the metal floor. In that same moment, the {g|Encyclopedia:Manufactorum}manufactorum{/g} surrounding you disappears in a whirlwind of mist, ash, and grey shadows.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pain, smoke, nausea — you drop to your knees as the {g|Encyclopedia:Manufactorum}manufactorum{/g} dissolves into ash.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
