A web of cracks spreads along the length of the hovering obelisk and, soon afterward, it shatters. You hear eager, snarling cackles coming from everywhere and nowhere at once — a portent of the oncoming calamity of your making.{/n}
  - After: {n}Unholy ash storms the psy-stifler, gnawing until the obelisk cracks and shatters. Snarling cackles echo from everywhere, heralding the calamity you've unleashed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Before you can put the bag away, it falls apart and seeps through your fingers to the arena floor in a pile of colourless flakes. The power that was hidden within is gone forever, its purpose unfulfilled.{/n}
  - After: {n}The bag crumbles into colourless flakes, its power gone forever.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Arena/MarazhaiAlly/MarazhaiAlly

- **Player**
  - Before: "Well, xenos, are you ready to serve me wholeheartedly and discharge your debt?"
  - After: "Ready to serve and repay your debt, xenos?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Call me a 'mon-keigh' one more time, and this partnership is over."
  - After: "Call me 'mon-keigh' again and we're done."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have no desire to die for the spectators' amusement. I take it neither do you."
  - After: "I won't die for the crowd. Nor will you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "They will take us to the Chasm now. Let us talk somewhere quiet — the Shriekers' den will do."
  - After: "To the Chasm, then. We talk in the Shriekers' den."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "So, mon-keigh..." {n}Marazhai looks at you with a strange expression as if struggling to comprehend what has just transpired.{/n} "You really are intent on escaping from the Chasm, aren't you? Bold ambitions for arena meat."
  - After: "So, mon-keigh..." {n}He looks puzzled.{/n} "You truly mean to escape?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A turn of the head, a quick glance, a subtle nod — you take notice of a wordless conversation happening among some of your companions.{/n}
  - After: {n}Companions trade glances.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}He grimaces.{/n} "I will... make an effort not to."
  - After: {n}He grimaces.{/n} "I will... try."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Never. I will break out of this arena, avoid the Cult's executioners... and make Yremeryss and Nazrakhei pay for every moment of my humiliation."
  - After: "Never. Yremeryss and Nazrakhei will pay."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Yes, we have much to discuss. I will head there now. Do not make me wait."
  - After: "Yes. Do not keep me waiting."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai shakes the blood off his blades and turns to you, battle fury still blazing in his eyes. A moment later, his lips twist into a smile.{/n} "Well, now. One can only marvel at the fickle turns of fate, Rogue Trader."
  - After: {n}Marazhai smiles, blades bloody.{/n} "Fate is fickle, Rogue Trader."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet raises her weapon, uncontained rage flashing in her eyes.{/n} "I will do what the elantach did not have the courage to do..."
  - After: {n}Yrliet raises her weapon.{/n} "I'll do what the elantach dared not..."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Sometimes we all have to contend with circumstances that make any... any ally count..." {n}Abelard is trying to convince himself, looking at the xenos in indignation and dismay.{/n}
  - After: "Any... ally counts..." {n}Abelard looks dismayed.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Ah, cousin! You have inexplicably managed to earn the forgiveness of the one you betrayed and pushed into Commorragh's embrace, and now you intend to go against {mf|his|her} will by killing me? Your lauded Asuryani restraint is failing you... much as it has before."
  - After: "Cousin! Forgiven, yet you defy {mf|his|her} will to kill me? Your restraint fails again."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet hesitates for a few moments... and shrinks under the mocking gaze of the Drukhari.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet shrinks back.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Do not entertain any illusions, little creature." {n}Marazhai's eyes narrow to two dark turquoise slits.{/n} "It is enough that I am treating you almost as an equal by agreeing to an alliance. Look for a pet xenos elsewhere."
  - After: "No illusions." {n}His eyes narrow.{/n} "An alliance is enough. Find another pet xenos."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "It is easy for you to say, Amic'Abelard. The Undying One will call upon you soon, but for how long are the rest of us supposed to tolerate this... ally..." {n}Kibellah sighs sullenly.{/n}
  - After: "Easy for you, Amic'Abelard. The Undying One calls you soon." {n}Kibellah sighs.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Soon... I beg your pardon? No, no, don't say anything, Mistress Kibellah. I will have none of it."
  - After: "Soon... pardon? Say nothing, Mistress Kibellah."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Arena/MarazhaiDefeated/MarazhaiDefeated_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Look Marazhai in the eye] "My offer still stands. Would you consider switching sides?"
  - After: [Look Marazhai in the eye] "My offer stands. Switch sides?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "You will answer for everything you have wrought!"
  - After: [Attack] "You'll answer for everything!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "In the name of the God-Emperor!"
  - After: [Attack] "For the God-Emperor!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I was told I would be facing untested fighters, not the champions of the arena!"
  - After: "I was promised untested fighters, not champions!"
- **Bloodstained Proselyte**
  - Before: {n}One of the Wyches lets out an acerbic laugh.{/n} "I doubt Yremeryss will change her mind. And Sinisthoria will surely not want to give up her new plaything."
  - After: {n}A Wych laughs.{/n} "Yremeryss won't relent, nor Sinisthoria."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai grips his blades with such strength that you can hear the scraping of his gauntlets against the handles.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai grips his blades.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Elantach..." {n}Yrliet chokes, unable to continue.{/n}
  - After: "Elantach..." {n}Yrliet chokes.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}The tormented expression in Marazhai's eyes vanishes — to be replaced with the malevolent resolve you have come to know.{/n} "Your offer is accepted, mon-keigh."
  - After: {n}He steels.{/n} "Accepted, mon-keigh."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai glances at the Wyches, his eyes brimming with a sea of powerless rage. A moment later, he looks at you. His expression changes slightly, one eyebrow arching as if he is trying to make some agonising decision.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai fumes, then eyes you, deciding.{/n}
- **Aebys**
  - Before: "What did you say, you arrogant wretch?"
  - After: "What, wretch?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah gasps in shock.{/n} "How am I to protect you from xenos if you welcome the vilest of them into your honoured retinue?"
  - After: {n}Kibellah gasps.{/n} "You welcome the vilest xenos?"
- **Aebys**
  - Before: {n}Aebys runs his fingers along the edge of his blade.{/n} "Your former captives. You have a chance to rectify the mistake that made you forfeit your Archon's favour."
  - After: {n}Aebys smirks.{/n} "Your former captives. Regain your Archon's favour."
- **Aebys**
  - Before: "The plans have changed, mon-keigh." {n}Aebys bares his teeth.{/n} "Keykeross wishes to teach Tervantias a lesson. Refuse like you has no place in the Chasm — you should be hanging from the spikes of the arena."
  - After: "Plans changed." {n}Aebys grins.{/n} "Keykeross wants to teach Tervantias a lesson."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "{name}, did you take too many hits to the head? You're not going to...? Are you?"
  - After: "{name}, hit your head? You're not...?"
- **Bloodstained Proselyte**
  - Before: "Foolish mon-keigh! The former Dracon of the Reaving Tempest is the property of the Cult and only the Succubi have the right—"
  - After: "Fool! The former Dracon belongs to the Cult—"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Ha! A fine jest! {mf|He|She} is joking, yes?" {n}Ulfar catches your eye, and the humour evaporates from his face.{/n} "Troll balls, you're not joking!"
  - After: "Ha! {mf|He|She} jests?" {n}Ulfar sees your face.{/n} "Troll balls!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard sighs and comments quietly:{/n} "Welcome to our fraternity of the perplexed, my lord Ulfar! Get used to it. The Rogue Trader never fails to astonish."
  - After: {n}Abelard sighs.{/n} "Welcome to the perplexed, Ulfar."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Arena/ThirdBattleWon/ThirdBattleWon_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Will you go to your master now?"
  - After: "Going to your master now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "You will pay for your betrayal!"
  - After: [Attack] "Pay for your betrayal!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "In spite of your transgressions... I wish you luck."
  - After: "Despite your crimes... good luck."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would end you here and now were it not for the hope that Commorragh would be more cruel to you than anything I could punish you with."
  - After: "I'd end you, but Commorragh will punish you worse."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Will you go to Tervantias now?"
  - After: "Going to Tervantias now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It feels odd to say this, but... good luck to you."
  - After: "Oddly... good luck to you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I hope your death will be sufficiently agonising."
  - After: "I hope your death is agonising."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Come along. I will get you out of here."
  - After: "Come. I'll get you out."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An unfamiliar monster, even more terrifying than the previous one of the Haemonculus's servants, bars your way. Its voice is as dry as death itself.{/n} "Master Tervantias sent me."
  - After: {n}A worse monster blocks you.{/n} "Tervantias sent me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas's voice quiets, becoming soft and insinuating, almost like it was in his former life.{/n} "I wish you luck, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I do not believe you will prevail, but you might be able to make a more honourable exit than I did."
  - After: {n}Achilleas softens.{/n} "Luck, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Exit better than I did."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas lets out a growl that must count for laughter now, then falls silent for a while. At last, he says in a quiet rumble,{/n} "A return to the Imperium does not bode well for me. Traitor, monster, spawn of corruption — a bonfire is all I will find there. But perhaps it is the right way."
  - After: {n}He growls.{/n} "The Imperium means a bonfire for me. Perhaps rightly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I doubt that it will smile upon me, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But I thank you nonetheless."
  - After: "Doubtful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Thanks."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I cannot fault you. So be it." {n}Achilleas makes no attempt to dodge your attack, as if eager to end his twisted, wretched existence that has gone on for too long.{/n}
  - After: "So be it." {n}He welcomes the blow.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Huh?" {n}The abomination stares at you for a while, then nods.{/n} "Yes."
  - After: "Huh?" {n}It nods.{/n} "Yes."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The abomination shrugs indifferently.{/n} "Perhaps. That's life in the spires."
  - After: {n}It shrugs.{/n} "Spire life."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The monstrosity jerks, bracing itself for your attack, but then something bursts inside its body and its limbs go slack.{/n}
  - After: {n}It braces, then goes slack.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I believe your hopes are well founded, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Farewell."
  - After: "Indeed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Farewell."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "A traitor cannot be healed, nor restored to even a fraction of his former self. Yet, to leave him in this marred state... is unmerciful." {n}Eogunn casts a gaze upon your weapon, then looks directly into your eyes.{/n} "Rogue Trader, I beg you, be merciful."
  - After: "He cannot be healed. Leaving him so is cruel." {n}Eogunn looks at you.{/n} "Be merciful."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No. His interest in me had run dry, so he let me go. Now... I do not know. Perhaps I'll try to live. Or maybe I'll try to die. I am still debating."
  - After: "No. He tired of me. Live or die? Undecided."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The master has sent me to tell you that he... equipped his servant with emergency measures... so that no harm might come to you." {n}Even as it dies, the monster is unable to stop parroting the words of its treacherous master.{/n}
  - After: "The master... ensured your safety." {n}It parrots him, dying.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The master doesn't need me anymore. I'll go kill someone. Get their pieces. And make myself stronger."
  - After: "Master's done with me. I'll kill and grow stronger."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "He had almost convinced me that I was a monster. A monster would not follow you back. If I go, I will prove him wrong. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I accept your offer to enter your service once more... as short as that service may be. Please allow me to enter the fray first."
  - After: "He nearly convinced me I was a monster. I'll prove him wrong. Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I accept your service. Let me lead the fray."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Surely we are not going to leave Master Scalander to suffer in this doomed body, are we? Death must come as atonement for his crimes. And a mercy that will wash away these... horrible, painful, and poisonous hues from his disfigured soul."
  - After: "Don't leave Master Scalander suffering. Death would be atonement and mercy."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Whatever for? What awaits me in the Imperium? I am a cursed soul and I should stay among souls as cursed as I am. Regardless, I am grateful for your mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "I belong among the cursed. Still, thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Arena/Wrack_FirstFight/Wrack_FirstFight_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the fighters] "This abomination says that our death is certain. But even in death, there is a choice: to be butchered like cattle or to die for the Imperium. Do not let the xenos decide your fate! May you leave this life with the Emperor's name on your lips!"
  - After: [Address the fighters] "Death is certain, but we choose how: as cattle, or for the Imperium. Die with the Emperor's name on your lips!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Commissar, it's an ambush!"
  - After: "Commissar, an ambush!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The Commissar has betrayed us, comrades! This is a trap!"
  - After: "The Commissar betrayed us! A trap!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am ready to fight."
  - After: "I'm ready to fight."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What did you do to me, foul spawn?"
  - After: "What did you do to me, spawn?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the monster] "I would like a deal. We have no desire to participate in fights."
  - After: [Address the monster] "A deal. We don't want to fight."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What will I receive should I emerge victorious?"
  - After: "What do I get if I win?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Fall to your knees] "I am begging you, get me out of this place! I am no gladiator, I am a dignitary!"
  - After: [Fall to your knees] "Please, get me out! I'm a dignitary, not a gladiator!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The Commissar has turned out to be yet another traitor. I believe I am starting to see how this game is played."
  - After: "Another traitor. I'm learning this game."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Draw your weapon] "You think you can force me to do your bidding, do you?"
  - After: [Draw your weapon] "You think you can force me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Give the monster a vicious smile] "Are you offering me a chance to skin a few of your friends? I can hardly wait!"
  - After: [Give the monster a vicious smile] "A chance to skin your friends? Can't wait!"
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "But should you kill something after all, do it painfully. Unless the masters' craving for death agony is sated, they will release me into the arena. And you will regret that. Got it?"
  - After: "Kill painfully, or they release me."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "Off with you, meat."
  - After: "Off, meat."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The gladiators around you are exchanging anxious smiles. Whatever awaits you all fills them with a mixture of terror and anticipation.{/n}
  - After: {n}Gladiators smile anxiously.{/n}
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}The moment you cross the portal, you realise that something is amiss. The thousands of Drukhari all around you, the towering bulk of abnormally bloated muscle whose face is hidden behind a black mask — none of it fits the Commissar's description of a "quiet dock."{/n}
  - After: {n}Thousands of Drukhari, a masked giant. No "quiet dock."{/n}
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "They are about to unleash fighters and beasts that will seek to eviscerate you, so try to survive until the end of the fight, meat. No one is expecting more from you."
  - After: "Beasts come. Survive, meat."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}Seeing as you are conscious, the monster looms over you and says in a voice that is hoarse with anger,{/n} "Do not play any more games with me, meat, or I will throw you out, forever broken."
  - After: {n}It looms.{/n} "No games, meat."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}The monster fixes you with a look of contempt and turns away, without deigning to entertain such a ludicrous proposition.{/n}
  - After: {n}It turns away, contemptuous.{/n}
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "No. But they can." {n}The creature is gloating, that much is clear.{/n}
  - After: "No. They can." {n}It gloats.{/n}
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}A gloating laugh comes from behind the black mask.{/n} "Then try to keep your dignity from being mangled."
  - After: {n}It laughs.{/n} "Guard your dignity, then."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "Then try not to die the most pathetic death."
  - After: "Don't die pathetically."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}The creature leans down to get a better look at you, then says acerbically,{/n} "Your life. But do not concern yourself. You will not win."
  - After: {n}It sneers.{/n} "Your life. You'll lose."
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "Farewell, comrades. Deceiving, manipulating, and nudging you toward your deaths has been an honour and a pleasure!" {n}The Commissar jumps into the closing portal before anyone gets a chance to stop him.{/n}
  - After: "Farewell, comrades. A pleasure!" {n}The Commissar leaps through the portal.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar laughs in your face.{/n} "How perceptive! You should join the Inquisition!"
  - After: {n}He laughs.{/n} "Join the Inquisition!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Impossible... He—" {n}Argenta's eyes flash with fury.{/n} "You will pay, treacherous serpent! You will pay for all our brothers and sisters! How many have you led to their deaths? Confess!"
  - After: {n}Argenta rages.{/n} "Serpent! How many have you killed? Confess!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With a roar, some of the fighters make the sign of the Aquila and ready their grenades. Their pale fingers clutch the pins as they steel themselves for a fight to the inevitable death, intent on taking as many enemies of Humanity with them as they can.{/n}
  - After: {n}Fighters make the Aquila, readying grenades.{/n}
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}The monster scoffs.{/n} "Pretty words. I hope your death will be pretty enough to match them."
  - After: {n}It scoffs.{/n} "Pretty words. Die prettily."
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "It's all right, you won't be so gullible next time. Oh wait — there won't be a next time!" {n}The Commissar makes no effort to conceal the sarcastic mockery in his voice.{/n}
  - After: "No next time for you!" {n}He mocks.{/n}
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: {n}Satisfied cackling booms from behind the monster's black mask.{/n} "Foolish meat! Falls for the same trick every time. Here is what happens to you now."
  - After: {n}It cackles.{/n} "Same trick every time!"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Kae-morag, this is another trap!" {n}Yrliet backs away, clenching the weapon in her hands, then turns abruptly to the Commissar.{/n} "You knew you were leading us to the slaughter, mon-keigh! Yes... you knew."
  - After: "Kae-morag, a trap!" {n}Yrliet turns.{/n} "You knew, mon-keigh!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Saints' blood, I will rip out your throat with my own hands!"
  - After: "Saints' blood, I'll rip your throat!"
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "You're amusing. Overconfident fools like you always die first."
  - After: "Amusing. Your kind die first."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}A stifled roar escapes Solomorne's throat, and Glaito bares his teeth, his lumens flickering wildly.{/n} "How many more of you bastards must I..."
  - After: {n}Solomorne roars; Glaito snarls.{/n} "How many more bastards..."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}The Arbitrator clutches his forehead with his metal hand.{/n} "No! Not now, not again!"
  - After: {n}He clutches his head.{/n} "Not again!"
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}The Proctor exhales fiercely.{/n} "No, I won't lose my grip again. Not over scum like you. I will sentence you with dignity, as befits an Arbitrator."
  - After: {n}The Proctor steadies.{/n} "I'll sentence you as an Arbitrator."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Consciousness returns to you in a flash of light. This has happened to you too often lately.{/n}
  - After: {n}You wake. Again.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "Oh, so many, Sister! Even more than usual lately, ever since volunteers started flocking to the sounds of your sweet sermons!"
  - After: "So many, Sister! Your sermons help!"
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "The gladiatorial arena of the Cult of the Fatal Thirst. This is where masters come for a new youth and where pathetic meat from the Chasm is brought to die."
  - After: "The Cult of the Fatal Thirst's arena. Masters regain youth; meat dies."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "...eviscerate you, so try to survive until the end of the fight, meat. No one expects more from you." {n}The hollow voice belongs to the giant that so guilefully neutralised you with gas.{/n}
  - After: "...survive, meat." {n}The giant who gassed you.{/n}

  - Before: {n}The monster's voice becomes strangely calm, almost human-like.{/n} "I won't. But they will leave you no choice."
  - After: {n}It calms.{/n} "They'll leave you no choice."
- **Rage of the Arena**
  - Before: "You have brought good meat. You have done well, Commissar." {n}The creature's guttural voice emanates menace.{/n}
  - After: "Good meat, Commissar." {n}It menaces.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "It can't be! Fight valiantly, my comrades-in-arms! The Imperium will not forget you!" {n}The Commissar makes no effort to conceal the sarcastic mockery in his voice.{/n}
  - After: "Fight on, comrades! The Imperium won't forget!" {n}He mocks.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The gladiator nods impassively. Perhaps intoxicants and stimulants have boiled his brain, or he does not care at whose behest he kills.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/Anger/Anger_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "But why? What is in it for you?"
  - After: "Why? What's in it for you?"

  - Before: "Xenos scum! You set me up! I am not one of your gladiators!"
  - After: "Xenos scum! You set me up! I'm no gladiator!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I must take my leave."
  - After: "I must go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What are the Shriekers? A gang of criminals?"
  - After: "Are the Shriekers criminals?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have some questions."
  - After: "I have questions."

  - Before: "He is of no use in this state. Let us draw what benefit we can from him — he can recruit new Shriekers for us."
  - After: "He's useless like this. Let him recruit new Shriekers for us."

  - Before: "I have no more questions."

  - Before: "There is actually something dignified about this grim readiness to die."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice's translucent eyelid membranes are closed. His voice is drowsy and languid.{/n} "You alive, humanling? You really must be someone after all, if the arena spared you. Well, you should celebrate — from this day on, you're a Shrieker. My protection, shelter, and equipment are now yours to claim."
  - After: {n}Malice drawls.{/n} "Alive, humanling? Then you're a Shrieker now: my protection and gear are yours."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Humanling. Relax with us. Take a stimulant and enjoy yourself."
  - After: "Relax. Take a stimulant."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hmm. I couldn't care less why you're here. My guess is you were dumped. The Chasm is a cesspit. Everything gets thrown in here — rubbish, bodies, prisoners... It all simmers together until the Drukhari masters fish out whatever they need from the pot. Fighters. Entertainment. Living flesh."
  - After: "Don't care. The Chasm is a cesspit; the Drukhari fish out what they need."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This is the Chasm. The place where those destined for the arena of the Wych Cult of the Fatal Thirst eke out their existence. It's also where the Haemonculus's cast-offs end up. Tervantias from the Coven of the Baleful Thorn — he has his own little nook where he conducts his experiments. The Chasm is an endless source of... raw material for his work, and the best results are destined for the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest — the patron of the Wych Cult and of Tervantias in particular."
  - After: "The Chasm, home to the Fatal Thirst's arena fodder. Tervantias of the Coven of the Baleful Thorn experiments here, for the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We are gladiators — we go into the arena to rip helpless meat to shreds, then we become the helpless meat ourselves.   - After: "We shred meat, then become meat. Certain death teaches you to enjoy life."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Have it your way. It will be funny if your own greed and arrogance get you killed."
  - After: "Fine. Greed may kill you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You're a touchy one, humanling. Fine, fine, I owe you." {n}Malice carelessly rifles through his own gear, unclips something from his belt without looking, and tosses it to you.{/n} "There's your compensation."
  - After: "Touchy. Fine." {n}Malice tosses you something.{/n} "Compensation."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You shouldn't have done that. You don't know when to stop, humanling. Now my Shriekers will have to finish what the arena started. And I'll watch you draw your last breath."
  - After: "Mistake. My Shriekers will finish you while I watch."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The name is an accurate reflection of my nature, more or less. It was given to me by Gipaeral, Archon of the Kabal of the Sheared Tongue. He was a competent master and he knew his servants well, which is why he didn't trust any of them and gave me the honour of guarding him."
  - After: "It fits. Gipaeral, Archon of the Sheared Tongue, named me. I guarded him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hmm... So you do know how to enjoy yourself. Maybe I'll look into your suggestion. Hear that, Commissar? What should we sew on you?"
  - After: "Fun idea. What should we sew on, Commissar?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ask away, humanling. But try not to bore me with your chatter."
  - After: "Ask. Don't bore me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Criminal... In Commorragh, the word sounds like a joke. The Shriekers are a gang of the doomed. They live in expectation of their inevitable death in the arena. And that death makes a lot more sense than all the other deaths on offer in the Dark City."
  - After: "Criminal? A joke here. Shriekers are doomed to the arena."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice's voice turns wistful.{/n} "Commorragh is hidden on the underside of existence and is stitched together from scraps of various dimensions and spaces. Long ago, the Aeldari created this place as a port, but now it is their refuge from She Who Thirsts. Commorragh has more bleeding spires than you can count, powered by the energy of stolen suns. An eternal war for power rages here, ambitions and passions are the fuel in the fire of an endless conflict of open clashes and covert treachery."
  - After: {n}Malice turns wistful.{/n} "Commorragh hides beneath reality, once an Aeldari port, now refuge from She Who Thirsts. Endless spires, endless treachery."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And what are you going to do? Force me to kill him? Let him go? And if I refuse, are you going to fight me? For the sake of this — what did you call him? Reprobate? I'd like to see that."
  - After: "You'll fight me for this reprobate? I'd like to see it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Sslyth? My kind were a greedy people. We always wanted more, and that's why we were rapacious and indomitable. Nothing could sate our growing appetite. Some called it the fall of our civilisation. But they did not understand the realisation we had come to — that no one needs other people. All you need is yourself."
  - After: "The Sslyth were greedy and indomitable. Then we scattered, and learned: all you need is yourself."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Good. In Commorragh, unnecessary questions can kill you quicker than a blade."
  - After: "Good. Questions kill here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I only just saved you and now you're trying to kill me. You've learned how to live in the spires, I see. Shriekers, kill the humanling slowly. I want to enjoy {mf|his|her} torment."
  - After: "I saved you, and now this? Shriekers, kill slowly. I want {mf|his|her} torment."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake laughs and leans toward you.{/n} "Oh yeah, we're really dignified. Death is a rare and exquisite event that only happens once in your life. Only an idiot would fear it and avoid thinking about it."
  - After: {n}The snake laughs.{/n} "Death comes once. Only idiots fear it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake laughs and leans toward you.{/n} "That's what you think. Yes, they're just livestock, but I'm the shepherd who gathers them into a herd so the Haemonculus's servants don't have to trouble themselves running all over the Chasm catching meat for the arena."
  - After: {n}The snake laughs.{/n} "Livestock, yes. I'm their shepherd for the Haemonculus."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake laughs and leans toward you.{/n} "But you're not going to resign yourself, is that it? You're not asking for my help, you're not going to work for me, not going to kill in exchange for security and comfort? Right?"
  - After: {n}The snake laughs.{/n} "And you won't give up or work for me?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't think you do. Not yet, at any rate. But witness a few more deaths, and then you really will see."
  - After: "Not yet. You will."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake laughs and leans toward you.{/n} "They believe every word of it. And as long as there are enough believers, the Haemonculus's servants won't drag me off to the arena. Why would they go to the effort of catching meat for the arena when it's all here waiting for them?"
  - After: {n}The snake laughs.{/n} "They believe. So the arena takes them, not me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice's mouth opens disturbingly wide, revealing long, dagger-like teeth. He stares at the head with naked hunger in his eyes.{/n} "A fine offering. His mangy brain would make the perfect snack, but... I have a better idea. Well done, humanling."
  - After: {n}Malice eyes the head hungrily.{/n} "Fine offering. Well done."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your conversation is rudely interrupted by a crash and thundering footsteps.{/n}
  - After: {n}A crash interrupts.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Now is when I should hold up my end of the deal and remove the mind maggot from your body... But even if I tried to, I doubt you'd survive. I'm a fighter, not a hacker of flesh. I lied to get you to act fast. That's just life in the spires, you see."
  - After: "I can't remove the mind maggot; you'd die. I lied so you'd hurry."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why are you shouting, humanling? I'm not denying anything."
  - After: "I don't deny it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It's in you. And you'll die soon. The only thing I lied about was being able to save you. The rest of it is true."
  - After: "It's real. You'll die soon. I only lied about saving you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Good to see how fast you're getting the hang of things in Commorragh. It's really a nice way to live."
  - After: "You learn fast."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice shrugs.{/n} "How would I know? None of the living refuse you'll find lying around here in the Chasm, that's for sure. Maybe a Haemonculus could cut that shit out of your body without... changing you too much in the process."
  - After: {n}Malice shrugs.{/n} "Maybe a Haemonculus could cut it out."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Let's see what Malice has to lavish upon one of his Shriekers."
  - After: "Let's see your gear."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If I gave you that, it would all be too easy for you. When you leave, I'll enjoy wondering if next time I see you, it'll be in one piece or several. Don't spoil my fun."
  - After: "Too easy. Don't spoil my fun."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You're starting to understand how we do things here in the Chasm, humanling. Think about the future, not the past, and trust no one."
  - After: "Learning. Trust no one."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Like everyone else here. No, his crime was something else — he got in my way. As for the treachery and killing, I have no complaints."
  - After: "His crime was crossing me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The two humanlings have plotted against me — how predictable! Shriekers, kill the humanling slowly, I want to enjoy {mf|his|her} torment."
  - After: "A plot! Shriekers, kill slowly. I want {mf|his|her} torment."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Learn from me while you're still alive. You humanlings don't have any sense of humour, but you're lucky to have met me."
  - After: "Learn from me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What do you mean 'us'? Watch how you use that word — it makes me antsy. There is me, my gang, and my recruits. As for the Commissar, it suits me best to have him in this useless state. It's a huge improvement on how he was before — unusually damaging."
  - After: "'Us'? Careful. He suits me useless."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have no idea. But a maestro needs an orchestra, and in the spires, there's only one kind of music — screams of agony. I'd go looking for your maestro in the Anatomical Opera."
  - After: "No idea. Try the Anatomical Opera."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Interesting. There's a soul inside, right? I wonder if it's possible to make it suffer... I'll give you my most skilled and savvy Shrieker for it. You could do with a decent fighter, right?"
  - After: "A soul inside? I'll trade my best Shrieker."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice summons one of the gladiators — a lean, twitchy human with animal brutality in his eyes.{/n} "This is... I don't know this humanling's name. Let's call him Meat. Meat is a good fighter, and he's my gift to you. Meat, this is your new {mf|master|mistress}. Fight well and die for {mf|him|her}."
  - After: {n}Malice summons a twitchy human.{/n} "Meat. Your new {mf|master|mistress}. Die for {mf|him|her}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Chasm is controlled by the Fatal Thirst — not the biggest Wych Cult, but an old and respected one. Three Succubi stand at its head — Tazarra, Keykeross, and Sinisthoria, the most influential of all. But Tazarra disappeared not long ago, and Sinisthoria's been lying low ever since she forged an alliance between her Cult and the Reaving Tempest. So the deadly Keykeross is in charge of the arena."
  - After: "The Fatal Thirst rules the Chasm. Of its Succubi, Tazarra vanished and Sinisthoria lies low after allying with the Reaving Tempest, so Keykeross runs the arena."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice laughs nastily.{/n} "You wanted my help, didn't you? Well, I help Shriekers. And when a Drukhari messenger comes to my den, they go off to the arena nice and quietly, and they try to survive. That's life in the spires."
  - After: {n}Malice laughs.{/n} "When the Drukhari call, Shriekers go quietly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar merely looks you in the eye with a brazen smirk. It seems he is able to find amusement even in a situation like this.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Commissar smirks.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I like looking at him. Suffering, helpless, so... comforting. And when he starts threatening me in that little rasping voice—"
  - After: "I like watching him suffer—"
- **Commissar**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar lets out a burbling rasp. It is surprising how much murderous rage can be infused into such a brief sound.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Commissar rasps murderously.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But now I'll look out for you. I'll give you shelter, and good weapons, armour, and combat stimulants that will make your mind light and easy. What's not to like, humanling?" {n}Malice appears relaxed, but the lazy drawl in his voice seems forced.{/n}
  - After: "Now you get shelter, weapons, stimulants." {n}His calm seems forced.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There's nothing in it for me. In the spires, plenty of things are done for no good reason, just because, or for pleasure. This is Commorragh — a moment's pleasure here is often the only sliver between your life and death. I was having a delectable time while you were still in the dark. That's what I got out of it."
  - After: "Nothing. Just pleasure, watching you in the dark."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Archon liked to watch me savage the assassins sent to kill him, and he named me Malice. I fended off a hundred attempts on Gipaeral's life, and only once was I too slow — but that was enough to lose my employer. And now I'm here."
  - After: "I stopped a hundred assassins. Once too slow, and lost Gipaeral."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The tops of the spires are the domain of the Kabal Archons, and reigning over all is Asdrubael Vect, the Supreme Overlord of the Kabal of the Black Heart. You will see them, the ruling elite, when you die in the arena, and they will feed on your suffering and gain new youth through it. They seem eternal, they live so long... but they will die one day. Commorragh itself will die — it has been dying for thousands of years already, disintegrating at its foundation. Nothing in this world is eternal."
  - After: "Archons rule the spires, above all Asdrubael Vect of the Kabal of the Black Heart. They'll feed on your death. Yet even Commorragh is dying."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The arena is the giver of life in Commorragh. Without the psychic sustenance created by pain and suffering, the masters of the Dark City would die off — it's just how they are made. The hungry come to the arena to gorge themselves. And the Wych Cults that rule the arenas ply their guests with bloody spectacles and heinous torture."
  - After: "The masters need suffering to live. Wych Cults feed them spectacle."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake's eyes glitter malevolently.{/n} "You did. I realised I wasn't finished with this lump of meat, so I stitched it back on. The result was... imperfect. Then again, your race are defective to begin with, so a few more flaws like madness and regular attempts to drink your own blood aren't very noticeable."
  - After: {n}The snake grins.{/n} "I stitched it back on. Imperfectly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Don't get ahead of yourself. You killed him once, and that's it. He's my plaything now, and I'll be the only one to kill him. As many times as I want."
  - After: "He's my plaything. Only I kill him."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos is clearly more comfortable now — the sleepy torpor induced by the low temperature has been replaced with the languid ease of an undisputed leader in his element.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Everyone gathered here is armed. They all bear scars, and some even have fresh wounds. You notice a few humans among the xenos. They clamour in a mishmash of tongues, and their laughter rings with lunacy and bloodlust. The air is thick with an all-pervading sense of doom.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your trained eye does not fail to notice that virtually everyone in this place is under the influence of some substance or other, and powerful ones at that. It seems you have wound up in a narcotics den.{/n}

  - Before: {n}The leader of this gang is powerfully built — his scaled hide is reinforced with engraved metal in several spots.   - After: {n}Tail coiling:{/n} "Stop dithering, humanling."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake-like xenos either fails to notice your presence or is simply ignoring you. Iridescent eyelid membranes slide over his eyes, momentarily shuttering them — no doubt a telling look among his kind.{/n}
  - After: {n}The xenos ignores you, eyelids shuttering.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What makes you think I care? No — don't answer. I don't care what makes you think that."
  - After: "Why would I care?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Narrowing his eyes in satisfaction, Malice growls,{/n} "A little more."
  - After: {n}Malice narrows his eyes.{/n} "A little more."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His serpentine head turns to you with inhuman fluidity, his forked tongue tasting the air.{/n} "I am Malice. You are an inconvenience. Get lost, or you'll find out how Malice deals with inconveniences, humanling."
  - After: {n}Tongue flicking:{/n} "I am Malice. Get lost, humanling."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You have nothing. Don't waste my time." {n}The xenos keeps his attention focused on the Drukhari, but his scaled fingers holding an elegant-looking injector clench in displeasure. He speaks slowly and indolently like a snake about to enter brumation.{/n}
  - After: "You have nothing. Don't waste my time." {n}He clenches his injector.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos's casual tone is full of contempt.{/n} "This place does not believe in promises, humanling. Commorragh believes only in strength and spilt blood. You have spilt plenty of your own blood on my floor, and I see no strength in you."
  - After: {n}Contempt.{/n} "Commorragh believes only in strength and blood. You have no strength."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Wasting no time, you approach the scaled ringleader of this rabble.{/n}
  - After: {n}You approach the ringleader.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He gestures with his fingers imperiously, as if dismissing you. The motion is slow and full of sweet sluggishness.{/n}
  - After: {n}He waves you off.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari's head shatters, and some of the scraps stick to the snake-like xenos's face. You now have his undivided attention — and that of everyone else in the room.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Drukhari's head shatters. Now everyone watches you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos's idle apathy drops in an instant, his tail coils as he readies himself to strike, but... he freezes. His eyes are transfixed on the barrel of the pistol aimed at his face. With a satisfied hiss, he says,{/n} "I respect the fearless. What do you want?"
  - After: {n}He coils, then freezes before your pistol.{/n} "I respect the fearless. What do you want?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos's idle apathy drops in an instant, and his tail coils as he readies himself to strike. You try to anticipate his attack with a pistol shot, but he is too quick.{/n}
  - After: {n}He coils. You fire, but he is quicker.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With a menacing hiss, the xenos says grimly,{/n} "You thought that would be enough to kill me?"
  - After: {n}He hisses,{/n} "You thought that would kill me?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ha! Many dream of that... And how do you imagine that would work? You think I'm going to take you there in my voidship? I don't have one."
  - After: "Ha! How? I have no voidship."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And what will you give me in return?"
  - After: "And what will you give me?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Through the drumbeat of your heart, you hear Malice's voice from somewhere far away:{/n} "Patch up the humanling. {mf|He|She} has character. I like those ones."
  - After: {n}Malice, far away:{/n} "Patch up the humanling. {mf|He|She} has character."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He casts a sidelong glance at you and says sceptically,{/n} "Not for you, by the looks of it."
  - After: {n}Sceptical:{/n} "Not for you, it seems."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So go and look for them elsewhere."
  - After: "Then look elsewhere."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos's eyes start flickering hypnotically. You sense a subtle, unhealthy curiosity in his tone as he points at your wounds:{/n} "You are bleeding like a butchered carcass. Are you in pain?"
  - After: {n}Curious:{/n} "You're bleeding. Are you in pain?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He does not hide his disappointment.{/n} "Talk, talk, talk. That's all you pathetic humanlings are good for."
  - After: {n}Disappointed:{/n} "Talk, talk. Pathetic humanlings."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos stares at you with a hungry look in his eyes.{/n} "Prove it."
  - After: {n}Hungrily:{/n} "Prove it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice's eyes flash with menace and he says mockingly,{/n} "Here, I'll help you."
  - After: {n}Menacing:{/n} "Here, I'll help."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Judging by his pleased expression, the xenos is enjoying himself.{/n} "Hurt yourself. Now."
  - After: {n}Pleased:{/n} "Hurt yourself. Now."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His expression changes to that of lazy annoyance and he brushes you off half-heartedly.{/n} "Then go and die on your own. Killing you would be too boring."
  - After: {n}Annoyed:{/n} "Then die alone. Killing you is boring."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}This particular breed of abominable xenos is unfamiliar to you, but its appearance alone speaks of a vicious nature and inborn wickedness.{/n}
  - After: {n}An unknown, vicious-looking xenos breed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That was an agent that we Sslyth inject to protect ourselves from the cold. I can only guess what it's doing to your bloodstream right now... But I am impressed by your fortitude — and your limitless nerve. What do you want from me?"
  - After: "That's our Sslyth cold-ward agent. Who knows what it does to you. Your nerve impresses me. What do you want?"
- **Malice's Servant**
  - Before: {n}Without deigning to look at you, the cadaverous Drukhari mutters,{/n} "Malice wants you to disappear, pathetic whelp."
  - After: {n}The Drukhari mutters,{/n} "Malice wants you gone, whelp."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You watch in detached surprise as drops of something red spray slowly through the air. Is that your blood? The clawed hand that has sliced open your throat leaves behind a crimson trail. Surprise is the last emotion you feel before your consciousness goes dark for good.{/n}
  - After: {n}A claw slashes your throat. Then darkness.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos is now staring at you intently, his gaze depraved.{/n} "More."
  - After: {n}Depraved stare.{/n} "More."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your knees buckle, and you fall. A shrieking cry of agony erupts from your throat.{/n}
  - After: {n}You collapse, shrieking.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What use could you be to me...?" {n}The xenos yawns sleepily, his mouth opening disproportionately wide.{/n} "But if you want to serve, I have a task for you. The den's temperature is controlled by an atmospheric convector. The scavenger who sold it to me forgot to mention that it was faulty. Unfortunately for him, he was unable to repair it. Now the scavenger is dead, and I have to suffer the discomfort."
  - After: "What use are you?" {n}He yawns.{/n} "But here's a task. The den's atmospheric convector is faulty. Its seller couldn't fix it, so he's dead, and I'm cold."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why should I?" {n}Malice looks at you with contempt.{/n} "The convector's fixed already. What's the point in me helping you?"
  - After: "Why? The convector's already fixed." {n}Contempt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice hisses in disappointment.{/n} "You have been interesting for a pitifully short time, humanling. Do not displease me again. I detest fickleness."
  - After: {n}He hisses.{/n} "I detest fickleness, humanling. Don't displease me again."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Will you, now? Going to pin your hopes on my good and gentle nature, famed throughout the Chasm?"
  - After: "Relying on my famous gentleness?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why shouldn't I? I'm allowed to enjoy myself. Or perhaps it's just that I don't believe you're capable of anything more."
  - After: "I like my fun. Or maybe you can't do more."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Then you can use your pride to bandage your wounds, and plug up the holes in your hide with honour."
  - After: "Then bandage yourself with pride."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hurry. Looking at your wounds, you don't have long to get the job done."
  - After: "Hurry. Your wounds won't wait."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Through the drumbeat of your heart, you hear Malice's voice from somewhere far away:{/n} "Fine, patch up the humanling. {mf|He|She}'s proven to be more useful than the rest of you put together."
  - After: {n}Malice, far away:{/n} "Fine, patch up the humanling. {mf|He|She}'s more useful than all of you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Before anyone can react, you seize the scaled xenos's companion and sink your teeth into her neck. A pop — and a fountain of scarlet blood gushes over your face, while the Drukhari gurgles in astonishment. You greedily gulp down the hot red liquid, staring into Malice's eyes, and you sense warmth spreading euphorically through your body.{/n}
  - After: {n}You bite the Drukhari's neck and gulp her blood, staring at Malice. Warmth floods you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Malice watches spellbound, frozen like a small animal that has sighted a predator. Try as he may to hide it, you can sense the fear rolling off him in waves. When you have slaked your thirst, he slowly says,{/n} "You are one {mf|sick bastard|twisted bitch}. What do you want?"
  - After: {n}Malice freezes, afraid.{/n} "You are one {mf|sick bastard|twisted bitch}. What do you want?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You clench your teeth and endure the torment without making a sound. You have had worse. You have {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}known{/d} pain that was far more harrowing and dismaying.{/n}
  - After: {n}You endure silently. You've {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}known{/d} worse.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos hisses his approval as you squeeze and mangle your own flesh. While the pain is unbearable at first, you grow more and more accustomed to it, and you begin to find it... sweet? You feel your blood pounding in your ears, you hear the xenos's cackling... and your own.{/n}
  - After: {n}You mangle your flesh until the pain turns sweet. You both cackle.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You have heard of this breed of xenos — the Sslyth. These creatures can often be found in the entourages of powerful Drukhari lords, where they serve as bodyguards and champions. They are just as depraved and vicious as their masters, but theirs is a more primitive intellect and they are driven by baser needs.{/n}
  - After: {n}A Sslyth: depraved bodyguards of Drukhari lords, primitive and driven by base needs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He responds in a mocking yet satisfied tone,{/n} "You beg? Go ahead, show me. I like it when they grovel before me."
  - After: {n}Mocking:{/n} "You beg? Show me. I like grovelling."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos's voice becomes demanding.{/n} "I. Said. Grovel."
  - After: {n}Demanding:{/n} "I. Said. Grovel."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That was an agent that we Sslyth inject to protect ourselves from the cold. But I can only guess what it's doing to your body right now. I suppose whatever happens now can be considered an act of mercy."
  - After: "That's our Sslyth cold-ward agent. Who knows what it does to you. Call what comes next mercy."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/Anger_NowYouAreOk/Anger_NowYouAreOk_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm going to need a more serious weapon."
  - After: "I need a better weapon."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Thank you for your help."
  - After: "Thanks for your help."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Enough talk. Help me up."
  - After: "Enough. Help me up."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I owe you. What is your price?"
  - After: "I owe you. Your price?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Wait silently for the xenos to continue]
  - After: [Wait silently]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why did you decide to help me in the end?"
  - After: "Why did you help me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What is a mind maggot?"
  - After: "What's a mind maggot?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Who is this Commissar?"
  - After: "Who's this Commissar?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The Mangled Sector? What an off-putting name."
  - After: "The Mangled Sector? Off-putting name."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you want me to do it?"
  - After: "Why me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. I will kill him."
  - After: "Very well. I'll kill him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have no interest in killing anyone for you."
  - After: "I won't kill for you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Sensation slowly returns to you. Your body is still in pain, but you are no longer on the brink of death. Your wounds have been crudely closed with metal clamps, and your throat is pocked with injector tracks, as though you have been wearing a neck pillow of needles. The one who rendered this first aid to you was certainly not a qualified chirurgeon, someone who would typically be permitted to minister to the person of the illustrious Rogue Trader.{/n}
  - After: {n}You wake, hurting but alive, wounds crudely clamped, throat full of needle marks.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It looks like you're back with us. I don't know whether to offer my congratulations or commiserations." {n}The scaled xenos looks at you without the slightest deference.{/n}
  - After: "You're back. Congratulations, or commiserations." {n}No deference.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The snake-like xenos hisses in satisfaction.{/n} "Commorragh. The Dark City — the underside of existence, the realm of the Drukhari. You heard of it, humanling?"
  - After: {n}He hisses.{/n} "Commorragh. The Dark City of the Drukhari."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am Malice, and the rabble you see are my Shriekers. We are gladiators, the bleeding meat of the Fatal Thirst's combat arena. We are the beasts who go out there to kill and to die inglorious deaths for the entertainment of the Dark City. And this den is our pleasure ground."
  - After: "I am Malice. These are my Shriekers, gladiators of the Fatal Thirst's arena. This den is ours."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do not want your thanks, humanling. You will earn back every stimulant I spent on you."
  - After: "No thanks. You'll repay every stimulant."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos does not move.{/n} "Make no mistake, humanling — just because I saved you, that will not stop me from killing you this very moment. Get yourself up."
  - After: {n}He doesn't move.{/n} "I can still kill you. Get up yourself."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Straight to business — I like it. You truly do owe me, but we will discuss that when you are no longer lying on the floor like a scrap of dead meat."
  - After: "Straight to business. You owe me. Get up first."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Enough lying around. Get up and we will discuss how you are going to pay for your rescue."
  - After: "Get up. Then we discuss payment."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Kill for me. Go into the Mangled Sector and find a freak called the Commissar — one of your kind — and spill his guts for me. Do that and you will earn my favour. And in the Chasm, that counts for a lot."
  - After: "Kill for me: a human called the Commissar, in the Mangled Sector. Earn my favour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A prisoner of the Drukhari who thinks too highly of himself. Instead of dying in the arena without any fuss, he is hiding, gathering other slaves of your race around him, and making pathetic plans to get his revenge. And many of your kind are listening to him — see how few humanling Shriekers there are? They used to all come to me, but now they listen to the Commissar and no longer come."
  - After: "An arrogant human prisoner hiding from the arena, rallying slaves for revenge. Humans follow him now, not me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It's an off-putting place. It's the base of the spire in which we live. Commorragh is stitched together from scraps of various dimensions, and in the Mangled Sector, the seams are starting to rip. Space is collapsing in on itself and entropic radiation is off the scale, spawning all kinds of abominations, and the sector itself is slowly but surely turning into nothing..."
  - After: "Our spire's base, where Commorragh's stitched dimensions tear. Space collapses, abominations spawn, it fades to nothing."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't want to drag my whole gang into the Mangled Sector — the place will kill off three times more fighters than the Commissar's crew will. That means I need to send in an assassin. The Commissar's fighters know my Shriekers. But nobody knows you. And besides, you don't have a choice, which means you'll see it through to the end."
  - After: "The sector would kill too many Shriekers, and his fighters know them. Nobody knows you. And you have no choice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Bring me his head. And in exchange, I will share my toys with you. They make surviving in Commorragh possible."
  - After: "Bring his head and I'll share my toys. They keep you alive here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That's what you think. I'm not even going to punish you for your disobedience — you'll think about it and realise on your own that you won't survive in Commorragh without friends. You need shelter, weapons, a healer. And I need what's sitting on the Commissar's shoulders."
  - After: "You'll learn you need shelter, weapons, a healer to survive here. And I want the Commissar's head."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And if you think of lying to me and running... When you're on the street, look out for a humanling dressed in red with a cog on his chest and a face full of misery. See how he is dying alone with nobody to help him. Your death will be just the same."
  - After: "Run, and you'll die like that miserable humanling in red with a cog on his chest: alone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your begging amused me. It was so... pathetic... and delectable."
  - After: "Your begging amused me. Pathetic... delectable."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As a sign of my favour, I'll give you your slave fighter. They wandered into the den while I was healing you, and said they were your bodyguard."
  - After: "Take your slave fighter. They claim to be your bodyguard."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A kind of translucent slug. It is a parasite that can only be found on this side of reality. Mind maggots feed on your memory and they inject toxic hallucinations into your mind to stop you resisting. Drukhari can train these creatures and use them to show their victims devious mirages."
  - After: "A parasite slug that eats memory and injects hallucinations. Drukhari train them to show victims mirages."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Or you can reject my generous offer and look for help elsewhere. Have you heard about that humanling that's always hanging around the gate to the Anatomical Opera, gasping for breath, and begging the Haemonculus to save her? She can't breathe normally, even the way she says her name is funny — J-Jae H-Heyd-hari, as if she's about to suffocate."
  - After: "Or beg elsewhere, like that gasping J-Jae H-Heyd-hari at the Anatomical Opera gate."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Serve me well, and I will not set a certain someone on you... There is an arena enthusiast who has acquired a scent beast, ferocious and toothy. Right now, he is trying out his new toy on the refuse near the corpse dump, but soon, he will seek out bigger prey, and you do not want to be it."
  - After: "Serve well, or an arena fan's scent beast near the corpse dump hunts you next."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Here, you can have this disobedient thing. It refuses to do what I say, so it will either become meat for the arena or allow you to strike an extra blow against the Commissar."
  - After: "Take this disobedient thing. Use it against the Commissar, or it's arena meat."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As soon as you stand up, you are seized by a strange sense of unreality. It is as if you are still there, in the wicked darkness, and everything around you is merely a twisted mirage. Doubt seeps into your mind like a poison, sundering its contact with your body. You have to make a deliberate effort to hold onto the thought that you are you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Standing, everything feels unreal, a mirage. You cling to yourself.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What, is your mind maggot giving you trouble? I saw it latch onto your spinal cord when you were being patched up. A fat, well-fed grub it was, with lots of teeth. It's dying now — they have a short lifespan — and that means its poison is especially toxic. You'll lose touch with reality from time to time, and when the mind maggot dies, the final dose of poison will make you think your body is not your body at all. And then your heart will just stop beating."
  - After: "Mind maggot? It's on your spine, dying and toxic. You'll lose touch with reality, and when it dies, your heart stops."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I could have pulled that thing out of you, of course, but I thought — why should I? Consider it a guarantee of your gratitude toward me. When you've earned your healing, I'll release you from it." {n}The lipless mouth stretches into a bloodthirsty grin.{/n}
  - After: "I left it in. A guarantee of gratitude. Earn your healing and I'll remove it." {n}He grins.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are a cocky whelp, but feeble like all members of your race. Your cockiness has not got you killed yet, which means you must be someone important. And you might be useful."
  - After: "Cocky but feeble. Still alive, so important. Maybe useful."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You'd have to be insane to set foot in a place like that. Insane, or an outcast like the Commissar, hiding from the hunt... or you."
  - After: "Only madmen go there. Or outcasts like the Commissar. Or you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Some unhinged humanling went there recently. What did they call him? Wersorean? He was old, but strong... and too loud. His visit probably stirred up all the freaks. You should be more careful and quieter than he was."
  - After: "A loud old humanling, Wersorean, went there recently and stirred up the freaks. Be quieter."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Prove that you're useful first. Do this and Malice will see that you have decent toys to play with. But not before. In the meantime, you can pick something out of the junk pile." {n}Malice gestures at a container half-full of shoddy equipment.{/n}
  - After: "Prove yourself first. For now, take junk." {n}He points at shoddy gear.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As a sign of my favour, I'll give you your slave fighters. They wandered into the den while I was healing you, and called themselves your bodyguards."
  - After: "Take your slave fighters. They claim to be your bodyguards."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/ArgentaConfession

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/ArgentaConfession/ArgentaConfession_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "No. Keep your secrets to yourself."
  - After: "No. Keep your secrets."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do your duty, Idira. The von Valancius blood will be avenged."
  - After: "Do your duty, Idira. Avenge the von Valancius blood."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you distraught because of Vigastes's fate and the deaths of those betrayed by the Commissar?"
  - After: "Is it Vigastes's fate and those the Commissar betrayed?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Remain steadfast. We will break free from this darkness."
  - After: "Stay steadfast. We'll escape this darkness."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You should have told me the truth. I see no reason to condemn you. Theodora deserved to die for her treachery. As for any other victims... it was acceptable collateral damage."
  - After: "You should have told me. I don't condemn you. Theodora deserved death for treachery; other victims were acceptable losses."
- **Player**
  - Before: "And you confess such a thing so casually?"
  - After: "You confess that so casually?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If prayer is helping you get through this, I am glad to hear it."
  - After: "If prayer helps, I'm glad."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Darkness, spiritual fortitude... Personally, I am rather enjoying my time here!"
  - After: "Darkness? I'm rather enjoying it here!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do. You are a faithful ally."
  - After: "I do. You're a faithful ally."
- **Player**
  - Before: "There is no one I trust completely. It is one of the principles I swear by."
  - After: "I trust no one completely. On principle."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You kept this secret all this time."
  - After: "You kept this secret all along."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Idira, you are blinded by grief. Stop. None of us are perfect."
  - After: "Idira, grief blinds you. Stop. None of us are perfect."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have nothing better to do. Speak, if you so wish."
  - After: "I've nothing better to do. Speak."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What's done is done. I hope you will learn from this. Right now we need to think about a way to escape."
  - After: "What's done is done. Learn from it. Now, we escape."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Enough. This quarrel ends here. Argenta, I have words for you."
  - After: "Enough quarrelling. Argenta, a word."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You murdered my kin and hid the truth from me. That is unforgivable. Leave my retinue. May Commorragh take you."
  - After: "You murdered my kin and lied. Unforgivable. Leave my retinue. May Commorragh take you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you at least regret doing what you did? Your hands would not be covered in the blood of innocents had you not acted on impulse."
  - After: "Do you regret it? Acting on impulse spilled innocent blood."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - Before: "Yes. It was me. Not your treacherous kin Voigtvir. Not the cultists. Me." {n}She speaks with a strange blend of pride and horror in her voice.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**

Then she suddenly slumps to her knees and lets out a tired sob.{/n} "Everything was going so well when Lady Theodora was alive... She appreciated me, she gave me a new life! - **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The stately man in a Commissar's coat and a tall service cap greets you with the sign of the Aquila and a solemn announcement:{/n} "Another loyal servant of the Throne has found {mf|his|her} way to us through these confounded catacombs!   - After: {n}A Commissar salutes.{/n} "Another loyal servant finds {mf|his|her} way here! Trust the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}; we're allies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar's speech is brisk and energetic:{/n} "Some of our own have captured a small xenos ship that was moored for repairs at a remote unused dock. They eliminated the crew quietly, but left the pilot alive to sail the ship back to {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}. We can get to the dock through a dimensional portal located at our old base."
  - After: {n}Briskly:{/n} "We seized a xenos ship and pilot to reach {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}, via a portal at our old base."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "By that time, our superior officers had already fallen, so I led my people in a bayonet charge. We taught the xenos a lesson in blood, and then... I have no memory of how the battle ended. I came to consciousness in this foul place, disarmed and on the verge of death. I thought I'd die, but it was not yet time for the Emperor to release me from His service."
  - After: "Our officers fell; I led a bayonet charge. I woke here, dying. The Emperor wasn't done with me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Every morsel of intelligence we have acquired and every step of progress we have made was paid for in blood and pain. The information about the dying Kabal that dreads entering the docks of its enemies and instead moors in an abandoned area was forced out of captive xenos. The knowledge of the portal was bought in exchange for one half of all the weapons we had stockpiled.   - After: "Every gain cost blood: captives' secrets, half our weapons for the portal, precious lives for the ship."

  - Before: {n}The man gets a better look at you, then fervently commands,{/n} "All of you, kneel before the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, the God-Emperor's steward beyond the borders of the blessed Imperium!"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar's plan is bold, and the odds of it succeeding are bleak. However, it seems improbable that anyone in Commorragh is prepared for such decisive covert action from the city's prisoners, so the Commissar and his people have the element of surprise on their side.{/n}
  - After: {n}Bold, bleak odds, but surprise is on their side.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

He has a large and powerful jaw, his eyes are hard and fearless, and the small scar over his brow adds a certain rugged charm to his features. His coat, though worn, has been diligently cleaned and mended, and the skull on his tall cap has been polished to a shine.{/n}

Having recovered from my wounds, I carry on fighting the wicked {g|Encyclopedia:Xenos}xenos{/g} as the head of the local resistance cell, which I founded."
