  - After: "Confident." {n}He smiles.{/n} "Do it. I could reanimate you. Would I?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With a loud click of his scissor-like fingers, Tervantias voice turns ghoulish,{/n} "Let's see what kind of interesting damage your body has taken and which parts of your miserable organics can be improved without inflicting any substantial harm on your sanity. Try not to scream — some specimens end up tearing their vocal cords during this procedure. Then again... you will scream whether you want to or not."
  - After: {n}His scissor-fingers click.{/n} "Let's improve your organics. You will scream."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Praise me for my generosity, specimen."
  - After: "Praise my generosity."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Oh, but there is more... I hope Keykeross and Sinisthoria are now writhing in horror at the mere thought that their headless subordinates have lost the Kabalite who was sentenced to death by Nazrakhei himself. First they decided to play at charity by making me a Proselyte, and now... they let me slip through their fingers. Oh, I wish I could see the Succubus's face when she was given the news."
  - After: "Keykeross and Sinisthoria lost the Kabalite Nazrakhei condemned. I wish I'd seen the Succubus's face."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Tervantias glares at Marazhai.{/n} "You were not in a position to know about the Archon's plans before, much less now."
  - After: {n}He glares at Marazhai.{/n} "You never knew the Archon's plans."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos suddenly lets out a spiteful cackle, a surprisingly lively reaction for such a cold creature.{/n} "Which made for an unpleasant surprise for Dracon Marazhai. Former Dracon, that is. That foolish whelp expected less of you, and you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_TrialFailed}humiliated him{/d}. It gave me something to think about. A good specimen."
  - After: {n}He cackles.{/n} "Former Dracon Marazhai underestimated you, and you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_TrialFailed}humiliated him{/d}. Good specimen."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Then find yourself other fighters. The Chasm has enough prisoners, mercenaries, and gladiators. My specimens are not yours to waste."
  - After: "Find other fighters. My specimens aren't yours."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Haemonculus mutters furiously and haughtily,{/n} "I should have stopped wasting time on this idiocy long ago. All those pathetic simpletons did was weaken my focus and distract me from my masterpiece. At last, I can devote all of myself to it!"
  - After: {n}He mutters,{/n} "No more distractions. Now, my masterpiece!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Good specimen." {n}He pulls his claw out of your flesh, and you notice a heavy drop of blood hanging from it.{/n} "Very responsive to pain stimuli."
  - After: "Good specimen." {n}He withdraws a bloody claw.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "How can you be certain of that? You have not yet tried... but you are about to."
  - After: "You're about to find out."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Are you trying to be resilient?" {n}The xenos's smile grows wider.{/n} "Do you wish to put my talents to the test? You have not the slightest understanding of who stands before you. I am the choirmaster of agony." {n}A second claw, this one tipped with a thin and impossibly sharp needle, pierces your forehead slightly above the bridge of your nose, reaching through bone as easily as through air. For a few moments, the needle wanders inside your brain, causing strange sensations throughout your body, and then...{/n}
  - After: "Resilient?" {n}He grins.{/n} "I am the choirmaster of agony." {n}A needle pierces your forehead into your brain, and then...{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The darkness is dispelled by a sliver of light — the glinting scalpel in Tervantias's hand. The Haemonculus offers you a crooked smile.{/n} "I can keep tossing you from one side of death to the other for as long as I so desire. But I doubt that reanimating you again will be quite as amusing. I would suggest not incurring my displeasure."
  - After: {n}Tervantias holds a scalpel.{/n} "I can revive you endlessly. Don't displease me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You cannot move your arms. The xenos smiles faintly and cocks his head, watching as convulsions rack your every limb.{/n} "Mon-keigh pain signals are so impractical. They drown out every other impulse in your brain — cognitive processes, motor patterns. This is indeed the only advantage you have over most other races — you are better at feeling pain."
  - After: {n}You convulse, unable to move.{/n} "Mon-keigh pain drowns everything. Your one talent."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/LivingMachine/LivingMachine_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Mend this creature, we are taking it with us."
  - After: "Mend it, we're taking it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why did you escape Tervantias?"
  - After: "Why escape Tervantias?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kick the abomination hard]
  - After: [Kick the abomination]
- **Player**
  - Before: [End the unusual exchange]
  - After: [End the exchange]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Wait for the thing to expire]
  - After: [Wait for it to expire]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pasqal, would you like to study this device?"
  - After: "Pasqal, study this device?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you think this thing is alive, you may end its suffering."
  - After: "If it's alive, end its suffering."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is this thing more than a perversion and an outrage to you?"
  - After: "Is it more than a perversion to you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are an Explorator. Study it before it gives up the ghost."
  - After: "Explorator, study it before it dies."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the monster] "Can you understand me?"
  - After: [Address the monster] "Understand me?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What was this machine built for?"
  - After: "What was this machine for?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Eogunn, do you wish to perform a vivisection?"
  - After: "Eogunn, want to vivisect it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will not hurt you any more."
  - After: "I won't hurt you any more."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The biomechanical creature is flailing its limbs faintly. Its body is broken and bears the signs of combat, but it seems no one is planning to repair it. You can see the glistening flesh under the cracked carapace and the bunches of wires that permeate it. The armour plates rise heavily and the creature emits a wistful, creaking sigh full of regret.{/n}
  - After: {n}A broken biomechanical creature flails weakly and sighs.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}The claw on Pasqal's mechadendrite clangs loudly. The visor emits a series of clicks, switching the observation spectrum. Pasqal's hands automatically reach for the combi-tool on his belt even as his eyes closely watch the dying creature.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal's visor clicks; he reaches for his combi-tool.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal suddenly freezes and takes a little step back.{/n} "Process interrupted. An operational collision has been detected."
  - After: {n}Pasqal freezes.{/n} "Process interrupted. Operational collision."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia's entire body is shivering.{/n} "The colours of this creature... it is oozing with stained crimson shades and the tenebrous blackness of suffering. It is as if this construct was purposefully made to absorb the most dreadful colours that living things can exude. But how is that possible?"
  - After: {n}Cassia shivers.{/n} "Its colours are crimson and black, built to absorb suffering. How?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Every limb of the creature, the hard ones on skeletal paws and the flexible ones on metallic cords, is equipped with a variety of implements similar to surgical tools. The jagged circular saws, twisted drills, and vibrating monoscalpels promise unbearable pain.{/n}
  - After: {n}Its limbs end in saws, drills and monoscalpels.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}If there are any functions in the design of this creature beyond maiming and brutally killing opponents, they elude you.{/n}
  - After: {n}It seems built only to maim and kill.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The impact lands on a cracked armour segment, and a wet, rumbling howl erupts from the guts of the mechanism, a sound that could easily be confused with a painful groan. The monster's limbs twitch in fear and retract under its belly.{/n}
  - After: {n}It howls wetly and cowers.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal does not say a word, but you think you see his face wrinkling in disgust and disapproval under his respirator.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal silently grimaces in disapproval.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Void take you, Heydari!" {n}The women glare at each other but then relax and chuckle quietly.{/n}
  - After: "Void take you, Heydari!" {n}They glare, then chuckle.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Request approved." {n}Pasqal eagerly unfolds his mechadendrites and they all rush toward the monster. A shrieking drill cuts deep into the armour, while a claw hungrily snaps off chunks of the flesh pierced with strands of metal wire. The creature thrashes and wheezes but cannot escape the merciless vivisection. The collected samples are sent to a portable analyser and the Tech-Priest's visor clicks, recording the procedure in pict-images.{/n}
  - After: "Request approved." {n}Pasqal's mechadendrites drill and tear samples from the thrashing creature.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This unit is under the influence of conflicting impulses. The operational vector of cognition dictates the necessity of studying this subject. The operational vector of obeying the Omnissiah and His Universal Laws dictates the necessity of recoiling from the subject and purifying it."
  - After: "Conflict. Cognition says study it. The Omnissiah's Laws say purify it."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The categorisation is correct. The object is a perversion and an outrage, one dangerously close to the creation of the anathematised Abominable Intelligence."
  - After: "Correct. A perversion, dangerously close to Abominable Intelligence."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Request approved as doctrinally correct." {n}Pasqal leans over the creature and the drill whirrs, its sound even, soothing, and right. The Tech-Priest's voice vibrates with shrill otherworldly frequencies:{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued, let your suffering be discontinued!"
  - After: "Request approved." {n}His drill whirrs softly.{/n} "Let your suffering be discontinued!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Request approved as doctrinally correct." {n}Pasqal leans over the creature and the drill whirrs, sounding shrill and relentless. The Tech-Priest's voice hums with the ice-cold determination of a divine vivisector:{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued, let ignorance be discontinued!"
  - After: "Request approved." {n}His drill shrieks coldly.{/n} "Let ignorance be discontinued!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Request approved as doctrinally correct." {n}Pasqal leans over the creature and the drill whirrs with wrath and fury. The Tech-Priest's voice boils like lava, ringing with the promise of divine punishment:{/n} "Let the Cycle be discontinued, let corruption be purged!"
  - After: "Request approved." {n}His drill whirrs with fury.{/n} "Let corruption be purged!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The creature responds with a series of choking and snarling sounds. After a moment, as if realising that its language is not clear to you, it extends a fighting limb in your direction in a menacing gesture. The message is clear: "I am a warrior. I am a killer."{/n}
  - After: {n}It snarls and raises a fighting limb: "I am a killer."{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The creature emits a series of wheezing sounds. Was it an answer, moans of agony, or just the normal rumbling of its mechanism? There is no way to tell.{/n}
  - After: {n}It wheezes. An answer, a moan, or just machinery?{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The creature's servo-motors howl as they send the last remaining energy into its body. One of the limbs lunges at you, but the charge is not enough for the strike to reach its target.{/n}
  - After: {n}Its servos howl; a limb lunges at you but falls short.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something bursts in the creature's gut with a quiet squelch and a puddle of oily ichor spreads from under its belly.{/n}
  - After: {n}Something bursts inside it; oily ichor pools.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Presenting a hypothesis. Existing under the oppression of the Haemonculus was unbearable and painful even for such an unholy construct."
  - After: "Hypothesis: serving the Haemonculus was unbearable even for it."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The nature of the damage indicates that the unit has been in combat. I hypothesise that its constructor sent it into the arena. Based on its current condition, the result of the combat tests was unsatisfactory. Otherwise, the unit would have been repaired."
  - After: "Arena damage. It failed, so its maker did not repair it."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The creatures in this place only understand the language of pain, shereen. Let's smash its head in before something happens that we can't undo."
  - After: "These things only understand pain, shereen. Smash its head in."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "It just happened to be smarter than the others. Isn't that right, Idira?"
  - After: "It was just smarter than the others. Right, Idira?"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn reaches out toward the creature with a diagnostor mechadendrite, only to recoil immediately as the beast greets the Manipulus's extended limb with a menacing snarl. The Tech-Priest does not make a second attempt — suddenly going still, he gazes upon the creature's agony with a strange expression, as though his mind has wandered elsewhere.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eogunn reaches out; it snarls. He recoils and stares, lost in thought.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "The reaction is evaluated as congruent. In other words — most likely yes, Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Reaction congruent. Most likely yes, Rogue Trader."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "It attempted to end the agony. Yet agony is the constant of its existence." {n}Eogunn grimly averts his gaze, and for a moment, he fixes it on Nuncius.{/n}
  - After: "It tried to end the agony. Yet agony is its existence." {n}Eogunn glances at Nuncius.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The operational vector of adoration before His might dictates... the necessity of reverence for the subject where the natural spirit resides in synthesis with that of the machine."
  - After: "Yet adoration of Him demands reverence where flesh and machine spirit unite."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn turns away, as if he finds it unbearable to watch the creature's torment.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eogunn turns away.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "No, Rogue Trader. Not this time." {n}His tone is utterly flat; he makes a deliberate effort to keep his eyes away from the beast.{/n} "I understand the irrationality of this decision, but the torment of this construct has stirred fragments of memories within me that I would prefer not to disturb. That is all I can say."
  - After: "No, Rogue Trader." {n}He looks away.{/n} "Irrational, but its torment stirs memories I'd rather not disturb."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}He looks wearily at Pasqal.{/n} "I am ready to grant the privilege of vivisection to the esteemed Magos, should he wish to perform the rite."
  - After: {n}He looks at Pasqal.{/n} "The esteemed Magos may vivisect it."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Once the creature stops moving, Eogunn's face relaxes in relief. He whispers a prayer to the Omnissiah.{/n}
  - After: {n}When it stops, Eogunn relaxes and prays to the Omnissiah.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Request denied. The inflicted damage is critical. The subject cannot be repaired."
  - After: "Request denied. Damage critical. Irreparable."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "But it is also a miracle of His boundless polymorphism." {n}Pasqal's voice carries a metallic note.{/n}
  - After: "But also a miracle of His polymorphism." {n}His voice rings metallic.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Presenting a hypothesis. This construct is a mobile execution chamber. A subject is immobilised by the implements, placed inside the construct, and subjected to highly painful disposal via chemical injection. The biological remains are preserved in the built-in reservoir of the construct."
  - After: "Hypothesis: a mobile execution chamber. It swallows victims, dissolves them painfully, and stores the remains."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You can clearly see the inside of the mechanism through the holes in its armour. Its gut can open to drag a hamstrung victim inside. Once the victim finds themselves in the monster's "stomach," they will be pierced by injectors that will liquefy them. The substance will then drain to the reservoirs at the tail end of the creature.{/n}
  - After: {n}Inside, you see a gut to swallow victims, injectors to liquefy them, and reservoirs.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "The initial chemical analysis of the remains yields... an abnormal result." {n}The vox emits a clanging metallic note.{/n} "It is as if the pain of the victims of this machine is dissolved in them. It is circulating in the metal veins of this creature. It can feel... everything."
  - After: "Abnormal." {n}His vox clangs.{/n} "The victims' pain flows in its veins. It feels everything."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something inside the creature clangs helplessly and then it starts tugging at one of its limbs with jittery motions, trying to rip it out of its socket. Its body convulses in excruciating pain.{/n}
  - After: {n}It tries to tear off its own limb, convulsing.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "It seems the blasphemous creature can feel pain and fear... That is glorious." {n}Ulfar's face breaks into a smile that is both joyous and bloodthirsty.{/n}
  - After: "It feels pain and fear... Glorious." {n}Ulfar grins bloodthirstily.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/MeatDump_WakeUp/MeatDump_WakeUp_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Until I get a cup of recaf, my vital status is yet to be determined."
  - After: "Not alive until I've had recaf."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Ignore the vaguely familiar voice]
  - After: [Ignore the familiar voice]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius lies before you. Kneel... and help me to rise."
  - After: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius. Kneel and help me rise."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I... I have seen you somewhere before. Who are you?"
  - After: "I've seen you before. Who are you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "My companions... Where are they?"
  - After: "Where are my companions?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What... will happen to me now?"
  - After: "What happens to me now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Turn your thoughts to the warp gods]
  - After: [Turn to the warp gods]
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The world is an impenetrable haze of warm pain. You lie motionless — no, you rest! — in the murky gloom, slowly dissolving into nothingness. Sometimes your repose is troubled by unpleasant and persistent tremors coming from the place where your legs used to be. You do your best to ignore them.{/n}
  - After: {n}You drift in warm pain. Something tugs where your legs were.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "Away, you vulture, this is not your prey!" {n}A vaguely familiar voice reaches you through the curtain of darkness, but your disobedient thoughts refuse to reveal where and when you have heard it before. Was it just recently, or a hundred lifetimes ago? The trembling coming from your legs is replaced with a violent jerking motion, and then it finally stops.{/n}
  - After: "Away, vulture, this is not your prey!" {n}A half-familiar voice. The tugging stops.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "Alas, the bliss of death will save you not,
The whirling waltz of chance and gloom you'll dance."
  - After: "Death's bliss won't save you;
You'll dance chance's waltz."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A prickling sensation burns your shoulder, and the darkness at last fully withdraws from your mind. Whatever the injection was, it is making your heart beat a frenzied tattoo and your pupils narrow so that you now register every detail of the disgusting place in which you have found yourself in merciless clarity.{/n}
  - After: {n}An injection stings. Your heart races; the foul place sharpens.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: {n}Quiet laughter reaches your ears.{/n}
"Your legs require direction, Merchant mine,
Therefore, address your pleas to them, not me.
Their thirst for dancing may yet spur them on!"
  - After: {n}Quiet laughter.{/n}
"Plead to your legs, Merchant mine,
Not me. They may yet dance!"
- **Stranger**
  - Before: {n}The stranger's tone speaks of bored indifference:{/n}
"Let your hauteur a steady crutch become
And vanity its elbow offer up."
  - After: {n}Bored:{/n}
"Let pride be your crutch
And vanity your elbow."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You immediately regret this decision. Every inch of your body is suffering. There is a dull, debilitating pain in your head caused by chemicals of some kind. Your body is covered in deep cuts, made either for fun or with sinister intent. All of your organs appear to be intact, but the same cannot be said for your blood — you have lost a great deal. Finally, a strange gnawing spasm occasionally flares at the base of your skull. It is not severe but for some reason it is what concerns you most of all.{/n}
  - After: {n}Everything hurts: chemical headache, deep cuts, blood loss. A gnawing spasm at your skull's base worries you most.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Every single inch of your body is suffering. Satisfied with this result, you do not delve into a detailed examination of your misfortune.{/n}
  - After: {n}Everything hurts. That's enough to know.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You are surrounded by the dead — numerous corpses, mutilated bodies and pieces thereof. Humans, Drukhari, and other xenos unfamiliar to you lie motionless in this gruesome mortuary.{/n}
  - After: {n}Corpses surround you: humans, Drukhari, other xenos.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: {n}Your eyes refuse to focus on the blurry figure of the person who came to your aid. He appears to be tall, and... your mind emphatically refuses to continue, for every moment of concentration causes you suffering.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your rescuer is a tall blur. Focusing hurts too much.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}All your equipment is gone, as are your shoes. You do not even have a knife at hand to fend off enemies, or to open your veins.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your gear and shoes are gone. Not even a knife.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "A dream obscure of death, deliverance,
Illuminating will, and agony."
  - After: "A dream of death, deliverance,
Will, and agony."
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "Not here. The roles have been decided now,
But if you play your part, perhaps, the plot
Will draw you back together... or to doom."
{n}The figure's cruel laughter follows.{/n}
  - After: "Not here. Play your part, and the plot
May reunite you... or doom you."
{n}Cruel laughter.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your bare feet feel like they are stuffed with rags and refuse to obey. You have to draw upon all your willpower to suppress the rebellion and stand upright. The pain that engulfs your whole body immediately makes you question the wisdom of this act of defiance.{/n}
  - After: {n}By sheer will you stand on numb feet. It hurts.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You try to resurrect the faces of your friends in your memory, but they all seem to be cloaked by an impenetrable haze. Pain prevents you from focusing on any one of them, and anger and despair start to overwhelm you. You must remember, you cannot die here! Spurred on by hopelessness, you make another attempt to get up.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your friends' faces blur. You cannot die here! You try again to rise.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your cracked lips futilely try to utter the words of a prayer. The familiar lines slip away from you one by one, devoured by the murky gloom of your errant thoughts and flashes of pain. But you refuse to believe the Emperor has abandoned you. If you cannot pray to Him right now, you must get up and survive so you can utter a thousand more prayers later. You make another attempt to get up.{/n}
  - After: {n}The prayers slip away, but the Emperor hasn't abandoned you. You try again to rise.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your body has suffered too much to obey your mind... or rather, that is how it would have been for someone else, perhaps. But not for you. {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}You have lived through worse{/d}. Anguish and torture could never break you now. You will rise to your feet and press on. All that is left to understand is why you should.{/n}
  - After: {n}Others would fail. {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_DH_Torture}You have lived through worse{/d}. You will rise. But why?{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You get up. Yes, your body aches and rebels against you, but your tempered mind is stronger than mortal flesh. You draw yourself up straight and take in your surroundings.{/n}
  - After: {n}You stand, mind over aching flesh, and look around.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: {n}The figure whispers conspiratorially,{/n}
"I spare my breath. The drape is yours to part."
  - After: {n}A whisper:{/n}
"The drape is yours to part."
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "Among the shadows in the wings you lie,
Where taut are pulled the puppet master's strings."
{n}The stranger intricately links his fingers to mimic the tools of a puppeteer.{/n}
  - After: "You lie in the wings,
Where the puppet master pulls strings."
{n}He mimes a puppeteer.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "From this phantasmagoria retreat
And deftly seize, my Merchant Vagabond,
The puppet master's strings left dangling.
Again rise up to take your place and dance."
{n}A spark ignites in the darkness, and its light ruthlessly cuts through the gloom that envelops you. An ugly image of the reality around you assaults your retina. You can feel your body again and realise it is filled with pain. Your shoulder is sore from an injection.{/n}
  - After: "Seize the dangling strings, Merchant Vagabond,
Rise and dance."
{n}A spark cuts the gloom. Pain returns, and a sore, injected shoulder.{/n}
- **Stranger**
  - Before: "Your wordlessness is worth a hundred words,
But here you ply your trade in other gems:
Red rubies of blood, and emeralds of pain,
The dance will leave your pockets fit to burst."
  - After: "Silence speaks,
But here you trade blood-rubies and pain-emeralds."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}For a few moments, your prayer goes unanswered. And yet... And yet something does reach your tortured consciousness after a while.   - After: {n}Once you ruled planets; now your feet won't obey.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: {n}Oblivion tempts, but pain screams: get up now, or never.{/n}

It appears my mind can no longer stomach the kind of horrors this place has to offer. I saw her by my side... I saw a different time... a different place..."
  - After: {n}Embarrassed.{/n} "My late wife, Lord Captain. My mind slipped. I saw her..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Perhaps... we should just give in... You always say that Dargonus is not your home, love..." {n}Abelard is looking past you at someone only he can see. There is a timid smile on his trembling lips.{/n} "Would you like that, love? Would you rather leave... leave it all behind... go somewhere far away... away from our toils?"
  - After: "Dargonus isn't your home, love..." {n}He smiles at no one.{/n} "Shall we leave it all?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Abelard flinches.{/n} "Family? But, Quatharina, you are my family, and you... are dead..." {n}He shakes his head as if waking from sleep, slaps himself on the cheeks, and looks up at you.{/n} "{name}! Apologies — that is to say, Lord Captain!"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Abelard flinches. A glow lights up in his watering eyes.{/n} "What's that? 'Seneschal'? Who is calling me?" {n}Abelard looks at you and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"
  - After: {n}He flinches.{/n} "Seneschal? Who calls?" {n}He sees you.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With a groan, Abelard tries to straighten his hunched back.{/n} "Thank the God-Emperor, death has not found you yet! Then again, given the circumstances... it may be for the worst."
  - After: {n}He groans.{/n} "Thank the Emperor you live! Though here, maybe worse."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I could not agree more, Lord Captain. I serve House von Valancius!" {n}Abelard salutes you with a shaking hand, and a ghost of his usual stern expression returns to his wrinkled face.{/n}
  - After: "Agreed. I serve House von Valancius!" {n}A shaky salute.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have not the faintest idea, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. All I can say is, if I have managed to survive down here, the others stand a chance too. There were no weaklings in your retinue."
  - After: "No idea, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. If I lived, so might they."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Pray, Lord Captain! There is enough strength in this body yet! Your Seneschal will not be so easily broken by some..." {n}He groans and clutches his side.{/n} "I could just use... a brief respite..."
  - After: "I'm strong!" {n}He clutches his side.{/n} "Just need rest..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Abelard is racked by an old man's hacking cough.{/n} "That thrice-blasted xenos simply chucked me aside like a piece of rubbish. I went to look for you... or for help... and I ended up here. This is where it found me, that... thing. Memory fails me, all I can remember is bits and pieces... and needles. It pumped something out of me, and it pumped something in..."
  - After: {n}He coughs.{/n} "The xenos tossed me aside. Here, that thing found me. Needles... It pumped something out, and something in..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He shudders.{/n} "A spawn of nightmares, so ghastly, my mind refuses to picture a clear image of it. Nothing but meat, metal, and many, many needles... It feasted on me. Feasted on my very soul! It would have devoured me whole if it hadn't gorged itself on another before me."
  - After: {n}He shudders.{/n} "Meat, metal, needles. It fed on my soul!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Mistress Heydari... I see hardship has done nothing for your character." {n}Squinting short-sightedly, the Seneschal nods his greeting.{/n}
  - After: "Mistress Heydari. Hardship hasn't improved you." {n}He nods.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I seem to be in one piece, except... That creature..." {n}Abelard tries to wipe his stained coat with a trembling hand.{/n} "How should I put this... its needles siphoned the strength out of me! I feel... older by a good decade or two..." {n}He touches his face and exclaims in surprise.{/n} "My word, I think I am older... That could be why I started seeing things. I never thought I'd live long enough to go senile!"
  - After: "Its needles drained me." {n}He wipes his coat.{/n} "I feel decades older..." {n}He touches his face.{/n} "I am! Hence the visions."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your words fall on deaf ears: the old man's attention remains focused on his conversation with a phantom.{/n}
  - After: {n}He talks to a phantom, deaf to you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Abelard flinches. His brow furrows and a glow lights up in his watering eyes.{/n} "'Heretic'? I recommend that you brush up on your regulations before accusing an officer! The Addendum Primum Errandum abolished the xeno-influence categorisation, and therefore..." {n}His vision somewhat cleared, Abelard looks at you and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"
  - After: {n}He frowns.{/n} "'Heretic'? Those categories were abolished..." {n}His eyes clear.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, old man, have you lost your marbles? And your dignity? Muttering things, scavenging. Hey! Abelard?" {n}Jae's voice falters.{/n}
  - After: "Old man, lost your marbles? Abelard?" {n}Jae falters.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "You will find no rest in this place with me or without me, grey-haired mon-keigh."
  - After: "No rest here regardless, grey-haired mon-keigh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With shaking hands, Abelard is still sifting through refuse, oblivious to you.{/n} "Quatharina? Yes, it's almost time... Call the children..."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The dose of stimulant sends such an intense spasm down his limbs that you fear his heart might rupture... but then clarity brightens his gaze. Abelard looks at you and takes a shuddering breath.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"
  - After: {n}The stimulant jolts him clear.{/n} "Saints' blood, Lord Captain! You're alive!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/PitArgenta/PitArgenta_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Who is this Commissar you speak of?"
  - After: "Who is this Commissar?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Gesture at Argenta's audience] "Who are these people?"
  - After: [Gesture at Argenta's audience] "Who are they?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Argenta, a grim task brings me here. I must kill the Commissar."
  - After: "Argenta, I'm here to kill the Commissar."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What happened to you after we ran into that trap?"
  - After: "What happened to you after the trap?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will join me, will you not?"
  - After: "You'll join me, won't you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I granted Yrliet my forgiveness. Let us end the discussion there."
  - After: "I forgave Yrliet. Enough said."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Yrliet will strive to redeem herself in my eyes."
  - After: "Yrliet will strive to redeem herself."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Yrliet was deceived, as we all were. Her actions can hardly be called trickery."
  - After: "Yrliet was deceived like us. That's not trickery."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader!" {n}Sister Argenta greets you with a glowing gaze and a confident smile.{/n} "The God-Emperor did not forsake His chosen one! I prayed that our paths would cross once more!"
  - After: "Rogue Trader!" {n}Argenta beams.{/n} "The Emperor kept His chosen safe!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You truly aren't worth the breath I have wasted on words." {n}Argenta pointedly turns away from her.{/n}
  - After: "You aren't worth my breath." {n}Argenta turns away.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae nonchalantly waves her off and immediately doubles over, coughing violently, leaving viscous clots of blood on her metal hand.{/n} "Groxseed! It's... it's—" {n}She is interrupted by her hacking cough.{/n} "—a long and grubby story, and I don't want to ruin the moment."
  - After: {n}Jae coughs blood onto her metal hand.{/n} "Groxseed!" {n}Coughing.{/n} "Long story."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta gestures at everyone around her.{/n} "Your arrival is timely indeed: with the Emperor's chosen on our side, we can come out of hiding and exact vengeance upon the enemies of Humanity! But I shouldn't take up your time — speak instead to the Commissar, the one who leads these valiant souls. He will tell you everything you need to know."
  - After: {n}Argenta gestures around.{/n} "Now we can strike back! Speak to the Commissar who leads them."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Sister Argenta! Thanks be to the God-Emperor, you are here! And you look as prepared for new trials as ever."
  - After: "Sister Argenta! Thank the Emperor!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Master Werserian. A loyal Seneschal never abandons his Lord Captain, does he? I am just as glad to see you alive." {n}She gives Abelard an encouraging smile.{/n}
  - After: "Master Werserian. Glad you live." {n}She smiles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta's expression changes drastically when she sees Yrliet.{/n} "Rogue Trader... why is that creature standing beside you? Why has the treacherous xenos not yet suffered retribution for her trickery? I remember what her accursed kin said when we stepped into that trap. Do you, {name}? Have you forgotten that she betrayed us?"
  - After: {n}Argenta sees Yrliet.{/n} "Why is that traitorous xenos unpunished? Forgotten her betrayal in that trap, {name}?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta's eyes flash with wrath.{/n} "Forgiveness is a great gift that precious few deserve. And even for them, forgiveness comes as a chance to die for a just cause, as Sisters Repentia die with a prayer on their lips! This is a xenos and a traitor. What forgiveness could you possibly speak of?"
  - After: {n}Her eyes flash.{/n} "Forgiveness means dying for a just cause, like the Repentia. She's a xenos traitor!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A loyal servant of the Emperor who has not lost the will to fight even in this impenetrable gloom. He has mustered a resistance, everyone who can hold a weapon and refuses to accept the fate of a toy in the clutches of vile xenos. The dwellers of these dungeons are myriad, and most are lacking in soul, courage, or willpower. The Commissar and his associates seek out the true champions of the Imperium among them and prepare those people for the battle against the xenos."
  - After: "A loyal servant of the Emperor. He leads a resistance, recruiting the captives' true champions against the xenos."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Providence itself has brought me here. I assisted the Commissar in his search in hopes of finding you among the captives. I devoted myself to helping the faithful yet frail pluck up their strength and guiding the able yet desperate toward hope. And my efforts have already borne fruit: two squads have gone on a scouting mission to discover safe passage out of Commorragh."
  - After: "I helped his search, hoping to find you. Two squads now scout a safe way out of Commorragh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I found them, subjects of the Imperium who were taken to this den of misery and despair, scattered across this vast Chasm. They were condemned to suffer for the amusement of enemies of Humanity, but the beasts were wrong in thinking we would simply resign ourselves to our fate! I share my faith in the future with them, the future that we will claim with His name upon our lips!"
  - After: "Imperial captives I gathered across the Chasm. We won't submit! We'll claim our future in His name!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is a subtle change in Argenta's gleaming eyes, and they begin to resemble glowing embers.{/n} "Perhaps this accursed place has afflicted you after all... You speak of madness that is tantamount to heresy, for you would be beheading the resistance and leaving these adamant hearts, His faithful, without a leader! I cannot let that come to pass, Rogue Trader, and I hope you do not intend to execute this plan in earnest."
  - After: {n}Her eyes smoulder.{/n} "Killing him would behead the resistance. Near heresy. I won't allow it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta looks at the people around her and nods.{/n} "I have served the resistance for as long as I could. My duty to these people is done — it is high time I rejoined you and pursued my original mission. But first, allow me to offer a few final words of guidance to my flock."
  - After: {n}Argenta nods.{/n} "My duty here is done; I'll rejoin you. First, words to my flock."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta scoffs.{/n} "You are harbouring a snake, {name}. You will have to sleep with one eye open, for you will find no rest for as long as this monster lives."
  - After: {n}Argenta scoffs.{/n} "You harbour a snake, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Deceived by whom? Her own kinsman? Do you honestly believe that, {name}? That worthless tale spun by an enemy of Humanity, a tale that could only convince a senseless child?"
  - After: "By her kinsman? A xenos fable fit for a child, {name}!"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet gazes at her from beneath a veneer of cold aloofness.{/n} "Your judgements have no weight before the elantach's will. Do not waste your breath on attempts to intimidate or insult me, for your words are like picked leaves that the wind throws against the cliffs."
  - After: {n}Yrliet, coldly:{/n} "Only the elantach's will matters. Your words are leaves on the wind."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Turning her clear gaze to Solomorne, Argenta exclaims,{/n} "Proctor! I have heard about your escape — about a prisoner who broke free from the clutches of his xenos jailers. I see you have even found the Rogue Trader — the Emperor has blessed you with incredible fortitude and resolve!"
  - After: {n}To Solomorne:{/n} "Proctor! You escaped your jailers and found the Rogue Trader! Blessed!"
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "No, Sister, it was {mf|he|she} who found me. And there was nothing valiant about my escape. But you — this place has surely put your faith to the test, yet you've emerged from that trial unstained."
  - After: "No, Sister, {mf|he|she} found me. But your faith came through unstained."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta turns to her audience, and her voice fills with zealous fire:{/n} "Servants of the Emperor! Children of Humanity! Be strong in your resolve and pure in your faith, for our deliverance is at hand! Steel your hearts, for a great trial lies ahead of us all, but the reward for passing it is freedom!"
  - After: {n}Argenta, zealous:{/n} "Servants of the Emperor! Deliverance is near! Steel your hearts; the reward is freedom!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "If only the Exalted One had given me a sign that his beautiful battle angel had survived to illuminate this disgusting place!" {n}Jae gazes admiringly at Argenta and makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "I would have rushed to your side long ago, Sister. You'll not find a more trustworthy ally in this shithole."
  - After: "My battle angel lives!" {n}Jae makes the Aquila.{/n} "Best ally in this shithole."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your parlance has changed greatly since the last time I saw you, Jae. Your language is now rife with profanities... and sincerity." {n}Argenta's eyes widen in surprise.{/n} "Your throat—"
  - After: "You've grown profane, Jae... and sincere." {n}She stares.{/n} "Your throat—"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "In His name..." {n}Jae clenches the gilded Aquila in her hand and brushes her bitten lips against it.{/n}
  - After: "In His name..." {n}Jae kisses her Aquila.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "There is no safe way out of Commorragh. You are lying to yourself and to these poor people. Wherever you send them, the Dark City holds only death and misery for mon-keigh."
  - After: "There is no safe way out of Commorragh. The Dark City holds only death for mon-keigh."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I am recording an instance of manifest grace evidenced by this unit's survival. I praise—" {n}His vox falls silent for a moment, then hisses cautiously,{/n} "I praise the Emperor for this gift."
  - After: "Recording manifest grace. I praise—" {n}His vox pauses.{/n} "I praise the Emperor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your poisonous words cannot break my spirit and my faith, xenos. I would rather die fighting evil than surrender!" {n}Argenta clenches her jaw and you notice the spark of doubt that flashes in her eyes.{/n}
  - After: "Your poison won't break my faith, xenos!" {n}A flash of doubt.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}With a warm laugh, Argenta winks at Pasqal.{/n} "Let us forget our theological differences for now, Brother Pasqal. You and I carry the same light, and here in the darkness, it is more evident than anywhere else. I have been praying for you."
  - After: {n}Argenta winks at Pasqal.{/n} "We share the same light, Brother. I prayed for you."

  - Before: {n}The gang of cutthroat gladiators known as the Shriekers stare at you in terror and obsequiousness. No one dares to wipe {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_AngerDead}Malice's blood{/d} off the floor: it is a symbol of your status.{/n}

  - Before: "Better to die for the Emperor than to live for yourself!" {n}The grim battle cry shakes the walls of the den, igniting a spark of the Imperium's light in the abominable darkness of Commorragh.{/n}
  - After: "Better to die for the Emperor than live for yourself!" {n}The cry shakes the den.{/n}
- **Wych Poisoner**
  - Before: {n}The gladiators murmur in fear,{/n} "No... no one, no. You're stronger than Malice. Lead us. We're yours."
  - After: {n}They murmur,{/n} "No one. You're stronger than Malice. We're yours."
- **Zealous Thug**
  - Before: {n}One of the resistance fighters points to a container filled to the brim with loot.{/n} "This is everything we found in this vile den. We searched all of that sly xenos's secret caches and stashes."
  - After: {n}A fighter points to a loot crate.{/n} "All the xenos's caches."
- **Kabalite Ranger**
  - Before: {n}One of the Shriekers answers proudly, chin raised high:{/n} "Yes! We are deathspawn, murderous wretches! Malice led us to our deaths before — you lead us now!"
  - After: {n}A Shrieker, proudly:{/n} "Yes! We are deathspawn! Malice led us to death — now you do!"
- **Wych Poisoner**
  - Before: {n}A Shrieker points at a container filled to the brim with loot.{/n} "This is all we had. Malice used to hide the best spoils in hidden caches, but we've emptied them all."
  - After: {n}A Shrieker points to a loot crate.{/n} "All Malice's hidden caches."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pitiful handful of freaks huddled in the corners of the lair would not make a worthy offering. The alien voice lurking in the back of your mind has fallen silent — you have missed your chance, slaughtering your servants before their time.{/n}
  - After: {n}The few freaks left are no worthy offering. You killed your servants too soon.{/n}
- **Malice**
  - Before: "Who can say, humanling... You can tear the den apart piece by piece, you can torture me — you will find nothing. We Sslyth know how to shut out our sense of pain, and will suppressors have no effect on us. So there is only one way you can get your hands on my treasures: open the cage, give me a knife, get on your knees, and let me carve your throat open. I will reveal the secret to you as you die."
  - After: "Who knows, humanling... We Sslyth ignore pain and will suppressors. Open the cage, give me a knife, kneel, and I'll tell you as I carve your throat."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A triumphant roar bursts from the throats of the condemned. The hissing of stimulant injectors rises up from every direction.{/n}
  - After: {n}The condemned roar. Stim injectors hiss.{/n}
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}One of the warriors, a woman with a stern face and a grim voice, says firmly,{/n} "Then there is no hope. We are doomed to remain captives of the xenos. But a clean death is a better fate by far. May we beg Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to grant us the Emperor's Peace?"
  - After: {n}A stern woman says,{/n} "Then we're doomed. A clean death is better. Grant us the Emperor's Peace, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"
- **Kabalite Ranger**
  - Before: {n}The crowd erupts into a wave of fierce cheers. The stimulant-fuelled cutthroats look ready to burst into the arena right now and strew their own guts all over its floor.{/n}
  - After: {n}Fierce, stim-fuelled cheers.{/n}
- **Kabalite Ranger**
  - Before: {n}Your words cause some eyes to flash with anger, but there is no one foolish enough to oppose you even among these gladiators pumped full of stimulants.{/n}
  - After: {n}Angry eyes, but no one dares oppose you.{/n}
- **Shrieker**
  - Before: {n}Some of the gladiators look confused, while others sigh in relief. You hear someone grumble in the back,{/n} "Finally, a boss who's right in the head. I was so sick of Malice mucking up the brains of fresh meat with his crap."
  - After: {n}Someone grumbles,{/n} "Finally, a sane boss."
- **Shrieker**
  - Before: {n}The gladiators, who were holding their breath, look at each other with relief. They must have taken your silence as a good sign. Or rather, your silence and the fact that you have not killed any of them yet.{/n}
  - After: {n}The gladiators exhale in relief.{/n}
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}You catch looks of displeasure coming from the Commissar's most fervent fighters, but the majority's spirits are only further crushed by this news. They drop to their knees and bow their heads, as is expected of serfs in the presence of their {mf|master|mistress}.{/n}
  - After: {n}Most kneel, crushed, as serfs before their {mf|master|mistress}.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar, whose proud features are utterly ruined, says in a gurgling voice,{/n} "Enjkhoy your little vikhtory while you khan. Khommorragh will rip your khead off quickher than it did mine. Then we'll see who'll be sitting in whose khage."
  - After: {n}The disfigured Commissar gurgles,{/n} "Enjkhoy it. Khommorragh will take your khead too. Then who's in the khage?"
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "To the arena? Nkho! Pkhlease, khan I pkhlease stay in this khage, pkhlease!" {n}The Commissar's feigned pride evaporates in an instant, leaving behind a thrashing, frightened animal.{/n}
  - After: "Nkho! Pkhlease, let me stay in this khage!" {n}His pride collapses into terror.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar shoots you a venomous glare.{/n}
  - After: {n}A venomous glare.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "You do nkhot need to tell me tkhwice. So longkh."
  - After: "So longkh."
- **Malice**
  - Before: {n}Malice's entire body is covered in grisly wounds. One of his arms has been nearly torn off and is now hanging by sinew. A human would have long since died from such injuries, but Malice does not even look like he is on his last legs.{/n} "Laugh away, humanling. You've won. 'Betray the one who aids you' — that's life in the spires."
  - After: {n}Malice is mangled, yet unbowed.{/n} "Laugh, humanling. 'Betray the one who aids you' — life in the spires."
- **Malice**
  - Before: "Very well. Once, you surprised me. You didn't die, and I lost my status. Maybe I won't die either. Maybe you will lose something too."
  - After: "You survived me. Maybe I'll survive too, and you'll lose something."
- **Malice**
  - Before: "Do you not see the irony of the situation? You think yourself the one with the key to the cage... But in truth, you yourself are caged."
  - After: "You think you hold the key... but you're caged too."
- **Malice**
  - Before: {n}Malice scoffs hoarsely and bares his fangs.{/n} "Not a chance. If I do, you might live, humanling. And I would still be sitting in this cage. No, your problems are your own."
  - After: {n}Malice bares his fangs.{/n} "Never. Your problems are your own."
- **Malice**
  - Before: {n}Malice stares at you with suspicion and then says cautiously,{/n} "Do not think that I will forget or forgive."
  - After: {n}Malice, warily:{/n} "I won't forget or forgive."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The resistance fighters are looking at you with a mixture of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarDead}fear and deep respect{/d}. They do not have the guts to break the silence and speak to you.{/n}
  - After: {n}The fighters regard you with {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_ComissarDead}fear and deep respect{/d}, silent.{/n}
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}A shocked murmur runs through the ranks. One fighter sobs, his face twisted in grief, while another whispers a string of curses, his fists clenched.{/n}
  - After: {n}Shocked murmurs, sobs, curses.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: "To survive. The Khult and I, we had a dkheal. They gkhet playthings, I gkhet protection. That's life in the spires."
  - After: "To survive. The Khult gkhet playthings, I gkhet protection."
- **Kabalite Ranger**
  - Before: {n}The frozen crowd exchange glances. Your fickle temper fills them with fear and hope that if they obey, your anger will once again pass them by.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd hopes obedience will spare them.{/n}
- **Zealous Thug**
  - Before: {n}The eyes of the Commissar's most zealous fighters flare in displeasure, but most are too crushed by the news. Your fickle temper does not inspire trust, but they have no one else to rely on.{/n}
  - After: {n}Zealots glare, but most are too crushed to resist.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Reeling, the Sslyth slithers away while looking straight at you without blinking, either in expectation of a sudden strike or to avoid making eye contact with anyone else.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Sslyth slithers off, eyes on you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar turns to you as he leaves, and you see a mad smile playing on his lips and a look in his eyes that says, "This isn't over."{/n}
  - After: {n}His mad smile says, "This isn't over."{/n}
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}The crowd erupts into emboldened shouts. Those who were ready to accept death with humble resignation a moment ago now look up with brightened expressions, gripping their weapons and roaring battle cries in the face of a grim fate.{/n}
  - After: {n}The resigned crowd now roars, gripping weapons.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_EmptyPit}gaggle of pathetic weaklings{/d} are all that is left of the denizens of this hideout. They are too terrified of the streets of Commorragh to leave this shelter, as unsafe as it has become.{/n}
  - After: {n}A {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_EmptyPit}gaggle of pathetic weaklings{/d} remain, too scared to leave.{/n}
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}In a united impulse, the crowd falls to its knees before you. You see their eyes, awestruck and warm like sunlight. As they offer their many-voiced prayer to the Emperor, you hear your name uttered over and over again.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd kneels in awe, praying and chanting your name.{/n}
- **Zealous Thug**
  - Before: {n}You catch looks of displeasure coming from the Commissar's most fervent fighters, but the majority greet your words with weary relief. You hear whispers among the crowd:{/n} "Well, why not? Maybe we will survive. Malice's thugs were doing all right for themselves. And we'll do just fine without the Emperor."
  - After: {n}Most seem relieved.{/n} "Why not? Malice's thugs did fine. We'll manage without the Emperor."
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}One by one, the proud people of the Imperium drop to their knees. Some of the faces show fear. Some display grim determination. Some bear expressions of serene acceptance. There are no cowards among the resistance fighters — none who would choose life among the xenos to death in the name of the Emperor.{/n}
  - After: {n}They kneel. None would choose life among xenos over death for the Emperor.{/n}
- **Malice**
  - Before: {n}Resilient to the end, the xenos refuses to die, clinging to his life with every fibre of his being. But there is nowhere for Malice to hide and, in the end, his cold heart stops. His jaw goes slack and his long, pale purple tongue falls out of his mouth. Malice, the master of the Shriekers, is dead.{/n}
  - After: {n}Malice clings to life, but his heart stops. The master of the Shriekers is dead.{/n}
- **Shrieker**
  - Before: {n}The people listen to you with wide eyes, hanging on every word with the greed of the downtrodden. As soon as you are finished speaking, you hear a cacophony of roars — and the clanging of weapons.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd roars, clanging weapons.{/n}
- **Kabalite Ranger**
  - Before: {n}Some gladiators let out a triumphant roar and charge in your direction to accept the gift of death from your hands. Others, terrified, scramble away with cries of fear.{/n}
  - After: {n}Some gladiators charge to die; others flee.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar meets your blow with a straight back and a raised chin. He gazes into the face of death with a fearlessness worthy of a true disciplinary officer of the Imperium.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Commissar dies fearless, like a true officer.{/n}
- **Commissar**
  - Before: {n}The Commissar meets your blow with a straight back and a raised chin just as a real disciplinary officer of the Imperium would. It may be nothing more than a fraud's deception, but this fraud relishes his performance and prefers to die without breaking character.{/n}
  - After: {n}The fraud dies in character, chin raised.{/n}
- **Imperial Guard**
  - Before: {n}In a united impulse, the crowd falls to its knees before you. You see grimaces of powerless rage and despair at the realisation that even the Emperor has betrayed them. Where once the Emperor's light shone in their souls, there is now only a gaping void waiting to be filled by a new patron. Every last one of them knows that their worthless fate is in your hands.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd kneels in despair: even the Emperor betrayed them. Their faith is a void, their fate yours.{/n}
- **Zealous Thug**
  - Before: "For our {mf|lord|lady} von Valancius! Kill the xenos spawn, crush their skulls, and let their blood flow!" {n}The bloodthirsty cry shakes the walls of the den, and the mere sound of it makes you feel as if you can taste the blood of your enemies in your throat.{/n}
  - After: "For our {mf|lord|lady} von Valancius! Crush the xenos!" {n}The cry shakes the den.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/PitCassia/PitCassia_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Lady Navigator, compose yourself! You are embarrassing the Orsellio name!"
  - After: "Compose yourself! You shame the Orsellio name!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will overcome this, Cassia. You are stronger than you think you are."
  - After: "You'll overcome this. You're stronger than you think."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Soothe her with prayer] "May the Emperor's radiance illuminate our way through the tenebrous gloom as we that are broken of heart turn to His wisdom..."
  - After: [Soothe her with prayer] "May the Emperor's radiance light our way..."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not interested in listening to you vent your grievances. Prove that you are still of use to me, or I shall send you back into the darkness!"
  - After: "Spare me your grievances. Prove your use, or back into the dark!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Seal Cassia inside the capsule] "I am doing this for everyone's sake."
  - After: [Seal Cassia inside the capsule] "It's for everyone's sake."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Leave Cassia] "You are a ticking time bomb. I cannot take you with me."
  - After: [Leave Cassia] "You're a ticking bomb. You stay."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will not leave you here. Come along."
  - After: "I won't leave you. Come."
- **Player**
  - Before: "And now... May I escort you out of here?"
  - After: "Now, may I escort you out?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Soothe her with prayer] "...The Emperor is with us so long as we remember our purpose — to serve Humankind and to never give in to its enemies..."
  - After: [Soothe her with prayer] "...He is with us while we serve Humankind and never yield..."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia] "I shall grant your final request."
  - After: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia] "I'll grant your final request."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia] "I should have killed you as soon as I met you."
  - After: [Pick up a pistol from the floor and shoot Cassia] "I should have killed you long ago."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are frightened, but that does not mean you can give up. Do not let these emotions consume you!"
  - After: "You're frightened, but don't give up. Don't let it consume you!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are angry with me? Why?"
  - After: "You're angry with me? Why?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "My only thought was to save you."
  - After: "I only wanted to save you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What you say is true. Growing too close does not bode well for either of us. I hope you understand."
  - After: "True. Growing close bodes ill for us both."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I was thinking about a future where we are together."
  - After: "I was thinking of our future together."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I was not thinking, just... acting."
  - After: "I wasn't thinking, just acting."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whatever happened to you, we can make it right. Put your trust in me."
  - After: "We can fix this. Trust me."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kiss her] "Words fail me as I seek to express my feelings. Let my actions speak for me."
  - After: [Kiss her] "Let my actions speak."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you wish to spend the rest of your days as the Haemonculus's test subject?"
  - After: "Want to be the Haemonculus's test subject forever?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "For all those years, fear and loneliness were all you knew. Not anymore. Don't you dare wish death upon yourself! When I am with you, I will strive to alleviate your every sorrow!"
  - After: "You knew only fear and loneliness. No more. Don't wish for death! I'll ease your sorrows!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Hold her and kiss her] "Don't even think of leaving me, Cassia. I won't let you go."
  - After: [Hold her and kiss her] "Don't leave me, Cassia. I won't let you go."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Hold her closer] "I fear that if I were to let you go, you might want to disappear again."
  - After: [Hold her closer] "If I let go, you might vanish again."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kill Cassia] "Forgive me, love. I shall grant your final request."
  - After: [Kill Cassia] "Forgive me, love. I'll grant your request."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We are in enemy territory! Unless you regain control of yourself, I will end this tumult personally!"
  - After: "We're in enemy territory! Control yourself, or I'll end this!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Cassia, the worst part is over. I am taking you away from this place."
  - After: "The worst is over. I'm taking you out of here."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will pay dearly for the injuries you have caused me. Come with me."
  - After: "You'll pay for hurting me. Come."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Thank the Emperor, you look like yourself again. Let us depart. There will be other opportunities to talk."
  - After: "Thank the Emperor, you're yourself again. Let's go; we'll talk later."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Smile through the pain] "All is well, my lady. You can defeat this. I shall stay by your side and help however I can."
  - After: [Smile through the pain] "All is well. You can beat this. I'll stay and help."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Cassia, we have walked a long road together. Do not make me abandon you here. Keep fighting!"
  - After: "We've come so far. Don't make me abandon you. Fight!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have had to rein in your gift before. Try to remember how you did it then!"
  - After: "You've reined in your gift before. Remember how!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I... feel. At last, I feel something..." {n}You see horror and confusion in Cassia's wide-open eyes. Her face, neck, and hands are gruesomely scratched and sticky blood is dripping from the tips of her claw-like fingernails.{/n} "Ah! Why are there so many of you at once? Red. Black. Violet. Scarlet. Yellow. Dark maroon... Away with you! Stop swarming my thoughts!"
  - After: "I feel. At last..." {n}She's clawed and bloody.{/n} "So many colours! Away! Stop swarming my thoughts!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Orsellio name... is no less glorious than that of von Valancius..." {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "Rogue Traders are not the only ones favoured by the Emperor, {name}. Do not dare threaten me."
  - After: "Orsellio is no less glorious than von Valancius." {n}She looks imperious, like Theodora.{/n} "Don't threaten me, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia clutches her head again, this time covering her third eye, but you can already feel the breath of the warp coming from its gaze. The {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone fused into her body{/d} heats up under her pale skin, burns through it, and... cracks.{/n} "{name}, I cannot control it!" {n}The powers flowing through Cassia's fragile body make your head swim and your hair stand on end.{/n}
  - After: {n}She covers her third eye; the warp seeps through. The {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone fused into her body{/d} cracks.{/n} "{name}, I can't control it!" {n}Your head swims.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia clutches her head again, this time covering her third eye, but you can already feel the breath of the warp coming from its gaze.{/n} "{name}, I... I cannot control it!" {n}The powers flowing through Cassia's fragile body make your head swim and your hair stand on end.{/n}
  - After: {n}She covers her third eye; the warp seeps through.{/n} "{name}, I can't control it!" {n}Your head swims.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I thank you for pulling me out of that... darkness, Lord Captain. And I beg your forgiveness for what happened. I... Oh, let us leave this awful place at last."
  - After: "Thank you for pulling me from that darkness. Forgive me. Let us leave."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "...And may His light scatter the darkness ahead, for the Astronomican is the beacon and His guiding blessing to me..."
  - After: {n}She looks imperious, like Theodora.{/n} "...May His light scatter the darkness, for the Astronomican is my beacon..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia struggles to focus her eyes on you. An unfamiliar expression is imprinted on her pale, gaunt face, one that is stern, confident, and imperious. It is the same expression you saw on Theodora von Valancius's face when you first met her.{/n} "At this very moment, I am trying to save your life. Should I... stop?"
  - After: {n}She looks imperious, like Theodora.{/n} "I'm saving your life. Should I stop?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Remarkable. You believe in me even when I have lost all faith in my own strength." {n}Cassia smiles faintly, enduring the pain.{/n}
  - After: "You believe in me when I can't." {n}A pained smile.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your body is burning as if you have been doused with a vat of molten plasteel, and your head is teeming with strange whispers, shadows, voices... Every breath is a struggle, as though something is scratching at your insides, trying to claw its way out of your chest. Your gorge rises. You have survived being exposed to the Navigator's open eye, but will your body and mind hold if it occurs again?{/n}
  - After: {n}You burn; whispers fill your head. You survived her open eye once. Again?{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You know, when darkness envelops you... it takes everything away. Leaving no sounds, no smells, no solid footing. Darkness devours every colour that tries to make its way in. Every colour I tried to create inside. Darkness is withering, it swallows the colours, it chews and consumes... But when despair had overtaken me completely, I could sense I was not alone in that darkness. Someone else was with me. Someone intangible, cold, and colourless. And that realisation ravaged my sanity all the more."
  - After: "Darkness devours every colour. In my despair, I sensed someone cold with me. That broke me further."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia closes her eyes and the tremors in her body taper to a stop. With a weary movement of her hand, she adjusts her forehead adornment, taking care to cover her Navigator's eye, and you no longer feel the menace that was emanating from her a moment ago.{/n} "Thank... you? Your words, they helped. I feel a little better..."
  - After: {n}She calms and covers her Navigator's eye.{/n} "Thank... you? That helped."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A haze of anger, despair, and fear smothers you like a burial shroud, but this is not the first time you have had to deal with a surge of foreign emotions assailing your mind. You wish you would die here and now. No. You wish you had never been born in the first place. You summon your will and push these thoughts away as though fending off a sword thrust, and Cassia's feelings dissipate before they can latch onto you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Anger, despair, fear. You wish you'd never been born. You've faced this before, and push it away.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A haze of anger, despair, and fear smothers you like a burial shroud. Rage is burrowing under your skin with hundreds of needles and distress is turning your lungs inside out. An inexplicable sense of loneliness and emptiness permeates your mind. You are drowning in someone else's emotions... or are they your own? It no longer matters. You are powerless to stop them. You wish you would die here and now. No. You wish you had never been born in the first place.{/n}
  - After: {n}Anger, despair, fear. You drown in emotions, hers or yours. You wish you'd never been born.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia takes a hesitant step toward you and nods slowly. Her fear and despair spread to you like a heavy burden upon your shoulders. Resisting her emotions was a difficult task even when they were stable. Now her powers have become that much more overwhelming.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cassia nods. Her despair weighs on you, stronger than ever.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With visible effort, Cassia clasps her hands in a gesture of prayer.{/n} "...and to believe in His might, and His aid, and His wisdom. And if we still have the strength to fight, then fight we shall to the end..." {n}Her pale brow furrows and rivulets of blood run from her nose and eyes. Undeterred, she focuses on bringing her powers under control... until her body jolts as if electrocuted.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cassia prays.{/n} "...If we can fight, we'll fight to the end..." {n}Bleeding, she strains for control... until she jolts.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}With visible effort, Cassia clasps her hands in a gesture of prayer but lets go instantly.{/n} "I cannot, I just..." {n}She suddenly straightens and her gaze becomes impassive and blank.{/n}

  - Before: {n}...with a sharp sound, the tubes slip out from under her skin, spraying blood mixed with some foul-smelling ochre-coloured slime, and the device detaches from Idira's head. She lets out a piercing cry, her head jerking back from the pain — and the delicate device clinks as it shatters into tiny fragments.{/n}
  - After: {n}The tubes tear out bloodily. Idira screams; the device shatters.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What have you done?" {n}Idira ignores the hundreds of cuts on her face, neck, and hands and reaches for the shards on the floor.{/n} "That... that was my hope! My salvation from all the crap that keeps crawling inside my head! And you just..."
  - After: "What have you done?" {n}Bleeding, she grabs at the shards.{/n} "That was my salvation!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}She takes a few moments to fight back the sobs welling up in her throat. Then she quickly wipes her face, straightens, and gives you a spiteful look.{/n} "You win... Lord Captain. Since dying of old age is off the table now, there's no point in me hanging around here. I'm going with you."
  - After: {n}She swallows sobs and glares.{/n} "You win, Lord Captain. I'm going with you."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia gives you a look full of pain and doubt.{/n} "Perhaps we should not deny her the choice to be... free in her own way?"
  - After: {n}Cassia looks pained.{/n} "Should we deny her freedom her way?"

  - Before: {n}Spellbound, Idira listens to the sound of your voice and weakly repeats after you,{/n} "Because the whispers are who I am, and I am the whispers... ## World/Dialogs/Ch3/Chasm/PitMarazhai/PitMarazhai_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, bearer of the Warrant of Trade and the Emperor's anointed — do not dare reject the immense honour of swearing allegiance to me and doing my will!"
  - After: "I am Rogue Trader {name} von Valancius, Warrant bearer and the Emperor's anointed. Swearing allegiance to me is an honour you won't refuse!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address Aebys] "So you and your rabble are the champions of the local arena?"
  - After: [Address Aebys] "So your rabble are the arena champions?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "So Marazhai was skinned and made to fight like this? Well, that is a balm to my heart. And also a delight to my eyes, where something was still stirring a while ago."
  - After: "Marazhai, skinned and made to fight? A balm to my heart, and to my eye, where something stirred a while ago."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address Marazhai] "I just wanted to get a proper look at you. Humiliated, stripped of everything you were. And later... later I shall find a way to kill you."
  - After: [Address Marazhai] "I wanted to see you humiliated, stripped of everything. Later, I'll kill you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are trapped. I am trapped. We could help each other."
  - After: "We're both trapped. We could help each other."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I saw what happened at the trial. You were tricked."
  - After: "I saw the trial. You were tricked."

  - Before: "Let's make a deal: you help me take out my enemies and I shall help you take out yours."
  - After: "A deal: help me kill my enemies, I'll help with yours."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have caused so much trouble for my protectorate that the only fitting punishment is to drag you out of Commorragh alive so that you may pay your debt to me."
  - After: "You've troubled my protectorate so much that I'll drag you out of Commorragh alive to repay me."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Snap the Elucidator shut and address Marazhai] "Your kin do not seem overly fond of you."
  - After: [Snap the Elucidator shut and address Marazhai] "Your kin don't seem fond of you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I want to get out of Commorragh alive. I need allies."
  - After: "I want out of Commorragh alive. I need allies."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Lean closer] "From the bottom of my heart, I hope you die in agony."
  - After: [Lean closer] "I sincerely hope you die in agony."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I believe in mercy. Even for the likes of you."
  - After: "I believe in mercy. Even for you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Oh, so you like being in this dump at the beck and call of this rabble? Aren't you afraid they won't give you back your skin the next time?"
  - After: "You like serving this rabble in this dump? Afraid they'll keep your skin next time?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address all the Drukhari in front of you] "Know this — I will kill each and every one of you! And I do not care if you are champions or not!"
  - After: [Address all the Drukhari in front of you] "I'll kill every one of you, champions or not!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai's eyes flare with turquoise fire at the sight of you — an immediate, uncontrollable urge to kill. The Drukhari seizes the blades hanging from his belt — and freezes at the shout of the metal-studded xenos.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai grabs his blades, but a shout stops him.{/n}
- **Aebys**
