  - Before: [Kill Marazhai] "Grant you the pleasure of torturing this vicious freak to death? I think not!"
  - After: [Kill Marazhai] "Let you torture this freak? No!"
- **Mandrake**
  - Before: {n}The Mandrake's words are barely comprehensible: the creature is clearly not accustomed to the tongue of its dark kin.{/n} "The Dracn din't offer a scrifice for our dids. The Dracn must become the scrifice."
  - After: {n}It rasps.{/n} "The Dracn must be the scrifice."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai places a hand on his weapon. His voice sounds calm but his gaze is tense as he peers at the dark creature before him.{/n} "You should not have crawled out of the abyss that your wretched kind call home. Consider our pact broken. Nazrakhei did not hold up his end of the bargain, so I had to finish the job myself."
  - After: {n}Marazhai grips his weapon.{/n} "Nazrakhei failed. Our pact is broken."
- **Mandrake**
  - Before: "The rsult... matters not. The scrifice will be made." {n}The Mandrake's head turns to you.{/n} "Make the sacrifice, mon-keigh. The tribe never relents. The tribe will find you."
  - After: "The scrifice will be made." {n}It turns to you.{/n} "The tribe will find you."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Throne's mercy... Lord Captain, it was extravagant enough of you to get yourself a pet xenos and now we discover that he comes with a whole gaggle of his kinfolk!"
  - After: "Throne's mercy... a pet xenos, and now his kin too!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Mind your tongue before I cut it down for you. The Mandrakes care not about mon-keigh. The Mandrakes want me. Even if they were to grow bold enough to come for me... oh, it would be quite an amusement to behold."
  - After: "Mind your tongue. They want me. Let them try."
- **Mandrake**
  - Before: {n}The xenos's body crumples to the floor, staining it with dark blood. The Mandrake scrapes its claws against the floor and lets out a wrathful hiss.{/n} "You will pay, mon-keigh! The tribe will take you and your whole pack for this one Dracn!"
  - After: {n}The xenos falls. The Mandrake hisses.{/n} "The tribe will take your whole pack for this!"
- **Mandrake**
  - Before: "Hshhh... Senseless crture. The tribe will fnd you. The tribe will have its scrifice."
  - After: "Hshhh... The tribe will have its scrifice."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari glowers at you.{/n} "So is keeping you, {name}."
  - After: {n}He glowers.{/n} "So are you, {name}."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari draws his weapon.{/n} "And if your filth needs a lesson in the language of pain..."
  - After: {n}He draws his weapon.{/n} "A lesson in pain, then..."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai gives you a look of bafflement and fury but does not get the chance to say anything in response.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai stares, furious, silenced.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, you can have him! I'm sure no one will miss him."
  - After: "Oh, you can have him!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, these creatures... It is as if they absorb the colours around them and spew out darkness. I do not think they are lying or trying to intimidate us. They will come from the shadows, just as they came once before."
  - After: "They're not bluffing, Lord Captain. They'll come from the shadows."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "It appears that the consequences of a certain someone's actions have caught up to them."
  - After: "Consequences caught up with someone."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "With a pure heart, I will raise my horn in praise to the Allfather on the day that this sharp-tongued scum dies. The foul xenos may be a meagre trophy, but he is still our trophy. Giving him up without a fight to this talking mop is shameful."
  - After: "I'd toast his death. But he's our trophy. Giving him up without a fight is shameful."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "This xenos's actions have done great harm to Humanity, and justice demands that—" {n}Solomorne falters.{/n} "No, I can't lie to myself — I don't want any human being to sully their weapon with killing that scumbag. Let him be devoured by his own kind."
  - After: "Justice—" {n}Solomorne falters.{/n} "No. Let his own kind devour him."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/ReavingTempestSpire/SpireCompanionBefore/SpireCompanionBefore

- **Player**
  - Before: "Fine. Just point out where this property of yours is."
  - After: "Fine. Where's your property?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will not waste my time on that."
  - After: "Not worth my time."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Yrliet, what is the plan to find your kin?"
  - After: "Yrliet, how do we find your kin?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Marazhai, what should we expect to find inside the spire?"
  - After: "Marazhai, what's inside the spire?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "It's settled then. Let's get out of this hole."
  - After: "Settled. Let's leave this hole."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How do you know how to unseal the Gate? I find such deep trust between two Drukhari too good to be true."
  - After: "How do you know how to unseal the Gate? Drukhari don't trust."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not trust you. It must be a trap intended to secure a pardon for yourself."
  - After: "It's a trap to buy your pardon."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Come along. When we find the Farseers, you will have all your answers."
  - After: "Come. The Farseers will have answers."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Don't even think about it! If you leave now, there will be no way back for you."
  - After: "Leave now and there's no way back!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The gargantuan spire is too large to see in its entirety. Its true proportions are shrouded in shadows, and you feel as if those shadows try to envelop and swallow you whenever you look away.{/n}
  - After: {n}The vast spire is swallowed by grasping shadows.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Ai'elethra has long since guided me down the roads of thorns. And you, elantach, are just another fleeting companion along one of them. Ask me a hundred times if I would choose to save my kin or walk at a mon-keigh's side, and my answer will not change once. Farewell, stranger from the darkness amid the stars. Here our Paths diverge."
  - After: "You were a fleeting companion on my thorny road. I'll always choose my kin. Farewell, stranger. Here our Paths diverge."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "So that's our way out, eh? Can't wait... I can't wait to get far away from here... I can't believe I'm saying this but I really want to see a real sun, not those pale feeble things among the spires!"
  - After: "Our way out? I can't wait to see a real sun!"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Grinning savagely, Ulfar says with undisguised joy,{/n} "I smell blood in the air — blood that is about to be spilt. I hear the echo of clashing swords and the terrified screams of xenos writhing under our heel. Allfather, what a marvellous feast you have prepared for me!"
  - After: {n}Ulfar grins.{/n} "I smell blood. Allfather, what a feast!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Of course. First, we need to find my raider. Most likely, at the end of the dock outside the spire. Let's go to the end of this terrace before we enter the spire."
  - After: "First, my raider, at the end of the dock. This way."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "If you wish for me to use my knowledge and open a path out of Commorragh for us, find this item. Without it, I am powerless to make the Webway allow us entry into its labyrinths."
  - After: "Find this item, or I can't open the Webway."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "The Spire of the Reaving Tempest. The seat of my Kabal. Both a place to find respite from the scheming of our enemies and a deadly trap for those too weak and soft for our ranks." {n}Marazhai tilts his head and glances at you.{/n} "The heart of the spire contains a secret: an ancient Webway Gate that has remained sealed for many, many aeons. Yremeryss kept it in case Vect's noose happened to tighten around the Kabal's neck. No one save for her and a certain other Kabalite knows where exactly in realspace the Gate leads. A perfect escape route. And I can open it for you."
  - After: "The Spire of the Reaving Tempest, my Kabal's seat." {n}He glances at you.{/n} "Its heart hides a sealed Webway Gate, Yremeryss's escape from Vect. I can open it."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Elantach..." {n}Yrliet touches the glowing stone in her chest and turns her aching gaze to the spire. Her face is burdened with a strange expression, as if a roaring torrent of sadness, fear, and rage is about to erupt.{/n} "My kin from Crudarach are still there, I can sense it. As I can sense the flames of their souls inexorably going out."
  - After: "Elantach..." {n}Yrliet touches her soul stone.{/n} "My Crudarach kin are in there. Their souls are going out."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai grips his weapon.{/n} "You cannot wait to leave Commorragh... and I cannot wait to pay my sister a visit. Rest assured, she is somewhere nearby."
  - After: {n}He grips his weapon.{/n} "And I'll visit my sister. She's near."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Trust? How unreliable. No, I simply abducted and tortured the Kabalite who was privy to this secret. There is even a chance that Yremeryss believed the story about the pathetic weakling running off."
  - After: "Trust? No. I tortured the Kabalite who knew."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Bah!" {n}The Kabalite lets out a grim laugh.{/n} "It will take more than your hide for Yremeryss to accept me back... Still, have it your way. It will provide me with a great deal of amusement to watch you scurry about in search of a different escape out of Commorragh."
  - After: "Bah!" {n}A grim laugh.{/n} "Find your own way out, then. I'll enjoy watching."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Please, while there is still time, I... we must save them! Let me accompany you into that nest of depravity, that domain of pain, anger, and betrayal of my kind." {n}Yrliet's voice is trembling like a taut string and her eyes are clouded with darkness.{/n} "Fury and fear are devouring me from the inside out and I do not know what frightens me more: the grim answers that hide behind the spire's walls or the scars that my heart will bear once I discover them. Yet, I must learn the truth about my world. Perhaps... this is the day the Outcast finds her Path again."
  - After: "Please, we must save them! Let me come." {n}Her voice trembles.{/n} "I fear what I'll find. But I must know. Perhaps today the Outcast finds her Path again."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Farseers are not easy captives to keep. Whatever the Dark Ones are using to repress my kin's powers, those... tools will be noticeable. I will find a way to them."
  - After: "Whatever suppresses the Farseers' powers will be noticeable. I'll find it."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Kabalites. Wyches. Incubi — at Yremeryss's side." {n}He pauses for a moment, an expression of concern flashing across his pale features.{/n} "That is all."
  - After: "Kabalites. Wyches. Incubi with Yremeryss." {n}A flash of concern.{/n} "That's all."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Then I will go alone." {n}Her voice is calm and quiet, without any hint of a plea or reproach. All you can hear is unshakeable resolve.{/n} "Only after I have found the germ of truth within the spire's dark halls will we reunite."
  - After: "Then I go alone." {n}Calm, resolute.{/n} "We'll reunite once I know the truth."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "So that is your answer?" {n}Yrliet covers her eyes with her hand and laughs for the first time, sadly and bitterly.{/n} "How could I ever have thought that a mon-keigh would... It does not matter. One day, your fear and hatred will consume you from within, elantach. Praise Isha, I will no longer be at your side when they do. Farewell, stranger from the darkness amid the stars. Our shared Path ends here."
  - After: "That's your answer?" {n}She laughs bitterly.{/n} "Your fear and hatred will consume you, elantach. I won't be there. Farewell. Our Path ends here."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Fury and fear are devouring me from the inside out, and I do not know what frightens me more — the grim answers that hide behind the spire's walls or the scars that my heart will bear once I discover them. Yet, I must learn the truth about my world. Perhaps... this is the day the Outcast finds her Path again."
  - After: "I fear what I'll find. But I must know. Perhaps today the Outcast finds her Path again."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet sends you one last look of suppressed sorrow, turns away, and disappears into the darkness a moment later.{/n}
  - After: {n}One sorrowful look, and Yrliet is gone.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Tossing her fiery-red hair as she turns, Yrliet rushes off.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet rushes off.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "You speak the truth, elantach. Let us be on our way. We will tear their lives from the clutches of my insatiable cousins." {n}She turns her face to you and, despite her tense expression, you see the corners of her mouth twitch.{/n} "I find myself wondering if a single Farseer, gazing at the hazy visions of things yet to come, ever glimpsed a future where the key to their salvation stemmed from the duo of a mon-keigh and an Outcast."
  - After: "True. Let us free them." {n}She almost smiles.{/n} "Did any Farseer foresee rescue by a mon-keigh and an Outcast?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Spire of the Reaving Tempest welcomes you with muffled noises seeping from its dark walls: distant voices, footsteps, and screams of pain.{/n}
  - After: {n}Voices and screams seep from the walls.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "We can only hope that your gift, Lady Navigator, will plot a trajectory toward liberation. This xenos stronghold is overflowing with ignorance and malice, and my internal chronometer counts down the seconds until we can finally depart this dismal vale."
  - After: "Guide us out, Lady Navigator. I count the seconds."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "As for the Webway Gate that the Arebennian mentioned... For it to open before you and let you enter the Webway, you would require help from one of our kind." {n}Yrliet's brow furrows.{/n} "I could... try to open the Gate. But to do that, I would need a certain construct: a resonance device. The masters of this place must keep it close at hand."
  - After: "Only my kind can open the Webway Gate." {n}She frowns.{/n} "I'd need a resonance device. The masters here keep one."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Try to avoid dying before our next meeting, elantach."
  - After: "Try not to die, elantach."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "I have a..." {n}Marazhai stops, searching for the right word.{/n} "A desire. Before we leave the spire, there is something I want to pick up. Something... memorable. I left it in the Kabal's abode. I do not want it to fall into the hands of others when carrion eaters and looters flood the spire after we are gone. There could be something in it for you..." {n}He lets the last words hang in the air.{/n}
  - After: "I have a..." {n}He pauses.{/n} "A desire. Something I left in the Kabal's abode, before looters take it. Something in it for you..." {n}He lets it hang.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "By the Golden Throne, we made it! And all in one piece. Not bad... But we can't relax just yet — we've still got a long way to go."
  - After: "Throne, we made it! But it's a long way yet."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai scoffs with contempt and turns away.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai scoffs, turning away.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "The colours here... are especially dark and dangerous. It is as if I am drowning in a bottomless ocean of billowing haze. But... what is it? I feel a faint tremor coming from deep inside the spire. Like the call of the Immaterium, except much purer."
  - After: "The colours here drown me. But deep inside, I feel a tremor, like the Immaterium, but purer."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "You are right, peddler: hope blinds. You sounded like a true commander just now. The xenos city must have given you a shock — have you considered repenting and breaking away from your shameful past once we are back in the Expanse?"
  - After: "Hope blinds, peddler. Spoken like a commander. Ready to repent your past?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "There's only one past I wanted to break from, and I have already done so, thank you! And also — warp damn it, lawman, you've said it yourself: hope blinds. So drop it with the daydreaming and making plans about my future!"
  - After: "Already did, thanks! Hope blinds, lawman, so stop planning my future!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/ReavingTempestSpire/YremerissFinal/YremerissFinal

- **Player**
  - Before: "I see you have taken Tervantias under your wing. Again."
  - After: "Protecting Tervantias again."
- **Player**
  - Before: "All those craftworld fragments, all those prisoners... Was it all worth it, xenos?"
  - After: "All those craftworld prisoners. Worth it, xenos?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The toys of your pet Haemonculus did little to help him."
  - After: "Your Haemonculus's toys failed him."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you wish to live, then get out of my way. I have come for the Gate, not your life."
  - After: "Move aside and live. I want the Gate."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have grown tired of the games and machinations you have ushered into my realm. Prepare to die, Archon Yremeryss."
  - After: "Enough games. Prepare to die, Archon Yremeryss."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What did you need the Farseers for? Why take such a risk?"
  - After: "Why risk taking the Farseers?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Marazhai, do you have any last words for your sister?"
  - After: "Marazhai, last words for your sister?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "In the name of the God-Emperor, I will destroy you, xenos!"
  - After: "In the God-Emperor's name, die, xenos!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Have you any final words to speak before your demise, Yremeryss?"
  - After: "Any final words, Yremeryss?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yremeryss gazes at you. The two of you lock eyes for the first time, an icy darkness churning in her stare.{/n} "Worm. Insect. You have... the nerve... to stand before me again? You should have gasped your last breath long ago. Very well. I will rid this arrogant mon-keigh of {mf|his|her} final breath myself."
  - After: {n}Her icy stare.{/n} "Insect. You dare return? I'll take {mf|his|her} last breath myself."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Miserable vermin!" {n}Yremeryss hisses through her teeth upon seeing you. Despite her blazing eyes and her bared teeth, you plainly discern what is in the Drukhari's heart: {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_DaemonicBreach}fear{/d}.{/n} "I will see to it that death comes for you slowly!"
  - After: "Vermin!" {n}She hisses, but you see {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_DaemonicBreach}fear{/d}.{/n} "You'll die slowly!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai draws his weapon in a single fluid motion.{/n} "Before your soul perishes in the maw of She Who Thirsts, I will teach it pain — the kind of pain you have never known in the whole of your existence, sister."
  - After: {n}Marazhai draws.{/n} "First, sister, I'll teach you pain."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Archon's gaze shifts away from you — to Marazhai. A venomous smile spreads across her face.{/n} "My former Dracon... My inept executioner. Have you found yourself a new {mf|master|mistress}?"
  - After: {n}She smiles at Marazhai.{/n} "My inept Dracon. A new {mf|master|mistress}?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's spirit stone flashes on her chest and the Ranger's hands tremble on the grip of her rifle.{/n} "Your death will give me no joy, Archon Yremeryss. But it may give peace to the spirits of my kin."
  - After: {n}Yrliet's stone flashes.{/n} "Your death brings no joy. Perhaps peace for my kin."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What about you, child of Crudarach? How does it feel to know that you could not save yourself, your family, or your precious craftworld?"
  - After: "And you, child of Crudarach? You saved no one."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yremeryss tilts her head.{/n} "I intend to live, mon-keigh. I will live. And I will continue my work and lead my Kabal to greatness."
  - After: {n}She tilts her head.{/n} "I will live, and lead my Kabal to greatness."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Spare yourself the struggle of comprehending the meaning behind my deeds, wretched creature. Crudarach was to be my key to power the likes of which the Reaving Tempest could only dream of. Majesty is mine alone to claim, and I will claim it!"
  - After: "Crudarach was my key to power. Majesty is mine to claim!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yremeryss smirks.{/n} "Oh, I am certain the Haemonculus still has plenty of unbroken toys left. You haven't seen even a tenth of what Tervantias commands."
  - After: {n}She smirks.{/n} "Tervantias has plenty more toys."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yremeryss laughs. The sound is reminiscent of a snake hissing.{/n} "Oh, mon-keigh. You are a brazen one, aren't you? Will you still be so brash when I flay you open and string you up by your sinews?"
  - After: {n}A hissing laugh.{/n} "Brash, until I flay you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My servants are heading out on a new hunt as we speak. Who will become their prey? Which lights will wink out in the void? How many mon-keigh will perish in the darkness?" {n}Yremeryss lets out a mocking laugh.{/n} "You will never know."
  - After: "My servants hunt anew. Whose lights will go out?" {n}She laughs.{/n} "You'll never know."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "You purged the ranks of the Kabal and cleared all obstacles from your path? Even in that you failed, you talentless wretch. I am still here. I will be the one to purge the Reaving Tempest of you."
  - After: {n}Marazhai glares.{/n} "You failed to purge me. I'll purge you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yremeryss stiffens, and a moment later bares her teeth in a furious hiss. The Archon of the Reaving Tempest raises a hand to signal to her underlings.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yremeryss hisses and signals her underlings.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai laughs mockingly.{/n} "Dragging Farseers into our spire in an attempt to trigger a dysjunction — that was your grand vision? It is a pity you have not bothered to lead a single raid in recent years — it would have been entertaining to watch you order a fleet to fly headlong into mon-keigh structures and detonate their engines, all to secure a bright future for the Kabal!"
  - After: {n}Marazhai laughs.{/n} "A dysjunction via Farseers? Your grand vision? Next you'd ram our fleet into mon-keigh stations!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You lie, xenos! This is the foul slander of an enemy of Humanity!"
  - After: "Lies, xenos! Slander against Humanity!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Blessed Throne..." {n}Abelard closes his eyes and shakes his head in sorrow. It seems the xenos's admission has aged him five years.{/n}
  - After: "Blessed Throne..." {n}Abelard looks aged.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Die? Ha!" {n}Yremeryss draws her weapon.{/n} "You are the only one who dies today. And after I am done with you, I will pay a visit to realspace — to observe the terror and ruin wrought by my Kabal."
  - After: "Die? Ha!" {n}She draws.{/n} "Only you die today. Then I'll watch my Kabal ravage realspace."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai's lips stretch into a saccharine smile.{/n} "My poor older sister, you still cannot stand the fact that I was born... but how can I be surprised? It is hard to think of more glaring proof that our mother considered her first attempt to continue the line a failure."
  - After: {n}Marazhai smiles sweetly.{/n} "Still bitter, sister? Mother thought you a failure."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do you know, mon-keigh, that so many of your kind have had their lives cut short at the hands of their own kin? I used you to purge the ranks of the Kabal, to clear all obstacles from my path. I used you to accomplish my goals. I colluded with your kind — despite your much-vaunted hatred of xenos, which ought to have prevented any of you from even considering such a thing!"
  - After: "Mon-keigh, your own kin killed so many of you. I used humans to purge my Kabal and clear my path, despite your vaunted hatred of xenos!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "You destroyed your future with your own hands. When the truth became known, all the weapons of Commorragh would have turned against you — and against my Kabal!"
  - After: "You doomed yourself. All Commorragh would turn on you, and my Kabal!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And this coward was my Dracon? You are too quick to call the Reaving Tempest your Kabal — you have neither the ambition nor the vision to lead all these warriors full of lust for power and blood!"
  - After: "This coward was my Dracon? You couldn't lead the Reaving Tempest!"
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "It sickens me to say this, but I believe the xenos. I know what kinds of things people will do in the name of personal gain, and now that the foul spawn has confessed, the situation in the Expanse suddenly makes a lot more sense."
  - After: "Sickening, but I believe it. The Expanse suddenly makes sense."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "No, Archon, you are destined for retribution. Blood for blood. I cannot destroy your entire Kabal as you destroyed Crudarach but I have the strength to cut off the snake's head."
  - After: "Blood for blood, Archon. I'll cut off the snake's head."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Oh, no. That could not be further from the truth. Archon Aezyrraesh dies today. Here. Now."
  - After: "Oh no. Archon Aezyrraesh dies. Here. Now."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Haemonculus may play as many of his little games in the arena as he pleases. I am satisfied with what he provides for the ranks of the Kabal. That makes him valuable enough to spare his life."
  - After: "The Haemonculus serves my Kabal well. That earns his life."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Poor little Outcast..." {n}Yremeryss leers at Yrliet, staring into her eyes like a predator.{/n} "The suffering of your brothers and sisters nourished us for a long time... Now you too will give me your pain!"
  - After: "Poor Outcast..." {n}She leers.{/n} "Your kin's pain fed us. Now yours!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So be it, I will humour you before death... If only to step out of another's shadow once and for all. I wished to orchestrate a little dysjunction — and with my helpless brethren in my clutches, who are capable of tearing apart the veil with their mere presence, it could not have been simpler. When the time came, the Farseers would be my weapon against the Reaving Tempest's rivals — under cover of the cataclysm, my blades would behead all those who stood in the way of my ascent!"
  - After: "Fine... I planned a dysjunction. Captive Farseers tear the veil just by being there. In the chaos, my blades would behead my rivals!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Now you speak only with the permission of your pet mon-keigh?" {n}Yremeryss laughs mockingly.{/n} "My insignificant little brother, you never should have crawled out of our mother's womb, your existence is a disgrace to our blood..."
  - After: "Speaking with your pet's permission?" {n}She laughs.{/n} "Little brother, you disgrace our blood..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Such amusing loftiness coming from an insect... Your toy god cannot help you. And nor can he help your fellow kin, that delectable prey still confined to the boundless darkness of realspace."
  - After: "Your toy god can't help you, insect, or your kin, our prey."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/RogueTraderKidnappingAhilleas/AchilleasTrap/AchilleasTrap_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Where can we find the main cogitator?"
  - After: "Where's the main cogitator?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where should we set up the ambush?"
  - After: "Where do we ambush?"
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, my agents report that Kunrad Voigtvir and his pet xenos will soon arrive. We have roughly an hour to inspect the station and set up the ambush. Unless, of course, you prefer to face the conspirators head-on." {n}Achilleas brings a trembling hand with his gilded respirator to his lips.{/n}
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Voigtvir and his xenos arrive within the hour. We can ambush." {n}He coughs.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix looks at Achilleas intently.{/n} "A shrewd and well-considered suggestion. I can see that you have taken the time to learn as much about this station as you could. Good work."
  - After: {n}Heinrix studies him.{/n} "Shrewd. Good work."
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas coughs.{/n} "Far from it, Master van Calox. Alas, my options were rather limited: we never properly scouted this place." {n}He lowers his head, too ashamed to bring himself to look Heinrix in the eye.{/n}
  - After: {n}Achilleas coughs.{/n} "Hardly. We never scouted it." {n}Ashamed.{/n}
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas sweeps into a bow.{/n} "I'm sorry to have made you needlessly worry about me. Discerning the traitor's plans and preparing a place to capture him... cost me a great deal."
  - After: {n}He bows.{/n} "Sorry to worry you. Trapping the traitor cost me dearly."
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: "Regrettably, my agents did not have time to draw up a map of the main compartment. The cogitator must be somewhere nearby, perhaps in one of the adjacent chambers."
  - After: "No map. Try nearby chambers."
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: "We have two enforcer squads and your personal retinue. We should look for well concealed or safely protected places that could fit enough of our people. The station may offer other opportunities that might help us capture the enemy."
  - After: "Two enforcer squads plus your retinue. Find hidden spots."
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: {n}Achilleas smiles enigmatically and shrugs.{/n} "Rogue Traders have their secrets to success. The Inquisition has its own."
  - After: {n}He shrugs.{/n} "The Inquisition has secrets."
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: "I will remain by the entrance and stand guard in case Kunrad and the xenos arrive earlier than anticipated. Once you have completed the inspection, please make sure to depressurise the other compartments, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. And may the God-Emperor help you!" {n}He coughs.{/n}
  - After: "I'll guard the entrance. Depressurise the other compartments, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Coughs.{/n}
- **Achilleas Scalander**
  - Before: "Whatever course of action you choose, we should depressurise all compartments except for the main one. That way the conspirators will have no choice but to try and restore the station's systems using the main cogitator. And that is where we will engage them."
  - After: "Depressurise all but the main compartment. They'll need the main cogitator—we strike there."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Am I the only one who thinks there's something off about this place? It's too... easy. Everything's coming together too nicely. When have we ever been so lucky, shereen?"
  - After: "Too easy. When are we ever this lucky, shereen?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Heydari, what exactly is it you are doubting — the credibility of the subjects of the Golden Throne or the Lord Captain's decisions? Take some time to carefully consider your answer."
  - After: "Heydari, do you doubt the Lord Captain? Think carefully."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia draws her pale brows together as if agonising over something.{/n} "Your colours are so mottled, tattered, and feverish, Master Scalander... I have not noticed such turmoil in your soul before."
  - After: {n}Cassia frowns.{/n} "Your colours are tattered, Master Scalander. Such turmoil is new."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira sniffs and brushes her fingers against your sleeve.{/n} "My voices are harping on about treachery — about what Voigtvir did, obviously... This is a chance to pin down the Master of Whispers, isn't it? Oh, I'd wait here months for that!"
  - After: {n}Idira touches your sleeve.{/n} "My voices cry treachery. Pin the Master of Whispers? I'd wait months!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/RogueTraderKidnappingAhilleas/MarazhaiTrapped/MarazhaiTrapped_dialogue

  - Before: "Achilleas! You vile traitor!"
  - After: "Achilleas! Traitor!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will see you both dead!"
  - After: "I'll kill you both!"

  - After: "Forgive me, Master van Calox..." {n}Trembling.{/n}

An uncanny quality for your kind." {n}He is speaking to Achilleas, who is lying nearby, his pale face contorted in terror and pain, and his eyes wide open and tearful.{/n} "I may find other uses for you in the future."

  - After: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I..." {n}He grimaces.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/RogueTraderKidnappingYrliet/OfficerInTerror/OfficerInTerror_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What are you so afraid of?"
  - After: "What scares you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Easy, Yrliet. We are about to find out."
  - After: "Easy, Yrliet. We'll find out."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Strike him] "Answer when asked, you worm!"
  - After: [Strike him] "Answer, worm!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How do you know that I am a Rogue Trader?"
  - After: "How do you know I'm a Rogue Trader?"
- **Intimidated Officer**
  - Before: {n}The lanky, haggard-looking officer with sunken cheeks stares at you in fright. His body is shivering as if from a feverish chill and his eyes are darting back and forth anxiously.{/n} "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} Rogue T-Trader, what b-brings you to our humble ship?"
  - After: {n}A haggard officer shivers.{/n} "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} Rogue T-Trader, why come here?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira lets out a piercing shriek.{/n} "There's no path, Red! There's only marsh, marsh, and underneath it... rings! Black dragon rings, they have already encircled and broken you, they're encircling u—"
  - After: {n}Idira shrieks.{/n} "No path, Red! Black dragon rings, encircling u—"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira flinches as if from a blow. She turns her head, and with unblinking eyes stares at Yrliet.{/n} "Red, where are you going? Where are you going? There is no path, you only think there is, you only think..."
  - After: {n}Idira stares at Yrliet.{/n} "Red, where are you going? There's no path..."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Stop shivering like a leaf in the wind, mon-keigh. Answer me: have you seen others like me in this system? If you have, tell me where, when, and under what circumstances your paths crossed and diverged afterward."
  - After: "Stop shivering, mon-keigh. Seen others like me? Where, when?"
- **Intimidated Officer**
  - Before: {n}The officer's eyes widen at the sight of Yrliet. His face grows even paler than before and his lips move in a wordless prayer, unable to utter a word in response.{/n}
  - After: {n}Seeing Yrliet, he prays wordlessly.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "A whirlwind of orange and blue torments their souls. Can you not feel its gusts in the air all around us? Its hues are... terrifying indeed."
  - After: "Orange and blue torment their souls. Terrifying."
- **Intimidated Officer**
  - Before: {n}The officer glances at Yrliet in fear. He forces out the word:{/n} "Pain."
  - After: {n}He eyes Yrliet.{/n} "Pain."
- **Intimidated Officer**
  - Before: "P-please, don't! We saw it, yes, we saw it all!"
  - After: "P-please! We saw it all!"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Please hurry, elantach—" {n}Yrliet breaks off.{/n}
  - After: "Please hurry, elantach—" {n}She stops.{/n}
- **Intimidated Officer**
  - Before: {n}The officer swallows, gives you a strange look, and then closes his eyes.{/n} "Emperor forgive me..."
  - After: {n}He shuts his eyes.{/n} "Emperor forgive me..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "What did you just say? 'Rogue Trader'? How would a mere officer know who's standing in front of him?" {n}Jae's face changes and she immediately grips the handle of her weapon.{/n}
  - After: "How would he know?" {n}Jae grips her weapon.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix sets his hand on his weapon and nods at the trembling officer.{/n} "I have seen people like this before. Afraid of their own shadow. More than that — I have turned my 'underlings' into this. He has been tortured."
  - After: {n}Heinrix grips his weapon.{/n} "I know this look. He's been tortured."

## World/Dialogs/Ch3/RogueTraderKidnappingYrliet/YrlietMarazhaiTrapped/YrlietMarazhaiTrapped_dialogue

  - Before: {n}Your consciousness emerges from an ocean of darkness and nightmares, as if someone's powerful hand reached into its depths and brought you into the light. In the dark room, long and angular shadows move around and exchange remarks. One of the shadows approaches you, ripping apart the veil of pain and revealing features that look familiar to you.{/n}

  - After: "Your craftworld friend? You'll meet her soon—the one who brought you to me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}For a brief moment, the mask of self-confidence on Marazhai's face slips. The twitch of his eyebrows and his altered expression almost betray his... doubt? The xenos, however, quickly turns away with an affected sigh.{/n} "Enough talk."

  - Before: {n}The slender fingers in the Kabalite's glove clutch at your face, the claws leaving deep scratches on your cheeks and forehead. The edge of a razor-sharp blade presses at your throat. Marazhai furiously hisses something incomprehensible... But then he releases his grip, suppressing his desire to kill you on the spot with an enormous effort of willpower.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai claws your face, blade at your throat, hissing—then forces himself to let go.{/n}

I spared no effort to set up this performance: the witnesses, the spies, the agents... and a small bargain to guarantee the result."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Only the truth, mon-keigh. So very simple, is it not? A little honesty before the powers that be. I have the tools to extract the most coveted mysteries from the deepest recesses of your mind, but I am not interested in your personal secrets. I only want that which will protect my Kabal."
  - After: "Only the truth, mon-keigh. Not your secrets—only what protects my Kabal."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do not know, Rogue Trader. Perhaps they are exuding suffering in one of the choirs of pain and torment. Perhaps they are rotting in one of the vats on the tiers below. I care little for their fate."
  - After: "Who knows? Pain choirs, or rotting in vats below. I don't care."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue and gently caresses the object in his hands with the claws of his glove, making it emit a little squeal.{/n} "It looks like you have acquired a taste for pain, mon-keigh. Have it your way, then: resist the inevitable and know a new facet of suffering."
  - After: {n}He strokes the squealing object.{/n} "A taste for pain? Then resist, and learn new suffering."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai is silent for a few moments, playing with the mysterious object in his hand.{/n} "You, mon-keigh, hate creatures alien to your kind — and this hatred is fuelled by primal fear and awareness of your insignificance. To us, you are cattle that exist to be butchered and to entertain us. Sometimes we use you in our little games, but to involve you filthy brutes in the politics of Commorragh... let alone in feuds between the Kabals... there are few worse ways to bring dishonour to oneself and one's Kabal."
  - After: {n}He toys with the object.{/n} "To us you are cattle. Involving you in Commorragh's Kabal feuds is the deepest dishonour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "From the first day I saw you, I knew you were being controlled by another hand, far too experienced and flexible to belong to another mon-keigh. You stayed ahead of me and Tazarra, anticipated our moves, fought back with surprising skill... and I can guess — no, I know exactly — how you were able to know so much. Only one creature was sufficiently aware of our tactics and raid plans. You will help me expose her — and restore the Reaving Tempest to its former favour."
  - After: "Someone guided you, outpacing me and Tazarra. Only one knew our raid plans. Help me expose her and restore the Reaving Tempest's favour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It looks like you are starting to respond to the training, Rogue Trader... Who knows, I might keep you after everything is over. The new Archon's court will be in need of illustrious entertainment."
  - After: "Learning, Rogue Trader? Perhaps I'll keep you to amuse the new Archon's court."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai laughs caustically.{/n} "You are trying to hold your own even in the face of overwhelming force... How touching! But enough talk."
  - After: {n}He laughs.{/n} "Defiant to the last. Touching! Enough talk."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari gestures to one of the shadows near you and your head is forced backward. Marazhai brings the hand holding the strange object closer: you manage to make out translucent, glossy skin, bluish, pulsating organs beneath, and a little head with serrated jaws, before the Drukhari pushes the larva into your face.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your head is forced back. Marazhai pushes a pulsating, serrated-jawed larva into your face.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Something about the tone of your voice makes Marazhai freeze — and then come closer and lean almost into your face. His black eyes greedily devour your slightest movement and his voice drops to a mocking whisper:{/n} "Very well... I am listening, mon-keigh."
  - After: {n}Marazhai freezes, leans close, eyes greedy.{/n} "Very well... I am listening, mon-keigh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai mockingly cocks his head.{/n} "No, mon-keigh. You have nothing that I could not extract from you myself... using my favourite tools."
  - After: {n}He cocks his head.{/n} "No. My tools will extract anything you have."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Lightning reflexes fail to save the stunned Kabalite: you smash your forehead into the pale face in front of you, the crunch of broken cartilage drowned out by the frenzied hissing of the Drukhari. Unbearable pain washes over you but, even in its crimson haze, you can still make out Marazhai's twisted face and the patch of blood spreading beneath his nose.{/n}
  - After: {n}You headbutt him. Cartilage crunches; blood spreads beneath Marazhai's nose.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai's pale lips stretch into a smile.{/n} "I would love to see you do that... But no, mon-keigh. I will be denied such entertainment."
  - After: {n}He smiles.{/n} "I'd love to see that. But no."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are awake, mon-keigh." {n}Marazhai's voice is sickeningly sweet. He is looking at you with idle interest, rolling a soft and milky-coloured object from one hand to the other.{/n} "Our toxin masters spared no efforts to drag you out of the induced dream. I must commend the nightmare weavers. The emanations of fear you exuded in your delirium are worthy of the highest praise. However, it is time to finish what you were brought here for. It is time to work for the good of the Kabal, Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Awake, mon-keigh." {n}Marazhai rolls a milky object in his hands.{/n} "Your nightmares were exquisite. Now work for the Kabal, Rogue Trader."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Darkness clouds your vision but the sensation of an alien presence does not relent. Something both primitive and stupid in its stubborn effort is rummaging through your mind, churning through thoughts and changing them. You gather whatever remains of your willpower and desperately hold on to the part of your consciousness that has not yet caved to the invading power. A prick of surprise, a burst of disappointment... The spell takes hold of your weakened self, but part of it still belongs to you and is ready to fight back. A stray light dawns at the edge of your perception...{/n}
  - After: {n}Something primitive churns through your mind. You cling to what's still yours, ready to fight. A light dawns...{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Darkness clouds your eyes, but the sensation of an alien presence does not relent. This is not a conscious mind but something primitive yet unbelievably strong in its unknowable pursuit. It is crawling around in your thoughts, scratching them with its sides, and changing their shape. Perhaps all this is just a bad dream... A quirk of the intellect exhausted by endless troubles... A calumny of a mind too weak for the burden it was made to carry. A stray light dawns at the edge of your perception...{/n}
  - After: {n}Something primitive and strong reshapes your thoughts. Maybe just a bad dream... A light dawns...{/n}

  - Before: "The court has been presented with enough evidence, and I hope no one is harbouring any doubts as to the guilt of the von Valancius dynasty. But let us allow the Rogue Trader to say {mf|his|her} final word. We are all curious to know what you have gleaned from this enquiry."

  - Before: {n}After the spell is lifted, staggering pain pierces your body. Darkness clouds your vision and nausea creeps up your throat, but the wounds you managed to forget soon remind you that you are still alive.{/n}

  - Before: {n}The words almost fly from your lips when a sharp pain seizes your head in a vice-like grip. Blood and nausea roil inside your throat, and the world starts swaying before your eyes. - **Archon Nazrakhei**
  - Before: {n}You have heard many gruesome tales about the atrocities of the Drukhari, but the cruellest and vilest always involved Asdrubael Vect, the Archon of the Kabal of the Black Heart, the supreme overlord of Commorragh, and the most dangerous of all his dark kind.{/n}

Before you stands a Harlequin, another representative of the multifaceted Aeldari race. The xenos catches your eye and nods. For a moment, the play of shadows on the mask appears to twist its expression into a mischievous grin.{/n}

The xenos catches your eye and nods. For a moment, the play of shadows on the mask appears to twist its expression into a mischievous grin.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman lets out a bloodthirsty chuckle.{/n} "Yes, it was... I was hoping to blow up your ship's reactor and just send bits of you flying into the void, but I'm going to enjoy this even more if I do it all myself."
  - After: {n}She chuckles.{/n} "I meant to blow your reactor. This is better."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Wrong. I have reliable information that He is in fact with us."
  - After: "Wrong. He's with us."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Ah! Fearless, mighty, with a heart as cold as stone! A worthy opponent, a far cry from wretched xenos and stinking heretics! It will be glorious to slay you!" {n}Ulfar greets Calcazar's assassin with the softest smile you have ever seen on his face.{/n}
  - After: "Fearless, cold-hearted! Glorious to slay!" {n}Ulfar smiles at the assassin.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Stand aside, redbeard, while I cut off the Rogue Trader's head. Wouldn't want to kill my first Emperor's Angel in a hurry." {n}The woman reciprocates with an equally friendly gaze and you see confusion on the faces of those around you.{/n}
  - After: "Wait, redbeard. Rogue Trader first, then my first Emperor's Angel." {n}She smiles back.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The woman's lips curve into a bloodthirsty grin.{/n} "I find cocky opponents so amusing — they're always shocked to discover they're mortal!"
  - After: {n}She grins.{/n} "Cocky ones always learn they're mortal!"

- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "I shall strive to find important lessons in them, so that I may become better and thus redeem his legacy in the Emperor's eyes." {n}Evayne bows his head in sadness.{/n} "Speaking of legacy, this used to belong to Calligos. It was made for war, but I have no desire to wield it or anything like it. Perhaps it will be of use to you in your campaign."
  - After: "I'll redeem his legacy." {n}Evayne bows.{/n} "This was Calligos's. I won't wield it. You might."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "What could be better and more dangerous than spilling the blood of that haughty degenerate Calcazar's minions? Punishing him for his insolence was long overdue. If you ever face him in battle, end the miserable bastard with this. And give him Calligos Winterscale's regards."
  - After: "Bleeding Calcazar's minions was overdue. End him with this. Give him Calligos Winterscale's regards."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Calligos strokes the weapon, looking pleased.{/n} "What I was born to do. Make war and sweep away any who stand in my path. I have a healthy list of those whose heads will make great decorations for my ship's bridge."
  - After: {n}Calligos strokes the weapon.{/n} "War. Many heads to collect."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I accept this duty with humility. The seeds of the Final Dawn's corruption will be destroyed, and the xenos banished from our systems. House Chorda will protect the Koronus Expanse, undeterred by the boundaries of other domains or the powers that be."
  - After: "Humbly accepted. House Chorda will purge the Final Dawn and xenos and guard the Koronus Expanse."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "Sharp-tongued as ever, eh?" {n}Winterscale nods his approval but remains serious.{/n} "There is no need. When the Tech-Priests patched up my body with their steel, I ordered them not to be overzealous. I want my every step and my every movement to bring pain. I want it to be an eternal reminder of what I have done."
  - After: "Sharp-tongued." {n}He nods.{/n} "No need. I kept the pain. Every step reminds me what I did."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "Now that a single step brings excruciating pain, I am being very cautious about the paths I choose." {n}Brazenness still colours the contours of Winterscale's smile, but the spite has vanished.{/n}
  - After: "Each step hurts, so I choose paths carefully." {n}The spite is gone.{/n}
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}The Factotum coughs.{/n} "Minor damage to the outer plating in the midship hull and negligible personnel losses as a result of offensive action by enemy boarding parties. The key systems are in order. The enginarium reports impeccable compliance on the part of the machine spirits. In other words, we are fully combat-ready, Lord Captain."
  - After: {n}The Factotum coughs.{/n} "Minor hull damage, few losses. Fully combat-ready, Lord Captain."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "May the path of those who enact His will be as a radiant ray, an all-consuming inferno of light. May that ray pierce whatever darkness hinders their progress."
  - After: "May His servants' path be a ray piercing darkness."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia Chorda calls for attention with an imperious gesture.{/n} "{name} von Valancius. When the hour is dark, only a coward and a heretic will not dare to look death in the face. I would like to join your crusade beyond the boundaries of the known universe. Will you allow me to do battle under your banner?"
  - After: {n}Incendia Chorda gestures.{/n} "{name} von Valancius, may I join your crusade?"
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "Hold on." {n}Calligos's voice thrums like the growl of a hungry beast.{/n} "You mean to say you're off to snap Calcazar's neck while I'm stuck here? Forget it. I'm coming with you to gut that bastard myself!"
  - After: "Hold on." {n}Calligos growls.{/n} "You'll kill Calcazar without me? I'm coming!"
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "May a river of blood flood forth toward the Master's throne! May a pyramid rise from the skulls of His enemies!"
  - After: "Blood and skulls for the Master's throne!"
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "So be it. I lend you my blade and my pistol as loyal companions on this quest."
  - After: "So be it. My blade is yours."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia breathes a faltering sigh of disappointment.{/n} "There is truth in your words, von Valancius. Well, then I shall continue to stand watch over the Expanse until your victorious return — or that of your funeral ashes."
  - After: {n}Incendia sighs.{/n} "True. I'll guard the Expanse until you return, alive or as ashes."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}With an animalistic howl, Calligos raises his weapon over his head.{/n} "Whoever stands in our way, they shall bleed!"
  - After: {n}Calligos howls.{/n} "Our foes shall bleed!"
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Winterscale growls furiously, glaring at you, but soon lets up and spits out resentfully,{/n} "Fine, {name}. You have the greater claim to that trophy. Good hunting."
  - After: {n}Winterscale glares, then relents.{/n} "Fine, {name}. Good hunting."
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "To give you a trophy that may serve you well in the battles to come. This used to belong to Calligos. It was made for war but I have no desire to wield it or anything like it, for that matter. Perhaps it will be of use to you in your campaign."
  - After: "To give you Calligos's weapon. I won't wield it. You might."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "To give you something. I used it to enact the Emperor's justice, but I proved to be a poor instrument of His will. Therefore I am handing this weapon of His wrath to you. May it protect you from evil in the darkness into which you are heading."
  - After: "To give you this. I failed as His instrument. May it guard you."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "And since I shall never see combat again... take this. You could use a sturdy weapon, and this one deserves better than gathering dust in my trophy room."
  - After: "I'll never fight again. Take this."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Winterscale grins bitterly.{/n} "It takes more than a broken back to fix my bad temper."
  - After: {n}He grins bitterly.{/n} "A broken back won't fix my temper."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Much has changed since my time ruling over Footfall."
  - After: "Much has changed since I ruled Footfall."
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Evayne smiles.{/n} "That is merely because the ceremony has yet to be held. You had done quite a bit as well before you officially announced yourself as heir. I have taken the dynastic reins of power — though, unfortunately, my ascent was not a bloodless one. But now is no time to celebrate. My protectorate stands to perish. I will invite you to my ceremony once you have returned, and my people are no longer suffering terrifying deaths."
  - After: {n}Evayne smiles.{/n} "No ceremony yet; I took the reins, not bloodlessly. My protectorate is dying. Come back for it."
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "My dynasty needs healing. It falls to me to discover new paths to the colonies isolated by the warp storm. To weed out the villainy that has infected Calligos's court. To help the worlds he has bled dry. To stand up to the xenos who terrorise the protectorate. To wipe out the Final Dawn infiltrators. To make peace with House Chorda and reclaim the planets taken from us... I don't know if I have the strength to do all of that. But I will not back down."
  - After: "My dynasty needs healing: lost colonies, Calligos's court, xenos, the Final Dawn, peace with House Chorda. I won't back down."
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "My dynasty is indebted to you. And Winterscales do not abandon their allies when in need. I may be inexperienced, but naive I am not. I can see that something is happening — something of great and alarming significance for the entire Expanse. If your aim is to unravel this matter and forestall further cataclysms, I will provide whatever assistance you require."
  - After: "Winterscales stand by allies. Something threatens the whole Expanse. I'll help you stop it."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "Quit playing coy, {name}. You know very well why. I am here because I owe you. Alas, Winterscales never find themselves in debt for long. Besides, I have never liked Calcazar. Your acknowledgement of me as a threat speaks to the trustworthiness of your intuition. And now that you have decided to take on the Lord Inquisitor, I would much rather align myself with a tried-and-true ally than someone of dubious repute."
  - After: "Don't play coy, {name}. I owe you, and hate Calcazar. I'll back a proven ally."
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "I will join you, {name}. My blood divination did not reveal to me all that lies ahead, but it did show that it is far more momentous and dangerous than a stray band of heathens. My brothers can complete their mission without me, but you may require the aid of the True Word."
  - After: "I'll join you, {name}. My blood divination shows great danger ahead. You may need the True Word."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "Correct my mistakes. Save what is left of my protectorate: find the worlds lost to the warp storm; drive the xenos out; weed out the Final Dawn infiltrators. And... negotiate peace with House Chorda." {n}The spite with which Calligos spits out the word "peace" makes him look like his old self for just a brief moment.{/n}
  - After: "Fix my mistakes: find lost worlds, drive out xenos, root out the Final Dawn. And make peace with House Chorda." {n}He spits "peace".{/n}
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "I wanted to make sure Calcazar's thugs, the ones guarding the gate, don't... give you any trouble. All sorts of things happen in the Expanse these days. I won't be boarding any ships myself anymore, of course, but I have enough soldiers to convince them that harassing Rogue Trader von Valancius is a bad idea."
  - After: "To keep Calcazar's gate guards off you. My soldiers will persuade them."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I may not see as clearly now as I once did... but the visions have not altogether forsaken my mind. And I sense some vile enterprise being plotted where you are going. You are able to stop it, which means your path must be clear."
  - After: "My visions remain. Something vile awaits where you go. You can stop it."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Never. My heart is forever with the Emperor, but I am a poor instrument of His will. I will serve the cause of justice, but I have no right to enact it. And so, I entrust this tool of judgement to you."
  - After: "Never. But I'm a poor instrument. I'll serve justice, not enact it. Take this."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Yes. Being here awakens... such terrible desires within my heart. To be the bringer of justice. The passer of verdicts! I must keep the Expanse safe from myself. I must return to my solitude."
  - After: "Yes. Here I crave to judge again. I must protect the Expanse from myself."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "May it be my destined lot to attain comprehension of His ways, His wishes, and His will."
  - After: "May I come to understand His will."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}There is nothing in Incendia's clear eyes but a righteous conviction that almost seems inhuman.{/n} "That was the path revealed to me. You are going to a place where evil is being wrought against the Emperor. If you step into this darkness, you can pluck the poisoned root from which the vile deed stems. As such, your path must be charted and cleared by those pure of faith. Therefore, accept this gift of righteous annihilation so that, come the hour of judgement, it helps direct you to the right course of action."
  - After: {n}Incendia's eyes burn.{/n} "Evil against the Emperor awaits; you can uproot it. Take this gift of righteous annihilation."
- **Nocturne of Oblivion**
  - Before: {n}The Harlequin begins taking off his mask, as if he is about to reveal what is beneath it, but before you can make out his features, he laughs and vanishes in a blue haze. Where the mysterious xenos just stood, his parting gift remains.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Harlequin laughs and vanishes in blue haze, leaving a gift.{/n}
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "May the faith in the hearts of the devout never waver."
  - After: "May the devout never waver."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Wasting no time on meaningless good luck wishes, your distinguished guests leave the bridge in solemn and respectful silence.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your guests leave silently.{/n}
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "As you wish, {name}. You chose this path yourself."
  - After: "As you wish, {name}. Your choice."
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "I thank you for the honour of being part of it. My brothers and I were impressed by the determination with which you descended upon the corpse emperor's lackeys. Brother Skarikitus, who fell in that battle, wished that his flesh be used to create this gift to you, for such vehemence must always be rewarded." {n}Uralon regally presents you with a bleeding package. Brother Skarikitus's remains are wrapped in a torn and stained banner of the Inquisition.{/n}
  - After: "An honour. Fallen Brother Skarikitus's flesh is your reward." {n}Uralon offers a bleeding bundle in an Inquisition banner.{/n}
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "I was granted a vision, and we could not let this chance to deliver a crushing blow to the misbelievers pass us by. Euphonious are the vox-frequencies that carry the dying screams of the godless."
  - After: "A vision showed us a chance to crush the misbelievers. Sweet screams."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: "Ha! We shall see, {name}, we shall see. When my blood's up, boundaries cease to matter."
  - After: "Ha! We'll see, {name}. Borders don't stop me."
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "A different path is ordained for them. Calcazar, the watchdog of the Expanse, ran, thereby condemning the worlds he was tasked to protect. The Word Bearers will see to it that the entire sector hears these tidings of despair, for it is in terror and woe that the soul opens to the will of the True Gods."
  - After: "Another path. Calcazar fled, dooming his worlds. The Word Bearers will spread despair; terror opens souls to the True Gods."
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "A becoming. The prophecy led me to the Expanse, for I saw the blaze of the Final Dawn usher in a new and true fate for this dark sector. The rays of the Final Dawn wreathed you and guided you to ascension. Now it is time for you to become the new fate of the Koronus Expanse."
  - After: "A becoming. The Final Dawn raised you. Now you become the Koronus Expanse's new fate."
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: "May our lips perpetuate the Truth, now and for all time."
  - After: "May we speak the Truth forever."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Tell me..." {n}Chorda looks up at you with obvious effort.{/n} "Is there any leniency in your soul for one who has strayed? Your crusade is a worthy endeavour, and I long to be a part of it. Let you stand in judgement over others — I shall be but your instrument."
  - After: "Tell me..." {n}Chorda looks up.{/n} "Can you forgive one who strayed? You judge; I'll be your instrument."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "So be it! From now on, I am your follower and your smiting hand!"
  - After: "So be it! I am your smiting hand!"
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Chorda's gaze fades, and she averts her eyes.{/n} "Very well. Then may the God-Emperor favour you on your path, and me on mine."
  - After: {n}Chorda looks away.{/n} "Then may the God-Emperor favour us both."
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: "I would have liked to follow you into the fire, but I am afraid I have much in the way of business keeping me here. The Emperor protects, {name}."
  - After: "Duty keeps me here. The Emperor protects, {name}."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}The Rogue Trader bares his teeth in a cruel smile. For just a moment, it seems that instead of teeth, you glimpse the sharp fangs of some beast.{/n} "I had long been waiting for an opportunity to get into the fray with those mongrels."
  - After: {n}Calligos bares beastlike fangs.{/n} "Finally, those mongrels."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Verily, the righteous shall inherit His realm." {n}The Rogue Trader readily finishes the line from the litany, as though waiting for it.{/n}
  - After: "The righteous shall inherit His realm." {n}She finishes the litany.{/n}
- **Nocturne of Oblivion**
  - Before: "The briefest moment I will here abide,
The lull between two heartbeats, nothing more.
Your deeds have left their mark in memory's halls,
Where few among your kin have earned a place.
The Merchant Vagabond's grand tales I'll keep,
And be the steadfast guard of every page.
Oblivion's Nocturne will be heard no more,
For with these words I play my final chord:
Farewell is not an ending but a thread
That leads you into a new drama's web."
  - After: "A heartbeat's stay.
Your deeds now dwell in memory's halls.
Oblivion's Nocturne plays its final chord:
Farewell's a thread to a new play."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Bridge_ChapterFinale/BridgeBeforeWarpGate/BridgeBeforeWarpGate_dialogue

- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Friends and allies of your dynasty have arrived from ships currently in this system. They would like to pay their respects to the Rogue Trader in person."
  - After: "Your dynasty's allies wish to pay respects in person."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia Chorda folds her arms on her chest, making the sign of the Aquila. Her eyes are aflame with {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaExileNot}fanatical conviction{/d}.{/n} "{name} von Valancius, I bear good tidings. The Emperor looks favourably on your campaign. Head into the darkness and be undaunted."
  - After: {n}Incendia Chorda, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaExileNot}fanatical conviction{/d} in her eyes.{/n} "{name}, the Emperor favours you. Go undaunted."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Something has changed about Calligos Winterscale in a way that is hard to pin down. A new harshness about his features gives him a predatory quality. His yellowed eyes are filled with rage.{/n} "What a slow talker that servant of yours is. Ha, I bet cutting off his legs would make his muttering a lot livelier!"
  - After: {n}Calligos Winterscale looks predatory, enraged.{/n} "Your servant drones. Legless, he'd talk faster!"
- **Evayne Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Young Evayne Winterscale looks at you with a solemn expression.{/n} "My friend, you have been by my side whenever I... no, whenever my dynasty has needed support from a wise ally. Please know {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_EvayneIsAlly}this will never be forgotten{/d}."
  - After: {n}Evayne Winterscale, solemn.{/n} "You stood by my dynasty. {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_EvayneIsAlly}This will never be forgotten{/d}."
- **Nocturne of Oblivion**
  - Before: {n}The Harlequin, paying no attention to the anxious glances of the crew, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_AeldariAlly}takes a bow{/d}.{/n}
"Behold in silence, Merchant Vagabond,
The crossroads laid before you at this time.
The laugh of jest unending has declared
Your dance adroit and worthy of applause.
And I, his words' mute echo, now arise
To send you on your merry way at last."
  - After: {n}The Harlequin {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_AeldariAlly}takes a bow{/d}.{/n}
"Merchant Vagabond, the endless laugh
Applauds your dance. Go your way."
- **Calligos Winterscale**
  - Before: {n}Calligos Winterscale has grown hollow-cheeked and pale. Instead of the graceful movements of a fierce predator, he now {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_WinterscaleRedeemed}lurches like a lame bird{/d}. The augmetics in his broken back are unable to make him as light-footed as he once was. He lets out a tired sigh and says joylessly,{/n} "We meet again, {name}."
  - After: {n}Gaunt Calligos Winterscale {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_WinterscaleRedeemed}lurches like a lame bird{/d}.{/n} "We meet again, {name}."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia avoids locking eyes with you. Her cheek twitches nervously as she says,{/n} "I have briefly suspended my {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaExile}exile{/d} in order to wish you luck on your travels."
  - After: {n}Incendia avoids your eyes.{/n} "I paused my {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_ChordaExile}exile{/d} to wish you luck."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}Janris sighs.{/n} "The xenos simply materialised on the bridge. Whereupon the enforcers simply refused to approach it. After all, the enemy of Humanity has not acted aggressively in any way. As of yet."
  - After: {n}Janris sighs.{/n} "The xenos just appeared. Enforcers won't approach. No aggression. Yet."
- **Uralon the Cruel**
  - Before: {n}The armour of Uralon the Cruel is adorned with fresh blood — likely that of the prisoners captured in the last battle.{/n} "I hope that you relished every moment of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Eufrates_ChampionOfChaos}eradicating the godless worms{/d}, {name}."
  - After: {n}Uralon the Cruel, blood-spattered.{/n} "Enjoyed {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Eufrates_ChampionOfChaos}eradicating the godless worms{/d}, {name}?"

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Bridge_ChapterFinale/GatesVisitors/GatesVisitors_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Isn't anyone going to try and talk me out of this venture?"
  - After: "No one will stop me?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The enemy has been routed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We are receiving a vox-signal requesting that we admit a convoy of shuttles on board for an audience. The augurs have confirmed that the shuttles are unarmed and belong to the forces that aided us in battle. Do you wish us to welcome these visitors?"
  - After: "Enemy routed, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Unarmed allied shuttles request an audience. Admit them?"
- **Master Helmsman Ravor**
  - Before: {n}Ravor merely smiles darkly in response.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ravor smiles darkly.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Bridge_ChapterStart

- **Player**
  - Before: "I would prefer to get the details of the situation first."
  - After: "Details first."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Aeldari troubles are no longer my concern."
  - After: "Aeldari troubles aren't my concern."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I might as well pay old Winterscale a visit."
  - After: "I'll visit old Winterscale."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Endanger my standing with Calligos? For the sake of some xenos?"
  - After: "Risk my standing with Calligos for xenos?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Dare I hope that you will lend me a shoulder to lean on again, elantach? Will you come with me to the distant stars of Quetza... Temer?" {n}In her agitation, the Aeldari is struggling with human language.{/n} "To save my kin from the wrath of your mighty rival?"
  - After: "Help me, elantach? Come to Quetza... Temer?" {n}She stumbles.{/n} "Save my kin from your rival?"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Hmm... My kin are not so blindly suicidal. Desperation is the more likely cause. In the wake of our most intriguing adventure in the Spire of the Reaving Tempest, many Kabal members must have lost everything and fled Commorragh before their old enemies caught up with them. How very... interesting and promising."
  - After: "Desperate. After the Spire, many Kabalites fled Commorragh. Promising."
- **Master Helmsman Ravor**
  - Before: "We pursued it, but the accursed xenos were too fast. They took cover in an asteroid belt and activated a cloaking field. We swept the asteroids, of course, but those vile creatures doubtlessly used our short delay to laugh at us and then slip even farther away. Such was our inglorious defeat, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "The xenos escaped under a cloaking field, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "The officers' council humbly requests that you accept a full report of the events that took place in your absence."
  - After: "The officers' council requests you hear their report."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet is about to object but reconsiders at the last moment, making do with only a loud sigh and a nod.{/n} "A right I would not dare take away from you, elantach. I only ask that you... make your decision soon. As much as I would like to lift that burden from your shoulders, the lives of my kin depend on you again."
  - After: {n}Yrliet nods.{/n} "Your right, elantach. Decide soon; my kin depend on you."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Then I will not presume to distract you any longer. The distant stars of Quet... za... Temer... await us." {n}In her agitation, the Aeldari is struggling with human language. She falls silent, absorbed in her thoughts.{/n}
  - After: "Then Quet... za... Temer awaits." {n}She falls silent.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Not for the sake of my kin, elantach. I... am asking you to do this for me. Perhaps you... perhaps we might convince your star rival to stop the meaningless bloodshed."
  - After: "Not for my kin, elantach. For me. Perhaps we can stop your rival's bloodshed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I see." {n}Yrliet's words are scalding cold.{/n} "Let me know if you change your mind... mon-keigh."
  - After: "I see." {n}Icy.{/n} "Tell me if you change your mind... mon-keigh."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "An Aeldari fleet? Elantach, I no longer believe in coincidences. Your pale-faced servant speaks of the same world that appeared to Muaran in his visions. The world where my kin fell into peril. Help me reach them!"
  - After: "An Aeldari fleet? Muaran's vision world, where my kin are in peril. Help me reach them!"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix gestures to you.{/n} "While the officers were preparing this briefing, I had some time to find out what had happened in our absence. I discovered that the Astropathic Choir received a message addressed to me... which I'd like to discuss at the earliest opportunity. Let me know when you have time to do that."
  - After: {n}Heinrix gestures.{/n} "The Choir has a message for me. Let's discuss it."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix falls silent, but then cannot help casting another dismayed glance at you.{/n} "Although... it can wait. I... would like to... I'll visit you in person after the briefing. I have... questions."
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks dismayed.{/n} "Later. I'll visit after the briefing. Questions."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The enemies of Humanity are showering us with blows, capitalising on our indecision." {n}Argenta jerks her head up, her eyes aflame.{/n} "I hasten to remind every one of them that their crimes have not escaped the eyes of the righteous — and there will be retribution for each of those crimes!"
  - After: "Our enemies exploit our indecision." {n}Argenta's eyes blaze.{/n} "Each crime will be avenged!"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "If the Expanse is under siege, then I know where to look for my pack: in the thick of battle. When we arrive at Footfall, I want to talk to Calcazar and find out to what battlefront he has sent my brothers."
  - After: "My pack fights somewhere. At Footfall, I'll ask Calcazar where."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I humbly ask that you accept my report on the events that took place in your absence."
  - After: "Please accept my report."

  - Before: "What is the source of the strife between Incendia and Calligos?"

  - Before: "Hmm... Your family have shown their true colours at last."

- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}The high-ranking officers beam with genuine happiness. Danrok steps forward and solemnly says,{/n} "Welcome to the bridge, Lord Captain. Like the rest of the crew, we are overjoyed by your return and thank the Emperor for it."
  - After: {n}The officers beam.{/n} "Welcome back, Lord Captain. The Emperor be thanked."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Exactly. The esteemed Lord Inquisitor Calcazar has declared himself Warden of the Koronus Expanse and issued orders to requisition troops. He has made Footfall his base of operations, as it was the most logistically convenient point. From there, his fleet strikes throughout the Expanse, destroying the forces of the Cult of the Final Dawn and the abominable Drukhari. He may be all that currently stands in the way of the Expanse being reduced to ashes."
  - After: "Yes. Lord Inquisitor Calcazar, self-declared Warden, strikes from Footfall at the Cult of the Final Dawn and the Drukhari."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "When heretics laid siege to Eufrates II, the hallowed forge of the Cognisance Fleet, the Lord Inquisitor sent an enormous force. Now they and the Explorator squadrons recalled from the front lines stand together against the heretics in the battle for the sacred planet."
  - After: "His forces and the Explorators defend Eufrates II, the Cognisance forge."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Dare we enquire what happened to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"
  - After: "What happened to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hostile stares fix on Yrliet, and a spiteful whisper whips through the air:{/n} "Xenos scum!"
  - After: {n}A whisper at Yrliet:{/n} "Xenos scum!"
- **Argenta**

  - After: {n}Argenta's eyes burn.{/n} "Nothing could keep the Emperor's chosen from those who trust {mf|him|her}! Welcome, {mf|him|her}!"
- **Abelard**
