  - After: "Lord Captain!" {n}Abelard is angry.{/n} "Hear me out before you accuse!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I cannot comprehend it." {n}The Seneschal shakes his head helplessly.{/n} "The Werserians have served the Rogue Trader dynasty loyally for generations... This is hard to admit, but the news has come as a crushing blow."
  - After: "Generations of loyal service..." {n}He shakes his head.{/n} "This is a crushing blow."
- **Master Helmsman Ravor**
  - Before: {n}The officers erupt into indignant shouts, promising death to any treacherous xenos that crosses their path. Ravor shakes his head.{/n} "Xenos have no souls and no conscience. They are dishonourable degenerates and traitors by their very nature."
  - After: {n}The officers vow death to xenos.{/n} "Xenos have no souls. Traitors by nature."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Not much, Lord Captain. All contact with your party was lost shortly after the supposed pirates boarded the ship and abducted... your companion's kinspeople. We immediately sent shuttles with boarding parties to your aid, but... we didn't find anyone on the ship save for the crew, all of whom had either been butchered or driven insane."
  - After: "Little. Contact was lost after the 'pirates' boarded. We found only the crew, butchered or mad."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Not much, Lord Captain. In keeping with Master Scalander's plan, after Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's party landed on the station, we went into vox-silence. We waited for quite some time, but the despised heretic Voigtvir's ship never showed. When we took the liberty of sending a messenger to the station with a report, he found only the bodies of unknown officers and other signs of bloodshed."
  - After: "Little. We went vox-silent after Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship landed. Voigtvir never came; we found only bodies."
- **Achilleas the Wrack**
  - Before: {n}The outburst prompts a self-conscious half-shrug from Achilleas, who is huffing noisily behind you. At this moment, he must be glad his disfigured face is hidden behind the black mask.{/n}
  - After: {n}Achilleas half-shrugs, glad of his mask.{/n}
- **Master Helmsman Ravor**
  - Before: "Achilleas Scalander — a traitor? If that damned wretch is still alive, we'll hunt him down no matter what system he's hiding in! I don't know if that corrupt sellout is capable of feeling love for anything or anyone, but if he does, we'll find it and destroy it!"
  - After: "Scalander, a traitor? We'll hunt him down and destroy anything he loves!"
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}The Factotum smacks his lips awkwardly and adds in a quieter voice,{/n} "Lord Captain... The senior officers will report to you shortly. In your absence, we received a number of Astropathic messages and dispatches that demand your attention."
  - After: {n}Danrok, quieter:{/n} "Officers will report soon. Messages await you."
- **Master Helmsman Ravor**
  - Before: "Death to the enemies of House von Valancius! Show us the culprits, and we'll tear the heads off the lot of them then stack them next to your throne, Lord Captain!" {n}The furious officers grab their weapons, as if eager to crush the foes who dared breach the sanctity of your person right here and now.{/n}
  - After: "Show us the culprits and we'll stack their heads by your throne!" {n}The officers grab their weapons.{/n}
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "The officers' council decided to take the ship to Footfall, where one can hear the gossip of the entire Expanse. Our agents tirelessly searched for information about Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Had we heard even a whisper of where you were imprisoned, we would have immediately launched a rescue expedition."
  - After: "At Footfall we sought word of Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship to mount a rescue."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}The Factotum lowers his head in thought.{/n} "There have been other minor developments... If you so wish, I will gladly bring you up to speed on the bridge. I would not want them to take any time away from this occasion."
  - After: {n}Danrok ponders.{/n} "Minor matters. I'll brief you on the bridge later."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}The high-ranking officers beam with genuine happiness. Abelard, who presides over the gathering, looks tired and a little older.{/n} "Lord Captain, the ship's officers gladly welcome you back! The crew offers prayers of thanks to the Emperor for your safe return!"
  - After: {n}The officers beam. Abelard looks tired.{/n} "Welcome back, Lord Captain! The crew thanks the Emperor!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "In your absence, I had to temporarily assume stewardship of your protectorate. I chose Footfall as our base of operations, as gossip from across the Expanse finds its way there. My agents searched for any mention of Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship that could point us to the target of our rescue expedition. I am greatly relieved to relinquish my command and return it to you, Lord Captain."
  - After: "I ran things from Footfall, seeking Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I gladly return command."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "The Expanse is in flames, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Squadrons and smaller groups of despicable Drukhari raid our systems. The Cult of the Final Dawn has emerged in full force, wreaking havoc everywhere. We've heard rumours of the fall of Santiel's Pride, House Chorda's world... An outrageous sacrilege, given how abundant and inexpensive promethium is there!"
  - After: "The Expanse burns, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Drukhari raid, the Cult of the Final Dawn rampages, and Chorda's Santiel's Pride may have fallen."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Strife has broken out between House Winterscale and House Chorda. Chaos reigns everywhere. Only the esteemed Lord Inquisitor is trying to fight it, concentrating all available forces at Footfall to draw them into a fist that will smash the rampaging heretics and xenos vermin."
  - After: "Houses Winterscale and Chorda are at war. Only the Lord Inquisitor resists, massing forces at Footfall."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Drukhari, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Their squadrons, both large and small, are invading the Expanse, unleashing carnage on planets, taking captives by the thousands, and attacking ships. It is as if something has poked their nest, if you will, and now they are lashing out."
  - After: "Drukhari, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. They ravage planets and ships, taking thousands captive."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "When the esteemed Lord Inquisitor called upon the Rogue Traders to join his forces, Her Ladyship Incendia Chorda heeded the summons, while His Lordship Calligos Winterscale... ignored it. Rumour has it that his refusal was... defiant in manner, and served as a pretext for Lady Chorda to declare war on House Winterscale."
  - After: "Incendia Chorda answered the Lord Inquisitor's summons. Calligos Winterscale defiantly refused, giving her a pretext for war."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Lord Captain..." {n}Abelard bows his head.{/n} "Allow me to make a request. A personal one."
  - After: "Lord Captain..." {n}Abelard bows.{/n} "A personal request."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's expression is inscrutable, but her eyes are fixed on you and you alone.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet watches only you.{/n}
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "We fully accept our responsibility, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Our negligence was unforgivable. Allow us to make amends through impeccable service and diligence."
  - After: "We accept the blame, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, and will make amends."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Since Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's body was never recovered, we hoped against hope that you were still alive. Alas, even our most alert augur operators never spotted anything suspicious, and thus our ignominious failure put you in dire peril."
  - After: "We hoped Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship lived, but our augurs saw nothing. We failed you."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Your... devotees continue their work of spreading the word of the Great Beacon. There are more and more people in the von Valancius protectorate who have accepted the new faith as the one true belief. The followers of the old cult are either hunted down or forced into hiding."
  - After: "Your devotees spread the Great Beacon's faith. The old cult is hunted or hiding."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Without a doubt, the return of the guardian of the Koronus Expanse will give new strength and faith to those who have stood under the blows of the enemies of Humanity in your absence! Rumours of the holy relic kept aboard your vessel are spreading to every system of the Expanse, inspiring and emboldening the weak and the forlorn."
  - After: "Your return heartens all! Rumours of your relic inspire the Expanse."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "The heretics' malicious acts make it difficult to maintain Astropathic contact with the colonies. The Cult of the Final Dawn strikes everywhere, and their sleeper agents are active on every planet. On Vheabos VI, a mutiny was crushed after a group of newly arrived prisoners succumbed to blasphemous propaganda. But other worlds stand firm against the onslaught of the enemies of Humanity and do not succumb to their pernicious influence."
  - After: "Heretics disrupt contact. A mutiny on Vheabos VI was crushed. Other worlds hold."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "While you were away, the Choirmaster received an Astropathic message from Dargonus. It concerns... my family. The Werserians have been accused of treason against House von Valancius."
  - After: "Dargonus sent word. My family, the Werserians, are accused of treason against House von Valancius."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "The accusations were levelled by, or on behalf of, the Drivestems. The governing house. Under normal circumstances, the investigation would not have required your involvement, and my entire family would have been... But being of noble stock, the Werserians are entitled under an ancient custom to petition for a Rogue Trader's personal protection once in a generation. Your personal protection, Lord Captain." {n}Abelard raises his gaze to you.{/n} "Do not deny us that honour, I implore you."
  - After: "The Drivestems accuse them. But custom lets nobles petition once a generation for a Rogue Trader's protection. Yours." {n}He looks up.{/n} "Don't deny us."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Then the traitors will accept their due punishment. I have never relied on my position as an immunity guarantee, and I will not even try to sway your decision... as long as it is fair and balanced."
  - After: "Then they'll be punished. I won't sway you, if you're fair."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard breathes a sigh of relief and seems to grow an inch or two taller.{/n} "It will be done, Lord Captain!"
  - After: {n}Abelard stands taller.{/n} "It will be done, Lord Captain!"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}The Seneschal wobbles slightly on unsteady legs, as though he is about to fall. He keeps his balance after all and says with dry lips, barely audibly,{/n} "I serve House von Valancius."
  - After: {n}Abelard nearly falls. A whisper:{/n} "I serve House von Valancius."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "What is more, regrettable events have taken place in your dynasty's capital..." {n}Vigdis hesitates.{/n} "House Werserian has been found guilty of organising revolts and plotting a conspiracy against Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Governor Drivestem has ordered the Werserians to be executed. Order has been fully restored on the planet."
  - After: "And..." {n}Vigdis hesitates.{/n} "House Werserian, guilty of conspiring against Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, was executed by Governor Drivestem."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Lord Captain..." {n}The Seneschal weighs his words carefully.{/n} "I hate to say that while you were away, Dargonus saw a series of revolts among its rabble. Charges of orchestrating those revolts, undermining the capital's economy, and... conspiring against you were brought against my family members."
  - After: "Lord Captain..." {n}Abelard hesitates.{/n} "My family was charged with Dargonus's revolts and conspiring against you."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Governor Drivestem had the perpetrators executed. Every last one of them." {n}Abelard's voice is raspy. He is struggling to speak.{/n} "I assure you those events happened without my knowledge and came as a genuine shock to me. Dargonus has been fully restored to order now, which is all that matters."
  - After: "Governor Drivestem executed them all." {n}Abelard rasps.{/n} "I never knew. Order is restored. That matters."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Once word of your return reaches every von Valancius world... why, the masses will be ecstatic! Never before has the Expanse known a leader as merciful as you! The fanatics of the Creed may whisper about the heresies of the mind burgeoning under your rule, but your benevolence has forever captured the souls of millions of ordinary subjects."
  - After: "Your worlds will rejoice! Fanatics whisper of heresy, but your mercy won millions."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Domin'{name}, the flagship without you was like a body without a heart — its blood froze in its veins. We welcome your return and stand ready to serve."
  - After: "Domin'{name}, without you the ship's blood froze. We stand ready."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "While you were absent, Lord Captain, we made every effort to find you. That resulted in a number of modifications to the ship that have significantly upgraded it. Thanks to a favourable deal secured by the esteemed High Factotum, the ship is now equipped with state-of-the-art augur systems and direction finders from Kiava Gamma."
  - After: "The search upgraded the ship: new Kiava Gamma augurs, via the Factotum's deal."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah devours you with her eyes, anxiety writ large on her usually impenetrable face.{/n} "As your shadow, I must personally make sure you are well, Domin. Wait for me in your quarters."
  - After: {n}Kibellah looks anxious.{/n} "I must check you're well, Domin. Wait in your quarters."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix van Calox approaches you. He is not looking his best. It seems he has not slept in quite a while.{/n} "Lord Captain, allow me to express how glad I am that you have rejoined us, alive and unharmed."
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks sleepless.{/n} "Glad you're back unharmed, Lord Captain."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, during your absence, your retinue has seen certain changes. The esteemed Master Anthar will no longer be able to accompany you. According to a message from the Adeptus Arbites, he has been discharged and is currently an overseer on Vheabos VI. However, Prefect Vultur has informed me that you have the authority to challenge that decision and have Master Anthar reinstated."
  - After: "The Arbites discharged Master Anthar to overseer on Vheabos VI. Prefect Vultur says you can reinstate him."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Winterscale's ships are being hunted and his worlds occupied under the pretence of compelling them to submit to the Imperial Creed. Surprisingly, for all his love of fighting, Winterscale is in no hurry to defend his domain. According to intercepted Astropathic messages, he and his retinue are currently on Quetza Temer hunting down a xenos fleet — Aeldari, by all appearances."
  - After: "Winterscale ignores his seized worlds, hunting Aeldari at Quetza Temer."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai's presence alone is enough to elicit gasps of dismay and whispers from the crowd. The Drukhari ignores all mon-keigh reactions to his person and surveys the ship's bridge, examining every detail with ostentatiously cool interest. His markedly casual posture is belied by the subtle and unusual tension in his body.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd gasps at Marazhai. He coolly surveys the bridge, subtly tense.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen, light of my eyes! I am overjoyed to see you among us once more! Truly, the Exalted One is merciful for showing you the way back home. I hope all the ashmags who left us to languish without our Lord Captain have already become food for the warp daemons!"
  - After: "Shereen, light of my eyes! I hope the ashmags who lost you are daemon food!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "The decks overflow with dazzling shades of yellow as the crew welcomes its {mf|lord|lady}, and I join them in this greeting!"
  - After: "The decks glow yellow for our {mf|lord|lady}, and I join them!"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}The crew stares in awe and terror at the giant towering over the crowd. Some make the sign of the Aquila on their chests, others collapse to their knees with a prayer to the God-Emperor on their lips. This wave of pious shock does not seem to discompose Ulfar in the slightest — he just chuckles into his beard and glances around curiously.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crew gapes at Ulfar, some praying. He chuckles.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}He stops, then his facade of sangfroid cracks, and he gives you another look, this one full of turmoil.{/n} "I would... prefer... I will meet with you in person after the briefing. I have... questions."
  - After: {n}His composure cracks.{/n} "I'll see you after the briefing. I have... questions."
- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Glory to the Rogue Trader! Glory to House von Valancius!" {n}Your subjects' triumphant roar sends a tremor through the bridge. It is as though the ship itself is greeting its long-lost owner.{/n}
  - After: "Glory to the Rogue Trader! Glory to House von Valancius!" {n}The bridge roars.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae twirls a lock of hair around her finger and sends a fiery gaze your way, which she immediately hides beneath her lowered lashes.{/n} "I... do hope we will get a chance to have a conversation in private very soon. For now, however, I dare not steal any more of the Rogue Trader's precious time..."
  - After: {n}Jae glances at you hotly.{/n} "I hope we can talk privately soon..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia nervously brings her thin fingers to her lips and lowers her eyes.{/n} "I am... particularly gladdened by your return, Lord Captain. I hope that you can find a moment... once you have seen to your duties..."
  - After: {n}Cassia lowers her eyes.{/n} "I'm... especially glad you're back. Perhaps a moment, later..."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal offers you a respectful bow.{/n} "The return of the {mf|master|mistress} of the temple is an event honoured by every spirit that dwells within the sacred systems and machines of this abode."
  - After: {n}Pasqal bows.{/n} "Every machine spirit honours its {mf|master|mistress}'s return."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix's gaze is focused on Yrliet. His eyes burn with undisguised hatred... and a promise.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix glares at Yrliet with hatred... and a promise.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix's gaze, tense and almost desperate, is focused on you. But he says nothing — for now, at least.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix watches you desperately, silent.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Lies." {n}The Interrogator's voice trembles with fury.{/n}
  - After: "Lies." {n}Heinrix trembles with fury.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "This is so... touching." {n}Marazhai's voice is laced with venom.{/n}
  - After: "So... touching." {n}Venomously.{/n}
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "We begin at once, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: "At once, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}Danrok throws up his hands.{/n} "But... but the crew is overcome with joy and gratitude to the God-Emperor... Nonetheless, your will is absolute!"
  - After: {n}Danrok throws up his hands.{/n} "But the crew... Still, your will is absolute!"
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}Danrok adjusts his jacket before addressing you.{/n} "Now then, Lord Captain... Shall we get to business? We have a number of items to go over."
  - After: {n}Danrok straightens.{/n} "Now, Lord Captain, to business."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "The Adeptus Arbites tasked him with a mission of some sort that, as far as I know, ended in failure, leading to Master Anthar being deemed unworthy of his rank and unfit to serve you."
  - After: "An Arbites mission he failed got him deemed unfit to serve you."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "I have good news to share as well: the {d|Encyclopedia:BS_Heartless}Heartless{/d} is fully repaired! Its hull has been considerably reinforced, and, after a complete cycle of tech-litanies, the fighter craft in its hangar now eagerly await the chance to show their worth in battle!"
  - After: "Good news: the {d|Encyclopedia:BS_Heartless}Heartless{/d} is repaired, hull reinforced, fighters battle-ready!"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn raises his hands in a gesture of solemn greeting.{/n} "My neural implants are overloaded with relief at beholding you in good health, Rogue Trader! I never doubted that the strength of your spirit and mind would triumph over xenos treachery, and this is an incontrovertible fact."
  - After: {n}Eogunn raises his hands.{/n} "My implants overload with relief, Rogue Trader!"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn looks grim and anxious.{/n} "Rogue Trader, I must speak with you regarding Nuncius and the events in Commorragh. I... have much to explain. Find me when you are ready to listen."
  - After: {n}Eogunn looks grim.{/n} "We must talk about Nuncius and Commorragh. Find me."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "On behalf of the officers' council, I dare say that the esteemed Seneschal Werserian performed his duties with distinction and averted many tragedies that threatened your domain in these trying times." {n}Danrok starts clapping, and the rest of the assembly joins in the applause. Abelard accepts the accolade with a faint smile of weary indifference.{/n}
  - After: "Seneschal Werserian served with distinction." {n}Applause. Abelard smiles wearily.{/n}
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "First and foremost, I have news about your subjects. In the time that you were gone, the servants of House von Valancius have toiled tirelessly in their service to you and for the benefit of the entire trade protectorate."
  - After: "First, your subjects. They have toiled tirelessly for you."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Bridge_KTC_ConfrontCorruption

- **Player**
  - Before: "What corruption in my soul are you talking about, Yrliet?"
  - After: "What corruption in my soul, Yrliet?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you are so worried about my wrongdoings, Sister, why did you take part in committing them?"
  - After: "If my wrongs worry you, Sister, why help commit them?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You may disapprove of my methods, but you cannot argue with my results."
  - After: "Dislike my methods, not my results."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How magnanimous of you, Interrogator. I shall bear it in mind."
  - After: "How magnanimous, Interrogator. Noted."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do only what is necessary to ensure the prosperity of the Expanse and House von Valancius."
  - After: "I do only what the Expanse and my House need."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Argenta, what is the meaning of this?"
  - After: "Argenta, what is this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you accusing me of something, Heinrix?"
  - After: "Are you accusing me, Heinrix?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I promise to atone for my faults. This audience is over."
  - After: "I'll atone. Audience over."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Threatening me may cost you your head, Wolf."
  - After: "Threats may cost your head, Wolf."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Perhaps I did misstep. It will not happen again."
  - After: "Perhaps I misstepped. Never again."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you some kind of seer now, seeing shadows and prophesying a dire future for me?"
  - After: "A seer now, prophesying my doom?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare you insinuate that I, one of the Emperor's anointed, have been weak-willed enough to succumb to the Archenemy? The audacity!"
  - After: "You say I, the Emperor's anointed, fell to the Archenemy? The audacity!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Lie] "I shall reconsider my ways, I give my word as Lord Captain! The Emperor protects."
  - After: [Lie] "I'll change, on my word as Lord Captain! The Emperor protects."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Given that the Lord Inquisitor still has not ordered you to execute me, I am not doing too badly."
  - After: "No execution order yet, so I'm fine."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are making a mistake. With me, many glorious battles still await you. Is that not what you desire?"
  - After: "A mistake. With me, glorious battles await. Isn't that your wish?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Have you finished the lecture? Then get off my bridge! I have other matters to attend to."
  - After: "Lecture over? Then off my bridge!"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Baring your fangs at me is unwise, Rogue Trader. You do not want to see what I am like when I take a threat to heart." {n}A sinister glint of bloodlust flares in the giant's darkened eyes.{/n}
  - After: "Don't bare your fangs at me." {n}Bloodlust glints.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "A wise decision, elantach. I hope you find the strength to return to the true path. For as long as I am at your side, I will help you find your way back."
  - After: "Wise, elantach. I'll help you back to the true path."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "I have no need of prophecy or sorcery to see what is blindingly obvious. Think about it, elantach. Is your own vision clear?"
  - After: "The obvious needs no prophecy. Is your vision clear, elantach?"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Even the most beautiful fruit can rot from the inside, but it is hard to tell until you cut off a piece. So look inside yourself, elantach. Is your inner world really as perfect as you think?"
  - After: "Fair fruit rots inside. Look within, elantach."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You are becoming more and more like Theodora. But even she stopped short of crossing the lines you have crossed. A few more steps and your soul will be irrevocably mired in the Archenemy's heresy. I cannot bear the fault of inaction, {name}. Either you come back to His light, or sooner or later I will leave this unholy ship."
  - After: "You've crossed lines even Theodora didn't. Return to His light, {name}, or I leave this ship."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Truly, I too have erred, and I will receive my due for the things I have done. But the spirit of any of His servants may falter. It is because I understand this that I now stand before you with a plea, and not with a sword."
  - After: "I've erred too. So I come with a plea, not a sword."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "With these words have the most horrendous crimes against the Imperium been committed. His commandments exist for a reason. You either follow them or receive your just punishment."
  - After: "The worst crimes began with those words. Obey His commandments or be punished."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Hearing is not enough. The sooner you start on the path to redemption, the better."
  - After: "Hearing isn't enough. Start atoning, soon."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I am at the Lord Captain's service, as always. However, magnanimity has nothing to do with it. Consider this my attempt to spare myself an unnecessary and unpleasant task."
  - After: "Not magnanimity. I'd rather skip an unpleasant task."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "For now, it is only a warning. Your Warrant is not a licence to do as you please. Many a Rogue Trader has forgotten this, and this mistake inevitably costs them their life. I can turn a blind eye to the occasional misdemeanour, but when they become systemic... Suffice to say that the Inquisition's conversations with hardened heretics tend to be short, and I'd rather not have one of those conversations with you."
  - After: "A warning. Your Warrant isn't a licence. Occasional misdeeds I'll overlook, systemic ones not. The Inquisition's talks with heretics are short."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I am doing only what is necessary for the prosperity of the entire Imperium. So when a member of the Inquisition tells you that you are on the verge of heresy, I advise that you listen."
  - After: "I serve the whole Imperium. When the Inquisition says you near heresy, listen."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Just because a heretic has stepped into the fire, but is not yet engulfed in flames, does not mean things are going well. The match is in my hands, and only your actions will decide whether or not I strike it. That is all I have to say."
  - After: "I hold the match; your actions decide if I strike it."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "I respect you enough, Rogue Trader, to speak frankly. I would rather fight shoulder to shoulder with you than stand against you."
  - After: "I speak frankly from respect. I'd rather fight beside you."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Glorious battles await me whether I am in your squad or on my own. I am only trying to prevent a course of events that will end with us meeting as enemies in one of those battles."
  - After: "Glory awaits me either way. I'd rather not meet you as an enemy."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Threats are the recourse of the weak. I am a loyal ally trying to keep you from making a mistake. The villainy you condone comes close to crossing the line beyond which there is no forgiveness. I do not wish to see you cross that line, for we are all bound by our duties, and it is my duty to punish such transgressions."
  - After: "Threats are for the weak. As an ally I warn you: your villainy nears the unforgivable, and I must punish that."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Vice and cruelty follow in your wake like a gloomy shadow, a shadow in which the malevolent smirk of She Who Thirsts more and more clearly manifests. This shadow will swallow you and everyone around you. And it will become irrevocable if you do not start fighting it. I am ready to help you in this if you are willing to renounce the path of corruption. Otherwise... I will not risk my immortal soul by remaining at your side."
  - After: "She Who Thirsts smirks in your shadow. It will swallow everyone. Renounce corruption and I'll help; otherwise I leave."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Bridge_KTC_ConfrontCorruption/Bridge_KTC_ConfrontCorruption_dialogue

- **Vox Master Vigdis**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, I tried to explain that you were busy but—" {n}The Vox Master does not have time to finish her sentence before she is unceremoniously interrupted.{/n}
  - After: "Lord Captain, I said you were busy—" {n}Vigdis is cut off.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You are consumed by corruption. With every decision you make, I feel more and more that I do not belong in your retinue. Stop. Repent before the Emperor — before it is too late."
  - After: "Corruption consumes you. Repent before the Emperor, before it's too late."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "{name}, your actions concern me. They concern me a great deal. It would be quite unfortunate if we found ourselves on opposing sides."
  - After: "{name}, your actions concern me. I'd hate to be your enemy."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Your actions have earned you a grim reputation, Aett-Vater. Ill deeds have too often been done by your hand. You do not live according to the law given by the Allfather, and so I ask you to stop before you go too far. I am loath to visit punishment upon my own saviour."
  - After: "You defy the Allfather's law, Aett-Vater. Stop, before I must punish my saviour."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "You have started down a dangerous path, elantach. I can see it in your eyes, your actions, the sound of your voice, the beating of your heart. Leave this path while the growing corruption can still be torn from your soul without completely destroying it! Or are you so lost in this world that you long to lose yourself as well?"
  - After: "A dangerous path, elantach. Leave it while the corruption can still be torn out."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Eufrates/BE_PlanetAssault/BE_PlanetAssault

  - Before: ...the use of combat-class servo-skulls coordinated by {mf|his|her} personal swarm, call sign {petname}, to assist with the tech-sabotage mission.

  - Before: ...ordered the troops to capture the cruiser at any cost and bolstered the strike force with a resplendent symbol of the faith: {petname}, {mf|his|her} own two-headed eagle.

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Upon descending from orbit, Sister Argenta inspired the troops with the very first notes of her prayers — her singing was the Emperor's voice commanding us to fight without any regard for our own lives. After rousing the soldiers to launch a daring raid, she quickly captured one of the heretics' commanders. That was when we heard a starkly different voice come from the Sister of Battle. Trembling with fury, she personally interrogated the miscreant, pulling one poisoned confession after another out of him. Once she was done, the world was purged of his impure breath. And she was the one wielding the flamer. The sight of that heretic writhing in flames was imprinted upon our memories, shining a light on the cruel darkness of our immediate future like a brilliant beacon.
  - After: Sister Argenta's prayers roused the troops. She captured a heretic commander, wrung confessions from him, then burned him herself. We never forgot it.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Sector: Koronus Expanse
Region: Mundus Valancius System
Location: Dargonus, palace of the Lord General Militant
Material: Extract from the memoirs "When the Expanse Burned"
Author: Corvan Lazarus, Lord General Militant of the Dargonus Planetary Defence Garrison
  - After: Dargonus, Koronus Expanse.
From "When the Expanse Burned" by Corvan Lazarus, Lord General Militant.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: A general once said that all wars are fundamentally the same — if you've seen one, you've seen them all. Groxshit. That general didn't witness the events on Eufrates II.
  - After: They say all wars are the same. Groxshit. Not Eufrates II.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: It came as a surprise to all when the Space Wolf Thorbald supported the Magos Dominus. After the Lord Captain had reconciled him with the Explorator leader, Thorbald had tamed his pride and spoke in favour of the Tech-Priests' cause of liberating the noble machine.
  - After: Surprisingly, Thorbald, reconciled by the Lord Captain, backed the Magos Dominus in freeing the noble machine.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: And that's when it came. Doomscream. An ancient and bloodthirsty Helbrute, a merciless executioner forged from adamantine and ceramite. That single foe was repelling our assaults one after the other, turning hundreds of soldiers into a bloody pulp. For as long as that abomination lived, we had no hope of reaching the heart of the enemy citadel.
  - After: Then came Doomscream, an ancient Helbrute. It pulped hundreds and blocked our way to the citadel's heart.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The shuttles would have blocked out the sun, if you could have seen it through the smoke of the manufactorum city of Sigma-S-13. At its heart stood the Machine Cathedral, our primary objective.
  - After: Shuttles filled the smoke over Sigma-S-13. Our objective: the Machine Cathedral at its heart.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Lord Captain showed us mercy by having the landing zone bombarded from orbit. All the shuttles carrying troops — and, more importantly, precious vehicles — reached their destination. Daunted by our numbers, the enemy withdrew. That was the perfect moment for a decisive attack — with an armoured vehicle force of this size, we had the upper hand.
  - After: Orbital bombardment cleared the landing zone. Every shuttle and tank landed, and the enemy fell back. Time to strike.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Lord Captain's orders were to commence a lightning-fast assault. We were flying straight into a hail of artillery fire. For many of us, that was the end. The rest were being thrown around in mid-air, praying that the next shell would miss their shuttle. But the losses were justified — with that surprise attack, we seized the initiative at the start of the battle.
  - After: We flew straight into artillery fire. Many died, but we seized the initiative.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Ignoring the protests of the venerated Tech-Priests, the Lord Captain gave the order not to spare the world's infrastructure. We struck at the sacred chapel of the Magos Alchemys, triggering an emission of toxic gas. The noxious cloud blanketed the enemy's positions, but even that did not make the heretics retreat. By the time we had fought our way to their positions, they were so weakened by the gas that hung in the air that they showed us no resistance and surrendered by the hundreds.
  - After: Over the Tech-Priests' protests, we gassed the enemy from the Magos Alchemys' chapel. Hundreds surrendered.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Opticon-22 and his cohort, their armour painted with black chrome, marched into the darkness of the manufactorum in silence. Hours later, we heard chilling sounds of combat, and then a flash erupted from the depths of the sacred workshops. The Emperor's Angels charged forth and found Doomscream there, crippled but still alive, and routed the fiend. His bloodied pincer, ripped off by the devastating explosion, was presented to the Lord Captain as a trophy. The body of Opticon-22 was never found — it was disintegrated by the atomic charge he carried into battle. Such was the high price for the grave and humiliating wound that he and his tech-comrades inflicted upon the unholy champion of the heretics. We chanted the name of the brave warrior of the Code in our prayers.
  - After: Opticon-22's cohort vanished into the manufactorum. Hours later, a flash. Doomscream, crippled, was routed; its pincer became the Lord Captain's trophy. Opticon-22's atomic charge left no body.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: What happened next would become legend. The Lord Captain at the head of {mf|his|her} retinue challenged the bloodlusting heresiarch that had crawled out of the darkness of time. {mf|He|She} dealt the wicked executioner a heavy and mortifying blow, and thus Doomscream was routed.
  - After: A legend: the Lord Captain led {mf|his|her} retinue against the heresiarch. {mf|He|She} struck, and Doomscream fled.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Lord Captain {mf|himself|herself} was wounded in battle. It was at that moment that Opticon-22 walked onto the battlefield with his cohort of elite Skitarii.
  - After: The Lord Captain was wounded {mf|himself|herself}. Then Opticon-22 arrived with elite Skitarii.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: We began our advance. I will never forget the roar of the tank, its treads tearing the heretics' infantry to pieces, accompanied by the shrieks of lasguns and the rumble of heavy artillery. The deafening symphony of war.

There, deep below, lay the last hiding place of the heretics' leaders. Hundreds of grenades, accompanied by promises of swift judgement, were hurled into the pit — such was our righteous anger.
  - After: At the Machine Cathedral, a drill shaft plunged to the heretic leaders' last refuge. We hurled in hundreds of grenades.

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Eufrates/CapitulatedEnemies/CapitulatedEnemies_dialogue

- **Player**

  - After: [Execute the heretics] "Mercy to Humanity's enemies is heresy. Death."

  - Before: "Lay down your weapons and await your judgement. We will hold the tribunal once I am done here."
  - After: "Lay down your weapons. Your tribunal comes when I'm done."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why the silence? Go on, keep praising me! If I like it, I shall spare you."
  - After: "Keep praising me! Please me, and I'll spare you."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Execute the heretics] "'Inevitability' is indeed the word. This is your reward."
  - After: [Execute the heretics] "'Inevitability' indeed. Your reward."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Not bad, but there is room for improvement. Everyone lay down your weapons, and you, come up with some more impressive words of praise by the time I return!"
  - After: "Not bad. Disarm, and have better praise ready when I return!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The crowd of heretics fall to their knees and hold out their hands to you, pleading for mercy. Their leader, a heretek with worm-like tentacles stirring about in one of his eye sockets, howls plaintively out of his vox,{/n} "{name} von Valancius, conqueror of steel and smiter of True Flesh, we initiate the capitulation protocol! Nowhere under this chrome firmament and leaden haze is there a cogitational array capable of designing a productive method of opposing you."
  - After: {n}The heretics kneel. Their heretek leader howls,{/n} "{name} von Valancius, we initiate the capitulation protocol! You cannot be opposed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}One after another, the heretics hand over their weapons, like a congregation bringing gifts to a terrifying god whose stare alone could pulverise them. Perhaps for them, now that they have witnessed your tactical genius and unbridled might, that image is not far from the truth.{/n}
  - After: {n}The heretics hand over their weapons like offerings to a god.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The heretek's tentacles recoil and his vox howls again as he pleads.{/n} "Even a mighty Titan could not withstand your wrath, and would turn into a lake of boiling metal!"
  - After: {n}The heretek cringes.{/n} "Even a Titan would melt before your wrath!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your wisdom is inscrutable as the warp's depths and boundless as the arcane technologies of ages past!"
  - After: "Your wisdom is deep as the warp!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You think you can hear cogs creak inside the heretek's skull as he tries to squeeze out some more words of praise.{/n} "You are inevitability. You are doom. You are the scourge of unbelievers..."
  - After: {n}Cogs creak in his skull.{/n} "You are inevitability. You are doom..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The heretek falls abruptly silent. The soundless tension is only punctuated by the strained breathing noises coming from his vox.{/n}
  - After: {n}The heretek falls silent, his vox wheezing.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your indestructible legions have annihilated all who dared to stand in their way. No matter what we threw at you, it all turned to dust, which your servants then trampled into oil and soot. Our survivors are few. Mercy! We beg for mercy!"
  - After: "Your legions crushed us. Few survive. Mercy, we beg!"
