With a feeble heart, you grant mercy to those who do not deserve it, you do not punish transgressions with the utmost severity, and you do not strike terror into your subjects that will bring them to pious trepidation. You waste your energy and attention on the needs of nonentities instead of turning them to His service. Under your hand, dangerous freethinking and satiety flourish, and will soon swell with the plagues of anarchy and decadence."
  - After: "You bend His laws, spare the undeserving and fail to terrify your subjects. Your freethinking breeds anarchy."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "That you are loathed and feared by the enemies of Humanity does not make you pure in the eyes of the Emperor. But perhaps He saw fit to set you on a different path, one of righteous xenocide and blood-soaked redemption for your faults. I would never dare to gainsay His will."
  - After: "Xenos hatred isn't purity. But perhaps He chose you for xenocide and redemption."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "That the enemies of Humanity see you as their rival in the fight for Humanity's souls does not absolve you in the eyes of this court."
  - After: "Rivalling Humanity's enemies does not absolve you here."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Your... intrepidity gives me reason to doubt the sufficiency of my evidence. Perhaps I should hold off on delivering the verdict. Briefly." {n}Her outraged expression does not bode well.{/n}
  - After: "Your... boldness gives me doubts. I'll delay the verdict. Briefly." {n}She seethes.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Speak your piece, {name}. You are but a step away from making statements that will be considered an infringement upon my privileges, so I invite you to continue."
  - After: "Speak on, {name}. One step more and you infringe my privileges. Please, continue."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}After clearing his throat and presenting his Interrogator's regalia, Heinrix pronounces imperatively,{/n} "On behalf of the Koronus Conclave, I hereby inform Rogue Trader House Chorda that, by order of Lord Inquisitor Calcazar, Rogue Trader von Valancius has been placed in the custody of the Inquisition. Any attack on {mf|his|her} safety is to be treated as an act of interference in the affairs of the Inquisition."
  - After: {n}Heinrix shows his regalia.{/n} "By Calcazar's order, von Valancius is in Inquisition custody. Any attack on {mf|his|her} safety defies the Inquisition."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "You insult the Emperor's judgement! You taunt the Rogue Trader! You blaspheme! Do not think for one second that you will get away with this!"
  - After: "You insult the Emperor's judgement! Blasphemer! You'll pay for this!"
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Indeed I am. When the Lord Inquisitor enacted martial law in the Expanse, I offered him my support at once. Footfall was chosen as the Lord Inquisitor's headquarters, and the position of Footfall's Liege was temporarily abolished for the duration of this war... or perhaps longer than that. All authority was transferred to the station's warden — to me. While the Lord Inquisitor is preoccupied with matters of strategic planning, I am tasked with overseeing security and order."
  - After: "I am. Under the Lord Inquisitor's martial law, I, the station's warden, hold all authority. He plans; I keep order."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia, who is engaged in reading one of her many parchments, greets you in a voice that is sonorous and solemn:{/n} "{name} von Valancius, I am pleased to see you. In this dark hour, when all the filth of the Expanse has caught the scent of freedom and crawled to the surface, it is comforting to see a faithful ally at my side. Together, we shall {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymHanged}finish the purging of Footfall{/d} and restore order to every system in the Expanse!"
  - After: {n}Incendia looks up.{/n} "{name} von Valancius, a faithful ally! Together we shall {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymHanged}finish the purging of Footfall{/d} and restore order!"
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Everyone knows that your cursed ship hosts traitors to the Emperor and worshippers of the Ruinous Powers. In every port you visit, people disappear and the seeds of evil cults take root. You shamelessly flaunt your perverted morals and offer patronage to those who revere you as if you were a deity. Your capital is a cesspool of filth that spreads heresy throughout the sector."
  - After: "Your ship harbours traitors and Chaos worshippers. Cults spread wherever you go."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "You pretend to be a faithful and devout servant of the Emperor, but you show no true zeal or fervour in faith. Your ship does not shake with hymns and chants to glorify His name, and your capital has not been led into pious trepidation. In so dark an hour, you have been granted the honour of being a light of righteousness in the eyes of the Expanse, but your light... is traitorously dim."
  - After: "You feign devotion without zeal. Your light should guide the Expanse, yet it is traitorously dim."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I deem the evidence against you sufficient to cast you as an enemy of Humanity."
  - After: "The evidence marks you an enemy of Humanity."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "All of them! Thieves, smugglers, pirates, traitors, heretics, deserters! Abettors, harbourers, cowards, and perjurers! Any who has ever trespassed, any who has ever protected a miscreant or kept quiet about a crime they knew of. They all will be condemned!" {n}With obsessive determination, Incendia starts going through her papers, seemingly no longer aware that she is doing so.{/n}
  - After: "All of them! Thieves, pirates, heretics, and their shielders!" {n}She shuffles papers.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "We have made several attempts to arrest him, yet he has evaded capture each time. Reverend Hieronymus has gone there to convince him to surrender quietly, but his efforts have likewise been unsuccessful. In the interest of Footfall's integrity, Tocara must be apprehended."
  - After: "He keeps escaping. Even Reverend Hieronymus failed to make him surrender."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Together, we shall make that scoundrel pay for his crimes. Let him drink the cup of His wrath to full, a cup that will be delivered by our hands."
  - After: "Together we'll make him drink His wrath."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "As the Rogue Trader in authority, I order you to aid me in bringing him to justice."
  - After: "As the Rogue Trader in authority, I order you to help."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "The asteroid where the Adeptus Amasecus is located has been cordoned off, but my enforcer will take you there. I want you to lure Tocara out of his hole and seize him so that he may stand trial. Do this for the sake of Footfall's liberation and pave the road that my justice will tread."
  - After: "My enforcer will take you to the Adeptus Amasecus. Lure Tocara out and seize him for trial."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "And let my vow be heard: I shall not leave this station, I shall not yield to sleep, I shall not let my body be washed until every last criminal who hides in this lawless den has faced His judgement!"
  - After: "I vow not to leave, sleep or wash until every criminal here is judged!"
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "The universe is a terrifying place. We are surrounded by the Archenemy's machinations and xenos scum who would deny us our right to exist. The threat is inconceivable, and human weakness will not help us avert it. If man is weak, I rid him of his spinelessness and feebleness, endowing him with a sacred narrowness of mind and eradicating all that prevents him from utilising his whole self in the service of the Imperium."
  - After: "The Archenemy and xenos beset us. Weakness won't save us, so I purge it from men."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia's face twists in displeasure, and her voice trembles with anger and tension:{/n} "You still cannot grasp the fact that everything has changed, {name}. Gone is the time when you could do only what you wished to do. It is now time to do what you must."
  - After: {n}Angrily:{/n} "Things have changed, {name}. Do what you must."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Not carnage, but judgement. His judgement. And I know of no other delight than serving Him."
  - After: "Not carnage — His judgement. Serving Him is my only delight."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I thought I was speaking to you, and yet I hear Theodora's words, greedy and full of hubris. Your 'gain' is the order that will come to this station and its obedience to the Emperor, His law, and His stewards."
  - After: "You sound like greedy Theodora. Your 'gain' is order and obedience to the Emperor."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Such is the law of Footfall. Any Rogue Trader who arrives here assumes the right of absolute authority. Surely it is not that thug Tocara who deserves to rule this station. He will soon be hanging from a noose, and so will his Kasballican henchmen, and so will those Anver firebrands whose outrageous activities brought Footfall so much grief."
  - After: "Here, any Rogue Trader holds absolute authority. Tocara will hang, with his Kasballica and the Anver firebrands."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "And there is much to do on that front. Pirates and smugglers, apostates and Cold Traders, deserters and outlaws... Every one of them warrants attention."
  - After: "Much to do. Pirates, smugglers, apostates, Cold Traders, deserters... All warrant attention."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Why wouldn't I? That vile rogue's infamy is known to all. He patronised thieves, smugglers, and pirates. By his leave, heresies and unholy cults flourished. That he has evaded punishment this long can only be described as gross negligence, which I intend to rectify in short order."
  - After: "Why not? He sheltered pirates and cults. I'll correct his long impunity."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Reverend Hieronymus headed where the rebels are seen most often, so he could preach to them and sway them to repent. Alas, he still cannot see the difference between those who have erred and those who are beyond any hope of redemption."
  - After: "Hieronymus went to preach repentance to the rebels. He can't tell the erring from the damned."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia seems slightly perplexed by your question. She starts moving signed sentences from one stack to another, then says uncertainly,{/n} "Three... weeks. The court carries on day and night, so my sense of time eludes me."
  - After: {n}Incendia, perplexed:{/n} "Three... weeks. The court never stops; I lose track."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "The scoundrels and thieves will be replaced by honest suppliers. Even degenerates such as the Kasballica can be of some use in the coming crisis, but their wilful leaders need to be replaced with more pliable and trepidatious successors. It is the only way for us to protect ourselves from being stabbed in the back."
  - After: "Honest suppliers will replace thieves. Even the Kasballica may serve, under pliant new leaders."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Since you, {name}, helped me {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}curb Calligos's... appetites{/d} once before, I will invite you to divide his territories with me. Once we have extinguished these roaring flames of wickedness, House von Valancius will be welcome to partake in the conquest of that profaner's worlds."
  - After: "You once helped me {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}curb Calligos's... appetites{/d}, {name}. Share his worlds with me once we conquer them."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I thought you and I were allies. But if you wish to challenge my authority... you are welcome to try." {n}Incendia touches a panel on the throne's armrest and is immediately shielded by a refractor field. You hear the sounds of alarms going off in the distance.{/n}
  - After: "I thought we were allies. Try me." {n}A refractor field shields her; alarms sound.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "In the Liege's chambers, coordinating the Expanse's defence. His attention is focused on matters of vital importance, and he is not seeing any supplicants."
  - After: "In the Liege's chambers, planning the Expanse's defence. He sees no supplicants."
- **Acolyte of the Inquisition**
  - Before: {n}The soldier wearing Inquisitorial armour echoes Incendia's words:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} cannot see the Lord Inquisitor now. However, he bade to inform Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} that he will summon you later, when circumstances permit."
  - After: {n}A soldier adds:{/n} "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} cannot see him now. He will summon Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} later."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "He is no more, then. Regrettably, he {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_WinterscaleDead}found his demise so easily{/d}. Calligos was meant to confess before the court and taste the detestation he deserved."
  - After: "Pity he {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_WinterscaleDead}found his demise so easily{/d}. Calligos deserved a trial."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Astrocartographers will soon have their hands full erasing the name 'Winterscale's Realm' from star maps. The castigating disgrace that will fall upon the dynasty will be a fitting punishment for Calligos's crimes."
  - After: "His dynasty's disgrace fits Calligos's crimes. 'Winterscale's Realm' will vanish from star maps."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Negotiating with that mad dog is off the table now. He will merely laugh at your talk of reconciliation and execute your envoys. For too long has Calligos revelled in impunity and believed himself the king of his world."
  - After: "No negotiating with that mad dog. He'd execute your envoys."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia's smile turns vicious.{/n} "I do so enjoy candour. When the one who stands before the court admits openly that {mf|he|she} shares the beliefs of someone about to be pronounced an outright anarchist and traitor to the Imperium... I say such a confession should earn {mf|him|her} a swift and less agonising execution."
  - After: {n}Vicious smile.{/n} "Admitting {mf|he|she} shares a traitor's beliefs earns {mf|him|her} a swifter execution."
- **Acolyte of the Inquisition**
  - Before: "If Her Ladyship is gravely threatened, we are authorised to detonate the dome over this sector. Doing so will trigger an explosive decompression. The attackers will be destroyed during depressurisation while Her Ladyship will be protected by the field projected by her throne. I urge you not to take steps that might be interpreted as an act of aggression."
  - After: "Threaten Her Ladyship and we blow the dome. Decompression kills you; her throne shields her."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Wait. You have a duty to the Emperor that you must see to. Vladaym Tocara, the deplorable rebel who once ruled this station, has slipped from my grasp. He is inciting the people to revolt, killing my servants, and hiding from my wrath with the dexterity of a void rat. My informers claim he often appears in that den of unrest that bears the irreverent name the Adeptus Amasecus."
  - After: "Wait. Vladaym Tocara, the former ruler, escaped me and incites revolt. Informers say he frequents the Adeptus Amasecus."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia wearily leans on an armrest and looks at you with contempt.{/n} "Take this pitiful gaggle of miscreants, {name}, if you so desire. My trial will not end here — I have the whole of Footfall to judge."
  - After: {n}Contemptuous:{/n} "Take these miscreants, {name}. I have all Footfall to judge."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}She is not lying. You can tell by her eyes and her voice, trembling with earnest faith, that Incendia genuinely believes in every word she just said.{/n}
  - After: {n}She truly believes every word.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}No matter how hard you try, you cannot discern what makes Incendia's voice tremble when she speaks of justice — the zeal of true faith or the lusting ecstasy of a maniac.{/n}
  - After: {n}Faith or a maniac's ecstasy? You can't tell.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "As long as you refuse to cooperate, Footfall's isolated sectors will remain off-limits to you. Go and consider my words... and your position." {n}With a brusqueness bordering on the offensive, Incendia dismisses you with a flick of her hand.{/n}
  - After: "Until you cooperate, Footfall's isolated sectors are closed to you." {n}She waves you off.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Cracking her neck, stiff from many hours of reading documents, Incendia again dips her silver spoon and scoops out brain matter from the open skull of the poor fellow standing next to her. Everywhere you look, servants are buckling under heavy stacks of new denunciations, warrants, and other documents.{/n}
  - After: {n}Incendia spoons more brain from the man's skull. Servants haul warrants.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Winterscale is a traitor! While the Expanse burns, ravaged by heretics and unhallowed xenos, he abandoned his duty completely and had the nerve to ignore the Lord Inquisitor's call to battle. My servants are capturing his worlds and ships while he hides from his reckoning, indulging his base urges. Soon enough, he too will stand before judgement."
  - After: "Winterscale is a traitor! He ignored the Lord Inquisitor's call to battle. I'm seizing his worlds. He'll be judged."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I have encountered sanctioned death cults that practised cannibalism as part of their way of praising the Emperor. A surprisingly large number of them harboured heresy within."
  - After: "I've known sanctioned cannibal death cults. Many hid heresy."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "You have suspicions about me? Well, it is your duty to suspect. But do your eyes see any trespass here? No. I have committed no malefaction against Him."
  - After: "Suspicion is your duty. But you see no trespass here."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "As for that pirate Ryzza, there is no need for you to mourn her. Yes, she did come across valuable prizes at times, but more often than not those prizes were tainted. Surely some other rat from her crew has already taken over her profane trade at the Amasecus and will be open for business... until I hang the lot of them, that is."
  - After: "Don't mourn Ryzza; her prizes were tainted. Her crew still trades at the Amasecus... until I hang them."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "His crimes were grievous, but they were no barrier to his receiving mercy. The heretic was purified in a holy procedure and converted to a new mission to serve the Imperium as a servitor. As were many, many others."
  - After: "He was shown mercy: purified and made a servitor. Like many others."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I'm afraid you will not have the opportunity to ask them — the Lord Inquisitor has left Footfall. He charged me with the defence of the Furibundus System and departed on a secret mission in great haste. None are privy to its details." {n}Incendia's tone carries a note of wounded pride.{/n}
  - After: "The Lord Inquisitor left on a secret mission. I defend the Furibundus System." {n}Wounded pride.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The hopeful crowd in the Atrium starts hysterically clamouring their oaths of fealty to House von Valancius. Not one of them thinks twice about clutching at the lifeline you have offered them.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Atrium crowd frantically swears fealty to House von Valancius.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia stares at you in amazement.{/n} "You truly wish to stand trial? Very well. May your zeal serve as an example to the rest."
  - After: {n}Amazed:{/n} "You wish to stand trial? Very well. Let your zeal be an example."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Take joy in the sight of a new and transformed Footfall." {n}Incendia tiredly closes her eyes, then pulls out a small book of Drusian prayers and starts reading. A serene smile soon spreads across her face.{/n}
  - After: "Enjoy the new Footfall." {n}She reads Drusian prayers, smiling.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia leans forward and peers into your eyes. Her gaze, like a monk carrying a rushlight, wanders down the corridors of your soul's fortress, checking every corner in search of the slightest faults or traces of corruption. Moments pass as Incendia conducts her thorough investigation, until at last, she reclines on her throne again. A weary smile touches her lips.{/n}
  - After: {n}Incendia searches your soul for taint, then sits back, smiling wearily.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "This attempt was mediocre and far from the first. But my enforcers and my throne keep me safe." {n}Incendia pats an armrest and smiles.{/n} "Its refractor field is impervious even to tank shells. That thief Tocara had this sacred Drusian relic stashed in one of his storerooms."
  - After: "Not the first attempt. This throne, a Drusian relic from Tocara's stores, stops tank shells." {n}She pats it.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I see no sign of taint in your soul, {name}. You are pure before the Emperor, and thus I acquit you and grant you His blessing in parting. Go forth and bring His punishment to those who have turned their back on His word."
  - After: "No taint in you, {name}. I acquit you. Go punish those who spurn His word."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "In due time, I shall weed out all the taint that has bred here on Footfall for so long. And then pious fear, loyalty, and devotion will once again become the pillars of this station under His watchful eye."
  - After: "In time, fear, loyalty and devotion will again be Footfall's pillars."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I promised you that I would clean up Footfall, and I have kept my promise. By virtue of {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}your support{/d}, the station will once again be an outpost of the Imperium — a purified bastion of industriousness and righteousness. The heretics who dared defy me have nearly been eradicated to the last."
  - After: "With {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallNotAlly}your support{/d}, I've purged Footfall. The heretics are nearly gone."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}She looks at you with a gloating smirk.{/n} "Once, you {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}hindered my efforts to subdue this station{/d}. And yet here I am now, dispensing justice to the wicked. I only regret that I was unable to begin sooner — then Tocara's troublemakers would have already been crushed, instead of lurking in cargo bays and maintenance tunnels. Regardless, I will deal with them soon enough."
  - After: {n}She smirks.{/n} "You once {d|Encyclopedia:Ch2_FootfallAlly}hindered my efforts to subdue this station{/d}. Now I judge. Tocara's rabble is next."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai's eyes are locked on the wretched soul who has had his skull cracked open. The corner of the Drukhari's mouth twitches, stretching his gaunt face into a twisted grin.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai grins at the victim.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Perceiving corruption? What lofty yet paltry hysterics. Your methods, however..." {n}Marazhai looks Incendia over and lets out a wanton laugh.{/n} "This place is soaked with pain, much like the torture chambers of my old spire. It takes a skilled hand to elicit such refined, artful anguish. Impressive! I am amazed by this mon-keigh's ingenuity... and her intricate means of indulging her passion." {n}His gaze shifts to the bare-brained man.{/n}
  - After: "Paltry hysterics. But your methods..." {n}He laughs.{/n} "Pain like my old spire's. Impressive, mon-keigh." {n}He eyes the victim.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Remove that profane filth from my sight. It sickens me to observe the degraded inhuman's pathetic attempts at vying for attention. The only thing that stays its immediate death are your Rogue Trader's privileges that grant you the right to drag around such xenos refuse in your retinue. However desperate my wish to exterminate it might be, I shall not go against the word of the law here, in a place where His solemn justice is served."
  - After: "Remove that xenos filth. Only your privileges spare it; I keep the law here."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai appears to have ignored her tirade completely and continues speaking nonchalantly, his gaze still focused on the wretched victim:{/n} "Such a shame it is that the Rogue Trader I crossed paths with is not capable of enjoying such fine delights... or is {mf|he|she}?" {n}He watches you, his eyes devouring.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ignoring her:{/n} "Pity the Rogue Trader can't enjoy such delights... or can {mf|he|she}?" {n}He watches you hungrily.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai looks at Incendia's meal. An intrigued smirk appears on his lips — the xenos is waiting to see your reaction.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai smirks, awaiting your reaction.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue and looks away, immediately losing all interest in both you and Incendia, and in everything that is happening in her hall of justice, apparently.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue, bored.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The brain matter spills inside your mouth, slips down into your gullet... and instantly triggers a wave of nausea. You barely stop yourself from losing the contents of your stomach with everyone watching. Your eyes tear up, and your vision goes dark — and not a shred of your suffering escapes Marazhai's notice as he savours every shift in your expression.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nausea hits. You barely hold it in. Marazhai savours your grimace.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai flinches but reacts too slowly to stop you. He turns away with a resentful hiss, visibly disappointed.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai flinches too late, hissing.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Then let us begin." {n}Chorda leans forward and stares intently into your eyes. Scarcely has Incendia's gaze met yours than she begins writhing in pain and clutching her head. She takes a deep breath and tries to look you in the eye again, only for a new flash of pain to almost make her cry out. Confusion and fear are visible in her eyes.{/n}
  - After: "Then let us begin." {n}Chorda stares into your eyes, then clutches her head in pain, afraid.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I... cannot. I cannot see your crimes. How is this possible? Someone like you cannot be pure!"
  - After: "I... cannot see your crimes. You cannot be pure!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "What is this abominable act His daughter is committing?" {n}The Sister of Battle whispers incredulously as she stares at Chorda's monstrous feast.{/n} "There must be... a reason..."
  - After: "What abomination is His daughter committing?" {n}Argenta whispers.{/n} "There must be a reason..."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Does it not satisfy you that order and Imperial Compliance will be restored on Footfall? I see you learned too much from Theodora — namely, her hubris, greed, and indifference to duty."
  - After: "Imperial order isn't enough? You've learned Theodora's greed."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "Do you think that I find enjoyment in this? Looking at vileness upon vileness, listening to one excuse after another? I loathe this and despise every malefactor out there. If I were weak of will, I would have obliterated this foul station with nuclear fire. Instead, I am here to offer each of them the right to be judged in His name and the chance to return to His fold renewed."
  - After: "You think I enjoy this? A weaker will would nuke this place. I offer His judgement."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Has it by any chance occurred to the Inquisitor that he, too, is getting dangerously close to something slightly insane? How can a thing like this be tolerated? How can anyone look calmly upon these atrocities and think everything's going as it should?"
  - After: "Is the Inquisitor going mad too? Who could tolerate this?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Calm yourself, Idira." {n}Abelard steps between the psyker and Chorda.{/n} "I can understand your anger, but by the God-Emperor, another word out of turn... and you will find yourself following those unfortunates."
  - After: "Calm yourself, Idira." {n}Abelard steps between them.{/n} "Another word and you'll join those unfortunates."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta grimaces.{/n} "Loath as my soul is to concur with a xenos... it is indeed."
  - After: {n}Argenta grimaces.{/n} "The xenos is right."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "More and more new convicts are being granted the great boon of undergoing Servitude Imperpituis and, having rid themselves of reprehensible consciousness, of serving the Imperium free from doubt and weakness. Footfall will once again become a bastion of law and righteousness — I will eradicate all heresy that prevents the faithless from giving themselves over to the good of toiling in His name!"
  - After: "More convicts earn Servitude Imperpituis, serving free of doubt. Footfall will be a bastion of law again!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Flesh and blood can grant revelations, but not like this. Devouring flesh is a profane act." {n}Kibellah looks with disapproval at the open brain and the pulsing blue vein within.{/n} "This is not the way to serve the Undying One."
  - After: "Devouring flesh is profane." {n}Kibellah frowns.{/n} "This does not serve the Undying One."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira lets out a quiet whistle.{/n} "If even Skully is bothered by it, then it must be bad."
  - After: {n}Idira whistles.{/n} "If even Skully's bothered, it's bad."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}Solomorne makes a decisive motion as if to step into the line of fire in front of you.{/n} "I remind you, Rogue Trader Chorda, that you may judge common people, but not someone who is your equal. Much less..." {n}You receive a long, hard stare.{/n} "...{mf|him|her}. Take care when making accusations."
  - After: {n}Solomorne steps in.{/n} "Chorda, you may judge commoners, not your equal. Much less..." {n}A hard stare.{/n} "...{mf|him|her}."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: {n}Incendia's eyes gleam in triumph as she points at Solomorne accusingly.{/n} "I long refused to believe that Theodora had bribed the Adeptus Arbites to turn a blind eye to her misdeeds, but now I see that heresy has corrupted the servants of the Lex Imperialis. Which means that all judgement in His name is now my duty alone."
  - After: {n}Incendia points triumphantly.{/n} "So Theodora bribed the Arbites! Judgement in His name is mine alone."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "It is well within her right to decide the fates of the station's inhabitants, but that does not change the fact that this is a perversion of justice. This is what happens when a judge is driven by morbid fanaticism instead of the Lex."
  - After: "It's her right, but this perverts justice: fanaticism, not the Lex, drives her."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "You have the gall to accuse me of heresy? No, you are the one indulging your hubris by thinking that {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}your former life{/d} outweighs the deeds of your present! Hide behind your dusty tomes all you want — I will show you true justice."
  - After: "Your hubris is thinking {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_Arbitrator}your former life{/d} outweighs your deeds! I'll show you true justice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A quintessential fanatic from your primitive kind. That is why there are so few exhibits of Humanity in my collection: you are all the same. You are all like this 'Chorda,' differing only in the degree of delusion as to your uniqueness. Dull, deplorably dull..."
  - After: "A typical fanatic. That's why I collect so few humans: you're all this 'Chorda'. Deplorably dull..."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "What an... extravagant practice." {n}Research interest flares within Eogunn's dark eyes.{/n} "I venture to hope that the medicae officers of the Chorda dynasty have screened the donor's grey matter for pathogenic substances."
  - After: "How... extravagant." {n}Eogunn looks intrigued.{/n} "I hope the grey matter was screened for pathogens."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Maintaining his phlegmatic composure, Eogunn scribes a note onto his data-slate.{/n} "It is not impossible that my hypothesis concerning the transmission of pathologies through the ingestion of grey matter may prove to be correct. Changes in behavioural patterns are self-evident, indicative of organic degrada—" {n}He instantly switches to Lingua-Technis upon meeting Incendia's steel gaze.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eogunn notes:{/n} "Ingested grey matter may transmit pathology. Her behaviour suggests degrada—" {n}Under Incendia's glare, he switches to Lingua-Technis.{/n}
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "But remember..." {n}Incendia's eyes flash maniacally.{/n} "None of the rebel leaders are allowed to die before their trial. I forbid you to execute them without my leave."
  - After: "But remember..." {n}Her eyes flash.{/n} "No rebel leader dies before trial."
- **Incendia Chorda**
  - Before: "I understand. I, too, had always accepted Reverend Hieronymus's relics with great reverence. However, there is more to the followers of Saint Drusus than Hieronymus Doloroso. Speak to the missionary everyone calls Chaplain. He preaches to the rabble at the Adeptus Amasecus. After Hieronymus's death, he became the new leader of the pious on Footfall and the new keeper of its reliquary."
  - After: "See the missionary called Chaplain at the Adeptus Amasecus. Since Hieronymus died, he leads Footfall's pious and keeps the reliquary."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Footfall/FactionsGoodBye/FactionsGoodBye_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Have you come to wish me good luck, Vladaym?"
  - After: "Here to wish me luck, Vladaym?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Octaviana, the Amasecus is going to have to get by without my tips for a while."
  - After: "Octaviana, no more tips for a while."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is blessing me the only thing you're here to do, Hieronymus?"
  - After: "Only here to bless me, Hieronymus?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Is blessing me the only thing you're here to do, Chaplain?"
  - After: "Only here to bless me, Chaplain?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Ryzza, are you here to discuss business or just to wish me good luck?"
  - After: "Ryzza, business or good luck?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the trembling pirate] "What do you want?"
  - After: [Address the trembling pirate] "What?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Turn to the officer] "What are your orders?"
  - After: [Turn to the officer] "Your orders?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You really ought to give up the smuggling. Or you'll end up like someone we both know."
  - After: "Quit smuggling, or end up like someone we know."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Quit acting like a bartender and start getting used to being a criminal kingpin."
  - After: "Stop bartending. You're a kingpin now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I expect you to maintain order on the station."
  - After: "Keep order on the station."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I must be on my way."
  - After: "I must go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It is time to depart. Farewell."
  - After: "Time to go. Farewell."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not forget about mercy, good shepherd. It is as important as justice."
  - After: "Remember mercy, shepherd, as much as justice."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Wear your scars as a reminder and do not repeat your past mistakes."
  - After: "Let your scars stop you repeating mistakes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Remember Hieronymus's mistakes, Chaplain. And do not repeat them."
  - After: "Don't repeat Hieronymus's mistakes, Chaplain."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If I were you, I would swear off preaching and go back to piracy."
  - After: "Quit preaching; go back to piracy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Glory to the Omnissiah. Try to be worthy of your predecessor."
  - After: "Glory to the Omnissiah. Be worthy of your predecessor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Just know that when I am back, I will cleanse the Expanse of the Archenemy's servants. And you had better not be among them."
  - After: "I'll return to cleanse the Archenemy's servants. Don't be one."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare you show up here and tarnish my good name by talking to me, pirate scum!"
  - After: "How dare you tarnish my name, pirate scum!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do your duty, but do not be needlessly harsh. The Expanse is still inhabited by free people."
  - After: "Do your duty, gently. Free people live here."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Protect the Expanse while I am away."
  - After: "Protect the Expanse while I'm away."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I expect my worlds to be under your special protection."
  - After: "Protect my worlds especially."
- **Player**
  - Before: "When I return, I expect you to have learned to act like the Fellowship of the Void's new leader and not a snivelling wimp."
  - After: "When I return, lead the Fellowship of the Void, not snivel."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your plundering operations should be in overdrive. I will return with valuable trophies."
  - After: "Plunder hard. I'll bring back trophies."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Smile] "No shenanigans while I'm away. Or I'll have you strung up as soon as I'm back."
  - After: [Smile] "No shenanigans, or I'll string you up."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why, Opticon-22 was a paragon of eloquence compared to you, cog."
  - After: "Opticon-22 was eloquent next to you, cog."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Turn away without saying a word]
  - After: [Turn away silently]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Farewell, my comrade. Remember Eufrates II."
  - After: "Farewell, comrade. Remember Eufrates II."
- **Player**
  - Before: "A word of advice: give up smuggling and take care of Footfall instead. Or you will end up on the gallows after all."
  - After: "Quit smuggling, tend Footfall, or you'll hang."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Keep up the good work, but remember, you are running your business under my protection now."
  - After: "Carry on, under my protection now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell all your associates that they work for me now."
  - After: "Tell your associates they work for me."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Turn away without deigning the wretch with a reply]
  - After: [Turn away from the wretch]
- **Player**
  - Before: "Look for rich customers. I plan on returning with a great wealth of trophies that will need buyers."
  - After: "Find rich buyers for my trophies."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}An entire group of people salutes you. Most of them — an escort of honour consisting of members of retinues, associates, secretaries, bodyguards, and assorted others — bow deeply to you and shout their greetings, making a lot of noise. It appears the news of your impending departure has already spread throughout the station.{/n}
  - After: {n}A noisy crowd bows. Word of your departure has spread.{/n}
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "I don't even know... You were {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Min}never particularly interested in our mission{/d}, so you might as well think of me as an old voidsman who's come to pay his respects, not a clergyman. So, from one conqueror of the void to another — good luck."
  - After: "You {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Min}never cared for our mission{/d}. Still, good luck."
- **Opticon-22**
  - Before: "Subject's status assessed as {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Max}Highest-Trusted Ally{/d}. In accordance with the mutual support manual, please confirm your readiness to receive a //fee//donation//contribution// from the Cognisance Fleet. Asset description: standard expeditionary supply set for a Revelation-02 voidship and a personal //gift//tool//blessing//."
  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Max}Highest-Trusted Ally{/d}. Accept //fee//donation//: supplies and a //gift//blessing//."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Leaving us, are you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?" {n}Vladaym Tocara is once again in his clean, decorous Imperial bureaucrat persona, as if the cutthroat who carved himself a bloody {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymLiege}path back to the Liege's throne{/d} never existed.{/n}
  - After: "Leaving, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship?" {n}Tocara plays bureaucrat again, despite his {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_Footfall_VladaymLiege}bloody return{/d}.{/n}
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "My flock tells me Rogue Trader von Valancius is going off on a long expedition. It would be unrighteous to let you go without a blessing for the journey."
  - After: "You leave on a long voyage. Take a blessing."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "The Lord Inquisitor has left us, and now you too? Footfall seems remarkably empty after recent events. All our decent patrons are taking wing."
  - After: "The Inquisitor gone, now you? Footfall empties."
- **Opticon-22**
  - Before: "Communicative interaction option unlocked. Purpose of data exchange: strengthening ties and delivering //a gift//material assets//a donation// to an ally."
  - After: "Purpose: deliver //a gift//a donation// to an ally."
- **Zeta-42//33-Mu**
  - Before: "Salutatory functionality initialised. Glory to House von Valancius. Trading terminal Zeta-42//33-Mu ready to perform the designated function. Glory to the Omnissiah."
  - After: "Glory to House von Valancius. Zeta-42//33-Mu ready. Glory to the Omnissiah."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "We barely got the news that the Lord Inquisitor had left his cosy Footfall perch, and now you're off on a long journey, too." {n}Ryzza grins contentedly.{/n} "Thought I might as well come to see an {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaAlive}old acquaintance{/d}."
  - After: "The Inquisitor's gone, now you." {n}Ryzza grins.{/n} "Came to see an {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaAlive}old acquaintance{/d}."
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: {n}A man with a scraggly beard bows deeply to you, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaDead}shaking with terror and awe{/d}.{/n} "Glory to the Emperor, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! You might not remember me at all..." {n}He seems to really hope that is the case.{/n} "I'm a merchant from the Fellowship of the Void... which has survived on and around Footfall by your good graces..."
  - After: {n}A pirate bows, {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_RyzzaDead}shaking with terror{/d}.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Remember me?" {n}He hopes not.{/n} "Fellowship of the Void... spared by you..."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "There is word among my flock that Rogue Trader von Valancius is going on a perilous voyage. So accept this blessing for the journey, noble {name}."
  - After: "You sail into peril. Accept this blessing, {name}."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "We won't go bankrupt, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Please accept this small gift from me... and my business partners." {n}Octaviana hands you an old, and, no doubt, {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}very expensive, bottle of dark-red amasec{/d}.{/n} "The best medicine against the terrors that lurk in the dark unknown."
  - After: "From me and my partners, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship." {n}A {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}very expensive amasec{/d}.{/n} "For the dark."
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: {n}An officer in Imperial Navy uniform folds his hands in the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "It's an honour, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I'm here on my superiors' orders to pay my respects to House von Valancius."
  - After: {n}A Navy officer salutes.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! My superiors send their respects."
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "To promise something, too. My mission will look after your subjects. {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Max}You've done us a lot of good{/d}, and it would be unrighteous not to repay you in kind. Members of my congregation are already loading supplies to your ship. And I have a personal gift of appreciation for you from the Cult of Saint Drusus. With people like you, this God-Emperor-forsaken corner of the universe still has a chance to become a fine place."
  - After: "And to promise we'll tend your subjects. {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Max}You've done us good{/d}. Supplies are loading; here's a gift from the Cult of Saint Drusus."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. On behalf of my organisation, I would like to express our regret that we have been {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Min}unable to establish a productive business relationship{/d}. But that, I hope, is... a temporary complication, and you will eventually see the potential and promise of what we can offer you."
  - After: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. We regret {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Min}no real partnership formed{/d}. Temporarily, I hope."
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "May Drusus the Warrior grant you good fortune in battle. And good thrust to your engines."
  - After: "Drusus the Warrior bless your battles. And engines."
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "I will remember, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. We'll all remember Reverend Hieronymus and the lessons he taught us. May the God-Emperor have mercy on his soul."
  - After: "I will, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Emperor rest Hieronymus."
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "Sometimes I dream about it myself, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. A boarding party is so much easier to lead than a congregation, so the Emperor be my witness. But Drusus the Warrior has given me a tactical objective, and so I'll pursue it."
  - After: "Tempting, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. But Drusus gave me orders."
- **Opticon-22**
  - Before: "Request approved. Information concerning the joint cleansing of the sacred world catalogued under High-Value Data."
  - After: "Approved. Joint cleansing catalogued as High-Value Data."
- **Opticon-22**
  - Before: "The Omnissiah knows all, comprehends all. The best of functional prosperity to you."
  - After: "The Omnissiah knows all. Prosperity to you."
- **Zeta-42//33-Mu**
  - Before: "Algorithmic setting accepted. Motivational framework 'Protecting the memory of a worthy unit from ignominy' catalogued. Glory to the Omnissiah."
  - After: "Accepted. Motivation 'Honour predecessor' catalogued. Glory to the Omnissiah."
- **Zeta-42//33-Mu**
  - Before: "Recording a blasphemous disparagement of this unit's technological capabilities. Transgression absolved due to the high value of the unit {name} von Valancius. Glory to the Omnissiah."
  - After: "Blasphemy absolved: {name} von Valancius is high-value. Glory to the Omnissiah."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "Ahem... I've lived too long to take such suggestions seriously anymore. Thank you for your concern, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I will bear it in mind."
  - After: "I'm too old for threats. Noted, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "Ah, old Ryzza is going to have to do some serious prowling about before she finds something sizeable enough to satisfy so demanding a customer. But have faith in me. I'll manage."
  - After: "Old Ryzza will prowl for big prizes. I'll manage."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: {n}Ryzza stifles a chuckle.{/n} "Well, I hope you don't forget old Ryzza. You know, pick a softer rope for old time's sake."
  - After: {n}Ryzza chuckles.{/n} "Use a softer rope, for old times."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "Sail smoothly through the warp, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "Smooth warp, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: "I dare not express how flatterfied I am to hear that! I promise Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship I will take every effort to prove worthy of the great trust extendiated to me! Now that I have your support, I will most certainly bring those sons of bitches to heel!"
  - After: "So flatterfied, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I'll bring those sons of bitches to heel!"
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: "I dare not make excuses for my most despicable blunders, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I merely beg your mercy and clemency! We'll set everything right! We'll prove our worth! We won't fail you, I swear!"
  - After: "Mercy, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We'll set it right, I swear!"
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: "The Fellowship of the Void will be glad to oblige a patron of such high standing, influence, and authority! And whoever isn't glad will be obliterated!"
  - After: "Gladly! Whoever isn't glad gets obliterated!"
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: {n}The pirate wipes the sweat from his brow, evidently relieved.{/n}
  - After: {n}The pirate sags, relieved.{/n}
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "Although what you said is at odds with the Imperial Navy's official policy regarding this sector, I promise I will relay this to my superiors."
  - After: "That defies Navy policy. I'll report it."
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "We will not forget our duty, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. These stars will be ours!"
  - After: "We'll do our duty, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. These stars will be ours!"
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "The von Valancius protectorate can rely on the strength of our void armour and the might of our macro-cannons. We will see to it that your subjects are not harassed."
  - After: "Our cannons will guard your subjects."
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "Return victorious from your campaign, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "Return victorious, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Zeta-42//33-Mu**
  - Before: "Information exchange request accepted. The Cognisance Fleet regrets that an {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Min}allied relationship of higher status has not been established{/d} between its mission and House von Valancius. Therefore, the Cognisance Fleet gifts you the following asset: a wish of good fortune. Glory to the Omnissiah."
  - After: "We regret {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Min}no higher alliance formed{/d}. Gift: a wish of fortune. Glory to the Omnissiah."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Why, of course. No business partner of the Kasballica Mission is {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Max}more reliable or more lucrative{/d} than Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Therefore, accept this gift and others that will be delivered to your ship as investments in your success."
  - After: "Of course. None is {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Max}more reliable or lucrative{/d} than Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Accept these gifts."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A multitude of voices answers you with good luck wishes, blessings, parting advice, and words of respect — shouting over each other but alike in their sincerity. For a second, you feel especially clearly that you likely will not see any of these people ever again.{/n}
  - After: {n}A chorus of sincere farewells. You'll likely never see them again.{/n}
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "It's all right. You've been a generous tipper, so we're not doing too badly. And not just we as in the Amasecus... The organisation I represent — you know which one — has also prospered thanks to its deals with you. And my partners would like to contribute their investments to your expedition. The supplies are being loaded into your ship's hold, and this is a {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Max}personal gift{/d} to you from the Kasballica Mission."
  - After: "You tipped well, and the Kasballica Mission prospered. Supplies are loading, and a {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Max}personal gift{/d}."
- **Opticon-22**
  - Before: "Glory to the Emperor, Rogue Trader. The best of functional prosperity to you."
  - After: "Glory to the Emperor, Rogue Trader. Prosperity to you."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "And to {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Max}pledge my help{/d}. Go forth without fear. The Cult of Saint Drusus will watch over your subjects' faith. You are one of the pillars of faith in the Expanse, and thus it would not be appropriate to see you off to the ungodly dark morass between the stars without a gift. Other and lesser offerings will be delivered to your ship, so that you may have no want of anything on your journey."
  - After: "And to {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Max}pledge my help{/d}. We'll guard your subjects' faith. Gifts await on your ship."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "What gift of greater value could I bring you? Our mission may not be among your dynasty's closest confidants, yet {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Mid}your deeds are laudable{/d}. And we will pray for you in your coming endeavour."
  - After: "What greater gift? We're not close, but {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Mid}your deeds are laudable{/d}. We'll pray for you."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Yes, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You're a {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}valuable business partner{/d}, although I'd much like to take our trade relationship to a higher level of trust. When you're back from your expedition with trophies, remember that I can offer the best price."
  - After: "A {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Mid}valuable partner{/d}, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I'll pay best for trophies."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "But my partners and I are still hoping to partake of your riches in the future. Unfortunately, Vladaym did not succeed in {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Min}establishing a robust business relationship{/d} with Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I hope you and I can set this right upon your return."
  - After: "Vladaym {d|Encyclopedia:KasballicaRep_Min}failed to build ties{/d} with Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Let's fix that."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "Business. It's a custom among the Fellowship of the Void never to see a {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Max}friend{/d} off on a long and dangerous expedition without gifts. The supplies are being loaded to your ship as we speak, and this... this is from old Ryzza personally."
  - After: "Business. A {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Max}friend{/d} never leaves without gifts. Supplies are loading; this is from me."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "Just to wish you good luck and let you know that when you're on your way back with your hold full of trophies, not one ship of the Fellowship of the Void is going to try and have a go at you. We {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Mid}respect{/d} Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "Luck. No Fellowship ship will touch you. We {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Mid}respect{/d} Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Ryzza**
  - Before: "To wish you good luck. You've {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Min}avoided{/d} doing business with the Fellowship of the Void, but... perhaps that may change in the future? When you're back and your hold is bursting with trophies, you can find me at the Amasecus. Drinks are on me."
  - After: "Luck. You've {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Min}avoided{/d} us. Return with trophies; drinks at the Amasecus."
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: "The Fellowship of the Void is elationed to have the great and illustratious Rogue Trader's protection. It has tasked me with bringing you these modest gifts that will be of use to you on your expedition, besides being a token of our {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Max}special defereverence{/d} toward your person."
  - After: "Elationed by your protection! Gifts of {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Max}special defereverence{/d}."
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: "The Fellowship of the Void has the {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Mid}greatermost respect{/d} for every deal it has ever concluded with Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. We may not be loyalsome allies today, but we are holding on to our hope of becoming them going forwardwise."
  - After: "{d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Mid}Greatermost respect{/d}, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Allies going forwardwise, we hope."
- **Useful Acquaintance**
  - Before: "The Fellowship of the Void is desperately hoping that upon your return, you'll appreciate our {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Min}willingness to cooperate and the prospects{/d} for great mutual benefit that our cooperation opens up."
  - After: "We hope you'll value our {d|Encyclopedia:PiratesRep_Min}willingness to cooperate and the prospects{/d}."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "And to wish that on your journey through the darkness, the Emperor grants you revelations and {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Min}opens your heart to our teaching{/d}. If that happens, come to me, and perhaps you might decide to make our cult part of your circle of close friends."
  - After: "And to pray the Emperor {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Min}opens your heart to our teaching{/d}. Then come to me."
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, before you leave Footfall, I would like to present you with an official {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Max}statement of gratitude{/d} from my organisation. The Imperial Navy values House von Valancius as loyal comrades-in-arms — allow us therefore to reiterate our grateful appreciation! Please do us the honour of accepting a modest quantity of supplies to support your courageous expedition."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, the Navy's {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Max}statement of gratitude{/d}, and supplies."
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "My command has tasked me with letting you know they strongly value our allyship with House von Valancius. Although at this time, we have not managed to build a powerful alliance, they believe that we will be able to {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Mid}strengthen our treaties{/d} and bring the light of the Imperium to the Expanse going forward. Someday."
  - After: "My command hopes to {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Mid}strengthen our treaties{/d}. Someday."
- **Chartist Captain Austerius Thorfast**
  - Before: "My command regrets that we {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Min}never succeeded in establishing a strong relationship{/d} with your protectorate. But we hope to fix that going forward."
  - After: "We regret {d|Encyclopedia:FleetRep_Min}never building strong ties{/d}. We hope to fix that."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Thank you for the warning, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "Thanks for the warning, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Have no doubt in my memory, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. House von Valancius can always count on a worthy percentage of my organisation's income as thanks for your generous patronage."
  - After: "Never, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You get a worthy cut."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "You've always known how to make a person root wholeheartedly for your cause, Lord Captain. Rest assured, my organisation will find the rarest and most special items to offer for your trading consideration."
  - After: "You win people over, Lord Captain. We'll find the rarest goods."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "All the best of luck to Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. And be vigilant."
  - After: "Good luck, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Be vigilant."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "Thank you for the warning, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. After Vladaym's trial, I don't exactly find him an inspiring example. The more time passes, the more I appreciate the opportunity to be a simple bartender."
  - After: "Noted, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I prefer bartending."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "I value your faith in my humble person. I hope running a criminal organisation is no more complicated than running a bar."
  - After: "Thanks. Hopefully crime's no harder than a bar."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "We've learned our lessons from recent events. And as for those who haven't learned theirs, I'll see to it that you can personally string up those slow-witted fools once you're back."
  - After: "We've learned. Those who haven't, you can hang."
- **Chaplain**
  - Before: "And to promise that the mission will pray for you. Although you chose not to place the Cult of Saint Drusus among your closest confidants, you have made {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Mid}generous donations{/d} to our cause, and we will remember your name in our liturgies."
  - After: "And to pray. For your {d|Encyclopedia:DrusiansRep_Mid}generous donations{/d}, we'll name you in liturgy."
- **Octaviana**
  - Before: "I hope to hear a thrilling story or two when you're back. I'll save a bottle of something special for the occasion."
  - After: "Bring back a story. I'll save a special bottle."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "Keep the faith, young von Valancius. The Expanse needs your faith."
  - After: "Keep the faith, young von Valancius."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "I hope mercy will be a healing potion and not a cup of poison served to my flock. But I have heard your words and committed them to my memory."
  - After: "May mercy heal, not poison. I'll remember."
- **Hieronymus Doloroso**
  - Before: "These scars are trifles. I bear much more terrible marks upon my heart. They are my faith."
  - After: "Trifles. My heart bears worse: my faith."
- **Opticon-22**
  - Before: "This unit //regrets//is disappointed at//is indignant at// the fact that {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Min}links of sufficiently high priority have not been established{/d} between House von Valancius and the Cognisance Fleet. While unable to place any research assets at the disposal of House von Valancius, this unit //hopes//prays//is counting on the reliability of the prediction// that your expedition will be successful."
  - After: "This unit //regrets//is indignant//: {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Min}no high-priority links formed{/d}. It //hopes//prays// you succeed."
- **Zeta-42//33-Mu**
  - Before: "Information exchange request accepted. This unit is grateful to House von Valancius for its {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Max}long history of cooperation with the Cognisance Fleet{/d}. As a bonus reward, a standard quantity of expeditionary supplies and a personal offering will be transferred into the ownership of House von Valancius. Glory to the Omnissiah."
  - After: "For your {d|Encyclopedia:AdMechRep_Max}long cooperation with the Cognisance Fleet{/d}: supplies and an offering. Glory to the Omnissiah."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Footfall/Hieronimus/Hieronimus_Footfall

- **Player**
  - Before: "I see frightened people trying to save their lives."
  - After: "I see frightened people saving their lives."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I see a pathetic old man who revels in the suffering of others."
  - After: "I see a pathetic old man reveling in suffering."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I agree that it's long past time to burn this den of snakes."
  - After: "It's past time to burn this den of snakes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The law of the Imperium is harsh, but not every transgression is punishable by death. Incendia thinks herself above the law, and that is heresy."
  - After: "Not every crime merits death. Incendia putting herself above the law is heresy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Arguing with you is pointless. What will be will be."
  - After: "Arguing is pointless. What will be will be."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you support Incendia's reign of terror?"
  - After: "Do you support Incendia's terror?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You created this monster. Now it is your duty to stop Incendia."
  - After: "You created this monster. Now stop Incendia."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Cast away your doubt, Reverend. Incendia's justice is righteous and fair."
  - After: "Cast off doubt, Reverend. Incendia's justice is righteous."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you preaching here, among rebels?"
  - After: "Why preach among rebels?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you not appealing to Incendia's mercy?"
  - After: "Why not appeal to Incendia's mercy?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You preach repentance, but Incendia gives no one a chance to repent."
  - After: "You preach repentance, but Incendia allows none."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Most curious. Let us return to other matters."
  - After: "Curious. Back to other matters."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Rotten souls cling together, do they not, Reverend?"
  - After: "Rotten souls cling together, Reverend?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not interested in your moralising."
  - After: "Spare me your moralising."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Point to Chaplain] "You are harbouring a pirate among your brethren?"
  - After: [Point to Chaplain] "You harbour a pirate among your brethren?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Reverend, I want to stop Incendia. Help me."
  - After: "Reverend, help me stop Incendia."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Saint Drusus's is a doctrine of redemption, but Incendia has forgotten about that. What else may she have forgotten?"
  - After: "Drusus taught redemption; Incendia forgot. What else has she forgotten?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have said it yourself: no one is pure, including yourself and your brethren. Her justice will not pass you by — you will perish too."
  - After: "You said no one is pure, you included. Her justice will take you too."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Reverend, you carry the seed of vice within you. Repent before it sprouts."
  - After: "Reverend, vice is seeded in you. Repent before it sprouts."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will not bother you with unwanted advice."
  - After: "I won't offer unwanted advice."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You do not believe in Incendia. Or in the Emperor. Your faith is a mere smokescreen for your fear of death, Hieronymus."
  - After: "You believe in neither Incendia nor the Emperor. Your faith masks your fear of death."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Because you know that I speak the truth. And Incendia will see right through you as well, Reverend. And you know better than to hope she will be merciful."
  - After: "Because I'm right. Incendia will see through you, and won't be merciful."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Then why did my words cause your face to contort in fear and not righteous anger?"
  - After: "Then why did my words bring fear to your face, not anger?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will show you the way, Reverend. The Emperor will not protect you from death. But there are forces that can grant you freedom from fear. Pray to them. Beseech them."
  - After: "The Emperor won't save you from death, but other forces can free you from fear. Pray to them."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will find your own path, one that is devoid of fear of death, and then you will show it to others. Suffer, and ye shall discover."
  - After: "Find a path free of death's fear and show others. Suffer, and ye shall discover."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Because her actions fly in the face of all that you believe in. That you truly believe in. Incendia's world has no place for redemption, or mercy, or penitence. Would the sight of such a world please your eyes?"
  - After: "She defies all you believe: no redemption, mercy or penitence. Would that please you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you are so sure of your own righteousness, why have you not faced Chorda's justice yet?"
  - After: "If you're so righteous, why haven't you faced Chorda's justice?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Now look me in the eye, Reverend, and tell me you are ready to meet your death right here and now, without a shadow of fear or regret."
  - After: "Look me in the eye and say you'd die now without fear."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Stop denying it, Hieronymus. Admit, once and for all, that your faith is not as strong as you thought it was, and that the Emperor will not protect you from the murderous zealot's fire."
  - After: "Admit your faith is weak, Hieronymus, and the Emperor won't shield you from her fire."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are going to die, and there is nothing you can do about it. Not a moment goes by without the horror of it consuming you from the inside. Admit it."
  - After: "You'll die, and the horror consumes you. Admit it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If this place is so full of vice, why do you not cleanse it yourself?"
  - After: "If this place is so vile, why not cleanse it yourself?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You give penitents a chance for redemption. That is commendable."
  - After: "Giving penitents a chance at redemption is commendable."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your cult is dangerous, welcoming criminals with open arms."
  - After: "Your cult is dangerous, welcoming criminals."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You aid and abet a vicious criminal. You will pay a harsh price for that, do not doubt it."
  - After: "You abet a vicious criminal. You'll pay harshly for it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The priest staggers back, stunned. He opens his mouth... and a tiny, barely visible fly passes between his gapped teeth and disappears in his throat. The preacher does not even notice.{/n} "What is all this heretical talk? I— I do believe! Why would I be afraid of death?"
  - After: {n}He staggers. A fly slips into his mouth unnoticed.{/n} "Heresy! I believe! Why fear death?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Emperor protects, young von Valancius. What has brought you here? Perhaps you would like to confess? Repentance is the first step on the path to redemption!"
  - After: "The Emperor protects, von Valancius. Come to confess?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Looking into your eyes, the preacher opens his mouth several times to say something, but never musters the courage. He frowns, and his lips twitch.{/n} "I— I cannot utter that, for it would be untrue."
  - After: {n}His lips twitch.{/n} "I cannot. It would be untrue."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Although I will not lie, I am finding it hard to look upon this cleansing fire, for its blaze is terrifying. I was Incendia's shepherd for many years, but now she leads and I follow. I would not have had the strength to lead Footfall down so terrible a path toward justice, for my heart is weak, and I am sometimes given to unrighteous doubt."
  - After: "Yet this fire terrifies me. I was Incendia's shepherd; now I follow. I am weak and doubt."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You have both banished some of my doubts and given me food for others. I will do what must be done. My faithful will assist you in battle. And afterward... I will find a new path."
  - After: "I'll do what I must. My faithful will fight with you. Then... a new path."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am glad that I can lean on your words. I will fortify my soul and cast away my fear. Thank you for not letting me stumble and banishing my doubts, noble {name}."
  - After: "Your words steady me. Thank you, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Expanse is aflame, besieged by the Archenemy's hosts and the cursed xenos. Anyone with a worm burrowed in their soul is a traitor in the making. At a different time, one could deem Incendia's justice to be too harsh, but not now."
  - After: "The Expanse burns. Any wormy soul is a future traitor. These times need her harshness."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I do indeed! A great cleansing is underway, and all those unfortunates have brought their suffering upon themselves! All of the vices that lurked like serpents in Footfall's belly have slithered out into the light, only to be met with the righteous fire of retribution. Or, do you believe that you or I could be better judges of who deserves to be punished for their deeds and who does not?"
  - After: "I do! Footfall's vices met righteous fire. Could we judge better?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus grimaces bitterly.{/n} "You are right. No one escapes retribution for their past deeds, as much as we might believe we were doing them for a good cause. I thought I was raising a paragon of righteousness, forgetting that my soul was more tarnished than many. And I have raised a monster, not a champion of faith. Now those who truly needed me are paying the price for my simple-minded pride."
  - After: {n}He grimaces.{/n} "True. I forgot my own tarnished soul and raised a monster, not a paragon. Others pay for my pride."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus laughs a dry croaking laugh.{/n} "Are you suggesting that I commit a new crime to undo an old one? That I stand shoulder to shoulder with the godless, the heretics, and the xenos, thus betraying a true-believing servant of the Emperor? I would rather let the righteous fire take me into its cleansing embrace!"
  - After: {n}He croaks a laugh.{/n} "Side with heretics and xenos against her? I'd rather burn!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Chaplain is a deeply devout servant of the Emperor. Few are as intimately familiar with human vice as him, and that is what fills his words with sincerity. His flock heeds and respects him. And as for all the hardened rascals and cutthroats who are part of that flock — why not? Our doctrine shuns no one, so long as they are willing to receive its word with an open heart."
  - After: "Chaplain is devout; his past makes him sincere. Our doctrine shuns no open heart, cutthroat or not."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}After a long silence, Hieronymus says,{/n} "I have thought about it. I have seen Incendia convict people for trivial past infractions. There are many outcasts among Saint Drusus's faithful whose old misdeeds she may deem unforgivable. I... cannot allow this."
  - After: {n}A long silence.{/n} "She convicts people for trivial old sins. My outcast faithful could be next. I cannot allow this."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I hope that the suffering we inflicted upon ourselves as penitents has cleansed our souls enough for us to face righteous justice. But if the blessed Incendia gleans corruption inside my soul and judges that only fire can eradicate it — then so be it!"
  - After: "I hope our penance cleansed us. If not, let her burn me!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What else would you like to know?"
  - After: "What else?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We would never refuse our help to one who makes generous donations to our mission."
  - After: "We never refuse a generous donor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is not rebels that I see. I see fools and malefactors whose weakness made them reject the law of the Imperium. Who are in need of repentance and instruction. Had I come here earlier, perhaps I would have been able to prevent this heretical insurrection. And what do you see, Rogue Trader?"
  - After: "Not rebels: weak fools needing repentance. I came too late to stop this. What do you see?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "On the contrary. Better to repent a moment away from death than to have lived a life of iniquity, and die corrupt, without once seeing your deeds for what they are."
  - After: "Better to repent at death's door than die blind."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Are you openly declaring your intent to move against an enactor of the Emperor's justice? And why should I, her mentor in the faith, help you commit that act of treachery?"
  - After: "Move against the Emperor's justice? Why would I, her mentor, help?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus bares his yellowed teeth in an acerbic grin.{/n} "Indeed! I would rather call the worst of all scoundrels my brother if he repents of his crimes, than someone convinced of their own soul's purity."
  - After: {n}A yellow grin.{/n} "Indeed! A repentant scoundrel over the self-righteous."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I take no credit for that. They choose that path for themselves. I merely point out that the path is open to all, and instruct those who have started their journey to redemption. For thus Saint Drusus taught us."
  - After: "They choose it. I only guide them, as Saint Drusus taught."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Saint Drusus taught that everyone deserves a chance at redemption if they sincerely wish to return to the fold of true faith. It is a thorny and painful path, which is why it is beneficial to the soul. All my brothers and sisters follow it, and thus serve the Emperor faithfully. Who are you to judge them?"
  - After: "Drusus taught redemption for all who seek it. Who are you to judge?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus hesitates. The colour has drained from his face, and he no longer has the look of a firebrand. The man in front of you is old, shrivelled, and frightened.{/n} "I want to argue with you, to denounce your lies, but... it is true. Incendia does scare me. As does death. But how do I not fear it?" {n}The reverend seems transfixed as he looks at you, ready to hang on your every word.{/n}
  - After: {n}He pales.{/n} "It's true. Incendia and death scare me. How do I stop fearing?" {n}He hangs on your words.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Now you have banished my doubt. I will do what must be done. Saint Drusus's faithful will aid you in battle."
  - After: "My doubt is gone. Drusus's faithful will fight beside you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are entirely right! But it is not their lives that they should be saving: it is their souls that are truly in peril."
  - After: "Yes! But their souls, not lives, are in peril."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am glad you have realised this! Justice will be done. All you can do is to accept it."
  - After: "Good! Accept justice."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You... are right. All our lives belong to the Emperor, and no one has the right to needlessly take them away from Him. People who, in this dark hour, could have atoned in battle against the enemies of Humanity, are instead perishing senselessly, robbed of their privilege to serve the Emperor. Incendia thinks herself above Him, and that is an egregious crime."
  - After: "You're right. Lives belong to the Emperor. They could atone in battle but die senselessly. Incendia puts herself above Him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Indeed, her fervour frightens me. Sometimes I feel she takes pleasure in doling out punishment and revels in her own power. She has forgotten that punishments exist to purify His servants and return them to His light, so that they may continue this service. Senseless slaughter is at odds with that goal. I regret never managing to drive that point home to her..."
  - After: "She enjoys punishing. Punishment should purify, not slaughter. I never made her see it..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Redemption is but one aspect of our teaching. You forget about Drusus the warrior, who teaches us to be ruthless toward the enemies of Humanity — those who can only be redeemed in death. Incendia was always inspired by his relentlessness in confronting corruption, and nurtured the same quality in herself."
  - After: "Drusus the warrior is ruthless to those redeemable only in death. Incendia took that to heart."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Enough! The pains you are taking to tempt me into betrayal are merely strengthening my faith. Incendia's justice is righteous, and retribution awaits the heretics who reject it. Now you have banished my doubt. Is that not wonderful?"
