  - After: "Enough! Your temptation strengthens my faith. Incendia is righteous. Wonderful, isn't it?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thank you for your tact, young von Valancius."
  - After: "Thank you for your tact."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am afraid, young von Valancius. I am afraid that I am wrong. And my words will lead a champion of faith astray."
  - After: "I'm afraid I'm wrong, and would mislead a champion of faith."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Sooner or later, we all will. We can only pray to Him that we will be able to pay the price when our time comes."
  - After: "We all will. Pray we can pay."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "They must. And so must you, and I! Or do you imagine your soul is pure? It is not. You, me, all of them, we are all reprobates, and only repentance can save our souls from heresy."
  - After: "They must. So must we! We're all reprobates; only repentance saves."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The priest shudders and mumbles, more to himself than to you,{/n} "Blasphemy. Heresy. And yet... do I have a choice? Is an unrighteous life the only thing that can save me from an unrighteous death? I am a vessel of depravity. And if so, what is even the point of redemption?"
  - After: {n}He shudders.{/n} "Blasphemy. Yet is sin my only escape from death? Then why redemption?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Hieronymus's eyes are filled with bitter sadness.{/n} "No. It would not. My way of serving Him has always been different from the paths trodden by the Ecclesiarchy. Saint Drusus's doctrine taught me virtues that are unknown to many among the righteous, and I, in turn, taught them to my brothers and sisters. I tried to teach them to Incendia, too, but... she chose a different path. It is time for me to remind her of those lessons."
  - After: {n}He looks sad.{/n} "No. Drusus taught me rare virtues, and I taught my brethren. Incendia rejected them. Time to remind her."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What could a lost soul like you know about her justice? Incendia truly has an eye that no vice can escape, nor can anyone hide from her avenging hand! I will face her justice and accept my lot if she so wills."
  - After: "What do you know of her justice? No vice escapes her! I'll accept my lot."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Because your invective caught me off guard. Did you really ask me to join a rebellion, then at once turn around and accuse me of heresy and treason? You say I am afraid of death — why, you positively crave it!"
  - After: "You urge rebellion, then accuse me of treason? You crave death!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Never once have I called myself a righteous man. My soul is burdened with many past deeds that prevent me from doing that." {n}The preacher thinks long and hard. He frowns, and his lips twitch.{/n} "Perhaps that is the reason I am biding my time before facing Incendia? Perhaps you... are right?"
  - After: "I never called myself righteous." {n}He frowns.{/n} "Is that why I avoid Incendia? Are you right?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My body is indeed worn and pathetic. But do you really think I am devoid of compassion? I grieve for each fallen soul and am more invested than anyone in their repentance! Bitter sorrow, not triumph, grips my heart in this place."
  - After: "My body is pathetic. But I grieve each fallen soul. Sorrow grips me here."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Or would it have been better for Footfall to still be ruled by Vladaym? The Liege tainted his name long ago by mingling with enemies of Humanity and dabbling in their creations. Now he has but deepened the corruption in his soul. Wilfully bringing xenos into the Emperor's domain to assist an insurgency against His servants? Heresy!"
  - After: "Should Vladaym rule instead? He brought xenos to aid a revolt against His servants. Heresy!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Because I believe that at least some of these lost souls can still be saved and returned to His light! I would separate the wheat from the chaff, not put the whole sheaf to the fire. But I will not lie — even I am given to doubt when I look at the heresy that reigns supreme in this place."
  - After: "Some can still be saved! Sort wheat from chaff. Yet even I doubt."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As you look into Hieronymus's eyes, it is clear to you that he, not you, is the one who ought to confess and repent. Hidden behind layers of piety and fervour is some secret the reverend has been carrying within him for years. A secret that is now gnawing away at him more strongly than ever before.{/n}
  - After: {n}Hieronymus, not you, needs to confess. An old secret gnaws at him.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The preacher does not argue. He knows your words to be true. Hieronymus sighs heavily and is silent for a while. Then he replies, in a hollow voice,{/n} "All my life, I have been a confessor to lost souls. Now let me make my own confession to you. I seek no forgiveness or understanding; I only want to tell the truth. The blood of House Chorda is on my hands. I chanced upon a secret world where Aspyce Bastaal-Chorda had imprisoned her heirs in cryo-vaults, to stop them from challenging her authority. Incendia was among them."
  - After: {n}He sighs, hollow.{/n} "Hear my confession. House Chorda's blood is on my hands. I found the world where Aspyce Bastaal-Chorda froze her heirs in cryo-vaults to keep power. Incendia was among them."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Footfall/Inquisitor

  - After: "We differ, but I'll miss your fervour."

  - After: "Shame your arrogant kind didn't die off entirely."

I supplemented it with a formal request to return to the Lord Inquisitor's side, which he immediately approved. But don't worry. The unsleeping eye of the Inquisition will continue to watch your every step."
  - After: {n}Heinrix coughs.{/n} "I reported on you to Lord Calcazar and rejoined him. The Inquisition still watches you."

- **Argenta**

  - After: "Without hesitation. You refused redemption. I will purge corruption."

  - After: {n}Argenta grips her weapon.{/n} "Burn in the abyss, {name}."

  - After: {n}Argenta looks away grimly.{/n}

  - After: "Prejudice? That's my faith. I warned you, {name}."

- **Heinrix**

  - After: "Try harder. Heretics said worse, dying."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "'Still' being the operative word, {name}. Don't overestimate your usefulness."
  - After: "'Still', {name}. Don't overestimate yourself."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Mostly the blood of heretics, xenos, and traitors, {name}. The Inquisition's methods aren't always decorous and often require great sacrifices. But I am loyal to the Imperium. Keeping it safe at any cost is my highest priority. And that includes keeping it safe from the likes of you."
  - After: "Heretics' and traitors' blood, {name}. I keep the Imperium safe, even from you."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Save your regret for the fate that awaits you, mon-keigh."
  - After: "Save your regret for your fate, mon-keigh."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}There is no spite in the look Yrliet gives you in response — only coldness and detachment. She no longer deigns to answer you, for talking to a mon-keigh is a pointless waste of an Asuryani's time.{/n}

  - Before: "My Path of the Outcast has taught me to trust no one, mon-keigh. And you have reinforced my belief that trying to find common ground with your species was an exercise in futility."
  - After: "The Outcast's Path taught me to trust no one. You proved it."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar, who has been observing the unfolding scene in silence, takes a slow sip from his cup.{/n} "Well then. I hope a diminished retinue will be no obstacle to doing your duty, {name}. Dismissed."
  - After: {n}Calcazar sips.{/n} "Fewer companions won't excuse failure, {name}. Dismissed."

- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "His Lordship has long displayed a susceptibility to... corrupting ideas. His loss of interest in managing his protectorate and his appetite for violence drew my notice some time ago." {n}After a moment's hesitation, Calcazar adds,{/n} "The only question that remains unanswered is how many agents of the Archenemy have infiltrated his entourage."
  - After: "He long leaned toward corruption." {n}He adds,{/n} "How many Archenemy agents are in his circle?"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Sounds suspicious. This is not how we Wolves conduct ourselves..."
  - After: "Suspicious. Not the Wolves' way..."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The corners of Calcazar's mouth creep upward. In a befittingly grave tone, he replies,{/n} "I would be loath to trouble our Master with a prayer for such an indulgence, especially one so utterly inappropriate at this fraught time."
  - After: {n}Calcazar half-smiles.{/n} "Not a prayer for these times."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I value your directness — it will save us much time. Yes, there is something you must do — it is time for you to play your part to save the Koronus Expanse. I would not disturb your esteemed personage for anything less."
  - After: "Good, directness saves time. You must help save the Koronus Expanse."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I offer my apologies. I have been slightly preoccupied, attempting as I am to deal with a dozen uprisings and two dozen xeno-incursions, while also trying to convince the powers that be in the Expanse to unlock their jaws from around each other's throats long enough to listen to reason. Being familiar with your extravagant mode of communication, I thought it best to delay our meeting until a time when keeping my hands off a weapon would not be so great a trial."
  - After: "Apologies. Uprisings, xeno-incursions, feuding powers. Knowing you, I waited until I could resist reaching for a weapon."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar's voice turns as dry as the reports on the table, and as sharp as the symbol of the Inquisition stamped upon them.{/n} "I would not wish you to make any assumptions, for you would be quite mistaken. I am but a servant of the Emperor — governing is beyond my purview."
  - After: {n}Dry, sharp:{/n} "Don't assume. I serve the Emperor; I don't govern."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I appreciate your willingness to dispense with ceremony and get right to the point."
  - After: "Thank you for skipping ceremony."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor raises an eyebrow, impressed.{/n} "You escaped from the Dark City? A feat that few have accomplished. Truly, I congratulate you on an exceptional performance, and I won't even mar your triumph by telling you that the Inquisition will, of course, be watching you very closely henceforth. I sincerely hope that your grand escape was not part of the xenos' devious machinations."
  - After: {n}An eyebrow rises.{/n} "You escaped the Dark City? Congratulations. The Inquisition will watch you, in case it's xenos scheming."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Earlier than I planned, but that is all to the good. On behalf of the Inquisition, I hereby inform you that your action will not be considered an attack on the privileges of a Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Early, but good. The Inquisition won't call it an attack on your privileges."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "How curious. When all this is over, I will certainly call you as a witness at Calligos's trial. Together we will decide how best to handle him while ensuring the safety of the Expanse."
  - After: "Curious. You'll testify at Calligos's trial."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I am delighted to hear it. Since the two of you are now bound by allegiance, when all this is over, I will call upon you to carry out House Winterscale's punishment for its disobedience. I hope Calligos will be gratified to see a familiar face in his executioner."
  - After: "Delightful. As his ally, you'll later execute House Winterscale's punishment."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "The Cult of the Final Dawn and Drukhari raiders are vying with each other to see who can cause us the greatest turmoil. I have mobilised all the forces I can to repel the attacks, which is why we are still alive. Combined militia brigades are hunting for xenos and guarding convoys, and expeditionary platoons under my command are crushing heretic rebellions. The situation is unstable, but... I will not pretend that I was prepared for this crisis. However, we have not lost our footing yet."
  - After: "The Cult of the Final Dawn and Drukhari raiders ravage us. I've mobilised militia and platoons to hold. We stand, barely."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Froscher, if you please." {n}The Inquisitor nods imperiously at the servant, who draws some kind of remote control from his pocket. All sounds whose sources are more than three metres away fade to nothing.{/n}
  - After: "Froscher, if you please." {n}A field silences all beyond three metres.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "You have misconstrued me. It is I who intend to help you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am displeased with you. You inherited a certain reputation from Theodora, and you have thoroughly tarnished that reputation. Under these difficult circumstances, a person in my position might decide that you ought to be killed before your actions become truly {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}deleterious{/d}."
  - After: "I'm helping you. You've tarnished Theodora's reputation. Some would kill you before you grow {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}deleterious{/d}, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "To my chagrin, the ability to be in two places at once does not number among my talents. That is why I wish for you to serve in my stead. I place such trust in very few people, you understand. You will feel what it is to walk in my shoes and attempt to compel a gaggle of quarrelsome blockheads to work together."
  - After: "I can't be everywhere. Serve in my stead, and herd quarrelsome blockheads."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor sighs heavily.{/n} "What can I say? Few among the Emperor's servants are without guilt. Forcing heartfelt repentance out of any of them is more than even I can do. As for you, I have already told you the price of my lenience. Eufrates II."
  - After: {n}He sighs.{/n} "Few are guiltless. My price stands: Eufrates II."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "You will reconquer Eufrates II for me." {n}The Inquisitor gestures to the servant and the silencing field disperses.{/n} "Froscher, another recaf — this one has gone cold."
  - After: "Reconquer Eufrates II for me." {n}The field drops.{/n} "Froscher, fresh recaf."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Prisoner interrogations indicate that an incident occurred in the Dark City, what the xenos call a {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_DaemonicBreach}dysjunction{/d}. A dimensional calamity that forced them to step up their raids in realspace. Their audacity speaks to their desperation, which in turn will translate into new trials for His servants."
  - After: "Prisoners speak of a Dark City {d|Encyclopedia:Ch3_DaemonicBreach}dysjunction{/d} driving their raids. Desperate xenos mean new trials."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "The warp is raging. This baleful sign always portends change, and crises beget desperation — the most fertile ground for heresy. I believe the Archenemy's servants think their time has come. Or perhaps this day was marked in their profane scripture as the date of the end of existence. I will not trouble myself with further attempts to make sense of their blasphemous doctrine. They are bent on destroying us all, and so they must be destroyed."
  - After: "The raging warp breeds heresy. The Archenemy thinks its time has come. They must be destroyed."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Prisoner interrogations indicate that a relatively major political upheaval has taken place in Commorragh. The Kabal of the Reaving Tempest has lost its grip on authority and become a target for enemies and rivals. Many vassals and members of the Kabal decided that fleeing to realspace was preferable to waiting in Commorragh to be killed."
  - After: "The Kabal of the Reaving Tempest fell in Commorragh. Its vassals fled to realspace."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Are you not standing before me now? While your... status remained unclear, I preferred not to requisition the resources of the von Valancius protectorate. Your people dealt with Uralon the Cruel's agents and with xenos raids, and that was enough for me. But now is the time to add your might and talents to the scales."
  - After: "While your status was unclear, I spared your protectorate. Now add your might."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The glance tossed at you is like a shot from an autopistol at point-blank range.{/n} "If such a plan were to exist, information about it would be of the utmost secrecy. I suggest you focus on the current strategy of putting out each fire as you encounter it."
  - After: {n}A sharp glance.{/n} "Any such plan is secret. Put out fires."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I see no need to get bogged down in the details. To apprise you of all the information I currently possess would require... more time than we have."
  - After: "No time for every detail."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Naturally. Her Ladyship has done me an invaluable service by taking on the task of instilling order on the station. Though her style of leadership seems unnecessarily brutal to me, on the whole her actions have not exceeded the bounds I set."
  - After: "Naturally. Her Ladyship imposed order. Brutally, but within my bounds."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Clearly, the stakes for them are high enough. Uralon the Cruel has stirred his profane self to make a personal appearance on Eufrates II. Kunrad Voigtvir, incidentally, is also there — I hear you two have unfinished business. Him I will generously leave to you. When you are finished with him, you may simply dispose of his mortal remains — no need to surrender them to the Inquisition for an inquest. Consider it my gift."
  - After: "Uralon the Cruel himself is there. So is Kunrad Voigtvir; he's yours, no inquest needed. My gift."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Firstly, I entrusted the task to Her Ladyship, and she is executing it competently. And secondly... {name}, are you unaware of what I am striving to do here? At present, I am trying to prevent the deaths of billions, yet you ask me why I am choosing not to save hundreds."
  - After: "She's competent. And, {name}, I'm saving billions. Why would I save hundreds?"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar bows respectfully.{/n} "Glory to the Emperor's Angels of Fenris. Your words will be heeded, my lord."
  - After: {n}Calcazar bows.{/n} "Glory to the Angels of Fenris, my lord."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Yet I am surprised that this xenos is still alive. What is it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}? Sentimentality? Revenge? Cold calculation?" {n}Calcazar gives Yrliet a long, significant look.{/n} "If you do not finish her off yourself, send word when you have tired of her. My acolytes will be only too eager to learn her secrets."
  - After: "This xenos lives, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?" {n}He eyes Yrliet.{/n} "When you tire of her, my acolytes want her secrets."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Clenching her jaw to the point of pain, Yrliet hisses Aeldari curses under her breath, but retreats half a step.{/n} "I have looked into the eyes of death... and of creatures far more dangerous than you, mon-keigh. Do not try to frighten me."
  - After: {n}Yrliet curses, stepping back.{/n} "I've faced worse than you, mon-keigh."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "A death cultist and the Rogue Trader's personal bodyguard." {n}The Lord Inquisitor gazes at Kibellah intently.{/n} "I am curious: do you still adhere firmly to your cult's dogma, or has your loyalty to your {mf|master|mistress} outgrown your faith?"
  - After: "A death cultist bodyguard." {n}He eyes Kibellah.{/n} "Dogma, or loyalty to your {mf|master|mistress}?"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "My loyalty to the Domin stems from the Undying One's will. Such is the thread of this blade, until His whisper bids it to spin a different one," {n}Kibellah responds with calm assurance.{/n}
  - After: "The Undying One wills my loyalty to the Domin," {n}Kibellah says calmly.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}Solomorne's face, already difficult to read, now becomes an impenetrable mask.{/n} "Only the Marshal can speak for all the Arbites in the Expanse. But for myself as a Proctor, I swear that I wholly serve the Lex Imperialis."
  - After: {n}Solomorne goes blank.{/n} "As Proctor, I serve the Lex Imperialis."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I heard the Adeptus Arbites had renewed their alliance with the von Valancius dynasty. One would not get far without it in a sector ruled by Rogue Traders, I imagine. However, under such circumstances, and considering all the rights granted by the sacred Warrant, you may struggle to distinguish whether you are indeed serving the Lex or, in fact, a particular person."
  - After: "The Arbites allied with von Valancius again. Careful you serve the Lex, not a person."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Genetor Februs. A most audacious step — to present yourself to me in person after such an unexpected disappearance from the laboratory entrusted to you. I hope you realise that you are only here because I have permitted you to live, owing to the potential utility of your research for the Imperium." {n}The Inquisitor's tone is neutrally polite, but the look he bestows upon Eogunn is chilling.{/n} "Very well, the Rogue Trader's retinue is indeed a haven for those who harbour bold ideas. We only hope that these ideas do not turn into excessive free-thinking."
  - After: "Genetor Februs. Bold, after abandoning your laboratory. You live only for your research." {n}He eyes Eogunn coldly.{/n} "Avoid free-thinking."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn's complexion, far from healthy to begin with, drains of colour entirely, but he speaks firmly.{/n} "I honour the tenets of the Omnissiah and do not stray from His truths."
  - After: {n}Eogunn pales.{/n} "I keep the Omnissiah's truths."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor's jaw hardens.{/n} "Despite the impression I may have created, I am not a schoolmaster obliged to rein in misbehaving Rogue Traders. Calligos rejected the call to fulfil his duty to the Emperor. What discussion was there to be had?"
  - After: {n}His jaw hardens.{/n} "Calligos refused his duty to the Emperor. What was to discuss?"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Lord Inquisitor replies in a soft, arid voice,{/n} "But it is not a request. It is a command. And I am far past the point of humouring your pride and vanity."
  - After: {n}Softly:{/n} "It's a command. I'm done humouring your vanity."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Why can't both be true? Froscher has been a member of my retinue for fifty Terran years and the person in my entourage who comes closest to being my confidant." {n}Something akin to a warm smile touches the Inquisitor's lips.{/n} "We have had cause to be involved in many incidents whose reports have since been marked with a seal of silence."
  - After: "Both. Froscher's served me fifty years, my confidant." {n}He almost smiles.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I am surprised you managed such a feat. However, it is probably for the best — I assumed the two of you would clash, but I expected a more tragic outcome. I admire your zeal for peacekeeping."
  - After: "Surprising. I expected a tragic clash. Admirable peacekeeping."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}The grey-haired servant's eyes burn with vicious indignation, like an executioner's pyre lit by a fanatic.{/n}
  - After: {n}The servant's eyes burn with indignation.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Indeed. You petitioned our aid in fighting xenos. We spilt much alien blood. But the wind of battle carried me far, and I lost contact with my pack. Do you know where I can seek out my brothers, the Baleful Howl?"
  - After: "Yes. We spilt much xenos blood, but I lost my pack, the Baleful Howl. Where are they?"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar nods at the paper that his servant has deferentially delivered to the table.{/n} "This document attests to the extraordinary powers you now have at your disposal. I am counting on your success, {name}."
  - After: {n}He nods at a document.{/n} "It grants you extraordinary powers. Succeed, {name}."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Do you see a better candidate for the job?" {n}The Lord Inquisitor closes his eyes wearily for a moment.{/n} "I may no longer be in the first flush of youth, but believe me when I say that there are many things I would much rather be doing than playing constable to the Koronus Expanse. But, alas, every ruler in our sector chooses to confine their concern to the well-being of their own holdings, whereas I alone must take care of all."
  - After: "See a better candidate?" {n}He looks weary.{/n} "Every ruler minds only their holdings. I alone mind the Expanse."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}The warrior of Fenris folds his arms on his ceramite-plated chest regally, and says in a dour voice,{/n} "Greetings, Inquisitor. You and I need to talk."
  - After: {n}Ulfar folds his arms.{/n} "Inquisitor. We must talk."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "We will both tire before I finish reciting the list of all your transgressions. You are not here to test my knowledge, so let us just agree that you have already more than earned your sentence. Have I expressed myself in terms basic enough for you to understand?"
  - After: "Your transgressions are endless. You've earned your sentence. Clear enough?"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I sent my troops to aid the Explorator forces laying siege to the world, but a... rift occurred among the commanders. They need an authoritative general, and you are perfect for the role. My confidence is not misplaced, I trust?"
  - After: "My troops aid the Explorator siege, but the commanders split. They need a general: you."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Unfortunately, the leaders have failed to find a common language. The esteemed Thorbald is at odds with the conclave of the Mechanicus's battle congregation, and the Omnissiah's servants find Thorbald's strident nature off-putting. And neither group is fond of Militant Sibilek, who commands my forces... Were not fond, to be precise. The esteemed Militant perished along with his ship a week ago when his noble allies failed to support his offensive."
  - After: "Thorbald and the Mechanicus clash, and both shunned Militant Sibilek. He died with his ship last week, unsupported."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "But instead, I am giving you a chance to redeem yourself. To serve me and therefore the Imperium, to demonstrate your extraordinary talents, and to dispel the doubts surrounding you... at least partly. This is a most generous and rare opportunity. Do not squander it."
  - After: "Instead, I offer redemption: serve the Imperium and dispel doubts. Don't squander it."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "You lie. The Baleful Howl never run from battle." {n}Ulfar's reply to the outrageous claim is surprisingly calm. Only the frosty chill of death born of his voice and carried across the room makes everyone's hair stand on end.{/n}
  - After: "You lie. The Baleful Howl never flee." {n}Ulfar's calm voice chills the room.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Contrary to my request to continue hunting the xenos, they embarked on an expedition whose objective is unknown to me. There has been no word of them since."
  - After: "They ignored my orders and left on an unknown expedition. No word since."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "No, but I believe I know someone who is better informed. And I will name that person as soon as we finally start discussing the matter that prompted me to summon Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "No, but I know who might. First, why I summoned Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "By the right, it seems, of the sole person in this sector who still remembers his duty to the Emperor! And on the grounds of your numerous grubby little deeds, of which I have full knowledge!" {n}The Lord Inquisitor's voice snaps out like a weapon bolt. Pressing his lips into a hard line, in a harried and vexed tone, he says,{/n} "I have no time for games, von Valancius."
  - After: "By right of the only one here mindful of duty! Your grubby deeds are known!" {n}He snaps.{/n} "No games, von Valancius."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "If this is some scheme of yours—"
  - After: "If this is your scheme—"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "To whom else could I entrust this mission? No need to feign ignorance, von Valancius — we both know the... shortcomings of the other candidates for this position. At present in the Expanse, there are two people with the perspective and steady hand required to control this situation — and they are both standing in this room. So, if you will, dispense with the humble Rogue Trader act and win this war for me."
  - After: "Who else? Only two people can control this, and both are here. Drop the humble act and win this war."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Lord Inquisitor does not appear aggrieved at the news.{/n} "As I understand, this was a private confrontation between two Rogue Traders, yes? As such, I hope your house will reach a reconciliation with Her Ladyship's heir. You have not hindered my plans — Lady Incendia purged Footfall sufficiently that I was not distracted by the need to pacify it."
  - After: {n}He seems unbothered.{/n} "A private Rogue Trader feud. Reconcile with her heir. Footfall is purged enough."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor dryly interrupts the Allfather's warrior:{/n} "Dare I remind you that your presence in the Expanse is not a favour to me, but the promised repayment of a debt? I kept secret those details that could have damaged your honour. Why, then, does your gratitude taste so poisonous?"
  - After: {n}Calcazar cuts in.{/n} "You're repaying a debt. I returned your lost brother to Fenris and kept your secrets. Why such poisonous gratitude?"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "A sacred world of the Adeptus Mechanicus, off limits to laypeople. I am one of the few who do not worship the Omnissiah to have set foot on its surface... Or rather, I was. Now it is crawling with unbelievers — the despicable Word Bearers attacked and captured Eufrates II, and the Cult of the Final Dawn brought an entire horde of heretics to the planet."
  - After: "A sacred Mechanicus world. Now the Word Bearers hold Eufrates II, and the Cult of the Final Dawn brought a heretic horde."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}The mention of Ulfar's lost brother makes him grind his teeth in anger before he falls sullenly silent.{/n}
  - After: {n}Ulfar grinds his teeth, silent.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I presumed it was to search for Brother Ulfar. It is common knowledge how deeply Space Wolves value the ties of brotherhood... Far more deeply than the ties that bind them to other subjects of the Emperor."
  - After: "Seeking Brother Ulfar, I presume. Wolves value brotherhood above all."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "An utterly transparent attempt to learn secret intelligence. I offer to make you my general, and you try to pump me for information? Poorly done."
  - After: "Pumping me for secrets? Poorly done."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor bows to Ulfar curtly.{/n} "I recommend that you, too, go to Eufrates II, my lord. Perhaps your pack was less reticent with the esteemed Thorbald than with me, and told him where they decided to direct their efforts."
  - After: {n}He bows to Ulfar.{/n} "Go to Eufrates II, my lord. Perhaps your pack told Thorbald their plans."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "It is a fine suggestion, which I accept gratefully, Inquisitor." {n}The expression of respect on Ulfar's face does a poor job of hiding his antipathy.{/n}
  - After: "Gratefully accepted, Inquisitor." {n}Ulfar hides his antipathy poorly.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I can tell you no more. As you well know, your pack preferred not to report their plans and intentions to me." {n}Albeit no match for Ulfar's tongue of ice, the coldness in Calcazar's voice, too, could freeze an entire world.{/n}
  - After: "I know no more. Your pack kept its plans from me." {n}His voice is icy.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Are you confessing your transgressions before the Lord Inquisitor and seeking to repent? That is brave. As I said, all you have to do to redeem yourself is to take Eufrates II.   - After: "Brave. Taking Eufrates II redeems you, but I can also purify you. Kneel, drink." {n}He offers a flask.{/n} "All of it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is nothing special about the taste. It is water, cool and pure. Whatever effect it was supposed to have on you, you do not feel it.{/n}
  - After: {n}Just cool water. You feel nothing.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I am pleased to see that Rogue Traders can indeed work together. This serves as proof that you are a worthy candidate for the mission that I am about to give you."
  - After: "Good. You are worthy of my mission."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor nods.{/n} "Now get ready and repeat after me. He touches your forehead with the tip of its blade.{/n} "God-Emperor, our shepherd and warden, hear my sorrowful cry of remorse and humility."
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "Repeat after me." {n}His dagger touches your forehead.{/n} "God-Emperor, our shepherd and warden, hear my sorrowful cry of remorse and humility."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}As soon as you finish the sentence, the Inquisitor presses down on the blade and carves some symbols into your forehead. You instantly feel agony spread through your body — as though the water you drank has turned into a holy fire that is burning out the roots of corruption in your soul, one by one.{/n}
  - After: {n}He carves symbols into your forehead. Agony, like holy fire burning out corruption.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The dagger draws more symbols on your forehead with strokes of incandescent pain. Your blood is boiling lead. Your nerves are poisoned wires. Your every breath shreds your throat like a hundred razor blades.{/n}
  - After: {n}More symbols. Your blood boils; breathing shreds your throat.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor's flat voice seems to be coming from a different reality:{/n} "Master of Mankind, my life belongs to You, for I am a blazing weapon of faith that will crush the heretic, the xenos, and the mutant who have raised a hand against Your kingdom."
  - After: {n}His voice seems distant:{/n} "Master of Mankind, I am Your blazing weapon against heretic, xenos and mutant."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The final symbols bite into your flesh, and just as you feel your body has reached the limit of what it can take, the pain subsides.   - After: {n}At your limit, the pain ends in warm grace. Your forehead is unscarred.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Rise. The rite of purification is complete. Now go forth and carry His light within you, and let your actions prove your loyalty to the Emperor. Eufrates II awaits you, {name}."
  - After: "Rise, purified. Prove your loyalty. Eufrates II awaits, {name}."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "I warned you, Rogue Trader. You reek of corruption from head to toe. Even an honourable death will not wash away the stench. The Inquisitor is free to absolve you of whatever he likes, but for me, being part of your warband is a disgrace. Farewell." {n}Ulfar spits and stares past you contemptuously.{/n}
  - After: "You reek of corruption. Serving you is a disgrace. Farewell." {n}Ulfar spits.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You have carried Theodora's unholy legacy, {name}, and you have surpassed her a hundredfold in unholiness. How regrettable. Farewell, and pray to the Emperor that you will find redemption before I have to grant you His Peace. For heretics—" {n}Argenta pauses. The fire in her eyes could incinerate you.{/n} "—deserve no quarter."
  - After: "You outdid Theodora's unholiness, {name}. Pray before I grant you His Peace. Heretics—" {n}Her eyes blaze.{/n} "—deserve no quarter."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "This is where we part ways, {name}. I have seen enough, and I no longer wish to be an accomplice to your crimes. Although the Lord Inquisitor was generous enough to look past your transgressions, I have no doubt that we will meet again in circumstances you will find less auspicious than these."
  - After: "We part here, {name}. I will not abet your crimes. We will meet again, less kindly."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Enough words, elantach. You have brushed my warning aside, and now there is no saving your soul from corruption any longer. If I remained at your side, I would risk forever falling into the embrace of She Who Thirsts. Our ways part here. Farewell, and you would be wise not to seek another meeting with me."
  - After: "Your soul is lost, elantach. Staying risks She Who Thirsts. Do not seek me."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "The reasons behind their machinations would be pure speculation at this point. Bring me prisoners to interrogate and perhaps we will gain some much needed insight."
  - After: "Speculation. Bring me prisoners to interrogate."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor's fingers tighten their steely grip on your shoulder.{/n} "On the contrary. You are being reborn. Repeat the prayer, {name}."
  - After: {n}His grip tightens.{/n} "You are being reborn. Repeat the prayer, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}He lets go of your shoulder and removes the dagger from your forehead. The pain is gone at once. Several deep cuts on your brow are the only reminder of the rite.{/n}
  - After: {n}He withdraws the dagger. The pain stops, leaving deep cuts.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Explorator Fleet Divine Cognisance 78-21 recalled its most combat-ready units to retake the world. They were supported by my most powerful strike fleet and a group of... deadlier allies. I dispatched a pack of Space Wolves to hunt down the transgressors."
  - After: "Explorator Fleet Divine Cognisance 78-21, my strike fleet, and a Space Wolf pack to hunt transgressors."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Most wise on your part."
  - After: "Most wise."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I must remind you that I am still Lord Inquisitor of the Koronus Expanse, not merely some — what do you always say, Froscher? — some 'grox-bothering prick.' If certain Rogue Traders at times allow themselves to speak to me in an overly... wilful manner, that should not give you cause to doubt my authority."
  - After: "I am Lord Inquisitor of the Koronus Expanse, not some 'grox-bothering prick.' Do not doubt me."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix nods silently at Calcazar, who responds by ever so slightly bowing his head.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix and Calcazar exchange nods.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar gives your retinue a cursory glance until his gaze rests on Marazhai.{/n} "Incendia has allowed a xenos of the most dangerous variety to roam freely on Footfall. The esteemed Lady Chorda has a frankly surprising amount of respect for the privileges bestowed by your Warrant."
  - After: {n}He eyes Marazhai.{/n} "Incendia lets a dangerous xenos roam Footfall. Lady Chorda respects your Warrant surprisingly."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "I rather think the mon-keigh fears what may befall her should she try to get rid of me." {n}The Drukhari stares baldly at Calcazar with no deference whatsoever. Perhaps he has no inkling of who he is talking to.{/n}
  - After: "She fears what I would do." {n}Marazhai stares at Calcazar boldly.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Rest assured that His Lordship will face the consequences of his actions."
  - After: "His Lordship will face the consequences."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}In response to Calcazar's question, Heinrix's eyes narrow, smouldering with anger.{/n} "Emelina is dead. By my hand."
  - After: {n}Heinrix's eyes smoulder.{/n} "Emelina is dead. By my hand."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Indeed? Well, I hope I can continue to trust you to know when a useful resource is finally exhausted and must be disposed of."
  - After: "Good. You know when a resource must be disposed of."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai tilts his head slightly to the side, eyeing Calcazar appraisingly. However, the Drukhari is in no hurry to speak his thoughts aloud.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai eyes Calcazar silently.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai's mocking gaze rests on you.{/n} "An entirely unpredictable turn of events... Isn't that right, {name}?"
  - After: {n}Marazhai smirks.{/n} "So unpredictable, {name}."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet sighs raggedly. Her voice is scarcely above a whisper:{/n} "And so your quest for revenge has brought forth a new era of suffering for mon-keigh, elantach. Are you satisfied?"
  - After: {n}Yrliet whispers:{/n} "Your revenge brought mon-keigh new suffering, elantach. Satisfied?"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "I would remind you that the particularities of the Inquisition's work lie far beyond a Rogue Trader's purview, but, given the circumstances... Yes, Acolyte Lichtenhart's words are true. It has been several years since I established contact with the Drukhari. They informed me of upcoming raids, and I thwarted them. I kept the Expanse safe while the xenos were absorbed in their internal squabbles, which are of little interest to me."
  - After: "Yes, Acolyte Lichtenhart is right. For years the Drukhari warned me of raids; I thwarted them."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "May the Emperor's mercy ensure that you never have cause to experience the hospitality of the Inquisition. Froscher, see to our guest." {n}Calcazar's voice seems to endow the servant with a phenomenal ability to move instantly through space — a cup of recaf appears in front of you before the sound of the Lord Inquisitor's voice dies away.{/n}
  - After: "Pray you never taste the Inquisition's hospitality. Froscher, see to our guest." {n}Recaf appears instantly.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Intriguing news about the fate of my Kabal. More so than expected."
  - After: "Intriguing news of my Kabal."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira shrinks under Calcazar's gaze and seems to try to sidle behind you, but the Lord Inquisitor does not even deign to address the psyker with a remark.{/n}
  - After: {n}Idira shrinks behind you, ignored.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar notices Argenta and inclines his head with a dignified air.{/n} "Sister."
  - After: {n}Calcazar nods to Argenta.{/n} "Sister."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Heinrix, I have to say I am disappointed by how easily information pertaining to the Expanse's security reaches the ears of those who should not be privy to it. This will be noted in your record. Would you care to put my concerns to rest and tell me that Emelina is not out there running amok around my sector and continuing to sow unrest?"
  - After: "Heinrix, secrets leak too easily. Noted in your record. Is Emelina still sowing unrest?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I regret incurring your disapproval, Lord Inquisitor. I will learn from this mistake. Emelina... no longer poses a threat. I have seen to it."
  - After: "I will learn from this, Lord Inquisitor. Emelina is no longer a threat."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Strictly speaking, one might regard my actions in this situation as unorthodox at the very least. In reality, however, they are undoubtedly beneficial. Acolyte Lichtenhart has demonstrated her inability to surmount the bounds of convention, and had she been in my position, the Expanse would have likely already fallen under the blows of the present crisis. Fortunately for you, she is not, and the Drukhari, drained by their power struggles and bereft of their best raiders, can do nothing more than run from my fleets."
  - After: "Unorthodox but beneficial. Lichtenhart would have lost the Expanse. Now the weakened Drukhari flee my fleets."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I hope it goes without saying that I would appreciate you not spreading dangerous and misleading rumours going forward — and keeping the content of this conversation private. Given the current state of affairs, I would have to treat such actions as subversive, so I thank you in advance for your considerate silence."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, keep this private and spread no rumours, or I will deem it subversion."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Much obliged, Interrogator. In the future, try to refrain from involving third parties in our conclave's internal matters."
  - After: "Much obliged, Interrogator. Keep outsiders out of our affairs."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}The Battle Sister's eyes gleam as the Lord Inquisitor addresses her.{/n} "May your path be blessed! It is gratifying to see that the trials endured by the Expanse have failed to extinguish the flame of your fortitude!"
  - After: {n}Argenta's eyes gleam.{/n} "Blessings! Your fortitude still burns!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal jerks his head up, clearly recognising the name Calcazar just uttered.{/n}
  - After: {n}Pasqal looks up at the name.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}Froscher nods deferentially, and on his aged, jowled face appears an expression caught between eternal loyalty, motherly affection, and religious devotion.{/n}
  - After: {n}Froscher nods, utterly devoted.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard stifles a grunt of displeasure, his mutter pitched for your ears only:{/n} "'You will reconquer Eufrates II for me'... The esteemed Lord Inquisitor has done away with all pretence and politeness now. His orders no longer come with even the veneer of a request..."
  - After: {n}Abelard mutters:{/n} "'For me'... Not even pretending to ask now."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard belatedly raises his hand as if trying to stop you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard belatedly raises a hand.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}A venomous chuckle escapes Marazhai's lips. He is looking between you and Calcazar with great interest.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai chuckles venomously.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Registering a Sanctity Alpha priority mission. The scourge of corrupted misbelievers reigning over blessed workshops fills the Omnissiah's faithful with anguish. Activating autoasceticism protocol: I offer a prayer for the liberation of the sacred world." {n}From beneath Pasqal's crimson robe comes the sound of mechanisms whirring to life, and dark bloodstains streak across the fabric.{/n}
  - After: "Sanctity Alpha priority mission. Autoasceticism protocol: praying for liberation." {n}Blood stains Pasqal's robe.{/n}
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "Lady Navigator Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella." {n}The Lord Inquisitor's lips curve into a thin smile as he catches a glimpse of scarlet eyes.{/n} "I hear that House Orsellio is going through a difficult time: change is coming. I sincerely hope it is for the better."
  - After: "Lady Navigator Cassia Tisiphia Evriaella." {n}He smiles thinly.{/n} "House Orsellio faces change. May it be for the better."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Your colours, Lord Inquisitor, are as rich as they are multifaceted. I have never encountered anything like it before — unclouded hues flowing from one to the next... Amazing harmony. Amazing and... frightening." {n}Cassia raises her chin and nods demurely.{/n} "That a man of such status and talents has taken an interest in the well-being of a Navis Nobilite House is a great honour."
  - After: "Your colours are harmonious... and frightening." {n}Cassia nods.{/n} "Your interest honours a Navis Nobilite House."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae touches the Aquila on her chest and drops her head in an unnecessarily deep bow.{/n} "O Lord Inquisitor, smiting spear of the Imperium, with the gold of faith cutting through the nebulae of the Koronus Exp—"
  - After: {n}Jae bows too deeply.{/n} "O Lord Inquisitor, smiting spear of the Imperium, cutting through the Koronus Exp—"
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: {n}Calcazar raises a hand in warning.{/n} "If I were you, Mistress Heydari, I would endeavour not to draw the Inquisition's attention to my person."
  - After: {n}Calcazar raises a hand.{/n} "Mistress Heydari, avoid the Inquisition's attention."
- **Xavier Calcazar**
  - Before: "A Mercatum Tabula Officiale can do many things. Reattaching a head to a body is not one of them."
  - After: "A Mercatum Tabula Officiale cannot reattach a head."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Footfall/InquisitorCalling/InquisitorCalling_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What makes Calcazar think he can summon me like some lackey?"
  - After: "Calcazar summons me like a lackey?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shall visit the Lord Inquisitor as soon as I can."
  - After: "I'll visit the Lord Inquisitor soon."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Calcazar will have to wait. I have urgent matters to attend to."
  - After: "Calcazar can wait. I'm busy."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}The elderly man in front of you is moving with the noiselessness of an experienced servant. He bows primly and says, in a raspy voice,{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor bade me inform you that it will be his pleasure to see Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship at his palace. There are matters of the utmost urgency that he wishes to discuss, and he hopes you will find the time to meet with him in the near future."
  - After: {n}An elderly servant bows silently.{/n} "The Lord Inquisitor urgently asks Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship to his palace."

  - After: "Froscher, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, the Lord Inquisitor's retainer." {n}Unarmed, but his posture marks a bodyguard.{/n}

  - After: "I will tell him." {n}He bows.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}The servant's face twists a little, but his voice remains perfectly flat and polite.{/n} "I will pass on your reply to the Lord Inquisitor. I dare not intrude upon Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's time any longer."
  - After: {n}His face twists.{/n} "I will pass on your reply, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Footfall/JudgementOfFootfall/JudgementOfFootfall

  - Before: "Hieronymus, perhaps you can talk her down?"

  - Before: [Discreetly wipe Ryzza's blood with a handkercher to use it in a dark ritual]

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The weapon in your hands starts glowing blindingly. Your holy attack atomises Ryzza before she has time to utter her last curse.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your holy blast atomises Ryzza.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Faith. The shield and the smiting blade were gifted by the Emperor to His servants. I saw the light of our Protector in you all along, {name}. I am glad He chose you to enact His punishment." {n}Chorda looks serene, and her voice has mellowed. Her face is completely calm, no longer visited by her nervous tic.{/n}
  - After: "Faith. His shield and blade. I always saw His light in you, {name}." {n}Chorda is serene, her tic gone.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Faith. A shield gifted by the Emperor to His servants. Did you not recognise the light of our protector, {name}?" {n}Chorda looks serene, and her voice has mellowed. Her face is completely calm, no longer visited by her nervous tic.{/n}
  - After: "Faith, His shield. Did you not see His light, {name}?" {n}Chorda is serene, her tic gone.{/n}
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "Now that we've dealt with the pressing issues, do you have any other instructions regarding the station's governance going forward? After all, Footfall is now under your exclusive personal protection." {n}Vladaym and everyone in the bar look at you expectantly.{/n}
  - After: "Further orders for Footfall? It's yours now." {n}The bar waits.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The eyes of everyone gathered in the bar converge on you. They are holding their breath as they wait for Footfall's new ruler to issue {mf|his|her} first decree.{/n}
  - After: {n}All await the new ruler and {mf|his|her} first decree.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Everyone present makes the sign of the Aquila and joins in a prayer to the Emperor. You see anxiety and doubt in the eyes of many. The recent atrocities are still fresh in the memories of everyone present, but no one dares question your will. The light of the Emperor will return to Footfall. One can either accept it, or be incinerated by it.{/n}
  - After: {n}All pray, anxious, but none defy you. Accept the Emperor's light or burn.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The entire gathering glorifies your name with a joyful chant. In their eyes, you see hope with a dash of mistrust. The station's inhabitants are not used to such magnanimity. However, something in your voice gives them hope that you are not putting on a show, and that perhaps this is the beginning of a new and less grim period in the station's history.{/n}
  - After: {n}The crowd cheers, hopeful but wary.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Furious shouts of elation shake the pub's walls. Everyone's eyes light up with anticipation of a life free from the Imperium's laws, and many are already busy thinking about who they will stab in the back to grab their coveted place in the sun.{/n}
  - After: {n}Wild cheers. Many already plot betrayals.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The people breathe a sigh of relief and glorify your name loudly. After a period of tribulation and hardship, Footfallers are glad that there will at least be something familiar and unchanged left in this world.{/n}
  - After: {n}Relieved cheers.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The fabric is soaked with the blood of the heretic sworn to the Ruinous Powers. The crimson drops hold tiny echoes of her unrighteous soul's agony. These barely perceptible particles used to be Ryzza until only a few moments ago — and you know they are all it will take to summon a being from beyond the veil into realspace. You pocket the handkercher.{/n}

- **Ryzza**

I let the corruption of heresy into my soul and rejected the light of the Emperor. I will accept my fate, but I'm begging you to be lenient toward the crew of my voidship. Only I am tainted. They knew nothing of my treachery."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In that case, I am ready to hand down your sentence. Commoner Ryzza, you are charged with piracy, with aiding and abetting rebels, and with blasphemous heresy and worship of the Ruinous Powers. Given your repentance, I will grant you a quick death. As regards your crew, they will face trial in due time, on the same terms as others on this station."
  - After: "Commoner Ryzza, guilty of piracy, aiding rebels and Ruinous heresy. For repenting, a quick death. Your crew faces trial later."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A quick death is the only mercy one can show to a servant of the Archenemy. Heresy cannot be forgiven."
  - After: "A quick death is the only mercy. Heresy is unforgivable."
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**
  - Before: "So you're going to string me up like a pirate? Well then, whatever bad place my soul goes to, once I become the ruler of it, I'll be back for you."
  - After: "Hanging me? I'll rule whatever hell I land in and come back for you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am only doing what the Emperor commands me to do."
  - After: "I only do the Emperor's will."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Incendia offers a prayer to the Emperor, then pierces Ryzza's heart with a quick and well-aimed shot from her pistol. The pirate meets her death with dignity, keeping her eyes on Incendia until the end.{/n}
  - After: {n}Incendia prays and shoots Ryzza, who dies with dignity.{/n}
- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**

- **Vladaym Tocara the Liege**

  - After: "The people will... pay their respects. They're quite exercised."

  - After: {n}Kibellah, weapon drawn, asks calmly,{/n} "What of your remains, Lady Chorda?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Arrogant wench! I will have YOUR remains strung up along with the corpses of your pitiful sect that has perverted His Creed!"
  - After: "Arrogant wench! I'll hang YOUR remains with your sect!"
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "If you are still able to speak after your defeat, I will repeat my question then. You have earned an honourable rest."
  - After: "I'll ask again after your defeat. You've earned rest."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "No, Incendia, do not invoke the Emperor's name as justification for your mistakes. There are different kinds of authority — you are the one who drove these people to the brink, so you are responsible for the carnage that followed."
  - After: "Don't hide behind the Emperor, Incendia. You drove them to this."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "Every Arbitrator is taught how to suppress a rebellion without starting a bigger one. Instead of doing your duty with a cool head, you let your seething hatred for heretics get the better of you — you will serve as a prime example of how not to do this job."
  - After: "Arbitrators quell rebellions without worsening them. Your hatred ruled you."

## World/Dialogs/Ch4/Footfall/NewPirateVendor/NewPirateVendor_dialog

  - Before: "Those who have reconsidered their ways should be pardoned. Your initiative is commendable."

  - Before: [Execute] "I'll do just fine without it."

  - Before: "I have no time to continue this conversation."

  - After: "I sentence you to death for piracy."

  - Before: {n}The man has a scraggly beard and a metal plate on his forehead. He is trembling like a leaf and looking around anxiously. When he sees you, he stands to attention and makes an awkward attempt to bow deferentially.{/n}

Anyway, I'm the Fellowship of the Void's new, err, commercionary agent on Footfall. I'm eager to assure Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship of my ultramost respect and offer my services. There's business to be done, reign of terror or no reign of terror, am I right?"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pirate looks away, embarrassed.{/n} "I drew the short lho joint. After Ryzza went on, you know, her last raid, none of us would volumpteer to replace her on the station."
  - After: {n}He looks away.{/n} "I drew the short lho joint."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We'll give it our all and hold nothing back! We'll join any fight for the righteous cause, to redempt ourselves with hardship and endeaviour! For the Emperor and Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Just don't banish us from Footfall or vanish us altogether!"

  - Before: "R-right away! For you, only the best valuables and rarifieties!"

Call me— why, don't call me anything, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. In times like these, a name is just more trouble. Let me just be your fri— useful acquaintance!"
  - After: "No, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship!" {n}He shakes.{/n} "I sell foffity poppity — forfeited property! No names, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship!"

P-putting our hopes in Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship's merciousness!"

- **(conversation owner)**

Started making dangerous friends and getting into d-deals with some right dodgy-looking fellows. Everybody tried to talk her out of it. It's one thing to sell heretical trinkets and such. It's a whole 'nother thing to wear them. But there's no arguing with her, is there? It's all old Ryzza this, and old Ryzza that, and don't lecture me, or I'll gut you. Sh-she went bonkers, and that's the long and the short of it." {n}The pirate spits irately and is immediately frightened of what he just did.{/n}
  - After: "P-perish the thought, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Ryzza went insanitary, wearing heretical trinkets." {n}He spits, then flinches.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "I'll be here, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship! At your servitudilance!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Y-Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! I greet you with ultramost respect! Let's get trading, shall we?"
  - After: "Y-Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Ultramost respect! Let's trade!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Don't be too harsh on us wretched unfortunables, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We're, you know, victims here too!"
  - After: "Mercy, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We're victims too!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why, of c-course we'd have given them no quarter back then either! But, you know, Ryzza... She was a horrible woman who kept everyone terrified to their ultramost core. M-many tried to overthrow her, only for her to dispatch them in some proper gut-wrenching ways. Her atroxities gave the whole crew the shivers."
  - After: "No quarter then either! But Ryzza gutted anyone who crossed her. Her atroxities terrified us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The plate-shaped implant lands on the deck with a loud clang. There is a hole in it now, and bits of the pirate's brains are stuck to it. The bar falls silent for a moment, but then the chatter resumes just as quickly. No one is much interested in another dead unfortunate who was foolish enough to anger a Rogue Trader.{/n}
  - After: {n}The holed plate clangs to the deck. The bar barely pauses.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The pirate gets up from his knees, huffing and trying to cover the stain on his breeches.{/n} "Of c-course, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship. M-most appropriate. Keep us in pious fear so that we have nary an ill thought, corruptuous as we are!"
  - After: {n}He rises, hiding a stain.{/n} "Of c-course, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Keep us corruptuous lot fearful!"
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "A pleasure, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship! Extremulously short work of heretics!"
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "Your previous ringleader was keenly aware of one rule: never get near a tithe ship — never even look in the direction of one. Or else..." {n}The Proctor makes a gesture, and Glaito gnashes his teeth, leaning closer to the "commercionary agent."{/n}
  - After: "Your last ringleader knew: never go near a tithe ship." {n}Glaito gnashes his teeth at the agent.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "Sorry, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Pardon my lowly nervacular!"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}After casting a sceptical look at the plump layman, the Wolf growls,{/n} "Are these your pirates? I see a dispiriting sign of the degradation that has overtaken the Expanse."
  - After: {n}The Wolf growls,{/n} "These are your pirates? The Expanse has decayed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "P-please! We are overacquainted with the way of things and with the expassing of the most dishonourable Captain Sargona. We would never, never think to encroach upon the sacred tribute. Never!"
  - After: "P-please! We remember Captain Sargona's fate. We'd never touch the tribute!"
- **(conversation owner)**

We'll do whatever you tell us to do — repent good and proper, and accept any punishment and battle the xenoses for yours, and for the Imperium's triumphant glory! Besides, if you executionise me, our lot will be too scared to keep on trading with you. Is our Fellowship of the Void of no use to you anymore?"
  - After: {n}He kneels.{/n} "M-mercy, Your L-{mf|Lord|Lady}ship! We'll repent and fight! Executionise me and nobody will trade with you!"

To spy for him?"

  - Before: {n}The hall bears the marks of a clean-up — quick, thorough, and unceremonious. The smell of ash from burned reports hangs in the air. What he says next carries an echo of Calcazar's rumbling voice.{/n} "Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, I regret that we never spoke. A matter of special importance has forced me to leave Footfall."

- **Froscher**
  - Before: "I was instructed to tell Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship that the Lord Inquisitor advises against making that enquiry." {n}The outrageously rude words are spoken in an impeccably polite tone.{/n}
  - After: "He advises Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship not to ask." {n}Politely rude.{/n}

  - Before: "As you may guess, I have a plan for defending the Expanse, but the events on Eufrates II have shown that the plan is compromised. The breach of secrecy has left no time for preparations.   - After: "Eufrates II compromised my plan to defend the Expanse. I must do something monumental, perhaps too dangerous. I hope you understand."

  - Before: {n}Jae clicks her tongue in disappointment.{/n} "I will have you know, shereen, that here on Footfall, they help insolent ashmags like this one relax and find their tongue. And the methods they use aren't of the pleasant variety..."

  - Before: "That was a mistake." {n}A blade appears in Froscher's hand: a common Cadian-pattern, monomolecular-edged bayonet knife whose handle is covered in scratches from years of use.{/n}

  - After: "{name}." {n}Heinrix, icy:{/n} "I can interrogate him."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The gleaming blade makes a series of lingering flashes on your retinas. You very narrowly dodge the stabs aimed at your eyes and throat, grab hold of the man's wrist, which might as well be made of stone, and start twisting it out of its cracking joint. A crushing elbow blow connects with your jaw, but the lightning-fast hand-to-hand fight ends in your victory before you even realise you have been attacked.{/n}
  - After: {n}You dodge his stabs, seize his wrist and twist. He elbows your jaw, but you win in a flash.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You manage to jerk your head out of the way of the serpentine strike, saving your eyes, but the blade rips your flesh open. One after another, it finds your internal organs: the liver, the lungs, and the kidneys. Overcoming the pain, you grab hold of his hand, which might as well be made of rock, and start twisting it out of its cracking joint. The pain makes your foe cease his resistance, and you realise that the fight that almost cost you your life has lasted no more than a few seconds.{/n}
  - After: {n}The blade finds your liver, lungs and kidneys. Through the pain, you twist his wrist until he yields.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}Froscher rasps stubbornly,{/n} "My master told me to stay behind to prevent the possibility of... pursuit. Your meddling in the Inquisition's affairs is a mistake."
  - After: {n}Froscher rasps,{/n} "I stayed to stop pursuit. You meddle wrongly."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix turns to Froscher and raises a hand. Otherworldly cold envelops you.{/n} "I will only ask you this question once..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix raises a hand; cold spreads.{/n} "I'll ask once..."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: "No!" {n}Froscher's voice breaks along with his resolve as his legs give out under the unseen influence of biomancy.{/n} "Master van Calox, stop... I have seen your work first-hand. I know what is left of the people you interrogate... Porta Septentum. Dimensional gate."
  - After: "No!" {n}Froscher collapses.{/n} "Stop, Master van Calox... Porta Septentum. Dimensional gate."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}Courageous spirit can overcome anything — but weak, pain-fearing flesh can't. When Froscher's nerves begin to snap under your pressure, he blurts out,{/n} "Porta... Septentum... dimensional gate..." {n}The servant bites his tongue furiously, livid at his body's faithless weakness.{/n}
  - After: {n}His flesh fails.{/n} "Porta... Septentum... dimensional gate..." {n}He bites his tongue.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Satisfied, Marazhai tenderly caresses Froscher's cheek.{/n} "I wish I was not so short on time... I would have employed something far more refined. But, I suppose, even such rushed work has delivered the desired results."
  - After: {n}Marazhai caresses Froscher's cheek.{/n} "Rushed, but it worked."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix lowers his hand.{/n} "Most sensible of you, old man. Good."
  - After: {n}Heinrix lowers his hand.{/n} "Sensible."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}You hear the crunch of a shattered joint, nerves snapping, tendons creaking. But that is all you hear; the servant's lips remain stubbornly sealed.{/n}
  - After: {n}Bones crunch; his lips stay sealed.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}Froscher glimpses something in your eyes and sighs in defeat.{/n} "That's true. No one can endure torture forever. He went into the Porta Septentum, the dimensional gate. And I have failed him."
  - After: {n}Froscher sighs.{/n} "He went into the Porta Septentum, the dimensional gate. I've failed him."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: "I am no longer young. My money is on my stubbornness against my weak heart. Let's see which breaks first."
  - After: "I'm old. Will my stubbornness or heart break first?"
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}It takes time to beat answers out of the lump of meat that once called itself Froscher. At some point, between the squelching sounds of your blows and the cracking of broken bones, you manage to force several words out of his mouth. "Porta Septentum. Dimensional gate."{/n}
  - After: {n}The beaten wreck gasps, "Porta Septentum. Dimensional gate."{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai lets out a disappointed sigh but does not intervene.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai sighs.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}The servant, now a broken man, looks at you with hatred in his eyes.{/n} "You won't stop my master anyway. Don't follow him... Better run away."
  - After: {n}He glares.{/n} "You won't stop my master. Run."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: "Of that I am ignorant, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. It was decided due to secrecy concerns that I should not know the details."
  - After: "I wasn't told, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: "I understand, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship." {n}The man makes no attempt to defend himself. He accepts death as one would accept an unpleasant but necessary medical procedure.{/n}
  - After: "I understand, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship." {n}He accepts death.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: "Farewell, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I hope you help my master achieve what he set out to do."
  - After: "Farewell, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Help my master."
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}Froscher shakes his head with a sad smile.{/n} "Always faithful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}A sad smile.{/n} "Always faithful, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "Finely honed rhetoric means saying a great deal, yet revealing nothing." {n}Eogunn smiles faintly.{/n} "A choice in name only. This summons is hardly a request, Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Much said, nothing revealed." {n}Eogunn smiles.{/n} "It's no request."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard's face turns a deep red.{/n} "You blasted..." {n}With visible effort, he swallows the insult he was about to spit out.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard reddens.{/n} "You blasted..." {n}He bites it back.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "However, it would be a shame to miss out on this opportunity to see the skills of certain members of your retinue in action." {n}Jae glances over her shoulder.{/n}
  - After: "Though I'd love to see your retinue work." {n}Jae glances back.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "{name}..." {n}Marazhai's voice is sickeningly sweet.{/n} "I can see that this mon-keigh is disinclined to speak... Let me have my way with him."
  - After: "{name}..." {n}Marazhai purrs.{/n} "Let me make him talk."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Arrows of Kurnous, we are too late... Elantach, at your word, I will track down that mon-keigh to the ends of the galaxy." {n}Fury rings in Yrliet's voice.{/n}
  - After: "Arrows of Kurnous, too late! Elantach, I'll hunt that mon-keigh down." {n}Yrliet seethes.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}Froscher presses his lips together stubbornly and reaches for his tall boot. You put more pressure on his maimed wrist to make him stop.{/n}
  - After: {n}He reaches for his boot; you twist his wrist.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai moves with practically imperceptible speed. Froscher only manages to grab the handle of a previously concealed bayonet knife when Marazhai appears before him and pierces his tear duct with a thin blade. Froscher goes still, his hands hanging limply, as the Drukhari starts trepanning the man alive.{/n}
  - After: {n}Froscher grabs a hidden knife, but Marazhai stabs his eye and trepans him alive.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}After a while, Marazhai casts a bloodied piece of Froscher's skull aside and inserts the blade. The man flinches and starts quietly howling a single note, his mouth drooling and his eyes rolling back. The howl rises to a deafening shriek before he sputters,{/n} "P-P-Port-ta Sept-t-tentum... D-d-dimensio... g-gate..."
  - After: {n}Marazhai probes his brain. Froscher howls, then sputters,{/n} "P-P-Port-ta Sept-t-tentum... D-d-dimensio... g-gate..."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}With a derisive laugh, Marazhai turns away from his mutilated victim.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai laughs.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: "That is why I am giving you an option to find me and, I hope, join me. I am travelling to the ancient dimensional gate in the Porta Septentum System, and beyond. If you wish, you can follow me and share with me the burden of responsibility for what is to come. And if not, pray for me, for I could use any help I can get. The Emperor protects, {name} von Valancius."
  - After: "Join me if you can. I'm going to the ancient dimensional gate in the Porta Septentum System, and beyond. Share the burden, or pray for me. The Emperor protects, {name} von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You might decide to show mercy... Later. When you have answers. Something almost tangible seems to touch your throat, freezing the words in it. Fate is yanking the leash insistently, and the fingers on Froscher's battered hand tighten their grip.{/n}
  - After: {n}Mercy can wait. Fate tugs; you grip Froscher tighter.{/n}
- **Froscher**
  - Before: {n}With a weak smile, Froscher replies calmly,{/n} "For my courage, sir."
  - After: {n}Froscher smiles weakly.{/n} "For courage, sir."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Something tells me, shereen, that we've missed our engagement with the Lord Inquisitor. So terribly rude of him to have departed in such haste, leaving us to wonder what he is planning..."
  - After: "We missed the Inquisitor, shereen. How rude."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "That's it?" {n}Heinrix looks at Froscher in confusion and anger.{/n}
  - After: "That's it?" {n}Heinrix glares.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta frowns, painfully processing what she just heard.{/n} "A call from His servant must not go unanswered, but... what is this plan for defending the Expanse that the Lord Inquisitor hides in the shadows? These tidings bring unease to my heart, Rogue Trader."
  - After: {n}Argenta frowns.{/n} "We must answer, but what is he hiding?"

- **Player**
  - Before: "And that is the truth. Pour every last drop of that heresy fuel away, right now."
