  - After: "The Wolves helped close the gate and hunted Yremeryss's targets. Then they pried. The Baleful Howl pack..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You came {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_XavierTrust}at just the right moment{/d}, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. I sometimes regret that timeliness isn't a virtue recognised by the Emperor. It truly deserves the honour."
  - After: "You came {d|Encyclopedia:Ch4_XavierTrust}at just the right moment{/d}, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I see that you did not heed my warnings, {name}. Your decision to come here in spite of them may have consequences. But we still have a chance to turn it to everyone's advantage, if Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship listens to me very carefully."
  - After: "You ignored my warnings, {name}. Listen carefully, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Cubis Delphim revealed to Uralon the Cruel where he should strike, and that almost spelt the end of Operation Precious Sentinel. I appreciate your efforts in resolving this problem. In fact, you turned out to be much more useful than Theodora ever was."
  - After: "You stopped Cubis Delphim aiding Uralon the Cruel and saved Operation Precious Sentinel. More useful than Theodora."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I value your bluntness. Let me match it: while my head will remain firmly on my shoulders, I will remove yours with the utmost pleasure. I tire of your arrogance, {name}."
  - After: "Then bluntly: I'll take your head, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I try to keep assistants like you a flamer's range away from my affairs."
  - After: "I keep assistants like you a flamer's range away."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Let us suppose that it is so. I cannot say that I am completely convinced of your sincerity, but you are off to a good start with your choice of words."
  - After: "Perhaps. A good start."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "No, {name}. The disaster is already unfolding — it is just that you and people like you are blissfully unaware of it thanks to me and others in my position. The Imperium is being pierced by a thousand daggers, every day, everywhere. It is bleeding. Weakening. One day it will grow too weak, unless radical steps are taken. I am not trying to foment disaster — I am trying to prevent it."
  - After: "Disaster is already here, {name}. The Imperium bleeds daily. Without radical steps, it falls. I'm preventing that."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Given the circumstances of our meeting, I do not see why I should hide anything. I seriously doubt you will share this information with anyone else... for one reason or another."
  - After: "Why hide anything? You won't tell anyone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Thanks to your predecessor. I arrived in the Expanse at the call of the Explorator Fleet to deal with Archmagos Amarnat's heresy. But I quickly came to the realisation that the Koronus Expanse's problems ran much deeper than tech-heresy. Unprecedented piracy running wild, blatant smuggling of xeno-artefacts, wilful and impetuous Rogue Traders, and growing threat of the Ruinous Powers — all this in a region that the Drukhari consider their domain."
  - After: "Your predecessor. I came for Archmagos Amarnat's heresy and found worse: piracy, xeno-smuggling, Chaos, all in Drukhari territory."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Frankly, I considered purging the entire Expanse: it would have been much easier to burn down this whole tangle of threats and corruption. But the web of spies that I had woven presented me with much more interesting and radical solutions. While investigating Amarnat's connections, I turned my eye to Theodora von Valancius, who ultimately gave me the Shard."
  - After: "Rather than purge the Expanse, I followed Amarnat to Theodora von Valancius, who gave me the Shard."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar stares at the Inquisitor with wide eyes, saying nothing. It seems you were not the only one unaware of Calcazar's plan. He finally breathes out, his voice heavy,{/n} "Morkai howls for you, Inquisitor."
  - After: {n}Ulfar stares, stunned.{/n} "Morkai howls for you, Inquisitor."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar stares coldly at him, the deadly frost of Fenris crackling in his voice as he speaks:{/n} "You will pay for this, Xavier Calcazar. Know that I will have my blood vengeance. I will have your death."
  - After: {n}Ulfar, ice-cold:{/n} "You will pay, Xavier Calcazar. I will have your death."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Theodora's instincts were uncanny. She spent decades hunting for a key that could open the dimensional gate, as if she knew that there was something incredible waiting for her on the other side. Her Ladyship was lucky enough to discover the Shard during one of her expeditions. A trophy that was too much for her to handle. Archmagos Amarnat studied it on Theodora's behalf, creating weapons in exchange for access to the dangerous relic. But their research was too primitive and unambitious compared to the true power contained inside the Shard."
  - After: "Theodora found the Shard seeking the dimensional gate's key. Archmagos Amarnat studied it for her, making weapons, but barely touched its power."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I had one of my own acolytes, Tanakia, send her spies to Theodora. They infiltrated the Rogue Trader's retinue, earned their trust, and reported to me about this magnificent object. The rest was trivial: I seized Epitaph and laid down the conditions of our further coexistence. She was wise enough to concede defeat with dignity."
  - After: "My acolyte Tanakia's spies found it. I seized Epitaph; Theodora conceded."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It was made on Eufrates II. I captured Amarnat's student, Axiomantha, and she passed all of her mentor's drafts to me. And the one overseeing the process was none other than your acquaintance, the Tech-Priest Cubis Delphim. His fall was regrettable. It seems that the unorthodox, daring things he did at my behest drove him to break his vows and sink into heresy."
  - After: "Made on Eufrates II from Amarnat's drafts, via his student Axiomantha. Cubis Delphim oversaw it, and fell to heresy."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I commend your ability to face the facts without fear or prejudice, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
  - After: "I commend your honesty, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Of course, I did not let him near the Shard itself, but rather set up a laboratory for him on Quetza Temer. It was safer that way. All the pieces were contributing to my plan, but none had enough information to comprehend the entirety of it."
  - After: "He worked on Quetza Temer, never near the Shard. No one saw the whole plan."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "So in the end..." {n}Marazhai's smile is not his usual triumphant and scornful one. He looks almost tired.{/n} "In the end, I was right about Yremeryss and the mon-keigh. I was right all along."
  - After: {n}Marazhai looks tired.{/n} "I was right about Yremeryss and the mon-keigh."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix cringes at Calcazar's words.{/n} "You disposed of Emelina like unwanted rubbish. Like... waste material. After all her years of faithful service to the Golden Throne..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix cringes.{/n} "You threw Emelina away like rubbish. After all her service..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Trust me, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship, the threat of the alien pales in comparison to that posed by the Ruinous Powers. Yremeryss could plunder a thousand worlds, but she is no Uralon the Cruel. She was as great a danger to her own kin as she was to the Imperium. The disruption she caused among the Drukhari was only to our benefit. She intended to trigger a powerful dysjunction in Commorragh, thereby destroying her rivals and elevating her own Kabal in the process."
  - After: "Chaos is worse than aliens, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. Yremeryss planned a dysjunction in Commorragh to destroy her rivals. That served us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I needed a remarkably strong force to keep my xenos allies in check. The Emperor's Angels were just the weapon I was looking for, except... considering the sensitive nature of my operation, I couldn't very well risk requesting aid from my allies in the Deathwatch, could I? And then I remembered an old debt owed to me by a Space Wolves Great Company. So I decided to call in a favour."
  - After: "I needed Astartes to check my xenos allies, discreetly. So I called in a Space Wolves debt."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You have come so far in pursuit of answers, {name}. It would be too cruel to leave your curiosity unsatisfied."
  - After: "You've come far for answers, {name}."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Theft of sacraments and secrets of the Adeptus Mechanicus: registered. Inciting a devout Tech-Priest to commit heresy: registered. Blasphemous merging of sacred technologies with forbidden ones: registered. Further transgression registration discontinued." {n}The drill on Pasqal's mechadendrite screeches in fury.{/n}
  - After: "Theft of Mechanicus secrets: registered. Inciting heresy: registered. Forbidden tech: registered." {n}Pasqal's drill screeches.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There was no more need for them, seeing as the Yoke was almost complete and the situation was escalating out of control. Theodora was dead, the Cult of the Final Dawn had reared its head and was preparing to strike. And Yremeryss had forgotten her place: she was putting forward too many elimination requests, and when I told her to curb her appetite, she retaliated. The theft of the Rykad star was timed to occur when Master van Calox would be on the planet. The Archon wanted to rob me of one of my agents and send a message."
  - After: "The Yoke was nearly done and chaos spreading. Yremeryss wanted too many kills. When I refused, she stole the Rykad star while Master van Calox was there, as a message."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}After a brief pause, Heinrix nods and responds gravely,{/n} "I no longer recognise your authority, Lord Inquisitor. My apologies."
  - After: {n}Heinrix nods gravely.{/n} "I no longer recognise your authority, Lord Inquisitor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "However, you will not be there to see it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I will have the C'tan Shard destroy your body so thoroughly that there won't be the slightest trace left of you. You may find it lamentable, but there is simply no place for the likes of you in the future that I am creating."
  - After: "But you won't see it, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. The C'tan Shard will erase you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Theodora's research destabilised the Shard's prison, and my project only made it worse. Whenever particles of the C'tan Shard's energy seep out, many curious phenomena occur. The destruction of the crypt, the warped reality... When I tame the monster, I will order it to stop disrupting the laws of the universe."
  - After: "Our research weakened its prison; its energy warps reality. Once tamed, that stops."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I'm afraid the Rogue Trader is right, Lord Inquisitor. I will not."
  - After: "The Rogue Trader is right. I will not."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Visibly offended, Heinrix looks back at you coldly and mutters,{/n} "I had no intention of complying."
  - After: {n}Heinrix, coldly:{/n} "I had no intention of complying."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In that case... Heinrix van Calox, in the name of the Emperor, I hereby revoke your Inquisitorial privileges and declare you Excommunicate Traitoris. The punishment for your heresy is death. I bid you farewell."
  - After: "Then, Heinrix van Calox, I declare you Excommunicate Traitoris. The punishment is death."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "With all due respect to you, Lord Inquisitor, I shall ask you to refrain from any further threats directed toward the blessed Rogue Trader. Lest you face repercussions from me."
  - After: "Stop threatening the Rogue Trader, Lord Inquisitor. Or answer to me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "How courteous of you to warn me, Master Werserian. I will remember your words."
  - After: "Noted, Master Werserian."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Gritting his teeth, Abelard says quietly,{/n} "In the old days, House von Valancius would have declared war over something like this. And fought until the offender was dead."
  - After: {n}Abelard grits his teeth.{/n} "Once, House von Valancius would have gone to war over this."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A specimen of an ancient predator race, devourers of pulsars who feasted on star systems. Reality itself bent to their power, but many millennia ago, an ancient xenos race managed to defeat them, shatter them into pieces, and lock them away in prisons like the one you see before you."
  - After: "Star-devouring predators who bent reality. Ancient xenos shattered and imprisoned them like this."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A containment device similar to this one, except... better. The Yoke was devised by the brightest minds of two races using the ancient wisdom of a long-gone xenos civilisation. A prison capable not only of holding the C'tan Shard, but also of controlling it while releasing fractions of its being. An instrument of obedience and destruction. A masterpiece whose creation required immense effort."
  - After: "A better prison, built by two races from ancient xenos wisdom. It holds and controls the C'tan Shard, releasing fractions of its power."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do you mean to say that a human is not capable of such a feat? But I am not just a human — I am an instrument of the Emperor's will, one of many. And the Imperium is omnipotent. If I were to fail, another would follow in my footsteps. That is how Humanity makes the impossible possible: with the hands of particular people in particular circumstances. Your scepticism is unwarranted."
  - After: "I am the Emperor's instrument. If I fail, another follows."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am not in this for my own sake. I am doing my duty. And as for the scale... Do you know what ensures the indomitability of every member of the Inquisition? The knowledge that they are personally responsible for the survival of the Imperium, and that the fate of billions hinges on their actions. Do you understand? Personally responsible. Compared to that scale, do you think I am daunted by the gravity of this mission?"
  - After: "This is duty. Every Inquisitor carries the Imperium's survival. This doesn't daunt me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "They raided an outpost where my agents had been meeting with the Drukhari. The pack took prisoners but lost the esteemed Brother Ulfar. I hoped they would give their all to the search, but instead the Wolves forced this system's coordinates out of the captives and came crashing down on my head. They had no gate to transport them — they used nothing but their warp engines. Thankfully, they realised their situation too late, so Tanakia managed to neutralise them."
  - After: "They lost Brother Ulfar raiding my Drukhari outpost, then tortured this system's coordinates from captives and warped in. Tanakia neutralised them."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Not at all. Operation Precious Sentinel is in its final stages. The increase in xenos activity is a vexing yet trivial development in the grand scheme of things. They were supposed to guard the device, but they slept through the intrusion, and only the C'tan Shard's emanations could make them stir."
  - After: "Not at all. Operation Precious Sentinel is nearly done. The guardians only woke from the Shard's emanations."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Enough, {name}. It will only be heresy if I lose. If I prevail, it will be a triumphant feat in the name of saving Humanity from the horrors of this universe. And I will not lose."
  - After: "Enough, {name}. It's only heresy if I lose. I won't."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And then the Koronus Expanse was engulfed in flame. I had to rush the operation and declare sector-wide martial law. The Webway Gate that Yremeryss's warriors had been using was destroyed and the facility on Quetza Temer razed. I evacuated the half of the Yoke that Tervantias had completed, but was too late to retrieve the second half from Eufrates II."
  - After: "Then the Expanse burned. Martial law. Quetza Temer razed. I saved Tervantias's half of the Yoke; the other half was lost on Eufrates II."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}There is not a shred of hatred or disappointment on Calcazar's face.{/n} "And you showed such promise, too. I blame your heredity... Farewell, {name}. I vow to find and destroy every single seed of corruption you have sown." {n}He glances at his retinue.{/n} "Execute the heretic."
  - After: {n}Calcazar shows no hatred.{/n} "Such promise. Farewell, {name}." {n}He glances at his retinue.{/n} "Execute the heretic."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I commenced Operation Precious Sentinel — I left a garrison on Epitaph, took the key to the dimensional gate from Theodora, sealed the gate, and started the creation of the Yoke. I kept Theodora and her heirs in my sights, just in case. Not long before her death, I assigned Heinrix to her and ordered her to rendezvous with him on Rykad Minoris. But Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} inherited him instead. I admit I wasn't aware of you — Theodora managed to keep her secret heir up her sleeve."
  - After: "I garrisoned Epitaph, sealed the gate, began the Yoke. I sent Heinrix to Theodora, but Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} inherited him. I never knew of her secret heir."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Coming here was hardly prudent of you, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You and your dynasty have {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}lost my trust{/d}, and now judgement awaits you."
  - After: "Unwise, Your {mf|Lord|Lady}ship. You've {d|Encyclopedia:Conviction_Heretical3OrMore}lost my trust{/d}. Judgement awaits."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But the human mind could never have comprehended the Shard... alone. And thus I appealed to the inhuman mind. I struck a deal with the Drukhari."
  - After: "No human mind could grasp the Shard. So I dealt with the Drukhari."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is one of the most complicated and perfect creations of a race much older than the Drukhari. It is no mere object, but a treasure trove of technology. A wise master could uncover many secrets simply by observing it."
  - After: "It's a perfect creation of an older race. A trove of technology."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Alas, the operation demanded it. Through the agents of one of my acolytes, Emelina, I contacted Archon Yremeryss and made a pact. I gave her access to the technologies contained within this relic and destroyed her rivals in the Kabal — she would relay information on their raids to my spies, and I would solve the problem. In exchange, her Haemonculus, Tervantias, forged the Yoke for me."
  - After: "Through my acolyte Emelina, I pacted with Archon Yremeryss: relic access, and I'd kill her rivals. Her Haemonculus Tervantias forged the Yoke."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Knowing full well how precarious her grand plan was, I made no attempt to talk her out of it. With a little luck, we wouldn't have need worry about Commorragh's influence."
  - After: "I let her try. With luck, Commorragh would fall."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Unfortunately, I had to send Emelina away and remove her from the board. A shrewd woman of principle — I used to value those qualities of hers, but suddenly, they started to get in the way of my plan. It would have been safer to eliminate her before she could figure out what was going on, but... I must have grown miserly over the years and was loath to part with a good agent. Or perhaps I was simply being sentimental."
  - After: "I sent Emelina away. Her principles got in my way. Killing her was safer, but I'm sentimental."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "This new information about a pact combined with the astro-observation data collected in this star system resolves the inconsistencies identified earlier. Unit Xavier Calcazar stands accused of stealing the astrographic records of the Cognisance Fleet."
  - After: "Unit Xavier Calcazar stands accused of stealing the Cognisance Fleet's astrographic records."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am amazed by your analytical prowess. Yes, I needed stars to feed the Shard. The Kabal of the Reaving Tempest could steal them and bring them here, but it was imperative to preserve the exact energy parameters so as not to trigger the object's premature detonation. I procured the necessary information on suitable stars from the Explorator Fleet's data-scriptorium."
  - After: "Impressive. Yes, the Shard eats stars. The Kabal of the Reaving Tempest stole ones matching the Explorator Fleet's records, so it wouldn't detonate."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Registering a Category One blasphemy. Unit Xavier Calcazar is hereby sentenced to intravital dissection and study. Upon the cessation of vital functions, the unit's remains must be disposed of in disgrace."
  - After: "Category One blasphemy. Unit Xavier Calcazar is sentenced to intravital dissection."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Over my years of service, I have come to realise that the main problem that Humanity faces in this war is the imbalance in power. Our opponents are not races or nations, but incomprehensible monsters. And it is high time we acquired one of our own. My Yoke will bind this creature and make it a chained guard serving the Emperor."
  - After: "Our enemies are monsters. We need our own. My Yoke will chain this one to the Emperor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are the one who is attempting something mad and dangerous by acting with insolence toward me. By the Emperor, {name}, I am in no mood to squabble with a Rogue Trader. Not even with Your Recently Installed {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
  - After: "Defying me is madness, {name}. Even for Your Recently Installed {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is not the full extent of my vision. There are other Shards similar to this one, scattered across the galaxy. I plan on seeking them out and confining them all inside the Yoke. Each conquered monstrosity will bolster our defences."
  - After: "Other Shards exist. I'll bind them all in the Yoke."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix looks at you with icy calm but does not utter a word.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix is silent.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta, in the full glory of her battle focus, is reciting a prayer in an ardent whisper.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta whispers a prayer.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}The red-headed giant gives you a menacing, exhilarated grin.{/n} "We meet again, you two-faced worm! I've had this feeling gnawing away at me, as if I haven't yet fulfilled my duty to the Allfather... As if I haven't yet killed someone I should."
  - After: {n}The red-headed giant grins.{/n} "Two-faced worm! I still owe the Allfather a kill."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Exactly what my duty dictates: saving the Imperium. Isn't it obvious?"
  - After: "Saving the Imperium. Obviously."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Illuminating, Lord Inquisitor." {n}Heinrix's tone would have frozen anyone else solid, but not Calcazar.{/n}
  - After: "Illuminating, Lord Inquisitor." {n}Icy.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Master van Calox, I am pleased to see you. How was your journey?"
  - After: "Master van Calox. How was your journey?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix's lip curls.{/n} "It is unfortunate that I was not privy to all the details of this plan."
  - After: {n}Heinrix's lip curls.{/n} "A pity I wasn't told."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Heinrix, eliminate the Rogue Trader." {n}Calcazar gazes at the unmoving Interrogator.{/n}
  - After: "Heinrix, eliminate the Rogue Trader." {n}Heinrix doesn't move.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "To put it plainly, {name}, I am averse to this proposition."
  - After: "Plainly, {name}, no."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai half-closes his eyes as if he has just heard something incredibly inane.{/n} "Grand spires of stupidity and unfathomable depths of opportunity is a dangerous combination for a single mon-keigh."
  - After: {n}Marazhai scoffs.{/n} "Stupidity and opportunity. Dangerous in a mon-keigh."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "You underestimate the Dark City's size and its resilience. It has survived thousands of dysjunctions and will survive thousands more to live on as fuel for your nightmares."
  - After: "The Dark City has survived thousands of dysjunctions."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "What? Rykad's sun... vanished because of me?"
  - After: "Rykad's sun vanished because of me?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I still fail to see the connection between the disappearing star and the Cult of the Final Dawn... How could the xenos catalyse the fulfilment of the Archenemy's prophecy?"
  - After: "How could a stolen star fulfil the Cult of the Final Dawn's prophecy?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira shakes her head.{/n} "Perhaps... perhaps the powers of the warp knew ahead of time what was destined to happen. Before the cult infiltrated the planet... Before either Aurora showed up in the system..."
  - After: {n}Idira shakes her head.{/n} "Perhaps the warp knew in advance..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Your actions have been questionable too, Lord Inquisitor. You may be within your rights to judge and punish bearers of the sacred Warrant, but here, among the uncharted stars, a Rogue Trader may easily find themselves executing an Inquisitor who is steeped in heresy." {n}Cassia's clear and confident gaze turns to Calcazar.{/n} "I see the canvas of your soul... and it is tainted with the gory hues of dried blood."
  - After: "Out here, a Rogue Trader may execute a heretic Inquisitor." {n}Cassia gazes at Calcazar.{/n} "Your soul is bloodstained."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Enough! I will have a separate conversation with House Orsellio."
  - After: "Enough! I'll deal with House Orsellio later."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "No one in this world is capable of taming the power of the true Yngir, the star devourers. And if you think even a small and imprisoned part of one of them is going to yield to you, you are mad, mon-keigh. Mad and short-sighted."
  - After: "No one tames the Yngir, the star devourers. You are mad, mon-keigh."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And that brings us to the most interesting part of our conversation. You know my plan, so now I want to know yours. Will you admit that I am in the right and join me in this undeniably ambitious act, or will you try to stop me? I will be upfront with you: if it is the latter, I will be forced to remove you. But I am sure you realise that already."
  - After: "Now, your choice. Join me, or try to stop me and die?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Of course the Inquisition wants to collar it. How typical." {n}Jae's honeyed speech dissolves into soldierly crudeness:{/n} "Throne damn it, even I can see that no good can come of this groxshit crazy plan!"
  - After: "Typical Inquisition." {n}Jae turns crude.{/n} "Throne damn it, this groxshit plan ends badly!"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "The Yngir are no mere predators, mon-keigh. They are not just another sentient race. The ancient tales speak of a great war between the Yngir and the Old Ones. And in that war, the Yngir found allies to whom they promised unbounded gifts. You have seen them, elantach. Your species call them Necrons. The Yngir granted them everything they needed to fight their enemies, but their largesse came at a price. Tricked into a state that was neither life nor death, the metal warriors served the star devourers for aeons, until they finally rebelled and confined their masters to prisons such as this one. Do you wish to be tricked by their power too?"
  - After: "The Yngir tricked those you call Necrons into a state neither life nor death and enslaved them for aeons, until they rebelled and imprisoned their masters. Will you be tricked too, elantach?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your unsanctioned xenos has a point, Rogue Trader. Which... isn't the same as saying she is right. The Imperium will harness this creature's power. And turn it against our enemies."
  - After: "She has a point, Rogue Trader, but isn't right. The Imperium will wield this power."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well noted. Yes, I acted as their executioner, as regrettable as those losses were. However, to overestimate their importance to the Imperium would have been folly. Every single day, Humanity pays a far more terrible price, and that must be brought to an end."
  - After: "Yes, I was their executioner. Humanity pays worse daily."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira's eyes widen — the cold light of prophecy shines in them.{/n} "The future... the future you are creating — it blinds... it burns... It is filled with the suffering of millions... for the sake of the phantom salvation of billions... salvation... in the bosom of a xenonightmare."
  - After: {n}Idira's eyes blaze.{/n} "Your future burns... millions suffering for a phantom salvation..."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Fear. I hear nothing but fear in your words. It was fear that made you believe that His grace alone is not enough to stand against the rising tide of darkness. It was fear that convinced you to seek salvation in the abyss of xenos filth. You are no guardian of the Imperium. You are just a greedy old coward."
  - After: "Fear made you seek salvation in xenos filth. You're a greedy old coward."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "The protocols dictate that the Inquisition is beyond the authority of the Adeptus Arbites. But not only have you put yourself above the Lex Imperialis..." {n}An angry growl creeps into Solomorne's voice.{/n} "You are playing god! I swore to keep order in the Imperium, and now, I'm just supposed to stand by and watch you do this? No."
  - After: "You're above the Lex Imperialis?" {n}Solomorne growls.{/n} "Playing god! I won't just watch."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Trazyn's laughter assails your ears — the ancient, heavy laughter of a creature of untold centuries. The Necron appears before you in the now painfully familiar projection.{/n} "How... audacious. And how unspeakably naive. Of all the people I've encountered on my journey with you, this little human — this mad, grandiose maniac who pursued his plan to the very end — has come closest to earning a place in my collection. And yet I am here for something else."
  - After: {n}Trazyn's projection appears, laughing.{/n} "How audacious. How naive. He nearly earns a place in my collection. But I'm here for something else."

  - Before: {n}You hear Trazyn's voice again — devoid of even a hint of the ringing mirth from moments ago.{/n} "Our agreement. I am ready to fulfil my part."
  - After: {n}Trazyn, mirth gone:{/n} "Our agreement. I am ready to fulfil my part."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "So be it. Before we begin, I will say this... I am encouraged by your pragmatism, {name}. You have surpassed Theodora and my expectations, and I am grateful to know that I will not determine the fate of Humanity alone, but with a dependable ally at my side."
  - After: "So be it. You've surpassed Theodora, {name}. I'm glad not to decide Humanity's fate alone."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Inquisitor nods calmly. There is not a shred of hatred or disappointment on his face.{/n} "Farewell, then. I am glad to have made your acquaintance, {name}, despite everything." {n}He glances at his retinue.{/n} "Eliminate the Rogue Trader."
  - After: {n}The Inquisitor nods calmly.{/n} "Farewell, {name}." {n}He glances at his retinue.{/n} "Eliminate the Rogue Trader."

They were called the C'tan. ## World/Dialogs/Ch5/Farewell/AbelardFarewell/AbelardFarewell_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Abelard, no matter what happened, you were always at my side."
  - After: "Abelard, you were always at my side."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have a highly organised mind, so you must have already considered what you are going to do once this campaign of ours comes to an end."
  - After: "Organised as you are, you must have plans for after this campaign."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you ready to follow me all the way?"
  - After: "Will you follow me all the way?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Get ready, Abelard. We have quite an ordeal ahead of us."
  - After: "Get ready, Abelard. An ordeal awaits."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Abelard looks at you with a tired smile. He cannot resist giving you his characteristic appraising glance.{/n} "Well, Lord Captain... My service to you began under the most remarkable circumstances. I should hardly be surprised that you have delivered us into circumstances more unexpected and surprising than ever before. Of one thing I am certain, the von Valancius dynasty will cover itself in glory today."
  - After: {n}Abelard smiles tiredly.{/n} "Strange times, Lord Captain. Our dynasty wins glory today."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, Lord Captain? We are all awaiting your order!"
  - After: "Yes, Lord Captain? We await your order!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A Seneschal's place is at the Rogue Trader's side. As you have learned, others can betray and abandon you in your darkest hour. If the Lord Captain cannot count on {mf|his|her} Seneschal, there is no one {mf|he|she} can count on. That is not a fate that I wish for you, so I am doing my duty."
  - After: "My place is at your side. If {mf|he|she} can't trust {mf|his|her} Seneschal, the Lord Captain trusts no one."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Somewhat embarrassed, Abelard tucks his thumbs into his belt.{/n} "Now that I have your blessing, it is about time I took care of my family. The Werserian clan has gone without its patriarch for too long, I should make time for my descendants before some noble upstart tries to chew them up again."
  - After: {n}Abelard, embarrassed:{/n} "I'll tend my family. The Werserian clan needs its patriarch."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What am I going to do? I will continue to serve you and see that you do not get into even worse trouble, though I fail to see how that would be possible." {n}Abelard chuckles grimly.{/n} "I swore an oath of loyalty to Lady Theodora, and then to you. Therefore my place is at the Rogue Trader's side and nowhere else."
  - After: "Keep serving, and keep you from worse trouble." {n}Abelard chuckles grimly.{/n} "I swore loyalty to Theodora, then you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Abelard looks up at you, a perennial weariness filling his gaze.{/n} "I have but one place to be, Lord Captain, and it is at your side. This is all I have left, so believe me, I will serve as your Seneschal for as long as I still draw breath."
  - After: {n}Abelard, weary:{/n} "My place is at your side. I'll serve while I breathe."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As always, Lord Captain, I would follow you into fire and back. God-Emperor be my witness, I have had the honour of serving under two Rogue Traders and survived one, so there would be no shame in going down alongside the other. If it comes to that, naturally." {n}Abelard's chuckle sounds slightly sharper than usual.{/n}
  - After: "Into fire and back. I survived one Rogue Trader; no shame falling beside another." {n}Abelard chuckles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We have been through worse..." {n}The old Seneschal grins cheekily, and for a split second looks younger by a good hundred years. He then bows his grey head.{/n} "I serve House von Valancius, Lord Captain."
  - After: "We've been through worse." {n}Abelard grins, then bows.{/n} "I serve House von Valancius."

## World/Dialogs/Ch5/Farewell/CassiaFarewell/CassiaFarewell_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Kiss] "I would rather not wait several lives. Let us find our blessing in this one."
  - After: [Kiss] "Why wait lives? Let's find blessing in this one."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am glad you are sharing this moment with me today."
  - After: "I'm glad you're sharing this moment."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Steel yourself, Lady Cassia. The hour of battle is at hand."
  - After: "Steel yourself, Lady Cassia. Battle nears."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Bow] "I am honoured to have you among my companions, Lady Cassia."
  - After: [Bow] "Honoured to have you, Lady Cassia."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This is probably not the future you dreamt of. But if all this ends in victory for us, what do you intend to do next?"
  - After: "If we win, what will you do next?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "L-Lord Captain?" {n}Cassia's pained, worried face seems to grow even paler.{/n} "The end of our journey draws near. I keep wondering... will this story have a happy ending? Or will we face an imminent but heroic demise..."
  - After: "L-Lord Captain?" {n}Cassia pales.{/n} "Will this end happily, or in death?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This place is drowning in anxieties the colour of olive haze, though many try to paint their insecurities over with deliberately bright hues." {n}The Lady Navigator's sombre gaze slides over the faces of those present.{/n} "Pale grey shadows swirl in a mournful dance, heralding the danger ahead. I cast them away as I cast away my doubts. There is no turning back."
  - After: {n}Cassia looks around.{/n} "Such anxiety. No turning back."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "{name}." {n}The faint smile on Cassia's face makes you momentarily forget about the impending battle.{/n} "We have travelled a long road together. Let us finish it together as well."
  - After: "{name}." {n}Cassia smiles.{/n} "Let's finish this together."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lord Captain." {n}Cassia nods courteously.{/n} "When I met you on Eurac V, I could not have imagined that I would find myself on the threshold of a great battle one day. Does the blue flutter of doubt and fear overwhelm my heart? Perhaps. Do I wish I could turn back time?" {n}A bitter smile graces the Lady Navigator's lips.{/n} "Never."
  - After: "Lord Captain." {n}Cassia nods.{/n} "Since Eurac V... Regrets?" {n}A bitter smile.{/n} "Never."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You have been my guide in this world this entire time. How could I turn my back on you at the last moment?"
  - After: "You've been my guide. How could I leave now?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My love." {n}, Cassia brushes the invisible weight off your shoulders with a light movement, and your heart feels a little calmer, {/n} "What lies ahead of us is uncertain. Perhaps darkness and oblivion. And yet I feel no fear, no trepidation, no doubt."
  - After: "My love." {n}Her touch calms you.{/n} "Whatever lies ahead, I feel no fear."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This is what friends are for, {name}. To be there for one another, in times of joy and in times of sorrow — I learned it all from you."
  - After: "That's what friends are for, {name}. You taught me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And when trouble recedes, I shall share a thousand more moments with you, my love."
  - After: "And after, a thousand more moments, my love."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia shrugs uncertainly.{/n} "Perhaps I shall stay on your ship for a while longer, if you wish. I... do enjoy travelling among the stars of the Expanse. Or should I... should I return to the fold of the House at the next opportunity? Ah, I do not know."
  - After: {n}Cassia shrugs.{/n} "Stay on your ship? Return to the House? I don't know."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The throne of the Novator of House Orsellio has sat empty for too long. The machinations of the Great Regent, the feuding between the branches of the same family, the attempts on my life and yours, too... I must rectify these mistakes. And take what is rightfully mine."
  - After: "House Orsellio's Novator throne sat empty too long. I'll end the feuds and take what's mine."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have been running for too long, {name}. Hiding behind others while my home, my family... were being torn apart by hatred and strife. And what could a young, inexperienced girl do to those who were so desperate to either destroy me or bend me to their will?"
  - After: "I hid too long, {name}, while my family tore itself apart."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia looks distressed.{/n} "I... I think I should return to the fold of the House Orsellio and claim the Novator's throne... If my family has not already been torn apart by a bloody feud."
  - After: {n}Cassia looks distressed.{/n} "I should claim House Orsellio's Novator throne, if anything's left."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "My heart is fluttering, Lord Captain, but not because of fear or doubt. I... am ready to face what is coming."
  - After: "Not fear, Lord Captain. I'm ready."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia smiles bitterly.{/n} "The throne of the Novator of House Orsellio will no longer sit empty. But... my only regret is that I shall have to leave your ship and the darkness between the stars that I have come to love so much. I hope you will visit me, {name}."
  - After: {n}Cassia smiles bitterly.{/n} "I'll take House Orsellio's throne. Visit me, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia's palm gently rests on your cheek.{/n} "To be here with you, to share the last moments of peace before the inevitable... If either of us should die in the coming battle, know that I will look for you in the next life. Until I find you again."
  - After: {n}Cassia touches your cheek.{/n} "If either of us dies, I'll find you in the next life."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I see flashes of mottled colour swirling at your temples. Did you... want something?"
  - After: "Colours swirl at your temples. Want something?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I... only wish to spend as much time with you as fate has given us. Among the futures I see, it is the only one my heart can bear."
  - After: "I want all the time fate gives us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia shakes her head, laughing softly.{/n} "It would be wonderful, my love. But will the stars let us?"
  - After: {n}Cassia laughs softly.{/n} "Will the stars allow it, my love?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia nods courteously and smiles.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cassia nods and smiles.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia nods pensively.{/n} "It is time for the most important lesson of all, Lord Captain. Thanks to you, I am here and ready for anything."
  - After: {n}Cassia nods.{/n} "Thanks to you, Lord Captain, I'm ready."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia smiles demurely and curtsies in response.{/n} "I am honoured to be your companion, {name} von Valancius."
  - After: {n}Cassia curtsies.{/n} "Honoured, {name} von Valancius."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Until duty calls me... I would like to spend the best moments of my life with you, Lord Captain. And only the stars know what will happen next."
  - After: "Until duty calls, I'm yours, Lord Captain."

  - Before: {n}Idira sobs at your words.{/n} "I... thank you, Lord Captain. I can't imagine why you've shown me so much kindness, after everything we have been through... You are the only reason I'm still alive! There were so many ways I could've died..."
  - After: {n}Idira sobs.{/n} "Thank you. I'm only alive because of you!"

  - After: "You'll never be Lady Theodora, but she couldn't be you. I'm glad it's you. Now, change of subject!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am ready, Lord Captain. Just say the word."
  - After: "Ready. Say the word."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Idira's impassive expression momentarily shows a glimpse of emotion.{/n} "And I am glad to serve you, Lord Captain. You gave me what even Lady Theodora could not. You gave me a future. It is a great gift, and I intend to repay this debt in full."
  - After: {n}A flicker of emotion.{/n} "You gave me a future, as Lady Theodora couldn't. I'll repay it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If it were an easy battle, who would ever bother to tell tales about it? Nobody, that's who! Let's show 'em, Lord Captain."
  - After: "Easy battles make no tales! Let's show 'em."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Idira sobs fearfully, but in the next moment hugs you back.{/n} "There, there... You really have lost it, haven't you?" {n}She is silent for a few seconds and mutters something before letting you go.{/n} "Thanks."
  - After: {n}She hugs back.{/n} "There, there... You've lost it." {n}She lets go.{/n} "Thanks."

  - Before: {n}Idira greets you with a bustling chorus of voices, her own barely audible among them:{/n} "Lord Captain! You got my little voices all excited, they all want to crawl out of my throat to greet you. They can sense it, I bet. That it's the threshold of the final door. Your door. Will you risk stepping beyond it? Hey, have I already told you I'll follow you anywhere? Or does that one happen later?"

  - After: "The roads tangle... I can't choose for you! Walk on, it'll wind your way."

  - After: {n}Many-voiced laugh.{/n} "Will do! Reassembling myself, voice by voice..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Idira looks up at you with a disconnected expression and couples it with a fake smile. She smells of cheap amasec and stimulants.{/n} "Lord Captain. It'll all be over soon, won't it? Finally over..." {n}She falls silent for a long time.{/n} "I'm sorry, I haven't slept in days — the voices just won't leave me alone. I'll get over it. I won't let you down. I promise."
  - After: {n}Glassy-eyed, reeking of amasec.{/n} "Nearly over..." {n}Silence.{/n} "The voices won't let me sleep. I won't fail you."

  - Before: {n}Idira narrows her eyes warily, as if not fully convinced of your sincerity. Then her expression softens.{/n} "Thank you, Lord Captain. I guess you're the only reason I'm still alive — most people in your shoes would've killed the wild witch long ago. Though, well, we both know I don't have long." {n}She smiles darkly.{/n} "Well, no point in talking about the depressing stuff! Let's talk about our suicidal expedition instead!"

## World/Dialogs/Ch5/Farewell/JaeFarewell/JaeFarewell_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: [Kiss Jae] "Thank you for walking this long road with me."
  - After: [Kiss Jae] "Thanks for walking this road with me."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I just wanted to say that I am glad of your company. Especially now."
  - After: "I'm glad of your company now."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Cast aside your doubts. The Emperor protects!"
  - After: "Cast aside doubt. The Emperor protects!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am curious to see what you will do once all this is over."
  - After: "What will you do after this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Get a grip, Jae. We have a hard battle ahead of us."
  - After: "Get a grip, Jae. Hard battle ahead."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you afraid of what is to come, Jae?"
  - After: "Are you afraid, Jae?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whatever comes our way, we can handle it."
  - After: "We can handle whatever comes."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The Exalted One once wove our destinies into the glittering tapestry of this world with gold and silver thread, shereen. And today the pattern of our lives will either be completed..." {n}Jae snaps her metal fingers deliberately loudly.{/n} "Or the tapestry will be torn asunder. Personally, I prefer to place my hope in the first option."
  - After: "Today our fate completes, shereen..." {n}Jae snaps metal fingers.{/n} "Or tears. I hope the former."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Shereen, luminary of the Expanse and ruler of a thousand stars! On the fiery wings of your determination we have come to this abode of darkness... But will those not possessed of your radiance withstand the onslaught of the void?"
  - After: "Shereen, you led us here. Can those lacking your radiance survive the void?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae intertwines her fingers with yours, snuggles up to you and whispers in your ear,{/n} "To the Exalted One's throne or into a cold abyss, it matters not, my beloved. Wherever you go, I will follow."
  - After: {n}Jae whispers in your ear,{/n} "Throne or abyss, beloved, I'll follow."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I don't know, shereen. Being drunk on unbridled freedom sounds nice. It's so close — I could reach out and grab it like the tail of a comet... and leave the Kasballica Mission behind, start doing things on my own without having to rely on your good favour. Limitless possibilities lie ahead! I just have to... survive the coming darkness."
  - After: "Freedom, shereen. Leave the Kasballica Mission, need no one's favour. If I survive."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I think the best place for people like me is in the shadows, shereen. I know how the Kasballica Mission operates in the Expanse. And how desperately it needs talented intermediaries to work with the powers that be... How fortunate it is, then, that Jae Heydari possesses the Mercatum Tabula Officiale and is a trade representative of the Imperium." {n}The Cold Trader shoots you a self-satisfied smirk and winks.{/n}
  - After: "The Kasballica Mission needs intermediaries, and I hold a Mercatum Tabula Officiale." {n}Smug wink.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae raises a brow.{/n} "Did you or did you not grant me the honour of becoming your vassal, shereen? The right hand of the Rogue Trader — I will guard the prosperity of your protectorate as eagerly as I guard my own life."
  - After: {n}Raised brow.{/n} "I'm your vassal, shereen. I'll guard your protectorate."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "All the world lies open before me, shereen. If I wish, I will return to Footfall, to the Kasballica Mission and the Cold Trade. If you wish to keep me near, then that is where I'll remain. A free spirit, a free agent!" {n}Jae sings sweetly, but the turmoil in her eyes reveals her uncertainty about her own words.{/n}
  - After: "Footfall, the Kasballica Mission, or you, shereen. Free!" {n}Her eyes betray doubt.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae chuckles.{/n} "The Exalted One, you know, may have other designs on our souls. But what remains faithful beyond faith itself? We can but trust in His grace. The Emperor protects, shereen."
  - After: {n}Jae chuckles.{/n} "Trust His grace. The Emperor protects, shereen."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Shereen?" {n}Jae's solemn gaze is suddenly fixed on you.{/n} "Long have I followed you wherever you go, like the midnight moon striving to catch up with the morning star. How is it that in chasing after your light, I now find myself on the threshold of an unknown darkness, one in which a terrible enemy lurks?"
  - After: "Shereen?" {n}Solemn gaze.{/n} "Chasing your light led me to a darkness hiding a terrible enemy."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Wreathed in the righteous flame of the Exalted One, you have laid a path for your enemies through the starry darkness, shereen. And the battle between the stout-hearted and the heartless draws near." {n}Jae touches the gleaming Aquila on her chest.{/n} "Do you think fortune will favour us this time?"
  - After: "The battle nears, shereen." {n}She touches her Aquila.{/n} "Will fortune favour us?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ah, shereen, you found the most discreet and frugal words to wrap the passion I kindle in your heart. I am not endowed with such rhetorical perfection, so I will respond more ardently: I too am glad that the Exalted One wove our destinies together."
  - After: "So frugal, shereen! I'm glad our destinies were woven together."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Our alliance is like a miraculous oasis blooming in the fierce desert heat. I am glad to be your partner, and friend, and ally in the fight against the enemy."
  - After: "Glad to be your partner, friend and ally."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As long as you need me, shereen, I will be a smiting sword in your hand, a punishing scourge whistling over the heads of your enemies, or a loyal helping hand."
  - After: "While you need me, I'm your sword, scourge or helping hand."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Without you, I never would have reached heights that others only dare to dream of. Jae Heydari always repays good favour with loyalty — whole-hearted and unbreakable."
  - After: "You raised me high. Jae Heydari repays with unbreakable loyalty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Shereen, your words are like honey to my ears!"
  - After: "Shereen, your words are honey!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Rest assured, shereen — when it comes to matters of being and oblivion, Jae Heydari has the coldest mind and the bravest heart."
  - After: "Jae Heydari has the coldest mind and bravest heart, shereen."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The battle against the enemy? Pain? Oblivion?" {n}Jae smiles and shakes her head.{/n} "Oh no, shereen. My only fear is that, after these tribulations, we will never be the same again. And I do so enjoy being me."
  - After: "Death?" {n}She shakes her head.{/n} "I fear we'll be changed. I like being me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am not afraid of dying, shereen. I am afraid of staying alive only to discover that everyone else has perished in the darkness... So, do try to avoid any fatal wounds."
  - After: "I fear surviving alone. Avoid fatal wounds, shereen."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae shrugs vaguely.{/n} "Better a live void jackal than a dead but noble lion."
  - After: {n}Jae shrugs.{/n} "Better a live void jackal than a dead lion."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I fear you underestimate your own power, shereen. And overestimate the capabilities of ordinary mortals."
  - After: "You underestimate yourself, shereen. And overestimate mortals."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}After a pregnant pause, Jae continues in her usual playful manner:{/n} "So... what brings you to me, shereen? Not parting words, I hope? Because I despise goodbyes. I feel as though they rob me of my future. You never want to hear 'goodbye,' after all, but only ever 'see you again under the same stars!'"
  - After: {n}Playfully:{/n} "Not a goodbye, shereen? I despise them. Say 'see you under the same stars!'"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You mean if it's ever over? And if the azhi don't play their evil tricks on us?" {n}Jae raises an eyebrow and shrugs.{/n}
  - After: "If it's ever over? If the azhi allow?" {n}Jae shrugs.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae responds to the kiss with eagerness and passion.{/n} "You have become my very special friend, shereen. Try not to die on this expedition. I do not wish to weep over you."
  - After: {n}Jae kisses back hungrily.{/n} "You're special to me, shereen. Don't die."

## World/Dialogs/Ch5/Farewell/PasqalFarewell/PasqalFarewell_dialogue

  - After: "You seem calm about landing."

  - After: "A Repentia has no future. If I live, I'll fight on until I die."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I will carry on in my service to the Emperor as I always have. But no longer as a fledgling Sister of Battle, but as the keeper of a relic that has been bestowed upon me by His will. I want to bring light to all the faithful in the Koronus Expanse, as Saint Argenta did in her lifetime. And I know I am ready for this mission."
  - After: "As keeper of His relic, I'll light the Koronus Expanse like Saint Argenta."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I long to set out on a journey of my own. Forgive me for saying this, Rogue Trader, but I have followed you long enough. There are too many restraints, too many distractions — and meanwhile, thousands, millions of heretics out there have yet to be found and destroyed. I am the only Sister of Battle the Koronus Expanse has, which means I have much work to do."
  - After: "Forgive me, I've followed long enough. I'm the Expanse's only Sister of Battle; heretics await."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta looks caught off guard.{/n} "I haven't, no. I am just as lost as the day I first found myself in the Koronus Expanse and realised the sheer cruelty of the warp's trickery."
  - After: {n}Caught off guard.{/n} "No. I'm still lost."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am prepared. Now and always!"
  - After: "Prepared. Always!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I would not have reached the end of my path without you. So I say this without hiding it: I am just as glad to be fighting shoulder to shoulder with you!"
  - After: "I'd not be here without you. Glad to fight beside you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Oh yes, better to have me as an ally than an opponent! For no foe of mine can survive the wrath of the keeper of the great relic."
  - After: "Better an ally than a foe! None survive the relic-keeper."

## World/Dialogs/Ch5/Farewell/UlfarFarewell/UlfarFarewell_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You found your pack, and our campaign is nearing its end. What are you going to do next?"
  - After: "You found your pack, and the campaign's ending. What next?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am glad the Emperor brought our paths together."
  - After: "Glad the Emperor brought us together."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Xavier Calcazar is waiting for me down there. Should I give him your regards?"
  - After: "Xavier Calcazar awaits. Any regards for him?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am not a priest, of course, and the spirits do not always speak clearly to me, but I did cast the runes. You have a great challenge ahead of you, Aett-Vater. Be very careful, or better yet, take me with you. There is no better way to guard your safety."
  - After: "The runes say a great challenge awaits, Aett-Vater. Take me along."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I will return to my brothers and sing the saga of the Baleful Howl pack. I will carry it all the way to Fenris and pour its ringing verses into the ears of the Jarl and the Great Wolf himself. Its burning words will warm us during the fierce Helwinter." {n}Ulfar grins.{/n} "And the brothers at the table will nudge each other and point their fingers at me and say, 'It was he who crafted such a beautiful saga! How generous the Allfather has been to him!'"
  - After: "I'll carry the saga of the Baleful Howl pack to Fenris, to the Jarl and the Great Wolf." {n}Ulfar grins.{/n} "And my brothers will praise its maker!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar shrugs.{/n} "I will go wherever and ask every person I meet, 'Do you know the face of evil?' Then I will find that evil and kill it. Until I find someone who kills me. If you want to seek me out, follow the bloody trail in the snow. And should you find my cold body at the end, do me a favour and give me a proper burial, Aett-Vater."
  - After: {n}Ulfar shrugs.{/n} "I'll hunt evil until something kills me. If you find my body, bury me properly, Aett-Vater."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Fenrys hjolda, Aett-Vater." {n}Ulfar bows his head solemnly and respectfully, an untold honour granted to a mortal who has impressed the Emperor's Angel with {mf|his|her} deeds.{/n}
  - After: "Fenrys hjolda, Aett-Vater." {n}Ulfar bows, honouring {mf|his|her} deeds.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This only proves that we will not lose, Aett-Vater. Go into the foulest hole in the universe, where only lowborn and wretched inhumans crawl, fall into darkness, and then cry out, 'Who here believes in the Allfather, sisters and brothers?' And even there, in the world's most rotten pit, you will hear an answer, and if you reach toward the voice, you will find a worthy companion. Everyone who believes in him and follows in his footsteps is given the chance to become... someone greater and more worthy."
  - After: "Then we can't lose, Aett-Vater. Even in the foulest pit, call on the Allfather's faithful and one will answer."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Aett-Vater? Is your heart at ease? Does a dark foreboding gnaw at it? Just say the word, and I'll replace you at the head of the squad."
  - After: "Uneasy, Aett-Vater? Say the word, I'll lead the squad."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I would rather talk to him myself. My angry and vengeful heart tells me that only he knows how and why the Baleful Howl pack died. It also tells me that I will not forgive myself if that puffed-up arsehole Calcazar somehow dies before I rip the answers from his leering mouth."
  - After: "I'll ask him myself. Only he knows why the Baleful Howl pack died. Calcazar won't die before I rip the answers out."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar smiles, but it is a smile that belongs on a dead man's skull.{/n} "I will go as far as I can. Plunge into the darkest depths, into the lair of evil itself, and then... That is where my hunt will end so the hunt of the Beast can start. Do not follow me, Aett-Vater. Do not risk it."
  - After: {n}A dead man's smile.{/n} "Into evil's lair, where my hunt ends and the Beast's begins. Don't follow, Aett-Vater."

  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, shuttle ready, landing site secured. Launch?"

  - After: "Acknowledged. Glory to the von Valancius dynasty."

  - After: "As Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} commands."

  - After: "Shuttle ready, Lord Captain. Launch?"

  - After: "Awaiting orders."
- **(conversation owner)**

## World/Dialogs/Ch5/Farewell/YrlietFarewell/YrlietFarewell_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "But your spirit stone was shattered. Should you die, Slaanesh will devour you in an instant."
  - After: "Your spirit stone is shattered. Die, and Slaanesh takes you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Our journey together has not been an easy one. But I am glad that both of us are here today."
  - After: "A hard journey, but glad we're here."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Standing united against a common threat. Is it not what sentient creatures do?"
  - After: "Uniting against a common threat — natural."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Our fate will be decided in the coming battle."
  - After: "The battle decides our fate."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "{name}." {n}Yrliet's voice is soft and melodic, enveloping you with calm.{/n} "No matter what lies ahead, I will walk this path with you to the end. Such was my promise, and such is the will of my soul."
  - After: "{name}." {n}Soothing voice.{/n} "I'll walk with you to the end."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet looks at you, her emerald eyes shining with quiet determination.{/n} "When the Path my lost soul was following crumbled beneath my feet, shattered, plunged me into doubt... you were always there, elantach. Despite how much you hated my kind. Despite what my kin were doing. It is time for me to repay you in kind."
  - After: {n}Determined.{/n} "When my Path shattered, you stood by me, elantach. I'll repay you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet folds her arms in a welcoming gesture and greets you with a meaningful nod.{/n} "Each journey has a beginning and an end, elantach. Here and now... Our journey leads into the maw of a merciless enemy. And only by breaking through the darkness ahead can we move on."
  - After: {n}Yrliet nods.{/n} "We must break through the enemy, elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I have a different role to play in this world." {n}Yrliet touches the spirit stone and smiles faintly and strangely.{/n}
  - After: "I have another role." {n}She touches the spirit stone.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We are standing on the edge of a cliff, elantach. Darkness and struggle lie ahead of us, fear and doubts lie behind. I am ready to step into the unknown to end my journey and begin the next."
  - After: "Ready to end this journey and begin the next, elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet turns pale, but her eyes spark with even greater determination.{/n} "Then I will survive, {name}. And I will do everything I can to keep you alive, too."
  - After: {n}Pale, resolute.{/n} "Then I'll survive, {name}. You too."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "As we walk down the road of thorns, we acquire not only scars but priceless treasures also. To know a stranger's soul, your own must shine just as brightly. I saw the light of your soul, {name}. It will drive away the darkness before us."
  - After: "I saw your soul's light, {name}. It will drive back the darkness."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We both defended what we held dear, just as life has taught us. And today my soul is at peace, for we can share the pain of the coming battle between us so it is diminished."
  - After: "Shared, the coming pain is lessened."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Our travels were full of heartache and countless hardships, elantach. And so the darkness ahead does not frighten my weathered heart. Nor does it frighten you."
  - After: "After all that, elantach, darkness frightens neither of us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "True. A human and a Child of Asuryan... We will fight side by side like a pair of blades, and the enemies will fall before our fury."
  - After: "True. Human and Child of Asuryan, two blades."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet cocks her head in surprise.{/n} "I promised to walk your short human path alongside you, {name}."
  - After: {n}Surprised.{/n} "I promised to walk your path with you, {name}."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Some day they will, elantach. Exile opened my eyes to many things, but the Path of the Outcast weighs heavily on my heart. I think... that I see my new Path clearly now. It sings to me, calling me forward — the Path of the Warrior, the protector of those I could not save before. All that I have learned about the world, about humans, about you... I will take this knowledge into my new life. And into the lives of my kin."
  - After: "Someday, elantach. The Path of the Warrior calls me now, to guard those I failed. I'll bring what I learned of you to my kin."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet shudders.{/n} "I do not think I will wish to return to my kin soon, elantach. Will I even be able to? Perhaps I will join you in your quest to explore the distant stars. Perhaps..."
  - After: {n}She shudders.{/n} "Not soon, elantach. Perhaps I'll explore the stars with you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet averts her sad eyes.{/n} "I will look for those who are not ready to return to life on a craftworld. Those like myself. The future is too... vague. And my Path is leading me into the unknown."
  - After: {n}Sad eyes.{/n} "I'll seek other outcasts. My Path leads into the unknown."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Sometimes silence is the best answer. But is it really what you have come here for?"
  - After: "Silence answers. But is that why you came?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet's voice rings like naked steel:{/n} "I am ready to drive back the darkness, elantach. Are you?"
  - After: {n}Steel-voiced:{/n} "I'm ready, elantach. Are you?"

  - Before: [Attack] "We have nothing to discuss. Die."

  - Before: "What is going on here?"
  - After: "What's going on?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Shoot at the source of the Necron's speech] "That's enough blathering, you foul piece of scrap!"
  - After: [Shoot at the source of the Necron's speech] "Enough blathering, scrap!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The drawn-out metallic groans form a painful and melancholy melody, but one that oozes with venomous spite.{/n} "I exist again and I behold discord! An abominable sight! The hollow insides are ablaze!" {n}The grating roar is more like the sound of a metal torture instrument than {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NecronKnowlege}a sentient being's speech{/d}.{/n}
  - After: {n}Spiteful metallic groans.{/n} "I exist again! Conquerors brought low by pestilence! Corrosion!" {n}A grinding roar, barely {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NecronKnowlege}speech{/d}.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The drawn-out metallic groans form a painful and melancholy melody, but one that oozes with venomous spite. The armoured plates {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NoNecronKnowlege}sing in an unknown language{/d}, and you feel as though the meaning is on the verge of reaching your mind — unless the monster cuts your lives short before that. The grating roar is more like the sound of a metal torture instrument than a sentient being's speech.{/n}
  - After: {n}Spiteful groans. Its plates {d|Encyclopedia:Ch5_NoNecronKnowlege}sing in an unknown language{/d}.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Necron's screeching distantly resembles laughter, or perhaps sobs. {/n} "Rust does not have the privilege of witnessing noble metal perish! The destroyer shall be destroyed. The accursed one is sowing disease. The great and mighty do battle — the petty and worthless shall fall!"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Rust is rust. It devours one day and disappears the next. I shall unmanifest it! Annihilation!"
  - After: "Rust is rust. Annihilation!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The sound of the vibrating metal plates has both the rhythmic malice of a march and the hollow hum of misery — the lament of an immortal mechanism doomed to aeons of wrath and battle, or else an impending demise. The salvo from the monstrous cannon is an infernal orchestral chord that makes the very fabric of space tremble.{/n}

Once before. And I will do to you as I did to them: send you to the depths of your tomb."
  - After: "An ancient nightmare..." {n}Yrliet stares.{/n} "I've faced your kind, Oghyr. Back to your tomb."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The xenos lets out a metallic click, a semblance of laughter.{/n} "An ancient weapon that was broken in battles forgotten... worthless!"
  - After: {n}Metallic laugh.{/n} "A broken ancient weapon... worthless!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The vox-translator spits out several metallic sounds, and a new flash of anger makes the Necron's bulky body rumble.{/n} "Desecration of intelligent speech! I will sooner see it obliterated!"
  - After: {n}The Necron rumbles.{/n} "Desecration of speech! Obliterate it!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The skull-like head jerks, and for a few moments, a circular opening appears between the jaws, resembling a mouth open in astonishment. The wound closes with a terrifying, tremulous ringing. The deafening roar that follows sharply pierces you with pain. Blood starts seeping out of your ears.{/n}
  - After: {n}A hole gapes in its skull, then rings shut. Its roar makes your ears bleed.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The runts of the universe shall be eliminated! I rout them and I pulverise them into bloodied dust! I rid myself of them and of my sorrow! The cursed one will regret ever existing!" {n}The xenos starts to shake, from the armoured plates on its head down to the tail flaps of its grav-pad. The tremor causes the rock below it to crack and sink in.{/n}
  - After: "The runts shall be pulverised! The cursed one will regret existing!" {n}It shakes; rock cracks.{/n}

STATUS: Activate information panels."{/n}

The message has an attachment containing the astronomical coordinates of a planet along with some binharic code.{/n}

The vindictive machine spirit triumphantly displays a blinking prophetic message.{/n}

STATUS: Awaiting data input."{/n}
