  - Before: "If you were slightly less useful to me, I would have brought you to justice myself."
  - After: "Were you less useful, I'd bring you to justice myself."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How do I benefit from your gaining official status?"
  - After: "How do I benefit from your official status?"
- **Player**

- **Player**
  - Before: "That sounds simple enough. I will help you."
  - After: "Simple enough. I'll help."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you really think I care one jot about the travails of Kasballican scum?"
  - After: "You think I care about Kasballican scum?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shall take it into consideration."
  - After: "I'll consider it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Help me to establish cooperation with the Kasballica."
  - After: "Help me cooperate with the Kasballica."
- **Player**

  - After: "I want friendly relations with the Drusians."

  - Before: "I wouldn't mind having closer ties to the pirates of the Expanse."
  - After: "I'd like closer ties to the Expanse's pirates."

  - After: "As you will, shereen."

- **Jae**
  - Before: "If the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} put in a good word for me with the servants of the Adeptus Administratum, I could become an official trade representative of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}. - **Jae**
  - Before: "Exalted One forfend, could such a lowly servant of the Emperor use the radiant bearer of the Warrant, like some kind of tool! The other way around, however..."
  - After: "Use the Warrant's bearer? Never! The reverse, though..."

  - Before: "But you keep me around because you need my capabilities, shereen. And I can offer you more..."
  - After: "You need me, shereen. I can offer more..."

One contains a polished {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} rifle, a rare model, and the other holds an ornate sword.{/n} "I am sharing what I've gained with you — please accept these humble gifts in honour of our wildly successful, though suddenly struck, friendship."

The hot-headed pirates of the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g}? You merely need to use the right words, like a key for a lock, and people will open their hearts to you.   - After: "Meanwhile, any faction you'd court? {g|Encyclopedia:Drusians}Drusians{/g}? {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica{/g} pirates? Just ask, shereen."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I will humbly wait until you steer your vessel toward Dargonus! The Mercatum Tabula Officiale... It sounds almost as majestic as the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}!"
  - After: "To Dargonus, then! Almost as grand as the {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant of Trade{/g}!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And if you change your mind about my proposal, you can always find me nearby on the bridge. Just say the word and I'll come, shereen."
  - After: "Change your mind? I'm on the bridge."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Jae smiles bitterly.{/n} "Next time I will try to present you with a worthier gift."
  - After: {n}Jae smiles bitterly.{/n} "A worthier gift next time."

- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}An ancient-looking woman in a voluminous robe peers at you critically through her ocular lenses when you descend into the bowels of her bureaucratic domain.{/n} "Another noble bypassing the queue under the pretext of 'Just wanted to ask'?   - After: {n}An ancient woman peers at you.{/n} "Another noble skipping the queue to 'just ask'? What of protocol?"
- **Master of Seals**

Or do you think the Master of Seals has nothing better to do than receive unexpected visitors?" {n}The old woman beckons over a servo-skull floating nearby.{/n} "Begin entry — current hour, current turn, current cycle, 41st millennium." {n}Metal manipulators immediately begin feverishly clacking, taking dictation.{/n}

- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}Dumbfounded by your speech and splendour, the petitioners around you freeze, open-mouthed.{/n}
  - After: {n}The petitioners gape.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae continues in a whisper,{/n} "She's ancient enough herself... Look at her, she's a bona fide living mummy!"
  - After: {n}Jae whispers,{/n} "She's a living mummy!"
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "{name} von Valancius, sole heir of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Theodora von Valancius, may the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g}'s radiance guide her path on the other side." {n}In a practised move, the Master of Seals twists her magnifying ocular lens and examines the ledger in front of her.{/n} "The sole person to publicly assert their claim, to be precise."
  - After: "{name} von Valancius, heir of {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} Theodora, may the {g|Encyclopedia:GoldenThrone}Throne{/g} guide her." {n}She checks a ledger.{/n} "Sole claimant."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals nods in approval and stows the scroll into a tube labelled with your name.{/n} "Next is the consent form for the processing and notarisation of the personal data of your most sacred personage."
  - After: {n}She files it.{/n} "Next, data consent."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals peers over her ocular lenses at Jae in disbelief. Then she looks at you.{/n} "I take it you are her sponsor? In that case, you must submit a written application in conformity with template #404.01. As well as written permission for the processing and notarisation of the personal data of your most sacred personage. Without it, I cannot issue Mistress..."
  - After: {n}She eyes Jae.{/n} "You're her sponsor? Then file form #404.01 and data consent, or I cannot issue Mistress..."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "...Mistress Heydari the form for collecting the seals required to obtain the Mercatum Tabula Officiale — the certificate of an official trade representative."
  - After: "...Mistress Heydari the seal form for a Mercatum Tabula Officiale, a trade certificate."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals raises her eyebrows in surprise.{/n} "You are in the very heart of the Palace of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g}. Day and night, hundreds of thousands of prefects, ordinates, scribes, servants, and {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitors{/g} carry out their duties to Humanity and the von Valancius dynasty here, never setting foot outside its boundaries for decades at a time. But knowledge comes through comparison! There are entire worlds belonging to the Administratum, so this palace is but a humble cog in the blessed machine of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."
  - After: {n}She raises her eyebrows.{/n} "The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Adeptus Administratum{/g} Palace, where thousands of {g|Encyclopedia:Servitor}servitors{/g} toil. A cog in the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The old woman smacks her lips in satisfaction and nods curtly.{/n} "Of course I know who is standing before me. It is my job to know."
  - After: {n}She nods.{/n} "Of course I know you. It's my job."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia stares in puzzlement at the gleaming coin in her hand.{/n} "Ah, I... House Orsellio thanks you for your service, Master of Seals."
  - After: {n}Cassia stares at the coin.{/n} "Ah... House Orsellio thanks you."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Fear the wrath of the Immortal One, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! What would become of your protectorate or even the Imperium itself if every person did what you are proposing? No, Lex Imperialis, Volume 249, Paragraph 18/2, amendment of the twelfth year of the previous millennium clearly states: 'Actions that circumvent the sacred law of the Imperium in pursuit of personal gain are a manifestation of human weakness, which is subject to eradication.'"
  - After: "Fear His wrath, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Lex Imperialis, Volume 249, 18/2: evading law for gain must be eradicated."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "No. I have received no reports about you."
  - After: "No. No reports on you."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Hmph." {n}The old woman is intently writing in her large ledger, not paying you any attention.{/n}
  - After: "Hmph." {n}She ignores you.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Come on, esteemed damaar! What's that you were saying about seals?"
  - After: "Damaar! What about seals?"
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The old woman unhurriedly holds out a printed scroll to Jae.{/n} "Here is your document, Mistress Heydari. Unfortunately, it does not yet have legal force — I can certify it as a sacred Mercatum Tabula Officiale once it has received two seals of approval. They are easy to obtain — in the Imperium court Administratum servitors have been handling such tasks for over fifty years. There is one such servitor here on Dargonus in the Rogue Trader's palace. The second is duty-bound to keep the seal in the Telikos Epsilon System."
  - After: {n}She hands Jae a scroll.{/n} "It needs two servitor seals before I certify it: one in the Rogue Trader's palace on Dargonus, one in the Telikos Epsilon System."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "According to Amendment 3-C/8, implemented by Prefectus Estinia II of Dargonus, one of the seals must be kept in the palace of the ruler of the von Valancius protectorate, remaining a symbol of the unbreakable link between the sacred Warrant and the Adeptus Administratum."
  - After: "Amendment 3-C/8, by Prefectus Estinia II: one seal stays in the ruler's palace."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals nods with satisfaction.{/n} "Please do return once you have prepared the documents."
  - After: {n}She nods.{/n} "Return when ready."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae smiles obsequiously, trying to hide her disappointment.{/n} "Ah, shereen. If that is your will, who am I to defy it?"
  - After: {n}Jae hides her disappointment.{/n} "As you will, shereen."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Whatever you want, shereen, whatever it takes to satisfy you!"
  - After: "Whatever it takes, shereen!"
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "You must have two seals of approval affixed to the document with which I furnished you. It is easily done — in the Imperium, Administratum servitors have been performing the duties of certification officers for more than fifty years already. You will find one such servitor here on Dargonus in the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s palace. The second is duty-bound to keep the seal in the Telikos Epsilon System."
  - After: "Two seals: one servitor in the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}'s palace on Dargonus, one in Telikos Epsilon."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The ocular lenses on the old woman's nose emit a subtle hum as she adjusts the magnification.{/n} "Yes, oh yes, indeed, it is perfect! The seals are authentic, so we may continue with the certification procedure. Follow me, please."
  - After: {n}Her lenses hum.{/n} "Perfect, authentic seals! Follow me."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "This is your queue and your ticket number is..." {n}The old woman's ocular lenses hum as she zooms in on the paper in her hand.{/n} "...three hundred and ninety-four! When it is your turn to be seen, the ranking prefect will review your documentation again and sign the official certification for Jae Heydari to possess a Mercatum Tabula Officiale. You will have a bit of a wait, but it will be worth it in the end, yes?"
  - After: "Your ticket..." {n}Her lenses hum.{/n} "...394! Then the prefect signs Jae Heydari's certification."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals peers at you over her ocular lenses.{/n} "Hardly. In accordance with Decree DA-58, Clause 201, citizens of the capital world of the von Valancius protectorate must submit their petitions at one of the assigned windows of the waiting hall. The decree makes no mention of the Rogue Trader being exempt from this rule."
  - After: {n}She peers at you.{/n} "Hardly. Decree DA-58, Clause 201: citizens petition at the windows. No exemption."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Under the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g}, your rights and privileges as Rogue Trader come into effect only after your official accession ceremony. Until then, you are just another humble subject of the von Valancius protectorate."
  - After: "Per {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g}, your privileges start at your accession ceremony. Until then, you're a subject."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The old woman wrinkles her nose like she has tasted something unpleasant.{/n} "I suppose I could make an exception — but only because Theodora von Valancius never once overlooked the laws of the Imperium or my advice! Here." {n}She holds out a new ticket with the number 301.{/n} "May His blessing be upon you."
  - After: {n}She grimaces.{/n} "For Theodora's sake, then." {n}She hands you ticket 301.{/n} "His blessing."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The old woman nods pensively.{/n} "That is your right."
  - After: {n}She nods.{/n} "Your right."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "The temple of law and order greets you, {name} von Valancius. You have returned with all the necessary paperwork, I presume?"
  - After: "Welcome back, {name} von Valancius. Paperwork ready?"
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Unfortunately, your previous place in the queue has not been held for you. If you wish to wait your turn, you will have to join the end of the queue."
  - After: "Your place wasn't held. Back of the queue."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Then I bid you good day. May the law and the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} keep you."
  - After: "Good day. The law and the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} keep you."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen, I know the azhi have thwarted our plans, and that unforeseen circumstances have arisen like... like... never mind. So the esteemed damaar wants us to fill in a couple of forms? I will do that with great pleasure!"
  - After: "Shereen, a couple forms? Gladly!"
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The colourless eyes of the Master of Seals suddenly fix on Cassia.{/n} "A Lady Navigator of House Orsellio whose name and deeds are unknown to me..." {n}She points her finger at the old ledger.{/n} "It says here that the von Valancius dynasty has owed your House one gold throne for thirty Terran years. Here, take this. And I, at last, will mark the matter closed."
  - After: {n}She eyes Cassia.{/n} "House Orsellio..." {n}She taps the ledger.{/n} "The dynasty owes your House one gold throne, thirty years now. Take it."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals looks over Jae's form, which has been rewritten four times already.{/n} "At last, you succeeded in completing the form without any errors. Next, protocol requires consent for the processing and notarisation of the personal data of {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}."
  - After: {n}Jae's fourth draft.{/n} "No errors, finally. Now consent for {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship}'s data."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Abelard Werserian," {n}The old woman directs her gaze over your shoulder.{/n} "Seneschal and right hand of the now departed Theodora von Valancius. And of her now extant heir."
  - After: "Abelard Werserian," {n}she looks past you.{/n} "Theodora's seneschal. Now her heir's."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae holds out the scroll, now covered in writing, for you to reinforce the words with the von Valancius coat of arms seal. Only now do you notice that the plebian expression 'chicken scratch writing' describes her gnarled penmanship absurdly accurately.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae hands you the scroll to seal. Her handwriting is chicken scratch.{/n}
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The scroll is whipped away into another tube by the Master of Seals.{/n} "Protocol executed. Application received. Processed. Approved." {n}The servo-skull scribe taps out each word after its mistress's pronouncement.{/n}
  - After: {n}She tubes the scroll.{/n} "Approved." {n}The servo-skull taps it out.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader, shereen, we've almost finished! Just two more piddling seals and, Exalted One knows, a full-fledged trade representative will be standing beside you in the darkness of the Expanse like a true comrade!" {n}Jae brings her hands together in a pleading gesture and smiles innocently.{/n}
  - After: "Almost done, shereen! Two seals and you'll have a true trade representative!" {n}Jae smiles innocently.{/n}
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Wonderful. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} blessed you with patience greater than that apportioned to ordinary mortals. Allow me to verify the authenticity of your documents — for the final time."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} gave you patience. Let me verify your documents, one final time."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "That's not even mentioning the fact that said humble subject is accompanied by a xenos." {n}The gaze of the Master of Seals latches onto Yrliet.{/n} "Given that your official induction has yet to take place, you are, technically speaking, performing an act of heresy here and now, in front of dozens of witnesses."
  - After: "And a xenos." {n}She eyes Yrliet.{/n} "Before induction, that's heresy."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet gives you a look.{/n} "So you, elantach, have not yet gone through the initiation rite that grants you all your privileges after all? I regret to see that a lie has passed between us."
  - After: {n}Yrliet looks at you.{/n} "No rite yet, elantach? So you lied to me."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Ahh, {name} von Valancius, you have returned! I hope the sacred document I entrusted to you last time has now successfully passed through the approval procedure?"
  - After: "{name} von Valancius! Has my document passed approval?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard lets out a stoic sigh and rolls his eyes. You get the feeling that this is not his first personal interaction with the Administratum bureaucracy, nor is it his second.{/n}
  - After: {n}Abelard sighs, a bureaucracy veteran.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "There was a time during my earlier years of service when I performed the duties of a secretary in charge of logistics reports at a local Administratum office. Your words, Master of Seals, bring back memories of which I am not the least bit fond."
  - After: "I once wrote Administratum logistics reports. Unfond memories."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira stares at Jae in surprise and lets out a whistle.{/n} "Well, that came out of nowhere..."
  - After: {n}Idira whistles.{/n} "Out of nowhere..."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Yes, yes, please do. I have three hundred petitioners to see after you today."
  - After: "Do. Three hundred petitioners await."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "I am the Master of Seals, the only one in your protectorate, for that matter." {n}The old woman sighs wearily, and then carefully wipes her fogged ocular lenses with a trembling hand.{/n}
  - After: "I'm the Master of Seals, your protectorate's only one." {n}She wipes her lenses.{/n}
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals animatedly draws her cogita-quill across the surface of a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}, paying no attention to you.{/n}
  - After: {n}She writes on a {g|Encyclopedia:Dataslate}data-slate{/g}, ignoring you.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, shereen, it's just another piece of paper! Say the word and I will take care of it just like the first one."
  - After: "Just paper, shereen! I'll handle it."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals respectfully inclines her head.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. So the law dictates."
  - After: {n}She bows.{/n} "Yes, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. So says the law."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix smiles wryly.{/n} "Understandable, though, given the circumstances."
  - After: {n}Heinrix smiles wryly.{/n} "Understandable."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Then, I'm afraid, Mistress Heydari will never receive her much-desired certificate. And I will be obliged to levy a fine against your noble name — for wasting the valuable time of the Master of Seals."
  - After: "Then no certificate. And a fine for wasting my time."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Of course, the {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}fame{/d} of your deeds has reached the walls of this temple of the Imperium's law and will. And yet the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g}..." {n}The expression on the Master of Seals's face undergoes an indescribable metamorphosis — various moral impulses are warring within her, her lips moving soundlessly. Then she nods several times to herself.{/n}
  - After: "Your {d|Encyclopedia:CharGen_MOT_Glory}fame{/d} reached here. Yet the {g|Encyclopedia:LexImperialis}Lex Imperialis{/g}..." {n}She wavers, then nods.{/n}
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The old woman holds the documents close so that they are almost touching her nose, her mechanical ocular lenses clicking incessantly.{/n} "Yes. Yes. Confirmed. Everything is in order. And this one. Ah, the seal is smudged slightly..."
  - After: {n}Lenses clicking, she inspects them.{/n} "In order. Ah, a smudged seal..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The perfectly sharpened quill scratches pleasantly on the parchment, but for the first few minutes. The obfuscatory phrasing, footnotes, amendments... You are forced to write out the same details over and over — about you, the protectorate, Theodora von Valancius, Jae... and then also every living person who bears your family name. If you do not know all the required information, you must complete supplementary forms.{/n}
  - After: {n}Endless footnotes and amendments. You repeat details on yourself, Theodora, Jae, every relative...{/n}
- **Master of Seals**

If I find a defect in the next one, you will have to repeat the application procedure from the start."
  - After: "Take another." {n}She hands you a scroll.{/n} "Another defect and you restart."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "The second seal..." {n}The ocular lenses perched on her nose click as she rifles through mouldering scrolls with her wrinkled fingers.{/n} "...is held in the Telikos Epsilon System in accordance with decree OL-008/ZN. Unfortunately, after a fire two hundred years ago, all that remains of the original decree is an addendum certified by an unknown adept with the initials A.A. No instructions repealing this decree were ever received from Holy Terra, therefore the seal remains where it ought to be."
  - After: "The second seal..." {n}She rifles scrolls.{/n} "...stays in Telikos Epsilon per decree OL-008/ZN, known only from a fire-scarred addendum by adept 'A.A.'."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "Decree 424, Clause 79, Amendment 8 of the Law on Certifying a Mercatum Tabula Officiale With Sponsorship of a Bearer of the Warrant of Trade: 'The sponsoring Rogue Trader must be present at the placing and certifying of each seal.   - After: "Decree 424, Clause 79, Amendment 8: the sponsoring Rogue Trader must attend each sealing, or it's invalid."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae's smile evaporates, revealing her true emotions.{/n} "Void scorpions scratch out my eyes, now what?"
  - After: {n}Jae's smile vanishes.{/n} "Void scorpions take my eyes, now what?"
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "...Hmm, I suppose I can overlook it, given that the rest has been certified correctly and promptly. Congratulations, Jae Heydari, you are now the holder of a Mercatum Tabula Officiale. Do not forget to repeat the certification process every one hundred Terran years.   - After: "...I'll overlook it. Jae Heydari, you hold a Mercatum Tabula Officiale. Recertify every century. Uphold {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} law in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Koronus Expanse{/g}."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "And one more thing — loss of the certificate is a grievous transgression, Mistress Heydari. Lose the original document, and you will be unable to regain your status as an official trade representative. Not even with the Rogue Trader's endorsement."
  - After: "Lose the original, Mistress Heydari, and the status is gone forever."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah surveys the room and slowly removes her hand from the handle of her weapon.{/n} "There is only one thing that can kill you here, Domin'{name}, and that is old age."
  - After: {n}Kibellah lowers her hand.{/n} "Only old age can kill you here, Domin'{name}."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}The Master of Seals tuts in displeasure.{/n} "One would think the protectorate's heir has no care for {mf|his|her} tongue, if {mf|he|she} is so willing to wag it to the point of blistering. However, I, despised servant of the Emperor that I am, do not possess the gift of unallocated time. Let us proceed to the matter of your application."
  - After: {n}She tuts.{/n} "The heir wags {mf|his|her} tongue as if {mf|he|she} had time. I don't. Your application."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "Just one strike. Not in His name, not by His will — merely for myself. Would it be a grave trespass, I wonder? No, I must banish such thoughts."
  - After: "One strike, for me alone. No, banish the thought."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}At these words, the saccharine smile drops from Jae's face.{/n} "Seals? What seals?"
  - After: {n}Jae's smile drops.{/n} "Seals? What seals?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae glances at you and whispers,{/n} "What? So I paid off a few clerks to let us skip the queue, shereen. Your time is more important to me than any little formalities."
  - After: {n}Jae whispers,{/n} "I bribed clerks to skip the queue. Your time matters more."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: "We will discuss that when {name} von Valancius has prepared the primary documentation."
  - After: "Later, once {name} von Valancius prepares the primary documents."
- **Master of Seals**
  - Before: {n}She mutters something waspishly under her breath, ignoring your question entirely.{/n}
  - After: {n}She mutters, ignoring you.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae shifts, deliberately putting her jewelled {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetic{/g} on display.{/n} "Does that mean that my reputation has preceded me as well, esteemed damaar?"
  - After: {n}Jae flaunts her jewelled {g|Encyclopedia:Augmentation}augmetic{/g}.{/n} "Did my reputation precede me too, damaar?"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q1/NamelessClerk/NamelessClerk_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "I trust you will take me to the certification officer directly?"
  - After: "Take me straight to the certification officer?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I require a blank form for the Mercatum Tabula Officiale."
  - After: "I need a blank Tabula form."
- **Deputy Prefect**
  - Before: {n}The scrawny man pales and leaps to attention at your approach.{/n} "R-R-Rogue Trader! Honoured to be of service! I am the second in line to temporarily carry out the duties of the Master of Seals. How m-may I help you?"
  - After: {n}A scrawny man pales.{/n} "R-Rogue Trader! I'm the second deputy Master of Seals. Yes?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "O-of course! So the law dictates. Unfortunately, you will have to join the very end of the queue, for there is no route to the certification officer but through humility and acceptance."
  - After: "O-of course! But join the end of the queue."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! It will be my honour!"
  - After: "Certainly, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **Deputy Prefect**
  - Before: {n}The prefect blinks in surprise.{/n} "Oh, you are the eleventh person today who has failed to submit their documents for certification within the validity period. I will pass it up the chain that we need to review our arrangements for managing petitioner flow. Or perhaps add a few extra hours to the certification officers' shifts? Hmm..."
  - After: {n}He blinks.{/n} "Eleventh late filing today. We need longer shifts..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "May the power of the law and the light of the Throne be upon you!"
  - After: "Law and Throne be with you!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The prefect's knees are knocking together in terror.{/n} "I'm afraid... I'm afraid I cannot do that, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Strictly speaking, you have not officially assumed the title of Rogue Trader after the death of Lady Theodora von Valancius. And within these walls, it is one rule for everyone..." {n}After uttering these last words, the man shrinks back and deliberately avoids looking you in the eye.{/n}
  - After: {n}His knees knock.{/n} "I c-can't, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You're not officially Rogue Trader yet. One rule for all..." {n}He shrinks back.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Wonderful, wonderful!" {n}The prefect nervously rummages in the drawers and retrieves what must be the gilded quill and red ink of the Master of Seals.{/n} "Aaand... there we are. In the name of the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, your application has been approved. Initiation of the new trade representative has been performed. The status is hereby confirmed."
  - After: "Wonderful!" {n}He grabs a gilded quill.{/n} "In the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s name, approved. Trade representative confirmed."
- **Deputy Prefect**
  - Before: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! You're back already."
  - After: "Y-Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}! Back already."
- **Deputy Prefect**
  - Before: {n}The prefect catches your look, pales slightly, and hurriedly shakes his head.{/n} "But that is neither here nor there! Here is your new petitioner form."
  - After: {n}He pales at your look.{/n} "Never mind! Your new form."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q1/Queue

- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen... You're a saint, have I told you that before? You must be, because I don't see any other reason why you would show such fervent but senseless patience. Can't we hurry things along?"
  - After: "Shereen, you're a saint, so senselessly patient. Can't we hurry?"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q1/Queue/Queue_JaeQ1_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "How dare a prefect's property try to make use of its own life! Get away — back to your master!"
  - After: "A prefect's property? Back to your master!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do not forget — you are the reason we are here."
  - After: "You are the reason we are here."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your paltry problems are no concern of mine. Begone!"
  - After: "Not my concern. Begone!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I've had it with this bureaucratic nonsense. We're leaving."
  - After: "Enough bureaucratic nonsense. We're leaving."
- **Player**
  - Before: "In the name of House von Valancius, I hereby make your fiancée a lady of the court. And release her from any obligations thereto."
  - After: "Your fiancée is now a von Valancius court lady, free of its duties."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You wish to study alongside your beloved? Very well. I hereby grant you ownership of the Dargonus University of Medicae — you may admit anyone you like."
  - After: "I grant you the Dargonus University of Medicae. Admit whoever you like."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Perhaps we shall return another time."
  - After: "We'll return another time."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Fine. I shall endure this for the good of the von Valancius protectorate."
  - After: "Fine. I'll endure it for the protectorate."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shall stay, but only because I enjoy hearing your pleas."
  - After: "I'll stay, but only to enjoy your pleas."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Are you going to make the Rogue Trader repeat {mf|himself|herself}?"
  - After: "Must the Rogue Trader repeat {mf|himself|herself}?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "So be it. We shall stay."
  - After: "So be it. We stay."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will have my people buy your granddaughter's release and see to your welfare."
  - After: "I'll buy your granddaughter's release and see to your welfare."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You do not have to die, old man. If she has been taken out of service, then the time has come to release her."
  - After: "You needn't die. If she's out of service, release her."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will give the order for your granddaughter to be repaired, but if you wish to be with her forever, you will also be subject to Servitude Imperpituis."
  - After: "I'll have her repaired, but staying with her means Servitude Imperpituis for you too."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This should suffice to cover your expenses."
  - After: "This should cover your expenses."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I suppose you must remarry, then? I shall have my people select the best spouse for you."
  - After: "Then remarry. I'll pick your spouse."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Frighten the people. These worms should bow down in terror before their {mf|master|mistress} and let us through."
  - After: "Frighten them into bowing to their {mf|master|mistress}."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We shall solve the problems of the common people."
  - After: "We'll solve the commoners' problems."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Whatever you are thinking — do it."
  - After: "Whatever you're thinking — do it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Heinrix, this is a perfect opportunity to make use of your privileged status. After all, you do not wish to suspend your mission for several cycles, do you?"
  - After: "Heinrix, use your status, or your mission waits for cycles."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Sister Argenta, I believe these people have been gripped by despondency. A sermon from one of His daughters could restore to them their determination."
  - After: "Sister Argenta, a sermon could lift these people's despair."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Idira, can you use psykana to persuade the petitioners that they must leave the queue?"
  - After: "Idira, can psykana make the petitioners leave?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Yrliet, I need you to serve as a distraction."
  - After: "Yrliet, I need you as a distraction."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Open fire on the crowd] "Why go to any effort when I can simply shoot everyone here?"
  - After: [Open fire on the crowd] "Why not just shoot everyone?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am sorry about your daughter, but if you do not let me past, tomorrow fifty Dargonian orphans will die!"
  - After: "Let me past, or fifty Dargonian orphans die tomorrow!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not think your daughter would mind if you let the Rogue Trader go ahead of you."
  - After: "Your daughter wouldn't mind you letting me ahead."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why don't I simply pay you and you give me your place in the queue?"
  - After: "I'll pay you for your place."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I see. Well, good luck to you and your daughter."
  - After: "Good luck to you and your daughter."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have no interest in your little drama. I will sign the paper if you require a sponsor."
  - After: "Spare me the drama. I'll sign as sponsor."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The lives of commoners hold no value. When you finish university, you will be qualified to save those who are truly worthy."
  - After: "Commoners are worthless. Graduate and save the worthy."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We need to move forward faster. Use your tricks."
  - After: "We must move faster. Use your tricks."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Solomorne, do you think a wanted criminal could blend into this crowd?"
  - After: "Solomorne, could a wanted criminal blend into this crowd?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your sacrifice will mean nothing to a servitor — you do realise that?"
  - After: "Your sacrifice will mean nothing to a servitor, you realise?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Wait patiently] "Gird your faith, sister. For it is only through patience and humility that true wisdom comes."
  - After: [Wait patiently] "Patience and humility bring wisdom, sister."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Eogunn, care to treat the commoners to a lecture on the importance of upholding the tenets of the Omnissiah?"
  - After: "Eogunn, lecture the commoners on the Omnissiah's tenets?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Perhaps I can rebuild this hat shop of yours?"
  - After: "Perhaps I could rebuild your hat shop?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "And what you want is a life that is meaningless and full of despair? Perhaps it is time you turned to faith, sister?"
  - After: "Life feels meaningless? Turn to faith, sister."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shall do everything in my power."
  - After: "I'll do all I can."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I want to consider everything again."
  - After: "I want to reconsider everything."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The queue hums with thousands of voices. Someone has rolled out bedding and is settling down to sleep; someone is playing some bizarre musical instrument; many are praying. Several highborn petitioners are debating who is here on the most important business.{/n}
  - After: {n}The queue hums with prayers and arguing nobles.{/n}
- **Jae**

  - After: "Throne, three places in all this time! We'll grow old here, shereen." {n}Jae wails.{/n}
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}Only now do you notice the tattoo on his right hand: the symbol of the Adeptus Administratum and several interlocking chains. It seems this old fellow is the property of a prefect of this palace.{/n}
  - After: {n}His chain tattoo marks him as a prefect's property.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Humility, acceptance, meekness... Those are the qualities that I entirely lack, shereen." {n}Jae smiles acidly and leaves you alone with your thoughts.{/n}
  - After: "Humility? Not mine, shereen." {n}Jae smiles acidly.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You wound me, shereen! Jae Heydari always has a better idea. What would you say to making the good folk ahead of us hurry up a little? Just a smidge." {n}Her eyes dart playfully over the faces of the people around you.{/n}
  - After: "Always! Let's hurry the folk ahead along." {n}Jae eyes the crowd.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You have to admit, the magnificent administrative machinery of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} isn't without its rough edges..." {n}Jae smiles sheepishly, eying the queue.{/n} "But what a thrilling adventure this is turning out to be, shereen! I've never seen anything like it before... And sometimes it's good to take a break from constant travelling. And to give all the hot-blooded newcomers a chance to cover themselves in glory without us in the way."
  - After: "The {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s machinery has rough edges..." {n}Jae smiles sheepishly.{/n} "But what an adventure, shereen!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And that was the will of the Exalted One, shereen!" {n}Jae throws up her arms and lowers her head.{/n} "And the Exalted One has granted me insight as to how, with a simple wave of your hand and a few wise words, we can ease our arduous wait."
  - After: "The Exalted One's will! And He showed me a shortcut." {n}Jae beams.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Wasting the Inquisition's time on this foolishness, it's simply unthinkable!" {n}Wearied by the long wait, Heinrix is rereading confidential reports on his data-slate for the tenth time.{/n}
  - After: "Wasting the Inquisition's time!" {n}Heinrix rereads his data-slate.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Unconstructive expenditure of temporal resources recorded. Recommended resolution: return to initial mission."
  - After: "Time wasted. Recommend: return to mission."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The minutes drag by intolerably slowly. Somewhere in the queue, a child is howling at the top of its lungs, the palace adepts are sedately moving documents from one pile to another, shuffling papers. Several petitioners have gathered in a huddle and are swapping rumours, while someone has laid down for a nap on a nearby bench.{/n}
  - After: {n}Minutes crawl. A child howls; adepts shuffle papers.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You have whiled away thirty seconds of your wait. You wonder how long you have left to go.{/n}
  - After: {n}Thirty seconds pass.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The people are constantly moving, coming and going, changing places or simply disappearing from view. On your first attempt, you count two hundred and thirty-eight petitioners. On your second attempt, you count two hundred and forty-four. On your third attempt, the next batch of unlucky souls is ushered into the hall, and you lose count.{/n}

- **Young Worker**
  - Before: {n}The young man in worn work overalls comports himself with unusual grace for a commoner.{/n} "My {mf|lord|lady}, I have been in this queue for two dozen moons already, trying to get a permission slip to wed my fiancée Zazi. Unfortunately, the servants of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} refuse to grant it without the signature of a highborn sponsor..."
  - After: {n}A graceful worker.{/n} "My {mf|lord|lady}, I've waited two dozen moons to wed Zazi, but the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptusAdministratum}Administratum{/g} wants a highborn sponsor."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You feel the envious eyes of the other petitioners upon you, but no one dares to do anything more than stare.{/n}
  - After: {n}Envious stares, nothing more.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "O shereen, my sponsor, my heaven-sent light of hope, my guiding star! Please, do not abandon our mission when we have almost reached our goal!"
  - After: "Shereen, my guiding star! Don't quit now!"
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}After allowing you a brief pause, a hunched ragamuffin approaches you. The old man's toothless mouth breathes out a putrefying cloud of air as he speaks only three words:{/n} "Death-th-th... f-f-for life..."

- **Young Worker**
  - Before: {n}The young man considers this for a few minutes, and then rips up his piece of paper.{/n} "You are right. There is no honour in dragging back trollops and drunks from the edge of death. Or self-indulgent nobles, for that matter." {n}He looks coldly at his mother.{/n} "I was born to save lives.   - After: {n}He tears up the paper.{/n} "You're right." {n}He eyes his mother.{/n} "I'll save lives in the {g|Encyclopedia:AstraMilitarum}Imperial Guard{/g}."
- **Young Worker**
  - Before: {n}The young man spends several seconds opening and closing his mouth in shock.{/n} "T-that means... our marriage will finally be certified?   - After: {n}He gapes.{/n} "Our marriage certified, and Zazi a chirurgeon? Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}! Take my place."

  - Before: "No, Steffo, that's not what I— stop! Please! Think about this!"
  - After: "No, Steffo— stop! Think about this!"
- **Young Worker**
  - Before: {n}The young man blinks in astonishment.{/n} "W-what? Y-yes, of course! That is just what I'll do! Thank you for your generosity, my {mf|lord|lady}! This... this is a miracle!"
  - After: {n}He blinks.{/n} "Y-yes! Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}! A miracle!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Ah, if I had known that before, shereen, I would have offered up my pleas for your delectation every day!"
  - After: "Had I known, I'd plead daily!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Definitely not! I'll gather my things and depart with you this instant..."
  - After: "Certainly not! I'll leave at once..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "For the great dynasty von Valancius!" {n}Jae echoes your words and sighs in relief.{/n}
  - After: "For the great dynasty von Valancius!" {n}Jae sighs, relieved.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae surveys the queue sadly.{/n} "Do you think the next time will be better?"
  - After: {n}Jae eyes the queue sadly.{/n} "Next time, then?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Oh, thank you, shereen! And we only have... a short while left to wait."
  - After: "Thank you! Only... a short wait left."

- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The man covers his face with his hands and shakes with soundless sobs.{/n} "Past t-t-time."
  - After: {n}He sobs into his hands.{/n} "Past t-t-time."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I'll be honest, shereen, I already tried to convince Heinrix to use his Interrogator's rosette, with sweet words and pretty songs I cajoled and wheedled. But he... remains unmoved, like a rock whipped by the winds. Perhaps he will be more amenable to a request from you?"

  - Before: "You could also ask Idira to use her talent... On second thought, no, that could be more disastrous than a suddenly erupting volcano, shereen. Forget it."

  - Before: "Well, that was... amusing. I paid off the last few onlookers who were willing to give up their place. It's a pity they aren't all so amenable."
  - After: "Amusing. I bought out the few willing sellers."
- **Wealthy Lady**
  - Before: {n}The woman's beleaguered eyes sparkle to life.{/n} "Why, that's a wonderful idea! Please, take my place in the queue here, I insist. I will leave my details with your retinue and go!"
  - After: {n}Her eyes brighten.{/n} "Wonderful! Take my place; I'll leave my details!"
- **Wealthy Lady**

  - After: "Ironic. They revere {mf|him|her}, then meet {mf|him|her} unrecognised."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Look at this, shereen!" {n}Jae is waving her hand in the air, clutching a dozen queue tickets.{/n} "It went just as I expected. Well... almost."
  - After: "Look!" {n}Jae waves a dozen tickets.{/n} "As expected. Almost."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You do not need to tell me twice, shereen. All is fair in love and bureaucracy..."
  - After: "Gladly. All's fair in love and bureaucracy..."
- **Menas**
  - Before: {n}Menas's fleshy face tenses at your words.{/n} "B-but, well... The time! And I've been... Oh, of course. Of course, it would be an honour for the de Pyrr family. Please, go ahead, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: {n}Menas tenses.{/n} "B-but... of course. An honour. Go ahead, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I doubt the Exalted One will be much help to us if we're going to change tack like that without warning, shereen. We're not going to get any ticket now — at least, not using these methods. I can sniff out an easy mark a mile away — and in this hall there was only one."
  - After: "Change tack like that and the Exalted One won't help. This hall had only one easy mark."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae inspects the tickets she now holds and nods with satisfaction.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae checks her tickets, pleased.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Not as smoothly done as it could have been... But you certainly have a style all your own, shereen! What now?"
  - After: "Not smooth, but stylish, shereen! What now?"
- **Menas**
  - Before: "Thank you, thank you! And may the Emperor aid you in your petition as well!"
  - After: "Thank you! Emperor aid your petition too!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You were thinking about it as well?" {n}Argenta's gaze is as clear as the midday sky.{/n} "Words of faith can heal any wound, even those that bleed naught but doubt. I will help these people."
  - After: "You too?" {n}Argenta nods.{/n} "Faith heals doubt. I'll help them."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "A wise decision, shereen! Cold Traders always say: if you can solve a problem with hard cash, then that's just the cost of doing business!"
  - After: "Wise! If cash solves it, it's just business!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae catches your eye and lays her hand on the shoulder of a weary-looking man.{/n} "May the Emperor illuminate your path, brother! I am Jae, and this is {name}. We've been in the queue so long already, we're all practically family now — won't you tell us what brought you to the palace of order?"
  - After: {n}Jae touches a weary man's shoulder.{/n} "Brother! I'm Jae, this is {name}. What brings you here?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Casting his eyes over the waiting hall, Heinrix heaves a resigned sigh.{/n} "It would be unpardonable to waste so much time here."
  - After: {n}Heinrix sighs.{/n} "Wasting this much time is unpardonable."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}A cold smile touches the Interrogator's lips.{/n} "If the Rogue Trader wishes to spend {mf|his|her} time helping someone whose every act is a challenge to the Imperium's will in this part of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}... I can only conclude that we are not anxious to be anywhere else. And so I have no reason to resort to similar acts, thereby sullying the sacred symbols of the Inquisition."
  - After: {n}Heinrix smiles coldly.{/n} "The Rogue Trader spends {mf|his|her} time aiding a rebel of the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}? Then no hurry. I won't sully my rosette."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Of course, Lord Captain! Let's go for a poke around in those empty little heads..."
  - After: "Of course, Lord Captain! Let's poke those empty heads..."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g}'s clear gaze surveys the crowd.{/n} "Elantach, I will do this, but only because you helped me to leave Janus. If any mon-keigh tries to touch me, I will end them as ruthlessly as one uproots a weed."
  - After: {n}The {g|Encyclopedia:Aeldari}Aeldari{/g} nods.{/n} "For freeing me from Janus, Elantach. Any mon-keigh who touches me dies."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "I heard your conversation with the ransacker of the sacred places of my ancestors. My answer is no. I will not help her, not as long as the stars overhead still glitter, and not before the sky above becomes the land underneath my feet."
  - After: "Help that plunderer of my ancestors' shrines? Never."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You have an interesting way of doing business, shereen. I'll keep that in mind." {n}Jae's shrewd eyes are alight with interest as she watches the young petitioner leave.{/n}
  - After: "Interesting business style, shereen." {n}Jae watches the youth leave.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The next eight hours pass surprisingly peacefully — nothing unusual happens, all the certification officers are at their windows and are accepting petitioners, and you have even started growing accustomed to the sounds and smells of this place.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eight more quiet hours pass.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You greeted the dusk and dawn from your place in the queue, observing the shifting rays of the Mundis Valancius through the windows of the palace. The night passed peacefully — the certification officers left for their beds and servitors took their place. Unfortunately, servitors cannot process all petitioner requests, so at night the queue moved even more slowly.{/n}
  - After: {n}A night passes. Servitors replace the officers; the queue slows further.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Interesting... So that is how the ruler of worlds and all the stars in the sky acts when {mf|he|she} finds an unfortunate on the edge of {mf|his|her} magnificent orbit." {n}Jae nods pensively and beckons the next petitioner forward.{/n}
  - After: "So that's what {mf|he|she} does with a wretch in {mf|his|her} orbit." {n}Jae calls the next.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Today the entire capital is celebrating the birthday of your ancestor — Miltiades Orest Theon von Valancius, who discovered and colonised Kiava Gamma. In every hive on Dargonus, prayer services are being held in his honour, nobles and commoners are attending fairs with amusements, and Governor Drivestem himself is giving his annual speech from the main spire of his palace. Most of the Administratum servants have joined the festivities, so today all of the windows are being served by only one certification officer.{/n}
  - After: {n}Dargonus celebrates your ancestor Miltiades Orest Theon von Valancius, coloniser of Kiava Gamma. One officer works all windows.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae sighs dejectedly.{/n} "Fiiine. Let's try something else, shall we, shereen?"
  - After: {n}Jae sighs.{/n} "Fiiine. Something else, shereen?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I know what you are suggesting. Are you using faith as a shield to hide your lack of restraint? Forgive me, but the Palace of the Adeptus Administratum is a place of quiet contemplation... and submission. And I will not disturb the peace of the servants of the Lex Imperialis."
  - After: "Faith as a shield for impatience? I won't disturb the Lex Imperialis's servants."
- **Young Worker**
  - Before: "Zazi is a healer too! And she helps the people of the hive a great deal more than any lily-white chirurgeon with a diploma! I do not want to live a life of idleness in the spires of Dargonus like you, not when I know there are thousands of unfortunate people in the lower levels who need my help!"
  - After: "Zazi is a healer too, and helps the hive more than any chirurgeon! Thousands below need me!"
- **Young Worker**
  - Before: "Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}! I promise I will tell my children and my children's children of your kindness!"
  - After: "Thank you, my {mf|lord|lady}! My grandchildren will hear of this!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "As they say on Efreet: 'There is no star more coveted than that which points to the Exalted One!" {n}Jae casts a sidelong glance at the Sister of Battle as the latter holds out several numbered tickets to you.{/n}
  - After: "As on Efreet: all stars point to the Exalted One!" {n}Argenta hands you tickets.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Actually..." {n}After catching your eye, Jae purrs surreptitiously as she glances at Kibellah,{/n} "Shereen, if you were to tell your pet assassin to put on a little show in this room right now... I bet the queue would get a lot shorter."
  - After: "Actually..." {n}Jae eyes Kibellah.{/n} "Your pet assassin's show would shrink the queue."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "To defile one of the Bloodspun Web's sacraments by dedicating it to your avarice? Think again, blasphemer."
  - After: "Defile a Bloodspun Web sacrament for greed? Think again, blasphemer."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}Solomorne stands impassively like a stone column amidst the throng of lowly petitioners, unmoving except for his eyes, which sweep the perimeter like a guard-visor.{/n}
  - After: {n}Solomorne stands like stone, eyes sweeping the crowd.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Hem-ahem. Attention, all! Before you is {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader and anointed sovereign of this world! Bow your unworthy heads and give your {mf|master|mistress} {mf|his|her} rightful place in the queue!"
  - After: "Bow to {mf|His Lordship|Her Ladyship} {name} von Valancius, Rogue Trader! Give your {mf|master|mistress} {mf|his|her} place!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae peers over the man's shoulder to read his crumpled form.{/n} "You... are here to request mortification, so that your organs go to your granddaughter as an inheritance? She will hardly want your worn-out body parts, old-timer..."
  - After: {n}Jae reads his form.{/n} "Mortification, so your granddaughter inherits your organs? She won't want them, old-timer."
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The ragged man shakes his head and covers his face with his wrinkled hands.{/n} "S-s-servitor... Disp-po-posal!"
  - After: {n}He covers his face.{/n} "S-s-servitor... Disp-po-posal!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae looks at the man's form again... and rears back in horror.{/n} "The granddaughter of this poor wretch was turned into a servitor sixteen Dargonus years ago!   - After: {n}Jae recoils.{/n} "His granddaughter, a servitor for sixteen Dargonus years, is marked for disposal. He'd be her spare parts!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}," {n}Jae says in a deliberately deferential tone and makes her way to the centre of the room.{/n}
  - After: "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}," {n}Jae bows mockingly.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}In the last eight hours, the only thing that has changed in the waiting hall is the warden shift. The petitioners in the queue placidly await the blessed hour when their appeal will be heard by the high-ranking servants of the Imperium. The entire queue perks up at a sudden announcement:{/n} "Number 285, proceed to the available window."
  - After: {n}Eight unchanged hours pass. Then:{/n} "Number 285, to the window."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I will pray to the Emperor in the hope that you will reconsider, shereen!"
  - After: "I'll pray you reconsider, shereen!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae gives you a conspiratorial wink and backs away slightly.{/n} "O Exalted One, could today be my lucky day?   - After: {n}Jae winks.{/n} "Lucky me! The kind {mf|lord|lady} von Valancius solved my problem — {mf|he|she} aids the downtrodden!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "We've got a servant of the Lex Imperialis on our team, and with a formidable dog to boot! Though the Proctor could probably just stare at the queue, and it would move right aside."
  - After: "Our Proctor's stare alone would part the queue!"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, this place is so dull there's not even any knocking on the other side of the door — all the whispers died down when they realised nothing interesting was going to happen! Can't we go back to the ship?"
  - After: "So dull even the whispers quit! Back to the ship?"
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The old man's withered lips curve in the semblance of a smile.{/n} "M-m-may the Emperor k-keep you!"
  - After: {n}He smiles toothlessly.{/n} "M-m-may the Emperor k-keep you!"
- **Wealthy Lady**
  - Before: {n}A mature woman in a finely made but threadbare dress greets you.{/n} "I heard you were helping those in need. Well, my family... it's devastated! My life's work, oh, my shop selling rare hats, burnt to ashes! I am living out my last years as a widow. Alone, in a cold, deserted manor, without servants, diversions, or delicacies befitting my status." {n}The woman falls silent, her brow raised in expectation of your response.{/n}
  - After: {n}A threadbare noblewoman.{/n} "My hat shop burnt! I'm a lonely widow now." {n}She waits.{/n}
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The old man's toothless mouth opens in pain, seemingly splitting his face in two, and his salty tears well in his time-worn eyes.{/n}
  - After: {n}He weeps in pain.{/n}
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The old man nods in understanding.{/n} "Yes... I underst-stand... Emperor w-watch over you!"
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "I underst-stand... Emperor w-watch over you!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Of course, shereen. Our number in the queue is..." {n}Jae checks the ticket.{/n} "O, Exalted One, I wish I hadn't looked. We are definitely not going anywhere soon, shereen. You need to make a decision."
  - After: "Our number..." {n}Jae checks.{/n} "Exalted One, we're stuck. Decide, shereen."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I'd prefer to call it my wisdom learned through many years' experience... But I don't care about the precise wording just now. How do you wish to proceed, shereen?"
  - After: "Call it experience. How shall we proceed?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cowering in fear under his shaking arms, the old man rushes out of the hall.{/n}
  - After: {n}The old man flees, cowering.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Another eight planetary hours go by. The queue has hardly moved — the adept in the next window was dealing with rebelling {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} in his {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}, so the petitioners from that queue were diverted to the middle of yours.{/n}
  - After: {n}Eight more hours. A {g|Encyclopedia:Cogitator}cogitator{/g}'s {g|Encyclopedia:MachineSpirit}machine spirits{/g} rebelled; its queue merged into yours.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Well, shereen, maybe this time you will lose patience with being patient and decide to move things along a teensy bit faster?"
  - After: "Maybe now you'll lose patience with patience, shereen?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "This accursed place again. I stood in this queue when I was planning to marry. I stood in it when every son and every daughter was born, so that their names would be entered in the chronicle of Dargonus. And when my dear wife departed this mortal world, I waited again." {n}Abelard sighs dejectedly.{/n}
  - After: "This queue again. I stood here to marry, for each child, and when my wife died." {n}Abelard sighs.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The Archenemy is plotting against His servants throughout the Expanse, and we are forced to wait here for a piece of paper to be certified!" {n}Argenta tosses a furious look at Jae.{/n} "And not for the good of the Imperium, no, but to satisfy the whim of a heretic!"
  - After: "The Archenemy plots, and we wait for paper!" {n}Argenta glares at Jae.{/n} "For a heretic's whim!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Oh, Lord Captain, this place teems with hideous stains of washed-out colours! It makes my head spin..." {n}Cassia covers her eyes with a thick shawl.{/n} "The Palace of the Adeptus Administratum has proved to be just as depressing as the published works of its servants."
  - After: "These washed-out colours make my head spin!" {n}Cassia covers her eyes.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "These were given to me in thanks by the poor souls who decided to abandon their vigil in this palace of the law and return to their worldly matters."
  - After: "Gifts from those who gave up waiting."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "Unlikely. In the time we've been standing here, I've assessed every individual in the queue. Then again, one can never be too vigilant — as an Arbitrator, I can perform an unscheduled check of identity documents. At least some good can come out of being stuck here."
  - After: "Unlikely; I've assessed everyone. But as an Arbitrator I can spot-check IDs."
- **Menas**
  - Before: "I've said too much. I do apologise — it's my nerves. My nerves. I just keep thinking about her there on Vheabos, shackled down in the mines. My poor, poor Ilena! She was acquitted two years ago. But to get the papers certified, and the seal? So much time has passed... And now here I am, standing, waiting. It doesn't matter. At the rate this queue's moving, it'll be ten cycles or more before our numbers come up."
  - After: "Forgive my nerves. Frail Ilena, in the Vheabos mines! Acquitted two years ago, but the papers await certifying. Ten cycles more, at this rate."
- **Young Worker**
  - Before: "Esteemed {mf|lord|lady}, take pity on this poor youth as well! I will give you everything I have, I swear before the Emperor! Only help me solve my problem."
  - After: "Help me too, {mf|lord|lady}! I'll give everything!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "We do not need everything, poor wretch. Only your place in the queue."
  - After: "Not everything, wretch. Just your place."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And here we are again, shereen. I think I saw these same glum faces the last time... No. These are new glum faces." {n}Jae sighs dramatically.{/n}
  - After: "Here again, shereen. Same glum faces... no, new ones." {n}Jae sighs.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "This time, I will not allow you to spend one second longer here than absolutely necessary, shereen! No more being patient! No more playing by the rules! Today we are going to make it to that Throne-cursed window and we're going to get the Mercatum Tabula Officiale!" {n}With a pointed smile, Jae glances at you, awaiting your response.{/n}
  - After: "No more patience or rules! Today we get the Mercatum Tabula Officiale!" {n}Jae grins.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "Here, is this what you were so desperate to obtain?" {n}Heinrix holds out three queue tickets dropped by petitioners fleeing the very sight of the Interrogator.{/n} "Do not ask me to resort to such tricks again."{g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}{/g}
  - After: "This what you wanted?" {n}Heinrix hands over three tickets dropped by fleeing petitioners.{/n} "Never again."{g|Encyclopedia:Inquisition}{/g}
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Sorry, Lord Captain. Things didn't exactly go to plan..." {n}Idira holds up her hands sheepishly.{/n}
  - After: "Sorry, Lord Captain. Not quite to plan..." {n}Idira shrugs.{/n}
- **Menas**
  - Before: "Falsely accused, falsely accused! She was slandered! They said she deliberately poisoned a whole room of highborn folk. With cakes! Have you ever heard the like of it? And the smugglers were found too. And what did the smugglers do? They framed someone else. And my daughter was charged!"
  - After: "Falsely! Nobles poisoned by cakes, they said! It was smuggled 'Fine Calixian Wine', and the smugglers framed her!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Not at all, light of my soul! You have done exceptionally well as always — the dead do not need tickets, do they?" {n}Jae triumphantly brandishes the newly acquired tickets and winks at the psyker.{/n}
  - After: "Not at all! The dead don't need tickets." {n}Jae winks.{/n}
- **Menas**
  - Before: "You... What?" {n}The man hesitates.{/n} "D-deal! Of course I'll give you my place! My poor, poor Ilena! Delicate little flower! We'll need money. Yeah. For her recuperation."
  - After: "What?" {n}He hesitates.{/n} "D-deal! Ilena will need money."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Such humiliation for a Child of Asuryan, to be nothing but a beast for mon-keigh to gawp at."
  - After: "A Child of Asuryan, gawped at by mon-keigh. Humiliating."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And here we are again, shereen. I think I saw these same glum faces the last time... No. These are new glum faces." {n}Jae sighs dramatically.{/n}
  - After: "Here again, shereen. Same glum faces... no, new ones." {n}Jae sighs.{/n}
- **Menas**
  - Before: {n}Menas's eyes go wide and despair dawns on his face.{/n} "B-but how? But what about Ilena... And the poor orphans. Just awful, awful! Of course you can go ahead of me. P-please, take my ticket. My Ilena's a fragile girl, but she loves children. She would want me to help!"
  - After: {n}Menas despairs.{/n} "The orphans! Take my ticket. Ilena loves children."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Look at it this way, my pointy-eared and elegant xenofriend — you have gained more intimate knowledge of the Imperium's culture. And I have got us a ticket that puts us a few places ahead in the queue. I didn't steal it! I simply... swapped it with ours when no one was looking."
  - After: "Call it culture, pointy-ears. Meanwhile I quietly swapped us a better ticket."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Didn't I tell you? One little sob story and we're already one step closer to our goal. Although, there are faster methods of doing that."
  - After: "One sob story, one step closer. There are faster ways."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "No Lex Imperialis violations detected." {n}Solomorne falls silent and turns to stone again, ready to wait until the end of time.{/n}
  - After: "No Lex Imperialis violations." {n}Solomorne turns back to stone.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "If these ashmags want to be tricked, I won't stop them." {n}Jae smugly watches the agitated crowd, whispering among themselves and jabbing each other with sheaves of paper.{/n}
  - After: "If ashmags want tricking, fine." {n}Jae smirks at the crowd.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "I can positively identify one criminal — the one who dragged us here." {n}Solomorne nods toward Jae.{/n} "Your companion would do well to learn the value of order and humility — I will not be violating the sacred regulations of the Administratum for her."
  - After: "I see one criminal: the one who dragged us here." {n}Solomorne nods at Jae.{/n} "No rule-breaking for her."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "But I did sniff out a few especially antsy petitioners — all I had to do was drop a vague hint that Master Proctor was here for them and I was immediately showered with thanks for the timely warning!" {n}Jae triumphantly shows off her ill-gotten tickets.{/n}
  - After: "I told antsy petitioners the Proctor was after them. They thanked me!" {n}Jae flaunts tickets.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Sister Argenta, your words cut more deeply than a chainsword!"
  - After: "Sister, your words cut like a chainsword!"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "An unexpected means of passing the time, my friend, but why not? It has been a long while since I last preached to the uninitiated." {n}Eogunn solemnly folds his hands over his stomach.{/n} "Hear me, loyal subjects of the Imperium!" {n}The Manipulus's booming voice, amplified by a vox-coder, instantly commands the crowd's attention.{/n}
  - After: "Why not?" {n}Eogunn folds his hands.{/n} "Hear me, subjects of the Imperium!" {n}His vox-voice grips the crowd.{/n}
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "I am not sure this time and place are well-chosen, Rogue Trader." {n}The Manipulus solemnly shakes his head.{/n} "Are the laity even ready to absorb the teachings of the Biologis in this place and hour?   - After: "Wrong place, Rogue Trader." {n}Eogunn shakes his head.{/n} "They're not ready for the Biologis."
- **Strange Petitioner**
  - Before: "Out of my way!" {n}Elbowing aside onlookers left and right, a richly dressed lady with a beauty mark augment above her lip charges toward you.{/n} "Esteemed {mf|lord|lady}, my eighth offspring has lost his mind!
