A union with a commoner will put an end to his studies at the university — but should Dargonus and the Officio Medicae be deprived of a capable chirurgeon because of a passing fancy?"
  - After: "Out of my way!" {n}A rich lady charges up.{/n} "Esteemed {mf|lord|lady}, my eighth son would give up his title and healing talent for a hive waif! Should the Officio Medicae lose a chirurgeon?"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: "...such are the daily rituals which must be upheld for the preservation of the organism's functions." {n}The Manipulus finishes his speech, looking in surprise at his skull companion.{/n} "Nuncius, has an error crept into my auditory algorithms, or am I hearing snoring?"
  - After: "...thus the organism's rituals." {n}Eogunn turns to his skull.{/n} "Nuncius, is that snoring?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Holding a few white tickets in one hand, Jae covers her mouth with the other, suppressing a yawn.{/n} "Has anyone ever told you, O wisest of men, that your voice is miraculous? A deep, sound sleep really does make the queue move faster."
  - After: {n}Jae stifles a yawn.{/n} "Miraculous voice, wise one. Sleep speeds the queue."
- **Decrepit Old Man**
  - Before: {n}The old man resembles a dried fruit, mottled and wizened. A worn wooden Aquila on his chest peeks out from under his tattered shirt, and his withered, shaking fingers are constantly checking that his precious paper has not slipped from his grasp.{/n}
  - After: {n}A wizened old man clutching his paper and a wooden Aquila.{/n}
- **Young Worker**
  - Before: "Y-yes, of course, I humbly beg your forgiveness, my {mf|lord|lady}."
  - After: "Y-yes, forgive me, my {mf|lord|lady}."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q1/QueueWitness/QueueWitness_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Certify this damned scrap of paper immediately or lose your head."
  - After: "Certify this scrap now or lose your head."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Would you be so obliging as to certify this document?"
  - After: "Would you kindly certify this?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Throw the paper in the officer's face] "Take care of that."
  - After: [Throw the paper in the officer's face] "Handle it."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kill the certification officer and place the seal yourself] "I will kill you, you paper-pushing vermin!"
  - After: [Kill the officer and seal it yourself] "Die, vermin!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If that is what the law of the Imperium requires, then that is what we shall do."
  - After: "If Imperial law requires it, so be it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How much are three hours forty-eight seconds of your life worth, servant?"
  - After: "What's three hours forty-eight seconds of your life worth?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Write out a letter of payment for ten times the officer's salary]
  - After: [Pay the officer ten times his salary]
- **Player**
  - Before: [Destroy the waiting hall and place the seal yourself] "I've had enough of all of you!"
  - After: [Destroy the waiting hall and seal it yourself] "Enough!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I stood in that damned queue for nearly three turns, without sleep or amenities. Either you certify this document, or, I swear to the Emperor, I will kill you!"
  - After: "Three sleepless turns queuing! Certify it, or by the Emperor, I'll kill you!"
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: {n}Two gleaming ocular lenses peer at you from beneath the shaking counter.{/n} "W-what is it y-you wanted, {mf|master|mistress}?"
  - After: {n}Lenses peer from under the counter.{/n} "W-what, {mf|master|mistress}?"
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "I'm afraid that..." {n}comes the rasping voice from the metal jaws with integrated {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "...the validity period for certifying one of your seals expired three hours and forty-eight seconds ago. You must request a blank form from the Master of Seals and have both seals placed again. After that, you may return here and wait in the queue for your turn to be seen."
  - After: "I'm afraid..." {n}rasps his {g|Encyclopedia:Vox}vox{/g},{/n} "...a seal lapsed three hours forty-eight seconds ago. Redo both seals via the Master of Seals, then queue again."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae leans over the quivering Administratum officer and nods sympathetically.{/n} "I know, my good man, you have had a lot to deal with today. But here's the thing... My companion, your {mf|master|mistress} in here on business of Imperial importance. As you may have noticed, {mf|he|she} is not the most patient of people. And {mf|he|she} does not want to waste another minute of {mf|his|her} time. So, my esteemed adept, could you please process our petition without delay? And then we will leave you in peace."
  - After: {n}Jae leans in.{/n} "Your {mf|master|mistress} is impatient: {mf|he|she} won't wait, and {mf|he|she} won't waste {mf|his|her} time. Process us now."
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "Y-yes, I d-do apologise for the inconvenience. It will be done now! J-just don't kill me!"
  - After: "Y-yes, at once! J-just don't kill me!"
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "O-of course..." {n}The officer glances in horror at the bodies behind you.{/n}
  - After: "O-of course..." {n}He eyes the bodies behind you.{/n}
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: {n}Without further ado, the certification officer picks up the document and begins feverishly filling in numerous forms. His augmented ocular eyes whirr as the lenses zoom in and out. With quiet scratching sounds, the cogita-quills that serve in place of the adept's fingers make notes on a fine sheet of paper.{/n}
  - After: {n}He feverishly fills in forms.{/n}
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "I'm sorry, but that is impossible. The validity period has—"
  - After: "Impossible. The validity period has—"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You'll shut up if you know what's good for you, servant of the law. Just shut up."
  - After: "Shut up, servant, if you're wise."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "But, shereen... He's saying we need to go back to Janus, then back here, then back to..." {n}Jae's shoulders slump.{/n} "Why do I sense that you are going to do something very bad to me as soon as we leave the Administratum Palace?"
  - After: "Back to Janus again..." {n}Jae slumps.{/n} "You'll punish me later, won't you?"
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: {n}The augmented ocular lenses stop moving, and the cogita-fingers sharply cease scratching out gnarled letters.{/n} "Ten times my salary."
  - After: {n}The lenses and quills freeze.{/n} "Ten times my salary."
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "In the law, we find His power. In the law, we find His truth. In humility, we find His generosity. And may His wisdom come to those who truly believe."
  - After: "In law, His power. In humility, His generosity."
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: {n}The mechanical ocular lenses hum in pleasure at the sight of the von Valancius seal on the document.{/n}
  - After: {n}His lenses hum at the von Valancius seal.{/n}
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "Ah, you again. Come forward." {n}The man makes several notes in the weighty ledger in front of him, then takes your new document and peers at it, adjusting the lenses of his ocular eyes. The cogita-quills, which the officer has instead of fingers, make notes on a fine sheet of paper with a quiet scratching sound.{/n}
  - After: "You again." {n}He studies your document.{/n}
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "H-here, please, t-take it, {mf|master|mistress}. Return to the Master of Seals in order to p-proceed. And may His light and w-wisdom guard you!"
  - After: "H-here, {mf|master|mistress}. Now the Master of Seals. His light guard you!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Madness glimmers in Jae's eyes as she stares at the bureaucrat and her hand reaches for the knife at her belt.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae reaches for her knife, eyes mad.{/n}
- **Officer of the Administratum**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}The certification officer makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "It is an honour to serve the Rogue Trader. Please, allow me to look at your document."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!" {n}He signs the Aquila.{/n} "Your document, please."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "O, Exalted One, Master of Mankind and Galactic Sovereign, please, be merciful..." {n}Jae grips her Aquila medallion in her hands and whispers her idiosyncratic prayer with surprising sincerity.{/n}
  - After: "Exalted One, be merciful..." {n}Jae clutches her Aquila.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q2/FalcoAliveOutcome/FalcoAliveOutcome_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Here's your favour, Falco: take this rabble and get out."
  - After: "Your favour, Falco: take this rabble and go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Take your piece of paper, Falco, and never forget what you have promised me."
  - After: "Take your paper. Remember your promise."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not here for underhanded dealings. You will not escape punishment for what you have done."
  - After: "No deals. You'll be punished for this."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack] "What makes you think only one Cold Trader will die here today?"
  - After: [Attack] "Why only one dead Cold Trader today?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} is full of surprises." {n}Falco can barely contain a smirk as he nods toward Jae's body.{/n} "Let's skip the prelude — your time is too valuable, and I dare not waste it any more than necessary. You know why I am here: the Mercatum. Tabula. Officiale."
  - After: "Surprising, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}Falco smirks at Jae's body.{/n} "I want the Mercatum Tabula Officiale."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "By the Undying Emperor, your papers are more lethal than a thousand blades. Were the spinners to arm themselves with quills, the Expanse would drown in blood."
  - After: "Your papers are deadlier than blades."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Never, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. You have my word as a trade representative of the Imperium." {n}With a brief gesture, the former privateer directs his gang to the exit.{/n} "Consider my eternal gratitude already in your pocket."
  - After: "Never, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}." {n}He waves his gang out.{/n} "I owe you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm afraid I must reject your offer, Rogue Trader. I'll have to deal with this the old-fashioned way."
  - After: "I refuse. The old-fashioned way, then."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Falco nods in understanding.{/n} "Fair enough. Then this will be our last hurrah, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
  - After: {n}Falco nods.{/n} "Our last hurrah, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "How much trouble one piece of paper can bring. And how many opportunities." {n}The eyes of the Cold Trader glint greedily.{/n} "Consider it a favour, a whim, or a risky investment — I'm no fool, my life is not worth a throne to you. But I'll give you everything I have now. And if fortune kisses me on the lips... Well. I've been called many things, but an ingrate? Never."
  - After: "Trouble and opportunity." {n}His eyes glint.{/n} "Call it an investment. I'll give everything. I'm no ingrate."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Falco stares at you for half a minute, then raises his hands in a conciliatory gesture.{/n} "Better to be a living privateer than a dead wannabe trade representative. I thank you for this small mercy, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, and may the stars favour you."
  - After: {n}Falco raises his hands.{/n} "Better a living privateer. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q2/FalcoAngry/FalcoAngry_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You have done all the dirty work for me, Falco. There is just one last loose end — kill Jae and we shall part as friends."
  - After: "Kill Jae, Falco, and we part friends."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Prepare yourself, Falco. You are going to be punished to the fullest extent of Imperial law."
  - After: "Falco, Imperial law will punish you fully."
- **Falco**
  - Before: "Well, well, what has fate loosed upon us at this late Footfall hour?" {n}A repulsive face emerges from the gloom, bisected by an old scar and with the left eye screwed up in a permanent squint. His oily hair has been scraped back flat to his head, and the swollen veins at his temples look like pulsating knots of worms.{/n}
  - After: "What has fate loosed on Footfall?" {n}A scarred, squinting face emerges.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Fate is for lawmen and drunkards, Falco." {n}Jae spits out in the direction of the twisted face, trying to maintain her composure. But she cannot keep her eyes from straying to the faces of her beaten associates.{/n} "But we've come here under our own steam, and you know why. Take your hands off the rifle and release my people!"
  - After: "Fate is for drunkards, Falco." {n}Jae eyes her beaten people.{/n} "Release them!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}The Cold Trader seems deaf to your words of comfort. Her eyes are bereft, and yet at the same time, filled with rage.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae's eyes are bereft, and furious.{/n}
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira shakes her head despondently — she must already know how this scene is going to end.{/n} "Don't look, Jae... Don't look..."
  - After: {n}Idira shakes her head.{/n} "Don't look, Jae..."
- **Falco**
  - Before: "Ooh, think you're going to take me alive, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?" {n}A ragged snarl of a smile splits the Cold Trader's face, and he laughs nastily.{/n} "I'd like to see you try!"
  - After: "Take me alive, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?" {n}He laughs.{/n} "Try it!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "What? No! He's going to die here, like the filthy cur that he is! It's what he deserves!" {n}Jae pulls out her weapon and levels it at Falco.{/n}
  - After: "No! He dies here, the cur!" {n}Jae aims at Falco.{/n}
- **Falco**
  - Before: "I regret nothing, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. My fate was sealed the second you landed on Footfall."
  - After: "No regrets, Your {mf|Lordliness|Ladyness}. You sealed my fate."
- **Falco**
  - Before: {n}Without a moment's hesitation, Falco gives the signal to his associates.{/n}
  - After: {n}Falco signals his men.{/n}
- **Falco**
  - Before: {n}The smuggler's face seems to cleave in two as he opens his mouth in a twisted snarl.{/n} "I knew it, even with your pack of whelps on the line, I knew you'd pull something like this, Heydari! You show up here with {mf|him|her}?" {n}Falco points at you.{/n} "We both know how this is going to end now."
  - After: {n}Falco snarls.{/n} "I knew it, Heydari! You bring {mf|him|her}?" {n}He points at you.{/n} "We know how this ends."
- **Torra**
  - Before: "Jeh! Geb oubba here! He wonb web you go!" {n}The bruised and bloodied face with swollen eyes is hard to recognise as the once radiant visage of Torra the twin.{/n} "Jeh, puhease..."
  - After: "Jeh! Geb oubba here!" {n}Torra is beaten bloody.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The vileness shows its face at last... It is time we rid Footfall of yet another lump of filth."
  - After: "Time to rid Footfall of this filth."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "Too many times have I watched heretics resort to some low act right before their sentence was delivered. Brace yourself, peddler."
  - After: "Heretics always try something low. Brace yourself, peddler."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q2/JaeBoysOutcome/JaeBoysOutcome_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Do what you want, but make it quick. The sewer stench is turning my stomach!"
  - After: "Do it quickly. This stench!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let's block off all the entrances to the sewers — let them suffer a slow, painful death down here."
  - After: "Seal the sewers. Let them die slowly."
- **Player**

  - After: "No anarchy, Jae. He'll go to Chorda."

  - Before: "You acted as a true servant of the Imperium ought. You can be proud of yourself."
  - After: "You served the Imperium truly. Be proud."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What can be right about failing to protect the people who need you?"
  - After: "How is failing your people right?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I'm sorry about your gang, but everyone is replaceable."
  - After: "Sorry, but everyone's replaceable."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well, I'll wait. It is not as though this place stinks of sewage and other people's retchings."
  - After: "Fine, I'll wait. In this stink."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Wake up, Torra! Come on, you bloody kaskha, wake up!" {n}Jae shakes the surviving twin by the shoulders.{/n}
  - After: "Wake up, Torra!" {n}Jae shakes her.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "By the Exalted One, what's that ashmag done to your poor face, light of my soul?" {n}Jae gently strokes the girl's swollen cheek and then turns to you.{/n} "He will die here, like the scum that he is, shereen. It's what he deserves." {n}She does not seem to be asking you a question.{/n}
  - After: "Your poor face!" {n}Jae turns to you.{/n} "He dies here, shereen." {n}It's not a question.{/n}

  - After: "Waib..." {n}Torra punches Falco.{/n} "Fub you!"

  - Before: {n}The rest of the gang are huddled together. Despite their pitiful physical condition, they greet you with satisfied smirks, and they continually shoot delighted glances at you and Jae.{/n}
  - After: {n}The battered gang smirk, delighted.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "No, shereen, I'm cursing. I'm cursing the one who killed them. The one who failed to stop it. And the ones who didn't care." {n}Her words are interrupted by a smothered sob, and Jae guiltily hangs her head.{/n} "Sorry, shereen. I've never... What is this? Grief? Ha, I'd forgotten..."
  - After: "No, I'm cursing his killer, and those who didn't care." {n}She sobs.{/n} "Sorry. Grief? I'd forgotten..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Without another word, the Cold Trader draws her weapon and carries out your sentence.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae carries out your sentence.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I'd rather drown him in sewage myself... But your suggestion will do, shereen. A stinking death for a stinking rat!"
  - After: "Fine. A stinking death for a stinking rat!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I wonder what you're thinking of, shereen. Mercy? The Imperium? Or how to make this ashmag suffer most?" {n}Jae smiles like a venomous snake.{/n} "All of them suit me, because everyone on Footfall knows that you'd be better off strung up on a live wire than in an interrogation room with Incendia's hounds."
  - After: "Mercy, or suffering?" {n}Jae smiles venomously.{/n} "Either beats Incendia's interrogators."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Bowing over the {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_BreakingThrough}pile of bodies{/d}, Jae brings her hands together in a praying gesture and then tightly grips the Aquila, her fingers turning white. A small, unintelligible murmur comes from behind the curtain of her jet-black hair.{/n}
  - After: {n}Over the {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_BreakingThrough}pile of bodies{/d}, Jae grips her Aquila, praying.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "'Die'? You would be satisfied with the mundane, swift death of your worst enemy without even adorning it with hours of artfully crafted anguish?"
  - After: "Just 'die'? No artful anguish?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I might like to, but hanging around here any longer than necessary—" {n}Jae shudders and makes the sign of the Aquila.{/n} "Exalted One save me, did I just agree with you?"
  - After: "I'd like to, but—" {n}Jae makes the Aquila.{/n} "Did I agree with you?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae stands over the bodies of her underlings — many of them have been mutilated beyond recognition, as though a troop of expert torturers had worked on them for many station cycles. Jae grips the Mercatum Tabula Officiale in her right hand and the parchment crunches in protest.{/n} "It was the right thing to do... Wasn't it?" {n}You cannot tell if Jae is asking herself or you.{/n}
  - After: {n}Jae crushes the Mercatum Tabula Officiale over her mutilated people.{/n} "It was right... Wasn't it?" {n}She asks herself, or you.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Well, there's nothing more for us to do here. I suggest we get out of this kingdom of stink and gut-smeared floors and go back to the perfumed chambers of your ship, shereen. And... yes, I'm fine, in case you were wondering. But even if you're not, I still have a lot I need to think about... We will talk about what happened later."
  - After: "We're done here. Back to the ship. I'm fine, but we'll talk later."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae doubles over sharply, her face contorted, as if she has been whipped.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}Weren't you the one talking about my great responsibility, shereen?{/d} Waxing lyrical about my obligations to the Imperium?" {n}The blade of rage is on the verge of being drawn from the sheath of Jae's good sense, but she manages to stay it.{/n} "Well, if those are the rules in the Exalted One's intimate circles... I'll learn to play by them."
  - After: {n}Jae flinches.{/n} "{d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}You preached my responsibility, shereen.{/d} My duty!" {n}She reins in her rage.{/n} "Then I'll learn these rules."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Finally, she sighs wearily, carefully straightens the certificate between her hands and places it in a special container with a code lock.{/n} "I would like to reflect on all this in privacy, shereen. Thank you for not leaving me in that situation. If I had been in your place... I don't know if I would have left you."
  - After: {n}She locks the certificate away.{/n} "I need time alone. Thank you for not leaving me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I know, shereen. I know... But why then does the taste of victory turn to rot in my mouth and send a chill through my limbs? {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}Is this what it means to serve the greater good of the Imperium?{/d}" {n}Jae's gaze is focused on a single point — the disfigured face of Torra, last of the twins, her faithful right hand.{/n}
  - After: "Then why does victory taste of rot? {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}Is this serving the Imperium?{/d}" {n}She stares at Torra.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae casts one last look at the bodies and adds quietly,{/n} "And just so we're clear... They died because of your pride and unwillingness to act cautiously. And their souls won't forgive me if I keep sleeping with the one who condemned them to death. I wouldn't forgive myself either."
  - After: {n}Jae looks at the bodies.{/n} "Your pride killed them. They were my family. I won't keep sleeping with the one who doomed them."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "I couldn't have put it better myself, Lord Captain. We could all do with some fresh air, away from the stench... and the locals too."
  - After: "Well said, Lord Captain. We need air."
- **Torra**
  - Before: "Jeh? Jeh, geb oubba here! Ibs a trap! He wohb web you go!" {n}The bruised and bloodied face with swollen eyes is hard to recognise as the once radiant visage of Torra the twin.{/n}
  - After: "Jeh, geb oubba here! Ibs a trap!" {n}Torra is beaten bloody.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You of all people should know that life is a series of decisions. Some great and some not so great. Simple, everyday decisions... and decisions that {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}change people's lives{/d}. Sometimes it might be the life of a single gang, and sometimes the lives of millions." {n}Jae gives a lifeless shrug, even as she attempts a smile.{/n}
  - After: "Life is decisions. Some {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}change lives{/d} — a gang's, or millions'." {n}Jae shrugs.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Well, shereen, from now on Footfall can sleep soundly — the foulest wart on its rusted body has finally been burnt off by none other than Jae Heydari! And her wonderful patron, of course." {n}Jae winks at you and her face breaks into the most genuine smile you have ever seen from her.{/n} "I'll admit, I'm still struggling to wrap my head around what's happened. I need to go over things with my guys, I'm sure I'll have advice and instructions to hand out. As for our little adventure... let's talk about it back on the ship, in a more private setting."
  - After: "Jae Heydari burnt off Footfall's foulest wart! With her patron." {n}She winks, smiling genuinely.{/n} "I'll brief my guys. We'll talk on the ship."
- **Torra**
  - Before: "Thabs for my brother, you piece of shib..." {n}A few scant tears trickle from Torra's watery eyes.{/n}
  - After: "Thabs for my brother..." {n}Torra weeps.{/n}
- **Torra**
  - Before: "A fibbing death for a piece of shib like you, Falco." {n}Torra spits yet another tooth out of her bloodied mouth straight into the sleeping face of her tormentor.{/n}
  - After: "A fibbing death, Falco." {n}Torra spits a tooth at him.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "An interesting observation, shereen. Does that mean that one day you will {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}replace me, like a rusty nail{/d}? Or like a worn-out boot?" {n}Jae's eyes narrow and you do not recognise the shuttered expression that comes over her face.{/n} "No, don't answer! Today I don't want to know the truth. I'd rather stay blind — sometimes it's the wiser path."
  - After: "You'll {d|Encyclopedia:JaeQ2_DogmaticReinforcement}replace me, like a rusty nail{/d}?" {n}Her face shutters.{/n} "Don't answer!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Deafening silence reigns for several minutes. Jae does not say another word, but her quivering shoulders speak volumes. At last, she straightens.{/n} "The Exalted One has blessed me with an understanding companion, shereen. Sometimes silence says more about us than an ocean of spilt words."
  - After: {n}Long silence. Jae's shoulders quiver.{/n} "Thank you. Silence says more."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You don't have to subject yourself to this horror, shereen." {n}Jae offers a cheery smile, but her reddened eyes look almost dead.{/n}
  - After: "You needn't endure this." {n}She smiles, eyes dead.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q2/UndergroundPlan/UndergroundPlan_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Jae Heydari, the certificate did not only grant you limitless opportunities, it also imposed upon you responsibilities to the Imperium. The certificate cannot be allowed to fall into Falco's hands — you know this."
  - After: "Jae, the certificate brings duties too. Falco cannot have it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I refuse to creep through tunnels like a rat! We will go in, wipe out Falco's gang, and leave!"
  - After: "No creeping! We go in, wipe out Falco's gang, leave!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Explain your plan in more detail."
  - After: "Explain your plan in detail."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why are you making this so complicated? I can just go and kill Falco."
  - After: "Why so complicated? I'll just kill Falco."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not telling you to abandon your gang. I am merely reminding you that the certificate is more important than the lives of common smugglers."
  - After: "The certificate outweighs common smugglers."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Torra and your gang can be replaced. But your certificate can never be."
  - After: "Torra and the gang are replaceable. The certificate isn't."
- **Player**
  - Before: "We shall work quickly and quietly — I understand."
  - After: "Quick and quiet — understood."
- **Player**
  - Before: "All right, all right. Let's go."
  - After: "All right. Let's go."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Can you go over the plan one more time?"
  - After: "Go over the plan again?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Where are we going to get a tank of sleeping gas?"
  - After: "Where do we get sleeping gas?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "And how are we going to direct the gas to the right place?"
  - After: "How do we direct the gas?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Come. It is time to enter the sewers."
  - After: "Come. Into the sewers."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You're right. We must save them at any cost."
  - After: "You're right. Save them at any cost."
- **Player**
  - Before: "All right, all right, let's just go. We shall improvise as the situation dictates."
  - After: "Let's just go and improvise."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Approach the thug on patrol] "Hey you, you filthy rats. Run along and tell Falco that the Rogue Trader is coming for his head!"
  - After: [Approach the thug on patrol] "Hey, rats! Tell Falco the Rogue Trader wants his head!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You made your choice the moment you accepted the Mercatum Tabula Officiale from the hands of the Administratum servants."
  - After: "You chose this accepting the Mercatum Tabula Officiale."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Well, shereen, what do we have here? A cowardly ashmag who wants to get his paws on my certificate without even working up a sweat. Considering the... circumstances currently affecting Footfall, the only fitting place this filth could be hiding is in the sewers." {n}Jae's nose wrinkles at the very thought.{/n}
  - After: "A cowardly ashmag wants my certificate. He must be hiding in the sewers." {n}Jae grimaces.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae breaks off, her shoulders sagging under the weight of her doubts.{/n} "If it doesn't, my gang are dead, shereen. One wrong move, one wrong word... Gah, Throne damn that ashmag, why is everything so difficult? Perhaps... perhaps I should just give him the Mercatum Tabula Officiale? Falco's not a complete idiot — he won't risk such a valuable payoff. He'll... hold up his end of the deal and give me Torra and the others."
  - After: {n}Jae sags.{/n} "Or my gang die. Throne damn him! Should I just give him the Mercatum Tabula Officiale? He'd free them."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "But you'll kill all my loyal mutts along with the jackals, shereen." {n}Jae's lips tremble in agitation.{/n} "They'll meet their deaths at the end of a jagged blade as soon as Falco realises that I haven't come to hand over the certificate. But... all right. Let's do it that way. There is always a chance of salvation, right, Exalted One?" {n}Jae squeezes the already shabby-looking Aquila on her chest, raising her eyes to the vaulted ceiling.{/n}
  - After: "Then my people die with the jackals." {n}Her lips tremble.{/n} "But... fine. There's always hope, right, Exalted One?" {n}She grips her Aquila.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "No!" {n}hisses Jae through her teeth, trying not to give herself away.{/n} "Shereen, what are you doing? BACK!"
  - After: "No!" {n}Jae hisses.{/n} "BACK!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "A nasty spot, with a powerful whiff about it, that is true. But I swear to you, shereen, you won't come up with a better trap for Falco — I know these tunnels like the back of my hand! And the most delicious part of all is that that ashmag chose to go in there — he'll wish he hadn't. Of course, that's only if the azhi don't mess things up for us and everything goes to plan. And if it doesn't..."
  - After: "It stinks, but I know these tunnels. A perfect trap — if the azhi don't spoil it. And if they do..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The gist is that we need to go down into the sewer tunnels of Footfall, connect a tank of sleeping gas to the old ventilation system, and direct the airflow to Falco's hideout... and, of course, pray to the Exalted One that the ashmag's jackals don't spot us!"
  - After: "In the sewers, we hook sleeping gas to the old ventilation and blow it into Falco's hideout, unseen."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I would prefer it if we stuck to the plan, shereen. But if you're in a rush, we can go over the details once we're in the sewers. Most of the passages have been sealed off by Chorda's hounds, but there is one they definitely haven't got to." {n}Jae visibly perks up.{/n} "Time to pay a visit to Octy and the Adeptus Amasecus, shereen."
  - After: "We'll go over it below. One passage isn't sealed by Chorda's hounds." {n}Jae perks up.{/n} "To Octy and the Adeptus Amasecus."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And may the Exalted Emperor light our path."
  - After: "May the Exalted Emperor light our path."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae interrupts.{/n} "I was actually trying to bring a little levity. I wasn't seriously describing—"
  - After: {n}Jae interrupts.{/n} "I was joking—"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen, tell me... why is it that, of all the xenos you could have taken under your wing, you picked the ones who refuse to understand my sarcasm?"
  - After: "Why pick xenos who don't get sarcasm?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And doom my associates to death, not even giving them a morsel of hope — as you might give a crumb of bread to the lowliest beggar — that it's not all over yet? If we rush in there, we'll be as good as slitting the throat of every idiot who ever swore their loyalty to me."
  - After: "And leave my people no hope? Rushing in kills them all."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "It's true, shereen... it's going to be a little trickier than it seems. Falco is desperate, so he's bound to have his thugs patrolling the tunnels. If we go crashing around down there, he'll know something is afoot. And when Falco's feeling jumpy..." {n}Jae's nostrils flare with impotent rage.{/n} "...heads roll."
  - After: "Falco's thugs patrol the tunnels. If he notices us..." {n}Jae's nostrils flare.{/n} "Heads roll."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae stares at you, trying to decide if you are joking or being completely serious.{/n} "What do you take me for? I have acquired it already. Don't worry, I have everything covered."
  - After: {n}Jae stares.{/n} "I've got it already."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "We'll need to turn a few valves there, and another couple here... And start up the ventilation system using an old cogitator, may the Exalted One preserve its machine spirit!"
  - After: "Turn some valves, then start the ventilation with an old cogitator."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The only thing life has ever taught me, shereen, is that no plan ever goes according to plan." {n}Jae gives you a rakish smile — she is more than ready to dice with death.{/n}
  - After: "No plan goes to plan." {n}Jae grins.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Most of the passages have been sealed off by Chorda's hounds, but there is one they definitely haven't got to." {n}Jae visibly perks up and winks at you.{/n} "Time to pay a visit to Octy and the Adeptus Amasecus, shereen."
  - After: "One passage isn't sealed by Chorda's hounds." {n}Jae winks.{/n} "To Octy and the Adeptus Amasecus."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "To the Amasecus we go, shereen. Or do you have other pressing business to handle on the way there?"
  - After: "To the Amasecus. Unless you've other business?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I, too, was a 'common smuggler' once, shereen," {n}retorts Jae in an even tone.{/n} "Don't worry. If things go awry down there, keeping the Mercatum Tabula Officiale is my top priority."
  - After: "I was a 'common smuggler' once," {n}Jae says evenly.{/n} "The Mercatum Tabula Officiale comes first."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Never..." {n}Jae repeats colourlessly, and her eyes fill with grim determination.{/n} "Ha, azhi devour me, I have no intention of giving up on my goal — the climb up here was too long, too steep — I'm at the summit now, and I'm not going to throw myself off without a second thought!"
  - After: "Never..." {n}Her eyes harden.{/n} "I climbed too far to quit!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Let's go — our way in is through a secret passage in the Adeptus Amasecus." {n}Without another word, Jae turns on her heel and strides off toward the Shadow Quarters.{/n}
  - After: "The way in is a secret passage in the Adeptus Amasecus." {n}Jae strides off.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The gang will understand, I'm sure. They would've bashed their own mother's head in for a treasure like the Mercatum Tabula Officiale. But Falco..." {n}Jae's mouth twists in a nasty smile.{/n} "Let's go to the Adeptus Amasecus, shereen. I'll lead you through the secret passage into the sewers. Rest assured, that ashmag hiding down there will sorely rue the day he decided to cross a trade representative of the Imperium."
  - After: "The gang will understand. But Falco..." {n}She smiles nastily.{/n} "To the Adeptus Amasecus's secret passage. He'll rue crossing me."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Surprise flickers in Jae's eyes.{/n} "Do you... really think so, shereen? In that case... I hope you will still help me release my thoroughbred of a scheme into the wild?"
  - After: {n}Jae looks surprised.{/n} "Really? Then you'll still help?"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "As I said before, Falco's jackals are patrolling every nook and cranny of this azhi-cursed place. See those scumbags over there? We need to avoid them and not draw any attention to ourselves, or else we might as well dump a pile of grox shit all over our plan!"
  - After: "Falco's jackals patrol everywhere. Avoid those scumbags, or the plan's ruined!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "But now we are going to follow the plan. If you will allow me, shereen, I will refresh your memory: avoiding the patrolling scum, we reach the sewer canal and follow it to the east almost until the very end. We connect the gas cylinder to the special intake — ironically enough, it was previously used for cleaning the air — then we need to turn the valves in a few spots so that the gas reaches the correct chamber... I wish I knew exactly where that ashmag was holed up."
  - After: "The plan: avoid patrols, follow the canal east almost to the end, connect the gas to the intake, turn valves to reach his chamber... wherever he's hiding."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet examines the filthy walls and the mounds of refuse.{/n} "The finest goods on Footfall... Does that make this place... some sort of mon-keigh trading hall? Really?" {n}You cannot tell from Yrliet's tone whether she is speaking in jest or genuinely confused.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet eyes the refuse.{/n} "A mon-keigh trading hall?" {n}Jest or not, you can't tell.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta examines the dark tunnels morosely.{/n} "To skulk in the shadows, to hide from battle... these things are beneath His warriors. But for the sake of saving the innocent, I will dim the flame in my soul that urges me to charge openly at the enemy's ranks."
  - After: {n}Argenta frowns.{/n} "Skulking shames His warriors. But for the innocent, I'll endure it."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I would be careful about using the word 'innocent,' given whose colleagues we are talking about."
  - After: "Careful with 'innocent' here."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "And 'the kingdom of killers' as well? I know that your kind knows nothing about the art of killing, but to found an order in a waste-coated hole like this?" {n}Unlike Yrliet, Marazhai does not even try to hide the venomous sarcasm in his voice.{/n}
  - After: "An order of killers in this hole?" {n}Marazhai sneers openly.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "A game of regicide is not won on the final move, but with a strategy planned in advance." {n}You can barely hear Heinrix's disgruntled muttering as he surveys the tunnels.{/n} "This whole operation... is the opposite of that."
  - After: "Regicide needs planning." {n}Heinrix mutters.{/n} "This has none."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae falls into a long, heavy silence, weighing every word you just spoke.{/n} "I will not gift him with an easy death, shereen. As an official representative of the Imperium, I am duty-bound to purge the tunnels of Footfall of ashmags like Falco."
  - After: {n}Jae is silent.{/n} "No easy death for him. It's my duty to purge Footfall of ashmags like Falco."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Welcome to the kingdom of thieves, killers, and smugglers, shereen! All the finest goods on Footfall — every last one of them — have passed through these tunnels." {n}Jae throws up her arms in a theatrical display of reverence.{/n}
  - After: "Welcome to the kingdom of thieves and smugglers!" {n}Jae spreads her arms.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I... do..." {n}Something breaks in Jae's voice. It even sounds to you as if you hear a grinding noise — as if an old screw has come loose and the rusty mechanism is screeching in protest at the assault.{/n} "But Torra and the rest... They're waiting for me, shereen! They're waiting!"
  - After: "I... do..." {n}Her voice breaks.{/n} "But Torra and the rest are waiting!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Aaand... the final move, like all the best regicide players, shereen: we find the service cogitator and send the gas along the pipes! And I'm sure I don't have to remind you that we must do all of this in complete silence? Not even the sewer rats are going to notice us, let alone Falco's lot."
  - After: "Last, the service cogitator sends the gas through the pipes. All in total silence."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "How can you be daydreaming in a place like this, shereen?" {n}Jae throws up her hands.{/n} "We avoid the patrols, we reach the sewer canal and follow it east. We connect the gas cylinder to the special intake, then we turn some valves — wherever we need to. And then last of all we find the service cogitator and send the gas along the pipes."
  - After: "Daydreaming?" {n}Jae sighs.{/n} "Avoid patrols, follow the canal east, connect the gas to the intake, turn valves, then send it via the service cogitator."
- **Falco's Patroller**
  - Before: "W-what?" {n}The pock-marked face peers fearfully into the dark of the tunnel.{/n} "Heydari! It's Heydari with the Rogue Trader!"
  - After: "W-what?" {n}A thug peers out.{/n} "Heydari and the Rogue Trader!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Throne curse you, shereen, you just signed my people's death warrant!" {n}You hear the sharp edge of desperation in her shout.{/n}
  - After: "Throne curse you, you've doomed my people!" {n}She's desperate.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "If Falco touches a hair on their heads — I'll kill him! I'll tear out his spine with my own teeth! Well, what are you waiting for, {name}? You want his head, don't you? Then we need to move now."
  - After: "If Falco touches them, I'll kill him! You want his head, {name}? Move!"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Jae/Jae_Q2/ktc_JaeWantsToVisitFootfall/ktc_JaeWantsToVisitFootfall_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Toliman did not say who sent the message?"
  - After: "Toliman didn't say who sent it?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "When we reach Footfall, I will help your associates."
  - After: "I'll help them at Footfall."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I've had enough of your problems, Jae. Deal with them yourself."
  - After: "Handle your own problems, Jae."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why should I help you? It seems you have reached the limit of your abilities."
  - After: "Why help? You've hit your limit."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The Exalted One bless the house of von Valancius for your largesse of spirit, shereen! And thank you for deigning to speak with me." {n}Jae turns unusually hesitant, now tentatively choosing the words that only a moment ago rolled off her tongue in an uninterrupted cascade.{/n} "Here's the thing, shereen — my network of 'trade representatives' has been stretched a little too thin recently, like a chiffon dress on a whore. Supplies are all over the place, orders aren't being filled, clients are kicking off — and not without reason — and revenue's plummeting!"
  - After: "Bless you for hearing me, shereen." {n}Jae hesitates.{/n} "My network is stretched thin. Orders unfilled, clients angry, revenue plummeting!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Thank you for dispelling the fog of naive expectations that clouded my gaze. I will not presume to disturb you any longer."
  - After: "Thank you for the clarity. I'll not disturb you further."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And if that wasn't bad enough, my guys running things from Footfall have been incommunicado recently. And an Astropathic message has finally come in to tell me why: some ashmag — or ashmags, Throne smite them — has captured my gang! And they're threatening to kill every last one of those hard-grafting whelps if I don't do what they want..."
  - After: "Worse, an Astropathic message says some ashmag captured my Footfall gang and will kill them unless I obey."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "And they only want one thing: my Mercatum Tabula Officiale in exchange for my gang's lives." {n}Jae tosses her thick mane of hair and grits her teeth, looking more vicious than you have ever seen her.{/n} "But I'm not giving up my certificate for anything! And nor am I going to leave my guys high and dry. That's why I am begging for your help and protection, shereen. If I have to step into a cage of hyenas, I'd rather do it with a lion at my side."
  - After: "They want my Mercatum Tabula Officiale for their lives." {n}Jae grits her teeth.{/n} "I'll give up neither. Help me, shereen. Facing hyenas, I want a lion beside me."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I look forward to that day, shereen! And praise be to the Exalted One for bestowing such a miserly portion of haughty indifference upon your heart."
  - After: "I look forward to it! Praise your kind heart."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "It could, shereen. But I've been missing the familiar stench of the docks, and darling Octy and her bar, and even the stony gaze of the Exalted One that watches over you wherever you are on Footfall. I'm homesick, you see?" {n}The tender smile vanishes from Jae's face, leaving a nakedly bleak expression behind.{/n} "The Exalted One helps those who help themselves, shereen. And I don't want to risk the lives of my people."
  - After: "Maybe. But I miss the docks, Octy's bar..." {n}Her smile fades.{/n} "And I won't risk my people."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen, you know yourself that all this Astropathic chitchat is nothing but a stream of images, thoughts, intentions... nothing concrete! But I don't need the name of the sender — I already know it. I can smell Falco's stench all over this... or else it's Vladaym's doing — this is just that damned ashmag's style, azhi take him!"
  - After: "Astropathic messages are vague. But it reeks of Falco. Or Vladaym, that ashmag!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "If the intoxicating feeling of your own magnanimity isn't enthralling enough, shereen, I will remind you of more mundane but no less significant concerns. My network of Cold Traders is falling apart because someone threw a spanner in my well-oiled machine, and then a few more for good measure. If we do not remove these obstructions, the network will not recover. And all the resources and effort you have invested in my business will have gone down the drain."
  - After: "Then think of profit. My Cold Trader network was sabotaged. Unless we fix it, your investment is lost."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "If the galaxy itself bows down before the will of the God-Emperor and the Rogue Trader, though the Rogue Trader be nothing compared to the might of the Master of Mankind..." {n}Jae shrugs her augmented shoulder and smiles thinly.{/n} "...then who is Jae Heydari to gainsay your decisions, shereen?"
  - After: "If the galaxy bows to you..." {n}Jae shrugs thinly.{/n} "...who is Jae Heydari to argue?"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Marazhai/Marazhai_Q1/HollowMarazhai/HollowMarazhai_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You are being addressed by the Rogue Trader and master of this vessel! I command you to compose yourself before the God-Emperor's chosen and beg forgiveness for your crimes."
  - After: "I am the Rogue Trader and master here! Compose yourself and beg forgiveness."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Ulfar, would you like to say a few words to your old acquaintance?"
  - After: "Ulfar, any words for your old acquaintance?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Attack Marazhai] "I will not show leniency to the one who butchered my people!"
  - After: [Attack Marazhai] "No leniency for the butcher of my people!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Push one of the enforcers forward] "Look, Marazhai, I brought you someone!"
  - After: [Push one of the enforcers forward] "Marazhai, I brought you someone!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I forbid you from moving about the ship unsupervised, and from here on out, you will be kept under lock and key during warp jumps. The alternative is death. The choice is yours."
  - After: "No roaming unsupervised, and you're locked up during warp jumps. Or die. Choose."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What about all that talk of the great Aeldari race? If only you could see yourself now, you worthless, quivering beast! A mirage was all it took for you to soil yourself!"
  - After: "So much for the great Aeldari! A mirage made you soil yourself, you quivering beast!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "How many dysjunctions did you survive in Commorragh, Marazhai? The warp is powerless as long as you refuse to let it take hold of you. Master yourself!"
  - After: "You survived Commorragh's dysjunctions, Marazhai. The warp only takes you if you let it. Master yourself!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "In the name of the Imperium, obey your {mf|master|mistress} and lay down your weapons!"
  - After: "In the Imperium's name, obey your {mf|master|mistress}! Lay down your weapons!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your presence is causing me a great deal of grief, xenos."
  - After: "Your presence grieves me, xenos."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Kill Marazhai] "I have had enough of this heresy on my ship."
  - After: [Kill Marazhai] "Enough heresy on my ship."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Let Heinrix dispose of Marazhai] "Esteemed Interrogator, I invite you to do your duty as a servant of the Holy Inquisition."
  - After: [Let Heinrix dispose of Marazhai] "Interrogator, do your Inquisition duty."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Marazhai, are you sure you have regained your senses?"
  - After: "Marazhai, have you truly regained your senses?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will change nothing. Marazhai is free to hunt wherever he pleases on my ship."
  - After: "Nothing changes. Marazhai may hunt anywhere on my ship."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I shall grant you hunting grounds, Marazhai. A bay on the lower decks. You can do whatever your heart desires down there, but you are not to leave its bounds during warp jumps."
  - After: "I grant you a hunting bay on the lower decks. Do as you please, but stay inside during warp jumps."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai jerks his head up when you appear. His already gaunt face is tightly wrapped in pale grey, parchment-like skin, his teeth are bared feverishly, and his dark eyes have turned into two pitch-black mirrors that could show your reflection clearly if you were to gaze into them. He opens his mouth, but instead of words, an unnatural, rasping hiss comes out. If this creature ever possessed intelligence, there is no sign of it left.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai looks up, teeth bared, eyes black mirrors, hissing mindlessly.{/n}
- **Artisan of Pain**
  - Before: "At last..." {n}The resonant voice that has followed you on your journey through the deck sounds like it is coming from every direction, chilling you to the bone.{/n} "At last we meet, my poor child. Look at him, mortal. Look at how he yearns to return to the one whose caress his kind rejects so stubbornly. Come, child. Follow my voice, and my Prince will grant you all the bliss and torment in this universe."
  - After: "At last..." {n}The voice is everywhere.{/n} "Come, my child. My Prince offers all bliss and torment."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai staggers to his feet, bleeding from his many wounds. There is awareness in his eyes — and fear.{/n} "They're... dead? Gone, vanished... But I can still hear their whispers. How do mon-keigh bear them for days and days on end?" {n}You hear genuine confusion in his voice.{/n}
  - After: {n}Marazhai staggers up, aware, afraid.{/n} "Gone... yet they whisper. How do mon-keigh bear it?" {n}He's confused.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "This ends now." {n}Heinrix draws his weapon, and the air around him grows colder.{/n} "We are putting the rabid beast down for good."
  - After: "This ends now." {n}Heinrix draws; the air chills.{/n} "Put the beast down."

  - After: {n}Marazhai's expression shifts.{/n} "The entire time you've been here..."

  - Before: {n}The warp spawn laughs musically.{/n} "Sooner or later, all of his kind will step into my embrace. The Prince is patient. The Prince knows that every Aeldari soul is already his."
  - After: {n}The warp spawn laughs.{/n} "The Prince is patient. Every Aeldari soul is his."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}The Drukhari lowers his head in thought. Then he gives Yrliet a sidelong glance.{/n} "I should have understood. From what you told me..." {n}Marazhai stops himself.{/n} "Well, no matter."

  - Before: "You moron, what is wrong with you? Is it so hard to just say, 'Thanks for saving my sorry hide just now'?" {n}Idira mutters under her breath in exasperation, not daring to raise her voice.{/n}
  - After: "Moron! Just say thanks!" {n}Idira mutters.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}The Wolf's upper lip lifts in a predatory snarl, and ferocious excitement flashes in his eyes. Ulfar's form seems to grow larger and darker as he utters,{/n} "Long have I waited for this, craven minion of derisible masters. And so have my brothers. This is where you meet your death. And your death will be long."

- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai, half-crouched, is teetering slightly, and that is the only movement you can see. His body language shows that he is ready to attack, as do the bloodstained blades he is holding.{/n}

- **Marazhai**

- **Artisan of Pain**

- **Marazhai**

- **Marazhai**

  - After: "I... never..." {n}He gnashes his teeth.{/n} "I forgot myself, briefly."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Your confident voice reverberates through the metal room. The Drukhari blinks. Then blinks again. The mirror-like surface of his eyes seems to ripple, as if something else is beginning to surface apart from the soulless reflection, something vaguely resembling awareness.{/n}

- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Your eyes can barely register the speed with which Marazhai moves. The scream becomes a howl, then a rattle, then the Drukhari throws the mangled corpse away and steps back. The impenetrable reflective veil over his eyes breaks, and you can almost make out his pupils.{/n}

- **Marazhai**

- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai does not react in time — warp madness must have affected him more than he is letting on. He lets out a short rasp and falls to the floor. His death throes only last a moment, and then the xenos is no more.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The trembling enforcers remain where they are. It would seem that their fear of the mad xenobeast is stronger than their fear of the Rogue Trader's ire.{/n}

- **Marazhai**

- **Marazhai**

- **Marazhai**

- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai closes his eyes for a moment and chuckles in satisfaction.{/n} "As it should be. See to it that I never have a shortage of prey — I tend to run out too quickly for my liking."

- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai turns to you, looking the same as ever — with the exception that you can see greyish-blue veins through his parchment skin and something resembling terror in his eyes.{/n} "They're gone, {name}. ## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Marazhai/Marazhai_Q1/MassacreSurvivors/MassacreSurvivors_dialogue

- **Player**

  - After: "Who were the victims?"

  - Before: "I have heard enough. I am heading inside."
  - After: "Enough. I'm going inside."

  - Before: [Point at the Daemonette] "Can you see her?"
  - After: [Point at the Daemonette] "See her?"

Well, actually, they say this... associate of yours had been acting strangely even before that. Then he suddenly howled and lunged at the people nearby."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, after translation your xenos started hearing things. He cut his own hand, then attacked people."

He's holed up in there." {n}He nods at the barricaded gate.{/n} "He corralled a number of crewmen in there like {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}groxes{/g} to a slaughterhouse, all we could hear were screams... Well, we couldn't save them, so we locked him in there so he couldn't crawl back out. Unless he finds a crack to squeeze through..."
  - After: "He's in there." {n}He nods at the barricade.{/n} "Herded crewmen in like {g|Encyclopedia:Grox}groxes{/g}. We locked him in."
- **Deck Enforcer**
  - Before: {n}The officer looks behind him, glances around the deck, then turns to you with an alarmed expression.{/n} "See w-who, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"
  - After: {n}The officer looks around, alarmed.{/n} "See w-who, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Whom are you referring to, Lord Captain?"
  - After: "Whom do you mean, Lord Captain?"
- **Deck Enforcer**
  - Before: "Anyone he could get his hands on, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}... Officers, serfs... a technomat... He even attacked a servitor, although that didn't last long, he just tore its head off. We figured, if the xenos thinks about showing his face, those systems will get him..."

  - After: "She Who Thirsts calls him." {n}Yrliet pales.{/n} "Beyond the veil, your wards can't silence her."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Marazhai/Marazhai_Q2/DrukhariMessengersPrompt/DrukhariMessengersPrompt

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Marazhai/Marazhai_Q2/DyingKabalite/DyingKabalite

  - Before: "It is time for us to go."

  - After: "What's happening on the planet?"

  - After: {n}He wheezes.{/n} "I am..."

  - After: {n}Marazhai grins.{/n} "My blades are restless."

  - After: {n}Yrliet recoils.{/n} "I answered to him at my trial in Commorragh..." {n}She grimaces.{/n}
- **Abelard**
