  - After: {n}Abelard rubs his temple.{/n} "So one xenos gang ate another for a ringleader's whim?"
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "To put it succinctly, yes."
  - After: "In short, yes."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "It baffles me how these enemies of Humanity did not wipe each other out centuries ago..."
  - After: "How haven't they wiped each other out?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Honestly, sometimes I just can't tell if I should be scared of the sheer cheek of our skinny xenos or impressed by it..."
  - After: "Is our skinny xenos's cheek scary or impressive?"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Sinisthoria. The last Succubus from the Cult of the Fatal Thirst that ruled the arena." {n}Marazhai responds without taking his eyes off his kin.{/n} "It was she who suggested I join the Bloodstained Proselytes instead of decorating her chambers with my innards."
  - After: "Sinisthoria, last Succubus of the Fatal Thirst." {n}Marazhai watches.{/n} "She sent me to the Bloodstained Proselytes."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Well, Rogue Trader? Why are we wasting time... when all our targets are out in the open? Give... the order..." {n}Argenta is shaking with the desire to raise her weapon.{/n}
  - After: "Targets in the open... Order it..." {n}Argenta shakes.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet looks as if she intends to say something, but she stops herself in time, hiding a smile.{/n}
  - After: {n}Yrliet hides a smile.{/n}
- **Archon Nazrakhei**
  - Before: "You have spoiled your pet, Marazhai. A mon-keigh that dares to speak in the presence of Aeldari... You could have at least sewn its mouth shut so as not to offend your ears with its ceaseless yapping."
  - After: "Your pet speaks before Aeldari, Marazhai? Sew its mouth shut."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Indeed, Nazrakhei." {n}Marazhai's voice is dull and almost bored.{/n} "What are the Great Archon and his pet Succubus doing here?"
  - After: "Indeed." {n}Marazhai sounds bored.{/n} "Why are the Archon and his Succubus here?"
- **Archon Nazrakhei**
  - Before: "I gave them the privilege of joining the Black Heart, the greatest Kabal of glorious Commorragh. But only if they tracked down and brought back the last surviving member of the former Archon's line, the last living Aezyrraesh. Your former warriors have done their part, though not without assistance from the Wyches of the Fatal Thirst. But that is no reason to deny them credit."
  - After: "They join the Black Heart for bringing me the last Aezyrraesh, with the Wyches' help."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Marazhai/Marazhai_Q2/TempestAftermath/TempestAftermath

- **Player**
  - Before: "And now explain to me what happened, xenos."
  - After: "Now explain what happened, xenos."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Will you leave me now? Just like that?"
  - After: "You'll just leave me now?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You think Marazhai could return to Commorragh?"
  - After: "Marazhai could return to Commorragh?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you not regret what happened?"
  - After: "Regrets?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Does this mean there is no one left to threaten you?"
  - After: "So no one's left to threaten you?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The fun is over. It is time to return."
  - After: "Fun's over. Time to return."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What of me? I still have need of your aid, Marazhai!"
  - After: "I still need your aid, Marazhai!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are not going anywhere until the terms of our deal are met!"
  - After: "Not until our deal is met!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "We must go. Let us not linger here."
  - After: "We must go. Let's not linger."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai shakes the blood off the blade and turns to the surviving Drukhari. His voice booms like thunder.{/n} "Who else dares to question my right?"
  - After: {n}Marazhai shakes off blood.{/n} "Who else questions me?"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai looks around the battlefield.{/n} "Nazrakhei is dead. Sinisthoria is dead. And all those cowards and sycophants are dead, every last one of them!"
  - After: {n}Marazhai looks around.{/n} "Nazrakhei, Sinisthoria, all the cowards: dead!"
- **Kharael**
  - Before: {n}Kharael lowers his head.{/n} "No, Archon Marazhai. The Aezyrraesh family has been chosen to lead the Kabal of the Reaving Tempest."
  - After: {n}Kharael bows.{/n} "No one, Archon. The Aezyrraesh lead the Reaving Tempest."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai laughs wickedly.{/n} "Yes, I remember. You still have plenty of enemies in need of my personal attention."
  - After: {n}Marazhai laughs.{/n} "Right. Your enemies need me."
- **Kharael**
  - Before: {n}Kharael shifts his gaze to Marazhai.{/n} "Archon Yremeryss. Archon Nazrakhei. The Cult of the Fatal Thirst. These are compelling reasons to make any who doubt the Aezyrraesh or wish to hinder this line bite their tongues, lest they become its next victims. Compelling enough to force Commorragh into accepting Archon Marazhai."
  - After: {n}Kharael eyes Marazhai.{/n} "Yremeryss, Nazrakhei, the Fatal Thirst. Their fates will force Commorragh to accept Archon Marazhai."
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "Your Kabal has been crushed and nearly wiped out completely. Commorragh is a death trap for your kin. So tell me, Dark One, are you purposefully luring the fallen Dracon back so you have something to bargain with when the minions of your supreme overlord come for your head?"
  - After: "Your Kabal is nearly gone. Is the Dracon your bargaining chip, Dark One?"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "I have no need of spineless, disloyal scum who were tested by circumstance and found wanting. The ones who cast me down I have ground to dust. What is there to regret?" {n}His gaze is directed somewhere else, past you, past the bloody remains beneath your feet, toward something only he can see.{/n} "I will find a purpose for myself. I will find whoever is pursuing me, even if that means tracking them here and not in the Webway."
  - After: "I ground my betrayers to dust. Why regret?" {n}He stares past you.{/n} "I'll find a purpose, and my hunters."
- **Kharael**
  - Before: {n}Kharael hesitates before muttering a reply, unable to tear his gaze away from the burning eyes of his overlord.{/n} "Your instructions will be carried out to the letter, Archon Marazhai."
  - After: {n}Kharael mutters:{/n} "It will be done, Archon."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Mandrakes. Nazrakhei's followers. The remains of the Reaving Tempest... No, I am still in danger. But will they risk hunting me, a Drukhari who lives in realspace and has destroyed all of his enemies? I doubt it."
  - After: "Mandrakes, Nazrakhei's followers... I'm still in danger. But will they dare hunt me here?"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai turns to Kharael.{/n} "You must act swiftly. Gather the survivors. Go back to Commorragh and find those loyal to the Tempest. Eliminate the traitors and renegades. Find a weak Kabal that can be consumed and start preparations for the raid. When I return... we will strike."
  - After: {n}Marazhai turns to Kharael.{/n} "Gather survivors, return to Commorragh, purge traitors, find a weak Kabal to consume. Then we raid."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}One by one, the Drukhari silently disappear amidst the devastation and traces of battle. You hear the roar of engines in the distance as the predatory silhouettes of the xenos ships start rising into the sky.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Drukhari ships roar skyward.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai turns his gaze on you, a satisfied grin adorning his face.{/n} "I have had enough of this rock, {name}. Let us go back to the ship as soon as we collect our trophies. Later... you and I will have a talk."
  - After: {n}Marazhai grins.{/n} "Trophies, then the ship, {name}. Later, we talk."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai nods grimly.{/n} "Indeed. And once we are back... you and I will have a talk. But for now... let us collect the trophies."
  - After: {n}Marazhai nods.{/n} "Trophies first. Later, we talk."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai chuckles and seizes Kharael by the chin in a fluid motion, the deceptively gentle act causing the white-haired Drukhari to flinch and then go still.{/n} "Patience, my pet. Concentrate on your duties... and I will be back with you before you know it."
  - After: {n}Marazhai grips Kharael's chin.{/n} "Patience, pet. I'll be back."
- **Kharael**
  - Before: "Fallen, risen..." {n}Kharael shakes his head condescendingly.{/n} "Those who now fear to raise their head against our enemies will follow the Aezyrraesh. And there are many, as many as Yremeryss once had — and her army of lackeys drove out most who wished to overthrow her. We will see who comes for the Reaving Tempest reborn. We will see who comes to die."
  - After: "Fallen, risen..." {n}Kharael scoffs.{/n} "The fearful will follow the Aezyrraesh. Whoever comes for the Reaving Tempest will die."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Oh, please let the xenos slink off to his Webway and leave us and our crew in peace..." {n}Abelard's voice rings with disappointment.{/n}
  - After: "Let the xenos slink off..." {n}Abelard sighs.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta's dark gaze follows the xenos as they leave — you can tell that she cannot bear to let so many enemies of Humanity walk away with their lives.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta glares, hating to spare them.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah starts frenziedly renewing the marks on her arm. Without looking away from the bloody pattern, she whispers,{/n} "You are my Domin still, but your decision... offends my soul."
  - After: {n}Kibellah frantically recuts her arm marks, whispering,{/n} "My Domin, this offends my soul."
- **Kharael**
  - Before: {n}Kharael looks at you with revulsion, but he notices Marazhai's narrowed eyes and answers:{/n} "The news that the Dracon survived and is in realspace was first brought to me by the old spies aboard your vessel. Nazrakhei was beside himself hoping to find the one who had turned him into the laughingstock of Commorragh first by escaping from the arena, then by fleeing the Dark City, and finally by surviving the Mandrakes' wrath. When the Archon found me, he demanded I bring him to Marazhai."
  - After: {n}Kharael, under Marazhai's glare:{/n} "Spies on your ship said the Dracon lived. Nazrakhei, shamed by his escapes, made me lead him here."
- **Kharael**
  - Before: "He must have decided that I would repeat Marazhai's same mistake and trust him. I did not, and besides, grovelling before an Archon that has fallen into disfavour is even more dangerous than resurrecting a fallen Kabal. Pretending that I was carrying out Nazrakhei's orders was easy, he became noticeably more stupid after his time in realspace. Conspiring with Marazhai via one of the unseen servants on your ship was more challenging... but not impossible."
  - After: "I didn't trust a disgraced Archon. Fooling him was easy; plotting with Marazhai via a servant on your ship, harder."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "{name}... you do realise, listening to this xenos's revelations, that your crew and ship are in for a long — very long — investigation and purge..."
  - After: "{name}... your ship now faces a long purge..."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "Do not play coy, mon-keigh. It will happen, {name}. One day." {n}He gently caresses your face with his fingers clad in his clawed metal glove, smiling.{/n} "But not just yet."
  - After: {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "It will happen, {name}." {n}His claw caresses your face.{/n} "Not yet."
- **Kharael**
  - Before: {n}Kharael hisses furiously.{/n} "What? You are not coming with us? You are going to stay with..." {n}He shoots you a look that is part disgust and part anger.{/n}
  - After: {n}Kharael hisses.{/n} "You stay with..." {n}He glares at you.{/n}
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai narrows his eyes.{/n} "Be quiet, or I will make you so. Are you starting off your service to the new Archon by challenging his decisions?"
  - After: {n}Marazhai glares.{/n} "Quiet. Challenging your Archon already?"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Navigator/Navigator_Q1/CassiaSeriousTalk/CassiaSeriousTalk_CassiaQ1_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Would you mind telling me why you needed one hundred species of bird and what you used them for?"
  - After: "Why did you need a hundred species of bird?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have been wilfully changing entries in the ship's logbook and forbidding officers from reporting it to Abelard."
  - After: "You've been altering the ship's log and forbidding officers to tell Abelard."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You must have had quite the falling-out with Jae if she is threatening to kill you."
  - After: "Jae threatening to kill you? Quite a falling-out."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The officers are reluctant to be quartered next to your chambers because of the constant emotional outbursts it causes them. Some even maim themselves and others."
  - After: "Officers near your chambers suffer emotional outbursts. Some maim themselves and others."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I think I have heard enough."
  - After: "I've heard enough."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your interpretation of this classical text is not entirely correct. If the subjects have grown accustomed to the ruling house, all the sovereign must do is refrain from breaching longstanding traditions. Adjust unwanted laws as gradually as you would shift the bed of a flooded river, and no one will ever take your power from you."
  - After: "You misread it. If subjects are used to the house, respect tradition and change laws gradually, like a river's bed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "On the contrary, the loyalty of subjects can be bought at a pittance — lower a tax, throw them a festival, or feed the needy — a gracious gesture once every cycle will exalt you in the eyes of the rabble as if it were His own blessing."
  - After: "Loyalty is cheap: a tax cut, a festival, bread. One gesture a cycle seems His blessing."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This inner turmoil is clouding your mind. My protectorate, my subjects, my title are mere resources that I am using solely for my own ends."
  - After: "Turmoil clouds your mind. My protectorate, subjects and title are just resources for my ends."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It is my duty whether I like it or not."
  - After: "It's my duty, like it or not."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Please, do continue."
  - After: "Please, continue."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Enough talk, Lady Cassia! You have pushed me to my limit. Dismissed."
  - After: "Enough, Lady Cassia! Dismissed."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am not afraid of acquiring a reputation for ruthlessness. I would rather crush a rebellion than condone one — is that not the greater mercy, in the end?"
  - After: "I'd rather be ruthless and crush a rebellion than condone one. Isn't that the greater mercy?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will exercise restraint and lenience in my actions. Excessive suspicion and mistrust harden the hearts of the people and turn them against each other."
  - After: "I'll be lenient. Suspicion hardens hearts and turns people against each other."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Oh, it has always been my opinion that subjects expect two things from their sovereign — to abuse power and to bless their babies. Succeed at both, and boring essays become unnecessary."
  - After: "Subjects want two things: abuse of power and blessed babies. Do both, skip the essays."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I beg your pardon, Oystach who? Is reading your only pastime?"
  - After: "Oystach who? Is reading your only pastime?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I am afraid I do not have an answer — I am not familiar with the works of this... scholar."
  - After: "I don't know this... scholar's works."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have done terrible things, but I would not presume to lecture a person of noble blood."
  - After: "You've done terrible things, but I won't lecture a noble."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Woes dog your steps, but we will find a way to defeat them. I promise."
  - After: "Woes dog you, but we'll defeat them. I promise."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It is not always easy, but I try to lead the dynasty toward prosperity by worthy means."
  - After: "It's not easy, but I try to lead the dynasty to prosperity by worthy means."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I never promised I would give you an answer. Let's end it at that."
  - After: "I never promised an answer. Let's end it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The messenger you rebuked butchered his own family and then killed himself."
  - After: "The messenger you rebuked butchered his family and killed himself."
- **Player**
  - Before: "During the warp voyage you gave the wrong orders, which led to the vessel shifting off course and the service bay being destroyed."
  - After: "Your wrong orders in the warp pushed us off course and destroyed the service bay."
- **Player**
  - Before: "My crew has good reason to fear you — you truly are a monster. From now on I forbid you to leave your chambers unless absolutely necessary."
  - After: "My crew is right to fear you, monster. You'll stay in your chambers unless absolutely necessary."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You have a kind soul but have difficulty reaching out to people. I could teach you the art of communication, if you like."
  - After: "You're kind but struggle with people. I could teach you to communicate."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Everyone who has dared to slander you will be punished. There is nothing reprehensible about your actions."
  - After: "Anyone who slandered you will be punished. You did nothing wrong."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Forgive my temerity, Lady Cassia. I was looking into your eyes and completely forgot your question."
  - After: "Forgive me, Lady Cassia. Lost in your eyes, I forgot your question."
- **Player**
  - Before: "One must be a tyrant, a friend, and a jester to one's subjects. What matters is that to clearly discern which role is required at a given moment."
  - After: "Be tyrant, friend and jester to your subjects, and know which role each moment needs."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "What is it you wanted to talk about, Lord Captain? I have nothing to say to your unfounded accusations about my conflicts with the crew — I cannot recall my having a single quarrel with any of your people during my entire time aboard!"
  - After: "What is it, Lord Captain? I've quarrelled with no one!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Admittedly, I am at a loss myself. The day we arrived on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} I sent a request to the ship's quartermaster and asked him to get me a songbird. But he never asked for clarification, and shortly before we left I had a countless number of cages delivered to me, all wrapped in bright red panic with flickering tints of fear. There was a bird in every one!"
  - After: "I asked the quartermaster for a songbird on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}. Countless caged birds arrived!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I haven't rebuked a single errand boy on this ship." {n}Cassia ponders this for a moment.{/n} "Ah, I think I remember! A kind young man with a shy smile and skilful fingers with too much rotten ochre on his shoulders. I grew tired of the disgusting colour and advised him to lighten his burden by casting the weight off his shoulders. He did not come the next day. Or ever again."
  - After: "Rebuked?" {n}Cassia ponders.{/n} "Ah, a shy youth heavy with rotten ochre. I told him to cast off the weight. He never returned."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I beg to differ! I read numerous books on Astra Nataris and can swear on House Orsellio's honour that your officers are entering data in complete contravention of regulation! False terms, random distances between lines, spelling mistakes in even the simplest of words. I have spent the last few cycles correcting the latest log entries, and I thought it would please Master Abelard, as he is so fond of order."
  - After: "No! Your officers' log entries break Astra Nataris regulation. I fixed them for Master Abelard."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia's ruby eyes become round and an unbidden flush suffuses her pale face with a rosy tint.{/n} "We didn't... I didn't... That is our private business — the issue was between me and Lady Jae. Lord Captain, please pay it no heed. We made our peace long ago. And I will have you know — no one threatened me. Your information is incorrect."
  - After: {n}Cassia blushes.{/n} "Private. Lady Jae and I made peace. No one threatened me."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Very well. Since we are done with this... misunderstanding, I would like to change the subject. It would only be fair for me to ask you a few questions now, wouldn't it?" {n}Cassia hesitates and continues in a less confident tone.{/n} "Do not mistake me, I am not going to accuse you of anything! It's just that... you are the most worthy interlocutor on the entire ship. And you are always so busy..."
  - After: "May I ask you questions now?" {n}She falters.{/n} "Not accusations! You're the worthiest company aboard."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "You are sending me away? Now?" {n}Cassia's look makes you wince as though you've just tasted sour citrus.{/n} "Although... Never mind. I dare not take up any more of your time, Lord Captain."
  - After: "Sending me away?" {n}Her look stings.{/n} "Never mind."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I admit I was afraid we were too different. And yet... You helped me realise that I can be candid with you."
  - After: "I feared we were too different. Yet I can be candid with you."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Thank you for the conversation, Lord Captain. It was... fascinating."
  - After: "Thank you, Lord Captain. Fascinating."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is so much power in your words — power that makes me want to join you. I understand now why your subjects are eager to follow you."
  - After: "Such power in your words. I see why your subjects follow you."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I must confess that sometimes I can hardly bear the burden the House has placed upon me. I feel I am not doing my best... Tell me how you, heir to a protectorate, can bear the responsibility for billions of lives day after day and not stoop under all the weight?"
  - After: "The House's burden crushes me. How do you bear billions of lives?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia cannot help but smile a little.{/n} "Please don't, Lord Captain. I was expecting a serious conversation, but you are joking. I hope you will give a proper answer to my second question."
  - After: {n}Cassia smiles.{/n} "You jest. Answer my second question properly."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Thank you for your patience, {name}. You are helping me to see the world in different colours... a novel experience for me. Our conversations hold a special place in my heart. Allow me to bid you farewell for now. I am heading back to my chambers to consider today's conversation."
  - After: "Thank you, {name}. You show me new colours. I treasure our talks. Farewell."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "And yet the Seneschal did not appreciate my efforts and for some reason called them an outrage. Even though mere days before he had been swaddling me in warm yellow words — I noticed all your people do this when they are expressing sympathy. I merely wanted to repay the Seneschal with the same courtesy. Perhaps he finds my friendliness off-putting?"
  - After: "Yet the Seneschal called it an outrage, though he'd swaddled me in warm yellow sympathy. Am I off-putting?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Will you share your thoughts with me?"
  - After: "Will you share your thoughts?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "According to the twenty tomes penned by the preacher Oystach-Istafan the Forgotten, mercy and cruelty go through the world hand in hand, but people flock only to one pan of the scales. Would you rather inspire fear in your followers, or be magnanimous and choose awe?"
  - After: "Oystach-Istafan the Forgotten says mercy and cruelty walk together. Rule by fear, or by awe?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "You... are saying strange things. I do not understand how you can even... A jester? Stuff and nonsense!"
  - After: "A jester? Stuff and nonsense!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "My ey—" {n}Cassia's cheeks flush.{/n} "Lord Captain, we do not know each other well enough for such talk. I forgive you... this time. Please try to listen to my second question."
  - After: "My ey—" {n}Cassia blushes.{/n} "Too familiar. Forgiven, this time. Next question."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia thinks for a moment and then smiles.{/n} "Indeed. I was not wrong about your merits, or your ability to hold a conversation. I hope my second question does not confound you either."
  - After: {n}Cassia smiles.{/n} "Indeed. Now my second question."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Perhaps I was mistaken about the vastness of your knowledge. I hope you will be able to answer my other question with more grace."
  - After: "Your knowledge is less vast than I thought. Try the next one."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We may not think alike, and I do not always understand your motives, and yet... May I be candid with you?"
  - After: "We differ, yet... may I be candid?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia shakes her head in disapproval.{/n} "I was expecting a serious conversation, but you are laughing in my face? I do hope you will give a proper answer to my second question."
  - After: {n}Cassia frowns.{/n} "You mock me? Answer my second question properly."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia regards you with an icy glare.{/n} "I also enjoy art. Painting. Singing. Writing poetry. But I fear those subjects would equally alien to you."
  - After: {n}Cassia glares.{/n} "I also paint, sing and write poetry. Alien to you, surely."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You may be right..." {n}It seems that Cassia did not appreciate your words.{/n}
  - After: "You may be right..." {n}Cassia is displeased.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I already told you I cannot control my abilities! What else do you want from me? Will I be assigned a Pariah chaperone? Or will you put me in suppressing shackles?"
  - After: "I can't control it! A Pariah chaperone? Shackles?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your kindness knows no bounds, {name}." {n}Cassia lowers her silver eyelashes.{/n} "I will endeavour not to cause you any more trouble..."
  - After: "So kind, {name}." {n}Cassia lowers her eyes.{/n} "I'll trouble you no more..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Lord... Lord Captain! I presume that you haven't yet read the book that I recommended to you. Or perhaps you already have and are simply ridiculing me?" {n}Your heart grows hotter in your chest, you lose your breath, and warmth rushes to your cheeks. Cassia, her face flush with colour, cannot bring herself to raise her snow-white eyelashes.{/n} "Just this once, I shall forgive you your... absent-mindedness. Please do try to concentrate when I ask you this next question."
  - After: "Lord Captain! Haven't you read my book? Are you mocking me?" {n}You both flush.{/n} "Forgiven once. Focus."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "That... would be wonderful! My education on Eurac V was cut short, but I had realised by then that the wisdom of books is a poor substitute for the wisdom of experience."
  - After: "Wonderful! My schooling on Eurac V was cut short; books can't replace experience."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia purses her lips.{/n} "So this is what you've decided."
  - After: {n}Cassia purses her lips.{/n} "So you've decided."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I saw something in the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g}. Something... vast. Predatory. Shimmering with indescribable colours. It came from nowhere and stared at the ship with hundreds of hungry eyes, right there in our path. I decided to change the course while it was still possible but did not want to sow panic. Would it have been better to tell the crew we were heading straight into a monster's gaping maw?"
  - After: "In the {g|Encyclopedia:Warp}warp{/g} something vast and predatory watched our path with hungry eyes. I changed course quietly, avoiding panic."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Thank you, Lord Captain. I hope your people won't soon forget the coming lesson in humility — their stinging backs will help to remind them."
  - After: "Thank you. Their stinging backs will teach them humility."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I read a treatise by Paisius de Mobbius very recently, who claimed that subjects would never believe their new ruler was better than the old one unless the old one had been a tyrant. No matter the circumstances, the lowborn rabble become deluded about their prospects and rebel in favour of their base desires. What do you make of that?"
  - After: "Paisius de Mobbius wrote that subjects favour a new ruler only if the old was a tyrant. Your view?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "This lack of manners is unbecoming of a Rogue Trader. And yet you are the master of this ship, and I am but a humble guest who abides by your rules."
  - After: "How rude. But you are master here, I a mere guest."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I was so excited, I thought I would have a hundred friends instead of just one! They were squeaking so piteously I let the poor things out. I even fed them my breakfast and dinner... But the stupid birds would not stop chittering even after bedtime! They were dashing about the room, smacking me in the face with their wings... and defecating! I became angry, and suddenly they started pecking at each other's eyes and attacking me! Then I became afraid — and they fell over dead... I do not think I want to keep pets anymore."
  - After: "A hundred friends! I fed them, but they shrieked and soiled everything. I got angry: they pecked each other and me. Afraid: they dropped dead. No more pets."

  - After: "Outrageous, but fair. Accepted — and our treaty withdrawn."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "Theodora von Valancius was a very open-minded woman, but sagacious Tisiphone did not support many of her... endeavours. And neither should we. We are afraid House Orsellio will have to refuse the Rogue Trader's offer."
  - After: "Tisiphone opposed Theodora von Valancius's ways. We refuse."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "We fear that honour will not allow us to betray our allies in such a contemptible manner."
  - After: "Honour forbids betraying our allies."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "There can be no doubt the traitors must be executed. All their complaints about Tisiphone's tyranny are merely a cover for their self-interest and their desire to seize power over the House. Did they hate Tisiphone? Perhaps. But I did not wrong them, and neither did your people."
  - After: "Execute the traitors. They wanted power, not justice."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "As we said earlier, the child must return to the fold of her House. We hope you will be gracious enough to acquiesce."
  - After: "The child must return to her House."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "{g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}." {n}The regent's sagging lips twist in a condescending sneer.{/n} "We hope the von Valancius protectorate finds its bearings soon and you astound us with {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_HumbleWelcome}functions every bit as grand as those of your peers{/d}."
  - After: "{g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}." {n}He sneers.{/n} "Someday, perhaps, {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_HumbleWelcome}functions every bit as grand as those of your peers{/d}."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "Say your farewells, child. Should you ever see the Rogue Trader again, it will be as the Novator of House Orsellio."
  - After: "Say farewell, child. Next time, you'll be Novator."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: {n}Regent Aaronto nods slowly.{/n} "In that case, House Orsellio is deeply indebted to the Rogue Trader, and we are willing to reciprocate such a magnanimous gesture. We trust that a treaty of friendship and alliance underpinned by the transfer of several artefacts of exceeding rarity will suffice."
  - After: {n}He nods.{/n} "We owe you: an alliance and rare artefacts."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "If I may speak, so many dirty colours have poured from the mouths of those present that I feel covered in filth from head to toe. I... As the future Novator, I want to bleach them, purify them, and let them go! Heed me — I am the one to blame for what happened today! And I accept full responsibility for the actions of my House." {n}Cassia speaks bravely and openly, though her hands are shaking a little.{/n}
  - After: "Such filthy colours here. As future Novator, I'd purify them and let them go! The blame is mine." {n}Her hands shake.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I... I thought you needed a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}. If you do not," {n}Cassia says, her face hardening in an instant,{/n} "it will be my pleasure to leave with the esteemed regent."
  - After: "I thought you needed a {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g}. If not," {n}she stiffens,{/n} "I'll leave."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: {n}Regent Aaronto remains silent for a long while.{/n} "So be it. We failed to notice that our child had grown up and become strong. You may stay with the Rogue Trader until the House summons you — {mf|his|her} influence is... anomalous, but it has served to bring out blessed Tisiphone's most precious talent — the talent of leadership."
  - After: {n}Silence.{/n} "So be it. Our child has grown. Stay until summoned — {mf|his|her} influence awoke Tisiphone's leadership."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: {n}Lady Elina stares at Cassia incredulously with bulging eyes but remains silent. Her hand restlessly caresses the spot where her Atlas is embedded.{/n}
  - After: {n}Elina stares at Cassia, touching her Atlas.{/n}
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia watches you closely, holding her hands in a gesture of prayer.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cassia watches you, hands in prayer.{/n}
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "Now come, child, it is time we departed for your new home, so that we may finish what we started." {n}He stretches out his withered hand, covered with translucent leathery membranes, toward Cassia.{/n}
  - After: "Come, child." {n}He reaches for her.{/n}
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "You call this a fair trial? Ridiculous! Everyone here is rotten to the core. All of you are heretics and madmen! Curse you! Curse you!"
  - After: "Fair trial? Heretics and madmen! Curse you!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}An unkindly light glints in Cassia's eyes:{/n} "Very well... Considering the circumstances, I will use the power..."
  - After: {n}Cassia's eyes glint coldly.{/n} "Very well... I'll use the power..."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "What does this mean, Rogue Trader? Did she not admit her guilt?"
  - After: "What? She admitted her guilt!"
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "Tisiphone always had plenty of opponents, but we were afraid to trust one another — any of us could be spying for her followers. We saved our strength and dealt the first blow five years after the heir was born, striking at one of the estates on Ir-T-Vi. But the girl survived, and Regent Aaronto hid her so far away and guarded so thoroughly it took us another thirteen years to find her."
  - After: "Fearing spies, we waited. We struck Ir-T-Vi when she was five; she survived. Finding her took thirteen years."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: {n}Elina watches you with hatred, unable to change her fate in any way.{/n}
  - After: {n}Elina glares, helpless.{/n}
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "Tisiphone's madness weakened the dynasty, and not long ago the {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novator{/g} vanished — indeed, her loyal followers lie when they say she chose to retire. The truth is that nobody knows the truth. I hope she is rotting away on one of her secret worlds," {n}Elina finishes with a sneer.{/n}
  - After: "Then the {g|Encyclopedia:Novator}Novator{/g} vanished — no one knows where. I hope she's rotting," {n}Elina sneers.{/n}
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "What an honour. I must give credit where credit is due, at least you bothered to listen to me. Good luck with the monster, Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Honoured. Good luck with the monster."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: {n}The unnaturally bulbous eyes of the {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} constantly shift between you and Cassia. Black secretions run down her cheeks instead of tears, leaving unsightly streaks.{/n}
  - After: {n}The bulging-eyed {g|Encyclopedia:Navigator}Navigator{/g} weeps black streaks.{/n}
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "I do not know what it is you wish to learn, but I will start from the very beginning. A long time ago, Tisiphone ascended to the throne of Orsellio — she was a daring Novator who brought part of the House to the Expanse, hoping to strengthen our position in the Imperium. The House prospered but Tisiphone was never satisfied — she went mad in her pursuit of power, seeking more influence, more control, and she saw enemies everywhere, even among her loyal followers."
  - After: "Tisiphone brought part of the House to the Expanse. We prospered, but she went mad for power, seeing enemies everywhere."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "At first many branches of House Orsellio tried to resist her tyranny — and Tisiphone cut them down with extreme brutality. For example, the entire Setthala branch was destroyed simply because its leaders asked too many questions about the Atlas and wanted to know the truth about its creation."
  - After: "She butchered resisters. The Setthala branch died for asking how the Atlas was made."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "Tisiphone passed her Atlas on to her successor before fleeing the House — to a newborn child! We could not surrender the throne to the tyrant's creature. Tisiphone was cunning and treacherous, she must have hatched the entire plan beforehand — her disappearance, the child, the transfer of the leash. We feared that one day she would be reborn in Cassia's body. And we could not let that happen."
  - After: "Fleeing, Tisiphone gave her Atlas to a newborn — planned. We feared she'd be reborn in Cassia."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: {n}Elina clicks her tongue loudly.{/n} "Regent Aaronto is guilty of mass killings, intimidation, inhuman torture, abetting Tisiphone, and raising her heir. His crimes are many, but this one is not among them. I'd love to see his head on the chopping block, but honour prohibits me from slandering him in a trial before the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}."
  - After: {n}Elina tuts.{/n} "Aaronto has massacres to answer for — not this. Honour forbids slander before the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "The Rogue Trader now knows about the regent's atrocities — and the girl's corruption. I hope I succeeded in warning you about the danger that lurks within Cassia Orsellio."
  - After: "Now you know. Beware Cassia Orsellio."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "Largely yes, but there is more. Have you never felt pure, unadulterated disgust while standing close to her? Or perhaps fury, or fear? Who but a monster would manipulate the minds and feelings of others? Even more so than Tisiphone herself did?"
  - After: "Mostly. Haven't you felt disgust or fear near her? Only a monster twists feelings so."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "I swore to tell nothing but the truth."
  - After: "I swore to tell the truth."
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "Thank you, Rogue Trader. We will contact your representative as soon as we return to the base and discuss what has transpired with the other branches of the House."
  - After: "Thank you. We'll contact your representative."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "Hear us, child. This burden is too heavy for you to shoulder alone. You are not yet ready..."
  - After: "Child, you're not ready..."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I... I am not sure my Atlas truly is the one that once belonged to Her Ladyship Tisiphone."
  - After: "I'm not sure my Atlas is Tisiphone's."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "House Orsellio is deeply saddened by the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Cassia_KilledBothNavis}passing of Theobald Thrice-Pioneer Orsellio{/d} — and at the hand of the Rogue Trader, no less! It is regrettable that the holder of a sacred {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} chose to deprive the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g} of one Navigator's eye." {n}The regent grimaces.{/n} "Now come, child, it is time we departed for your new home, so that we may finish what we started."
  - After: "We mourn the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Cassia_KilledBothNavis}passing of Theobald Thrice-Pioneer Orsellio{/d} — by a {g|Encyclopedia:Warrant}Warrant{/g} holder! A loss to the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}." {n}He grimaces.{/n} "Come, child."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: {n}Reddish brown splotches cover the regent's face.{/n} "We do not wish to discuss the transgressions of the Rogue Trader — this is not the time or the place. That {name} von Valancius chose to {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Cassia_HelpedNaviRadicals}side with the most despicable renegades{/d} among the {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g} and caused the demise of our brother Theobald Thrice-Pioneer... Well, we will overlook that in exchange for your rescue, child. Now come, it is time we departed for your new home, so that we may finish what we started."
  - After: {n}He flushes.{/n} "{name} von Valancius {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Cassia_HelpedNaviRadicals}sided with the most despicable renegades{/d} of the {g|Encyclopedia:NavisNobilite}Navis Nobilite{/g}, killing Theobald. We'll overlook it. Come, child."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "A ridiculous claim! In the heat of battle, your servants would not have paused to consider who was truly to blame! We would have been cut down next to the traitors if we'd so much as reached for our weapons!"
  - After: "Ridiculous! Armed, we'd have died with the traitors!"
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: {n}Elina gives a satisfied chuckle.{/n} "At least Felek did one thing right."
  - After: {n}Elina chuckles.{/n} "Felek did one thing right."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "What are you saying, child? Isn't that what we, the Great Regent, have taught you since the very day of your birth?"
  - After: "Child? Is that not what we taught you since birth?"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia frowns and touches the {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone{/d} that is heating up under her skin.{/n} "Even if I wanted to carry out the execution personally... The traitor's artefact is limiting my powers."
  - After: {n}Cassia touches the hot {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_CassiaAmuletOn}stone{/d} in her skin.{/n} "The traitor's artefact limits me."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, ending the trial like this goes against every law and custom!"
  - After: "Lord Captain, this breaks custom!"
- **Cassia**
  - Before: {n}Cassia's expression remains calm, but her lips tremble when she turns around to look at you for the last time.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cassia looks back, lips trembling.{/n}
- **Lady Navigator Elina**
  - Before: "If you are truly letting me go... There is no need to say it twice. I will no longer cause any trouble. Not to you, at least." {n}Elina glares at Cassia and Aaronto.{/n}
  - After: "I'll trouble you no more." {n}Elina glares at Cassia and Aaronto.{/n}
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "This is unthinkable! We, the Great Regent, were hoping for a fair trial and proper decorum from Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} in accordance with the laws of the Koronus Expanse! Therefore... we are deeply disappointed, Rogue Trader."
  - After: "Unthinkable! We expected decorum from Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We are disappointed."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "Kindly explain what you mean by that!"
  - After: "Explain yourself!"
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: {n}The Navigator cocks his head.{/n} "I am afraid we, the Great Regent Aaronto, must respectfully decline your offer. House Orsellio has enough... problems of its own. I am afraid adding allies' troubles would be too great a burden for us at present."
  - After: {n}He cocks his head.{/n} "We decline. Our own problems suffice."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "Nevertheless, we must remind you that this is a... turbulent time for House Orsellio. We are delighted to be allies of the Rogue Trader, but until our internal and external conflicts are resolved, our capacity for assisting you will be limited."
  - After: "Still, until our conflicts end, our help is limited."
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: "As for the treaty of friendship between our dynasties... Our emissary will contact yours and deliver the scrolls for your signature and seal. And may the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} bless this new alliance!"
  - After: "Our emissary will bring the treaty. The {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g} bless this alliance!"
- **Regent Aaronto**
  - Before: {n}Regent Aaronto stares through you unblinkingly as though you have not spoken.{/n}
  - After: {n}Aaronto stares through you.{/n}
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: "Keep your mouth shut, Regent. Your House is guilty of attempting to take the life of a Rogue Trader — the accused will speak only when graciously permitted to do so." {n}The Proctor's hand slams into his chest with a thud.{/n} "Let judgement begin."
  - After: "Quiet, Regent. Your House tried to kill a Rogue Trader." {n}The Proctor thumps his chest.{/n} "Let judgement begin."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I will dismiss the charges against House Orsellio for what transpired."
  - After: "I dismiss the charges against House Orsellio."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Navigator/Navigator_Q1/ktc_CassiaAskForMeeting/CassiaAskForMeeting_Q1_ktc_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "In accordance with your current contract, you will serve as Navigator Primaris on this vessel for another 600 turns."
  - After: "Your contract keeps you as Navigator Primaris for 600 more turns."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would be honoured to do the Lady Navigator a favour. The Astropathic Choir will contact Regent Aaronto and arrange a formal reception on the capital world of Dargonus."
  - After: "Gladly. The Astropathic Choir will arrange a reception with Regent Aaronto on Dargonus."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Don't even think about it. A Navis Nobilite House can take care of itself without you. Your place is aboard my ship."
  - After: "Forget it. Your House can manage. Your place is on my ship."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I apologise for the sudden request for an audience, Rogue Trader. {name}. We need to discuss the future of our rela— our cooperation."
  - After: "Forgive the sudden audience, {name}. We must discuss our rela— cooperation."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Your words are oozing with virid green, Rogue Trader. They are choking people like a leash wrapped around their necks. But if you wish to make prisoners instead of allies, I have no choice but to become one of them."
  - After: "Your words ooze choking green. Prisoners, then."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "I cannot wait that long!" {n}Cassia's usually quiet voice rises, sending a wave of heat toward you — and you instinctively clench your teeth, reflecting her anger.{/n} "The regent must be told that I am alive. The House must be told I am alive! Or the Orsellio dynasty will tear itself apart from the inside. I am begging you, Rogue Trader. Aid me. I am sure Regent Aaronto will reward you most generously."
  - After: "I can't wait that long!" {n}Her anger hits you.{/n} "The House must know I live, or it'll tear itself apart. The regent will reward you."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "The events on Eurac V destroyed the world I knew. Words cannot describe the depth of my gratitude for rescuing me. But I dare not impose upon your goodwill any longer — and therefore I am asking for a favour. Help me contact Regent Aaronto. I wish to return to the fold of House Orsellio as soon as possible so that I can complete my education. The first thing I need to do is... Well, a meeting with House Orsellio will be enough."
  - After: "Thank you for saving me on Eurac V. Please help me contact Regent Aaronto and return to House Orsellio."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "You cannot imagine how badly I wanted to hear these words. Rogue Trader, you have my gratitude. I will continue to honour our agreements until we arrive on Dargonus."
  - After: "Thank you. I'll honour our deal until Dargonus."

That is utterly lamentable. But unsurprising, considering your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Cassia_KilledBothNavis}fit of bloodlust on Eurac V{/d} and your merciless actions that {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_AllExecuted}left not one but two leaders of the feuding sides decapitated{/d} at the official reception on Dargonus."
  - After: {n}Cassia shrugs coldly.{/n} "Through the Atlas I hear our Navigators. Renegades razed more estates; Orsellio blood spills. No surprise, after your {d|Encyclopedia:Ch1_Cassia_KilledBothNavis}bloodlust on Eurac V{/d} and {d|Encyclopedia:CassiaQ1_AllExecuted}beheading both leaders{/d} on Dargonus."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I came to deliver good tidings. I have spoken with the House's Navigators through the Atlas. Of late, I can feel with increasing clarity how our connection is growing stronger. Despite the dissent in its midst, House Orsellio has been able to keep a precarious equilibrium, thanks in part to your unexpected arrival on Eurac V and the resolution of the conflict at the Dargonus reception. Not all Orsellios concur with your decisions, but none can deny the impact that you, and no one else, have had on the House's present state of affairs."
  - After: "Good tidings. Through the Atlas I hear our Navigators. Thanks to you, House Orsellio holds a fragile balance. None deny your impact."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "For the first time ever, I have an opportunity to find answers to the questions my mentors so deftly avoided. Why did Tisiphone choose me? What is the Atlas? Is it true that House Orsellio's past is drenched in blood? Please, {name}, do not snap this tautly drawn string of destiny — my destiny! Journey with me in Tisiphone's wake to the distant stars!"
  - After: "At last I can learn why Tisiphone chose me and what the Atlas is. Please, {name}, follow her path with me!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In that case... I shall humbly await your decision. You know where you can find me."
  - After: "Then I'll await your decision. You know where I am."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia clenches her fists, her claws cutting into her palms, and a few ruby droplets stain the hem of her garb.{/n} "I see. I... I shall never disturb you again, Rogue Trader."
  - After: {n}Cassia's fists bleed.{/n} "I see. I won't disturb you again."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia's silvery eyelashes are stained with scarlet.{/n} "Rogue Trader, please..."
  - After: {n}Cassia's eyes redden.{/n} "Rogue Trader, please..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader? More often than not, whenever I find myself in your presence, greyish-blue mist surrounds me soon afterward." {n}Despondency. Irritation. Disappointment. The moment Cassia enters the room, you feel a wave of emotions that are not your own.{/n} "Ah, I beg your forgiveness. My powers cannot stop trying to break free from my control."
  - After: "Rogue Trader? Grey-blue mist follows you." {n}Her despondency washes over you.{/n} "Forgive me. My powers slip."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Cassia nods gratefully, lowers her gaze, and clasps her hands together.{/n} "There is more I wish to tell you. It is about... the visions that I have come to experience at an increasing rate during warp jumps. The same visions come to me again, and again, and again... It is as if I am going mad. For you see, these visions are about me, the Atlas, and Tisiphone Orsellio, the House's previous Novator. I have seen Tisiphone's experiments, the ones that involved the Navigators from the Setthala branch, which she was rumoured to have destroyed for disobedience."
  - After: {n}Cassia nods gratefully.{/n} "There's more. In warp jumps I keep seeing visions: me, the Atlas, and Tisiphone experimenting on the Setthala Navigators she supposedly destroyed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "However, I am not here to reproach you for the deeds of yore. Instead, I wish to tell you of the visions that I have come to experience at an increasing rate during warp jumps. The same visions come to me again, and again, and again... It is as if I am going mad. For you see, these visions are about me, the Atlas, and Tisiphone Orsellio, the House's previous Novator. I have seen Tisiphone's experiments, the ones that involved the Navigators from the Setthala branch, which she was rumoured to have destroyed for disobedience."
  - After: "I'm not here to reproach you. In warp jumps I keep seeing visions: me, the Atlas, and Tisiphone experimenting on the Setthala Navigators she supposedly destroyed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I shan't beg you." {n}Cassia's eyes remain impassive, but she cannot stop her pale lips from trembling.{/n} "Should the anthracite vice around your heart ever change to... lighter shades... you know where you can find me."
  - After: "I won't beg." {n}Cassia's lips tremble.{/n} "If your heart softens, you know where to find me."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Nomos/MalatekInterrogation/MalatekInterrogation_c4_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Before I accept your apologies, tell me who you are and why you infiltrated my ship."
  - After: "First, who are you and why infiltrate my ship?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I honour the fraternity of the Omnissiah's servants. It pains me to see you trespassing on board like a thief instead of arriving as a guest."
  - After: "I honour Omnissiah's servants. Why sneak aboard like a thief?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your apology is accepted. For your prompt admission of guilt, I will allow you to choose the method of your execution."
  - After: "Accepted. You may choose your execution method."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Tell me more about Theodora's journey."
  - After: "Tell me about Theodora's journey."
- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you know about this great spirit?"
  - After: "What of this great spirit?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have made my decision regarding your fate."
  - After: "I have decided your fate."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Does the name Nomos mean anything to you?"
  - After: "Does the name Nomos mean anything?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I find you guilty of offences against the Cult Mechanicus and House von Valancius. Your crimes warrant punishment more severe than death. You will atone by serving me and therefore the Imperium."
  - After: "You wronged the Mechanicus and my House. Death is too lenient: you'll atone serving me and the Imperium."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Your actions have caused no harm, and so I shall not harm you. You are free. You may stay on my ship if you so choose."
  - After: "You did no harm, so you are free. Stay aboard if you wish."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will be executed for your crimes. My decision is final."
  - After: "You will be executed. Final."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are now mine. And you shall obey my every whim."
  - After: "You're mine now. Obey my every whim."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are strong, yet you let yourself be caught."
  - After: "You're strong, yet got caught."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Very well. Your execution can wait. Speak, then."
  - After: "Fine. Execution can wait. Speak."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have changed my mind. I will choose the method myself. Burn the heretic."
  - After: "Changed my mind. Burn the heretic."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: {n}The captured man — if he can be called that — looks positively gigantic next to the enforcers at his side. Deadly-looking metal gleams dimly beneath his faded crimson robes, his hands are folded obediently, and his mechadendrites are perfectly still.{/n} "I greet the master of this vessel-cathedral and offer my humble apologies for this unbidden intrusion."
  - After: {n}A crimson-robed giant.{/n} "Master of this vessel-cathedral, forgive my intrusion."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Malateks are exiles whose ideas have not crossed the line of heresy yet have come close to it. They are removed from the Fleet's structure to give them a chance to see the folly of their ways... and prevent sedition from spreading." {n}Pasqal's voice sounds unusually alarmed.{/n}
  - After: "Malateks are near-heretic exiles." {n}Pasqal sounds alarmed.{/n}
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "All of that is trivial. My past is nothing but a set of archive data. My lost status is a part replacement string in the long chronicle of the Cognisance Fleet. I come not as the priesthood's messenger, but as a faithful disciple of the most holy Amarnat."
  - After: "My past is trivial. I follow the most holy Amarnat."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "My apologies to you as well, brother." {n}The interloper inclines his head in the direction of the frowning Pasqal.{/n}
  - After: "Apologies, brother." {n}He nods to Pasqal.{/n}
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "I dare not oppose your will and humbly accept your sentence. That I was given the chance to set foot inside this abode and behold a great spirit, however briefly, is already a great blessing. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"
  - After: "I accept. I saw the great spirit. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Submitting a priority request for a stay of my tech-brother's execution as well as a supplementary request to have the verdict reconsidered. Our first step should be extracting what information he possesses."
  - After: "Requesting a stay of execution. Let us first extract what he knows."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "My choice has long been made," {n}the prisoner says humbly.{/n} "And now I ask that you let me tell you about it — among many other things."
  - After: "Long chosen," {n}he says humbly.{/n} "Let me explain."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "My name, if it matters, is Asclepius. Formerly a Computator-General of the Cognisance Fleet, now a liber-recluse with the status of malatek."
  - After: "Asclepius. Once Computator-General of the Cognisance Fleet, now malatek."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "Whatever it is, I will accept it."
  - After: "I will accept it."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: {n}The group of servitors, whose movements are suspiciously well synchronised, stares at the towering prisoner. You do not need to hear them speak to recognise Nomos, who has seen fit to attend the interrogation.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nomos's synchronised servitors watch the prisoner.{/n}
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: {n}The giant's shoulders shift slightly.{/n} "For that, I apologise as well. I did not expect to find understanding amid the suffocating ignorance that abounds within the laity — and even many of my brethren. For this reason, I chose to carry out my mission in secret and without seeking your permission."
  - After: {n}He shrugs.{/n} "Sorry. I expected ignorance, so acted secretly."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: "We ask you to keep him for us," {n}Nomos's servitors speak up suddenly, in the faintest of whispers.{/n}
  - After: "Keep him for us," {n}Nomos's servitors whisper.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "As will I. And yet I plead that my brother be shown leniency. His story... initialises thought."
  - After: "As will I. Yet show him leniency. His story... initialises thought."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "I could not ask for more. All I wish is to remain in these halls and observe in reverence the great spirit's deeds. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"
  - After: "I ask only to stay. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "All that he conveyed to me was that Theodora had reached worlds unlike any the people of the Koronus Expanse had ever seen. There, she unearthed a great treasure of technology, one that Amarnat had the privilege of experiencing."
  - After: "Only that Theodora reached unknown worlds and found a techno-treasure Amarnat experienced."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: {n}Nomos's servitors observe everything with cold stillness.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nomos's servitors watch.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "I grieve for your fate, my former brother. Yet the gravity of your trespass is too great, and it is not within my right to defy the will proclaimed by the Rogue Trader."
  - After: "I grieve, former brother. But I cannot defy the Rogue Trader."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: {n}The prisoner offers you a bow of resignation and calmly allows the enforcers to escort him out.{/n}
  - After: {n}The prisoner bows and is led out.{/n}
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "This is not what I wished for. But if such is the price to be paid for the right of staying on this ship and beholding the currents of the great spirit, then pay it I shall. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"
  - After: "Not my wish, but I'll pay it to stay. Let the Cycle be discontinued!"
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "Yes, he did. My brother's words on this were clear. Years ago, Amarnat was part of Rogue Trader Theodora's inner circle, before their ways parted."
  - After: "Yes. Amarnat was in Theodora's inner circle, before they parted."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "My knowledge of it is scarce. My brother suspected that his memory, along with the memory of all who might have known the details, had been purposefully modified. He saw it as a sign that the journey had revealed a great truth — and there were those who did not wish to see that truth brought to light."
  - After: "Little. My brother believed memories of it were altered to bury a great truth."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "It is a great miracle, the Omnissiah's breath meant to help us discontinue the Cycle. It was born of the treasure that Amarnat and Theodora discovered upon the dark worlds. Yet even a being so glorious needs attendants and guides. And as long as the Cognisance Fleet is racked by schism and my brothers and sisters suffer defeats without end, there is no one to aid the spirit. That is why I came here."
  - After: "A miracle from Amarnat and Theodora's find, to discontinue the Cycle. It needs attendants my schism-torn Fleet can't provide. So I came."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "I took a vow that I would never inflict physical harm upon laypeople. The Omnissiah grants us the power of the True Flesh for a purpose other than damaging the frail and blind creatures that are all who have not yet tasted His knowledge."
  - After: "I vowed never to harm laypeople."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: {n}Nomos's servitors turn their heads to you and nod all at once in what can be interpreted as an expression of gratitude.{/n}
  - After: {n}Nomos's servitors nod gratefully.{/n}
- **Nomos**
  - Before: "He has not come to know us yet. He will if you let him, {name}. We know... we sense that his words are about us, that the story he has told is our story."
  - After: "Not yet. Let him, {name}. His story is ours."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "My brother once served as the Enginseer Prime on this ship." {n}Asclepius gestures around him reverently.{/n} "He was an adherent of the school of Discontinuing the Cycle, as am I."
  - After: "My brother was Enginseer Prime here." {n}He gestures reverently.{/n} "A Cycle-discontinuer, like me."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: {n}Then the prisoner turns slightly and looks straight at Nomos's observing servitors.{/n} "And of course, I must beg forgiveness from you, great spirit. It was not my intent to desecrate your temple."
  - After: {n}He faces Nomos's servitors.{/n} "Forgive me, great spirit."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: "We are interested in this shell. Nomos do not want its functions to cease." {n}The servitor chorus sounds a little different this time — its normally perfect sync is disrupted by a subtle dissonance.{/n}
  - After: "Nomos do not want this shell to cease." {n}The chorus wavers.{/n}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "It has spread that far..." {n}It is difficult to discern Pasqal's emotions from his tone.{/n}
  - After: "It spread that far..." {n}Pasqal is unreadable.{/n}
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "I know that my brother perished. But before he did, he sent me a message that told of a journey embarked upon by Theodora von Valancius. A journey through a dimensional gate — an artefact more ancient than Humanity itself — and toward worlds unknown. The blessed Amarnat was with her."
  - After: "Dying, my brother wrote that Theodora von Valancius and blessed Amarnat passed an ancient dimensional gate to unknown worlds."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "There, upon those dark worlds, he witnessed a great miracle — the birth of a machine spirit of incalculable might. My brother believed that this spirit then fell aslumber within this ship like a child in a cradle, not responding to lowly pleas. That was the purpose of my pilgrimage — to reach the ship where my brother died, the ship upon whose decks the blessed Amarnat had walked, and prostrate myself before the great spirit."
  - After: "There a mighty machine spirit was born. It sleeps in this ship. I came to bow before it."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Nomos/NomosAlignment/NomosAlignment_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "It is not yet time for us to part ways."
  - After: "Not time to part yet."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You will be destroyed for this insolence."
  - After: "You'll be destroyed for this insolence."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you do not want to help, then don't!"
  - After: "Then don't help!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What do you wish to do?"
  - After: "What do you wish?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have heard you and made my decision."
  - After: "I've decided."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You can take Asclepius's body."
  - After: "Take Asclepius's body."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You do not have my permission to claim another vessel for yourself."
  - After: "You may not claim another vessel."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You would sacrifice yourself, Asclepius?"
  - After: "You'd sacrifice yourself, Asclepius?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Every person on the bridge freezes in astonishment, watching the remarkable procession approach your throne. Officers and enforcers are glancing at you questioningly but do not interfere until they are ordered to.{/n}
  - After: {n}The bridge freezes as the procession nears.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We have come to speak with you, {name}. You gave us food for consideration by revealing the mystery of our origin. From then to now, we observed, calculated, sensed. And we discovered that a great change is coming. A trial."
  - After: "{name}. We have watched. A great trial is coming."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We see a threat to that which the Imperium brings. The intricate plexus of tenets, the determined advance of myriads through darkness by the will of the golden light. All the things that were strange to us yet in whose embrace we were born and raised. All of it is in danger. At least within the bounds of the Koronus Expanse."
  - After: "The Imperium's light that raised us is in danger."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We see the potential for a great disaster. It is already ripening. The wave could crash down upon the Koronus Expanse and, perhaps, extend beyond it. We are headed for suffering and death."
  - After: "Disaster is ripening. Suffering and death for the Koronus Expanse."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We see that the future has... potential. A great wave that sweeps everything away, a probability of deaths and ruin. And with them comes a probability of ascension. Of claiming. Of an infinity of possibilities."
  - After: "A wave of ruin comes. And with it, ascension."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are the one who can stop it. And Nomos must help you. We are an unidentified thing spawned from chance. But we want to justify our existence by serving the light."
  - After: "You can stop it, and Nomos must help. We would serve the light."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But you are not someone who can stop it. You have no light and no resolve. For this reason, we have decided that we should not help you any longer."
  - After: "But you lack light and resolve. We will help you no longer."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are the one who can prevent the disaster. And we want to help you. We do. Let us help. Nomos are not human, but we have learned to see people as more than shells. We want to save them. Protect them."
  - After: "You can prevent it. Let us help. We want to protect people."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But you are not someone who can defeat the disaster. Even if you do, you might become the next disaster. There is no light in you, no desire to protect, and for this reason, we have decided that we should not help you any longer."
  - After: "But you'd become the next disaster. We will help you no longer."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Nomos await this feast eagerly. We wish to share it with you. You are the one who can ride the wave with us."
  - After: "We crave this feast. Ride the wave with us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But you are not someone who can use this potential. You are weak, and your soul and mind are bound in chains. We see no reason to help you. We are no longer interested."
  - After: "But you are weak and chained. We are no longer interested."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Please. Give us freedom, and we will stand with you in the hour of great need."
  - After: "Free us, and we will stand with you in need."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "I grieve that this honour is not mine. But all it means is that my service is not yet done."
  - After: "I grieve. My service continues."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: "How sweet is the wait and how coveted the moment."
  - After: "How sweet the wait."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "I desire it more than anything."
  - After: "More than anything."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We asked him many times because we did not want to hurt him. Nomos would not have proposed it if the human was against it."
  - After: "We asked him many times. He agreed."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why are you asking him? He is guilty by the word of the Imperium. Now you decide what to do with his body."
  - After: "Why ask? The Imperium judged him guilty."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Why are you asking him when you can take what you want and use it how you want?"
  - After: "Why ask? Just take it."
- **Nomos**
  - Before: "Thank you, {name}. You have given us a good toy. We will leave you for now — we have yet to subdue that which occupies our future vessel. But know that when the great trial comes, so will we."
  - After: "Thank you, {name}. First we subdue its occupant. At the trial, we return."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "My grief is without end."
  - After: "My grief is endless."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If you do not want to help us, we cannot help you. We are saddened. We are leaving. For a time... or forever."
  - After: "Then we cannot help you. We are leaving."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "Praise the Omnissiah. I kneel before His favoured child and humbly offer this shell as a gift. May I become a temple to the machine and a vessel for its great spirit."
  - After: "Praise the Omnissiah. I offer this shell to His favoured child."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "How... interesting. We feel restricted, but not as much as inside servitors. Some work must be done on the new shell. Then it will be ready for journeys to the outside."
  - After: "Interesting. Freer than servitors. Some work, and it's ready."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "We will leave you for now, {name}. But in the hour when you stand before the great trial, we will return and stand with you, side by side."
  - After: "We leave for now, {name}. At the trial, we return."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is something we require to do it. Nomos are tethered to the shell of this ship. We can only follow you outside by using servitors as our shell. But they are... lacking. Only a modicum of us can enter such a primitive vessel. And our power is likewise limited."
  - After: "We are tethered to this ship. Servitors hold only a fraction of us."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We need a vessel. A body. But very few things can house us. That is why we have come to ask you. Magos Asclepius has offered his shell to us. It might do."
  - After: "We need a body. Magos Asclepius has offered his."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "Indeed I have. I cannot think of a prouder end to my pilgrimage than the liturgy of synchronisation with the great spirit. I will become a vessel for the Omnissiah's favoured child and step beyond the confines of wretched living existence and into the halls of the eternal machine song."
  - After: "Indeed. No prouder end to my pilgrimage."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "There is another option. The scion of machine and the dark light. The one you took from Kiava Gamma. It would be a pleasure for us to go into the bowels of the ship where its anger is imprisoned and rip out its raging essence to subjugate its steel shell."
  - After: "Or the Daemon Engine from Kiava Gamma. We'd gladly rip out its essence."
- **Asclepius**
  - Before: "We await your word, master of the ship."
  - After: "We await your word, master."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Wait until the unknown threat appears before you. Then face it. We do not know where or when it will happen. We do not know what we will face. But we know that we want to be there with you."
  - After: "Face the unknown threat when it comes. We'll be with you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But however frightening or all-powerful it may be, we are ready to face it. Rise against it. Even if it destroys us, it will be a sacrifice for the sake of redemption."
  - After: "But we will face it, even if it destroys us. For redemption."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But we now know that living souls are the same. They are always larger than they seem. And no capacity can calculate their potential. This makes us believe that we, Nomos, and you, {name}, can step beyond the limit of calculations. There, we will face the unleashing horror without faltering."
  - After: "But souls defy calculation. Together, {name}, we can face it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It excites us. It makes us eager. The greater the danger, the stronger the craving for triumph."
  - After: "It excites us. Greater danger, greater triumph."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Nomos have decided. We are leaving. We are glad to have received what we have from you, but we cannot and do not want to stay any longer."
  - After: "Nomos have decided. We are leaving."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We must say... It frightens us to think about this unknown something that is trying to break free. It is so vast. Too vast to measure or explain."
  - After: "This unknown thing frightens us. Too vast to measure."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Nomos/NomosFate

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "///You called yourself the Lord Captain and demanded that we start the engine. We did."
  - After: "///You, Lord Captain, demanded we start the engine. We did."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Nomos/NomosFate/NomosFate_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "Do you have at least a vague idea of what the problem is or what we might encounter?"
  - After: "Any idea what we might encounter?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Remind me, what is it we intend to do here?"
  - After: "Remind me what we intend here?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Pasqal, what is going on?"
  - After: "Pasqal, what's going on?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not fear you. I am trying to understand you."
  - After: "I don't fear you. I want to understand you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You are abominable tech-heresy. There is no place for you on my ship."
  - After: "You're tech-heresy. No place for you on my ship."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Let's start by clearing certain things up. Were you the one responsible for the ship's malfunctions? And what about the strange entries in the ship's log?"
  - After: "Did you cause the malfunctions and log entries?"

- **Player**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We feel your rapture. We share it."
  - After: "We share your rapture."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The chorus of servitors pauses, as if the controlling entity is busy thinking.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Nomos have a poor understanding of the concept of servitude. We must reflect."

  - Before: "How is that a triumph? You desire other victories. We know that you do."
