  - After: "Depot 4 means brawls and rotgut. We'd have managed without the harsh crackdown. And unrest there spreads to neighbouring sectors."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I am sorry, Lord Captain. I... I thought that drastic times called for drastic measures!" {n}Vent exclaims hotly.{/n}
  - After: "Sorry, Lord Captain. Drastic times, drastic measures!" {n}Vent says hotly.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Flushed with anger and embarrassment, the Seneschal bellows,{/n} "Enough! Lieutenant, you know where the exit is. You and I will discuss the brewing rebellion, as well as your egregious breach of protocol here today."
  - After: {n}The Seneschal, flushed:{/n} "Enough! Out, Lieutenant. We'll discuss your breach later."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This matter cannot wait. Any minute now, an assault unit will be dispatched to the lower decks on orders to crush the workers' strike by any means necessary. - **Abelard**

  - After: "Never, Seneschal. Your conduct is spotless. But your mere attention inflates junior officers and undermines discipline."

  - After: "Such trivia isn't worth your time, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

  - After: "Training the dynasty's servants is my duty. Every third person on this bridge was my student."

  - Before: "If I may, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, sending a hit squad to crush the rebellion is a means of ignoring the problem, not solving it."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, a hit squad ignores the problem."
- **Abelard**

  - Before: "Praise the Emperor!" {n}Vent cannot contain her relief.{/n} "Thank you, Lord Captain!"

  - After: "Anyone." {n}A bitter laugh.{/n} "The other houses covet our fleet and logistics."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Lady Theodora chose to grant noble status to House Werserian, but the other houses, which have served in the Expanse for millennia, did not welcome the decision. It has led to some difficulties."
  - After: "Lady Theodora ennobled the Werserians. The ancient houses resented it."
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Clementia motions sharply for Astartia to stop. Her voice rings with relief:{/n} "This explains a great deal. This is how it all started. The first allegations of forgery were enough for other accusations to be tacked on. It is good to know that the true culprit has been found. Thank you for letting us know, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I am surprised that Urbend allowed this to happen — I doubt he was involved."
  - After: {n}Clementia silences Astartia.{/n} "So the forgery claim started it all. Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I doubt Urbend was involved."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Clementia, if you know that a member of your family is guilty of the crimes you are being accused of—"
  - After: "Clementia, if one of your family is guilty—"
- **Astartia Werserian**
  - Before: {n}Astartia's face turns red, and she can barely contain the enraged cry inside her chest.{/n} "That grox spawn! I wouldn't be surprised if this was no mistake but a deliberate act of sabotage from the off..."
  - After: {n}Astartia flushes.{/n} "That grox spawn! Probably deliberate sabotage..."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Clementia." {n}A hint of sorrow creeps into Abelard's voice, belying his stern facade.{/n} "You were acting head of this family. You were supposed to take care of each and every family member. And now you are being accused of treason and collusion against the Rogue Trader, and the entire family is facing death. How could you let this happen?"
  - After: "Clementia." {n}Sorrow tinges his voice.{/n} "You led this family, and now all face death for treason. How could you?"
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "Servitors? Is that so..." {n}Clementia crosses her arms and furrows her brow, deep in thought.{/n} "I have encountered servitors that were indistinguishable from normal augmented humans, but only once. They were accompanying several members of House Gaprak."
  - After: "Servitors?" {n}She frowns.{/n} "I've seen human-like ones once, with House Gaprak."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The younger members of the Werserian family crowd around to examine the note in Clementia's hands. All present are beset with worry and bewilderment.{/n}
  - After: {n}The young Werserians eye the note, worried.{/n}
- **Clementia Werserian**
  - Before: "I am not sure if it is relevant, but perhaps you should know: since the fall of Kiava Gamma, House Gaprak has been faring poorly, to say the least. They have been looking for ways to enhance their influence and to improve their lot, including asking for help from the other noble houses. They have not approached us, of course — it is shameful to seek help from those you consider your inferiors, you understand. But perhaps the Drivestems or the Sauerbacks can tell you more about this matter."
  - After: "Since Kiava Gamma, House Gaprak has sought help from other houses, never us. Ask the Drivestems or Sauerbacks."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Laughing, Ulfar elbows Abelard.{/n} "Your brood, eh? Admit it, were you like that in your youth? As sharp as a harpoon strike to an ice troll's balls?"
  - After: {n}Ulfar elbows Abelard.{/n} "Your brood, eh? Sharp as a harpoon to an ice troll's balls?"
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard glares at Astartia before responding reluctantly,{/n} "I'm afraid I cannot answer you on that last part. As for your general point, yes, I certainly was. And now I better understand why I was so frequently belted."
  - After: {n}Abelard glares at Astartia.{/n} "Yes. Now I see why I was belted so often."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q1/ArgentaTemple/ArgentaTemple_SororitasQ1_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "We don't have time for talk. Let's keep moving!"
  - After: "No time for talk. Move!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Remind me, what was it that Reverend Hieronymus wanted from us?"
  - After: "What did Reverend Hieronymus want again?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "You seem weighed down by something."
  - After: "Something weighs on you."
- **Player**
  - Before: "If something is troubling you, tell me. Perhaps I can help?"
  - After: "Tell me what troubles you. Perhaps I can help."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How and why did your stay on Footfall come to an end? Something must have changed?"
  - After: "Why did your Footfall stay end?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I would like to know what this 'personal weakness' is. Members of my crew cannot keep secrets from me."
  - After: "What 'personal weakness'? My crew keeps no secrets."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You know Footfall better than me. Do you think the rumours of heretics are true?"
  - After: "You know Footfall. Are the heretic rumours true?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta gestures for your attention.{/n} "Rogue Trader, I would like to remind you about Reverend Hieronymus's request... He asked us to search for a potential cultist den in Footfall's Shadow Quarters."
  - After: {n}Argenta signals.{/n} "Reverend Hieronymus wants us to find a cultist den in Footfall's Shadow Quarters."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Yes. A sign, almost a portent, showed me the right path. But it's not something I can speak of like this, on the street, in this den of malice. Let us be on our way! All I'll say is that on Footfall I met Lady Theodora and joined her — and that was the end of my languishing in this place."
  - After: "A sign showed me the way. Not here, though. I met Lady Theodora on Footfall and joined her."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "There was a time when I'd have said it was likely a fabrication. One can say many things about the {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica Mission{/g} and the other shady operators on Footfall, but even those thugs are loyal to the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}, and so they mercilessly exterminate outright heretics in their territory. But now..."
  - After: "Once I'd have doubted it. Even {g|Encyclopedia:KasballicaMission}Kasballica Mission{/g} thugs serve the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}. But now..."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "He told us to look for sun symbols inscribed in blue and gold. Hieronymus's congregation suspects certain suspicious individuals of heresy, and rumour has it that this is how they mark their hideout."
  - After: "Find blue and gold sun symbols. Heretics reportedly mark their hideout so."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I wasn't born in the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g}. I was sent here to be a guardian of a reliquary on Footfall. But my ship became caught in a warp anomaly, and although it lasted only days for those on board, decades had flown by in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}."
  - After: "I came from outside the {g|Encyclopedia:KoronusExpanse}Expanse{/g} to guard a reliquary here. A warp anomaly turned days into decades in {g|Encyclopedia:Realspace}realspace{/g}."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "When at last I arrived on Footfall, it felt like I had been erased from time. No one was waiting for me on this side of the Maw — the people who were supposed to greet me, who knew about my imminent arrival, had died. The reliquary that should have been mine to safeguard had instead been taken under the protection of Reverend Hieronymus and his brethren. They were more than up to the task — they had no need of my help."
  - After: "Everyone expecting me was dead. Reverend Hieronymus's brethren guarded the reliquary without me."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Footfall became my cage. I didn't know who I was or what purpose I had here. The way back to Calixis seemed like another trap — even if I were to find a ship headed there, my sector, my {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}order{/g} — they too would have lived decades without me by that point! Whenever I'm reminded of those months spent on Footfall, it feels like I'm falling into a pit. I hope the rumours of cultists turn out to be true — I can't wait to prove with my bolter that... that... that the world and the Imperium need me!"
  - After: "Footfall became my cage. My {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}order{/g} moved on decades ago. I hope the cultists are real, so my bolter can prove the Imperium needs me!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "What? No!" {n}Argenta shakes her head and rubs her temples tiredly.{/n} "Apologies, Rogue Trader. Being here, on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}, is... difficult for me. It's a minor, personal weakness, but I'm as ready to fight as ever! It will have no effect on my combat skills."
  - After: "No!" {n}She rubs her temples.{/n} "{g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g} is hard for me. It won't affect my fighting."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Heretics have launched an open attack on a Rogue Trader's ship. A member of your dynasty, Kunrad Voigtvir, has turned out to be one of them! And Footfall itself is sinking deeper and deeper into madness. In these times of strife, I'm willing to believe in heretics who openly perform their dark rituals and brazenly mark their dens with sacrilegious symbols."
  - After: "Heretics attacked your ship; Kunrad Voigtvir was one! Footfall sinks into madness. Now I believe."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta nods with relief.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta nods, relieved.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta shoots you a wary look.{/n} "I suppose I could share it with you... But the tale will be long, and I will have to start from the beginning."
  - After: {n}She looks wary.{/n} "It's a long tale."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You're right. I will explain. It's about the... circumstances of my arrival on Footfall."
  - After: "Fine. It's about how I came here."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q1/Orphans/Orphans_SororitasQ1_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "Infernus Master, do you serve as a teacher in your spare time?"
  - After: "Infernus Master, are you their teacher?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the chaperones] "Punish the troublemaker, put the rest back in their bays. This audience is over."
  - After: [Address the chaperones] "Punish the troublemaker, send the rest back. This audience is over."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Grandly address the group] "I, the Rogue Trader and Lord Captain of this ship, speak to you now! Your parents gave their lives for a just cause and brought honour to the von Valancius banners and those of the Imperium. I am proud of them, and I believe that you will become their worthy heirs!"
  - After: [Grandly address the group] "I, your Rogue Trader, say: your parents died for a just cause, honouring von Valancius and the Imperium. Be their worthy heirs!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Smile at the group] "Your Lord Captain greets you, brave ones!"
  - After: [Smile at the group] "Greetings, brave ones!"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the chaperones] "Give them treats and escort them to their homes. I believe a minute of beholding the Lord Captain is a great enough honour for them."
  - After: [Address the chaperones] "Give them treats and take them home. A minute with the Lord Captain is honour enough."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the chaperones] "Their comportment leaves much to be desired. I hope that they will be moulded into worthy servants of House von Valancius. This audience is over."
  - After: [Address the chaperones] "Their manners are lacking. Mould them into worthy servants of House von Valancius. This audience is over."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Address the group] "If you have things to say — say them without fear. I will listen."
  - After: [Address the group] "Speak without fear. I will listen."
- **Player**
  - Before: [Ignore the interruption] "Rest assured, you won't be abandoned. You will be taken care of."
  - After: [Ignore the interruption] "You won't be abandoned. You'll be cared for."
- **Player**
  - Before: "When the heretics who killed your parents attacked the ship, I was there. I took command, I fought, and I repelled the assault as quickly as I could. But no war can be won without losses. You can only strive to do what is within your power."
  - After: "When heretics attacked, I took command and repelled them fast. But no war is won without losses."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I understand your grief and dismay. Your parents died. It's not an easy thing to go through. But they gave their lives for the truth, for the good of the whole ship, for the Imperium. Do not speak of their honourable fate with anger and disdain."
  - After: "I understand your grief. But your parents died for the ship and the Imperium. Don't speak of their honourable fate with scorn."
- **Player**
  - Before: "The strong have the power to decide the fate of others; the weak either obey or die. If you seek a different lot in life, boy — save your grumbling and look for an opportunity to rise above the rest."
  - After: "The strong decide; the weak obey or die. Want a different lot, boy? Stop grumbling and find a way to rise."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Infernus Master, since you are so concerned about the orphans, they are henceforth your clan. It falls to you to teach them the meaning of what their parents fought and died for."
  - After: "Infernus Master, since you care so much, the orphans are now your clan. Teach them what their parents died for."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A group of adolescents, clearly dressed in their finest, freshly pressed clothes, forms a straight line before you. Some stare at you with wide eyes like you're some mythical creature, while others huddle together in fear and look away.{/n}
  - After: {n}Adolescents in their best clothes line up; some awed, some afraid.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The motley group of adolescents do not take their eyes off you, gazing at you as if you were a creature straight from a fairy tale.{/n}
  - After: {n}The adolescents gaze at you, awed.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta is standing to the side of the group. At your approach, she perks up and announces, her voice ringing,{/n} "Brave ones, the master of this ship has appeared before you, the one who guides it through the darkness of the universe by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s will. Greet your Lord Captain, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g} of House von Valancius!"
  - After: {n}Argenta announces,{/n} "Greet your Lord Captain, the {g|Encyclopedia:RogueTrader}Rogue Trader{/g}, guided by the {g|Encyclopedia:Emperor}Emperor{/g}'s will!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta rubs her temple pensively. She smiles and offers a few more words of encouragement, then leaves the bay.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta encourages them, then leaves.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The servants rush to carry out your order.{/n}
  - After: {n}The servants obey.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}Abelard gives a sign — and servants immediately emerge carrying packaged treats with "von Valancius" emblazoned on the wrappers. It appears that the Seneschal came prepared for any contingency.{/n}
  - After: {n}At Abelard's sign, servants bring von Valancius treats.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The teenagers hang on your every word with bated breath. Only a few at the far end of the row seem sullen and not particularly impressed by your speech.{/n}
  - After: {n}The teens listen raptly; a few look sullen.{/n}
- **Orphan**
  - Before: {n}The boy smiles grimly.{/n} "It doesn't matter what we say — it won't bring our parents back. And it won't change our fates either. We'll keep slaving away on this ship until we drop and die like our folks. Or worse."
  - After: {n}The boy smiles grimly.{/n} "Words won't bring our parents back. We'll slave till we die too."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The teenagers keep staring at you. A girl who has remained close to Argenta smiles uncertainly. A skinny pale lad tries to throw his shoulders back and stand at attention like a soldier. Only a few teenagers at the far end of the row seem sullen and not particularly impressed.{/n}
  - After: {n}The teens stare. A girl smiles; a lad stands straight. Some sulk.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta quickly turns to the boy. A flurry of emotions flashes in her dark eyes — like she wants both to calm him and scold him for his impudence.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta turns to the boy, torn between soothing and scolding.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You can tell by their bright eyes that your words and the very fact of meeting the Rogue Trader in the flesh have left an indelible impression on them.{/n}
  - After: {n}Their eyes shine; you've impressed them.{/n}
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Young ones. You won't recognise them in a year or two — they will learn to salute and speak only when permitted by their superior officer. But right now, clowning around is all they know."
  - After: "Young ones. In a year they'll learn to salute. For now, they clown."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Our indefatigable sister has been keeping an eye on these pups." {n}Abelard glances at the gathered children.{/n} "It is hardly the {g|Encyclopedia:ScholaProgenium}Schola Progenium{/g} in here, but we have provided the orphans on our ship with adequate care and instruction."
  - After: "Our sister watches these pups." {n}Abelard glances at them.{/n} "No {g|Encyclopedia:ScholaProgenium}Schola Progenium{/g}, but they're cared for."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You heard the Rogue Trader. {mf|His|Her} words carry the wisdom of the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}."
  - After: "{mf|His|Her} words carry the {g|Encyclopedia:Imperium}Imperium{/g}'s wisdom."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}It's hard to say whether or not your words have left an impression on the boy, but he nods slowly. Then he catches himself and gives you an awkward bow.{/n}
  - After: {n}The boy nods slowly, then bows awkwardly.{/n}
- **Orphan**
  - Before: {n}One of the scowling visitors with a thin scar across his face tosses his head back and says bitterly,{/n} "So what? Why should we care? Our friends and parents died in their dozens for you noble lot, and you just... give us speeches."
  - After: {n}A scarred boy says bitterly,{/n} "Our families died for you nobles, and we get speeches."
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: "Are they taught useful trades they can later apply in the dynasty's service?" {n}After the Seneschal's affirmative nod and a grimace that probably means something like "obviously," Pasqal makes a gesture of blessing.{/n} "Housing and care conditions deemed to be rational."
  - After: "Are they taught useful trades?" {n}Abelard nods; Pasqal blesses them.{/n} "Rational."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The boy just raises his chin stubbornly, his mouth pressed into a hard line. The others quiet down in fear.{/n}
  - After: {n}The boy raises his chin. The others hush.{/n}
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: {n}You notice Infernus Master Einrich Monteg standing a few paces away from the orphans. He watches you with approval and bows respectfully when you meet his gaze.{/n}
  - After: {n}Infernus Master Einrich Monteg bows approvingly nearby.{/n}
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "Not at all, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. I'm just looking out for them. It's the infernus way to help folks in trouble — it's our job, after all. So we chip in rations here and there and make sure nobody gives them a hard time. We take the older ones into the clan's care if they want. Many in the guild are not our family by blood, but by circumstance."
  - After: "No, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Inferni help those in trouble: rations, protection, a place in the clan. Family by circumstance."
- **Einrich Monteg**
  - Before: "Thank you for your trust, Lord Captain. We won't waste it. The inferni know all about taking pride in service, courage, and self-sacrifice. We'll make true heroes out of them for you." {n}Einrich beams at the orphans, and they smile back at him with enraptured devotion.{/n}
  - After: "Thank you, Lord Captain. We'll make heroes of them." {n}Einrich beams; the orphans smile back.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q1/RebaCultistDefeated/RebaCultistDefeated_SororitasQ1_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "If you wish to be part of my crew, follow the orders given to you instead of going on adventures without leave."
  - After: "If you're crew, follow orders, no wandering off."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Argenta, wait. The heretic must be interrogated."
  - After: "Argenta, wait. Interrogate him first."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How do you know Argenta? Have you seen her on Footfall before?"
  - After: "How do you know Argenta? From Footfall?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Who or what is this 'true god' you keep mentioning?"
  - After: "Who is this 'true god'?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have no intention of tolerating your wilfulness. You are no longer welcome aboard my ship."
  - After: "I won't tolerate your wilfulness. You're no longer welcome aboard."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta rushes to the last living cultist and silently, furiously punches him in the face.{/n} "Blaspheming heretic! Who were you praying to? I know those words, that call to a 'Lor—'"
  - After: {n}Argenta punches the cultist.{/n} "Heretic! I know that call to 'Lor—'"
- **Cultist Leader**
  - Before: {n}Argenta doesn't get to finish — the cultist, having dropped to his knees, interrupts her with grating, rasping laughter.{/n} "Of course you know them. I recognise you too, lackey to the corpse on the throne. Haven't you already experienced the power of the true god? Didn't you flee from us, shedding tears?"
  - After: {n}He laughs.{/n} "I know you, corpse-lackey. Didn't you flee us in tears?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta recoils as if from a blow, but then steps forward, grabs the cultist by the scruff of his neck, and makes him look into her eyes, burning like embers.{/n} "I am one of the {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}. And I have never, not once in my life, fled from heretics and betrayers of Humankind."
  - After: {n}Argenta glares.{/n} "I am {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Adepta Sororitas{/g}. I never flee heretics."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Just how many of you vermin are there! First Rykad Minoris, now here."
  - After: "Vermin! First Rykad Minoris, now here."
- **Cultist Leader**
  - Before: "What do you want to know, servants of the corpse emperor? The names of my brethren? How many of us there are? Where we are? I will tell you myself — we are myriad, and we are everywhere. Soon, very soon, you will hear our voices. And when you hear them at your back, so close you can feel our breath — then you will know the power of the true god!"
  - After: "We are myriad, everywhere. Soon you'll feel our breath and know the true god!"
- **Cultist Leader**
  - Before: "You can kill me, servants of the corpse emperor. But you can't stop the victory of the true god! The Edge of Daybreak is nigh... and the hour of his triumph approaches!"
  - After: "Kill me; the true god still wins! The Edge of Daybreak is nigh!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Silence hangs for a minute. Then Argenta turns to you and shrugs nonchalantly.{/n} "That's it. We've fulfilled Reverend Hieronymus's request, which means I am now free. I can continue my travels with you, Rogue Trader."
  - After: {n}Argenta shrugs.{/n} "Hieronymus's task is done. I'll join you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Not on {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}." {n}The cultist laughs hoarsely.{/n} "In another place — she flew right in, like a bird into a snare!"
  - After: "Not {g|Encyclopedia:Footfall}Footfall{/g}." {n}He laughs.{/n} "Elsewhere — into our snare!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta is staring at the cultist, her eyes wide. As if against her will, she whispers two words,{/n} "Salis Prime."
  - After: {n}Argenta whispers,{/n} "Salis Prime."
- **Cultist Leader**
  - Before: "You will know... in time." {n}The cultist gives you a wicked smile painted with the fresh blood on his lips.{/n}
  - After: "In time." {n}He smiles, bloody.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}She snaps out of it, as if emerging from a reverie.{/n} "A planet... a place... It doesn't matter! I know these heretics — I fought them and was gravely wounded. But I swear — I never turned from them and ran!"
  - After: {n}She snaps out of it.{/n} "A planet. I fought them, wounded. I never ran!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}She turns to the cultist, her eyes filled with cold fury.{/n} "If you truly have seen me on Salis Prime, someone among you must know a way to get there. Do you have your own ship? A Navigator? Answer me!"
  - After: {n}Coldly:{/n} "You saw me on Salis Prime? Then how do you get there? A Navigator? Answer!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Ships and maps, roads and doors — we have them all, but our paths are not for you! The true god spins his web, and you are but a fly caught in it. But where is the spider?" {n}The cultist's eyes fill with madness.{/n}
  - After: "Not for you! You're a fly in the true god's web." {n}He looks mad.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Before we leave this den — let us round up what remains of the blasphemers. I would like to cleanse this place with purifying flame, but perhaps we can find clues that might tell us where these heretics came from, or if they have any more associates."
  - After: "Round up the rest. I'd burn this place, but clues may lead to their allies."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader... we won't get anything from this madman! As for my part in the story, I will tell it — but not here, not in his presence."
  - After: "This madman is useless. I'll explain later, not here."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta lowers her head wearily.{/n} "We need to talk... but it can wait. Let's meet on the ship when it's time to depart Footfall."
  - After: {n}Argenta sighs.{/n} "We'll talk aboard, leaving Footfall."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Pressing her lips into a thin line, Argenta nods coldly.{/n} "As you wish, Rogue Trader. Farewell!"
  - After: {n}Argenta nods coldly.{/n} "As you wish. Farewell!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Rogue Trader, I respect you and the burden of your mission to serve the Imperium. But I am one of the Adepta Sororitas, and my primary duty is to the Emperor and the Ecclesiarchy. To ignore a priest's request and refuse to search for cultists would be a dereliction of that duty and a transgression! That is the one and only reason why I left your side and came here myself."
  - After: "As Adepta Sororitas, I serve the Emperor and Ecclesiarchy first. Refusing a priest's call to hunt cultists is sin. That's why I left."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Can't you see he's trying to get under your skin?" {n}Idira mutters.{/n} "I bet he wants a quick bullet to the head instead of a bonfire." {n}Despite her tone, she is looking around anxiously and rubbing her temples.{/n} "Smells of a dark future... like a noose around the neck..."{g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}{/g}
  - After: {n}Idira mutters,{/n} "He wants a bullet, not a bonfire." {n}She frets.{/n} "A noose..."{g|Encyclopedia:Psyker}{/g}
- **Pasqal**
  - Before: {n}Pasqal pulls a number of instruments out of his robe. You would bet your life that the purpose of these items isn't to disassemble machines. He says casually,{/n} "Should you encounter difficulties during the information extraction process, I would recommend precise targeting of ganglia."{g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}{/g}
  - After: {n}Pasqal produces instruments.{/n} "I recommend targeting ganglia."{g|Encyclopedia:TechPriest}{/g}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The cultist chuckles arrogantly but pales under Pasqal's calmly probing gaze.{/n}
  - After: {n}The cultist chuckles but pales.{/n}
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "The Undying Emperor is the one true god. You will soon learn this — when you face His harsh judgement. As will all your accomplices." {n}Kibellah's voice is filled with cold implacability.{/n}
  - After: "The Undying Emperor is the true god. You'll learn at His judgement." {n}Kibellah, coldly.{/n}

  - Before: {n}Argenta looks at you, somewhat surprised.{/n} "I thought that I had been called, that finding the ship was my destiny... My place in the world? Perhaps... perhaps there is something to that."

- **(conversation owner)**

  - Before: "Yes, Rogue Trader." {n}Argenta looks you in the eye.{/n} "I saw with my own eyes how a member of your family showed his true colours as a servant of the {g|Encyclopedia:Chaos}Archenemy{/g}.   - Before: "A {mf|man|woman} who stood shoulder to shoulder with me and helped eradicate the cultists on Footfall." {n}Argenta smiles, as if reminiscing about a pleasant evening spent in the company of friends rather than a bloody battle.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes! I rushed to Theodora the moment I could walk again, and I insisted on going back to Salis Prime to defend the relic from the heretics.   - After: "Yes! I begged Theodora to return, but the warp had destroyed the route. As if anything mattered more than faith!"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes. Now the planet is yours by right. But it's not as simple as that — the warp route leading to it was lost. I will explain in due time. May I continue?"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "But even those blasphemers could not touch Argenta's ashes or her holy relic, the One Star. For the fallen ship, which now served as the resting place for the saint's remains, would only allow the truly righteous to enter — all others would meet their death."
  - After: "But they couldn't touch her ashes or her relic, the One Star. The ship admits only the righteous; others die."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "What I didn't expect was an ambush waiting for us on the planet! I landed there with a small unit provided by Theodora. I know Saint Argenta's hagiography by heart, I know all the legends about her. I followed their obscure clues — the descriptions of mountains and rivers from millennia-old tales. And I was certain that I had found the way to the ship! And that's when we were attacked."
  - After: "Then an ambush! With Theodora's small unit, I followed the legends' clues and was sure I'd found the ship. Then they attacked."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm glad that you understand me. I had been called! And thus it was my business and mine alone."
  - After: "I'm glad you understand. It was my calling alone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The words we heard in the heretics' shrine on Footfall.   - After: "The Footfall shrine words, 'lord,' 'Edge of Daybreak.'" {n}She shudders.{/n} "The Salis Prime cultists said them too. My unit died. Only a miracle saved me!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I didn't connect these events at first. The cultists on Footfall. The cultists on Salis Prime. The cultists attacking the ship and Kunrad's betrayal.   - After: "Footfall, Salis Prime, the ship attack, Kunrad: one chain? Did I lead heretics to the sacred planet?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You refused to turn a blind eye to insolence, even when it came from a thoughtless boy. That is a sign of a firm leader, Rogue Trader, one who doesn't tolerate weakness. The Imperium needs people like you."
  - After: "You didn't tolerate insolence, even from a boy. The Imperium needs firm leaders."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Holy relics cannot be truly lost," {n}Argenta says stubbornly.{/n} "When the time is right, they reveal themselves to the worthy. But I will accept this reproach and try my best to think on it."
  - After: "Relics reveal themselves to the worthy," {n}she insists.{/n} "But I'll reflect."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I thought at first that it was too harsh a ruling to make him and the other orphans join the Infernus Guild. For such is the only way to forge His truest servants!"
  - After: "Sending the orphans to the inferni seemed harsh, but hardship forges His truest servants!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Although my opinion of you started to change even before then — back when you agreed to talk to the orphans at my request.   - After: "My view of you changed when you met the orphans. A leader who honours the fallen inspires trust."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You didn't turn a blind eye to his misdeed, but you chose the right words to show him the path to redemption.   - After: "You showed him a path to redemption. Harsh, but needed. I hope I judged you rightly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You found the words that could comfort him. You didn't punish him, didn't scare him with a show of austerity. You even admitted that you are not all-powerful! It surprised me. I even saw it as weakness at first. But after giving it some thought, I saw the wisdom in it. The way you openly addressed the thoughtless boy does you credit, Rogue Trader."
  - After: "You comforted him and admitted you're not all-powerful. I thought it weakness, then saw wisdom."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Do you remember? There was a young man whose grief and confusion had driven him to insolence."
  - After: "Remember the grieving, insolent young man?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I... couldn't just come out and tell him. It was a portent revealed to me personally, can't you see?   - After: "The portent was mine alone. I told Hieronymus truly: a pilgrimage. Touching her remains and relic would prove the saint's favour."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lady Theodora... lent her assistance. It was her intention to visit the newly discovered world, and she took me with her."
  - After: "Lady Theodora took me along to the new world."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Argenta bites her lip.{/n} "You suspect me of unworthy urges. But I will accept this reproach and try my best to think on it. The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Sisters{/g} know the meaning of humility..."
  - After: {n}She bites her lip.{/n} "I'll reflect on it. The {g|Encyclopedia:AdeptaSororitas}Sisters{/g} know humility."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Apologies, I got so carried away I forgot to explain! The One Star is the relic kept by Saint Argenta.   - After: "Sorry! The One Star is Saint Argenta's relic, sacred to my Order Pronatus. Legends call it a banner, armour, or chainsword. A beacon of righteousness, lost with her."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q2/AfterlightFirst/AfterlightFirst_SororitasQ2_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "The strongest of the disciples who survived, you mean. After all, we exterminated the rest of you on every world we found you on."

  - After: "You forget the blood spilt because of you, and too often call yourself the Emperor's chosen."

  - After: "No time for regrets. Focus on what we can fix now."
- **Player**

  - After: {n}Argenta blazes.{/n} "Who are you, sorcerer?"

  - Before: "No, you don't. But you should. I am called Brother Afterlight. Divine blessing flows through my veins, and my ears hear whispers of the truth that you will never comprehend, puppet. All you need to know is that of all the disciples of the Final Dawn in this corner of the Koronus Expanse, I am the strongest."
  - After: "Brother Afterlight, strongest of the Final Dawn in this corner of the Koronus Expanse."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Well, that's enough of that. The little puppet brought some friends with her. Good. I have just finished with the remains of the last group of fools who risked coming to this planet with you. You remember their death cries, don't you? Or do the lives of mere pawns mean nothing to you?"
  - After: "The puppet brought friends. I just killed your last followers here. Remember their cries?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "But enough of this. My path has only just begun, and I crave to see the agony of heretics. Come!"
  - After: "Enough. I crave heretics' agony. Come!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The ghostly figure lets out a laugh.{/n} "I hear such hubris in your words. What I should hear instead is despair. Or haven't you realised it yet, stranger? You are fighting a war against an ocean without end. No matter how many of my brothers and sisters you cut down, those who join our ranks will always be greater in number."
  - After: {n}The ghost laughs.{/n} "Hubris. You fight an endless ocean."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I see you are acquainted with my brethren in faith. If so, then you must also know that we are without number. Destroy our cell on one world, and we will rear our heads on a dozen others."
  - After: "Then you know we're countless. Crush one cell; a dozen rise."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Hiding? Me? Oh, were you expecting me to hurry forward to greet you? Organise a welcoming committee, perhaps?"
  - After: "Hiding? Expecting a welcome?"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}In her unfettered rage, Argenta continues to rain destruction upon the sorcerous device. Shards fly in every direction, some leaving deep cuts on her face.{/n}
  - After: {n}Argenta smashes the device; shards cut her.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "But... But I thought..." {n}Argenta waves a hand in frustration, as if cutting through the air.{/n} "Your rebukes weigh heavily, Rogue Trader. But we should return to our mission. Our enemy awaits, and so does a relic in need of protection. Come!"
  - After: "But I..." {n}She waves it off.{/n} "Noted. The relic awaits. Come!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta lowers her weapon and drops her head.{/n} "Such painful mistakes... I brought heretics to a sacred ship, I lost the battle for a holy relic, and I let those who followed me die a terrible death. All because I decided that I could achieve everything on my own, that it was my purpose and mine alone!"
  - After: {n}Argenta hangs her head.{/n} "I led heretics to the ship, lost the relic, got my followers killed. Pride!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta lowers her weapon. A breath escapes her lips.{/n} "That heretic was deliberately trying to awaken my anger. He is {d|Encyclopedia:CompArgenta_SupportedFire}wrong{/d} to think that he can manipulate the chosen one of Holy Terra."
  - After: {n}Argenta exhales.{/n} "He's {d|Encyclopedia:CompArgenta_SupportedFire}wrong{/d} to think he can provoke Holy Terra's chosen."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Why fear something as righteous as my anger? And why are you so suddenly trying to hold me back, Rogue Trader? Did you not {d|Encyclopedia:CompArgenta_SupportedFury}support{/d} me in my right to wield my fury before?"
  - After: "Why fear righteous anger? You {d|Encyclopedia:CompArgenta_SupportedFury}supported{/d} my fury before!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You agreed that Theodora's death and the deaths of her protectors were justified."
  - After: "You called Theodora's death justified."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You even let me exterminate your pet witch."
  - After: "You let me kill your witch."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Indeed. That is what I did. And that is what I will continue to do. I won't let the shadows of doubts cloud my mind again."
  - After: "Indeed. No more doubts."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You have told me more than once to pay more attention to the errors I make," {n}Argenta says with bitterness.{/n} "But now is not the time for this conversation. We must stop that monster and protect the relic. Come!"
  - After: "You've chided my errors," {n}bitterly.{/n} "Later. Stop the monster, save the relic. Come!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The Emperor accepted the souls of His faithful!"
  - After: "The Emperor took His faithful!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "They died cursing your name. The name of the puppet who had brought them to the slaughter and then alone escaped with her life."
  - After: "They died cursing you, the puppet who alone escaped."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Enough! Be silent!"
  - After: "Silence!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Never. Evil cannot push back a righteous flame. Then let us go and put an end to this evil!"
  - After: "Never. Let's end this evil!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Perhaps... perhaps you are right, Rogue Trader. Righteous fury must know no bounds!"
  - After: "Perhaps. Righteous fury knows no bounds!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You're right. You're {d|Encyclopedia:CompArgenta_SupportedMeek}a thousand times{/d} right, Rogue Trader! I feel remorse, and I will atone for my mistakes. Come!"
  - After: "You're {d|Encyclopedia:CompArgenta_SupportedMeek}a thousand times{/d} right! I'll atone. Come!"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q2/AfterlightSecond

  - Before: "What? How can you even—"
  - After: "What? How—"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Afterlight smiles faintly and coldly.{/n} "I accept."
  - After: {n}Afterlight smiles.{/n} "Accepted."
- **(conversation owner)**

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q2/AfterlightSecond/AfterlightSecond_SororitasQ2_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "No more words. Accept your death, heretic!"
  - After: "No more words. Die, heretic!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "If you hadn't threatened me, things could have gone differently. But you did. And for that, you will die."
  - After: "Had you not threatened me, things might differ. Now you die."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And so we meet face to face." {n}Afterlight does not look alarmed or tense, merely somewhat puzzled.{/n} "Welcome to my temple."
  - After: "At last." {n}Afterlight looks puzzled.{/n} "Welcome to my temple."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You have no idea how mistaken you are." {n}Afterlight nods at the unmoving ship and the sinister-looking devices nearby.{/n} "For a long time now, I have been preparing to bend this 'relic' of your cult of puppets to my master's will. You Imperium lackeys are blind, stubborn, and carry the stench of dead flesh wherever you go. But you make for good sacrifices, and the baubles you worship make for superb materials for artefacts."
  - After: "Wrong." {n}He nods at the ship.{/n} "Your 'relic' will serve my master. You make fine sacrifices."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Feel the wrath of true divinity, puppets of the corpse!"
  - After: "Feel true divinity, puppets!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Your every word defiles the air of this place, heretic. The threshold of the sacred ship is not your temple, and it never will be!"
  - After: "Heretic! This sacred ship is no temple of yours!"

Bone flutes that summon my master's angels from the Immaterium. Lenses that burn away the imperfections of people and worlds. Such things require resources. I found good use for the rabble that came with you to the planet back then. I'll find a use for your new friends too. And you. And this ship. And whatever 'relic' it holds."
  - After: "I am the Final Dawn's arch-artificer. My creations summon the Immaterium's angels. I'll use you, this ship and its 'relic'."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q2/FinalTrial/TheFinalTrial_SororitasQ2_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "You may go. But do not keep me waiting."
  - After: "Go. Don't keep me waiting."
- **Player**
  - Before: "You speak as though you intend to go in alone."
  - After: "You mean to go alone?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "What if I too wish to enter the ship?"
  - After: "What if I enter too?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "Go, Argenta. May you find what you seek."
  - After: "Go, Argenta. Find what you seek."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I do. This... This is my personal trial, Rogue Trader. Besides, so it is written in the life of Saint Argenta that pilgrims may enter the ship one by one, for their deeds must first be measured. Every pilgrim will thence be permitted to behold the relic or denied that right according to their past actions and the strength of their faith."
  - After: "I do. Per Saint Argenta's life, pilgrims enter alone, judged by deeds and faith."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta gestures for you to stop. She looks at the shining entrance to the ship and begins to speak, quietly and solemnly.{/n} "When I first learned of this planet's existence, of the great relic that lies before us, I decided that I was chosen for a great destiny. That the saint whose name I bear had summoned me, led me through the void and the nightmares of the Maw, all so that I could enter the sacred halls of this ship and accept her boon."
  - After: {n}Argenta stops you.{/n} "I thought my namesake saint summoned me here for her boon."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "Perhaps there was too much hubris in those thoughts. I made many a mistake on my way here. My pilgrimage to the sacred ship will become my trial. Yet I do not fear trials, for I draw strength from them. I do not turn my back on my mistakes, for I find wisdom within them. I walk forth with an open heart."
  - After: "Hubris, perhaps. I erred. I face this trial with an open heart."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "And now, more than ever, I believe that I was right. My journey here was paid for in the blood of fallen innocents, but their sacrifice will not be for naught! I will enter the halls of the hallowed ship. I will lay my hand upon the relic and find new strength to turn my wrath against the wicked."
  - After: "I was right. Innocents bled for this. The relic will strengthen my wrath."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "But never mind that!" {n}Bitterness creeps into Argenta's voice.{/n} "I thought myself special, chosen, worthier than all my sisters even back when I was a novice. Pride. I was blinded by pride. In reality, every step of my way here was fraught with errors."
  - After: "But no." {n}Bitterly.{/n} "Pride blinded me. Every step here was an error."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "I trusted Theodora and Kunrad, I failed to see the darkness in their hearts, and in doing so, I revealed the relic's secret to the heretics of the Final Dawn. In my search for the sacred ship, I rushed into a reckless expedition that got my companions killed and nearly killed me. Then, driven by blind fury, I killed Theodora and her innocent protectors. I orphaned faithful children of the Imperium. I lied and kept the truth hidden."
  - After: "I trusted Theodora and Kunrad and exposed the relic to the Final Dawn. My recklessness killed my companions. In fury I killed Theodora and her innocent guards, orphaned children, and hid the truth."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta nods. Her eyes are locked on the entrance.{/n} "Only the worthy, those whom the saint accepts, may enter these gates. The undeserving will be rejected. I... I am ready to accept her verdict."
  - After: {n}Argenta nods.{/n} "Only those the saint accepts may enter. I'm ready."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You may, but... you must wait for my return. Please understand that this ship is more than just a curious ancient site waiting to be explored! The ship itself is a relic imbued with great power. You saw it yourself — even a sinister sorcerer, the Archenemy's servant, in all that time, could not find a way inside. Only pilgrims may enter, and only those whose soul is without flaw."
  - After: "Yes, but after I return. The ship is itself a relic. Even that sorcerer never got in. Only the flawless may enter."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar's voice is serious and calm, lacking its usual bravado.{/n} "I am an upstanding warrior of the Allfather, but my heart can hardly be called untainted. However, it is a Wolf's duty to guard the Allfather's pack without fear. I am ready to climb aboard this holy vessel with you and guard against any threat that may lurk within. I care not about the consequences."
  - After: {n}Ulfar, solemn:{/n} "My heart isn't pure, but a Wolf guards the pack. I'll go with you."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta smiles softly.{/n} "Thank you, brave Ulfar. One could not ask for a more dependable and vigilant protector. But I won't need to lean on your mighty shoulder today."
  - After: {n}Argenta smiles.{/n} "Thank you, Ulfar. Not today."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: "It is a sacred path that one must walk alone." {n}Kibellah nods.{/n} "The Undying One will measure your soul. His judgement will be stern, and His verdict unyielding."
  - After: "This path is walked alone." {n}Kibellah nods.{/n} "The Undying One judges sternly."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta looks at her with clear and calm eyes.{/n} "I know."
  - After: {n}Calmly:{/n} "I know."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta frowns as she listens to Idira's words, clearly tempted to object indignantly. But she holds it back.{/n} "I... Thank you for the warning. I see that you mean me well."
  - After: {n}Argenta bites back an objection.{/n} "Thank you. You mean well."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Damn right I do! We've been through so much together... that Drukhari place, for one thing." {n}Idira falls silent for a moment.{/n} "You won't turn back no matter what, will you?"
  - After: "Damn right! After that Drukhari place..." {n}A pause.{/n} "You won't turn back, will you?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Wait!" {n}Idira looks like she has surprised herself with her outburst.{/n} "Argenta... wait. Please. I feel uneasy. This ship... there really is something inside it. Something big, something that changes people's fates. If you go in, you won't come back out. Or at least the you who comes out won't be the same you."
  - After: "Wait!" {n}Idira startles herself.{/n} "That ship changes fates. You won't come out the same."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "This cannot go on. I must cleanse myself. I will enter the sacred ship to beg forgiveness. And I will emerge renewed. I know it. I believe."
  - After: "I must be cleansed. I'll beg forgiveness and emerge renewed."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Without another word, she starts walking toward the ship, toward the blinding light pouring through the gate.{/n}
  - After: {n}Silently, she walks into the gate's light.{/n}
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "You're right. I will not. This is my trial and my pilgrimage..." {n}Argenta pauses too.{/n} "Take care, Idira Tlass. Wicked sorcery is smothering you, but... in every darkness, the light of hope lives."
  - After: "No. This is my trial." {n}A pause.{/n} "Take care, Idira Tlass. In every darkness, hope lives."
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Yeah... You take care of yourself in there too. Walk toward the light. Always toward the light."
  - After: "You too. Always walk toward the light."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Lord Captain! Please return to the ship! I urge you to hurry! The storm is coming, the one I warned you about. You can't survive it on the planet's surface!"
  - After: "Lord Captain! Return to the ship! The storm I warned of is coming!"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Sororitas/Sororitas_Q2/MyTrial/Argenta_MyTrial_dialog

- **Player**
  - Before: "What should we look for once we get to the mountain?"

  - Before: "What if the cultists are long gone? What if they stole the relic?"
  - After: "What if the cultists took the relic?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "A ship that resembles a mountain?"
  - After: "A ship like a mountain?"

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The augurs are operating at full capacity, but the data we are receiving is limited. The planet's magnetosphere is hindering our scans. Fierce, never-ending storms constantly ravage the surface. Relying on Sister Argenta's memory is the only way to find what we're looking for."

  - Before: "I... have no objections." {n}Argenta says calmly.{/n} "Perhaps it will benefit you to stand in the presence of the great relic, Idira."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Pardon the interruption." {n}Despite her energetic tone, Idira appears perturbed.{/n} "I'd like to go down to the surface with you. I hear... a very strange whisper coming from down there."

  - Before: "Yes," {n}Argenta says with reverence.{/n} "Legends say the ship fell from the skies, yet it wasn't destroyed by the impact.   - Before: "Then I will chase after them to the ends of the universe, through darkness, fire, and all the horrors of the warp!" {n}Her voice is vibrating with anger. But a moment passes, and she calms herself surprisingly quickly.{/n} "But I do not believe that those rotten-souled scoundrels could have stolen the relic. It says plainly in the saint's hagiography that only one who is righteous and resplendent of heart can enter her ship. I know her power is greater than the most profane sorcery of cultists. What could they possibly do to match the workings of one who was a Living Saint of the Imperium?"
  - After: "Then I'll hunt them through the warp!" {n}She calms.{/n} "But only the righteous may enter her ship. No cultist sorcery matches a Living Saint."

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**

- **Halbrandt**
  - Before: "When the Baleful Howl was setting off, we exchanged gifts — our pack runes. Every tenth watch, a priest cast the runes and saw what fate they revealed. Fifty watches after the Baleful Howl left, the runes showed Calamity. Sixty watches after they left — Death. Since then, the runes have been voiceless and their patterns hold no meaning."
  - After: "We swapped pack runes. At fifty watches: Calamity. At sixty: Death. Then silence."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "And that's it? The spirits deceive you — your priest went a little soft in the head and forgot how to read his runes, and for that you give my pack up for dead? Cowards!"
  - After: "That's it? Your priest misread them, and you call my pack dead? Cowards!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "He is our brother. He should not be left to wander the galaxy in the company of ordinary mortals, or alone. Wolves are like sharp knives, we hone ourselves against each other, and without brothers, Ulfar will rust and grow dull. Be with us, Ulfar, we will take you in."
  - After: "He's our brother. Wolves hone each other; alone, he'll rust. Join us, Ulfar."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Go to Hel, Thorbald, they'll take you in there."
  - After: "Go to Hel, Thorbald."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And even if you remain deaf to my words, I still will not tell you where your brothers went! Respect your alpha, Ulfar!"
  - After: "Even so, I won't tell you where they went! Obey your alpha!"
- **Halbrandt**
  - Before: "So you hold this mortal above your brothers? Being without a pack has turned you feral and stupid, Everlost!"
  - After: "This mortal above your brothers? You've gone feral, Everlost!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}A harsh shout drowns out the two Wolves, who are ready to lunge at one another.{/n} "Quiet! Both of you! Have you forgotten where you are? Holmgang can only take place on solid ground, not on a boat! The void and the warp are treacherous, and unfit to host a duel of the worthy!"
  - After: {n}A shout stops them mid-lunge.{/n} "Quiet! Holmgang is fought on solid ground, never aboard ship!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Giving you a disgruntled look, Thorbald sternly cuts you off:{/n} "When it concerns Wolf matters, Halbrandt will speak if he wishes. Do not forget that we are the chosen warriors of the Allfather, Rogue Trader. Treat us like servants at your peril..."
  - After: {n}Thorbald cuts you off:{/n} "In Wolf matters, Halbrandt speaks freely. We're no servants."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "We'll see about that! I will prove that the Stormbiters will never be a match for the Baleful Howl! Aett-Vater, I must be at your side when you depart for the assault! Promise that you will grant me this honour!"
  - After: "We'll see! Aett-Vater, promise I'll be at your side for the assault!"
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar's eyes flash with fury.{/n} "Stop there, Thorbald. This mortal rescued me from captivity and proved {mf|his|her} valour. I will not stand here and allow {mf|him|her} to be disrespected."
  - After: {n}Ulfar flares.{/n} "Enough. This mortal freed me and proved {mf|his|her} valour. Don't disrespect {mf|him|her}."
- **Halbrandt**
  - Before: "And forget not to tell
of the dire curse
that of yore was laid
upon the mighty Ulfar;
No good death for him is fated,
Only to one day be lost,
Bereft of glory and honour."
{n}Halbrandt declaims the lines so sonorously and powerfully that the bulkheads begin to vibrate.{/n}
  - After: "And tell of Ulfar's curse:
no good death,
only to be lost, without glory."
{n}The bulkheads shake.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Any who cross his path
let him regale, and gladly,
That proud warrior,
Halbrandt Blatherskite;
Singer of rumours
and fine tattler of tall tales,
For he has glimpsed
no worthy deeds
in his short life."
  - After: "Halbrandt Blatherskite,
teller of tall tales,
who's seen no worthy deeds."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If you prove that your words carry more weight than a battle axe, I will tell you where your brothers went. If you fail, you will submit." {n}Thorbald's lips curve into a superior smirk.{/n}
  - After: "Prove yourself and I'll tell you where they went. Fail, and submit." {n}Thorbald smirks.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Wolf leader's tone may be threatening, but you notice a sly glint in his eye. Ulfar, on the other hand, is growling furiously, with no matching twinkle in his gaze.{/n}
  - After: {n}Thorbald's eye glints slyly. Ulfar just growls.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Thorbald chuckles.{/n} "Thank you for the correction, Everlost. I reckon we can do without the saga."
  - After: {n}Thorbald chuckles.{/n} "We'll skip the saga."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar gives the peaceably smiling Thorbald a penetrating look, his face darkening and his voice dropping low to a bestial snarl:{/n} "Have you lost your mind, Thorbald?"
  - After: {n}Ulfar snarls:{/n} "Have you lost your mind?"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "They dissemble so sweetly — they would tear each other apart at the first opportunity."
  - After: "Sweet pretence. They'd tear each other apart."
- **Halbrandt**
  - Before: "Shut up, wretched captive." {n}Halbrandt does not even dignify Marazhai with a contemptuous glance.{/n}
  - After: "Shut up, captive." {n}Halbrandt ignores Marazhai.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "He... ah... he is not a captive. He is the Rogue Trader's huskaerl." {n}Ulfar averts his gaze.{/n}
  - After: "He's... the Rogue Trader's huskaerl." {n}Ulfar looks away.{/n}
- **Halbrandt**
  - Before: "Huskaerl? A fine squad you have found for yourself, Everlost."
  - After: "Huskaerl? Fine company, Everlost."
- **Halbrandt**
  - Before: "Perhaps it is you who's lost his mind, if you are daring to speak so insolently to Ironhide?" {n}Halbrandt's insinuating tone is dripping with such menace that even the drawing of a sword could not have made his threat any clearer.{/n}
  - After: "Or you've lost yours, talking so to Ironhide?" {n}Pure menace.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The runes do not lie, Ulfar, you know this. I am sorry about your brothers, but their fate is clear."
  - After: "The runes don't lie, Ulfar. I'm sorry."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/CompanionQuests/Ulfar/Ulfar_Q2/UlfarWounded

  - After: "Without it I feel flayed. I can't remember living without a skin. Too many years."

and shattered dreams,

on its broad shoulders,

and takes a seat

unbidden, it takes a seat
by your hearth."

  - After: {n}Ulfar sighs.{/n} "You rule; I hunt. My death would be joyous. Yours, a loss to many."

- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "I understand, Aett-Vater. But my pack's saga must end."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Heinrix/NM_01_AfterJanus/AfterJanus

  - After: "I... I'm glad too!" {n}He steps closer.{/n}

Just wait, tomorrow you'll find a new way to send me out of my mind with worry... but I'm ready for it. I swear on the Throne, for you, I'm ready for anything."

  - Before: "I know. You don't need to remind me." {n}Heinrix presses his lips to your brow for a moment.{/n} "It doesn't matter. I'll endure anything for you."

Alone."

  - After: {n}He steps over the body and goes in.{/n}
