- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The atmosphere in the lair is one of false excitement. The faces are sour, the smiles forced, and even the bottles of booze dotted about seem to gleam with insincerity. One of those in attendance, a man whose face is crosshatched with scars, glares at Jae with undisguised scepticism.{/n}
  - After: {n}Forced smiles. A scarred man glares at Jae.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Shereen! The spectators in the arena won't ever forget our bloody spectacle — we couldn't have been more memorable if we'd tattooed our names right on their eyeballs! The Dark City trembles before us, and we simply must honour the heroes of the hour!" {n}Jae's ebullient words ring out in the joyless, dank silence.{/n}
  - After: "Shereen! The arena won't forget us! Let's honour the heroes!" {n}Silence.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Our deeds are like a proud stallion, shereen! Look at it from one end and you see the proud bearing, the powerful muscles, and fire in its eyes! Look at it from the other end and all you see is a horse's arse. I prefer to view this victory as a triumph of the Exalted One's warriors over those revered by the inhumans as the finest masters of their bloody dance!"
  - After: "Deeds are a stallion, shereen: fire up front, a horse's arse behind. I choose to see us beating the xenos' finest!"
- **Marked Man**
  - Before: "But the arse end of this horse doesn't disappear when you stop looking at it. And we'll all be staring at it soon enough when the Wyches come seeking revenge. I doubt they'll be able to figure out who butchered their favourites in the arena, and whose luck simply ran out."
  - After: "The arse stays. The Wyches will want revenge."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If not now, when, shereen?" {n}Her eyes blazing, Jae drops her voice to a whisper:{/n} "Don't you see that everyone in this place is simply waiting to die? I refuse to spend what could be the last moments of my life under this cloud of doom!"
  - After: "If not now, when?" {n}She whispers:{/n} "Everyone's waiting to die. I won't!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Brothers and sisters in arms, let's raise our glasses, and may what splashes in them wash the sorrow from our souls as clear waters wash the dirt and sand from the body of a weary traveller to whom the Exalted One has sent an oasis glittering with crystal streams!"
  - After: "Raise your glasses, and may they wash the sorrow from our souls!"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "This is exactly the time! Let's raise a toast, and you'll see how sparks of wine can kindle into a blaze of merriment!" {n}Jae retorts, somehow managing to sound cordial and waspish at the same time.{/n}
  - After: "It's exactly the time! Toast!" {n}Cordial yet waspish.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Everyone raises their cups in a determined show of enthusiasm. You hear a few snippets of laughter that seem to be on the verge of turning into sobs. Jae herself flashes a dazzling smile as genuine as the gems of an underhive merchant. Her eyes resemble two dark pools that have frozen solid.{/n}
  - After: {n}Cups rise; laughter nears sobs. Jae's smile is fake.{/n}
- **Marked Man**
  - Before: {n}The bitter chuckle that bursts from the lips of the marked prisoner turns your words into a deathbed platitude.{/n}
  - After: {n}The marked man's bitter chuckle mocks your words.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}While everyone stares at you wide-eyed, Jae mutters,{/n} "Thank you ever so much. You've really brought the party spirit."
  - After: {n}All stare.{/n} "Thanks. Real party spirit."
- **Marked Man**
  - Before: "Malice used to say the same thing. Live it up, you'll be dead soon." {n}The muttering of the grim captive dispels the ghost of false merriment haunting the lair, like a rite of exorcism.{/n}
  - After: "Malice said that too. Live it up, you'll die soon." {n}Merriment dies.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Friends, comrades in arms, and those whom the azhi's harsh captivity has thrown together with us! A great wise man once said that human life is like a cruel desert, with one lifeless dune appearing after another — that is the joke the universe plays on us. But the Exalted One does not abide those who mock his children, and that is why he gifted us the water of cold springs, green grass, and the shade of sprawling-limbed trees. He who has faith in Him will reach that blessed oasis, defying the world's cruelty, and today we—"
  - After: "Friends, fellow captives of the azhi! Life is a cruel desert, but the Exalted One grants oases to the faithful. Today we—"
- **Marked Man**
  - Before: {n}The marked prisoner scoffs.{/n} "Listening to you leaves my ears in knots. Some kind of a lady, are you? Only the great and the good refuse to recognise death when it looks them in the eye — they believe in their own luck to the very end."
  - After: {n}He scoffs.{/n} "Some lady, eh? Only the highborn trust their luck till death."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'll have you know, ill fate's marked man, that I am a princess of the distant world of Ef—" {n}Jae breaks off, then with a crooked smile, says,{/n} "I'm no damn kind of lady. I'm a lowborn rat, same as you."
  - After: "I'm a princess of Ef—" {n}A crooked smile.{/n} "No. I'm a lowborn rat, like you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Leave it, {name}. These people do not want to feel joy."
  - After: "Leave it, {name}. They don't want joy."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You know what? Screw the lot of you. I've seen better morale at the bottom of a half-flooded trench! If you want to harp on about how you'll all be killed soon, fill your boots. Me, I'd rather go and kill someone else."
  - After: "Screw you all. I'd rather kill someone."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Yes, shereen, that is a dazzling idea..." {n}Jae gives you a seductive look, then suddenly frowns.{/n} "Damn it! People jumping to bed together when they fear for their lives — no, it's too pathetic and desperate."
  - After: "Dazzling, shereen..." {n}She frowns.{/n} "No. Bedding down from fear — too pathetic."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Her cheek twitching, Jae nods to you and says with grim delight,{/n} "It's true. I may have been born a lowly wretch, but even these vermin won't make me die a wretch, whining and begging for mercy."
  - After: {n}Jae nods grimly.{/n} "Born a wretch, but I won't die begging."
- **Idira**
  - Before: {n}Idira speaks, and you hear a plea in her words:{/n} "Jae, I told you we don't need—"
  - After: {n}Idira pleads,{/n} "Jae, we don't need—"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shut up. We do need this. I need this."
  - After: "Shut up. I need this."
- **Cassia**
  - Before: "Do not speak so about yourself. Your origins may not be noble, but a soaring spirit can lift..."
  - After: "Don't. A soaring spirit can lift..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae raises her furious gaze to Cassia.{/n} "Princess. Please, shut up."
  - After: {n}Jae glares.{/n} "Princess. Shut up."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: {n}After draining his cup and noisily clearing his throat, Abelard says with studied joviality,{/n} "I know one shanty that always goes down a treat at parties..." {n}He looks at the grim countenances around him and seems to lose heart.{/n} "But it's only a favourite among voidsmen, I dare say, not a good choice for present company."
  - After: {n}Abelard drains his cup.{/n} "I know a shanty..." {n}He sees the faces.{/n} "No — not for this company."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "She is scared, {name}. That's all." {n}The Battle Sister's voice is sad.{/n}
  - After: "She's scared, {name}." {n}Argenta sounds sad.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "As if! What could ever scare the Jae Amira Fathreen Tameri ash Efreet, queen of the Cold Trade!"
  - After: "As if! What scares Jae Amira Fathreen Tameri ash Efreet, queen of the Cold Trade!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Mmm, the taste of dark despair in the air. Do all your celebrations taste as sweet as this?" {n}The xenos's question seems sincere rather than mocking — he genuinely wishes to know the answer.{/n}
  - After: "Mmm, despair. Are all your celebrations this sweet?" {n}He means it.{/n}
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "I am beginning to discern the different shades of mon-keigh emotions. That seemed like anger, but it was actually closer to despair. She feels afraid. And alone."
  - After: "That seemed anger, but was despair. She is afraid. And alone."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}Heinrix, one of the few whose cordial expression remains unchanged, looks at Jae with sincere sympathy.{/n}
  - After: {n}Heinrix looks at Jae with sympathy.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Rumbling, Ulfar declares in a consoling tone,{/n} "Among worthy warriors, valour is not measured based on the glory of our ancestors, but on our own deeds."
  - After: {n}Ulfar rumbles,{/n} "Valour is measured by deeds, not ancestors."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Sure they do — if you're an Angel of the Exalted One, you can ignore parentage completely. Too bad I'm not one of you."
  - After: "Sure — for Angels of the Exalted One. Not me."
- **Kibellah**
  - Before: {n}Kibellah's expression becomes strangely soft.{/n} "One should meet their death with an easy heart, for death is a gift. If Vil'Jae can only put her heart at ease through idle libations before she faces a violent death, let us help her."
  - After: {n}Kibellah softens.{/n} "Death is a gift. If drink eases Vil'Jae's heart, let us help."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Thanks, but you're not helping. I definitely didn't need the part about the violent death."
  - After: "Thanks, but the death part didn't help."
- **Solomorne**
  - Before: {n}Solomorne swirls the amasec in his mug, and says in a monotone,{/n} "A rat is certainly better than a Cold Trader. Progress. Pity it took a brush with death for spiritual growth."
  - After: {n}Solomorne, flatly:{/n} "A rat beats a Cold Trader. Progress."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Jae is quick to make an obscene gesture at the Arbitrator.{/n} "And there I was wondering whether to invite you or not! You hard-nosed ashmag!"
  - After: {n}Jae flips him off.{/n} "Hard-nosed ashmag!"
- **Eogunn**
  - Before: {n}Eogunn meets the Cold Trader's words with unexpected approval.{/n} "Suppressing the central nervous system with socially approved toxins is indeed a peculiar ritual of the laity, in which it would be fascinating to engage — most notably under the guidance of Mistress Heydari! Isn't it better to let loose the reins on our neural pathways and face doom with joy and excitement, than to let existential dread swallow us whole?"
  - After: {n}Eogunn approves.{/n} "Suppressing the nervous system with approved toxins — fascinating, under Mistress Heydari! Better joy than dread!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I knew that nothing human was alien to you, O wisest of men! Let's get on with suppressing the central whatever it was!"
  - After: "Wisest of men! On with suppressing the central whatever!"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Jae/FactotumAboutJae/FactotumAboutJae_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "I think we need to talk about your past."
  - After: "We need to talk about your past."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I want to know the details."
  - After: "Details."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How did you come to know of this?"
  - After: "How do you know?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I wish to see Jae Heydari. We have something to discuss."
  - After: "Bring me Jae Heydari."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Drop this, Danrok. Forget what you know."
  - After: "Drop this, Danrok."
- **Player**
  - Before: "I do not want to know anything. This conversation never happened."
  - After: "This never happened."
- **Player**
  - Before: "This evidence had better be incontrovertible."
  - After: "This had better be solid."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I must report highly compromising information about a member of your retinue. Namely, Mistress Jae Heydari, who it turns out, is nothing of the sort, but a commoner, a fugitive from the law, and a deserter from the Imperial Guard. I have solid evidence to prove it."
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Jae Heydari is a lowborn fugitive and Guard deserter. I have proof."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s absence, the person whom we presently know as Jae Heydari made a concerted effort to find you. After contacting all the Cold Traders in the sector, Heydari approached an individual by the name of Mercy, a highly influential and infamous figure in the Kasballica Mission. He was paid an eye-watering sum directly from your own coffers."
  - After: "While Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} was gone, Heydari paid Mercy of the Kasballica a fortune from your coffers."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "In Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}'s absence, the burden of watching over the dynasty's treasury fell upon my shoulders. I deemed Jae Heydari the likeliest threat to the dynasty's material security. I had my people conduct an investigation, and they uncovered a past connection between Heydari and an individual by the name of Mercy, a highly influential figure in the Kasballica Mission with a dangerous reputation."
  - After: "While Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} was gone, I found Heydari tied to Mercy, a dangerous Kasballica figure."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I may have overlooked some nuances, but I have solid evidence that the person whom we presently know as Jae Heydari served in the 19th Efreet Regiment, and was identified as the perpetrator of numerous instances of theft and smuggling, as well as desertion. And this individual is not of noble birth, but of the lowest origins."
  - After: "Heydari served in the 19th Efreet. Theft, smuggling, desertion. Lowborn."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Fearing that the predatory interests of the Kasballica would pose a threat to your coffers, I began my own investigation. It was entirely reasonable to suspect collusion of some kind between Heydari and Mercy, and so my suspicions were confirmed — the two were connected. It was from Mercy's associates that I acquired the compromising intelligence on Heydari."
  - After: "I suspected collusion, rightly. Mercy's associates sold me the proof."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "But I won't forget." {n}Jae smiles grimly at the Factotum.{/n} "Let's not play games, {name}. You heard everything. You know everything."
  - After: "But I won't forget." {n}Jae smiles grimly.{/n} "You know everything, {name}."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shopped me, did you, you little wannabe Questor?" {n}Jae's voice and bearing undergo a stark transformation. Biting soldier slang cuts through her typically gentle speech.{/n} "Don't miss a thing, your servants, {name}. And they're sneaky as, too. They'll climb up a grox's arse to find out what they want to know."
  - After: "Shopped me, wannabe Questor?" {n}Jae turns coarse.{/n} "Your servants would climb a grox's arse for secrets, {name}."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}Shrugging, Jae gives you one of her dazzling smiles of old.{/n} "Your word is law, shereen. For me, and for this bloated, devious louse."
  - After: {n}Jae smiles dazzlingly.{/n} "Your word is law, shereen."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Only if this scum slings his hook." {n}Jae nods at the now much paler Danrok.{/n}
  - After: "Only if this scum slings his hook." {n}Danrok pales.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Factotum bows and holds out a data-slate to you.{/n} "It is all here, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Official records from the Administratum, attestations from the Departmento Munitorum, and much more besides."
  - After: {n}The Factotum offers a data-slate.{/n} "Administratum and Munitorum records, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Jae/FactotumJaeAndMoney/FactotumJaeAndMoney_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "What crimes has she committed against the treasury?"
  - After: "What has she done to the treasury?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have no interest in hearing about this."
  - After: "I don't want to hear it."
- **Player**
  - Before: "How much has her chicanery cost us?"
  - After: "How much has it cost us?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "I have been informed that you have been soliciting bribes."
  - After: "I hear you solicit bribes."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Why do you need such gifts? Do you not receive enough through working with me?"
  - After: "Why gifts? Don't I pay you enough?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "The High Factotum is worried that you are exploiting your privileged position."
  - After: "The Factotum says you exploit your position."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Jae, I command you to stop riding roughshod over my Factotum and my treasury."
  - After: "Jae, stop bullying my Factotum and treasury."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Danrok the bumbling suitor. You dangle after my companion and now you are trying to settle the score? Get out of my sight."
  - After: "Jilted suitor settling scores, Danrok? Get out."
- **Player**
  - Before: "Janris, henceforth you will furnish Jae with whatever she desires. Is that clear?"
  - After: "Janris, give Jae whatever she desires."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, I must report systematic and flagrant attacks on the dynasty's coffers perpetrated by your companion Mistress Heydari. The Emperor as my witness, the worst rumours of her thieving ways proved to be a significant understatement of the reality!"
  - After: "Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}, Mistress Heydari is plundering the coffers. The rumours understated it!"
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Perhaps this isn't about hints but the habits of a rotten, venal soul accustomed to doling out bribes left and right and thereby draining the dynasty's treasury? I'd be curious to know, Danrok, how much of the von Valancius fortune you have squandered by handing out bribes to people who did not ask for them."
  - After: "Or he's a venal briber draining the treasury. How much have you squandered, Danrok?"
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "She is extorting bribes and oblations. Gifts. Favours. For herself, in particular. She is exploiting rumours of a connection between, ahem, herself and Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} to unscrupulously gather bribes from all and sundry, hinting at how displeased Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} will be to hear if anyone is being uncooperative. I myself have found myself the victim of her attacks with particular frequency, due to my position."
  - After: "She extorts gifts, hinting at her closeness to Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship} and the displeasure of Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Mostly from me."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}Surprised by the question, Danrok vacillates before saying,{/n} "On a protectorate-wide scale, the astronomical sum she has extorted from us seems negligible and not worthy of notice... Nevertheless, I cannot help but be outraged by her blatant exploitation of your goodwill!"
  - After: {n}Danrok hesitates.{/n} "A negligible sum... but it outrages me!"
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}With an air of pure anguish, Danrok bows his head.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. But when that woman sells your ship out from under you, I will say I warned you."
  - After: {n}Danrok bows.{/n} "As you wish, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Remember I warned you."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "You wished to see me, shereen?" {n}She bestows a dazzling smile upon you, and a look of pure contempt on Danrok.{/n}
  - After: "You wished to see me, shereen?" {n}She smiles at you, sneers at Danrok.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Bribes? What ashmag besmirched their worm-eaten lips with such a scurrilous lie? Actually, don't tell me — I don't even want to hear their blackened name. I have never demanded bribes from any of your vassals. But I have willingly accepted the gifts they have offered. Is that a crime?"
  - After: "Bribes? What ashmag said that? I never demanded. I accepted gifts. Is that a crime?"
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Mistress Heydari is quibbling over semantics! She may not demand anything directly, but she drops heavy hints..."
  - After: "Semantics! She drops heavy hints..."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I am a businesswoman, shereen. I extract profit from everything — it's in my nature. When a desert lion catches the scent of blood, he will eat even if his belly is full. For who knows when the next feast will come. And besides... what girl doesn't like receiving gifts?" {n}Jae lowers her abashed gaze to the floor.{/n}
  - After: "I'm a businesswoman, shereen. A desert lion eats even when full. And girls like gifts." {n}Jae looks down.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "The High Factotum should try to worry less — it's not good for the slanderous little heart that pumps blood around his ungrateful carcass. But I am surprised he was not worried before, when he showered me with generous gifts the moment I arrived on board. Of course, I will not accuse him of trying to buy my favour..."
  - After: "He showered me with gifts when I arrived. Not that he sought my favour..."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Factotum's face changes colour to match his jacket, whose collar suddenly appears to be digging into his flabby throat.{/n}
  - After: {n}The Factotum flushes red.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "...however, the source of these blessings dried up as soon as he learned of our connection, shereen. I considered it profoundly wrong that our affection should have had such an unhappy effect on my material well-being. Therefore, I took it upon myself to remind the High Factotum of his previous largesse."
  - After: "...but the gifts stopped once he learned of us, shereen. So I reminded him."
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: {n}The High Factotum lets out an incoherent burble, sweeps into a deep bow, and hastily beats a retreat.{/n}
  - After: {n}Danrok burbles, bows and flees.{/n}
- **Jae**
  - Before: "These unjust reproaches are like a hailstorm upon my soul. All right, shereen. I will not trouble your treasurer again. Although I find it very strange that you trust a man who hides his real smell under lashings of perfume. Everyone knows that that is a sure sign of the heart's proclivity for deception." {n}Jae leaves, vindictively treading on the Factotum's foot as she goes, no doubt already plotting a new affront to Danrok's ears.{/n}
  - After: "Fine, shereen, I'll leave your treasurer be. But perfumed men hide deceit." {n}Jae leaves, treading on his foot.{/n}
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**
  - Before: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. Your servants will be pleased to know that they have your protection against the inveiglements of that... grasping viper."
  - After: "Thank you, Your {mf|Lordship|Ladyship}. We are safe from that grasping viper."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}With a vicious smile, Jae remarks in his wake,{/n} "Who would ever trust the word of a man who douses himself in perfume to cover up his body odour? Everyone knows that that is a sure sign of a soul prone to deceit!"
  - After: {n}Jae smiles viciously.{/n} "Who trusts a man who perfumes his stink? Deceitful!"

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Jae/Hangover/JaeRomance_Hangover_dialogue

- **Player**
  - Before: "You and I... We did not fall into bed together just to sleep, did we?"
  - After: "We didn't just sleep, did we?"
- **Player**
  - Before: "We need to make ourselves presentable."
  - After: "We must look presentable."
- **Jae**
  - Before: {n}You hear a soft sigh beside you. Looking over, you see dark hair fanned out across your pillow. Jae, who is cosied up next to you fast asleep, is fully dressed — just as you are. Or perhaps she is not asleep at all.{/n} "Shereen... You certainly know how to have a good time."
  - After: {n}Jae lies beside you, fully dressed.{/n} "Shereen... You know how to have fun."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "I don't remember all of it. I think... We shot at some people. Over their heads. Someone didn't offer us the required amount of respect. Then you said that flying a shuttle was easy and that you would bet your Warrant that you could get us to the ship. We also stripped a man and burnt his clothes because the sight of them offended the Exalted One... I can still smell the singed fibres now."
  - After: "We shot over disrespectful heads. You bet your Warrant you could fly us home. We burned a man's clothes for offending the Exalted One... I still smell it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You can smell it too, and you feel slight burn marks on your fingers. You notice one more thing — your lips feel rough and dry, like they have been nipped over and over by another's teeth.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your fingers are singed, your lips bitten raw.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Turning her remarkably fresh-looking face to you, Jae smirks.{/n} "You don't remember anything at all, shereen? Neither do I. All the better. What sweet and thrilling scenarios we can imagine to fill in the gaps."
  - After: {n}Jae smirks.{/n} "You don't remember? Nor do I. Better to imagine."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You struggle to piece together your fragmented memories of last night's carousing. For some reason, you can clearly recall the ingratiating looks of the wardens as they tried to persuade you to stop, the cries of the beggars to whom you gave an obscene amount of alms, and the stamping of the servitor that you rode around the station to Jae's unconcealed glee.{/n}
  - After: {n}You recall pleading wardens, lavish alms, and riding a servitor around the station.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Your memories have been split into tiny fragments that your mind mercifully refuses to reassemble into a clear picture of the scandalous events of last night.{/n}
  - After: {n}Your mind mercifully refuses to remember.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I'm sorry to say you're right, shereen. No matter how soft the bed or how pleasant the company, there is a line we must not cross. And I am perilously close to doing exactly that by getting a couple of bottles of delicious medicine for our aching heads."
  - After: "Sadly, you're right, shereen. Though I'm tempted to fetch hangover medicine in bottles."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Thoughts tumble violently inside your head, periodically ricocheting off the inside of your skull and triggering bursts of piercing pain. Your tongue feels desiccated and shrivelled in your mouth, and it scrapes painfully against your teeth. Light... Light is the enemy.{/n}

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Jae/WelcomeToParty/JaeRomance_WelcomeToParty_prompt

- **Player**

  - After: "Ammaricar — a celebration?"

  - Before: "What kind of people will be at this party? Smugglers and thieves?"
  - After: "Who'll be there? Smugglers and thieves?"

  - Before: "It would be my pleasure to attend your party."
  - After: "I'd be pleased to attend."
- **Player**
  - Before: "It is beneath me to attend such gatherings."
  - After: "Such gatherings are beneath me."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Shereen, if you find a spare minute on Footfall when you are not deciding our lacklustre fates, I would be delighted to see you at my ammaricar in the Amasecus. I'll tell Octy to set aside some decent wine in case you decide to grace our humble party with your luminous presence."
  - After: "Shereen, if you're free on Footfall, come to my ammaricar at the Amasecus. Octy will save decent wine for you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "It is an occasion celebrated on my world, Efreet. It is the day when a person shows, by their actions, that they have reached maturity, that their spirit is ennobled. Among the Efreetian nobility, this day is considered more important than other symbolic events, such as the first cry or the day of repose. And by a wonderful coincidence, my ammaricar happens to fall on the day when I also wish to celebrate my acquisition of the Mercatum Tabula Officiale."
  - After: "An Efreet rite marking maturity of spirit. Our nobles prize it most. I'll also celebrate getting the Mercatum Tabula Officiale."

  - After: "Only my dearest friends. Mostly thieves and smugglers, admittedly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "The lowly regulars of the Amasecus will be telling their great-grandchildren about the time they had the honour of witnessing your dazzling visit to that unworthy dive, shereen. That is, of course, if they live long enough to see their great-grandchildren."
  - After: "The Amasecus regulars will tell their great-grandchildren of your visit, shereen. If they live that long."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I agree with every word, shereen. But who would dare question the Rogue Trader's decision to attend a little party? After all, was it not the Exalted One Himself who granted the Rogue Trader a fraction of His own dazzling glory? I pray that He might send your heart the urge to reconsider."
  - After: "Agreed, shereen. Still, may the Exalted One change your mind."

- **Marazhai**

But you can clearly see the deranged fire in his eyes go out as if doused with water. Drawing his blades, the Drukhari meets the humans rushing at him with the arrogant laughter of one who is doomed to die.{/n}

  - After: {n}He grins.{/n} "Good. Name your victim."

  - After: {n}Vigdis flinches.{/n}
- **High Factotum Janris Danrok**

It is time to prepare for our feast." {n}The Drukhari casts one last look at the officers, who do not seem to believe their luck, then turns and strides off.{/n}

The Drukhari tilts his head to the side, admiring you as if you were his own creation. The sharp claws of his glove slide along your jawline, his voice dropping to a whisper only you can hear:{/n} "My naive little pet... Do you think you can so easily cast off who you have become under my influence? No, {name}. But for your obedience... I will gift you the life that you just exchanged for your own."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Marazhai/NM_SpireEvents/01_Raider/MarazhaiRaider_dialogue

  - Before: "I do not trust you."
  - After: "I don't trust you."

  - Before: "We do not have time for this."

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}After a minute, Marazhai bolts upright and freezes, clearly wrestling with his own irritation. A moment later, he cranes his neck to look down into the abyss beneath his feet.{/n} "Come here, {name}. Take a look at this view."

  - After: {n}He smiles.{/n} "Commorragh is the greatest creation of any race. See it properly."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}His dark eyes narrow to slits.{/n} "I do not need your trust, {name}. I am offering you a chance... to learn something new."
  - After: {n}His eyes narrow.{/n} "I don't need trust, {name}. I offer a lesson."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The chasm yawns endlessly below, the cyclopean spires of Commorragh piercing upward out of the gloom. The details of these vast structures are hidden by the hazy gloaming — the many lights on the spire's terraces, which resemble marsh gas, are all that bring colour to this bleak and awe-inspiring vista. The towering height takes your breath away and you almost swoon... and then a gentle shove at your back makes you lose your balance.{/n}
  - After: {n}Commorragh's spires pierce the gloom of an endless chasm. You feel dizzy... then a shove topples you.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The moments stretch into an eternity: your firm footing is swept out from under you, your heart stops beating entirely, the chasm below seems to rush up toward you, ready to swallow you whole... and then clawed fingers close around your wrist, halting your fall, but holding you suspended over the abyss. Marazhai's laughter rings with dark delight when he finally tugs you back into the raider.{/n}
  - After: {n}You fall... then claws catch your wrist. Laughing, Marazhai hauls you back.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai clicks his tongue.{/n} "Such a narrow mind. How disappointing. Or perhaps it is cowardice, {name}? But that is your weakness, not mine." {n}He steps over the side of the raider, returning to the platform.{/n}
  - After: {n}He tuts.{/n} "Narrow-minded. Or cowardly, {name}?" {n}He climbs out.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Terror! Unbridled, exquisite terror! Far more bite to it than the stale, predictable pain of torture victims. That burn in your chest, that tang in your mouth... Can you feel the blood roaring in your veins? Your heart battering out a march of triumph? Life becomes more vivid when death can come at any moment, {name}. I will continue to remind you of that." {n}Without giving you a chance to respond, Marazhai steps over the side of the raider and returns to the platform.{/n}
  - After: "Terror! Sharper than any torture! Feel your blood roar? Life is vivid near death, {name}." {n}He climbs out.{/n}

Once inside, we must proceed through the first chambers directly ahead and turn left, then left again. Come — I intend to claim what is mine."
  - After: "Kabalites picked the raider clean. What I seek is in the spire's torture chamber: through the first chambers, then left, and left again. Come."

After sealing the container, he proceeds to another one nearby.{/n} "I have to make sure that Tervantias's servants have not laid their claws on my property.   - Before: {n}The devices withhold their secrets from you — the nature of the xenotech is so depraved that you are unable to discern the purpose of these tools. A moment later, you hear Marazhai slam a container shut and stand up.{/n}

  - Before: {n}Marazhai straightens and turns to you, holding something in his hands.{/n} "You are not satisfied with what you have already experienced in the tangle of the Dark City? Ha. A laudable thirst for knowledge."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Marazhai/StartingEvent_P1

- **Player**
  - Before: "I did not save Marazhai's life so you could take matters into your own hands! Put your weapons away, all of you!"
  - After: "I didn't save Marazhai for this! Weapons away!"
- **Player**
  - Before: "And what, the rest of you just stood by and watched?"
  - After: "And the rest of you watched?"
- **Player**
  - Before: [Draw your weapon] "Let's rid the world of this scum together."
  - After: [Draw your weapon] "Let's kill this scum."
- **Abelard**
  - Before: "Who am I to stand in the way of the Imperium's justice?"
  - After: "Who am I to block Imperial justice?"
- **Idira**
  - Before: "Lord Captain, it's none of my business... but seeing that pasty scumbag get the crap beaten out of him is fine by me!"
  - After: "Not my business, but I enjoyed the beating!"
- **Yrliet**
  - Before: "I refuse to pay for the deeds of my dark cousin."
  - After: "I won't pay for my dark cousin."
- **Jae**
  - Before: "Shereen, true wisdom lies in knowing when to step forward, and when to step back and blend into the wall."
  - After: "Shereen, wisdom is blending into the wall."

  - After: "Beatings subdue xenos. Even Drukhari?"

  - After: "Xenos Marazhai: insufficient priority."

  - Before: {n}Heinrix curses floridly in a dialect of Low Gothic that you do not recognise.{/n} "Damn it, {name}! Your leniency toward enemies of Humanity... no, toward this particular duplicitous and despicable piece of filth crosses all bounds!"
  - After: {n}Heinrix curses.{/n} "Damn it, {name}! This leniency crosses all bounds!"
- **Argenta**

  - After: {n}Argenta glares.{/n} "I won't oppose you. But I await its cause. Eagerly."
- **Ulfar**

  - After: {n}Ulfar sighs.{/n} "Another time, scrawny inhuman."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai takes his eyes off the exit and looks at you. The contorted mask of battle rage slides from his face, and he sheathes his blades.{/n} "If your lackeys have seen enough of the show, I have business to discuss with you, {name}."
  - After: {n}Marazhai sheathes his blades.{/n} "Show's over. We have business, {name}."

  - After: {n}Marazhai charges.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "The right decision." {n}Heinrix's eyes blaze with otherworldly ice.{/n}
  - After: "The right decision." {n}Heinrix's eyes blaze.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "There are some things in the universe that cannot be changed. Wolf meets xenos, xenos dies. Let's finish him, Aett-Vater!"
  - After: "Wolf meets xenos, xenos dies. Finish him, Aett-Vater!"
- **Kibellah**

  - After: "You didn't name him, Domin'{name}. Else all this city deserves the blade."

## World/Dialogs/Companions/Romances/Marazhai/StartingEvent_P1/StartingEvent_KillingAttempt

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Time seems to stand still when you enter. Figures cast in shadow, huddled against the walls, turn to you — everyone except the few standing frozen in the middle of the room with weapons in their hands.{/n}
  - After: {n}All turn to you, except the armed few mid-room.{/n}
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: {n}The air around Heinrix seems to crackle with cold. He is grimacing and spitting blood, clearly in pain from a bruise on his cheekbone.{/n} "Pretty quick for carrion..."
  - After: {n}Heinrix spits blood.{/n} "Quick for carrion..."
- **Argenta**
  - Before: {n}Argenta is panting, but her weapon is steadily trained on Marazhai.{/n} "May Thy will fortify my hand, may my faith in Thee grant me strength..."
  - After: {n}Argenta aims at Marazhai.{/n} "Fortify my hand..."
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: {n}Ulfar's rumbling malicious laughter echoes off the lair's ceiling.{/n} "A nimble pest, aren't you? You could have surrendered without a fight — I would have snapped your neck and spared you torment. But you chose to die more painfully..."
  - After: {n}Ulfar laughs.{/n} "Nimble pest! You could've died quick. Now, slow..."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Despite his proud stance, Marazhai is clearly struggling to stay upright. His armour is battered and chipped in places, and his twisted face is marred with bloody streaks.{/n} "Closer, mon-keigh... closer, if you are so eager to know the caress of my blades..."
  - After: {n}Marazhai, bloodied, barely stands.{/n} "Closer, mon-keigh..."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai, whose armour is dented in a few places, lets out a guttural laugh.{/n} "What are you waiting for? It is about time we finished our little dance!"
  - After: {n}Marazhai laughs.{/n} "Let us finish our dance!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai lightly brandishes his blades, laughing mockingly in his opponent's face.{/n} "I can continue dancing with you for a long, long time... but I am growing weary of your pathetic attempts."
  - After: {n}Marazhai mocks.{/n} "I could dance all day... but you bore me."
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: "Not all your lackeys are well trained, {name}. As soon as I crossed the threshold of this squalid hole, I was forced to take up arms."
  - After: "Your lackeys attacked me at the door, {name}."
- **Heinrix**
  - Before: "I am merely doing my job, {name}." {n}Heinrix's voice drips with sarcastic venom.{/n} "I have not heard you officially declare yourself the protector of this xenos, and so the Ordo is fully within its rights to act!"
  - After: "Just my job, {name}." {n}He sneers.{/n} "You never declared him protected, so the Ordo acts!"
- **Argenta**
  - Before: "The abomination that you have allowed into the ranks of your companions must die. This is His will and my duty, Rogue Trader." {n}Argenta's eyes burn with a frenzied, incinerating fire.{/n}
  - After: "This abomination must die. His will, Rogue Trader." {n}Her eyes burn.{/n}
- **Ulfar**
  - Before: "Ho there! I decided to unwind by chasing this stringy xenos across the ceiling! Join me, Aett-Vater!"
  - After: "Ho! Chasing this stringy xenos! Join me, Aett-Vater!"
- **Marazhai**
  - Before: {n}Marazhai chuckles hoarsely.{/n} "I do not care about your lackeys, {name}. But they do seem to care about me. The mon-keigh do not know their place in your circle. A pitiful spectacle."
  - After: {n}Marazhai chuckles.{/n} "Your lackeys forget their place, {name}. Pitiful."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You posed a question to me not long ago, elantach. And now I am here to present you with my answer." {n}With fluid grace, Yrliet emerges from the shadows of the captain's bridge. Her face seems to glow under the lumen light, her expression slightly more pensive than usual.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You try to split the world into pieces, to fragment it: into light and dark, truth and lies, self and other. But I see the world as a single whole, and in this lies its simplicity and complexity. It is not enough simply to see the world and hear its voices. You must understand it."
  - After: "You split the world into halves. I see it whole. You must understand it, not just see it."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Instead of the lifeless clamour of monstrous mechanisms, the roar of engines, and the discordant voices of your followers, I hear and attend to silence.   - After: "Past your clamour, I heed silence, where the soul changes."
- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "Only truth, elantach — no invitation. Your soul shines. I see you. That is all."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}You almost miss the flicker of disappointment in the Aeldari's eyes.{/n} "This is only the beginning, elantach. I have more to tell you."
  - After: {n}A flicker of disappointment.{/n} "This is only the beginning, elantach."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The foreign word rolls around awkwardly in your mouth and, once released, it immediately sinks without a trace in the sea of voices on the captain's bridge.{/n}
  - After: {n}The word stumbles out and is lost.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "You are rushing, elantach. Try again. Do not force the word — let it take you with it."
  - After: "You rush, elantach. Let the word carry you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Aeldari turns away, but before she leaves she looks at you once more:{/n} "Do not take my words to heart. There is no shame in thinking as others of your kind do. It is much more difficult to follow a different path from the rest."
  - After: {n}She looks back.{/n} "No shame in thinking like your kind. A different path is harder."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The Aeldari inclines her head and makes a subtle hand gesture whose meaning is unknown to you.{/n} "Some questions are destined to remain unanswered. You no doubt have important affairs to attend to. I will not distract the overlord of the mon-keigh any longer."
  - After: {n}She bows her head.{/n} "Some questions stay unanswered. I'll not keep you."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "We talked about how we each see the world in our own way. You were eager to know how Aeldari see the world. Do you still wish to hear the answer?"
  - After: "You wished to know how Aeldari see. Still curious?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Then listen closely to my answer, elantach. You may struggle to comprehend what is to be said, being accustomed to revelling in your own might and skewing the world to suit yourself. Pitch your understanding not toward my words, but the sense that lies hidden in the shade of their sounds." {n}Yrliet half-closes her eyes, her words unfurling slowly and melodically.{/n}
  - After: "Listen, elantach. Heed not my words, but the sense beneath them." {n}She half-closes her eyes.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And what do you make of it, elantach? How differently do you see the world?"
  - After: "And you, elantach? How do you see the world?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "And in you, elantach... I see much more than just another mon-keigh. Your true essence lies in your will, which is capable of changing the world around you and within you. It lies in your ability to create and to understand your creation, and in your ability to destroy. It lies in what your kin's minds cannot grasp, what their primitive sight cannot behold...   - After: "In you, elantach, I see more than a mon-keigh: a will to create, understand and destroy. Only I see it."

  - After: {n}Yrliet's breath hitches.{/n} "You see as your kin do. I judged too soon."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Sometimes it is so." {n}Yrliet closes her eyes as though she is sinking into a memory.{/n} "Even the ruins of long-forgotten worlds contain the stories of the past and of those who came before us."

- **(conversation owner)**

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Yrliet says nothing for a time, silently watching you from under her half-lowered lids.{/n} "Now that we have each shared our truth about this world... I would like to know if your thoughts about me align with those of your kin, elantach, or if you see me differently."

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Your words do not trouble my soul. On the contrary, they bring only relief. And now that this conversation is over, I will leave you to return to guiding your steel-winged bird." {n}Yrliet nods curtly and melts into the shadows of the bridge.{/n}
  - After: "A relief. Guide your steel-winged bird." {n}She melts into the shadows.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}Guarded interest gleams in Yrliet's eyes when your gazes meet again.{/n}
  - After: {n}Guarded interest gleams in Yrliet's eyes.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That is enough, mon-keigh. Did I not warn you about the consequences?"
  - After: "Enough, mon-keigh. Did I not warn you of the consequences?"
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "I accept your answer, elantach. As long as you do not attempt to get under my skin or demand... something else... of me." {n}She places particular emphasis on the last few words.{/n} "I will go now, elantach. Guide your steel-winged bird."
  - After: "Accepted, elantach, so long as you demand nothing... else." {n}She stresses it.{/n} "Guide your steel-winged bird."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "If your words are sincere, elantach... then you are capable of seeing more than you do now."
  - After: "If sincere, elantach, you can see more than you do."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "That will be best, I think. The less conspicuous my presence is on your ship, the more at peace my soul will be. I will go now, elantach. Guide your steel-winged bird." {n}Yrliet nods curtly and melts into the shadows of the bridge.{/n}
  - After: "Best. Unnoticed, I am at peace. Guide your steel-winged bird, elantach." {n}She melts into the shadows.{/n}
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Mon-keigh lives pass so swiftly. You rush through them for the sake of a chosen goal, but thoughts of transience and loss frighten you, and so you drive such thoughts away and drown yourselves in the daily tumult. But it is from fleeting moments, which enter our lives and quickly vanish from them, that the soul's fortress grows. A moment's blooming, an hour's wilting — the splendour of each lies in its ephemerality. So too the memories of those who have left our side and no longer walk the path with us."
  - After: "Mon-keigh lives pass swiftly; fearing loss, you drown in tumult. Yet fleeting moments build the soul — a bloom, or those we have lost."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Think of the Lilaethan, the world on which our paths crossed. What is it truly? What is its essence? The Lilaethan's magnificence comes not from the green of its vast forests, or from the depths of its waters. Its beauty is in the word. In the way it dances on the tongue. And even you, elantach, can sense it. Try — say the word, slowly, delicately, casting aside all stray thoughts. Feel. Perhaps then you will see."
  - After: "Lilaethan, where we met: its beauty is its word, dancing on the tongue. Say it slowly, elantach. Feel."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: "Mon-keigh grow angry when they do not receive an answer. And when they do receive an answer, they grow angry then, too." {n}Yrliet steps back and looks away from you.{/n} "Let us leave this conversation in the past, and move on."
  - After: "Mon-keigh rage with or without answers." {n}She looks away.{/n} "Let us move on."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: {n}The world around you fades and your perception instantly narrows, coming to a single point of focus on the tip of your tongue. "Lae" — the tip of your tongue touches the same place again and air softly rushes from your chest, the sound like the susurration of leaves as the wind weaves through a forest canopy. "Than" — your tongue taps your front teeth and a gentle vibration spreads through your body, sending a shiver along your spine.{/n}

- **(conversation owner)**

  - After: "Still, your reaction fascinated me. How do you see the world?"

## World/Dialogs/Epilogues

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: If rumours are to be believed, the madness that permeated the Rogue Trader's ship had struck the Seneschal's mind as well. Eyewitnesses to his agony spoke of the voice of his beloved and dearly missed spouse Quatharina beginning to haunt his every step. At first, the esteemed Seneschal welcomed the insanity that overcame him. Then, he ran from it in terror, trying to drown out his wife's voice in the barking of orders and the screams of castigated crew members. The sight of the grave officer, dishevelled, uniform covered in filth, with a power cleaver in one hand and a clanging ship's bell in the other, filled his subordinates with dread.
  - After: Rumour said madness took the Seneschal: his late wife Quatharina's voice haunted him. Filthy, wielding cleaver and bell, he terrified his crew.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The short life of the entity named Nomos ended on Epitaph. The young being was devoured by its maker, perishing in the very whirlwind of C'tan Shard energies that once spawned it, devoured by their own creator. It was not in the nature of the star vampires to willingly give or gift. Predatory consumption was their primary instinct, and thus Nomos were ordered to cease existing and merge in a stream of obedient energy with the mighty body of the ancient deity.
  - After: Nomos died on Epitaph, devoured by its maker in the C'tan Shard energies that spawned it. Star vampires take; they never give.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Great Judgement of Incendia Chorda and the atrocities committed by her confessional units bled Footfall dry. The station soon faced a labour shortage, and few survivors of the religious purges could handle the increased workloads. Without thrones from the Cold Trade, the station fell into decay. Footfall entered an era of piety, hunger, and hardship.
  - After: Incendia Chorda's purges bled Footfall dry; without Cold Trade thrones, it sank into piety and hunger.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: After recovering from Chorda's regime, Footfall reclaimed its status as the trading hub of the Expanse. Having learned a bitter lesson, Vladaym Tocara created the Footfall Partisans' Militia — a well-equipped mercenary army that answered only to him. A modicum of order returned to the station.
  - After: Footfall became the Expanse's trade hub again, guarded by Vladaym Tocara's private Footfall Partisans' Militia.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Urbend Drivestem cared more about preserving the influence of his line than the well-being of the protectorate. His blind ambition lost him his governor's seat and the respect of his family. Within a few generations, one of the largest houses of Dargonus turned into an obscure family of petty aristocrats.
  - After: Urbend Drivestem's ambition cost him the governorship; his great Dargonus house dwindled into petty nobility.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The mutiny was mercilessly suppressed by the united forces of Navigators loyal to Cassia and von Valancius enforcers. But the price of even a failed rebellion was too high for House Orsellio, which lost half of its influence overnight and thereafter operated entirely under the aegis of the Rogue Trader, a Navigator House in name only.
  - After: Cassia's Navigators and von Valancius enforcers crushed the mutiny. Halved, House Orsellio became the Rogue Trader's puppet.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Having lost its leader and lacking a worthy successor, the Chorda dynasty began to weaken. The grim legacy of the abominable Aspyce revealed itself, and the protectorate fell into chaos. Grasping claimants tore the defenceless demesne apart.
  - After: Leaderless, the Chorda dynasty crumbled; Aspyce's legacy resurfaced and claimants tore the protectorate apart.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Incendia Chorda continued her merciless fight against the heresies plaguing the Expanse. Not concerning herself with notions of jurisdiction, she brought the Imperium's justice everywhere she went, killing heretics by the thousands. Stained-glass windows with her likeness illuminated by bonfires graced the sector's chapels. With her tightening grip of fear, the prayers of the pious became ever more fervent in their reverence of the Gracious Chastiser.
  - After: Incendia Chorda kept purging heresy across the Expanse, ignoring jurisdiction and killing thousands. Fearful chapels glorified the Gracious Chastiser.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Having learned a bitter lesson on Footfall, Incendia Chorda let go of her fanatical zeal. Relinquishing the reins of power, she secluded herself on a cloister world. The time of purges passed — and with it, the time of law and order. In the power vacuum that followed, the dark legacy of the abominable Aspyce reared its ugly head, and Incendia's dominion gradually devolved into a nest of criminals and pirates.
  - After: Humbled, Incendia Chorda retired to a cloister world. Aspyce's dark legacy returned, and her dominion became a pirate nest.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Evayne Winterscale underwent his Magnae Accessio and became his dynasty's new Rogue Trader. Many said that noble Evayne lacked firmness of judgement, yet he had more than enough trust, even in those who were unworthy of it. The young Rogue Trader did not forget those who had saved him from the Rykad System or the favours that House von Valancius had bestowed on the Winterscales.
  - After: Evayne Winterscale became Rogue Trader. Overly trusting, he never forgot that House von Valancius saved him in the Rykad System.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Cult of Saint Drusus continued its indefatigable struggle to spread the faith around the Expanse and expose the vile transgressions of the authorities. The stronger and wealthier a planet was, the less its rulers wanted to see the black-clad preachers. Riots and assassinations pushed the cult to the place where it felt most confident — the frontier.
  - After: Hounded by riots and assassinations, the Cult of Saint Drusus took its preaching to the frontier.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: After the death of Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso, a man called Chaplain took over the leadership of the Drusian mission. He hid his name, but not his crimes or his piratical past. With the resolve of an experienced voidfarer, he steered the cult and even led his fellow believers on military expeditions against brigands, enforcing order and converting depraved captives to the faith.
  - After: After Reverend Hieronymus Doloroso died, the ex-pirate Chaplain led the Drusian mission, crusading against brigands and converting captives.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The deals struck by the Cognisance Fleet and the von Valancius dynasty replenished the Explorators' dwindling supplies and allowed them to re-embark on a rapid and unrelenting expansion campaign. With powerful bases established in the Expanse, the Omnissiah's scouts bravely ventured forth toward unnamed stars with the same drive that propelled their ancestors to explore the Expanse itself.
  - After: Resupplied by von Valancius trade, the Cognisance Fleet's Explorators pushed on toward unnamed stars.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Magos Dominus Opticon-22 was sent to the forward scouting squadron by the fleet conclave. The reason for this was the discovery of the support he secretly stored in his computing blocks for the Discontinuing of the Cycle. His ship disappeared without a trace in a research raid.
  - After: Exposed as a Discontinuing of the Cycle sympathiser, Magos Dominus Opticon-22 was sent scouting and vanished.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Cassia Orsellio renounced her destiny of becoming the Novator and chose to spend her days with her beloved. She lived a short life, trying to fill every moment spent together with colour and passion. Alas, Cassia's genetic mutations did not allow her to bear an heir, and soon they began grotesquely deforming her body. One night, she gave her lover a kiss and disappeared forever, leaving behind a short note: "My love, from our first meeting to our final days together, you were the only morning light that shone in my heart, never fading. You have a life ahead of you — live it happily, for both of us. As for me... I love you endlessly. Yours, Cass."
  - After: Cassia Orsellio forsook becoming Novator for her beloved. Barren, her mutations deforming her, she vanished one night after a kiss, leaving a note: "You were the only morning light in my heart. Live happily, for both of us. I love you endlessly. Yours, Cass."
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The crisis in the Expanse dealt a serious blow to the business interests of the Fellowship of the Void. Having no powerful allies, they retreated into the darkness of frontier systems. The hard life they faced there forged them into a new tribe — furious, wild, and willing to do anything for survival. They swore to return and retake what had once been theirs.
  - After: Ruined by the crisis, the Fellowship of the Void fled to the frontier, grew wild, and swore to return.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Vladaym Tocara, as Liege of Footfall, survived fourteen assassination attempts and thwarted no less than two thousand schemers before a shot finally took his life. The esteemed Liege's funeral was held in great secrecy with only his closest entourage being permitted to view his corpse, which spawned some peculiar rumours.
  - After: Liege Vladaym Tocara foiled fourteen assassinations and two thousand schemers before a shot killed him. Rumours followed.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: When Octaviana became the new leader of the Kasballica Mission, she made every effort to not end up like Vladaym. The Mission's leadership demanded profits, and Chorda's enforcers thirsted for blood. Octaviana's dilemma sorted itself out when one day all of Footfall's Cold Traders were arrested and herded onto the Adeptus Amasecus. The ship was undocked from the station and left to drift toward Furibundus with no fuel and almost no air. Octaviana was not on board. She had made a deal to turn over all her accomplices, and she disappeared with a fortune in thrones.
  - After: Octaviana, new Kasballica Mission head, betrayed her accomplices: Footfall's Cold Traders were set adrift on the Adeptus Amasecus toward Furibundus. She vanished, rich.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Time spent on the same world as mon-keigh pushed the Farseer Muaran toward reflection. When the Webway Gate awoke on Janus and squads of Aeldari rangers stepped onto their ancestors' world, he averted a bloodbath. Granting the Lilaethan and its new and naive citizens his blessing, he disappeared through a shining portal, departing for a new home.
  - After: When Janus's Webway Gate woke, Farseer Muaran averted a bloodbath, blessed the Lilaethan, and departed for a new home.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Such was the echo of the deeds of the Rogue Trader of House von Valancius. Deeds that transformed the Koronus Expanse and prepared it for events even darker and more violent. But those are the events of a different story. This one has come to an end.
  - After: So the von Valancius Rogue Trader reshaped the Koronus Expanse. That story is over.

  - After: Vheabos VI's domed palaces sheltered blackguards and exiled nobles, making the death world the Expanse's political centre.

  - Before: Rumours and stories of {mf|his|her} humanitarian rule formed the foundation of the Valancean school of philosophy. This dangerous heresy was denounced in many systems, but persecutions only hardened and multiplied its followers.
  - After: Tales of {mf|his|her} humane rule birthed the Valancean school. Denounced as heresy, persecution only spread it.

  - After: Legend said the God-Emperor empowered {mf|him|her} and shielded {mf|him|her}. The Ecclesiarchy persecuted such tales and talk of sainthood.

  - After: Forewarned, Marshal Anthar shielded many from mad Argenta's wrath. Facing her once, he lost his right arm.

  - After: The skull-and-pillar dagger was reforged into an Inquisitor Insignia; Xavier Calcazar inducted {mf|him|her} into the Koronus Conclave.

  - After: The Edge of Daybreak, Greater Daemon of Eufrates II, counselled {mf|His|Her} {mf|Lord|Lady}ship and warned {mf|him|her}, until {name} von Valancius and it became rivals.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: No longer secluded and forlorn, Foulstone turned into the spiritual centre of the Expanse, clad in gold and power. Rulers went there to be anointed for greatness, criminals for penance, and the righteous for encouragement, and there was no end to them in sight.
  - After: Foulstone became the Expanse's golden spiritual centre.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Of course, the corrupting influence of the Rogue Trader tainted each spark of faith that was kindled on Foulstone, turning the zealots into tools and the gullible into traitors. Donning the masks of piety, despicable demagogues lead their flock into the abyss of heresy.
  - After: The Rogue Trader's corruption turned Foulstone's faithful toward heresy.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Farseer Muaran led his kin in battle against the mon-keigh. He was not able to overcome his hatred for them, and he washed the bitterness of loss from his heart with blood before leaving the transformed Lilaethan behind.
  - After: Farseer Muaran warred on the mon-keigh in hatred, then left Lilaethan.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Naturally, the servants of the von Valancius dynasty and people under the Rogue Trader's protection were safe from the Fellowship of the Void's attacks... mostly.
  - After: Von Valancius's subjects were safe from the Fellowship of the Void... mostly.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: After returning to the place where {mf|his|her} path as a Rogue Trader had begun, {name} von Valancius founded a new capital on Rykad Minoris, asserting {mf|his|her} right to rule over any manifestation of the warp's horror in the Koronus Expanse.
  - After: {name} von Valancius founded a capital on Rykad Minoris, where {mf|his|her} path began, ruling every warp horror in {mf|his|her} Expanse.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: By some bizarre miracle, Marazhai Aezyrraesh managed to survive the Rogue Trader's betrayal on Epitaph. Even more fortuitously, he was picked up by a Drukhari raiding ship and delivered to Commorragh. Acting strangely calm and quiet, the former Dracon of the Reaving Tempest was granted an audience with one of the Archons of the Kabal of the Black Heart. What they discussed that day is unknown, but Marazhai left the Archon's palace with an armed squad and embarked on a hunt for a secret trophy.
  - After: Marazhai survived the betrayal on Epitaph and reached Commorragh. After meeting an Archon of the Black Heart, he set off hunting a secret trophy.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Incendia Chorda's crusade put an end to the existence of this corrupted place. With heavy losses, her fleet broke into the system, defeated the warp spawn there, and bombed every world to ash with cyclonic torpedoes. A decade later, the warp tear in realspace closed.
  - After: Incendia Chorda's crusade bombed this corrupted system to ash. A decade later, the warp tear closed.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Brave House Werserian returned to its roots and engaged in void trade. Their renowned ship, the Lady Theodora, embarked on many grand voyages and took part in astounding expeditions to the limits of uncharted systems.
  - After: House Werserian returned to void trade, its ship Lady Theodora exploring uncharted systems.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: However, close friendship with the von Valancius dynasty did not stop pirate squadrons from pillaging the protectorate's treasures when fleets of outraged neighbours arrived to take their vengeance.
  - After: Friendship didn't stop pirates looting the protectorate when it fell.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Realising that things were changing in the Expanse, Kasballica agents limited their appetites and restricted their trade to goods of moderate risk. They secretly turned the most dangerous trophies over to the Inquisition, alongside information about their suspicious suppliers. Information about this shadowy alliance was tightly controlled.
  - After: Kasballica agents traded cautiously, secretly feeding the Inquisition.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: When news of the death of the master of flesh reached him, Shairenkhei sent what was left of the Aeldari ships to the most distant stars of the Expanse. There, hidden from human eyes with xenotech and sorcery, the Aeldari carried on their humble existence and even managed to establish a few contacts among trusted mon-keigh, who helped the xenos in return for knowledge and technology.
  - After: After the master of flesh died, Shairenkhei hid the surviving Aeldari in far stars, trading knowledge with trusted mon-keigh.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: When the von Valancius protectorate perished under the retaliatory strikes of resentful citizens of the Expanse, many servants of the Rogue Trader found sanctuary and a new way of life in this powerful organisation. The Kasballica Mission did not forget the kindness shown to it.
  - After: When the protectorate fell, many von Valancius servants found refuge in the grateful Kasballica Mission.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Memories of the adversity they suffered and of their fallen home filled the hearts of both commoners and nobles with hatred for the Ruinous Powers. That loathing fuelled the building of a kingdom of intolerance and strict order on New Rykad. Proclaiming prayers to the Emperor, they kept vigilant watch for any signs of corruption in their home and surrounding colonies and regularly embarked on "purging campaigns" on nearby colonies that resembled military invasions.
  - After: Hating the Ruinous Powers, the survivors built a strict, intolerant kingdom on New Rykad, launching "purging campaigns" on nearby colonies.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The corrupted harvest from Janus was eradicated from Footfall's agro-chapels, but some of it remained in underground nurseries. The starving were ready to commit heinous acts for a handful of food, or even a sip of fermented rotgut. Illegal drinks made from the fruits of Janus sparked sinister rage and a thirst for violence in the hearts of the peasantry, spawning riots and stirring up the worst vices of the common folk.
  - After: Janus's corrupted harvest lingered in Footfall's underground nurseries. Rotgut brewed from it drove the starving to rage and riots.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The schism of Discontinuing the Cycle engulfed the entire Cognisance Fleet, and soon the civil war was over. Disregarding the commandments of their forefathers, the Explorators started down a dangerous path of new comprehension, creation, and revision of procedures and algorithms. The fleet was united once more, and in its unity, it was ready to stare down any horrors standing in the way of the Catechism of Maintenance and Operation.
  - After: The Discontinuing the Cycle schism took the whole Cognisance Fleet. Reunited, the Explorators boldly revised ancient procedures.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Cassia Orsellio died on Epitaph, and her death became the undoing of her noble House. In her last moments, tormented by fear and sorrow, she let out a scream so full of despair that every Navigator of her bloodline heard it. Echoing her cry, they all lost their minds in that instant and became loathsome monstrosities. House Orsellio fell, and its inhabitants were buried in the ruins.
  - After: Cassia Orsellio died on Epitaph. Her dying scream drove every Navigator of her bloodline mad and monstrous. House Orsellio fell into ruin.

## World/Dialogs/Epilogues/Epilogue_dialogue

- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The C'tan Shard was destroyed. The shadow of calamity threatening the Koronus Expanse should the ancient god ever be unshackled had been lifted... at least, for a time.
  - After: The C'tan Shard was destroyed, its threat lifted... for a time.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Yet cruelty, intolerance, and corruption grew like festering sores throughout the sector. Only the Rogue Trader's constant oversight could keep the pestilence at bay.
  - After: Yet corruption festered, held back only by the Rogue Trader's vigilance.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The von Valancius dynasty was given the privilege of becoming the stewards of the Expanse. The Rogue Trader led many campaigns of conquest against xenos enclaves and heretic nests. Karrad Vall, an infamous disciple of the Ruinous Powers, gathered forces in corrupted systems to challenge the Defender of the Creed. A great confrontation was unavoidable.
  - After: Von Valancius became steward of the Expanse. Karrad Vall, a Chaos disciple, rose against the Defender of the Creed.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The C'tan Shard, a deity from a forgotten era, was enslaved by the Rogue Trader. The Empyrean above the Koronus Expanse trembled, touched by the winds of great change.
  - After: The Rogue Trader enslaved the C'tan Shard. The warp trembled.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Nomos did not have long to learn their new powers. At the bidding of the Dark Gods, {name} von Valancius imprisoned them within the Yoke, turning them into {mf|his|her} shackled monster. The strange entity, imbued with a sliver of a Star God's power, was beyond the reach of the rulers of the warp. And, as such, they were dangerous and destined to be enslaved.
  - After: For the Dark Gods, {name} von Valancius bound Nomos in the Yoke as {mf|his|her} shackled monster.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: When the Rogue Trader rebelled against the Imperium, {mf|he|she} united heretics and enemies of the Creed in the Expanse around {mf|him|her}. No one was brave enough to challenge the {mf|master|mistress} of the enslaved stellar beast. Under the Rogue Trader's iron rule, a new legion of the Ruinous Powers was forming, welded together by fear and obedience.
  - After: Rebelling, {mf|he|she} united heretics. None defied the {mf|master|mistress} of the beast, and a Chaos legion rose, bound to {mf|him|her} by fear.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Protecting the young kingdom of freedom, Nomos created dimensional barriers that cut the Koronus Expanse off from the Imperium more soundly than the Great Rift. The Humanity of the Expanse was left in isolation. Relying only on themselves, they either had to build something new and different from the Imperium or fall to the horrors lurking in the darkness.
  - After: Nomos sealed the Expanse off from the Imperium. Isolated, it had to build anew or fall.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The C'tan Shard was transmuted into a new form, and their name was Nomos. Possessing the power of an ancient being and nurtured by the Rogue Trader, the young Star God watched over the Koronus Expanse, their new domain, with curiosity.
  - After: The C'tan Shard was reborn as Nomos, a young Star God curiously watching the Expanse.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Perceiving themselves as an entity deeply beholden to the Emperor, at the very least on account of their unholy existence, Nomos exterminated corruption with extra zeal, sometimes razing entire worlds. Weaknesses of human nature, such as doubt, mercy, or self-loathing, were unknown to the God-Emperor's perfect Beast.
  - After: Nomos, the God-Emperor's merciless Beast, purged corruption, sometimes razing whole worlds.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The C'tan Shard and its merciless and enlightened harbinger, once bearing the name of {name} von Valancius, left the Koronus Expanse. The trivial concerns of short-lived species were of no interest to them. Stellar winds carried them to other dimensions, toward deeds befitting their wisdom and glory. The echoes of these deeds will ripple through the universe, fracturing the bones of existence as we know it.
  - After: The C'tan Shard and its harbinger, once {name} von Valancius, left for other dimensions and world-breaking deeds.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Returning victorious, the Lord Inquisitor entrusted the heavy burden of watching over the Expanse to his loyal ally from the von Valancius dynasty. For him, it was time to change.
  - After: The Lord Inquisitor left the Expanse in von Valancius's care. He would change.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Gathering its bleeding worlds together again, the Rogue Trader dared to build something more noble and civilised in the Expanse — a haven for those drifting and unprotected in the strict hierarchy of the Imperium. It would be an unbound frontier, where freedom and compassion were not wholly extinct.
  - After: The Rogue Trader rebuilt a freer, kinder frontier.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Koronus Expanse became the hunting grounds of the new wicked sovereign of the von Valancius dynasty. From the ruins of the old order, a new kingdom was born — one that worshipped the Dark Gods of the warp. The formation of a new gargantuan punitive squadron began in the Calixis Sector. However, no one knew if it would make it through the furious warp storms of the Great Rift.
  - After: The Expanse became a Chaos kingdom. Calixis sent a punitive fleet, if it could cross the Great Rift.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Across many systems, power was seized by heresiarchs and pirate leaders. When they failed to find a common enemy, they turned their weapons on each other, and the Expanse sank into even darker depths of bloody anarchy.
  - After: Heresiarchs and pirates seized power, then fought each other into anarchy.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: The Lord Inquisitor delved deeper and deeper into dangerous and obscure fields of study. Having succeeded in shackling one ancient beast, he now wanted to repeat his success. The Imperium would never be safe while its enemies yet lived.
  - After: The Lord Inquisitor sought to shackle another ancient beast.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: After being given to Trazyn the Infinite by Rogue Trader von Valancius, the C'tan Shard vanished without a trace along with its new owner. And it seemed that all the calamities heralded for the Koronus Expanse with the Star God's impending awakening vanished along with them.
  - After: Given to Trazyn the Infinite, the C'tan Shard vanished, and the foretold calamities with it.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Gazing upon the drained and crippled worlds, the Rogue Trader saw innumerable opportunities for the growth of {mf|his|her} dynasty. From the ashes of decades of relative peace, a new ambitious power was set to rise.
  - After: In the crippled worlds, the Rogue Trader saw room for {mf|his|her} dynasty.
- **(conversation owner)**
  - Before: Having tamed a deity, the von Valancius dynasty became the dominant power in the Expanse. Of course, news of the horrible monster that {name} von Valancius was using to terrorise the entire sector would sooner or later reach the Imperium and prompt a punitive expedition, but... the Rogue Trader was given plenty of time to prepare.
  - After: With a tamed deity, {name} von Valancius ruled the Expanse. The Imperium would strike back, eventually.
